q.en: Which of these is the correct body name, not a nickname, for the private part most boys have?
q.hg: Inme se kaunsa sahi body name hai, nickname nahi, jo zyada-tar boys ke private part ka hai?

options.en: Penis
options.hg: Penis

options.en: Susu
options.hg: Susu

options.en: Nunu
options.hg: Nunu

options.en: Pippi
options.hg: Pippi

explain.en: Nicknames are fine at home, but 'penis' is the real name, just like 'elbow'. Knowing it helps a child tell a parent or doctor exactly what hurts or what happened.
explain.hg: Ghar pe nickname chalta hai, par asli naam 'penis' hai, bilkul 'elbow' jaisa. Asli naam pata ho toh bachcha parent ya doctor ko saaf bata sakta hai ki kya dard hai ya kya hua.

q.en: Most girls have a private part on the outside of the body, between the legs. What is it called?
q.hg: Zyada-tar girls ke body ke bahar, legs ke beech, ek private part hota hai. Uska naam kya hai?

options.en: Vagina
options.hg: Vagina

options.en: Navel
options.hg: Navel (naabhi)

options.en: Bladder
options.hg: Bladder

options.en: Vulva
options.hg: Vulva

explain.en: The vulva is everything on the outside. The vagina is a different part: a passage inside the body. Many people mix them up, so using the right word matters.
explain.hg: Bahar jo dikhta hai, woh sab vulva hai. Vagina alag part hai: body ke andar ek raasta. Log aksar dono ko mix kar dete hain, isliye sahi word use karna zaroori hai.

q.en: Which parts of the body are called private parts?
q.hg: Body ke kaunse parts ko private parts kehte hain?

options.en: Any part of you that feels ticklish
options.hg: Jo bhi part gudgudi mehsoos kare

options.en: Only the parts inside your tummy
options.hg: Sirf pet ke andar wale parts

options.en: The parts covered by your underwear
options.hg: Jo parts underwear se dhake rehte hain

options.en: Only your face and your hands
options.hg: Sirf chehra aur haath

explain.en: Private parts are the parts covered by underwear: the penis, testicles, vulva and bottom. Chests and nipples are also kept private. They are yours, and nobody should touch or look at them without a good, safe reason.
explain.hg: Private parts woh hain jo underwear se dhake rehte hain: penis, testicles, vulva aur bottom. Chest aur nipples bhi private rakhe jaate hain. Yeh tumhare hain, aur bina safe wajah ke koi inhe chhu ya dekh nahi sakta.

q.en: Is it rude to say the words 'penis' or 'vulva'?
q.hg: Kya 'penis' ya 'vulva' bolna gandi baat hai?

options.en: Only doctors in hospitals can use them
options.hg: Sirf hospital ke doctor bol sakte hain

options.en: No, they are proper names like knee or elbow
options.hg: Nahi, yeh knee ya elbow jaise sahi naam hain

options.en: Yes, they are bad words children must not say
options.hg: Haan, yeh gande words hain, bachche nahi bolte

options.en: Only grown-ups are allowed to say them
options.hg: Sirf bade log hi bol sakte hain

explain.en: These are the real names of body parts, not bad words. Children who know them can explain clearly if something hurts or if someone touched them in a way that felt wrong.
explain.hg: Yeh body parts ke asli naam hain, gande words nahi. Jo bachche yeh naam jaante hain, woh saaf bata paate hain agar kuch dard ho ya kisi ne galat tareeke se chhua ho.

q.en: If your private part hurts or itches, what should you do?
q.hg: Agar tumhare private part mein dard ya khujli ho, toh kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Tell a parent or trusted grown-up
options.hg: Parent ya kisi trusted bade ko batao

options.en: Keep quiet because it is embarrassing
options.hg: Chup raho, kyunki sharam ki baat hai

options.en: Wait many weeks for it to go away
options.hg: Kai hafte wait karo, apne aap theek hoga

options.en: Only tell a friend in your class
options.hg: Sirf class ke kisi dost ko batao

explain.en: A hurting private part is like a hurting ear: it may need care. Telling a parent or trusted adult means they can help, or take you to a doctor. It is nothing to be ashamed of.
explain.hg: Private part mein dard bhi kaan ke dard jaisa hai: dhyan dena padta hai. Parent ya trusted bade ko bataoge toh woh help karenge ya doctor ke paas le jaayenge. Isme sharam ki koi baat nahi.

q.en: When is it okay for a doctor to check your private parts?
q.hg: Doctor tumhare private parts kab check kar sakte hain?

options.en: Whenever a stranger says it is fine
options.hg: Jab bhi koi anjaan aadmi bole ki theek hai

options.en: Only if you promise to keep it secret
options.hg: Sirf tab jab tum secret rakhne ka promise karo

options.en: Never, not even if you are badly hurt
options.hg: Kabhi nahi, chahe kitna bhi dard ho

options.en: When you are sick and a parent is with you
options.hg: Jab tum beemar ho aur parent saath ho

explain.en: A doctor may need to check you when you are unwell, with a parent or trusted adult in the room. A real check-up is never a secret, and the doctor explains what they are doing.
explain.hg: Jab tum beemar ho, doctor ko check karna pad sakta hai, parent ya trusted bade ke saamne. Asli check-up kabhi secret nahi hota, aur doctor batata hai ki kya kar raha hai.

q.en: What is the best way to keep your body clean?
q.hg: Body ko saaf rakhne ka sabse achha tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Use lots of powder instead of bathing
options.hg: Nahane ki jagah bahut saara powder lagao

options.en: Wash only your face and your feet
options.hg: Sirf chehra aur pair dho lo

options.en: Bathe every day and wash hands with soap
options.hg: Roz nahao aur haath sabun se dho

options.en: Bathe only on days you look dirty
options.hg: Sirf tab nahao jab gande dikho

explain.en: A daily bath washes away sweat and germs you cannot see, and soapy hands stop germs reaching your mouth. Powder or perfume only covers smells; it does not clean.
explain.hg: Roz nahane se paseena aur woh germs nikal jaate hain jo dikhte nahi, aur sabun se haath dhone se germs muh tak nahi pahunchte. Powder ya perfume sirf smell chhupata hai, saaf nahi karta.

q.en: When should you wash your hands with soap?
q.hg: Haath sabun se kab dhone chahiye?

options.en: Only after playing in mud
options.hg: Sirf mitti mein khelne ke baad

options.en: After the toilet and before eating
options.hg: Toilet ke baad aur khaane se pehle

options.en: Only when they look dirty
options.hg: Sirf jab gande dikhen

options.en: Only once a day at bedtime
options.hg: Din mein ek baar, sone se pehle

explain.en: Germs from the toilet can stay on hands even when they look clean. Washing with soap after the toilet and before eating stops tummy infections and keeps everyone healthy.
explain.hg: Toilet ke germs haath pe reh jaate hain, chahe haath saaf dikhen. Toilet ke baad aur khaane se pehle sabun se haath dhone se pet ke infection nahi hote.

q.en: Who is allowed to take photos of your private parts?
q.hg: Tumhare private parts ki photo kaun le sakta hai?

options.en: Nobody at all
options.hg: Koi bhi nahi

options.en: A friend, if they ask nicely
options.hg: Dost, agar pyaar se maange

options.en: An older cousin you like
options.hg: Koi bada cousin jo tumhe pasand ho

options.en: Anyone you know very well
options.hg: Koi bhi jise tum achhe se jaante ho

explain.en: Nobody should take photos of your private parts, not even someone you know and like. If anyone tries or asks, say no, move away and tell a grown-up you trust. It is never your fault.
explain.hg: Koi bhi tumhare private parts ki photo nahi le sakta, chahe tum use jaante ho ya pasand karte ho. Koi try kare ya maange toh 'no' bolo, wahan se hato aur kisi trusted bade ko batao. Tumhari galti kabhi nahi hoti.

q.en: Which of these do all children have, whether they are boys or girls?
q.hg: Inme se kya sab bachchon ke paas hota hai, chahe boy ho ya girl?

options.en: A penis and testicles
options.hg: Penis aur testicles

options.en: A vulva and a vagina
options.hg: Vulva aur vagina

options.en: A moustache and beard
options.hg: Moonchh aur daadhi

options.en: Nipples and a bottom
options.hg: Nipples aur bottom

explain.en: Everyone has nipples and a bottom. Most boys have a penis and testicles and most girls have a vulva and vagina, while a moustache usually appears only after puberty.
explain.hg: Sabke paas nipples aur bottom hote hain. Zyada-tar boys ke paas penis aur testicles, aur zyada-tar girls ke paas vulva aur vagina hoti hai. Moonchh aam taur pe puberty ke baad aati hai.

q.en: Bodies can be tall or short, dark or fair, and some people use glasses or a wheelchair. Which is true?
q.hg: Body lambi ya chhoti, saanvli ya gori ho sakti hai, aur kuch log chashma ya wheelchair use karte hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Fair skin is better than dark skin
options.hg: Gori skin saanvli se better hai

options.en: All bodies should look the same
options.hg: Sab bodies ek jaisi honi chahiye

options.en: Every body is a good body
options.hg: Har body achhi body hai

options.en: Only tall bodies are healthy
options.hg: Sirf lambi body healthy hoti hai

explain.en: Bodies come in many shapes, sizes and colours, and none is better than another. Teasing someone about their body is unkind; what matters is being healthy and kind.
explain.hg: Body alag-alag shape, size aur rang mein aati hai, aur koi kisi se better nahi. Kisi ki body ka mazaak udana galat hai; zaroori hai healthy rehna aur sabke saath achha rehna.

q.en: Someone asks to see your private parts. What should you do?
q.hg: Koi tumse tumhare private parts dikhane ko kahe. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Do it if they give you a chocolate
options.hg: Chocolate mile toh dikha do

options.en: Say no, go away, tell a grown-up you trust
options.hg: Mana karo, wahan se jao, trusted bade ko batao

options.en: Show them if they are older than you
options.hg: Agar woh tumse bade hain toh dikha do

options.en: Keep it secret so nobody gets upset
options.hg: Secret rakho taaki koi naraz na ho

explain.en: Your private parts are private. If anyone asks to see them, even someone you know, you can say NO, move away and tell a trusted adult. Keep telling until someone helps.
explain.hg: Tumhare private parts private hain. Koi bhi dekhne ko kahe, chahe jaan-pehchaan wala ho, tum NO bol sakte ho, wahan se hat sakte ho aur trusted bade ko bata sakte ho. Jab tak koi help na kare, batate raho.

q.en: After using the toilet, which way should girls wipe or wash?
q.hg: Toilet ke baad girls ko kis direction mein wipe ya wash karna chahiye?

options.en: From front to back
options.hg: Aage se peeche ki taraf

options.en: From back to front
options.hg: Peeche se aage ki taraf

options.en: Round and round in circles
options.hg: Gol-gol ghumaate hue

options.en: It makes no difference
options.hg: Koi farak nahi padta

explain.en: Wiping from front to back keeps germs from the bottom away from the small opening where urine comes out. This helps prevent urine infections.
explain.hg: Aage se peeche wipe karne se bottom ke germs us chhote opening se door rehte hain jahan se susu aati hai. Isse urine infection se bachav hota hai.

q.en: What is the real name for the part of the body where a baby grows before it is born?
q.hg: Paida hone se pehle baby body ke jis part mein badhta hai, uska asli naam kya hai?

options.en: The stomach, where food goes
options.hg: Stomach, jahan khaana jaata hai

options.en: The bladder, where urine is kept
options.hg: Bladder, jahan susu rukti hai

options.en: The heart, in the chest
options.hg: Heart, chest ke andar

options.en: The uterus, or womb
options.hg: Uterus, yaani womb (garbhashay)

explain.en: Many children hear that a baby is in 'mummy's tummy', but it grows in the uterus, a special organ below the stomach. Food goes to the stomach; babies do not.
explain.hg: Bachche aksar sunte hain ki baby 'mummy ke pet' mein hai, par baby uterus mein badhta hai, jo stomach ke neeche ek alag organ hai. Khaana stomach mein jaata hai, baby nahi.

q.en: Your younger brother giggles when he reads the word 'vulva' in a science book. What could you tell him?
q.hg: Tumhara chhota bhai science book mein 'vulva' word padhke hasne lagta hai. Tum use kya bata sakte ho?

options.en: Only girls are allowed to say it
options.hg: Yeh sirf girls bol sakti hain

options.en: Books should never print such words
options.hg: Books mein aise words nahi hone chahiye

options.en: It is just the real name of a body part
options.hg: Yeh bas ek body part ka asli naam hai

options.en: It is a bad word he must never say
options.hg: Yeh gandi baat hai, kabhi mat bolna

explain.en: Giggling is normal when a word is new. Calmly saying it is just a body name, like nose or knee, teaches him that bodies are nothing to be ashamed of.
explain.hg: Naye word pe hasi aana normal hai. Shaanti se batao ki yeh bas body ka naam hai, nose ya knee jaisa. Isse woh seekhega ki body mein sharam wali koi baat nahi.

q.en: Why should you put on clean underwear every day?
q.hg: Roz saaf underwear kyun pehenna chahiye?

options.en: Underwear shrinks after one day
options.hg: Ek din mein underwear chhota ho jaata hai

options.en: Sweat and germs collect in worn underwear
options.hg: Pehne hue underwear mein paseena aur germs jama hote hain

options.en: Old underwear makes you grow slowly
options.hg: Purana underwear growth slow kar deta hai

options.en: It is a rule only for girls
options.hg: Yeh rule sirf girls ke liye hai

explain.en: Underwear worn all day collects sweat and germs, which can cause itching, rashes and smell. Clean, dry underwear every day keeps everyone, boys and girls, comfortable.
explain.hg: Din bhar pehne underwear mein paseena aur germs jama ho jaate hain, jisse khujli, rash aur smell ho sakti hai. Roz saaf, sookha underwear sabko, boys aur girls dono ko, comfortable rakhta hai.

q.en: Why is it useful for children to know the real names of private parts?
q.hg: Bachchon ko private parts ke asli naam pata hona kyun useful hai?

options.en: To tell a doctor or adult exactly what is wrong
options.hg: Doctor ya bade ko saaf bata sakein ki kya hua

options.en: So they can tease other kids with the words
options.hg: Taaki doosre bachchon ko chidha sakein

options.en: Because nicknames are against the law
options.hg: Kyunki nicknames law ke khilaaf hain

options.en: It is not useful; nicknames work better
options.hg: Koi faayda nahi, nicknames better hain

explain.en: Clear words help a child say exactly where it hurts or what happened. Adults understand quickly and can help sooner, which also keeps children safer.
explain.hg: Saaf words se bachcha bata sakta hai ki kahan dard hai ya kya hua. Bade jaldi samajhte hain aur jaldi help karte hain, isse bachche zyada safe bhi rehte hain.

q.en: Is it okay to close the bathroom door when you bathe or use the toilet?
q.hg: Kya nahate ya toilet use karte waqt bathroom ka darwaaza band karna theek hai?

options.en: No, children cannot have privacy
options.hg: Nahi, bachchon ki privacy nahi hoti

options.en: Only grown-ups may close the door
options.hg: Sirf bade darwaaza band kar sakte hain

options.en: Only when guests are at home
options.hg: Sirf jab ghar pe mehmaan hon

options.en: Yes, everyone deserves privacy
options.hg: Haan, sabko privacy ka haq hai

explain.en: As children grow, wanting privacy is natural and healthy. Closing the door while bathing or using the toilet is a normal way to keep your body private.
explain.hg: Badhte bachchon ka privacy chahna natural aur healthy hai. Nahate ya toilet karte waqt darwaaza band karna body ko private rakhne ka normal tareeka hai.

q.en: What is your belly button?
q.hg: Tumhara belly button (naabhi) kya hai?

options.en: A small hole that leads to your stomach
options.hg: Ek chhota chhed jo stomach tak jaata hai

options.en: A spot where extra food is stored
options.hg: Woh jagah jahan extra khaana jama hota hai

options.en: Where your cord was attached before birth
options.hg: Jahan paida hone se pehle cord judi thi

options.en: The opening a baby comes out of at birth
options.hg: Woh jagah jahan se baby bahar aata hai

explain.en: Before birth, a cord joined the baby to the mother and brought food and oxygen. After birth it is cut, and the belly button is where it was. It is not a hole into the stomach.
explain.hg: Paida hone se pehle ek cord baby ko maa se jodti hai aur khaana aur oxygen deti hai. Birth ke baad use kaat dete hain, aur belly button wahi jagah hai. Yeh stomach tak jaane wala chhed nahi hai.

q.en: You have a question about your body that feels a bit embarrassing. Who is a good person to ask?
q.hg: Tumhare mann mein body ke baare mein ek sawaal hai jo thoda sharmila lagta hai. Kisse poochna achha hai?

options.en: Strangers in an online game chat
options.hg: Online game chat ke anjaan log

options.en: A parent, teacher or doctor you trust
options.hg: Parent, teacher ya doctor jin pe bharosa ho

options.en: Nobody, because body questions are rude
options.hg: Kisi se nahi, body ke sawaal gande hain

options.en: Only friends who are your own age
options.hg: Sirf apni umar ke dost

explain.en: Body questions are normal and not rude. A trusted adult or doctor can give correct answers, while friends may guess and strangers online may not be safe.
explain.hg: Body ke sawaal normal hain, gande nahi. Trusted bade ya doctor sahi jawaab dete hain, jabki dost andaza laga sakte hain aur online anjaan log safe nahi bhi ho sakte.

q.en: What is the opening that poo comes out of called?
q.hg: Jis opening se potty bahar aati hai, use kya kehte hain?

options.en: Anus
options.hg: Anus

options.en: Urethra
options.hg: Urethra

options.en: Navel
options.hg: Navel (naabhi)

options.en: Vagina
options.hg: Vagina

explain.en: Poo leaves through the anus. Urine leaves through a different small tube called the urethra. Everyone has an anus, whatever their body.
explain.hg: Potty anus se bahar aati hai. Susu ek alag chhoti tube se nikalti hai jise urethra kehte hain. Anus sabke paas hota hai.

q.en: Most boys have two testicles. Where are they?
q.hg: Zyada-tar boys ke do testicles hote hain. Woh kahan hote hain?

options.en: Inside the stomach, near the navel
options.hg: Pet ke andar, naabhi ke paas

options.en: Inside the bladder, with the urine
options.hg: Bladder ke andar, susu ke saath

options.en: Under the skin of the thighs
options.hg: Thighs ki skin ke neeche

options.en: In a pouch of skin called the scrotum
options.hg: Scrotum naam ki skin ki thaili mein

explain.en: The testicles hang in the scrotum, a soft pouch of skin behind the penis. From puberty they make sperm and the hormone testosterone.
explain.hg: Testicles scrotum mein latakte hain, jo penis ke peeche skin ki ek naram thaili hai. Puberty se yeh sperm aur testosterone hormone banane lagte hain.

q.en: When you were small, a parent helped you bathe. As you grow older, what usually changes?
q.hg: Jab tum chhote the, parent nahane mein help karte the. Bade hone pe aam taur pe kya badalta hai?

options.en: Any visitor may now help you bathe
options.hg: Ab koi bhi mehmaan nahane mein help kar sakta hai

options.en: You must bathe together with friends
options.hg: Doston ke saath milke nahana padta hai

options.en: You learn to wash your own private parts
options.hg: Tum apne private parts khud dhona seekhte ho

options.en: You stop needing to bathe every day
options.hg: Roz nahane ki zaroorat khatam ho jaati hai

explain.en: Growing up means taking care of your own body, including washing your private parts yourself. It also means more privacy, not less.
explain.hg: Bade hone ka matlab hai apni body ka khud khayal rakhna, private parts khud dhona bhi. Iska matlab privacy badhna bhi hai, kam hona nahi.

q.en: In a body with a vulva, there are three openings between the legs. Which one does urine come out of?
q.hg: Jis body mein vulva hoti hai, legs ke beech teen openings hote hain. Susu kis opening se aati hai?

options.en: The navel
options.hg: Navel (naabhi)

options.en: The urethra
options.hg: Urethra

options.en: The vagina
options.hg: Vagina

options.en: The anus
options.hg: Anus

explain.en: From front to back the openings are the urethra (urine), the vagina and the anus (poo). Many people think girls pee from the vagina, but the urethra is a separate small opening.
explain.hg: Aage se peeche teen openings hain: urethra (susu), vagina aur anus (potty). Bahut log sochte hain girls vagina se susu karti hain, par urethra ek alag chhota opening hai.

q.en: Why should you dry yourself well, including between the legs and toes, after a bath?
q.hg: Nahane ke baad body achhe se, legs ke beech aur ungliyon ke beech bhi, kyun sukhani chahiye?

options.en: Damp skin can let itchy fungal rashes grow
options.hg: Geeli skin pe khujli wala fungal rash ho sakta hai

options.en: Water on skin makes you grow shorter
options.hg: Skin pe paani rehne se height kam hoti hai

options.en: Drying is only needed in winter
options.hg: Sukhana sirf sardi mein zaroori hai

options.en: Wet skin is cleaner than dry skin
options.hg: Geeli skin sookhi skin se zyada saaf hai

explain.en: Fungus loves warm, damp folds of skin like the groin, underarms and between toes. Drying well and wearing dry cotton clothes helps prevent itchy rashes.
explain.hg: Fungus ko garam, geeli skin ki folds pasand hain, jaise groin, underarms aur pair ki ungliyon ke beech. Achhe se sukhane aur sookhe cotton kapde pehenne se khujli wala rash nahi hota.

q.en: What is puberty?
q.hg: Puberty kya hai?

options.en: An illness that teenagers catch from others
options.hg: Ek beemari jo teenagers ek-doosre se pakadte hain

options.en: A single birthday when you become an adult
options.hg: Ek birthday jis din tum adult ban jaate ho

options.en: A change that happens only to girls
options.hg: Ek badlaav jo sirf girls mein hota hai

options.en: Years when a child's body slowly becomes adult
options.hg: Woh saal jab bachche ki body dheere-dheere adult banti hai

explain.en: Puberty is a slow process over a few years in which the body grows, changes shape and the reproductive organs start working. It happens to everyone, boys and girls, and is not an illness.
explain.hg: Puberty kuch saalon ka dheema process hai jisme body badhti hai, shape badalti hai aur reproductive organs kaam karna shuru karte hain. Yeh sabke saath hota hai, boys aur girls dono, aur yeh beemari nahi hai.

q.en: Which is the usual age range for puberty to begin in boys?
q.hg: Boys mein puberty aam taur pe kis umar ke beech shuru hoti hai?

options.en: Between 16 and 20
options.hg: 16 aur 20 ke beech

options.en: Exactly at 13 for all
options.hg: Sabki theek 13 pe

options.en: Between 9 and 14
options.hg: 9 aur 14 ke beech

options.en: Between 5 and 7
options.hg: 5 aur 7 ke beech

explain.en: Boys usually start between 9 and 14, and girls between 8 and 13. That is why classmates of the same age can look very different, and both early and late starters within this range are normal.
explain.hg: Boys mein yeh aksar 9 se 14 ke beech shuru hoti hai, aur girls mein 8 se 13 ke beech. Isliye ek hi umar ke classmates alag dikh sakte hain, aur is range mein jaldi ya der se shuru hona dono normal hai.

q.en: What is usually the very first sign of puberty in girls?
q.hg: Girls mein puberty ka sabse pehla sign aam taur pe kya hota hai?

options.en: Hair on the face
options.hg: Chehre pe baal

options.en: Small breast buds
options.hg: Chhote breast buds

options.en: The first period
options.hg: Pehla period

options.en: A much deeper voice
options.hg: Bahut bhaari awaaz

explain.en: For most girls the first sign is a breast bud, a small firm lump under the nipple. The first period usually comes later, about two years after breasts begin to develop.
explain.hg: Zyada-tar girls mein pehla sign breast bud hota hai, nipple ke neeche ek chhoti sakht gaanth. Pehla period baad mein aata hai, aksar breast badhna shuru hone ke lagbhag do saal baad.

q.en: What is usually the first sign of puberty in boys, one that is easy to miss?
q.hg: Boys mein puberty ka pehla sign kya hota hai, jo aksar notice nahi hota?

options.en: The testicles getting bigger
options.hg: Testicles ka bada hona

options.en: The voice starting to crack
options.hg: Awaaz ka phatna shuru hona

options.en: A moustache starting to show
options.hg: Moonchh dikhna shuru hona

options.en: The first wet dream
options.hg: Pehla wet dream

explain.en: In boys, the testicles grow first, which most people do not notice. Voice changes, facial hair and wet dreams usually come later in puberty.
explain.hg: Boys mein sabse pehle testicles bade hote hain, jo zyada-tar log notice nahi karte. Awaaz badalna, moonchh aur wet dreams aam taur pe baad mein aate hain.

q.en: Why does sweat start to smell during puberty?
q.hg: Puberty mein paseene se smell kyun aane lagti hai?

options.en: Fresh sweat always has a strong smell
options.hg: Taaza paseene mein hamesha tez smell hoti hai

options.en: Spicy food comes out through the skin
options.hg: Masaledaar khaana skin se bahar aata hai

options.en: It is a sign that you are unwell
options.hg: Yeh sign hai ki tum beemar ho

options.en: Bacteria on the skin break down the sweat
options.hg: Skin pe bacteria paseene ko break karte hain

explain.en: New sweat glands switch on in the armpits and groin. Fresh sweat barely smells; odour appears when skin bacteria break it down. Washing with soap fixes it better than perfume.
explain.hg: Armpits aur groin mein naye sweat glands chalu ho jaate hain. Taaza paseene mein smell nahi hoti; smell tab aati hai jab skin ke bacteria use break karte hain. Perfume se zyada sabun se dhona kaam karta hai.

q.en: After football, Rohan, 12, notices his armpits smell. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Football ke baad Rohan, 12, notice karta hai ki uske armpits se smell aa rahi hai. Sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Stop playing sports so he does not sweat
options.hg: Sports khelna band kar de taaki paseena na aaye

options.en: Ignore it, since only adults have body odour
options.hg: Ignore kare, body odour sirf badon ko hota hai

options.en: Bathe, wash armpits with soap, wear a clean shirt
options.hg: Nahaye, armpits sabun se dhoye, saaf shirt pehne

options.en: Spray deodorant over the sweat and carry on
options.hg: Paseene pe hi deodorant spray karke chal de

explain.en: Body odour is normal in puberty and is managed by washing. Deodorant can help after a bath, but spraying it on unwashed skin just mixes two smells. Sport is good for health; keep playing.
explain.hg: Puberty mein body odour normal hai aur dhone se control hota hai. Nahane ke baad deodorant help karta hai, par bina dhoye skin pe spray karne se bas do smell mix hoti hain. Sports health ke liye achha hai, khelte raho.

q.en: Do girls' voices change during puberty too?
q.hg: Kya puberty mein girls ki awaaz bhi badalti hai?

options.en: Only if they sing a lot
options.hg: Sirf agar woh bahut gaati hain

options.en: Yes, they get slightly deeper
options.hg: Haan, thodi si bhaari hoti hai

options.en: No, only boys' voices change
options.hg: Nahi, sirf boys ki awaaz badalti hai

options.en: Yes, they always get much higher
options.hg: Haan, hamesha bahut patli ho jaati hai

explain.en: Everyone's voice box grows in puberty. In boys the change is big and the voice may crack; in girls the voice deepens only a little, so it is easy to miss.
explain.hg: Puberty mein sabka voice box badhta hai. Boys mein badlaav bada hota hai aur awaaz phat sakti hai; girls mein awaaz bas thodi bhaari hoti hai, isliye pata kam chalta hai.

q.en: What is the bump at the front of the throat that grows in many boys during puberty?
q.hg: Puberty mein kai boys ke gale ke aage jo ubhaar banta hai, woh kya hai?

options.en: The growing voice box, or Adam's apple
options.hg: Badhta hua voice box, yaani Adam's apple

options.en: A swollen gland from an infection
options.hg: Infection se suji hui gland

options.en: Extra muscle built from exercise
options.hg: Exercise se bani extra muscle

options.en: A lump of fat that will melt away
options.hg: Charbi ki gaanth jo pighal jaayegi

explain.en: The larynx, or voice box, grows during puberty and in many boys it shows as a bump called the Adam's apple. Its growth is also why the voice deepens.
explain.hg: Puberty mein larynx yaani voice box badhta hai, aur kai boys mein woh gale pe ubhaar ki tarah dikhta hai jise Adam's apple kehte hain. Isi wajah se awaaz bhi bhaari hoti hai.

q.en: What is an erection?
q.hg: Erection kya hota hai?

options.en: A small bone in the penis moving upward
options.hg: Penis ki ek chhoti haddi ka upar uthna

options.en: A sign the bladder is too full of urine
options.hg: Sign ki bladder mein bahut susu bhari hai

options.en: A sign of an infection that needs medicine
options.hg: Infection ka sign jisme dawai chahiye

options.en: Blood filling the penis so it is firm for a while
options.hg: Penis mein blood bharna, jisse woh kuch der sakht ho

explain.en: An erection happens when extra blood flows into spongy tissue in the penis. There is no bone in it. Erections happen from babyhood and become more frequent in puberty.
explain.hg: Erection tab hota hai jab penis ke spongy tissue mein extra blood bhar jaata hai. Penis mein koi haddi nahi hoti. Erection bachpan se hote hain aur puberty mein zyada hone lagte hain.

q.en: Arjun, 12, gets an erection in class for no reason and is worried. What is true?
q.hg: Arjun, 12, ko class mein bina kisi wajah ke erection ho jaata hai aur woh pareshan hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: He must see a doctor the same day
options.hg: Use usi din doctor ke paas jaana chahiye

options.en: It only happens to boys who are unwell
options.hg: Yeh sirf beemar boys ko hota hai

options.en: It is common in puberty and goes down by itself
options.hg: Puberty mein yeh common hai aur apne aap theek hota hai

options.en: It means he was thinking dirty thoughts
options.hg: Iska matlab woh gande khayal soch raha tha

explain.en: In puberty, erections often happen for no reason at all, in class, on the bus or on waking. They go down on their own; sitting down or holding a bag in front helps meanwhile.
explain.hg: Puberty mein erection aksar bina wajah hote hain, class mein, bus mein ya subah uthte waqt. Yeh apne aap chale jaate hain; tab tak baith jaana ya bag aage pakad lena help karta hai.

q.en: What is a wet dream?
q.hg: Wet dream kya hota hai?

options.en: Sweating at night because of fever
options.hg: Bukhaar ki wajah se raat mein paseena

options.en: Semen coming out of the penis during sleep
options.hg: Sote waqt penis se semen nikalna

options.en: Wetting the bed with urine at night
options.hg: Raat mein bistar pe susu kar dena

options.en: A dream about rain or swimming
options.hg: Baarish ya swimming ka sapna

explain.en: A wet dream is when semen, a whitish sticky fluid, comes out during sleep. It is not urine, it cannot be controlled, and it is a normal part of puberty.
explain.hg: Wet dream mein sote waqt semen, ek safed chipchipa fluid, bahar aata hai. Yeh susu nahi hai, ise control nahi kar sakte, aur yeh puberty ka normal hissa hai.

q.en: Your younger brother wakes up with a sticky wet patch on his shorts and looks scared. What can you tell him?
q.hg: Tumhara chhota bhai subah shorts pe chipchipa geela daag dekh ke dar gaya hai. Tum use kya bata sakte ho?

options.en: It is a normal wet dream; just wash and change
options.hg: Yeh normal wet dream hai; bas dho ke kapde badal lo

options.en: He wet the bed and should drink less water
options.hg: Usne bistar geela kiya, paani kam piye

options.en: It means he is losing his body's strength
options.hg: Iska matlab uski body ki taakat kam ho rahi hai

options.en: He should hide the shorts from everyone
options.hg: Shorts sabse chhupa ke rakhe

explain.en: Wet dreams are an automatic part of puberty, not a weakness or a sign of bad thoughts. Rinsing the clothes and changing is all that is needed.
explain.hg: Wet dreams puberty ka automatic hissa hain, kamzori ya gande khayalon ka sign nahi. Bas kapde dho lo aur badal lo, itna kaafi hai.

q.en: Some boys have many wet dreams and some have none at all. What is true?
q.hg: Kuch boys ko bahut wet dreams hote hain aur kuch ko bilkul nahi. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Having none means a fertility problem
options.hg: Na hona fertility problem ka sign hai

options.en: Having many makes a boy weak
options.hg: Zyada hone se boy kamzor hota hai

options.en: They only stop after marriage
options.hg: Yeh sirf shaadi ke baad rukte hain

options.en: Both are completely normal
options.hg: Dono bilkul normal hain

explain.en: How often wet dreams happen varies a lot. Many or none, both are normal, and neither affects strength, health or the ability to have children later.
explain.hg: Wet dreams kitni baar hote hain, yeh sabme alag hota hai. Zyada ho ya bilkul na ho, dono normal hain, aur dono se taakat, health ya aage bachche hone ki ability pe koi asar nahi padta.

q.en: What is a breast bud?
q.hg: Breast bud kya hota hai?

options.en: A pimple growing under the skin
options.hg: Skin ke neeche badhta hua pimple

options.en: An insect bite that needs a cream
options.hg: Keede ka kaata jisme cream lagani ho

options.en: A small lump under the nipple as breasts begin
options.hg: Breast badhne ki shuruaat mein nipple ke neeche chhoti gaanth

options.en: An early sign of a serious breast disease
options.hg: Breast ki kisi gambhir beemari ka pehla sign

explain.en: A breast bud is the start of breast development: a small, firm lump under the nipple that can feel tender. It is normal, and full development takes several years.
explain.hg: Breast bud breast development ki shuruaat hai: nipple ke neeche ek chhoti, sakht gaanth jo thodi dard bhari lag sakti hai. Yeh normal hai, aur poora development kai saal leta hai.

q.en: Priya, 10, notices one breast has started to grow but the other has not. What is true?
q.hg: Priya, 10, dekhti hai ki ek breast badhna shuru ho gaya hai par doosra nahi. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It happened because of tight clothes
options.hg: Yeh tight kapdon ki wajah se hua

options.en: Common; one side often starts first
options.hg: Common hai; aksar ek side pehle shuru hoti hai

options.en: She needs to see a doctor right away
options.hg: Use turant doctor ke paas jaana chahiye

options.en: Only one breast will ever grow
options.hg: Sirf ek hi breast kabhi badhega

explain.en: One breast often starts growing months before the other, and adult breasts are often slightly different in size. This is a normal part of puberty.
explain.hg: Aksar ek breast doosre se kuch mahine pehle badhna shuru karta hai, aur bade hone pe bhi dono size mein thode alag hote hain. Yeh puberty ka normal hissa hai.

q.en: Kabir, 12, finds a small tender swelling under one nipple. What is the most likely reason?
q.hg: Kabir, 12, ko ek nipple ke neeche chhoti, dard wali sujan milti hai. Sabse zyada sambhav wajah kya hai?

options.en: A common, temporary puberty change
options.hg: Puberty ka common, temporary badlaav

options.en: He is turning into a girl
options.hg: Woh ladki ban raha hai

options.en: He ate too much chicken or milk
options.hg: Usne bahut chicken ya doodh khaaya

options.en: Breast cancer that needs surgery
options.hg: Breast cancer jiske liye surgery chahiye

explain.en: Many boys get a tender lump under a nipple in puberty because of shifting hormones. It usually settles within a year or two. See a doctor if it is painful, grows fast or worries him.
explain.hg: Kai boys ko puberty mein hormones badalne se nipple ke neeche dard wali gaanth hoti hai. Yeh aksar ek-do saal mein theek ho jaati hai. Bahut dard ho, tezi se badhe ya chinta ho toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: Why are many girls taller than boys in classes 6 and 7?
q.hg: Class 6 aur 7 mein kai girls boys se lambi kyun hoti hain?

options.en: Boys stop growing at around age 11
options.hg: Boys lagbhag 11 saal pe badhna band kar dete hain

options.en: Girls drink more milk than boys
options.hg: Girls boys se zyada doodh peeti hain

options.en: Boys sleep less than girls at that age
options.hg: Us umar mein boys girls se kam sote hain

options.en: Girls usually have their growth spurt earlier
options.hg: Girls ka growth spurt aksar pehle aata hai

explain.en: Girls' growth spurt often comes around 10 to 12 and boys' around 12 to 15. Boys catch up and often overtake later, so a height gap in middle school is temporary.
explain.hg: Girls ka growth spurt aksar 10 se 12 ke aas-paas aata hai aur boys ka 12 se 15 ke beech. Boys baad mein barabar ho jaate hain ya aage nikal jaate hain, isliye middle school ka height gap temporary hai.

q.en: Which helps most for healthy growth during puberty?
q.hg: Puberty mein healthy growth ke liye sabse zyada kya help karta hai?

options.en: Hanging from a bar for an hour every day
options.hg: Roz ek ghanta rod se latakna

options.en: Skipping meals to stay slim
options.hg: Patla rehne ke liye khaana chhodna

options.en: Regular meals, enough sleep and activity
options.hg: Time pe khaana, poori neend aur khel-kood

options.en: Height-increasing powders from TV adverts
options.hg: TV ads wale height badhane ke powder

explain.en: Height is mostly set by genes. What the body needs is fuel and rest: dal, eggs, milk or curd, vegetables, and enough sleep. Advertised height drinks and tricks cannot change your genes.
explain.hg: Height zyada-tar genes se tay hoti hai. Body ko chahiye khaana aur aaraam: dal, ande, doodh ya dahi, sabziyan aur poori neend. Advertised height drinks aur tricks genes nahi badal sakte.

q.en: Is removing body hair needed to stay clean?
q.hg: Kya saaf rehne ke liye body hair hataana zaroori hai?

options.en: Yes, before starting school
options.hg: Haan, school jaane se pehle

options.en: No, it is a personal choice
options.hg: Nahi, yeh apni marzi hai

options.en: Yes, body hair makes you dirty
options.hg: Haan, body hair se gandagi hoti hai

options.en: Yes, but only for girls
options.hg: Haan, par sirf girls ke liye

explain.en: Body hair is normal for everyone after puberty. Washing keeps you clean, with or without hair. Removing it is a personal choice, not a hygiene rule, for boys and girls alike.
explain.hg: Puberty ke baad body hair sabke liye normal hai. Baal ho ya na ho, dhone se hi safai hoti hai. Hataana apni marzi hai, hygiene ka rule nahi, boys aur girls dono ke liye.

q.en: Your friend wants to try shaving for the first time and plans to borrow his uncle's razor. What is the best advice?
q.hg: Tumhara dost pehli baar shave try karna chahta hai aur chacha ka razor lene wala hai. Sabse achhi salah kya hai?

options.en: Use your own razor; ask an adult to show you
options.hg: Apna razor lo; kisi bade se seekh lo

options.en: Borrowing is fine if the blade looks clean
options.hg: Blade saaf dikhe toh borrow karna theek hai

options.en: Shave on dry skin so it is quicker
options.hg: Sookhi skin pe shave karo, jaldi hoga

options.en: Shave daily so the hair grows thinner
options.hg: Roz shave karo taaki baal patle ho jaayen

explain.en: Razors should never be shared, because tiny cuts can pass on infections. Wetting the skin and having an adult show you how the first time prevents cuts and rashes.
explain.hg: Razor kabhi share nahi karna chahiye, kyunki chhote cuts se infection fail sakta hai. Skin geeli karke aur pehli baar kisi bade se seekh ke shave karne se cuts aur rash nahi hote.

q.en: Does shaving make hair grow back thicker or darker?
q.hg: Kya shave karne se baal zyada mote ya kaale wapas aate hain?

options.en: Yes, each shave doubles the hair
options.hg: Haan, har shave se baal double hote hain

options.en: Yes, but only on the face
options.hg: Haan, par sirf chehre pe

options.en: Yes, which is why girls must never shave
options.hg: Haan, isliye girls ko kabhi shave nahi karna chahiye

options.en: No, cut ends just feel blunt as they regrow
options.hg: Nahi, kate hue sire bas regrow hote waqt sakht lagte hain

explain.en: Shaving cuts hair at the surface; it does not touch the root, so it cannot change thickness, colour or speed of growth. Regrowing hair has a blunt tip, which feels coarser.
explain.hg: Shave baal ko upar se kaatta hai, root ko nahi chhoota, isliye moti, rang ya growth ki speed nahi badalti. Wapas aate baal ka sira kund hota hai, isliye sakht lagta hai.

q.en: Why do pimples become common in puberty?
q.hg: Puberty mein pimples itne common kyun ho jaate hain?

options.en: Not drinking enough water during the day
options.hg: Din mein kam paani peene se

options.en: Catching them from friends who have acne
options.hg: Acne wale doston se lag jaane se

options.en: Hormones make skin oilier and pores get blocked
options.hg: Hormones skin ko oily karte hain aur pores band hote hain

options.en: Eating mangoes and other 'heaty' foods
options.hg: Aam aur doosra 'garam' khaana khaane se

explain.en: Puberty hormones enlarge oil glands. When oil and dead skin block a pore, bacteria grow and a pimple forms. Acne is not caught from others, and gentle washing twice a day helps.
explain.hg: Puberty ke hormones oil glands ko bada karte hain. Jab oil aur dead skin pore band karte hain, bacteria badhte hain aur pimple banta hai. Acne kisi se lagta nahi, aur din mein do baar halke se face wash karna help karta hai.

q.en: Who goes through puberty?
q.hg: Puberty kisme hoti hai?

options.en: Only children who play sports
options.hg: Sirf woh bachche jo sports khelte hain

options.en: Everyone, though the changes differ
options.hg: Sabme, bas badlaav alag hote hain

options.en: Only girls, because of periods
options.hg: Sirf girls mein, periods ki wajah se

options.en: Only boys, because of the voice
options.hg: Sirf boys mein, awaaz ki wajah se

explain.en: Every child goes through puberty. Some changes, like growth, body hair, pimples and sweat, happen to everyone, while others differ between bodies.
explain.hg: Har bachcha puberty se guzarta hai. Kuch badlaav, jaise height, body hair, pimples aur paseena, sabme hote hain, aur kuch alag-alag bodies mein alag hote hain.

q.en: In the PT period, some classmates tease Neha for the hair on her arms. What is true?
q.hg: PT period mein kuch classmates Neha ko uske haathon ke baalon pe chidhate hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Body hair is normal and teasing is body-shaming
options.hg: Body hair normal hai, aur chidhana body-shaming hai

options.en: She must wax it so she looks clean
options.hg: Saaf dikhne ke liye use wax karna hi padega

options.en: Only boys are meant to have arm hair
options.hg: Haathon pe baal sirf boys ke hone chahiye

options.en: It shows her hormones are not working
options.hg: Yeh dikhata hai ki uske hormones kaam nahi kar rahe

explain.en: Hair on arms and legs is normal for girls and boys, and how much depends mainly on family genes. Commenting on someone's body hair, even as a joke, is body-shaming.
explain.hg: Haathon aur pairon pe baal girls aur boys dono ke liye normal hain, aur kitne honge yeh zyada-tar family genes pe depend karta hai. Kisi ke body hair pe comment karna, mazaak mein bhi, body-shaming hai.

q.en: What is the best way to wash the outside of the genitals every day?
q.hg: Genitals ka bahar ka hissa roz dhone ka sabse achha tareeka kya hai?

options.en: A strong antiseptic liquid every day
options.hg: Roz tez antiseptic liquid

options.en: Perfumed powder instead of washing
options.hg: Dhone ki jagah khushbu wala powder

options.en: Never wash there, it cleans itself
options.hg: Wahan kabhi mat dho, apne aap saaf hota hai

options.en: Water and a mild soap outside, then dry well
options.hg: Bahar paani aur mild sabun, phir achhe se sukhao

explain.en: Gentle washing of the outside with water, and mild soap if you like, then drying well is enough. Strong antiseptics and perfumed products can irritate sensitive skin.
explain.hg: Bahar se paani, aur chaho toh mild sabun, se halke se dhona aur phir achhe se sukhana kaafi hai. Tez antiseptic aur khushbu wale products naazuk skin ko irritate kar sakte hain.

q.en: What is the foreskin?
q.hg: Foreskin kya hoti hai?

options.en: Extra skin that every boy must have removed
options.hg: Extra skin jo har boy ko hatwani padti hai

options.en: The pouch of skin that holds the testicles
options.hg: Skin ki woh thaili jisme testicles hote hain

options.en: A loose fold of skin over the tip of the penis
options.hg: Penis ke sire ko dhakne wali dheeli skin

options.en: A skin infection that grows on the penis
options.hg: Penis pe hone wala ek skin infection

explain.en: The foreskin covers and protects the tip (glans) of the penis. Some boys have it removed by circumcision for religious, family or medical reasons; both are normal.
explain.hg: Foreskin penis ke sire (glans) ko dhakti aur bachati hai. Kuch boys ki dharmik, family ya medical wajah se circumcision mein hata di jaati hai; dono normal hain.

q.en: A boy's foreskin does not pull back fully at age 9. What is true?
q.hg: 9 saal ke ek boy ki foreskin poori peeche nahi hoti. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is a sign of a dangerous infection
options.hg: Yeh khatarnaak infection ka sign hai

options.en: Common; it loosens with age and must not be forced
options.hg: Common hai; umar ke saath dheeli hoti hai, zabardasti nahi

options.en: It should be pulled back hard every day
options.hg: Ise roz zor se peeche kheenchna chahiye

options.en: He needs an operation as soon as possible
options.hg: Use jaldi se jaldi operation chahiye

explain.en: In childhood the foreskin is often attached and may not pull back until the teen years. Forcing it can cause pain and scarring. See a doctor if it is painful, swollen or makes urinating hard.
explain.hg: Bachpan mein foreskin aksar judi rehti hai aur teen age tak peeche nahi hoti. Zabardasti karne se dard aur nishaan ho sakte hain. Dard, sujan ya susu karne mein dikkat ho toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: During a growth spurt, many teens feel clumsy. Why?
q.hg: Growth spurt ke time kai teens ko lagta hai ki woh baar-baar takra jaate hain. Kyun?

options.en: Hands and feet often grow before the rest
options.hg: Haath-pair aksar baaki body se pehle badhte hain

options.en: The brain shrinks during puberty
options.hg: Puberty mein dimaag chhota ho jaata hai

options.en: Bones become soft for a few years
options.hg: Kuch saal ke liye haddiyan naram ho jaati hain

options.en: It is a sign of a vitamin problem
options.hg: Yeh vitamin ki kami ka sign hai

explain.en: Body parts grow on different schedules: hands and feet first, then arms and legs, then the spine. The brain takes time to adjust to the new sizes, so some clumsiness is normal.
explain.hg: Body ke parts alag-alag time pe badhte hain: pehle haath-pair, phir baahein aur taangein, phir reedh ki haddi. Dimaag ko naye size ki aadat lagne mein time lagta hai, isliye thoda takrana normal hai.

q.en: Your cousin, 10, started puberty before all her friends and feels embarrassed. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhari cousin, 10, ne apne sab doston se pehle puberty shuru ki aur use sharam aati hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Early starters always stop growing at once
options.hg: Jaldi shuru karne wale turant badhna band kar dete hain

options.en: She must have done something to cause it
options.hg: Usne zaroor kuch kiya hoga jisse yeh hua

options.en: She will be the shortest adult in her class
options.hg: Woh class ki sabse chhoti adult banegi

options.en: Starting at 9 or at 13 are both normal
options.hg: 9 pe ya 13 pe shuru hona, dono normal hain

explain.en: The normal start for girls is anywhere from 8 to 13, and timing is mostly set by genes. Starting early is not caused by anything she did and says nothing about adult height.
explain.hg: Girls ke liye normal shuruaat 8 se 13 ke beech kabhi bhi ho sakti hai, aur timing zyada-tar genes se tay hoti hai. Jaldi shuru hona uski kisi harkat se nahi hua, aur isse adult height ka kuch pata nahi chalta.

q.en: A change in your body is worrying you. What is the best first step?
q.hg: Body mein koi badlaav tumhe pareshan kar raha hai. Sabse achha pehla kadam kya hai?

options.en: Believe the first video you find
options.hg: Jo pehla video mile, use maan lo

options.en: Only ask classmates to look at it
options.hg: Sirf classmates ko dikhao

options.en: Ask a trusted adult or a doctor
options.hg: Kisi trusted bade ya doctor se poochho

options.en: Hide it and hope it goes away
options.hg: Chhupao aur umeed karo ki chala jaaye

explain.en: Most body worries in puberty turn out to be normal, but only a trusted adult or doctor can tell you properly. Random videos often spread myths or try to sell you something.
explain.hg: Puberty ki zyada-tar body worries normal nikalti hain, par sahi se sirf trusted bade ya doctor hi bata sakte hain. Random videos aksar myths failate hain ya kuch bechna chahte hain.

q.en: Sahil notices that one of his testicles hangs a little lower than the other. What is true?
q.hg: Sahil dekhta hai ki uska ek testicle doosre se thoda neeche latakta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It must be fixed with surgery
options.hg: Ise surgery se theek karna padega

options.en: That is normal for most people
options.hg: Yeh zyada-tar logon mein normal hai

options.en: It is an early sign of cancer
options.hg: Yeh cancer ka pehla sign hai

options.en: He must have hurt it while playing
options.hg: Khelte waqt zaroor chot lagi hogi

explain.en: One testicle usually hangs lower than the other, and that is normal. What needs a doctor is a new hard lump, swelling or pain.
explain.hg: Aam taur pe ek testicle doosre se neeche latakta hai, aur yeh normal hai. Doctor ko dikhana tab chahiye jab nayi sakht gaanth, sujan ya dard ho.

q.en: A boy has sudden, severe pain in one testicle. What should happen?
q.hg: Ek boy ke ek testicle mein achanak bahut tez dard hota hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Go to a hospital immediately
options.hg: Turant hospital jaana chahiye

options.en: Wait a day to see if it passes
options.hg: Ek din wait karo, shayad chala jaaye

options.en: Rub some oil and lie down
options.hg: Thoda tel lagao aur let jao

options.en: Take a painkiller and sleep
options.hg: Painkiller lo aur so jao

explain.en: Sudden severe testicle pain can mean the testicle has twisted and lost its blood supply. This is an emergency that needs treatment within hours, so go to a hospital straight away.
explain.hg: Testicle mein achanak tez dard ka matlab ho sakta hai ki testicle ghoom gaya hai aur blood supply ruk gayi hai. Yeh emergency hai jiska ilaaj kuch ghanton mein chahiye, isliye seedha hospital jao.

q.en: Rahul, 13, sees thin lines on his back and thighs after growing taller fast. What are they most likely?
q.hg: Rahul, 13, tezi se lamba hone ke baad apni peeth aur thighs pe patli lines dekhta hai. Yeh sabse zyada kya ho sakti hain?

options.en: A skin disease that spreads
options.hg: Failne wali skin ki beemari

options.en: Scratches from his bedsheet
options.hg: Bedsheet se lagi kharonch

options.en: A sign of weak bones
options.hg: Kamzor haddiyon ka sign

options.en: Stretch marks from fast growth
options.hg: Tez growth se bane stretch marks

explain.en: When skin stretches quickly during a growth spurt, stretch marks often appear in boys and girls. They are harmless and usually fade with time.
explain.hg: Growth spurt mein jab skin tezi se khinchti hai, toh boys aur girls dono mein stretch marks aa jaate hain. Yeh harmless hain aur time ke saath halke ho jaate hain.

q.en: Which small gland at the base of the brain sends out hormones that switch on puberty?
q.hg: Dimaag ke neeche wali kaunsi chhoti gland hormones bhej ke puberty chalu karti hai?

options.en: The adrenal gland
options.hg: Adrenal gland

options.en: The salivary gland
options.hg: Salivary gland

options.en: The pituitary gland
options.hg: Pituitary gland

options.en: The thyroid gland
options.hg: Thyroid gland

explain.en: Signals from the brain wake up the pea-sized pituitary gland, which releases LH and FSH. These tell the testes or ovaries to start making adult levels of hormones.
explain.hg: Dimaag ke signal matar jitni pituitary gland ko jagaate hain, jo LH aur FSH chhodti hai. Yeh testes ya ovaries ko adult level ke hormones banane ka order dete hain.

q.en: Under the foreskin, a whitish substance can build up. What is the best habit?
q.hg: Foreskin ke neeche ek safed sa padarth jama ho sakta hai. Sabse achhi aadat kya hai?

options.en: Apply powder so it stays dry
options.hg: Powder lagao taaki sookha rahe

options.en: Gently pull it back if it moves easily and rinse
options.hg: Aaram se peeche ho toh peeche karke paani se dho lo

options.en: Scrub hard under it with strong soap
options.hg: Tez sabun se zor se ragdo

options.en: Leave it, washing there is harmful
options.hg: Chhod do, wahan dhona nuksaan karta hai

explain.en: Once the foreskin moves back easily, rinse underneath daily with water and bring it forward again. Never force it. Harsh scrubbing or soaps can irritate the skin.
explain.hg: Jab foreskin aaram se peeche hone lage, roz neeche paani se dho lo aur phir wapas aage kar do. Kabhi zabardasti mat karo. Tez sabun ya ragadne se skin irritate hoti hai.

q.en: Is waking up with an erection normal?
q.hg: Kya subah uthne pe erection hona normal hai?

options.en: Yes, it is common and healthy
options.hg: Haan, yeh common aur healthy hai

options.en: No, it means something is wrong
options.hg: Nahi, iska matlab kuch gadbad hai

options.en: Only if he had a bad dream
options.hg: Sirf agar bura sapna aaya ho

options.en: Only in boys who are ill
options.hg: Sirf beemar boys mein

explain.en: Erections often happen during sleep and on waking, and they are a sign the body is working normally. They go down on their own.
explain.hg: Erection aksar neend mein aur subah uthte waqt hote hain, aur yeh sign hai ki body normal kaam kar rahi hai. Yeh apne aap chale jaate hain.

q.en: Which statement about testosterone and oestrogen is true?
q.hg: Testosterone aur oestrogen ke baare mein kaunsi baat sach hai?

options.en: Boys make only testosterone, never oestrogen
options.hg: Boys sirf testosterone banate hain, oestrogen kabhi nahi

options.en: Girls make only oestrogen, never testosterone
options.hg: Girls sirf oestrogen banati hain, testosterone kabhi nahi

options.en: Neither is made until the age of 18
options.hg: 18 saal tak dono mein se koi nahi banta

options.en: Every body makes both, in different amounts
options.hg: Har body dono banati hai, bas alag maatra mein

explain.en: These are not 'boy' and 'girl' hormones. Every body makes both. Oestrogen helps keep everyone's bones strong, and testosterone-type hormones cause pubic and underarm hair in all genders.
explain.hg: Yeh 'boy' aur 'girl' hormones nahi hain. Har body dono banati hai. Oestrogen sabki haddiyan mazboot rakhta hai, aur testosterone jaise hormones sab genders mein pubic aur underarm hair laate hain.

q.en: Where are sperm made?
q.hg: Sperm kahan bante hain?

options.en: In the bladder
options.hg: Bladder mein

options.en: In the kidneys
options.hg: Kidneys mein

options.en: In the testicles
options.hg: Testicles mein

options.en: In the prostate
options.hg: Prostate mein

explain.en: From puberty, the testicles make millions of sperm every day. The prostate and other glands add fluid to make semen, but they do not make sperm.
explain.hg: Puberty se testicles roz laakhon sperm banate hain. Prostate aur doosri glands fluid milaake semen banati hain, par sperm nahi banati.

q.en: Can urine and semen come out of the penis at the same moment?
q.hg: Kya penis se susu aur semen ek saath nikal sakte hain?

options.en: Only first thing in the morning
options.hg: Sirf subah-subah

options.en: No, a muscle closes the bladder at that moment
options.hg: Nahi, us waqt ek muscle bladder band kar deti hai

options.en: Yes, they always come out mixed together
options.hg: Haan, dono hamesha mix hoke nikalte hain

options.en: Yes, because semen is a kind of urine
options.hg: Haan, kyunki semen ek tarah ki susu hai

explain.en: Both leave through the urethra, but during ejaculation a ring of muscle at the bladder outlet closes. So urine and semen do not come out together, and semen is not urine.
explain.hg: Dono urethra se nikalte hain, par ejaculation ke waqt bladder ke muh pe ek muscle ka ring band ho jaata hai. Isliye susu aur semen ek saath nahi nikalte, aur semen susu nahi hai.

q.en: Which describes the vagina correctly?
q.hg: Vagina ka sahi description kaunsa hai?

options.en: A stretchy passage from the vulva to the uterus
options.hg: Vulva se uterus tak jaane wala lachila raasta

options.en: All the parts you can see on the outside
options.hg: Bahar dikhne wale saare parts

options.en: The small opening where urine comes out
options.hg: Woh chhota opening jahan se susu aati hai

options.en: A tube that carries eggs to the ovaries
options.hg: Ek tube jo eggs ko ovaries tak le jaati hai

explain.en: The vagina is an internal, muscular passage leading from the vulva up to the uterus. The outside parts are the vulva, and urine leaves through the separate urethra.
explain.hg: Vagina andar ka ek muscular raasta hai jo vulva se upar uterus tak jaata hai. Bahar ke parts vulva kehlate hain, aur susu alag urethra se nikalti hai.

q.en: What is the job of the fallopian tubes?
q.hg: Fallopian tubes ka kaam kya hai?

options.en: Carry urine from the kidneys to the bladder
options.hg: Susu ko kidneys se bladder tak le jaana

options.en: Make the hormone testosterone
options.hg: Testosterone hormone banana

options.en: Store period blood until it leaves
options.hg: Period ka blood nikalne tak jama rakhna

options.en: Carry the egg from the ovary to the uterus
options.hg: Egg ko ovary se uterus tak le jaana

explain.en: After an egg is released from an ovary, it is swept into a fallopian tube and moves towards the uterus. This is also where a sperm and egg can meet.
explain.hg: Ovary se egg nikalne ke baad woh fallopian tube mein jaata hai aur uterus ki taraf badhta hai. Sperm aur egg ka milna bhi aksar yahin hota hai.

q.en: Which is true about eggs in the ovaries?
q.hg: Ovaries ke eggs ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: Eggs only form after the first period
options.hg: Eggs sirf pehle period ke baad bante hain

options.en: Eggs are made only after marriage
options.hg: Eggs sirf shaadi ke baad bante hain

options.en: A girl is born with all the eggs she will have
options.hg: Girl paida hote hi saare eggs ke saath aati hai

options.en: New eggs are made fresh every single month
options.hg: Har mahine naye eggs bante hain

explain.en: Ovaries do not make new eggs. A baby girl is born with all her egg cells in an immature form, and from puberty a few ripen each cycle, usually with one released.
explain.hg: Ovaries naye eggs nahi banati. Baby girl apne saare egg cells ke saath paida hoti hai, kachchi form mein, aur puberty se har cycle mein kuch pakte hain, aksar ek bahar aata hai.

q.en: Sana, 15, notices that her inner labia are longer and darker than the outer ones. What is true?
q.hg: Sana, 15, dekhti hai ki uske inner labia outer labia se lambe aur zyada dark hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is a sign of an infection
options.hg: Yeh infection ka sign hai

options.en: This is a common, normal variation
options.hg: Yeh common, normal variation hai

options.en: She needs surgery to correct it
options.hg: Use theek karne ke liye surgery chahiye

options.en: It is caused by touching herself
options.hg: Yeh khud ko chhoone se hua

explain.en: Genitals vary as much as faces. Inner labia that are longer, darker or uneven are very common and healthy. See a doctor only for pain, sores, itching or unusual discharge.
explain.hg: Genitals chehron ki tarah alag-alag hote hain. Lambe, dark ya ek-doosre se alag inner labia bahut common aur healthy hain. Doctor ko sirf dard, chhaale, khujli ya ajeeb discharge pe dikhao.

q.en: Is it normal for one breast to be a little bigger than the other?
q.hg: Kya ek breast ka doosre se thoda bada hona normal hai?

options.en: Yes, it is very common
options.hg: Haan, yeh bahut common hai

options.en: No, it always needs treatment
options.hg: Nahi, iska hamesha ilaaj chahiye

options.en: Only during pregnancy
options.hg: Sirf pregnancy mein

options.en: Only if you sleep on one side
options.hg: Sirf agar ek side sote ho

explain.en: Most people's breasts are slightly different in size or shape. A new lump, skin changes or nipple discharge are the things to get checked, not normal unevenness.
explain.hg: Zyada-tar logon ke breasts size ya shape mein thode alag hote hain. Check tab karwana chahiye jab nayi gaanth, skin mein badlaav ya nipple se discharge ho, normal farak pe nahi.

q.en: Ria's nipples have always been turned inward, since puberty began. What is true?
q.hg: Ria ke nipples puberty shuru hone se hi andar ki taraf mude hue hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: They always mean a serious disease
options.hg: Yeh hamesha gambhir beemari ka sign hain

options.en: She will never be able to breastfeed
options.hg: Woh kabhi breastfeed nahi kar paayegi

options.en: They are caused by wearing a bra
options.hg: Yeh bra pehenne se hota hai

options.en: Lifelong inverted nipples are a normal variation
options.hg: Hamesha se andar mude nipples normal variation hain

explain.en: Nipples can be flat, raised or turned inward, and all are normal if they have always been that way. A nipple that newly turns inward in adulthood should be checked by a doctor.
explain.hg: Nipples flat, ubhre hue ya andar mude ho sakte hain, aur agar hamesha se aise hain toh sab normal hai. Agar bade hone ke baad koi nipple achanak andar mud jaaye, toh doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

q.en: What mostly decides the size and shape of breasts?
q.hg: Breasts ka size aur shape zyada-tar kis cheez se tay hota hai?

options.en: Massage oils and firming creams
options.hg: Massage oil aur firming creams

options.en: Drinking more milk in puberty
options.hg: Puberty mein zyada doodh peena

options.en: Genes and overall body build
options.hg: Genes aur body ki banawat

options.en: The type of bra a girl wears
options.hg: Girl kaunsa bra pehenti hai

explain.en: Breast size and shape depend mainly on genes and body build. No food, cream, oil or type of bra changes them; a bra is for comfort only.
explain.hg: Breast ka size aur shape mainly genes aur body build pe depend karta hai. Koi khaana, cream, tel ya bra inhe nahi badalta; bra sirf comfort ke liye hai.

q.en: An online advert promises an oil that will make the penis bigger. What is true?
q.hg: Ek online ad aisa tel bechta hai jo penis bada kar dega. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It works if a chemist recommends it
options.hg: Chemist bole toh kaam karta hai

options.en: No oil, pill or exercise can enlarge it
options.hg: Koi tel, goli ya exercise ise bada nahi kar sakti

options.en: It works if used every day for months
options.hg: Mahinon tak roz lagao toh kaam karta hai

options.en: It works only for boys under 18
options.hg: Sirf 18 se kam umar ke boys pe kaam karta hai

explain.en: Penis size is set by genes and puberty, and no oil, pill, device or exercise changes it. These products sell by creating worry and some can irritate or injure the skin.
explain.hg: Penis ka size genes aur puberty se tay hota hai, aur koi tel, goli, device ya exercise use nahi badalti. Aise products chinta paida karke bikte hain, aur kuch skin ko nuksaan bhi pahuncha sakte hain.

q.en: Is there a bone inside the human penis?
q.hg: Kya insaan ke penis mein haddi hoti hai?

options.en: No, erections come from blood flow
options.hg: Nahi, erection blood flow se hota hai

options.en: Yes, a small bone runs through it
options.hg: Haan, ek chhoti haddi hoti hai

options.en: Yes, but only after puberty
options.hg: Haan, par sirf puberty ke baad

options.en: Yes, it can break in a fall
options.hg: Haan, girne se toot sakti hai

explain.en: There is no bone in the human penis. An erection happens when spongy tissue fills with blood. It softens again when the blood flows back out.
explain.hg: Insaan ke penis mein koi haddi nahi hoti. Erection tab hota hai jab spongy tissue blood se bhar jaata hai. Blood wapas bahar jaate hi yeh phir naram ho jaata hai.

q.en: Which is true about penis size and fertility?
q.hg: Penis size aur fertility ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: A bigger penis makes more sperm
options.hg: Bade penis se zyada sperm bante hain

options.en: A smaller penis means no sperm
options.hg: Chhote penis ka matlab sperm nahi

options.en: Size decides if you can be a father
options.hg: Size tay karta hai ki baap ban sakte ho ya nahi

options.en: Size has no link to fertility
options.hg: Size ka fertility se koi lena-dena nahi

explain.en: Sperm are made in the testicles, and penis size has nothing to do with fertility. Size when soft also says little about size when erect.
explain.hg: Sperm testicles mein bante hain, aur penis size ka fertility se koi lena-dena nahi. Naram halat ka size bhi erect size ke baare mein zyada kuch nahi batata.

q.en: What does 'intersex' mean?
q.hg: 'Intersex' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Another word for being gay or lesbian
options.hg: Gay ya lesbian hone ka doosra naam

options.en: A body problem caused by parents' mistakes
options.hg: Parents ki galti se hui body problem

options.en: Born with sex traits not fitting typical male or female
options.hg: Aise sex traits ke saath paida hona jo typical male ya female mein fit na hon

options.en: An illness some people catch after birth
options.hg: Ek beemari jo kuch log paida hone ke baad pakadte hain

explain.en: Intersex variations are natural differences in chromosomes, hormones, internal organs or genitals. They are not an illness or anyone's fault, and they are about bodies, not sexual orientation.
explain.hg: Intersex variations chromosomes, hormones, andar ke organs ya genitals mein natural farak hain. Yeh beemari ya kisi ki galti nahi, aur yeh body ke baare mein hai, sexual orientation ke baare mein nahi.

q.en: When might someone find out they have an intersex variation?
q.hg: Kisi ko kab pata chal sakta hai ki unka intersex variation hai?

options.en: Only after they get married
options.hg: Sirf shaadi ke baad

options.en: At birth, at puberty, or sometimes never
options.hg: Birth pe, puberty mein, ya kabhi nahi

options.en: Only at birth, never later
options.hg: Sirf birth pe, baad mein kabhi nahi

options.en: Only through a test at age 18
options.hg: Sirf 18 saal pe ek test se

explain.en: Some intersex variations are noticed at birth, some only at puberty, for example when periods do not start, and some are never discovered. An intersex person may identify as a girl, a boy or neither.
explain.hg: Kuch intersex variations birth pe dikh jaate hain, kuch sirf puberty mein, jaise jab periods shuru na hon, aur kuch kabhi pata hi nahi chalte. Intersex insaan khud ko girl, boy ya dono mein se koi nahi maan sakta hai.

q.en: Vikram is 14 and has no signs of puberty yet, while his friends have moustaches. What is the best step?
q.hg: Vikram 14 ka hai aur abhi tak puberty ka koi sign nahi, jabki doston ki moonchh aa gayi hai. Sabse achha kadam kya hai?

options.en: See a doctor; most late starters just run late
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhaye; zyada-tar late starters bas late hote hain

options.en: Start protein powder and gym supplements
options.hg: Protein powder aur gym supplements shuru kare

options.en: Accept that he will never develop
options.hg: Maan le ki uska development kabhi nahi hoga

options.en: Wait until he turns 21 before asking
options.hg: 21 saal tak wait kare, phir poochhe

explain.en: No signs by 14 in boys, or by 13 in girls, is a good reason for a check-up. Most often it is a family pattern of late puberty and the person catches up fully.
explain.hg: Boys mein 14 tak, ya girls mein 13 tak koi sign na ho, toh check-up karwana sahi hai. Aksar yeh family mein late puberty ka pattern hota hai aur insaan baad mein poori tarah catch up kar leta hai.

q.en: At what point should a doctor check whether a girl's puberty is too early?
q.hg: Kab doctor ko check karna chahiye ki girl ki puberty bahut jaldi toh nahi shuru hui?

options.en: If signs appear before age 12
options.hg: Agar signs 12 saal se pehle dikhen

options.en: If her period comes before 15
options.hg: Agar period 15 se pehle aa jaaye

options.en: Never, early puberty is always fine
options.hg: Kabhi nahi, early puberty hamesha theek hai

options.en: If signs appear before age 8
options.hg: Agar signs 8 saal se pehle dikhen

explain.en: Breast development or pubic hair before 8 in girls, or before 9 in boys, is called early puberty and is worth checking. Starting at 9 to 12 is within the normal range for girls.
explain.hg: Girls mein 8 se pehle, ya boys mein 9 se pehle breast development ya pubic hair ho, toh ise early puberty kehte hain aur check karwana chahiye. Girls ke liye 9 se 12 pe shuru hona normal range mein hai.

q.en: In the changing room, classmates mock a boy for looking 'small' compared to them. What is true?
q.hg: Changing room mein classmates ek boy ka mazaak udaate hain ki woh unse 'chhota' dikhta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: He is less of a man than the others
options.hg: Woh baakiyon se kam mard hai

options.en: He should take hormone pills to catch up
options.hg: Use catch up karne ke liye hormone goliyan leni chahiye

options.en: Bodies develop at different times; mocking is shaming
options.hg: Bodies alag time pe develop hoti hain; mazaak udana shaming hai

options.en: He will stay small and undeveloped for life
options.hg: Woh zindagi bhar chhota aur undeveloped rahega

explain.en: Puberty starts and moves at different speeds, so any changing room has bodies at every stage. Late developers catch up. Mocking someone's body is body-shaming and can hurt for years.
explain.hg: Puberty alag-alag time aur speed pe hoti hai, isliye changing room mein har stage ki body hoti hai. Late developers baad mein catch up karte hain. Kisi ki body ka mazaak body-shaming hai aur saalon tak chubhta hai.

q.en: A clear or white discharge in the underwear, in a girl who has started puberty, usually means what?
q.hg: Puberty shuru ho chuki girl ke underwear mein saaf ya safed discharge aam taur pe kya darshata hai?

options.en: She is not bathing properly
options.hg: Woh theek se nahi naha rahi

options.en: The vagina is cleaning itself, which is normal
options.hg: Vagina khud ko saaf kar rahi hai, jo normal hai

options.en: She has caught an infection
options.hg: Use infection ho gaya hai

options.en: She is losing strength from her body
options.hg: Uski body se taakat nikal rahi hai

explain.en: Clear or white discharge is the vagina's natural way of cleaning itself and often starts months before the first period. Its amount and texture change through the cycle.
explain.hg: Saaf ya safed discharge vagina ka khud ko saaf karne ka natural tareeka hai, aur aksar pehle period se kuch mahine pehle shuru hota hai. Iski maatra aur texture cycle ke saath badalte rehte hain.

q.en: Which kind of vaginal discharge is a reason to see a doctor?
q.hg: Kis tarah ke vaginal discharge pe doctor ko dikhana chahiye?

options.en: Green or grey, smelly and itchy
options.hg: Hara ya grey, badboo aur khujli ke saath

options.en: Clear and stretchy, like egg white
options.hg: Saaf aur khinchne wala, ande ki safedi jaisa

options.en: White and creamy before a period
options.hg: Period se pehle safed aur creamy

options.en: A small amount on underwear daily
options.hg: Roz underwear pe thoda sa

explain.en: Clear, white or creamy discharge that changes through the cycle is normal. Discharge that turns grey, green or yellow, smells strong, or comes with itching or burning should be checked.
explain.hg: Saaf, safed ya creamy discharge jo cycle ke saath badle, normal hai. Agar discharge grey, hara ya peela ho jaaye, tez smell aaye, ya khujli ya jalan ho, toh check karwana chahiye.

q.en: You feel a burning pain every time you urinate. What should you do?
q.hg: Har baar susu karte waqt jalan hoti hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Drink less water so you urinate less
options.hg: Kam paani piyo taaki susu kam aaye

options.en: Ignore it; it is part of puberty
options.hg: Ignore karo; yeh puberty ka hissa hai

options.en: Use perfumed powder on the area
options.hg: Wahan khushbu wala powder lagao

options.en: See a doctor; it may be a urine infection
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhao; urine infection ho sakta hai

explain.en: Burning while urinating is not a normal part of puberty. It is often a urine infection, which is easy to treat. Keep drinking water and see a doctor.
explain.hg: Susu mein jalan puberty ka normal hissa nahi hai. Aksar yeh urine infection hota hai, jiska ilaaj aasaan hai. Paani peete raho aur doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: Abhi, 16, feels a new hard lump on the front of one testicle. What is best?
q.hg: Abhi, 16, ko ek testicle ke aage nayi sakht gaanth mehsoos hoti hai. Sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Massage it with warm oil daily
options.hg: Roz garam tel se maalish kare

options.en: Ignore it; lumps there are normal
options.hg: Ignore kare; wahan gaanth normal hai

options.en: Show a doctor soon
options.hg: Jaldi doctor ko dikhaye

options.en: Wait a year and check again
options.hg: Ek saal wait karke phir dekhe

explain.en: The soft coiled tube at the back of each testicle is normal, but a new hard lump, swelling or heaviness should be shown to a doctor soon. Most lumps are harmless, and problems found early are easier to treat.
explain.hg: Har testicle ke peeche wali naram, gol-gol tube normal hai, par nayi sakht gaanth, sujan ya bhaaripan ho toh jaldi doctor ko dikhao. Zyada-tar gaanthen harmless hoti hain, aur jaldi pata chale toh ilaaj aasaan hota hai.

q.en: A teenager's foreskin has been pulled back and now will not go forward again, and it is swelling. What should he do?
q.hg: Ek teenager ki foreskin peeche ho gayi hai aur ab aage nahi aa rahi, aur sujan badh rahi hai. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Apply ice and tell no one
options.hg: Barf lagaye aur kisi ko na bataye

options.en: Go to a hospital immediately
options.hg: Turant hospital jaaye

options.en: Wait overnight for it to settle
options.hg: Raat bhar wait kare, theek ho jaayega

options.en: Pull it back even further
options.hg: Ise aur peeche kheenche

explain.en: A foreskin stuck behind the tip of the penis can cut off blood flow as swelling grows. This is an emergency, so go to a hospital straight away; doctors handle it routinely.
explain.hg: Agar foreskin penis ke sire ke peeche atak jaaye, toh sujan badhne pe blood flow ruk sakta hai. Yeh emergency hai, isliye seedha hospital jao; doctors ke liye yeh aam baat hai.

q.en: Who can visit a government Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic?
q.hg: Sarkari Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic mein kaun ja sakta hai?

options.en: Young people aged 10 to 19
options.hg: 10 se 19 saal ke young log

options.en: Only married couples
options.hg: Sirf shaadishuda couples

options.en: Only girls with periods
options.hg: Sirf periods wali girls

options.en: Only those sent by police
options.hg: Sirf police ke bheje log

explain.en: Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics at government facilities offer counselling and check-ups for boys and girls aged 10 to 19, on puberty, periods, skin, mood and more.
explain.hg: Sarkari Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics mein 10 se 19 saal ke boys aur girls ko counselling aur check-up milta hai, puberty, periods, skin, mood aur bahut kuch pe.

q.en: At a family wedding, an aunt tells Riya, 14, that she is 'too dark' and should use fairness cream. What is true?
q.hg: Ek shaadi mein ek aunty Riya, 14, se kehti hain ki woh 'bahut kaali' hai aur fairness cream lagaye. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Darker skin is less healthy than fair skin
options.hg: Saanvli skin gori skin se kam healthy hai

options.en: Fairness creams safely change skin colour
options.hg: Fairness creams safely skin ka rang badal deti hain

options.en: She should stay indoors until she is fairer
options.hg: Gori hone tak use ghar ke andar rehna chahiye

options.en: Every skin shade is healthy and needs no fixing
options.hg: Har skin shade healthy hai, kuch theek nahi karna

explain.en: Skin colour is set mainly by genes and is healthy in every shade. Fairness products sell by making people feel something is wrong with them. Sunscreen protects skin; it is not about colour.
explain.hg: Skin ka rang zyada-tar genes se tay hota hai aur har shade healthy hai. Fairness products logon ko yeh mehsoos karwa ke bikte hain ki unme kuch kami hai. Sunscreen skin ko bachata hai; iska rang se lena-dena nahi.

q.en: Why do some lessons say 'most girls have a vulva' instead of 'all girls'?
q.hg: Kuch lessons mein 'zyada-tar girls ke paas vulva hoti hai' kyun kehte hain, 'sab girls' kyun nahi?

options.en: The vulva grows only after marriage
options.hg: Vulva sirf shaadi ke baad banti hai

options.en: Doctors still disagree on what a vulva is
options.hg: Doctors abhi tak tay nahi kar paaye ki vulva kya hai

options.en: Intersex and transgender people's bodies can differ
options.hg: Intersex aur transgender logon ki body alag ho sakti hai

options.en: Some girls lose their vulva during puberty
options.hg: Kuch girls ki vulva puberty mein chali jaati hai

explain.en: Most girls have a vulva and most boys have a penis, but intersex people are born with variations, and a transgender person's gender differs from the sex recorded at birth. 'Most' keeps everyone included.
explain.hg: Zyada-tar girls ke paas vulva aur boys ke paas penis hota hai, par intersex log variations ke saath paida hote hain, aur transgender insaan ka gender birth pe likhe sex se alag hota hai. 'Zyada-tar' kehne se sab shaamil rehte hain.

q.en: Tanvi, 15, has extra hair on her chin and very irregular periods. What is the sensible step?
q.hg: Tanvi, 15, ki thodi pe extra baal hain aur periods bahut irregular hain. Samajhdaari ka kadam kya hai?

options.en: Accept it as a sign she is 'like a boy'
options.hg: Maan le ki woh 'ladke jaisi' hai

options.en: See a doctor; a hormone check may help
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhaye; hormone check help kar sakta hai

options.en: Bleach and wax it and say nothing
options.hg: Bleach aur wax kare aur kisi ko na bataye

options.en: Eat less so her hormones settle
options.hg: Kam khaaye taaki hormones theek ho jaayen

explain.en: Some facial hair is common in girls, but extra hair together with irregular periods or stubborn acne can be a sign of a hormonal condition such as PCOS. A doctor can check and help manage it.
explain.hg: Girls mein thode facial hair common hain, par extra baal ke saath irregular periods ya na jaane wale acne ho, toh yeh PCOS jaisi hormonal condition ka sign ho sakta hai. Doctor check karke manage karne mein help karte hain.

q.en: Around what age do most boys reach their adult height?
q.hg: Zyada-tar boys apni adult height kis umar ke aas-paas tak pahunchte hain?

options.en: Around 16 to 18
options.hg: Lagbhag 16 se 18

options.en: Around 11 to 12
options.hg: Lagbhag 11 se 12

options.en: Around 25 to 30
options.hg: Lagbhag 25 se 30

options.en: They keep growing all their life
options.hg: Zindagi bhar badhte rehte hain

explain.en: Most girls reach adult height around 14 to 16 and most boys around 16 to 18, though some boys grow slowly a little longer. Facial hair and shoulder width can keep changing into the early twenties.
explain.hg: Zyada-tar girls lagbhag 14 se 16 tak aur boys 16 se 18 tak adult height pe pahunch jaate hain, kuch boys thoda aur dheere badhte hain. Facial hair aur kandhon ki chaudai early twenties tak badal sakti hai.

q.en: What is the hymen?
q.hg: Hymen kya hai?

options.en: A seal that completely closes the vagina
options.hg: Ek seal jo vagina ko poori tarah band rakhti hai

options.en: A layer that always tears and bleeds once
options.hg: Ek parat jo hamesha ek baar phatti aur bleed karti hai

options.en: A part a doctor can use to check virginity
options.hg: Woh part jisse doctor virginity check kar sakte hain

options.en: A thin, stretchy rim of tissue at the vaginal opening
