options.hg: Vagina ke opening pe patla, lachila tissue ka ring

explain.en: The hymen is a thin, stretchy rim that normally has an opening, which is how period blood leaves. It varies naturally, may or may not bleed, and can never show whether someone has had sex.
explain.hg: Hymen ek patla, lachila ring hai jisme normally opening hoti hai, isi se period ka blood bahar aata hai. Yeh sabme alag hota hai, bleed kare ya na kare, aur kabhi nahi bata sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi.

q.en: A 'sex clinic' advert says losing semen in sleep or urine drains a man's strength. What is true?
q.hg: Ek 'sex clinic' ka ad kehta hai ki neend mein ya susu mein semen nikalne se mard ki taakat kam hoti hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Wet dreams slowly lead to infertility
options.hg: Wet dreams dheere-dheere infertility laate hain

options.en: Only expensive tonics can restore the loss
options.hg: Sirf mehenge tonic hi yeh nuksaan bharte hain

options.en: Semen is made all the time; losing it does not weaken
options.hg: Semen lagaataar banta hai; nikalne se kamzori nahi hoti

options.en: Each drop of semen equals many drops of blood
options.hg: Semen ki ek boond kai boond blood ke barabar hai

explain.en: The body makes semen continuously, so wet dreams or semen loss do not drain strength. This worry, sometimes called 'dhat', is common and a qualified doctor can help; costly 'gupt rog' tonics cannot.
explain.hg: Body lagaataar semen banati hai, isliye wet dreams ya semen nikalne se taakat kam nahi hoti. Yeh chinta, jise kabhi 'dhat' kehte hain, common hai aur qualified doctor help kar sakte hain; mehenge 'gupt rog' tonic nahi.

q.en: Which is true about circumcision?
q.hg: Circumcision ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: Every boy must be circumcised for health
options.hg: Health ke liye har boy ka circumcision zaroori hai

options.en: Circumcised and uncircumcised penises are both normal
options.hg: Circumcised aur uncircumcised dono penis normal hain

options.en: An uncircumcised penis cannot be kept clean
options.hg: Uncircumcised penis saaf nahi rakha ja sakta

options.en: Circumcised men cannot become fathers
options.hg: Circumcised mard baap nahi ban sakte

explain.en: Whether a penis has a foreskin or not, both are normal. An uncircumcised penis stays clean with simple daily rinsing, and circumcision does not affect fertility.
explain.hg: Penis pe foreskin ho ya na ho, dono normal hain. Uncircumcised penis roz simple paani se dhone se saaf rehta hai, aur circumcision se fertility pe koi asar nahi padta.

q.en: Your friend, 15, says looking at edited photos online makes her think her body is 'wrong'. What is the most helpful thing to say?
q.hg: Tumhari dost, 15, kehti hai ki online edited photos dekh ke use lagta hai uski body 'galat' hai. Sabse helpful baat kya hogi?

options.en: Those photos are posed and edited; real bodies vary
options.hg: Woh photos pose aur edit ki hui hain; asli bodies alag hoti hain

options.en: She should diet until she looks like them
options.hg: Unke jaisi dikhne tak diet kare

options.en: Everyone online is naturally perfect
options.hg: Online sab natural perfect hain

options.en: She should post more photos for likes
options.hg: Likes ke liye aur photos post kare

explain.en: Images online are chosen, lit, filtered and edited, and show a narrow slice of bodies. If body worries take up hours of her day or stop her eating or going out, she should talk to a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Online images chuni hui, lighting wali, filtered aur edited hoti hain, aur bodies ka bahut chhota hissa dikhati hain. Agar body ki chinta din ke ghante kha jaaye ya khaana-peena ya bahar jaana rok de, toh kisi trusted bade se baat karni chahiye.

q.en: Why do bodies sweat more during puberty?
q.hg: Puberty mein body ko zyada paseena kyun aata hai?

options.en: The body is getting rid of dirt from inside
options.hg: Body andar ki gandagi bahar nikaal rahi hai

options.en: It is a sign of a weak or tired heart
options.hg: Yeh kamzor ya thake dil ka sign hai

options.en: It happens only to people who are overweight
options.hg: Yeh sirf overweight logon ko hota hai

options.en: New sweat glands start working to cool you
options.hg: Thanda rakhne ke liye naye sweat glands chalu hote hain

explain.en: Sweating is how the body cools itself, and new sweat glands in the armpits and groin start working in puberty. Sweating a lot does not mean you are dirty or unhealthy.
explain.hg: Paseena body ko thanda karne ka tareeka hai, aur puberty mein armpits aur groin ke naye sweat glands kaam karne lagte hain. Zyada paseena aane ka matlab yeh nahi ki tum gande ya beemar ho.

q.en: What is the main role of the clitoris?
q.hg: Clitoris ka main kaam kya hai?

options.en: Letting period blood flow out
options.hg: Period ka blood bahar nikaalna

options.en: Producing and storing eggs
options.hg: Eggs banana aur jama karna

options.en: Sensation, with thousands of nerve endings
options.hg: Sensation, hazaaron nerve endings ke saath

options.en: Passing urine out of the body
options.hg: Susu bahar nikaalna

explain.en: The clitoris is packed with nerve endings and its role is sensation, including sexual sensation. It plays no part in urination, periods or pregnancy.
explain.hg: Clitoris mein bahut saari nerve endings hoti hain aur iska kaam sensation hai, sexual sensation bhi. Susu, periods ya pregnancy mein iska koi role nahi.

q.en: Which is true about the size of the clitoris?
q.hg: Clitoris ke size ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: It is found only in some women
options.hg: Yeh sirf kuch women mein hota hai

options.en: Most of it lies inside the body
options.hg: Iska zyada-tar hissa body ke andar hota hai

options.en: All of it is the small visible nub
options.hg: Poora bas woh chhota dikhne wala hissa hai

options.en: It only develops after childbirth
options.hg: Yeh sirf delivery ke baad develop hota hai

explain.en: The visible tip, or glans, is only part of the clitoris. It also has a shaft, two arms and two bulbs inside the body around the vaginal opening, and it forms from the same tissue as the penis.
explain.hg: Bahar dikhne wala sira, yaani glans, clitoris ka bas ek hissa hai. Iska shaft, do arms aur do bulbs body ke andar vagina ke opening ke aas-paas hote hain, aur yeh usi tissue se banta hai jisse penis.

q.en: Does the vagina become permanently loose?
q.hg: Kya vagina hamesha ke liye dheeli ho jaati hai?

options.en: No, it stretches and returns to shape
options.hg: Nahi, yeh khinchti hai aur wapas shape mein aati hai

options.en: Yes, after the first time someone has sex
options.hg: Haan, pehli baar sex ke baad

options.en: Yes, after using tampons or cups
options.hg: Haan, tampons ya cups use karne ke baad

options.en: Yes, after riding a bicycle often
options.hg: Haan, zyada cycle chalane ke baad

explain.en: The vagina is a muscular, elastic passage that stretches a great deal and returns to its shape. Sex, tampons, cups or cycling do not make it permanently loose.
explain.hg: Vagina ek muscular, lachila raasta hai jo bahut khinch sakta hai aur wapas apni shape mein aa jaata hai. Sex, tampons, cups ya cycling se yeh hamesha ke liye dheeli nahi hoti.

q.en: What does the prostate gland do?
q.hg: Prostate gland kya kaam karti hai?

options.en: Makes the sperm
options.hg: Sperm banati hai

options.en: Stores the urine
options.hg: Susu jama karti hai

options.en: Makes testosterone
options.hg: Testosterone banati hai

options.en: Adds fluid to semen
options.hg: Semen mein fluid milati hai

explain.en: The prostate is a walnut-sized gland below the bladder that adds fluid to semen. Sperm and most testosterone are made in the testicles, and urine is stored in the bladder.
explain.hg: Prostate bladder ke neeche akhrot jitni gland hai jo semen mein fluid milati hai. Sperm aur zyada-tar testosterone testicles mein bante hain, aur susu bladder mein jama hoti hai.

q.en: Where do finished sperm wait before they leave the body?
q.hg: Tayyar sperm body se nikalne se pehle kahan rukte hain?

options.en: In the prostate gland
options.hg: Prostate gland mein

options.en: In the tip of the penis
options.hg: Penis ke sire mein

options.en: In the epididymis behind each testicle
options.hg: Har testicle ke peeche epididymis mein

options.en: In the bladder, mixed with urine
options.hg: Bladder mein, susu ke saath

explain.en: Sperm made in the testicles mature and wait in the epididymis, a coiled tube behind each testicle. During ejaculation they travel through the vas deferens and mix with fluids to form semen.
explain.hg: Testicles mein bane sperm epididymis mein pakte aur rukte hain, jo har testicle ke peeche ek gol-gol tube hai. Ejaculation ke waqt woh vas deferens se guzarte hain aur fluids ke saath milke semen bante hain.

q.en: About how long does it take for a sperm cell to mature?
q.hg: Ek sperm cell ko poori tarah tayyar hone mein lagbhag kitna time lagta hai?

options.en: About two years
options.hg: Lagbhag do saal

options.en: About two to three months
options.hg: Lagbhag do se teen mahine

options.en: About two to three hours
options.hg: Lagbhag do se teen ghante

options.en: About one day
options.hg: Lagbhag ek din

explain.en: Millions of sperm are made every day, but each one takes roughly two to three months to mature. That is why health habits like not smoking matter for sperm over months, not days.
explain.hg: Roz laakhon sperm bante hain, par har ek ko tayyar hone mein lagbhag do se teen mahine lagte hain. Isliye smoking na karne jaisi aadatein sperm ke liye mahinon mein asar dikhati hain, dinon mein nahi.

q.en: A young man notices his erect penis curves slightly to one side. What is true?
q.hg: Ek young aadmi dekhta hai ki erection mein uska penis thoda ek side mud jaata hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: A slight curve is common and usually normal
options.hg: Thoda mudna common hai aur aksar normal hai

options.en: Any curve always needs surgery
options.hg: Koi bhi mod ho, surgery zaroori hai

options.en: It was caused by masturbation
options.hg: Yeh masturbation se hua

options.en: It means he cannot have children
options.hg: Iska matlab woh bachche nahi kar sakta

explain.en: A slight curve is very common. A doctor's visit makes sense if the bend is marked, new, getting worse or painful, or if erections hurt.
explain.hg: Thoda sa mod bahut common hai. Doctor ke paas tab jaana chahiye jab mod zyada ho, naya ho, badh raha ho ya dard ho, ya erection mein dard ho.

q.en: What is the cervix?
q.hg: Cervix kya hai?

options.en: The outer folds of skin of the vulva
options.hg: Vulva ki bahar wali skin ki parten

options.en: The opening where urine leaves the body
options.hg: Woh opening jahan se susu nikalti hai

options.en: A gland that makes breast milk
options.hg: Woh gland jo doodh banati hai

options.en: The lower neck of the uterus with a tiny opening
options.hg: Uterus ki neeche wali gardan, ek chhote opening ke saath

explain.en: The cervix is the firm lower part of the uterus at the top of the vagina. Its tiny opening lets period blood out and widens during childbirth. Cervical screening and the HPV vaccine help protect it.
explain.hg: Cervix uterus ka sakht neeche wala hissa hai jo vagina ke upar hota hai. Iska chhota opening period ka blood bahar jaane deta hai aur delivery ke waqt chauda hota hai. Cervical screening aur HPV vaccine ise bachaane mein help karte hain.

q.en: Meena, 30, notices a new lump in her breast that was not there last month. What should she do?
q.hg: Meena, 30, ko breast mein nayi gaanth mehsoos hoti hai jo pichhle mahine nahi thi. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Apply a home paste and watch it
options.hg: Ghar ka lep lagaye aur dekhti rahe

options.en: Worry only if it grows very big
options.hg: Bahut bada ho tabhi chinta kare

options.en: Get it checked by a doctor soon
options.hg: Jaldi doctor se check karwaye

options.en: Wait until it starts to hurt
options.hg: Dard shuru hone tak wait kare

explain.en: Most breast lumps are harmless, but any new lump should be checked by a doctor, even if it does not hurt. Many serious problems are painless at first, and early checks make treatment easier.
explain.hg: Zyada-tar breast ki gaanthen harmless hoti hain, par koi bhi nayi gaanth doctor ko dikhani chahiye, chahe dard na ho. Kai gambhir problems shuru mein dard nahi detin, aur jaldi check se ilaaj aasaan hota hai.

q.en: Your 6-year-old asks why her body looks different from her baby brother's. What is the best response?
q.hg: Tumhari 6 saal ki beti poochhti hai ki uski body chhote bhai se alag kyun dikhti hai. Sabse achha jawaab kya hai?

options.en: Laugh and change the subject
options.hg: Has ke baat badal do

options.en: Calmly explain using the correct body names
options.hg: Shaanti se sahi body names use karke samjhao

options.en: Tell her it is a dirty question
options.hg: Bolo ki yeh ganda sawaal hai

options.en: Say you will explain after she marries
options.hg: Bolo shaadi ke baad samjhaoge

explain.en: A short, calm answer with real names, like 'boys usually have a penis and girls usually have a vulva', satisfies curiosity and tells her she can always bring questions to you.
explain.hg: Asli naamon ke saath chhota, shaant jawaab, jaise 'boys ke paas aksar penis hota hai aur girls ke paas vulva', uski curiosity poori karta hai aur use batata hai ki woh hamesha tumse sawaal pooch sakti hai.

q.en: Your 10-year-old son asks what a wet dream is after hearing the term at school. What is the best approach?
q.hg: Tumhara 10 saal ka beta school mein sun ke poochhta hai ki wet dream kya hota hai. Sabse achha tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Explain simply that it is a normal part of puberty
options.hg: Simple tareeke se batao ki yeh puberty ka normal hissa hai

options.en: Tell him he is too young to ask that
options.hg: Bolo ki woh yeh poochhne ke liye bahut chhota hai

options.en: Warn him that it makes boys weak
options.hg: Use darao ki isse boys kamzor hote hain

options.en: Tell him only bad boys have them
options.hg: Bolo ki yeh sirf bure ladkon ko hote hain

explain.en: Children hear these words anyway. A simple, calm answer before it happens to him prevents fear and shame, and shows him that you are the safe person to ask.
explain.hg: Bachche yeh words kahin na kahin sun hi lete hain. Pehle se simple, shaant jawaab dene se dar aur sharam nahi hoti, aur use pata chalta hai ki tum poochhne ke liye safe insaan ho.

q.en: Ankit, 17, worries because his moustache and beard are still patchy. What is true?
q.hg: Ankit, 17, pareshan hai kyunki uski moonchh aur daadhi abhi bhi kahin-kahin hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: If it is not full by 16, it never will be
options.hg: 16 tak poori nahi hui toh kabhi nahi hogi

options.en: Shaving every day will make it thick
options.hg: Roz shave karne se ghani ho jaayegi

options.en: He needs testosterone injections now
options.hg: Use abhi testosterone injection chahiye

options.en: Facial hair can keep filling in into the early 20s
options.hg: Facial hair early 20s tak bharte reh sakte hain

explain.en: Facial and chest hair can keep developing into the early twenties, and how much grows depends mostly on family genes. Shaving does not thicken it, and hormones should only be taken under a specialist.
explain.hg: Facial aur chest hair early twenties tak develop hote reh sakte hain, aur kitne aayenge yeh zyada-tar family genes pe depend karta hai. Shave karne se ghane nahi hote, aur hormones sirf specialist ki dekh-rekh mein lene chahiye.

q.en: Simran, 19, wants cosmetic surgery on her labia after comparing herself with images online. What is the most accurate thing to know?
q.hg: Simran, 19, online images se compare karke apne labia ki cosmetic surgery karwana chahti hai. Sabse sahi jaankari kya hai?

options.en: Longer labia cause infertility
options.hg: Lambe labia se infertility hoti hai

options.en: Surgery is needed before marriage
options.hg: Shaadi se pehle surgery zaroori hai

options.en: Labia vary widely; online images are often edited
options.hg: Labia sabme bahut alag hote hain; online images aksar edited hoti hain

options.en: All healthy labia look exactly the same
options.hg: Sab healthy labia bilkul ek jaise dikhte hain

explain.en: Labia come in many shapes, sizes and colours, and online images show a narrow, often altered range. Surgery has risks; a doctor should be seen if there is pain or discomfort, not to match a picture.
explain.hg: Labia alag-alag shape, size aur rang ke hote hain, aur online images ek chhoti, aksar badli hui range dikhati hain. Surgery ke risks hote hain; doctor ke paas dard ya discomfort ke liye jaana chahiye, kisi picture se match karne ke liye nahi.

q.en: Who is the boss of your body?
q.hg: Tumhari body ka boss kaun hai?

options.en: Any grown-up who is older than you
options.hg: Koi bhi bada jo tumse umar mein bada ho

options.en: Only the teachers at your school
options.hg: Sirf tumhare school ke teachers

options.en: You are, and you can say what feels okay
options.hg: Tum khud, aur tum bata sakte ho kya theek lagta hai

options.en: Any relative who loves you a lot
options.hg: Koi bhi relative jo tumse bahut pyaar karta ho

explain.en: Your body belongs to you. Grown-ups keep you safe and healthy, but nobody gets to touch you in a way that feels wrong just because they are older or family.
explain.hg: Tumhari body tumhari hai. Bade log tumhe safe aur healthy rakhte hain, par koi bhi sirf bada ya family hone ki wajah se tumhe aise touch nahi kar sakta jo galat lage.

q.en: At a family function, an uncle pinches your cheeks hard every time and it hurts. Can you say, 'Please stop, that hurts'?
q.hg: Family function mein ek uncle har baar zor se gaal kheenchte hain aur dard hota hai. Kya tum bol sakte ho, 'Please mat karo, dard hota hai'?

options.en: Yes, you can say it politely and tell your parent
options.hg: Haan, politely bol sakte ho aur mummy-papa ko bata sakte ho

options.en: No, you must never say no to an elder
options.hg: Nahi, bade logon ko kabhi mana nahi karte

options.en: Only if your parents say it for you first
options.hg: Sirf tab jab mummy-papa pehle tumhare liye bolein

options.en: Only if the uncle is not part of your family
options.hg: Sirf tab jab uncle family ke na hon

explain.en: Saying 'Please stop, that hurts' is polite and honest. Being respectful to elders does not mean letting anyone hurt you, and a parent can help if the uncle does not listen.
explain.hg: 'Please mat karo, dard hota hai' bolna polite bhi hai aur honest bhi. Badon ki respect ka matlab yeh nahi ki koi tumhe hurt kare. Agar uncle na sunein toh mummy-papa help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Your cousin says, 'We are planning a surprise party for Dadi. Don't tell her till Sunday!' What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara cousin bolta hai, 'Hum Dadi ke liye surprise party plan kar rahe hain. Sunday tak unhe mat batana!' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A secret you must keep forever and ever
options.hg: Ek secret jo hamesha ke liye chhupana hai

options.en: An unsafe secret you should report right away
options.hg: Ek unsafe secret jo turant kisi ko batana chahiye

options.en: A lie that will get you into big trouble
options.hg: Ek jhooth jisse tum bade problem mein phasoge

options.en: A happy surprise that everyone will know about soon
options.hg: Ek happy surprise jo jaldi sabko pata chal jayega

explain.en: A surprise is fun and ends soon, when everyone finds out. A secret that someone says you must never tell, especially about touching or your body, is different: always tell a grown-up you trust.
explain.hg: Surprise mazedaar hota hai aur jaldi khatam ho jata hai jab sabko pata chal jata hai. Par jo secret kabhi na batane ko kaha jaye, khaaskar touch ya body ke baare mein, woh alag hai: hamesha kisi trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: An older boy in your building says, 'Let's play a special game, but it's our secret. Don't tell your mummy.' What should you do?
q.hg: Building ka ek bada ladka bolta hai, 'Chalo ek special game khelte hain, par yeh hamara secret hai. Mummy ko mat batana.' Tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Play the game and keep the secret so he stays happy
options.hg: Game khel lo aur secret rakho taaki woh khush rahe

options.en: Say no, go away and tell a grown-up you trust
options.hg: Mana karo, wahan se chale jao aur kisi trusted bade ko batao

options.en: Ask him to promise first that it is a nice game
options.hg: Pehle usse promise karwao ki game achha hai

options.en: Keep it secret unless he asks you a second time
options.hg: Secret rakho jab tak woh doosri baar na pooche

explain.en: Games and fun things don't need to be hidden from parents. When someone asks you to keep a game secret from your family, that is a warning sign. Say no, leave and tell a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Achhe games aur masti ko mummy-papa se chhupane ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Jab koi bole ki game family se secret rakho, toh yeh warning sign hai. Mana karo, wahan se jao aur kisi trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: You are play-wrestling with a friend. You say 'Stop!' but your friend keeps going. What can you do?
q.hg: Tum dost ke saath masti mein kushti kar rahe ho. Tum 'Stop!' bolte ho par dost rukta nahi. Tum kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Keep playing, because stopping would spoil the fun
options.hg: Khelte raho, rukne se saara mazaa kharab ho jayega

options.en: Say 'Stop' louder, move away and tell an adult
options.hg: Zor se 'Stop' bolo, door hato aur kisi bade ko batao

options.en: Laugh so that it all feels like a joke again
options.hg: Has do taaki sab phir se mazaak jaisa lage

options.en: Wait quietly until your friend gets tired
options.hg: Chup-chaap wait karo jab tak dost thak na jaye

explain.en: 'Stop' means stop, even in a game. If someone does not listen, you are allowed to get louder, step away and ask a grown-up to help.
explain.hg: 'Stop' ka matlab stop hai, game mein bhi. Agar koi nahi sunta, toh tum zor se bol sakte ho, door ho sakte ho aur kisi bade se help le sakte ho.

q.en: Your friend is sad and you want to give her a hug. What is the best first step?
q.hg: Tumhari dost udaas hai aur tum use hug karna chahte ho. Sabse achha pehla step kya hai?

options.en: Hug her quickly before she can say no
options.hg: Jaldi se hug kar lo isse pehle ki woh mana kare

options.en: Hug her tightly, because hugs always help
options.hg: Kas ke hug karo, kyunki hug se hamesha accha lagta hai

options.en: Ask the teacher if you are allowed to hug
options.hg: Teacher se poochho ki hug karna allowed hai ya nahi

options.en: Ask her, 'Do you want a hug?'
options.hg: Usse poochho, 'Hug chahiye?'

explain.en: Asking first shows you care about how she feels. Some people want a hug when they are sad and some want space. Her answer is the one that counts.
explain.hg: Pehle poochhna dikhata hai ki tumhe uski feelings ki parwah hai. Kuch log udaas hone par hug chahte hain, kuch log space. Uska jawab hi matter karta hai.

q.en: Your uncle is tickling you. You are laughing but you say 'Stop!' He says, 'You're laughing, so you like it.' What is true?
q.hg: Uncle tumhe gudgudi kar rahe hain. Tum has rahe ho par bolte ho 'Stop!' Woh bolte hain, 'Has rahe ho, matlab achha lag raha hai.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: Your words matter more, so he should stop
options.hg: Tumhare words zyada matter karte hain, unhe rukna chahiye

options.en: Laughing means you really want more tickles
options.hg: Hasne ka matlab tumhe aur gudgudi chahiye

options.en: Uncles are allowed to decide when to stop
options.hg: Uncle decide kar sakte hain kab rukna hai

options.en: You should stop laughing if you want him to stop
options.hg: Rukwana hai toh pehle hasna band karo

explain.en: Tickling makes the body laugh even when you don't like it. When you say 'Stop', the other person should stop, whatever your face is doing. If they don't, tell a parent.
explain.hg: Gudgudi mein body has deti hai chahe tumhe pasand na ho. Jab tum 'Stop' bolte ho, toh saamne wale ko rukna chahiye, chahe tumhara chehra kuch bhi kar raha ho. Na rukein toh mummy-papa ko batao.

q.en: Can you say no to a hug or kiss even from someone you love, like a grandparent?
q.hg: Kya tum hug ya kiss ke liye mana kar sakte ho, us insaan ko bhi jisse tum pyaar karte ho, jaise Nani-Dadi?

options.en: No, saying no to family is always rude
options.hg: Nahi, family ko mana karna hamesha rude hai

options.en: Only to strangers, never to your own family
options.hg: Sirf strangers ko, apni family ko kabhi nahi

options.en: Yes, and you can offer a namaste or high-five instead
options.hg: Haan, aur uski jagah namaste ya high-five de sakte ho

options.en: Only if you can explain a very good reason
options.hg: Sirf tab jab tum koi bahut achhi wajah bata sako

explain.en: You can love someone and still not want a hug right now. A namaste, a smile or a high-five is a kind way to say hello while still listening to your body.
explain.hg: Tum kisi se pyaar karte ho phir bhi abhi hug ka mann na ho, yeh normal hai. Namaste, smile ya high-five se pyaar se hello bol sakte ho aur apni body ki baat bhi sun sakte ho.

q.en: Your teacher asks, 'May I put your drawing up on the class board?' Why is she asking you?
q.hg: Teacher poochhti hain, 'Kya main tumhari drawing class board par laga doon?' Woh tumse kyun poochh rahi hain?

options.en: Teachers have to ask before every small thing
options.hg: Teachers ko har chhoti cheez ke liye poochhna padta hai

options.en: She is not sure if the drawing is good enough
options.hg: Unhe pakka nahi hai ki drawing achhi hai ya nahi

options.en: It is your drawing, so you get to choose
options.hg: Drawing tumhari hai, isliye choice bhi tumhari hai

options.en: She needs your parents' signature for it
options.hg: Unhe iske liye mummy-papa ka sign chahiye

explain.en: Asking before using something that belongs to someone is called asking for consent. Your drawings, your things and your body are yours, so people should ask you first.
explain.hg: Kisi ki cheez use karne se pehle poochhna consent lena kehlata hai. Tumhari drawing, tumhari cheezein aur tumhari body tumhari hain, isliye log pehle tumse poochhein.

q.en: Your friend says, 'If you don't hold my hand, I won't be your friend any more.' What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara dost bolta hai, 'Agar mera haath nahi pakdoge toh main tumhara dost nahi rahunga.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Pressure, because a real friend accepts your no
options.hg: Pressure, kyunki sachcha dost tumhara no accept karta hai

options.en: A normal friendship rule that everyone follows
options.hg: Dosti ka normal rule jo sab follow karte hain

options.en: Fair, because best friends always hold hands
options.hg: Theek hai, kyunki best friends hamesha haath pakadte hain

options.en: A sign that you should give in this one time
options.hg: Ek sign ki is baar tumhe maan jana chahiye

explain.en: Threatening to end a friendship to get you to do something is pressure. Good friends can feel sad about a no, but they don't punish you for it.
explain.hg: Dosti todne ki dhamki dekar kuch karwana pressure hai. Achhe dost tumhare no se thoda udaas ho sakte hain, par uski saza nahi dete.

q.en: A grown-up gives you chocolate and says, 'Don't tell anyone I gave you this.' What is the safest thing to do?
q.hg: Ek bada tumhe chocolate deta hai aur bolta hai, 'Kisi ko mat batana ki maine di.' Sabse safe kya karna hai?

options.en: Eat it quickly and keep the secret
options.hg: Jaldi kha lo aur secret rakho

options.en: Keep the secret because it was a kind gift
options.hg: Secret rakho kyunki gift toh pyaar se diya tha

options.en: Ask the grown-up for one more chocolate
options.hg: Us bade se ek aur chocolate maang lo

options.en: Tell your parent or another trusted adult
options.hg: Mummy-papa ya kisi aur trusted bade ko batao

explain.en: Safe grown-ups don't ask children to hide gifts or secrets from their parents. Telling a trusted adult is never 'getting someone in trouble'; it keeps you safe.
explain.hg: Safe bade bachchon se gifts ya secrets mummy-papa se chhupane ko nahi kehte. Trusted bade ko batana kisi ko 'phasana' nahi hai, isse tum safe rehte ho.

q.en: Your cousin starts reading your diary without asking. What can you say?
q.hg: Tumhara cousin bina poochhe tumhari diary padhne lagta hai. Tum kya bol sakte ho?

options.en: Nothing, because cousins share everything
options.hg: Kuch nahi, cousins toh sab share karte hain

options.en: 'Please don't read it, it's private'
options.hg: 'Please mat padho, yeh private hai'

options.en: 'Okay, but only read the first few pages'
options.hg: 'Theek hai, par sirf pehle kuch pages padhna'

options.en: Grab his phone and read his chats instead
options.hg: Uska phone chheen ke uski chats padh lo

explain.en: Your private things, like a diary, are part of your personal space. You can ask people to respect it, calmly and clearly. Taking revenge just crosses their boundary too.
explain.hg: Tumhari private cheezein, jaise diary, tumhare personal space ka hissa hain. Tum calmly aur clearly bol sakte ho ki respect karo. Badla lena bas unki boundary bhi cross karna hai.

q.en: What does 'consent' mean in simple words?
q.hg: Simple words mein 'consent' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Saying yes after someone asks many times
options.hg: Kisi ke baar-baar poochhne par haan bol dena

options.en: Freely agreeing, knowing you can say no
options.hg: Apni marzi se haan bolna, yeh jaante hue ki na bhi bol sakte ho

options.en: Doing whatever an older person tells you
options.hg: Jo bhi bada bole woh kar dena

options.en: Not saying no when something happens
options.hg: Kuch hone par na nahi bolna

explain.en: Consent is a free, clear yes. If someone says yes only because they were pushed, scared or tired of being asked, that is not real consent.
explain.hg: Consent ek free aur clear haan hai. Agar koi sirf isliye haan bole kyunki use push kiya gaya, darr tha ya baar-baar poochhne se thak gaya, toh woh asli consent nahi hai.

q.en: At a family wedding, a cousin's friend keeps putting his arm around you for photos. You feel uncomfortable. What can you do?
q.hg: Family shaadi mein cousin ka ek dost photos ke liye baar-baar tumhare kandhe par haath rakhta hai. Tumhe uncomfortable lagta hai. Kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Smile and bear it, since it is a wedding
options.hg: Smile karke seh lo, shaadi hai aakhir

options.en: Leave the wedding without telling anyone
options.hg: Kisi ko bataye bina shaadi se chale jao

options.en: Wait for him to notice you are not smiling
options.hg: Wait karo ki woh khud notice kare tum smile nahi kar rahe

options.en: Step aside, say 'No arm, please' and tell a parent
options.hg: Side ho jao, bolo 'Haath mat rakho please' aur parent ko batao

explain.en: You don't have to put up with touch that makes you uncomfortable, even at a happy event. A short, clear 'no' and telling a parent is enough. You don't need to explain.
explain.hg: Jo touch uncomfortable lage use sehna zaroori nahi, chahe function kitna bhi khushi ka ho. Chhota sa clear 'no' bolo aur parent ko batao. Explain karne ki zaroorat nahi.

q.en: Can boys say no to hugs, kisses or touch they don't want?
q.hg: Kya ladke bhi unwanted hug, kiss ya touch ke liye mana kar sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, every child's body belongs to them
options.hg: Haan, har bachche ki body uski apni hai

options.en: No, boys should be tough and not complain
options.hg: Nahi, ladkon ko strong rehna chahiye, complain nahi

options.en: Only to strangers, not to people they know
options.hg: Sirf strangers ko, jaan-pehchaan walon ko nahi

options.en: Only once they are old enough to shave
options.hg: Sirf tab jab woh shave karne layak bade ho jayein

explain.en: Body rules are the same for everyone. Boys have the same right to say no, and the same right to tell a trusted adult if someone touches them in a way that feels wrong.
explain.hg: Body ke rules sabke liye same hain. Ladkon ko bhi mana karne ka utna hi haq hai, aur agar koi galat tarah se touch kare toh trusted bade ko batane ka bhi.

q.en: A friend wants to post a funny photo of you in the class WhatsApp group. Whose 'yes' is needed?
q.hg: Ek dost class WhatsApp group mein tumhari funny photo daalna chahta hai. Kiska 'haan' chahiye?

options.en: Only the friend who clicked the photo
options.hg: Sirf us dost ka jisne photo kheenchi

options.en: The group admin who runs the group
options.hg: Group admin ka jo group chalata hai

options.en: Yours, because it is a photo of you
options.hg: Tumhara, kyunki photo tumhari hai

options.en: Nobody's, it is just a class group
options.hg: Kisi ka nahi, bas class group hi toh hai

explain.en: A photo of you is about you, so you get a say in where it goes. Asking first is respect. Once something is in a group it can be forwarded anywhere, so it is fine to say no.
explain.hg: Tumhari photo tumhare baare mein hai, isliye kahan jayegi yeh tum bhi decide karoge. Pehle poochhna respect hai. Group mein jaane ke baad cheez kahin bhi forward ho sakti hai, isliye no bolna bilkul theek hai.

q.en: You said yes to a friend posting your photo. A week later you want it removed. What should your friend do?
q.hg: Tumne dost ko apni photo post karne ke liye haan bola tha. Ek hafte baad tum chahte ho ki hata de. Dost ko kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Keep it up, because you already said yes
options.hg: Rehne de, kyunki tumne pehle haan bol diya tha

options.en: Keep it up only if it got many likes
options.hg: Rehne de agar us par bahut likes aaye

options.en: Take it down, because you changed your mind
options.hg: Hata de, kyunki tumne apna mann badal liya

options.en: Ask the whole class to vote on it
options.hg: Poori class se vote karwa le

explain.en: A yes can change into a no later. Consent is not a one-time stamp; it is ongoing, for photos and for everything about your body.
explain.hg: Haan baad mein na ban sakta hai. Consent ek baar ka stamp nahi hai, yeh chalta rehta hai, photos ke liye bhi aur body se judi har cheez ke liye bhi.

q.en: People in class keep touching a new student's curly hair without asking. What is the respectful thing to do?
q.hg: Class mein log ek naye student ke curly baalon ko bina poochhe chhoote rehte hain. Respectful kya hai?

options.en: Don't touch, it is her hair and her choice
options.hg: Mat chhuo, baal uske hain aur choice bhi uski

options.en: Touch gently, since it is only out of curiosity
options.hg: Halke se chhoo lo, bas curiosity hi toh hai

options.en: Touch only when the teacher is not looking
options.hg: Sirf tab chhuo jab teacher na dekh rahi ho

options.en: Touch it once so you know how it feels
options.hg: Ek baar chhoo lo taaki pata chale kaisa lagta hai

explain.en: Curiosity is natural, but it doesn't give anyone permission to touch another person's body, including their hair. If you are curious, you can talk to her instead.
explain.hg: Curiosity normal hai, par isse kisi ko doosre ki body, baal bhi, chhoone ki permission nahi milti. Curious ho toh usse baat kar lo.

q.en: Your friend tells you she doesn't like it when her coach hugs her for too long after practice. What should you do?
q.hg: Tumhari dost batati hai ki practice ke baad coach ka der tak hug karna use achha nahi lagta. Tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Tell her that coaches are just friendly like that
options.hg: Bolo ki coaches toh aise hi friendly hote hain

options.en: Keep it to yourself so she doesn't feel shy
options.hg: Apne tak rakho taaki woh sharminda na ho

options.en: Tell her to quit the team to avoid trouble
options.hg: Bolo team chhod de taaki koi jhanjhat na ho

options.en: Believe her and help her tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Uski baat maano aur kisi trusted bade ko batane mein help karo

explain.en: Her feeling matters, even if the adult is popular or important. Going with her to a parent, teacher or 1098 helps; she should not have to give up something she loves.
explain.hg: Uski feeling matter karti hai, chahe woh bada popular ya important ho. Usse saath le jaakar parent, teacher ya 1098 tak pahunchna help karta hai. Use apni pasand ki cheez chhodni nahi padni chahiye.

q.en: At a dance party, people ask a wheelchair user's friend whether she wants to dance, instead of asking her. What is right?
q.hg: Ek dance party mein log wheelchair use karne wali ladki se poochhne ki jagah uski dost se poochhte hain ki kya woh dance karegi. Sahi kya hai?

options.en: Ask her friend, who knows her better
options.hg: Uski dost se poochho, woh use behtar jaanti hai

options.en: Ask her directly, because she decides for herself
options.hg: Seedha usi se poochho, kyunki decide woh khud karegi

options.en: Don't ask at all, so she doesn't feel awkward
options.hg: Poochho hi mat, taaki use awkward na lage

options.en: Pull her wheelchair onto the floor as a surprise
options.hg: Surprise mein uski wheelchair dance floor par le jao

explain.en: People with disabilities make their own choices about their bodies and their fun, like everyone else. Ask the person, and never move someone's wheelchair without asking: it is part of their personal space.
explain.hg: Disability wale log bhi sabki tarah apni body aur apni masti ke faisle khud lete hain. Usi insaan se poochho, aur bina poochhe kisi ki wheelchair mat hilao: woh unke personal space ka hissa hai.

q.en: A doctor needs to examine your body during a check-up. What makes this okay?
q.hg: Check-up mein doctor ko tumhari body examine karni hai. Kya cheez ise theek banati hai?

options.en: The doctor asks you to keep the check-up a secret
options.hg: Doctor bole ki check-up ki baat secret rakho

options.en: A parent is there and the doctor explains each step
options.hg: Parent saath ho aur doctor har step samjhaye

options.en: Nobody else is allowed in the room with you
options.hg: Kamre mein tumhare saath kisi aur ko aane na diya jaye

options.en: The doctor says you are too young to ask questions
options.hg: Doctor bole ki tum sawaal poochhne ke liye chhote ho

explain.en: A good doctor explains what they are doing and why, lets a parent or trusted adult stay, and never asks you to keep it secret. You can always ask questions.
explain.hg: Achha doctor batata hai woh kya kar raha hai aur kyun, parent ya trusted bade ko saath rehne deta hai, aur kabhi secret rakhne ko nahi kehta. Tum hamesha sawaal poochh sakte ho.

q.en: At a sleepover, your friend says no to a game and the others call her 'boring'. What can you do?
q.hg: Sleepover mein tumhari dost ek game ke liye mana karti hai aur baaki log use 'boring' bolte hain. Tum kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Join in, so the group does not tease you next
options.hg: Tum bhi shamil ho jao taaki agla number tumhara na ho

options.en: Tell her quietly to just play and stop fussing
options.hg: Use chupke se bolo ki khel le, nakhre mat kar

options.en: Stay quiet, because it is not your business
options.hg: Chup raho, yeh tumhara mamla nahi hai

options.en: Back her up: 'She said no, let's play something else'
options.hg: Uska saath do: 'Usne mana kiya, kuch aur khelte hain'

explain.en: Supporting someone's no makes it easier for everyone to speak up. One person backing her up often changes what the whole group does.
explain.hg: Kisi ke no ka saath dene se sabke liye bolna aasaan ho jata hai. Ek insaan bhi saath de toh aksar poore group ka behaviour badal jata hai.

q.en: Your friend grabs your phone and starts scrolling through your gallery. What is a fair response?
q.hg: Tumhara dost tumhara phone utha kar gallery scroll karne lagta hai. Fair response kya hai?

options.en: 'Please give it back, ask me before you look'
options.hg: 'Wapas do please, dekhne se pehle mujhse poochho'

options.en: Let it go, friends can see everything
options.hg: Jaane do, dost sab kuch dekh sakte hain

options.en: Laugh it off and hope they stop soon
options.hg: Has ke taal do aur ummeed karo ki ruk jayega

options.en: Delete all your photos so nobody sees them
options.hg: Saari photos delete kar do taaki koi na dekhe

explain.en: Your phone holds your private life. Close friends still need to ask. Saying it clearly and calmly sets the boundary without a fight.
explain.hg: Tumhare phone mein tumhari private life hai. Close friends ko bhi poochhna chahiye. Clearly aur calmly bolne se bina jhagde boundary set ho jati hai.

q.en: Which is the clearest sign that someone is consenting?
q.hg: Kaunsa sign sabse clearly batata hai ki koi consent de raha hai?

options.en: They don't say no, so it must be fine
options.hg: Woh na nahi bolte, toh theek hi hoga

options.en: They stay quiet and don't move away
options.hg: Woh chup rehte hain aur door nahi hat-te

options.en: They say a clear, happy yes and seem into it
options.hg: Woh clear, khushi se haan bolte hain aur interested lagte hain

options.en: They said yes to something similar last week
options.hg: Pichhle hafte unhone aisi hi cheez ke liye haan bola tha

explain.en: Consent is a clear, willing yes for this moment. Silence, stillness or an old yes don't count. If you are not sure, ask.
explain.hg: Consent is moment ke liye ek clear, apni marzi wala haan hai. Chuppi, kuch na karna ya purana haan count nahi hota. Doubt ho toh poochho.

q.en: If someone goes silent and doesn't push you away, have they agreed?
q.hg: Agar koi chup ho jaye aur tumhe door na kare, toh kya usne haan bola?

options.en: Yes, silence usually means a yes
options.hg: Haan, chuppi ka matlab aksar haan hota hai

options.en: Yes, if the two of you are dating
options.hg: Haan, agar tum dono date kar rahe ho

options.en: No, silence or freezing is not a yes
options.hg: Nahi, chuppi ya freeze ho jana haan nahi hai

options.en: Yes, if they smiled at you earlier
options.hg: Haan, agar unhone pehle smile kiya tha

explain.en: Many people freeze when they are scared or unsure. A missing 'no' is not a 'yes'. Stop and check in with words.
explain.hg: Bahut log darr ya confusion mein freeze ho jate hain. 'Na' na bolna 'haan' nahi hai. Ruko aur words mein poochho.

q.en: Why might someone not say no or fight back when something makes them uncomfortable?
q.hg: Koi uncomfortable hone par bhi na kyun nahi bolta ya virodh kyun nahi karta?

options.en: Fear can make the body freeze, a natural stress response
options.hg: Darr se body freeze ho sakti hai, yeh natural stress response hai

options.en: Because deep down they actually wanted it
options.hg: Kyunki andar se woh asal mein chahte the

options.en: Because they were only trying to be polite
options.hg: Kyunki woh bas polite rehna chah rahe the

options.en: Because it did not really bother them at all
options.hg: Kyunki unhe asal mein koi farak nahi pada

explain.en: Fight, flight and freeze are all automatic reactions to fear. Freezing is common and is never a sign of agreement. Indian law also says not physically resisting does not mean consent.
explain.hg: Fight, flight aur freeze, teeno darr ke automatic reactions hain. Freeze hona common hai aur kabhi bhi haan ka sign nahi. Indian law bhi kehta hai ki physically virodh na karna consent nahi hai.

q.en: Two people are kissing. One of them says, 'Wait, stop.' What should happen?
q.hg: Do log kiss kar rahe hain. Ek bolta hai, 'Ruko, stop.' Ab kya hona chahiye?

options.en: Finish first, since they had agreed to start
options.hg: Pehle khatam karo, unhone shuru karne ke liye haan bola tha

options.en: Ask them to explain exactly why they want to stop
options.hg: Unse poochho ki rukna kyun hai, poori wajah batao

options.en: Gently try to change their mind with a compliment
options.hg: Ek compliment dekar pyaar se mann badalne ki koshish karo

options.en: Stop right away; consent can be taken back anytime
options.hg: Turant ruko; consent kabhi bhi wapas liya ja sakta hai

explain.en: Consent is ongoing. Anyone can change their mind at any moment, and they don't owe a reason. Stopping straight away is the only respectful response.
explain.hg: Consent lagataar chalta hai. Koi bhi kabhi bhi mann badal sakta hai, aur use wajah batane ki zaroorat nahi. Turant rukna hi respectful jawab hai.

q.en: Someone agreed to hold hands. What have they agreed to?
q.hg: Kisi ne haath pakadne ke liye haan bola. Usne kis cheez ke liye haan bola?

options.en: Anything else that usually comes after holding hands
options.hg: Jo bhi cheez aksar haath pakadne ke baad hoti hai

options.en: Only holding hands; each new step needs its own yes
options.hg: Sirf haath pakadna; har naye step ke liye alag haan chahiye

options.en: Anything, as long as it happens on the same day
options.hg: Kuch bhi, bas usi din ho

options.en: Any kind of touch that does not hurt them
options.hg: Koi bhi touch jisse unhe dard na ho

explain.en: Consent is specific. A yes to one thing is not a yes to something else. Before going further, check again.
explain.hg: Consent specific hota hai. Ek cheez ka haan doosri cheez ka haan nahi hai. Aage badhne se pehle dobara poochho.

q.en: After you say no, someone keeps asking: 'Please, just once, don't you love me?' On the twentieth time you say okay. Was that consent?
q.hg: Tumhare na bolne ke baad koi baar-baar poochhta hai: 'Please, bas ek baar, kya tum mujhse pyaar nahi karte?' Beesvi baar tum okay bol dete ho. Kya yeh consent tha?

options.en: Yes, because in the end you did say okay
options.hg: Haan, kyunki aakhir mein tumne okay bola

options.en: No, a yes squeezed out by pressure is not free
options.hg: Nahi, pressure se nikala gaya haan free nahi hai

options.en: Yes, because the two of you love each other
options.hg: Haan, kyunki tum dono ek doosre se pyaar karte ho

options.en: Yes, as long as nobody used physical force
options.hg: Haan, jab tak kisi ne zabardasti nahi ki

explain.en: Wearing someone down with guilt, begging or sulking is coercion. Real consent is given freely the first time, not extracted after many no's.
explain.hg: Guilt, minnat ya naraazgi se kisi ko thaka dena coercion hai. Asli consent apni marzi se diya jata hai, bahut saare na ke baad nikala nahi jata.

q.en: If someone touches another person without their consent, who is responsible?
q.hg: Agar koi kisi ko bina consent ke touch kare, toh zimmedaar kaun hai?

options.en: The person who did not say no loudly enough
options.hg: Woh jisne zor se na nahi bola

options.en: Both of them, in exactly equal parts
options.hg: Dono, bilkul barabar

options.en: Whoever was wearing more revealing clothes
options.hg: Jisne zyada revealing kapde pehne the

options.en: The person who did not wait for a yes
options.hg: Woh jisne haan ka intezaar nahi kiya

explain.en: The person who acts is responsible for getting consent. Blaming the other person for not resisting, for their clothes or for being there is victim blaming.
explain.hg: Jo insaan aage badhta hai, consent lene ki zimmedaari uski hai. Doosre ko virodh na karne, kapdon ya wahan hone ke liye blame karna victim blaming hai.

q.en: A girl wears a short dress to a party. Some boys say she is 'asking for it'. What is true?
q.hg: Ek ladki party mein short dress pehenti hai. Kuch ladke bolte hain woh 'khud bula rahi hai'. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Clothes are never consent; only a clear yes is
options.hg: Kapde kabhi consent nahi hote; sirf clear haan hota hai

options.en: Clothes do send a signal that others can read
options.hg: Kapde ek signal dete hain jo log samajh sakte hain

options.en: It is partly her fault if anything happens
options.hg: Kuch hua toh thodi galti uski bhi hogi

options.en: Only modest clothes keep people safe
options.hg: Sirf dhake hue kapde hi logon ko safe rakhte hain

explain.en: What anyone wears says nothing about what they want to do. People are harmed in every kind of clothing. The only person responsible for harm is the one who causes it.
explain.hg: Koi kya pehenta hai, isse yeh pata nahi chalta ki woh kya karna chahta hai. Log har tarah ke kapdon mein harm hote hain. Zimmedaar sirf woh hai jo harm karta hai.

q.en: A boy's girlfriend keeps touching him though he has said he is not comfortable. His friends say, 'Lucky you!' What is true?
q.hg: Ek ladke ki girlfriend use touch karti rehti hai jabki woh bol chuka hai ki use comfortable nahi lagta. Uske dost bolte hain, 'Lucky hai tu!' Sach kya hai?

options.en: Boys always want it, so it can't be a problem
options.hg: Ladke toh hamesha chahte hain, problem ho hi nahi sakti

options.en: It only counts if she is stronger than him
options.hg: Tabhi count hoga agar woh usse zyada strong ho

options.en: His no deserves the same respect as anyone's
options.hg: Uske no ki bhi utni hi respect honi chahiye jitni kisi aur ki

options.en: He should feel flattered and stop complaining
options.hg: Use flattered feel karna chahiye, complain nahi

explain.en: Boys and men can be pressured or touched without consent too. The idea that boys are 'always ready' makes it harder for them to speak up. Consent rules apply to everyone.
explain.hg: Ladkon aur mardon ko bhi pressure kiya ja sakta hai ya bina consent touch kiya ja sakta hai. 'Ladke hamesha ready hote hain' wali soch unke liye bolna mushkil banati hai. Consent ke rules sab par lagte hain.

q.en: Does consent matter in the same way in same-sex relationships?
q.hg: Kya same-sex relationships mein bhi consent utna hi matter karta hai?

options.en: Less, because both people are the same gender
options.hg: Kam, kyunki dono same gender ke hain

options.en: No, consent rules are only for boy-girl couples
options.hg: Nahi, consent ke rules sirf ladka-ladki ke liye hain

options.en: Yes, everyone needs a clear yes, whatever their gender
options.hg: Haan, gender kuch bhi ho, sabko clear haan chahiye

options.en: Only if one partner is much older than the other
options.hg: Sirf tab jab ek partner doosre se kaafi bada ho

explain.en: Consent is about respect between people, not about their gender or sexuality. Pressure and abuse happen in queer relationships too, and they are just as serious.
explain.hg: Consent logon ke beech respect ki baat hai, gender ya sexuality ki nahi. Queer relationships mein bhi pressure aur abuse hota hai, aur woh utna hi serious hai.

q.en: When someone answers 'maybe' or 'I don't know', what should you do?
q.hg: Jab koi 'shayad' ya 'pata nahi' bole, toh tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Treat it as not a yes, and give them time
options.hg: Ise haan mat samjho, aur unhe time do

options.en: Treat it as a yes that just needs a push
options.hg: Ise haan samjho jise bas thoda push chahiye

options.en: Keep asking until you get a proper answer
options.hg: Tab tak poochhte raho jab tak proper jawab na mile

options.en: Go ahead slowly and see how they react
options.hg: Dheere-dheere aage badho aur dekho kaisa react karte hain

explain.en: Only a clear yes is a yes. 'Maybe' means they are unsure, and pushing on would be pressure. Waiting shows you care about what they actually want.
explain.hg: Sirf clear haan hi haan hai. 'Shayad' ka matlab woh sure nahi hain, aur aage push karna pressure hoga. Wait karna dikhata hai ki tumhe unki asli marzi ki parwah hai.

q.en: Someone says 'yes' but pulls away, looks tense and won't look at you. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Koi 'haan' bolta hai par peeche hat-ta hai, tense dikhta hai aur nazar nahi milata. Sabse sahi kya hai?

options.en: Carry on, because they did say yes out loud
options.hg: Aage badho, kyunki unhone bol ke haan kaha

options.en: Ignore the body language, it means nothing
options.hg: Body language ko ignore karo, uska koi matlab nahi

options.en: Ask them to relax and stop overthinking
options.hg: Unhe bolo relax karo, zyada mat socho

options.en: Pause and ask, 'You seem unsure. Want to stop?'
options.hg: Ruko aur poochho, 'Tum unsure lag rahe ho. Rukna hai?'

explain.en: Words and body language should match. When they don't, check in. A shaky yes may come from fear or pressure, and stopping costs you nothing.
explain.hg: Words aur body language match hone chahiye. Na karein toh check karo. Kaanpta hua haan darr ya pressure se aa sakta hai, aur rukne mein tumhara kuch nahi jata.

q.en: They said yes yesterday. Does that mean you don't need to ask today?
q.hg: Kal unhone haan bola tha. Kya iska matlab aaj poochhne ki zaroorat nahi?

options.en: Yes, a yes lasts until they say no
options.hg: Haan, haan tab tak chalta hai jab tak woh na na bolein

options.en: No, consent is given fresh each time
options.hg: Nahi, consent har baar naye sire se diya jata hai

options.en: Yes, if it is the very same thing again
options.hg: Haan, agar bilkul wahi cheez dobara ho rahi hai

options.en: Yes, if you are in a serious relationship
options.hg: Haan, agar tum serious relationship mein ho

explain.en: People's feelings change from day to day. Yesterday's yes says nothing about today. Checking in is quick and keeps both people comfortable.
explain.hg: Logon ki feelings roz badalti hain. Kal ka haan aaj ke baare mein kuch nahi batata. Check karna jaldi ho jata hai aur dono ko comfortable rakhta hai.

q.en: Some people say that asking for consent 'kills the mood'. What is true?
q.hg: Kuch log kehte hain ki consent poochhne se 'mood kharab ho jata hai'. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Real romance means you just know without asking
options.hg: Asli romance mein bina poochhe pata chal jata hai

options.en: Asking shows respect and can be simple and warm
options.hg: Poochhna respect dikhata hai aur simple, pyaar bhara ho sakta hai

options.en: Asking is only needed with people you just met
options.hg: Sirf naye milne walon se poochhna padta hai

options.en: Asking makes you look unsure and less attractive
options.hg: Poochhne se tum unsure aur kam attractive lagte ho

explain.en: A simple 'Is this okay?' or 'Do you want to?' takes seconds. Feeling safe and respected makes closeness better, not worse. Films often skip this; real life shouldn't.
explain.hg: Simple sa 'Yeh theek hai?' ya 'Tum chahte ho?' seconds leta hai. Safe aur respected feel karna closeness ko behtar banata hai. Films mein yeh aksar skip hota hai, real life mein nahi hona chahiye.

q.en: Which of these is a good way to check in with someone?
q.hg: In mein se kisi se check karne ka achha tareeka kaunsa hai?

options.en: 'You're fine, right?' while carrying on
options.hg: 'Tum theek ho na?' bolte hue aage badhte rehna

options.en: 'Come on, everyone does this.'
options.hg: 'Arre, sab yeh karte hain.'

options.en: 'You wouldn't say no to me, would you?'
options.hg: 'Tum mujhe mana thodi karoge, haina?'

options.en: 'Is this okay? We can stop anytime.'
options.hg: 'Yeh theek hai? Hum kabhi bhi ruk sakte hain.'

explain.en: A real question leaves room for a real no. Questions that assume the answer, pile on pressure or keep going while asking are not checking in.
explain.hg: Asli sawaal mein asli 'na' ki jagah hoti hai. Jo sawaal jawab pehle se maan le, pressure daale ya poochhte hue aage badhta rahe, woh check-in nahi hai.

q.en: You like someone, but you are not ready for what they are asking. Which reply is clear and kind?
q.hg: Tumhe koi pasand hai, par woh jo maang rahe hain uske liye tum ready nahi. Kaunsa jawab clear aur kind hai?

options.en: 'I like you, but I'm not ready for that.'
options.hg: 'Tum mujhe pasand ho, par main uske liye ready nahi.'

options.en: Say yes now and avoid them from tomorrow
options.hg: Abhi haan bol do aur kal se unse bacho

options.en: Make up an excuse, like a stomach ache
options.hg: Koi bahana bana do, jaise pet dard

options.en: Change the topic and hope they forget
options.hg: Topic badal do aur ummeed karo woh bhool jayein

explain.en: Liking someone and saying no can both be true. A clear, honest no is respectful, and anyone who truly likes you will accept it.
explain.hg: Kisi ko pasand karna aur na bolna, dono saath sach ho sakte hain. Clear, honest no respectful hai, aur jo tumhe sach mein pasand karta hai woh ise accept karega.

q.en: Do you need a reason to say no?
q.hg: Kya na bolne ke liye koi wajah chahiye?

options.en: Yes, otherwise the other person may feel hurt
options.hg: Haan, warna saamne wale ko bura lag sakta hai

options.en: Yes, if you said yes to them in the past
options.hg: Haan, agar tumne pehle unhe haan bola tha

options.en: No, 'no' is a full answer on its own
options.hg: Nahi, 'na' apne aap mein poora jawab hai

options.en: Only if they are older or senior to you
options.hg: Sirf tab jab woh tumse bade ya senior hon

explain.en: You can explain if you want to, but you never have to. Demanding reasons is often a way to argue someone out of their no.
explain.hg: Chaho toh explain kar sakte ho, par zaroori nahi. Wajah maangna aksar kisi ke no ko behas se haan mein badalne ka tareeka hota hai.

q.en: Can consent be shown without words?
q.hg: Kya consent bina words ke diya ja sakta hai?

options.en: No, it only counts if it is written down
options.hg: Nahi, sirf likha hua consent hi count hota hai

options.en: Yes, and not pulling away is enough of a sign
options.hg: Haan, aur door na hona kaafi sign hai

options.en: Yes, but it must be clear; if unsure, ask in words
options.hg: Haan, par clear hona chahiye; doubt ho toh words mein poochho

options.en: No, gestures can never show what someone wants
options.hg: Nahi, gestures kabhi nahi batate ki koi kya chahta hai

explain.en: People can show a willing yes through words and actions. But stillness or not pulling away is not a yes. When the signals are not clearly positive, use words.
explain.hg: Log words aur actions dono se apni marzi dikha sakte hain. Par chup rehna ya door na hona haan nahi hai. Jab signals clearly positive na hon, words use karo.

q.en: What is the problem with only listening for a 'no'?
q.hg: Sirf 'na' sunne ka intezaar karne mein kya problem hai?

options.en: Many people freeze or can't say no, so look for a yes
options.hg: Bahut log freeze ho jate hain ya na bol nahi paate, isliye haan dhoondho

options.en: There is no problem; a missing no is enough
options.hg: Koi problem nahi; na nahi bola toh kaafi hai

options.en: People always say no loudly when they mean it
options.hg: Log jab na chahte hain toh hamesha zor se bolte hain

options.en: A no is only real if it is repeated three times
options.hg: Na tabhi asli hai jab teen baar bola jaye

explain.en: Fear, shock, alcohol or a power gap can stop someone from saying no. 'Enthusiastic consent' means looking for a clear, willing yes instead of waiting for resistance.
explain.hg: Darr, shock, alcohol ya power ka farak kisi ko na bolne se rok sakta hai. 'Enthusiastic consent' ka matlab hai virodh ka wait karne ki jagah ek clear, willing haan dhoondhna.

q.en: Your friend says, 'Riya likes you. She'll definitely say yes to a kiss.' What should you do?
q.hg: Tumhara dost bolta hai, 'Riya tujhe pasand karti hai. Kiss ke liye pakka haan bolegi.' Tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Trust your friend; he knows her well
options.hg: Dost par bharosa karo, woh use achhe se jaanta hai

options.en: Kiss her and see how she reacts
options.hg: Kiss karo aur dekho woh kaise react karti hai

options.en: Ask your friend to get her yes for you
options.hg: Dost se bolo ki tumhare liye uska haan le aaye

options.en: Ask Riya herself and accept her answer
options.hg: Riya se khud poochho aur uska jawab maano

explain.en: Nobody can give consent on someone else's behalf. Even if she likes you, she decides what she wants to do and when.
explain.hg: Koi bhi kisi aur ki taraf se consent nahi de sakta. Woh tumhe pasand kare tab bhi, kya karna hai aur kab, yeh woh khud decide karegi.

q.en: On the school trip bus, a friend dares you to kiss a classmate who is asleep, 'just as a joke'. What should you do?
q.hg: School trip ki bus mein dost dare deta hai ki soye hue classmate ko kiss karo, 'bas mazaak mein'. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Do it quickly, since they will never know
options.hg: Jaldi kar lo, unhe kabhi pata nahi chalega

options.en: Refuse, because a sleeping person can't agree
options.hg: Mana karo, kyunki soya hua insaan haan nahi bol sakta

options.en: Do it, but only a quick one on the cheek
options.hg: Kar lo, par bas gaal par ek chhota sa

options.en: Do it only if the classmate is your crush
options.hg: Sirf tab karo jab woh tumhara crush ho

explain.en: Someone who is asleep, passed out or unable to respond cannot consent. A 'joke' or a dare does not change that, and the same goes for photos of them.
explain.hg: Jo so raha ho, behosh ho ya jawab na de sake, woh consent nahi de sakta. 'Mazaak' ya dare se yeh nahi badalta, aur unki photos ke liye bhi yahi rule hai.

q.en: In Truth or Dare, someone is dared to kiss a person who looks uncomfortable. What is true?
q.hg: Truth or Dare mein kisi ko aise insaan ko kiss karne ka dare milta hai jo uncomfortable lag raha hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Rules are rules, so the dare must be done
options.hg: Rules toh rules hain, dare karna hi padega

options.en: A dare is not consent; anyone can refuse
options.hg: Dare consent nahi hai; koi bhi mana kar sakta hai

options.en: It's fine because it's only a party game
options.hg: Theek hai, bas party game hi toh hai

options.en: Refusing a dare makes you a bad sport
options.hg: Dare mana karne se tum bad sport ban jate ho

explain.en: A game cannot sign anyone up for touch they don't want. Both the person dared and the person being kissed can say no, and friends can help by changing the dare.
explain.hg: Koi game kisi ko unwanted touch ke liye sign up nahi kar sakta. Jise dare mila aur jise kiss kiya ja raha hai, dono mana kar sakte hain, aur dost dare badal kar help kar sakte hain.

q.en: In the school corridor, a group pulls a classmate's track pants down as a 'prank'. What is this?
q.hg: School corridor mein ek group 'prank' ke naam par ek classmate ki track pant kheench deta hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Harmless fun, because they are all boys
options.hg: Masoom masti, kyunki sab ladke hi toh hain

options.en: A normal part of growing up at school
options.hg: School mein bade hone ka normal hissa

options.en: Only a problem if someone takes a video
options.hg: Problem tabhi hai jab koi video bana le

options.en: A violation of his body and dignity; tell a teacher
options.hg: Uski body aur izzat ka violation; teacher ko batao

explain.en: Exposing someone's body without consent humiliates them, whatever their gender. It is not a prank. Reporting it to a teacher protects the classmate and stops it becoming a habit.
explain.hg: Bina consent kisi ki body expose karna use sharminda karta hai, gender kuch bhi ho. Yeh prank nahi hai. Teacher ko batane se classmate protect hota hai aur yeh aadat nahi banti.

q.en: At the gym, a trainer correcting your posture moves his hand somewhere that feels wrong. Can you say, 'Please don't touch there'?
q.hg: Gym mein posture theek karte hue trainer ka haath aisi jagah jata hai jo galat lagta hai. Kya tum bol sakte ho, 'Please wahan touch mat karo'?

options.en: Yes; professionals should explain and ask first
options.hg: Haan; professional ko pehle samjhana aur poochhna chahiye

options.en: No, trainers need to touch to do their job
options.hg: Nahi, trainer ko kaam ke liye touch karna padta hai

options.en: Only if you are paying for personal training
options.hg: Sirf tab jab tum personal training ke paise de rahe ho

options.en: Only if another member saw it happen
options.hg: Sirf tab jab kisi aur member ne dekha ho

explain.en: A trainer, tailor, doctor or coach may need to touch for their work, but they should say what they will do and stop when asked. Your discomfort is enough reason to speak up.
explain.hg: Trainer, darzi, doctor ya coach ko kaam ke liye touch karna pad sakta hai, par unhe batana chahiye ki kya karenge aur kehne par rukna chahiye. Tumhara uncomfortable hona bolne ke liye kaafi wajah hai.

q.en: In a shared auto, a co-passenger keeps pressing his leg against yours, even after you move away. What can you do?
q.hg: Shared auto mein ek co-passenger baar-baar apni taang tumhari taang se dabata hai, tumhare hatne ke baad bhi. Kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Stay quiet, because it may be an accident
options.hg: Chup raho, ho sakta hai galti se ho raha ho

options.en: Blame yourself for choosing a shared auto
options.hg: Shared auto lene ke liye khud ko blame karo

options.en: Say loudly, 'Move away,' or ask the driver to stop
options.hg: Zor se bolo, 'Door hato,' ya driver ko rokne ko kaho

options.en: Wait till your stop and never mention it
options.hg: Apne stop tak wait karo aur kabhi zikr mat karo

explain.en: Repeated touching after you have moved away is not an accident. Speaking up loudly often stops it and alerts others. If you feel unsafe, call 112. It is never your fault.
explain.hg: Tumhare hatne ke baad bhi baar-baar touch karna galti se nahi hota. Zor se bolne se aksar yeh ruk jata hai aur baaki log alert ho jate hain. Unsafe lage toh 112 call karo. Galti kabhi tumhari nahi hai.

q.en: Your partner says, 'If you don't, I'll find someone who will.' What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara partner bolta hai, 'Agar tum nahi karoge, toh main kisi aur ko dhoondh lunga.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Honest talk about what they need
options.hg: Unki zaroorat ke baare mein honest baat

options.en: A normal part of being in love
options.hg: Pyaar mein hone ka normal hissa

options.en: Emotional pressure, which is not okay
options.hg: Emotional pressure, jo theek nahi hai

options.en: A fair deal between two partners
options.hg: Do partners ke beech fair deal

explain.en: Threatening to leave to get something is coercion. Partners can share what they want, but a yes given out of fear of losing someone is not free.
explain.hg: Kuch paane ke liye chhod dene ki dhamki dena coercion hai. Partners apni chahat bata sakte hain, par kisi ko kho dene ke darr se diya gaya haan free nahi hai.

q.en: Under Indian law, can a 16-year-old legally consent to sexual activity?
q.hg: Indian law ke hisaab se, kya ek 16 saal ka insaan sexual activity ke liye legally consent de sakta hai?

options.en: No, POCSO treats everyone under 18 as a child
options.hg: Nahi, POCSO 18 se kam umar wale sabko child maanta hai

options.en: Yes, as long as they clearly agree
options.hg: Haan, jab tak woh clearly haan bolein

options.en: Yes, if the partner is the same age
options.hg: Haan, agar partner bhi same age ka ho

options.en: Yes, if their parents give permission
options.hg: Haan, agar mummy-papa permission dein

explain.en: Under the POCSO Act, 2012, anyone under 18 is a child, and sexual activity with a child is an offence even if the child said yes. There is no exception for two teenagers of the same age.
explain.hg: POCSO Act, 2012 ke hisaab se 18 se kam umar ka har insaan child hai, aur child ke saath sexual activity offence hai chahe child ne haan bola ho. Same age ke do teenagers ke liye bhi koi exception nahi hai.

q.en: A 22-year-old says his 16-year-old girlfriend 'agreed' to sexual activity. What does the law say?
q.hg: Ek 22 saal ka ladka kehta hai ki uski 16 saal ki girlfriend ne sexual activity ke liye 'haan' bola. Law kya kehta hai?

options.en: It is legal, because she agreed to it
options.hg: Legal hai, kyunki usne haan bola tha

options.en: It is legal if they plan to marry later
options.hg: Legal hai agar woh baad mein shaadi karne wale hain

options.en: It is only illegal if her parents complain
options.hg: Illegal tabhi hai jab uske parents complain karein

options.en: It is an offence under POCSO; her 'yes' doesn't count
options.hg: POCSO ke tahat offence hai; uska 'haan' count nahi hota

explain.en: POCSO protects everyone under 18, and an adult cannot use a minor's 'consent' as a defence. A big age and power gap is also a red flag for grooming. Help is available at 1098.
explain.hg: POCSO 18 se kam har insaan ko protect karta hai, aur koi adult minor ke 'consent' ko defence nahi bana sakta. Bada age aur power gap grooming ka red flag bhi hai. Help ke liye 1098.

q.en: A classmate says POCSO is a 'girls' law' and boys can't be victims under it. What is true?
q.hg: Ek classmate kehta hai ki POCSO 'ladkiyon ka law' hai aur ladke iske tahat victim nahi ho sakte. Sach kya hai?

options.en: No, it was written only to protect girls
options.hg: Nahi, yeh sirf ladkiyon ko protect karne ke liye bana tha

options.en: Yes, it covers every child under 18, any gender
options.hg: Haan, yeh 18 se kam har bachche ko cover karta hai, gender kuch bhi ho

options.en: Only boys under 12 are covered by the law
options.hg: Sirf 12 se chhote ladke is law mein aate hain

options.en: Only when the accused person is a woman
options.hg: Sirf tab jab accused ek aurat ho

explain.en: POCSO is gender-neutral: boys, girls and transgender children are all protected. Boys are abused too and deserve to be believed and helped.
explain.hg: POCSO gender-neutral hai: ladke, ladkiyan aur transgender bachche, sab protected hain. Ladkon ke saath bhi abuse hota hai aur unki baat maani jani chahiye, unhe help milni chahiye.

q.en: At a party, someone is very drunk, slurring and stumbling. Can they consent to sex?
q.hg: Party mein koi bahut zyada nashe mein hai, ladkhada raha hai aur theek se bol nahi pa raha. Kya woh sex ke liye consent de sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, if they said yes earlier in the evening
options.hg: Haan, agar unhone shaam ko pehle haan bola tha

options.en: No, someone that drunk cannot give real consent
options.hg: Nahi, itne nashe mein koi asli consent nahi de sakta

options.en: Yes, if the other person is drunk as well
options.hg: Haan, agar doosra insaan bhi nashe mein hai

options.en: Yes, if the two of them are already dating
options.hg: Haan, agar dono pehle se date kar rahe hain

explain.en: Consent needs a clear mind. If someone is too drunk to understand what is happening, any 'yes' doesn't count. The right move is to make sure they get home safely.
explain.hg: Consent ke liye saaf dimaag chahiye. Agar koi itne nashe mein hai ki samajh na paye kya ho raha hai, toh uska koi bhi 'haan' count nahi hota. Sahi kaam hai ki woh safely ghar pahunche.

q.en: Under the BNS, if a woman is too intoxicated to understand what she is agreeing to, her 'consent' is…
q.hg: BNS ke hisaab se, agar ek aurat itne nashe mein hai ki samajh na paaye kis cheez ke liye haan bol rahi hai, toh uska 'consent'…

options.en: valid, if she said it out loud
options.hg: valid hai, agar usne bol ke kaha

options.en: valid, if she chose to drink
options.hg: valid hai, agar usne khud peena chuna

options.en: valid, if they are in a relationship
options.hg: valid hai, agar woh relationship mein hain

options.en: not valid consent in law
options.hg: law mein valid consent nahi hai

explain.en: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita says consent given while a person cannot understand the nature and consequences of the act, for example because of intoxication, is not consent. Choosing to drink never means choosing to be harmed.
explain.hg: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita kehti hai ki jab koi act ka nature aur consequences samajh na sake, jaise nashe ki wajah se, tab diya gaya consent consent nahi hai. Peena chunna kabhi harm hona chunna nahi hai.

q.en: Earlier in the night your partner said yes. Now, after drinking, they have passed out. What is true?
q.hg: Raat mein pehle tumhare partner ne haan bola tha. Ab drink karne ke baad woh behosh ho gaye hain. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Consent ends when they can no longer respond
options.hg: Jab woh jawab dene layak nahi, consent khatam ho jata hai

options.en: Their earlier yes still counts for the night
options.hg: Unka pehle wala haan poori raat ke liye count hota hai

options.en: It's fine because you are a couple
options.hg: Theek hai, kyunki tum couple ho

options.en: It's fine if you are gentle with them
options.hg: Theek hai agar tum dhyaan se karo

explain.en: Consent must be present the whole time. A person who is passed out cannot agree, change their mind or say stop. Check they are breathing, put them on their side and stay with them.
explain.hg: Consent poore time hona chahiye. Behosh insaan na haan bol sakta hai, na mann badal sakta hai, na stop bol sakta hai. Check karo ki woh saans le rahe hain, unhe karwat par lita do aur saath raho.

q.en: At a hostel party, a friend is leading a very drunk classmate towards an empty room. What should you do?
q.hg: Hostel party mein ek dost bahut nashe mein ek classmate ko khaali kamre ki taraf le ja raha hai. Tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Mind your own business, they are adults
options.hg: Apne kaam se kaam rakho, sab bade hain

options.en: Assume they must be dating and leave it
options.hg: Maan lo ki woh date kar rahe honge aur chhod do

options.en: Step in: check on the classmate and get others' help
options.hg: Beech mein aao: classmate ka haal poochho aur baaki logon ki help lo

options.en: Wait outside the room to see what happens
options.hg: Kamre ke bahar wait karo aur dekho kya hota hai

explain.en: You can interrupt without a fight: 'Hey, she looks sick, let's get her some water.' Bring other friends and help the drunk person get somewhere safe. Acting early is how harm is prevented.
explain.hg: Bina jhagde beech mein aa sakte ho: 'Arre, iski tabiyat theek nahi lag rahi, paani le aate hain.' Baaki doston ko bulao aur nashe wale insaan ko safe jagah pahunchao. Jaldi action lene se harm rukta hai.

q.en: Your partner of two years says, 'We're together. I don't need to ask every time.' What is true?
q.hg: Do saal se tumhara partner bolta hai, 'Hum saath hain. Mujhe har baar poochhne ki zaroorat nahi.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: After a year, consent is understood to be there
options.hg: Ek saal baad consent samjha hua hota hai

options.en: Couples only need to ask on the first date
options.hg: Couples ko sirf pehli date par poochhna hota hai

options.en: Being together doesn't replace asking each time
options.hg: Saath hona har baar poochhne ki jagah nahi le sakta

options.en: Asking is needed only if you have fought
options.hg: Poochhna tabhi zaroori hai jab jhagda hua ho

explain.en: Being in a relationship means you know each other, not that one person's body belongs to the other. Checking in stays important however long you have been together.
explain.hg: Relationship mein hone ka matlab hai ki tum ek doosre ko jaante ho, yeh nahi ki ek ki body doosre ki ho gayi. Kitne bhi time se saath ho, check karna zaroori rehta hai.

q.en: Does getting married mean a spouse has agreed to sex whenever the other wants?
q.hg: Kya shaadi ka matlab hai ki spouse ne jab bhi doosra chahe tab sex ke liye haan bol diya?

options.en: No, consent is needed every time, married or not
options.hg: Nahi, consent har baar chahiye, shaadi ho ya na ho

options.en: Yes, the wedding itself is lifelong consent
options.hg: Haan, shaadi khud hi zindagi bhar ka consent hai

options.en: Yes, as long as the couple lives together
options.hg: Haan, jab tak couple saath rehta hai

options.en: Only after the first year of marriage
options.hg: Sirf shaadi ke pehle saal ke baad

explain.en: Marriage is a partnership, not ownership. Each spouse can say yes or no on any day. Ethically and medically, marriage is not consent.
explain.hg: Shaadi partnership hai, malikana haq nahi. Har spouse kisi bhi din haan ya na bol sakta hai. Ethically aur medically, shaadi consent nahi hai.

q.en: What does Indian criminal law currently say about forced sex by a husband on his wife who is 18 or older?
q.hg: Indian criminal law abhi kya kehta hai jab pati apni 18 ya usse zyada umar ki patni ke saath zabardasti sex karta hai?

options.en: It is punished exactly like any other rape
options.hg: Iski saza bilkul baaki rape jaisi hai

options.en: It is legal, and no law at all can help her
options.hg: Yeh legal hai, aur koi bhi law uski help nahi kar sakta

options.en: The Supreme Court has already removed the exception
options.hg: Supreme Court exception pehle hi hata chuka hai

options.en: The BNS keeps an exception, and it is being challenged
options.hg: BNS mein ek exception hai, aur use challenge kiya ja raha hai

explain.en: The BNS still says intercourse by a man with his wife aged 18 or over is not 'rape', and this exception is under challenge in the Supreme Court. She can still seek protection under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005, and call 181 or 112.
explain.hg: BNS abhi bhi kehti hai ki 18 ya usse zyada umar ki patni ke saath pati ka intercourse 'rape' nahi hai, aur is exception ko Supreme Court mein challenge kiya gaya hai. Woh phir bhi Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ke tahat protection le sakti hai, aur 181 ya 112 call kar sakti hai.

q.en: Under Indian law, sexual intercourse with a wife who is under 18 is…
q.hg: Indian law ke hisaab se, 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sexual intercourse…

options.en: legal, because the couple is married
options.hg: legal hai, kyunki couple shaadi-shuda hai

options.en: rape, and also an offence under POCSO
options.hg: rape hai, aur POCSO ke tahat bhi offence hai

options.en: legal, if both families agreed to it
options.hg: legal hai, agar dono families ne haan kaha

options.en: a crime only if she complains in writing
options.hg: crime tabhi hai jab woh likh kar complaint kare

explain.en: The marriage exception in the BNS does not apply to a wife under 18. Marrying a girl under 18 is itself illegal under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006. Childline 1098 can help stop a child marriage.
explain.hg: BNS ka marriage exception 18 se kam umar ki patni par laagu nahi hota. 18 se kam umar ki ladki ki shaadi khud Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 ke tahat illegal hai. Child marriage rokne mein Childline 1098 help kar sakti hai.

q.en: In an arranged marriage, relatives tease the new couple that the first night is 'compulsory'. What is true?
q.hg: Arranged marriage mein rishtedaar naye couple ko chhedte hain ki pehli raat 'zaroori' hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Tradition decides, so the couple must follow it
options.hg: Parampara decide karti hai, couple ko maanna padega

options.en: The couple decides when they are ready, together
options.hg: Couple khud milkar decide karega ki kab ready hain

options.en: The husband decides, as head of the family
options.hg: Pati decide karega, kyunki woh ghar ka mukhiya hai

options.en: The elders decide, since they arranged the match
options.hg: Bade decide karenge, kyunki rishta unhone karaya

explain.en: Many couples in arranged marriages are still getting to know each other. Taking time is normal and healthy. Intimacy should happen only when both people want it.
explain.hg: Arranged marriage mein bahut couples abhi ek doosre ko jaan rahe hote hain. Time lena normal aur healthy hai. Intimacy tabhi honi chahiye jab dono chahein.

q.en: Does an adult married woman need her husband's permission to get an abortion under the MTP Act?
q.hg: MTP Act ke tahat kya ek adult shaadi-shuda aurat ko abortion ke liye pati ki permission chahiye?

options.en: Yes, the husband must sign the form
options.hg: Haan, pati ko form sign karna padta hai

options.en: Yes, unless she already has children
options.hg: Haan, jab tak uske pehle se bachche na hon

options.en: Only her in-laws' permission is needed
options.hg: Sirf uske sasural walon ki permission chahiye

options.en: No, only her own consent is required
options.hg: Nahi, sirf uska apna consent chahiye

explain.en: Under the Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, an adult woman's own consent is what the law requires, married or unmarried. Decisions about her body are hers. Someone under 18 needs a guardian's written consent.
explain.hg: Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act ke tahat adult aurat ka apna consent hi zaroori hai, shaadi-shuda ho ya nahi. Uski body ke faisle uske hain. 18 se kam umar wale ko guardian ka likhit consent chahiye.

q.en: Someone gets a woman to agree to sex by promising marriage, with no intention of ever marrying her. Under the BNS, this is…
q.hg: Koi ek aurat se shaadi ka vaada karke sex ke liye haan karwata hai, jabki uska shaadi karne ka koi irada nahi tha. BNS ke hisaab se yeh…

options.en: a separate offence of using deceitful means
