options.hg: dhokhe se kiya gaya ek alag offence hai

options.en: not a crime, only a broken heart
options.hg: crime nahi, bas dil toota hai

options.en: only a civil dispute about the marriage
options.hg: sirf shaadi ka civil jhagda hai

options.en: a crime only if they were formally engaged
options.hg: crime tabhi hai jab formal engagement hui ho

explain.en: Section 69 of the BNS makes sex obtained by deceitful means, such as a false promise of marriage made with no intention of keeping it, an offence. A promise that was genuinely meant but later fell through is treated differently.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 69 dhokhe se, jaise jhootha shaadi ka vaada jise nibhane ka irada hi na ho, sex karne ko offence banata hai. Jo vaada sach mein kiya gaya par baad mein toot gaya, use alag tarah dekha jata hai.

q.en: A couple agrees to sex with a condom, but one partner secretly removes it. What is true?
q.hg: Ek couple condom ke saath sex ke liye agree karta hai, par ek partner chupke se condom hata deta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is fine because they had agreed to have sex
options.hg: Theek hai, kyunki sex ke liye toh haan tha

options.en: It is fine if the partner did not notice
options.hg: Theek hai agar partner ko pata nahi chala

options.en: It breaks the agreement; the consent was only with a condom
options.hg: Agreement toot gaya; consent sirf condom ke saath tha

options.en: It only matters if it leads to a pregnancy
options.hg: Tabhi matter karta hai jab pregnancy ho jaye

explain.en: Consent to protected sex is not consent to unprotected sex. The person affected can see a doctor quickly about emergency contraception (works up to 5 days, sooner is better) and HIV PEP (start within 72 hours), plus STI testing.
explain.hg: Protected sex ka consent unprotected sex ka consent nahi hai. Jiske saath hua, woh jaldi doctor se emergency contraception (5 din tak kaam karti hai, jitni jaldi utna achha) aur HIV PEP (72 ghante ke andar shuru) ke baare mein mile, aur STI test bhi karaye.

q.en: Why can it be hard to give consent freely when the other person is your boss, teacher or much older?
q.hg: Jab saamne wala tumhara boss, teacher ya tumse kaafi bada ho, toh free consent dena mushkil kyun ho sakta hai?

options.en: Older people are always better at explaining
options.hg: Bade log hamesha behtar samjhate hain

options.en: Younger people don't have real feelings yet
options.hg: Chhote logon ki asli feelings abhi nahi hoti

options.en: The power gap can make saying no feel risky
options.hg: Power ka farak na bolna risky bana sakta hai

options.en: It isn't hard; power never affects a yes
options.hg: Mushkil nahi hai; power se haan par farak nahi padta

explain.en: When someone controls your marks, job or safety, saying no can feel like it has a cost. That is why people with power must take extra care, and why workplaces and schools have rules against it.
explain.hg: Jab koi tumhare marks, job ya safety control karta ho, toh na bolna mehenga lag sakta hai. Isiliye power wale logon ko extra dhyaan rakhna chahiye, aur isiliye offices aur schools mein iske khilaf rules hote hain.

q.en: Meera's manager keeps 'jokingly' massaging her shoulders at her desk. She has moved away twice. What is this?
q.hg: Meera ka manager 'mazaak mein' desk par uske kandhe dabata rehta hai. Woh do baar door hat chuki hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Unwelcome touch she can report to the Internal Committee
options.hg: Unwelcome touch jise woh Internal Committee ko report kar sakti hai

options.en: Harmless office culture she should get used to
options.hg: Normal office culture, use aadat daal leni chahiye

options.en: Friendly behaviour, since he does it to others too
options.hg: Friendly behaviour, woh doosron ke saath bhi karta hai

options.en: Her fault for not saying no more strongly
options.hg: Uski galti ki usne zor se na nahi bola

explain.en: Under the POSH Act, 2013, unwelcome physical contact at work can be sexual harassment of a woman. Workplaces with 10 or more employees must have an Internal Committee (ICC). Many company policies also protect other genders.
explain.hg: POSH Act, 2013 ke tahat kaam ki jagah par aurat ke saath unwelcome physical contact sexual harassment ho sakta hai. 10 ya usse zyada employees wali jagah par Internal Committee (ICC) honi chahiye. Kai companies ki policy doosre genders ko bhi protect karti hai.

q.en: A colleague keeps sending Anjali sexual 'jokes' on WhatsApp late at night, even after she asked him to stop. What can she do?
q.hg: Ek colleague raat ko Anjali ko WhatsApp par sexual 'jokes' bhejta rehta hai, uske mana karne ke baad bhi. Woh kya kar sakti hai?

options.en: Ignore it; messages outside office don't count
options.hg: Ignore kare; office ke bahar ke messages count nahi hote

options.en: Reply with jokes so she doesn't seem uptight
options.hg: Jokes se reply kare taaki boring na lage

options.en: Delete the chats so nobody thinks badly of her
options.hg: Chats delete kar de taaki koi uske baare mein bura na soche

options.en: Keep screenshots and complain to the Internal Committee
options.hg: Screenshots rakhe aur Internal Committee mein complaint kare

explain.en: Sexually coloured remarks that are unwelcome can be sexual harassment under the POSH Act, even on WhatsApp or after hours when it is linked to work. Keeping evidence helps any complaint.
explain.hg: Unwelcome sexual remarks POSH Act ke tahat sexual harassment ho sakte hain, WhatsApp par ya office time ke baad bhi, agar kaam se jude hon. Evidence rakhne se complaint mein help milti hai.

q.en: In college, seniors order first-years to strip as part of an 'intro'. What is true?
q.hg: College mein seniors first-years ko 'intro' ke naam par kapde utaarne ka order dete hain. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is a harmless tradition that builds bonding
options.hg: Yeh masoom parampara hai jisse bonding banti hai

options.en: It is ragging and a violation; report it to the college
options.hg: Yeh ragging aur violation hai; college ko report karo

options.en: Juniors must obey seniors in their first year
options.hg: First year mein juniors ko seniors ki baat maanni padti hai

options.en: It is fine if everyone in the batch does it
options.hg: Theek hai agar poora batch kar raha ho

explain.en: Forcing anyone to undress is a serious violation of consent and dignity, whatever the 'tradition'. Ragging is banned in Indian colleges, and every college must have an anti-ragging committee.
explain.hg: Kisi ko kapde utaarne par majboor karna consent aur izzat ka serious violation hai, 'parampara' kuch bhi ho. Indian colleges mein ragging banned hai, aur har college mein anti-ragging committee honi chahiye.

q.en: In a crowded metro, a man keeps brushing against a woman who keeps shifting away. Which is a safe 'delegate' option?
q.hg: Bheed wali metro mein ek aadmi baar-baar ek aurat se ragad raha hai jo door hat-ti ja rahi hai. Safe 'delegate' option kaunsa hai?

options.en: Push the man hard so he falls over
options.hg: Aadmi ko zor se dhakka do taaki gir jaye

options.en: Alert the metro staff or security, or call 112
options.hg: Metro staff ya security ko batao, ya 112 call karo

options.en: Film the woman's face and post it online
options.hg: Aurat ka chehra film karke online post karo

options.en: Tell the woman she should move to the ladies' coach
options.hg: Aurat ko bolo ki ladies coach mein chali jaye

explain.en: 'Delegate' means getting help from someone with authority, like staff, security, a guard or 112. It works when stepping in yourself does not feel safe.
explain.hg: 'Delegate' ka matlab hai authority wale se help lena, jaise staff, security, guard ya 112. Yeh tab kaam aata hai jab khud beech mein aana safe na lage.

q.en: You saw someone being harassed but could not step in at that moment. What can you still do?
q.hg: Tumne kisi ko harass hote dekha par us waqt beech mein nahi aa paaye. Ab bhi kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Nothing, the moment to help has already passed
options.hg: Kuch nahi, help ka moment nikal gaya

options.en: Post their photo online so people know
options.hg: Unki photo online daalo taaki logon ko pata chale

options.en: Tell them they should have shouted for help
options.hg: Unhe bolo ki unhe help ke liye chillana chahiye tha

options.en: Check on them afterwards and ask how you can help
options.hg: Baad mein unka haal poochho aur poochho kaise help karein

explain.en: This is called 'delay', one of the bystander Ds. Saying 'I saw that, are you okay?' tells the person they are not alone and that it was not their fault.
explain.hg: Ise 'delay' kehte hain, bystander ke Ds mein se ek. 'Maine dekha, tum theek ho?' bolne se unhe lagta hai ki woh akele nahi aur galti unki nahi thi.

q.en: If you record harassment as a bystander, what is the right thing to do with the video?
q.hg: Agar bystander ke roop mein tum harassment record karte ho, toh video ke saath sahi kya hai?

options.en: Ask the person harmed what they want done with it
options.hg: Jiske saath hua, unse poochho video ka kya karna hai

options.en: Post it online straight away to shame him
options.hg: Turant online daalo taaki usko sharam aaye

options.en: Share it in WhatsApp groups to warn people
options.hg: Logon ko alert karne ke liye WhatsApp groups mein share karo

options.en: Zoom in on the victim so it is clear what happened
options.hg: Victim par zoom karo taaki saaf dikhe kya hua

explain.en: Recording ('document') can help, but only from a safe distance and ideally when someone else is already helping. The video belongs to the person harmed: posting it without their consent can hurt them again.
explain.hg: Record karna ('document') help kar sakta hai, par sirf safe doori se aur behtar hai jab koi aur pehle se help kar raha ho. Video us insaan ka hai jiske saath hua: bina unke consent post karna unhe phir se hurt kar sakta hai.

q.en: In your friends' WhatsApp group, someone shares a 'joke' about forcing a girl. What is a good response?
q.hg: Doston ke WhatsApp group mein koi ladki ke saath zabardasti par 'joke' share karta hai. Achha response kya hai?

options.en: Send a laughing emoji so you fit in
options.hg: Laughing emoji bhejo taaki tum alag na dikho

options.en: Forward it to another group for a reaction
options.hg: Doosre group mein forward karo reaction ke liye

options.en: Say plainly that it's not funny and why
options.hg: Seedha bolo ki yeh funny nahi hai aur kyun

options.en: Leave quietly without saying anything
options.hg: Bina kuch bole chupchaap group chhod do

explain.en: Jokes about forcing someone make harm sound normal. One person saying 'Not cool, that's about hurting someone' often gives others the courage to agree.
explain.hg: Zabardasti par jokes harm ko normal bana dete hain. Ek insaan ka 'Not cool, yeh kisi ko hurt karne ki baat hai' bolna aksar baaki logon ko bhi himmat deta hai.

q.en: A friend tells you someone touched them without consent. What is the best first thing to say?
q.hg: Ek dost batata hai ki kisi ne use bina consent touch kiya. Sabse pehle kya bolna sabse achha hai?

options.en: 'Are you sure that's what really happened?'
options.hg: 'Pakka yahi hua tha?'

options.en: 'Why did you go there in the first place?'
options.hg: 'Tum wahan gaye hi kyun the?'

options.en: 'I believe you. It's not your fault.'
options.hg: 'Mujhe tum par bharosa hai. Tumhari galti nahi hai.'

options.en: 'Just forget it and move on quickly.'
options.hg: 'Bhool jao aur jaldi aage badho.'

explain.en: Being believed is the most important first step. Questions that doubt or blame make people stop talking. After that, ask what they need and help them reach a trusted adult or support.
explain.hg: Bharosa milna sabse zaroori pehla step hai. Shak ya blame wale sawaal logon ko chup kara dete hain. Uske baad poochho unhe kya chahiye aur trusted bade ya support tak pahunchne mein help karo.

q.en: Someone tells people about a sexual assault months after it happened. Does the delay mean it isn't true?
q.hg: Koi sexual assault ke baare mein mahino baad batata hai. Kya der se batane ka matlab yeh sach nahi?

options.en: No, many people need time because of fear or shame
options.hg: Nahi, darr ya sharam ki wajah se bahut logon ko time lagta hai

options.en: Yes, real victims always report immediately
options.hg: Haan, asli victims hamesha turant report karte hain

options.en: Yes, if they acted normal in the meantime
options.hg: Haan, agar beech mein woh normal behave kar rahe the

options.en: Only if they first told a friend, not police
options.hg: Sirf tab jab pehle dost ko bataya, police ko nahi

explain.en: Shock, fear, confusion and worry about not being believed often delay telling. Many survivors carry on with daily life while hurting inside. Delay is common and does not make it less true.
explain.hg: Shock, darr, confusion aur yeh fikr ki koi yakeen nahi karega, aksar batane mein der karwate hain. Bahut survivors andar se dard mein hote hue bhi roz ki zindagi chalate rehte hain. Der common hai aur isse sach kam nahi hota.

q.en: Your friend says her boyfriend forced her into things she said no to, but adds, 'He's my boyfriend, so maybe it doesn't count.' What is true?
q.hg: Tumhari dost kehti hai ki uske boyfriend ne un cheezon ke liye zabardasti ki jinke liye usne na bola tha, par phir kehti hai, 'Woh mera boyfriend hai, shayad yeh count nahi hota.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: It doesn't count between couples
options.hg: Couples ke beech yeh count nahi hota

options.en: It only counts if she broke up with him first
options.hg: Tabhi count hota hai jab woh pehle breakup kar chuki ho

options.en: It only counts if there were injuries
options.hg: Tabhi count hota hai jab chot lagi ho

options.en: It counts; a relationship never makes force okay
options.hg: Count hota hai; relationship mein bhi zabardasti theek nahi

explain.en: Most harm is done by someone the person knows, often a partner. A no means no inside a relationship too. Listen, believe her, and help her reach support she trusts.
explain.hg: Zyadatar harm koi jaan-pehchaan wala karta hai, aksar partner. Relationship ke andar bhi na ka matlab na hai. Suno, bharosa karo, aur use aise support tak pahunchao jis par woh bharosa kare.

q.en: A 19-year-old man tells you he was sexually assaulted and says no one will believe a guy. What is the best response?
q.hg: Ek 19 saal ka ladka batata hai ki uske saath sexual assault hua aur kehta hai ki ladke ki baat koi nahi maanega. Sabse achha response kya hai?

options.en: Tell him men can't really be assaulted
options.hg: Bolo ki mardon ke saath asal mein assault nahi hota

options.en: Believe him and help him find support
options.hg: Uski baat maano aur support dhoondhne mein help karo

options.en: Joke that he must have enjoyed it
options.hg: Mazaak karo ki use maza aaya hoga

options.en: Tell him to keep quiet to protect his image
options.hg: Bolo ki image bachane ke liye chup rahe

explain.en: Men and boys are sexually assaulted too, and stigma keeps many silent. Believe him, remind him it is not his fault, and help him reach medical care and support. Tele-MANAS 14416 offers free mental-health support.
explain.hg: Mardon aur ladkon ke saath bhi sexual assault hota hai, aur stigma bahut logon ko chup rakhta hai. Uski baat maano, yaad dilao ki galti uski nahi, aur medical care aur support tak pahunchao. Tele-MANAS 14416 free mental-health support deta hai.

q.en: At college, people keep touching a transgender classmate's hair and body 'out of curiosity'. What is true?
q.hg: College mein log ek transgender classmate ke baal aur body ko 'curiosity' mein chhoote rehte hain. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's fine if they ask questions politely after
options.hg: Theek hai agar baad mein politely sawaal poochh lein

options.en: Curiosity never gives anyone permission to touch
options.hg: Curiosity kisi ko touch karne ki permission nahi deti

options.en: Trans people are used to it, so it's okay
options.hg: Trans log iske aadi hote hain, toh theek hai

options.en: It is only wrong if the classmate complains
options.hg: Galat tabhi hai jab classmate complain kare

explain.en: Every person's body is their own, whatever their gender identity. Treating someone as an object of curiosity is disrespectful and can be harassment. If you're curious, read and learn; don't touch.
explain.hg: Har insaan ki body uski apni hai, gender identity kuch bhi ho. Kisi ko curiosity ki cheez samajhna disrespect hai aur harassment ho sakta hai. Curious ho toh padho aur seekho; touch mat karo.

q.en: A boy says no to kissing a girl on a dare at a party, and his friends call him 'not a real man'. What is true?
q.hg: Ek ladka party mein dare par ladki ko kiss karne se mana karta hai, aur dost use 'asli mard nahi' bolte hain. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Real men never turn down a chance like that
options.hg: Asli mard aisa mauka kabhi nahi chhodte

options.en: He should have just done it to save face
options.hg: Izzat bachane ke liye use bas kar lena chahiye tha

options.en: It shows that something is wrong with him
options.hg: Isse pata chalta hai ki usme kuch gadbad hai

options.en: It's his right; it has nothing to do with manhood
options.hg: Yeh uska haq hai; iska mardangi se koi lena-dena nahi

explain.en: Boys feel pressure to always want sex or physical contact, but they have the same right to say no. Respecting the girl's consent and his own is exactly what a decent person does.
explain.hg: Ladkon par hamesha 'chahne' ka pressure hota hai, par unhe bhi na bolne ka utna hi haq hai. Ladki ke consent aur apne consent dono ki respect karna hi ek achhe insaan ka kaam hai.

q.en: On a dating app, your match invites you to their home for the first date. You'd rather meet at a café. What is fair?
q.hg: Dating app par tumhara match pehli date ke liye ghar bulata hai. Tum café mein milna chahte ho. Fair kya hai?

options.en: Say so; a good match will be fine with a café
options.hg: Bata do; achha match café ke liye maan jayega

options.en: Go anyway, so you don't seem rude
options.hg: Phir bhi chale jao, taaki rude na lago

options.en: Cancel without a word and block them
options.hg: Bina kuch bole cancel karo aur block kar do

options.en: Agree, but share your location with nobody
options.hg: Haan bol do, par kisi ko location mat batao

explain.en: Choosing where you feel safe is a boundary, not rudeness. A public place for a first meeting is sensible, and telling a friend where you will be is a good habit.
explain.hg: Jahan tum safe feel karo woh chunna boundary hai, rudeness nahi. Pehli mulakat ke liye public jagah samajhdaari hai, aur kisi dost ko batana ki tum kahan ho, achhi aadat hai.

q.en: You agreed to go back to your date's flat for coffee. Does that mean you agreed to sex?
q.hg: Tumne date ke flat par coffee ke liye jaane ko haan bola. Kya iska matlab tumne sex ke liye haan bola?

options.en: Yes, everyone knows what 'coffee' means
options.hg: Haan, sab jaante hain 'coffee' ka kya matlab hai

options.en: Yes, if it is already late at night
options.hg: Haan, agar raat pehle hi bahut ho gayi hai

options.en: No, going there isn't agreeing to anything more
options.hg: Nahi, wahan jaana kisi aur cheez ka haan nahi hai

options.en: Yes, if you have already kissed before
options.hg: Haan, agar tum pehle kiss kar chuke ho

explain.en: Consent is about a specific act, given at that moment. Going to someone's home, kissing or flirting does not sign you up for anything else.
explain.hg: Consent ek specific act ke liye, usi moment diya jata hai. Kisi ke ghar jaana, kiss karna ya flirt karna tumhe kisi aur cheez ke liye sign up nahi karta.

q.en: After an expensive dinner, your date says, 'I paid for everything, so…' What is true?
q.hg: Mehenge dinner ke baad date bolta hai, 'Saara bill maine diya, toh…' Sach kya hai?

options.en: You should at least give them a kiss
options.hg: Kam se kam ek kiss toh dena chahiye

options.en: It's fair to split the bill in some other way
options.hg: Bill kisi aur tarah se chukana fair hai

options.en: Paying never earns anyone a yes
options.hg: Paise dene se kisi ka haan nahi kharida jata

options.en: You should have paid to avoid this
options.hg: Yeh na ho isliye tumhe pay karna chahiye tha

explain.en: Dinner, gifts or favours are not a down payment on someone's body. Expecting something in return turns kindness into pressure. Leaving is a completely fair choice.
explain.hg: Dinner, gifts ya favours kisi ki body ka advance nahi hain. Badle mein kuch expect karna kindness ko pressure bana deta hai. Wahan se nikal jaana bilkul fair choice hai.

q.en: Someone has had sex before. Does that make them more likely to say yes to you?
q.hg: Kisi ne pehle sex kiya hai. Kya isse woh tumhe haan bolne ke zyada chance mein hai?

options.en: No, past choices say nothing about today
options.hg: Nahi, purane faisle aaj ke baare mein kuch nahi batate

options.en: Yes, they have already crossed that line
options.hg: Haan, woh woh line pehle hi paar kar chuke hain

options.en: Yes, if they had more than one partner
options.hg: Haan, agar unke ek se zyada partners rahe

options.en: Yes, it means their no is less serious
options.hg: Haan, iska matlab unka na kam serious hai

explain.en: Every person decides fresh each time, with each partner. A person's sexual history never reduces their right to say no, and judging people for it is unfair.
explain.hg: Har insaan har baar, har partner ke saath naye sire se decide karta hai. Kisi ki sexual history uske na bolne ke haq ko kam nahi karti, aur iske liye judge karna galat hai.

q.en: Your partner wants to try something they saw in porn. You are not keen. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner kuch aisa try karna chahta hai jo usne porn mein dekha. Tumhara mann nahi hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: You should try it once to be a good partner
options.hg: Achha partner banne ke liye ek baar try karna chahiye

options.en: Porn shows what everyone actually does
options.hg: Porn wahi dikhata hai jo sab asal mein karte hain

options.en: Saying no means the relationship is in trouble
options.hg: Na bolne ka matlab relationship mein problem hai

options.en: You can say no; good partners talk and respect limits
options.hg: Tum na bol sakte ho; achhe partners baat karte hain aur limits maante hain

explain.en: Porn is staged and often skips consent and comfort. Partners can talk openly about what each wants, and each person's limits are respected, without pressure or sulking.
explain.hg: Porn staged hota hai aur aksar consent aur comfort ko skip karta hai. Partners khul ke baat kar sakte hain ki kaun kya chahta hai, aur har insaan ki limits bina pressure ya naraazgi ke maani jati hain.

q.en: After you say no, your partner gives you the silent treatment for days. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhare na bolne ke baad partner kai din tak tumse baat nahi karta. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A fair way to show they are hurt
options.hg: Hurt dikhane ka fair tareeka

options.en: Guilt-tripping, a kind of pressure
options.hg: Guilt-trip karna, ek tarah ka pressure

options.en: Normal space that every couple needs
options.hg: Normal space jo har couple ko chahiye

options.en: A sign you made the wrong choice
options.hg: Sign ki tumne galat faisla liya

explain.en: Feeling disappointed is human, and saying so is fine. Punishing someone with silence until they give in is pressure. A no should never come with a penalty.
explain.hg: Disappoint hona normal hai, aur bata dena bhi theek hai. Jab tak koi maan na jaye tab tak chuppi se saza dena pressure hai. Na ke saath koi saza nahi aani chahiye.

q.en: Someone sent a private photo to one person they trust. Does that person have consent to forward it?
q.hg: Kisi ne ek private photo sirf ek trusted insaan ko bheji. Kya us insaan ko ise forward karne ka consent hai?

options.en: Yes, once it is sent it belongs to them
options.hg: Haan, bhejne ke baad photo unki ho gayi

options.en: No, sending to one person isn't consent to share
options.hg: Nahi, ek ko bhejna share karne ka consent nahi hai

options.en: Yes, if they only share it with close friends
options.hg: Haan, agar sirf close friends ko bhejein

options.en: Yes, if the face is not clearly visible
options.hg: Haan, agar chehra saaf nahi dikh raha

explain.en: Consent is specific to who sees something. Sharing private images without consent is a serious violation and an offence under Indian law. For anyone under 18, never forward: tell a trusted adult and report it at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.
explain.hg: Consent is baat ke liye specific hai ki kaun dekhega. Bina consent private images share karna serious violation hai aur Indian law mein offence hai. 18 se kam umar ka mamla ho toh kabhi forward mat karo: trusted bade ko batao aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo.

q.en: Someone keeps calling you 'jaan' and sending heart emojis after you clearly said you're not interested. What is true?
q.hg: Tumne clearly bol diya ki interest nahi hai, phir bhi koi tumhe 'jaan' bolta rehta hai aur heart emojis bhejta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is romantic persistence, like in films
options.hg: Yeh romantic koshish hai, films jaisi

options.en: It is fine as long as they are polite
options.hg: Jab tak polite hain tab tak theek hai

options.en: You must reply, otherwise you're being rude
options.hg: Reply karna padega, warna tum rude ho

options.en: Continuing after a clear no is harassment
options.hg: Clear na ke baad bhi lage rehna harassment hai

explain.en: A no to a relationship applies to messages too. You can block, save screenshots and tell a trusted adult. Repeated unwanted contact can be stalking under the BNS, and cybercrime.gov.in or 1930 can help.
explain.hg: Relationship ka na messages par bhi laagu hota hai. Tum block kar sakte ho, screenshots rakh sakte ho aur trusted bade ko bata sakte ho. Baar-baar unwanted contact BNS ke tahat stalking ho sakta hai, aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Which situation shows real, free consent?
q.hg: Kaunsi situation asli, free consent dikhati hai?

options.en: Both are sober, relaxed and say they want to
options.hg: Dono hosh mein hain, relaxed hain aur bolte hain ki chahte hain

options.en: One agrees after being told 'you owe me'
options.hg: Ek 'tum mujhe owe karte ho' sunne ke baad maan jata hai

options.en: One agrees so the other won't share a secret
options.hg: Ek isliye maan jata hai taaki doosra secret na khole

options.en: One agrees after the other gets angry
options.hg: Ek doosre ke gussa hone ke baad maan jata hai

explain.en: Consent must be free of debt, threats and fear. A yes that comes from 'owing', blackmail or someone's anger is not a free choice.
explain.hg: Consent karz, dhamki aur darr se free hona chahiye. Jo haan 'owe' karne, blackmail ya kisi ke gusse se aaye, woh free choice nahi hai.

q.en: Someone is threatened with having their secret exposed unless they agree. What is this called?
q.hg: Kisi ko dhamki di jati hai ki agar woh nahi maane toh unka secret khol diya jayega. Ise kya kehte hain?

options.en: Negotiation between two equals
options.hg: Do barabar logon ke beech negotiation

options.en: A dare that they are free to accept
options.hg: Ek dare jise accept karne ki azadi hai

options.en: Coercion, so any 'yes' is not consent
options.hg: Coercion, isliye koi bhi 'haan' consent nahi hai

options.en: Consent, because they still had a choice
options.hg: Consent, kyunki unke paas phir bhi choice thi

explain.en: Blackmail removes free choice. Threatening to expose photos, chats or someone's sexuality to get them to agree is coercion and can be a crime. Report it to cybercrime.gov.in or 1930 and tell someone you trust.
explain.hg: Blackmail free choice khatam kar deta hai. Photos, chats ya kisi ki sexuality expose karne ki dhamki dekar haan karwana coercion hai aur crime ho sakta hai. cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo aur kisi trusted insaan ko batao.

q.en: Your cousin, also a teenager, keeps insisting on lying close to you at family sleepovers even though you've said no. What should you do?
q.hg: Tumhara teenage cousin family sleepovers mein baar-baar tumhare paas letne ki zid karta hai, tumhare mana karne ke baad bhi. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Put up with it to keep the peace in the family
options.hg: Family mein shanti ke liye seh lo

options.en: Keep it to yourself because he is family
options.hg: Apne tak rakho kyunki woh family hai

options.en: Sleep elsewhere and tell a parent you trust
options.hg: Kahin aur so jao aur kisi trusted parent ko batao

options.en: Wait until you're older to bring it up
options.hg: Bade hone tak ruko, phir baat karna

explain.en: Ignoring your no is not okay, even from family, and it is not your job to keep the peace. Telling a trusted adult lets them make sleeping arrangements that keep you comfortable and safe.
explain.hg: Tumhare na ko ignore karna theek nahi, family wala bhi kare tab bhi, aur shanti banaye rakhna tumhara kaam nahi. Trusted bade ko batane se woh aisa intezaam kar sakte hain jisme tum comfortable aur safe raho.

q.en: Why is it a problem when films show a hero 'convincing' a heroine who keeps saying no?
q.hg: Jab films mein hero baar-baar na bolne wali heroine ko 'mana leta' hai, toh yeh problem kyun hai?

options.en: It teaches that no means 'try harder'
options.hg: Yeh sikhata hai ki na ka matlab 'aur koshish karo' hai

options.en: It isn't a problem; films are not real
options.hg: Problem nahi; films real nahi hoti

options.en: It is only a problem in English films
options.hg: Yeh sirf English films mein problem hai

options.en: It is a problem only if he uses force
options.hg: Problem tabhi hai jab woh zabardasti kare

explain.en: Stories shape what people think romance looks like. When a no is shown as a challenge, real people may ignore it. Respect looks like hearing a no the first time.
explain.hg: Kahaniyan logon ki romance ki soch banati hain. Jab na ko challenge ki tarah dikhaya jata hai, toh asli log bhi use ignore kar sakte hain. Respect ka matlab hai pehli baar mein na sun lena.

q.en: At a party at home, a relative tells you to sit on a guest's lap for a photo. You don't want to. What can you say?
q.hg: Ghar ki party mein ek rishtedaar bolte hain ki photo ke liye ek guest ki god mein baith jao. Tumhara mann nahi hai. Kya bol sakte ho?

options.en: Nothing, because the guest might feel insulted
options.hg: Kuch nahi, kyunki guest ko bura lag sakta hai

options.en: 'Okay', and then cry quietly after the photo
options.hg: 'Okay', aur photo ke baad chupke se ro lena

options.en: 'Only if you give me a present afterwards'
options.hg: 'Sirf tab jab baad mein mujhe gift milega'

options.en: 'I'd like to stand next to you instead, thank you'
options.hg: 'Main aapke bagal mein khada hona chahta hoon, thank you'

explain.en: You can say no to sitting on anyone's lap, even for a photo. A polite 'No, thank you' with another idea works well, and a parent should back you up.
explain.hg: Tum kisi ki bhi god mein baithne se mana kar sakte ho, photo ke liye bhi. Ek polite 'No, thank you' aur koi doosra idea achha kaam karta hai, aur mummy-papa ko tumhara saath dena chahiye.

q.en: A friend secretly clicks a stranger's photo on the metro to post with 'cute or not?' in a group. What is true?
q.hg: Ek dost metro mein chupke se ek anjaan insaan ki photo kheenchta hai taaki group mein 'cute hai ya nahi?' likh kar daal sake. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's fine, because the metro is a public place
options.hg: Theek hai, kyunki metro public jagah hai

options.en: It's wrong: she never agreed to be photographed or rated
options.hg: Galat hai: usne photo ya rating ke liye kabhi haan nahi bola

options.en: It's fine if her face is a little blurry
options.hg: Theek hai agar chehra thoda blur hai

options.en: It's a compliment, so she would be happy
options.hg: Yeh compliment hai, woh khush hi hogi

explain.en: Being in public doesn't mean agreeing to be photographed and judged by strangers. Ask your friend to delete it. Treating people as objects to rate is disrespectful and can become harassment.
explain.hg: Public mein hona yeh nahi ki anjaan log tumhari photo kheench kar judge karein. Dost ko delete karne ko bolo. Logon ko rating ki cheez samajhna disrespect hai aur harassment ban sakta hai.

q.en: You ask your partner if they want to go further, and they say, 'Whatever you want.' What is the best response?
q.hg: Tum partner se poochhte ho ki aage badhna hai kya, aur woh bolte hain, 'Jo tum chaho.' Sabse achha response kya hai?

options.en: Take it as a yes and just carry on
options.hg: Ise haan samjho aur bas aage badho

options.en: 'I want to know what you want. We can wait.'
options.hg: 'Mujhe jaanna hai tum kya chahte ho. Hum ruk sakte hain.'

options.en: Take it as a sign they are just shy
options.hg: Samjho ki woh bas sharma rahe hain

options.en: Decide for both of you, since they let you
options.hg: Dono ke liye tum decide karo, unhone kaha hai

explain.en: 'Whatever you want' is not an enthusiastic yes. It may hide doubt or a wish to please. Asking about their own wishes, and being happy to wait, keeps consent real.
explain.hg: 'Jo tum chaho' enthusiastic haan nahi hai. Iske peeche doubt ya bas khush karne ki chahat ho sakti hai. Unki apni marzi poochhna, aur khushi se wait karna, consent ko asli rakhta hai.

q.en: When is the best time for a couple to talk about each other's boundaries?
q.hg: Ek couple ke liye ek doosre ki boundaries par baat karne ka sabse achha time kab hai?

options.en: Only after something has already gone wrong
options.hg: Sirf tab jab kuch galat ho chuka ho

options.en: Never; talking about it ruins the romance
options.hg: Kabhi nahi; isse romance kharab hota hai

options.en: Only in the middle of being physically close
options.hg: Sirf tab jab physically close ho rahe hon

options.en: When both are sober, calm and not in the moment
options.hg: Jab dono hosh mein, shaant hon aur us moment mein na hon

explain.en: Talking about likes, limits and 'stop' signals at a calm time makes it easier to speak up later. Checking in during closeness is still needed; the earlier talk just makes it easier.
explain.hg: Pasand, limits aur 'stop' signals ki baat shaant time par karne se baad mein bolna aasaan hota hai. Closeness ke dauraan check karna phir bhi zaroori hai; pehle ki baat bas use aasaan banati hai.

q.en: Under the BNS, if a woman did not physically resist, does that by itself mean she consented?
q.hg: BNS ke hisaab se, agar aurat ne physically virodh nahi kiya, toh kya sirf isse maana jayega ki usne consent diya?

options.en: No, the law says that alone is not consent
options.hg: Nahi, law kehta hai sirf isse consent nahi maana jata

options.en: Yes, not resisting means she agreed
options.hg: Haan, virodh na karna matlab haan

options.en: Yes, unless she had visible injuries
options.hg: Haan, jab tak koi chot na dikhe

options.en: Yes, if she already knew the person well
options.hg: Haan, agar woh us insaan ko pehle se achhe se jaanti thi

explain.en: The BNS defines consent as an unequivocal, voluntary agreement and says a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting. Fear often stops people from fighting back.
explain.hg: BNS consent ko ek saaf, apni marzi ka agreement maanti hai aur kehti hai ki jo aurat physically virodh nahi karti, sirf isi wajah se uska consent nahi maana jayega. Darr aksar logon ko virodh karne se rokta hai.

q.en: Someone goes on a date, then decides to go home early. Your friend says she 'led him on'. What is true?
q.hg: Koi date par jati hai, phir jaldi ghar jaane ka faisla karti hai. Tumhara dost kehta hai ki usne 'ladke ko umeed dila ke chhod diya'. Sach kya hai?

options.en: She owed him at least one more hour
options.hg: Use kam se kam ek ghanta aur rukna chahiye tha

options.en: Flirting means she promised something
options.hg: Flirt karne ka matlab usne kuch promise kiya tha

options.en: She can leave anytime; a date isn't a debt
options.hg: Woh kabhi bhi ja sakti hai; date koi karz nahi hai

options.en: She should apologise for wasting his time
options.hg: Use time waste karne ke liye sorry bolna chahiye

explain.en: Spending time with someone, flirting or saying yes to a date never creates a debt. Anyone can change their mind and leave. 'Leading on' talk is a way of blaming people for their own choices.
explain.hg: Kisi ke saath time bitana, flirt karna ya date ke liye haan bolna kabhi karz nahi banata. Koi bhi mann badal kar ja sakta hai. 'Umeed dila ke chhoda' wali baat logon ko unke apne faislon ke liye blame karne ka tareeka hai.

q.en: You decide to step in directly when someone is being harassed. What makes a 'direct' response safer?
q.hg: Tum kisi ke harassment mein seedha beech mein aane ka faisla karte ho. 'Direct' response ko kya safe banata hai?

options.en: Start a long argument to prove the harasser wrong
options.hg: Lambi behas karo taaki harasser galat saabit ho

options.en: Threaten to beat him up so he gets scared
options.hg: Maarne ki dhamki do taaki woh darr jaye

options.en: Keep it short and calm, and focus on the person harmed
options.hg: Chhota aur shaant rakho, aur jiske saath ho raha hai us par focus karo

options.en: Wait until you are alone with the harasser
options.hg: Wait karo jab tak harasser ke saath akele na ho

explain.en: A short line like 'Leave her alone' or 'Are you okay?', said calmly, is safer than a fight. Only go direct if you feel safe, and bring others in. Distract, delegate, document and delay are other options.
explain.hg: 'Usse chhod do' ya 'Tum theek ho?' jaisi chhoti line, shaanti se, ladai se zyada safe hai. Direct tabhi jao jab safe lage, aur doosron ko saath lo. Distract, delegate, document aur delay bhi options hain.

q.en: Your spouse says, 'Not tonight, I'm exhausted.' What is the respectful response?
q.hg: Tumhara spouse kehta hai, 'Aaj nahi, bahut thak gaya/gayi hoon.' Respectful response kya hai?

options.en: Accept it warmly, without sulking or arguing
options.hg: Pyaar se maan lo, bina naraaz hue ya behas kiye

options.en: Remind them that married couples shouldn't refuse
options.hg: Yaad dilao ki shaadi-shuda log mana nahi karte

options.en: Keep trying until they are less tired
options.hg: Koshish karte raho jab tak thakaan kam na ho

options.en: Sleep in another room to show you are hurt
options.hg: Hurt dikhane ke liye doosre kamre mein so jao

explain.en: A no in marriage is as valid as any other no. Accepting it kindly builds trust, and partners can talk later about how often each wants closeness.
explain.hg: Shaadi mein na bhi utna hi valid hai jitna koi aur na. Ise pyaar se maan lena trust banata hai, aur partners baad mein baat kar sakte hain ki kaun kitni closeness chahta hai.

q.en: On a dating app, someone sends you an explicit photo you never asked for. What is true?
q.hg: Dating app par koi tumhe ek explicit photo bhejta hai jo tumne kabhi nahi maangi. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's normal on dating apps, so ignore it
options.hg: Dating apps par yeh normal hai, ignore karo

options.en: It just means they really like you a lot
options.hg: Iska bas matlab hai woh tumhe bahut pasand karte hain

options.en: You should send one back to be fair to them
options.hg: Fair rehne ke liye tumhe bhi ek wapas bhejni chahiye

options.en: It's not okay without consent; you can report it
options.hg: Bina consent yeh theek nahi; tum report kar sakte ho

explain.en: Consent applies to what people see as well as touch. Unasked-for explicit images can be sexual harassment and an offence. Block, report on the app and, if needed, at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.
explain.hg: Consent touch ke saath-saath is par bhi laagu hota hai ki log kya dekhte hain. Bina maange explicit images bhejna sexual harassment aur offence ho sakta hai. Block karo, app par report karo, aur zaroorat ho toh cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par.

q.en: Under the POSH Act, does workplace sexual harassment have to involve touching?
q.hg: POSH Act ke tahat, kya workplace sexual harassment mein touch hona zaroori hai?

options.en: Yes, only physical contact counts under it
options.hg: Haan, isme sirf physical contact count hota hai

options.en: No, remarks, porn or asking for favours count
options.hg: Nahi, remarks, porn dikhana ya favours maangna bhi count hota hai

options.en: Yes, unless it happens again and again
options.hg: Haan, jab tak baar-baar na ho

options.en: Only if a senior is the one doing it
options.hg: Sirf tab jab koi senior aisa kare

explain.en: The POSH Act protects women at work. It covers unwelcome physical contact, requests for sexual favours, sexually coloured remarks, showing pornography and other unwelcome sexual conduct. Harassment by a junior or a colleague counts too.
explain.hg: POSH Act kaam ki jagah auraton ko protect karta hai. Yeh unwelcome physical contact, sexual favours maangna, sexual remarks, porn dikhana aur doosre unwelcome sexual conduct ko cover karta hai. Junior ya colleague ka harassment bhi count hota hai.

q.en: In simple biology, how does a pregnancy begin?
q.hg: Simple biology mein, pregnancy kaise shuru hoti hai?

options.en: An egg grows into a baby on its own every single month
options.hg: Egg har mahine apne aap hi baby ban jaata hai

options.en: Two people kiss or hug for a long time
options.hg: Do log der tak kiss ya hug karte hain

options.en: A sperm joins an egg and it settles in the uterus
options.hg: Sperm egg se milta hai aur woh uterus mein settle hota hai

options.en: A period stops because of stress or worry
options.hg: Stress ya tension se period ruk jaata hai

explain.en: Pregnancy starts when a sperm fertilises an egg and the fertilised egg implants in the lining of the uterus. Kissing, hugging or stress cannot start a pregnancy.
explain.hg: Pregnancy tab shuru hoti hai jab sperm egg ko fertilise karta hai aur fertilised egg uterus ki lining mein implant hota hai. Kiss, hug ya stress se pregnancy nahi hoti.

q.en: After an egg is fertilised, where does a healthy pregnancy normally grow?
q.hg: Egg fertilise hone ke baad, healthy pregnancy normally kahan grow karti hai?

options.en: In the fallopian tube
options.hg: Fallopian tube mein

options.en: In the uterus (womb)
options.hg: Uterus (garbhashay) mein

options.en: Inside the ovary
options.hg: Ovary ke andar

options.en: In the stomach
options.hg: Pet (stomach) mein

explain.en: A healthy pregnancy implants in the lining of the uterus. If it implants elsewhere, usually in a fallopian tube, it is an ectopic pregnancy, which is a medical emergency.
explain.hg: Healthy pregnancy uterus ki lining mein implant hoti hai. Agar kahin aur implant ho jaaye, aksar fallopian tube mein, toh woh ectopic pregnancy hai, jo medical emergency hai.

q.en: A rumour in class says you can get pregnant from a toilet seat or a swimming pool. Is that true?
q.hg: Class mein rumour hai ki toilet seat ya swimming pool se pregnant ho sakte hain. Kya yeh sach hai?

options.en: No, sperm cannot reach an egg that way
options.hg: Nahi, sperm aise egg tak nahi pahunch sakta

options.en: Yes, but only in warm water
options.hg: Haan, par sirf garam paani mein

options.en: Only if it happens during your period
options.hg: Sirf agar period ke time ho

options.en: Yes, if someone used it just before you
options.hg: Haan, agar kisi ne abhi abhi use kiya ho

explain.en: Sperm survive inside the body, not on seats or in pool water. Pregnancy needs sperm to enter the vagina and meet an egg. Toilet seats and pools cannot cause it.
explain.hg: Sperm body ke andar zinda reh sakte hain, seat ya pool ke paani mein nahi. Pregnancy ke liye sperm ka vagina mein jaana aur egg se milna zaroori hai. Toilet seat ya pool se aisa nahi hota.

q.en: Can a person get pregnant from kissing or hugging?
q.hg: Kya kiss ya hug karne se koi pregnant ho sakta hai?

options.en: No, they cannot cause pregnancy
options.hg: Nahi, inse pregnancy nahi hoti

options.en: Only if both people are over 18
options.hg: Sirf agar dono 18 se upar hon

options.en: Yes, if the kiss lasts a long time
options.hg: Haan, agar kiss bahut der tak chale

options.en: Yes, if it happens many times
options.hg: Haan, agar bahut baar ho

explain.en: Pregnancy can only happen when sperm meets an egg. Kissing and hugging do not bring sperm anywhere near an egg, so they cannot cause pregnancy.
explain.hg: Pregnancy tabhi ho sakti hai jab sperm egg se mile. Kiss aur hug se sperm egg tak nahi pahunchta, isliye inse pregnancy nahi ho sakti.

q.en: Can someone get pregnant the very first time they have sex?
q.hg: Kya koi pehli hi baar sex karne par pregnant ho sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, pregnancy can happen the first time
options.hg: Haan, pehli baar mein bhi pregnancy ho sakti hai

options.en: No, the body is not ready the first time
options.hg: Nahi, pehli baar body ready nahi hoti

options.en: Only if the hymen breaks and bleeds
options.hg: Sirf agar hymen tootkar bleeding ho

options.en: Only after periods have been regular for years
options.hg: Sirf jab periods saalon se regular hon

explain.en: If an egg has been released and sperm reach it, pregnancy can happen, first time or not. The hymen has nothing to do with it, and it cannot show whether someone has had sex.
explain.hg: Agar egg release ho chuka hai aur sperm usse mil jaaye, toh pregnancy ho sakti hai, chahe pehli baar ho. Hymen ka isse koi lena-dena nahi, aur woh yeh bhi nahi bata sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi.

q.en: Is it possible to get pregnant from sex during a period?
q.hg: Kya period ke dauraan sex se pregnant hona possible hai?

options.en: Only if it is the first day of the period
options.hg: Sirf agar period ka pehla din ho

options.en: No, period blood kills all the sperm
options.hg: Nahi, period ka blood saare sperm maar deta hai

options.en: Yes, it is less likely but possible
options.hg: Haan, chance kam hai par possible hai

options.en: No, a period means no egg exists at all
options.hg: Nahi, period mein egg hota hi nahi

explain.en: Sperm can survive in the body for several days, and in shorter or irregular cycles an egg may be released soon after a period ends. So pregnancy during or just after a period is possible.
explain.hg: Sperm body mein kai din tak zinda reh sakte hain, aur chhoti ya irregular cycle mein period khatam hote hi egg release ho sakta hai. Isliye period ke dauraan ya turant baad bhi pregnancy possible hai.

q.en: Once a girl's periods have started, what does it mean for her body?
q.hg: Jab kisi ladki ke periods shuru ho jaate hain, toh uski body ke liye iska kya matlab hai?

options.en: She is now fully grown and her body is ready for a baby
options.hg: Ab woh poori tarah badi hai aur body baby ke liye ready hai

options.en: Pregnancy is impossible until she turns 18
options.hg: 18 saal ki hone tak pregnancy impossible hai

options.en: Her body can release eggs, so pregnancy is possible
options.hg: Body egg release kar sakti hai, toh pregnancy possible hai

options.en: Pregnancy is only possible after marriage
options.hg: Pregnancy sirf shaadi ke baad possible hai

explain.en: Periods mean the ovaries have started releasing eggs, so pregnancy is biologically possible. That does not mean the body or the person is ready for a pregnancy; teen pregnancy carries higher health risks.
explain.hg: Periods ka matlab hai ovaries egg release karne lagi hain, toh biologically pregnancy possible hai. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki body ya woh insaan pregnancy ke liye ready hai; teenage pregnancy mein health risk zyada hota hai.

q.en: What is often the first sign of pregnancy that people notice?
q.hg: Log aksar pregnancy ka sabse pehla sign kya notice karte hain?

options.en: Hair falling out quickly
options.hg: Baal tezi se girna

options.en: A sudden rash on the face
options.hg: Chehre par achanak rash

options.en: A high fever for a week
options.hg: Hafte bhar tez bukhaar

options.en: A missed period
options.hg: Period miss hona

explain.en: A missed period is often the first clue, but periods can also be late because of stress, illness or other reasons. A pregnancy test is the way to know.
explain.hg: Period miss hona aksar pehla clue hota hai, par stress, bimaari ya aur wajahon se bhi period late ho sakta hai. Pakka jaanne ke liye pregnancy test karo.

q.en: Your classmate quietly asks how pregnancy happens and says she is too embarrassed to ask anyone. What is a helpful suggestion?
q.hg: Tumhari classmate chupke se poochti hai ki pregnancy kaise hoti hai, aur kehti hai ki kisi se poochne mein sharam aati hai. Kya suggest karna helpful hai?

options.en: Learn it from reels and from the older kids in the area
options.hg: Reels aur mohalle ke bade bachchon se seekh lo

options.en: Wait until marriage, people explain it then
options.hg: Shaadi tak ruko, tab log samjha dete hain

options.en: Do not ask, it is a shameful topic
options.hg: Mat poochho, yeh sharam wala topic hai

options.en: Ask a trusted adult, school counsellor or doctor
options.hg: Kisi trusted bade, school counsellor ya doctor se poochho

explain.en: Questions about the body are normal and deserve correct answers. A trusted adult, counsellor, doctor or an Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic gives facts; reels and rumours often spread myths.
explain.hg: Body ke baare mein sawaal normal hain aur sahi jawaab milna chahiye. Trusted bade, counsellor, doctor ya Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic facts batate hain; reels aur rumours aksar myths phailaate hain.

q.en: Does learning about contraception in school make teenagers start having sex earlier?
q.hg: Kya school mein contraception ke baare mein padhne se teenagers jaldi sex shuru kar dete hain?

options.en: No, good sex education is linked to safer choices
options.hg: Nahi, achhi sex education safer choices se judi hai

options.en: It makes no difference to anyone's health
options.hg: Isse kisi ki health par koi fark nahi padta

options.en: Yes, knowing about it always leads to trying it
options.hg: Haan, jaanne se log try karte hi hain

options.en: Yes, so it should only ever be taught after marriage
options.hg: Haan, isliye ise shaadi ke baad hi padhana chahiye

explain.en: Research reviewed by UNESCO and WHO shows that comprehensive sexuality education does not make young people start sex earlier. It helps them delay, say no, and stay safe when they do decide.
explain.hg: UNESCO aur WHO ki review ki gayi research batati hai ki comprehensive sexuality education se young log jaldi sex shuru nahi karte. Isse unhe ruk-ne, na bolne aur jab decide karein tab safe rehne mein madad milti hai.

q.en: A late period always means a person is pregnant. True or false?
q.hg: Period late hai matlab pakka pregnancy hai. Sach ya jhooth?

options.en: True: periods are never late for any other reason at all
options.hg: Sach: periods kisi aur wajah se kabhi late nahi hote

options.en: False: a late period means a weak body
options.hg: Jhooth: late period ka matlab kamzor body

options.en: True, if the person is above 15
options.hg: Sach, agar umar 15 se zyada ho

options.en: False: stress, illness or PCOS can also delay it
options.hg: Jhooth: stress, bimaari ya PCOS se bhi late hota hai

explain.en: Periods can be late because of stress, travel, illness, weight changes or conditions like PCOS. If pregnancy is possible, a home test gives a clear answer; a doctor can help if periods keep being irregular.
explain.hg: Stress, travel, bimaari, weight change ya PCOS jaisi condition se bhi period late ho sakta hai. Agar pregnancy possible hai toh home test se clear ho jaata hai; periods baar baar irregular hon toh doctor se milo.

q.en: Aman, 21, feels awkward buying condoms at a chemist. What is true?
q.hg: Aman, 21, ko chemist se condom khareedne mein awkward lagta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Chemists only sell condoms to married men
options.hg: Chemist sirf shaadishuda logon ko condom bechte hain

options.en: He needs a doctor's prescription before he can buy them
options.hg: Khareedne se pehle use doctor ka prescription chahiye

options.en: Buying condoms is legal and routine for chemists
options.hg: Condom khareedna legal hai, chemist ke liye routine hai

options.en: The chemist must note down his name and ID
options.hg: Chemist ko uska naam aur ID likhna padta hai

explain.en: Condoms are sold over the counter with no prescription, ID or marriage proof. Chemists sell them all day. Buying them is a responsible health choice, not something to be embarrassed about.
explain.hg: Condom bina prescription, ID ya shaadi ke proof ke milte hain. Chemist din bhar bechte hain. Condom lena ek responsible health choice hai, sharam ki baat nahi.

q.en: Before opening a condom, what should you check on the packet?
q.hg: Condom kholne se pehle packet par kya check karna chahiye?

options.en: The expiry date and that the wrapper is not torn
options.hg: Expiry date aur wrapper kahin se phata na ho

options.en: That the colour matches the box picture
options.hg: Ki colour box ki picture se match kare

options.en: That the brand is imported from abroad
options.hg: Ki brand bahar se imported ho

options.en: That it is the most expensive one in the shop
options.hg: Ki woh shop ka sabse mehenga wala ho

explain.en: An expired or damaged condom can tear. Check the date, make sure the wrapper is intact (you can often feel a small air cushion), and open it with fingers, not teeth or scissors.
explain.hg: Expired ya damaged condom phat sakta hai. Date check karo, wrapper sahi ho (aksar chhota sa air cushion feel hota hai), aur ungliyon se kholo, daant ya kainchi se nahi.

q.en: Which kind of lubricant is safe to use with a latex condom?
q.hg: Latex condom ke saath kaunsa lubricant safe hai?

options.en: A water-based lubricant
options.hg: Water-based lubricant

options.en: Petroleum jelly
options.hg: Petroleum jelly (Vaseline)

options.en: Coconut oil
options.hg: Nariyal tel

options.en: Body lotion or baby oil
options.hg: Body lotion ya baby oil

explain.en: Oils, petroleum jelly and lotions weaken latex and can make a condom break. Water-based or silicone-based lubricants are safe and can actually reduce the chance of tearing.
explain.hg: Tel, petroleum jelly aur lotion latex ko kamzor karte hain aur condom phat sakta hai. Water-based ya silicone-based lubricant safe hain aur phatne ka chance kam karte hain.

q.en: A friend says wearing two condoms at once gives double protection. What is true?
q.hg: Ek dost kehta hai ki ek saath do condom pehenne se double protection milta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Yes, it is what doctors usually advise
options.hg: Haan, doctor aksar yahi advise karte hain

options.en: It works if one is internal, one external
options.hg: Ek internal aur ek external ho toh kaam karta hai

options.en: No, they rub and are more likely to tear
options.hg: Nahi, ragadkar jaldi phat sakte hain

options.en: Yes, but only with extra-thin condoms
options.hg: Haan, par sirf extra-thin condoms ke saath

explain.en: One condom used correctly every time works best. Two condoms create friction and are more likely to break. The same goes for using an internal and an external condom together.
explain.hg: Ek condom ko sahi tarah har baar use karna best hai. Do condom ragadte hain aur phatne ka chance badhta hai. Internal aur external condom saath mein use karna bhi yahi problem deta hai.

q.en: Where is the best place to keep condoms until you need them?
q.hg: Condom ko use karne tak kahan rakhna sabse achha hai?

options.en: Somewhere cool and dry, away from sunlight
options.hg: Thandi, sookhi jagah, dhoop se door

options.en: In a bike's storage box in summer
options.hg: Garmi mein bike ki dikki mein

options.en: On a car dashboard so it stays handy
options.hg: Car ke dashboard par taaki haath mein rahe

options.en: In a back-pocket wallet for months
options.hg: Mahino tak back-pocket wale wallet mein

explain.en: Heat, sunlight and constant rubbing damage condoms. Keep them in a cool, dry place, and if one has been in a wallet or vehicle for a long time, use a fresh one.
explain.hg: Garmi, dhoop aur lagataar ragad se condom kharab hote hain. Thandi, sookhi jagah rakho, aur jo condom bahut time se wallet ya gaadi mein pada ho uski jagah naya use karo.

q.en: Can a condom be washed and used again?
q.hg: Kya condom ko dhokar dobara use kar sakte hain?

options.en: Only if it was used for a short time
options.hg: Sirf agar thodi der hi use hua ho

options.en: Yes, up to two or three times
options.hg: Haan, do-teen baar tak

options.en: No, a new condom is needed every time
options.hg: Nahi, har baar naya condom chahiye

options.en: Yes, if it is washed with soap
options.hg: Haan, agar sabun se dhoya ho

explain.en: Condoms are made for single use. Washing or reusing one weakens it and it can tear or leak. Use a new one each time and throw the used one in the bin, not the toilet.
explain.hg: Condom sirf ek baar ke liye bane hote hain. Dhone ya dobara use karne se woh kamzor hota hai aur phat ya leak ho sakta hai. Har baar naya lo aur purana dustbin mein daalo, toilet mein nahi.

q.en: When should a condom be put on during sex?
q.hg: Sex ke dauraan condom kab pehenna chahiye?

options.en: Only if the partner asks for it
options.hg: Sirf agar partner bole

options.en: Just before ejaculation happens
options.hg: Bas ejaculation hone se pehle

options.en: Before any genital contact begins
options.hg: Kisi bhi genital contact se pehle

options.en: Only after the first few minutes
options.hg: Sirf shuru ke kuch minute baad

explain.en: Pre-ejaculate (pre-cum) can contain sperm, and many STIs spread through skin and fluid contact. A condom protects only if it is on from the start until the end.
explain.hg: Pre-ejaculate (pre-cum) mein bhi sperm ho sakte hain, aur kai STIs skin aur fluid contact se phailte hain. Condom tabhi protect karta hai jab shuru se end tak laga ho.

q.en: What is an internal (female) condom?
q.hg: Internal (female) condom kya hota hai?

options.en: A pill a woman takes just before sex
options.hg: Ek goli jo woman sex se just pehle leti hai

options.en: A small device a doctor fits for years
options.hg: Chhota device jo doctor saalon ke liye lagata hai

options.en: A soft pouch worn inside the vagina
options.hg: Ek soft pouch jo vagina ke andar pehna jaata hai

options.en: A gel that kills sperm on contact
options.hg: Ek gel jo sperm ko turant maar deta hai

explain.en: The internal condom is a soft pouch placed inside the vagina before sex. Like the external condom, it lowers the risk of both pregnancy and STIs. It should not be used together with an external condom.
explain.hg: Internal condom ek soft pouch hai jo sex se pehle vagina ke andar lagaya jaata hai. External condom ki tarah yeh pregnancy aur STI dono ka risk kam karta hai. Ise external condom ke saath ek saath use nahi karte.

q.en: Riya is on the combined pill. Her partner says they can now stop using condoms. What does the pill NOT do?
q.hg: Riya combined pill leti hai. Uska partner kehta hai ab condom ki zaroorat nahi. Pill kya NAHI karti?

options.en: Protect against STIs like HIV or chlamydia
options.hg: HIV ya chlamydia jaise STIs se bachana

options.en: Work for a month if taken daily
options.hg: Roz lene par poore mahine kaam karna

options.en: Lower the chance of pregnancy
options.hg: Pregnancy ka chance kam karna

options.en: Prevent ovulation when taken correctly
options.hg: Sahi lene par ovulation rokna

explain.en: The pill is very good at preventing pregnancy when taken daily, but it gives no protection from STIs. Condoms are the only method that also lowers STI risk, so many couples use both.
explain.hg: Pill roz lene par pregnancy rokne mein bahut achhi hai, par STIs se bilkul nahi bachati. Sirf condom hi STI risk bhi kam karta hai, isliye kai couples dono use karte hain.

q.en: What does 'dual protection' mean?
q.hg: 'Dual protection' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Taking two pregnancy tests to be sure
options.hg: Pakka hone ke liye do pregnancy test karna

options.en: Guarding against both pregnancy and STIs
options.hg: Pregnancy aur STI dono se bachaav

options.en: Both partners taking the same pill
options.hg: Dono partners ka same pill lena

options.en: Using emergency pills twice a month
options.hg: Mahine mein do baar emergency pill lena

explain.en: Dual protection means protecting against pregnancy and STIs together: condoms on their own, or condoms plus another method such as the pill or an IUD for extra pregnancy protection.
explain.hg: Dual protection matlab pregnancy aur STI dono se ek saath bachaav: sirf condom se, ya condom ke saath pill ya IUD jaisa koi aur method jo pregnancy se aur bhi bachaaye.

q.en: Your partner refuses to use a condom and says, 'Don't you trust me?' What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner condom use karne se mana karta hai aur kehta hai, 'Mujh par trust nahi hai kya?' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Trust is enough to prevent pregnancy
options.hg: Trust hi pregnancy rokne ke liye kaafi hai

options.en: Asking for a condom means you suspect them
options.hg: Condom maangna matlab tum shak kar rahe ho

options.en: You can say no to sex without a condom
options.hg: Tum bina condom ke sex ko na bol sakte ho

options.en: You must agree to keep the relationship
options.hg: Relationship bachaane ke liye maanna padega

explain.en: Trust is not a method of contraception, and many STIs have no symptoms, so a partner may not know they have one. Wanting a condom is about health, and you always have the right to say no.
explain.hg: Trust contraception ka method nahi hai, aur kai STIs ke symptoms nahi hote, toh partner ko khud pata na ho. Condom maangna health ki baat hai, aur tumhe hamesha na bolne ka haq hai.

q.en: Where can people get free condoms in India?
q.hg: India mein free condom kahan mil sakte hain?

options.en: Only private chemists, at full price
options.hg: Sirf private chemist se, poori keemat par

options.en: Only police stations, after filling a form
options.hg: Sirf police station se, form bharkar

options.en: Government health centres and from ASHA workers
options.hg: Government health centres aur ASHA workers se

options.en: Only with a marriage certificate, at a district hospital
options.hg: Sirf shaadi ke certificate ke saath, district hospital se

explain.en: Government hospitals, PHCs, CHCs and many dispensaries give free condoms, and ASHA workers can supply them in villages and urban slums. No marriage proof or explanation is needed.
explain.hg: Government hospital, PHC, CHC aur kai dispensaries free condom dete hain, aur gaon ya basti mein ASHA workers bhi de sakti hain. Shaadi ka proof ya koi explanation nahi chahiye.

q.en: A friend says the free condoms from the government hospital 'don't work as well' as the ones in shops. What is true?
q.hg: Ek dost kehta hai government hospital ke free condom dukaan walon jitne 'achhe kaam nahi karte'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: They must be used two at a time to be safe
options.hg: Safe rehne ke liye do ek saath use karne padte hain

options.en: If in date and undamaged, they work the same
options.hg: Expiry ke andar aur sahi ho toh same kaam karte hain

options.en: They protect from pregnancy but not from STIs
options.hg: Pregnancy se bachaate hain par STI se nahi

options.en: Free condoms are only for display, not use
options.hg: Free condom sirf dikhane ke liye hain, use ke liye nahi

explain.en: What matters is that a condom is within its expiry date, the packet is intact and it is used correctly every time. A free condom used properly protects just like a bought one.
explain.hg: Zaroori yeh hai ki condom expiry ke andar ho, packet sahi ho aur har baar sahi use ho. Free condom bhi sahi use karne par kharide hue condom jaisa hi protect karta hai.

q.en: Is the emergency contraceptive pill the same as an abortion pill?
q.hg: Kya emergency contraceptive pill aur abortion pill ek hi cheez hain?

options.en: Yes, it is just a lower dose of the very same medicine
options.hg: Haan, yeh bas usi dawa ka kam dose hai

options.en: Yes, both end an early pregnancy
options.hg: Haan, dono shuruaati pregnancy khatam karti hain

options.en: No, it prevents pregnancy; it cannot end one
options.hg: Nahi, yeh pregnancy rokti hai, khatam nahi karti

options.en: Only if it is taken after 72 hours
options.hg: Sirf agar 72 ghante ke baad li jaaye

explain.en: Emergency contraception mainly works by delaying ovulation, so sperm and egg do not meet. It does not end an established pregnancy, which is why it is not abortion.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception mainly ovulation ko delay karti hai, taaki sperm aur egg na milein. Yeh pehle se ho chuki pregnancy ko khatam nahi karti, isliye yeh abortion nahi hai.

q.en: How does the emergency contraceptive pill mainly work?
q.hg: Emergency contraceptive pill mainly kaise kaam karti hai?

options.en: It delays ovulation (egg release)
options.hg: Ovulation (egg release) ko delay karti hai

options.en: It ends a pregnancy that has begun
options.hg: Shuru ho chuki pregnancy khatam karti hai

options.en: It cleans the uterus lining
options.hg: Uterus ki lining saaf kar deti hai

options.en: It flushes sperm out of the body
options.hg: Sperm ko body se bahar nikaal deti hai

explain.en: By delaying ovulation, emergency contraception keeps sperm already in the body from meeting an egg. That is why taking it sooner works better: it needs to act before ovulation.
explain.hg: Ovulation delay karke emergency contraception body mein pehle se maujood sperm ko egg se milne nahi deti. Isliye jaldi lena behtar hai: ise ovulation se pehle kaam karna hota hai.

q.en: Up to how long after unprotected sex can emergency contraception be used?
q.hg: Unprotected sex ke kitni der baad tak emergency contraception use ho sakti hai?

options.en: Only until the next morning
options.hg: Sirf agli subah tak

options.en: Up to two weeks, if no period comes
options.hg: Do hafte tak, agar period na aaye

options.en: Only within 12 hours of having sex
options.hg: Sex ke sirf 12 ghante ke andar

options.en: Up to 120 hours (5 days), sooner better
options.hg: 120 ghante (5 din) tak, jitna jaldi utna behtar

explain.en: Emergency contraception can be used up to 5 days (120 hours) after unprotected sex, but the sooner it is taken, the better it works. Do not wait to 'see what happens'.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception unprotected sex ke 5 din (120 ghante) tak use ho sakti hai, par jitni jaldi lo utna achha kaam karti hai. 'Dekhte hain kya hota hai' karke wait mat karo.

q.en: Your friend calls, panicking: the condom broke last night. What is the most useful advice?
q.hg: Tumhari dost ghabrakar call karti hai: kal raat condom phat gaya. Sabse useful advice kya hai?

options.en: Wash well with soap or antiseptic to remove all the sperm
options.hg: Sabun ya antiseptic se achhe se dhokar saare sperm nikaal do

options.en: Wait for the next period, nothing can be done now
options.hg: Agle period ka wait karo, ab kuch nahi ho sakta

options.en: Take a few pills from a regular pill strip
options.hg: Normal pill strip se kuch goliyan le lo

options.en: Get emergency contraception soon and think about STI risk
options.hg: Jaldi emergency contraception lo aur STI risk bhi socho

explain.en: Emergency contraception works best the sooner it is taken, up to 5 days. Washing does not remove sperm. If HIV exposure is possible, HIV PEP must start within 72 hours, so a clinic visit helps with both.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception jitni jaldi lo utna achha, 5 din tak. Dhone se sperm nahi nikalte. Agar HIV ka risk ho sakta hai toh HIV PEP 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye, isliye clinic jaana dono mein help karta hai.

q.en: After a condom broke with a partner whose HIV status is unknown, which statement about time limits is correct?
q.hg: Jis partner ka HIV status pata nahi, uske saath condom phat gaya. Time limit ke baare mein kaunsi baat sahi hai?

options.en: Both work any time before the next period
options.hg: Dono agle period se pehle kabhi bhi kaam karte hain

options.en: Both must be started within 12 hours of sex
options.hg: Dono sex ke 12 ghante ke andar shuru hone chahiye

options.en: EC: up to 5 days; HIV PEP: within 72 hours
options.hg: EC: 5 din tak; HIV PEP: 72 ghante ke andar

options.en: EC works up to 72 hours; HIV PEP up to 5 days
options.hg: EC 72 ghante tak; HIV PEP 5 din tak

explain.en: Emergency contraception can be used up to 5 days (120 hours) after sex. HIV PEP needs urgent medical assessment and must start as soon as possible, no later than 72 hours. Earlier is better for both.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception sex ke 5 din (120 ghante) tak use ho sakti hai. HIV PEP ke liye turant doctor ko dikhana zaroori hai aur yeh jaldi se jaldi, 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye. Dono ke liye jaldi behtar hai.

q.en: Neha, married, needs emergency contraception on day 4 after unprotected sex and also wants long-term contraception. Which option does both?
q.hg: Neha, shaadishuda, ko unprotected sex ke 4th din emergency contraception chahiye aur long-term contraception bhi. Kaunsa option dono karta hai?

options.en: A copper IUD fitted by a trained provider
options.hg: Trained provider se lagwaya gaya copper IUD

options.en: A condom used from now on
options.hg: Ab se condom use karna

options.en: Two emergency pills taken one day apart
options.hg: Ek din ke gap par do emergency pills

options.en: The combined pill started the same night
options.hg: Usi raat se combined pill shuru karna

explain.en: A copper IUD inserted within 5 days is the most effective emergency contraception, and it can then stay in place as long-term contraception for years. Her doctor will check that it suits her.
explain.hg: 5 din ke andar lagaya gaya copper IUD sabse effective emergency contraception hai, aur phir saalon tak long-term contraception ki tarah reh sakta hai. Doctor check karenge ki yeh unke liye sahi hai.

q.en: Can the emergency pill be used as a regular, every-week method?
q.hg: Kya emergency pill ko regular, har hafte wale method ki tarah use kar sakte hain?

options.en: No; regular methods prevent pregnancy better
options.hg: Nahi; regular methods pregnancy behtar rokte hain

options.en: Yes, as long as it is not more than twice a month
options.hg: Haan, bas mahine mein do baar se zyada na ho

options.en: Yes, it is the safest everyday method
options.hg: Haan, yeh sabse safe roz ka method hai

options.en: No, using it even once causes infertility
options.hg: Nahi, ek baar lene se bhi infertility hoti hai

explain.en: Emergency contraception is safe but is not designed for regular use, and regular methods such as condoms, the pill or an IUD prevent pregnancy more reliably. It does not cause infertility.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception safe hai par regular use ke liye nahi bani, aur condom, pill ya IUD jaise regular methods pregnancy zyada achhe se rokte hain. Isse infertility nahi hoti.

q.en: A WhatsApp forward says the emergency pill makes women infertile later. What is true?
q.hg: Ek WhatsApp forward kehta hai emergency pill se aage chalkar women infertile ho jaati hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: True, if taken more than once in life
options.hg: Sach, agar zindagi mein ek se zyada baar li

options.en: False: it does not affect future fertility
options.hg: Jhooth: isse aage ki fertility par asar nahi padta

options.en: True: one pill can block the tubes
options.hg: Sach: ek pill tubes block kar sakti hai

options.en: True, but only for women under 25
options.hg: Sach, par sirf 25 se kam umar wali women ke liye

explain.en: Emergency contraception works only on the current cycle by delaying ovulation. It does not damage the uterus, tubes or ovaries, and fertility is not affected.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception sirf us cycle par asar karti hai, ovulation delay karke. Yeh uterus, tubes ya ovaries ko nuksaan nahi pahunchati, aur fertility par asar nahi hota.

q.en: After taking an emergency pill, what is a normal thing to expect?
q.hg: Emergency pill lene ke baad kya normal hai?

options.en: Protection for the rest of the month
options.hg: Baaki mahine ke liye protection

options.en: The next period may come early or late
options.hg: Agla period jaldi ya late aa sakta hai

options.en: A heavy bleed the same day is guaranteed
options.hg: Usi din heavy bleeding pakka hogi

options.en: Periods stop completely for six months
options.hg: Periods chhe mahine ke liye poori tarah ruk jaate hain

explain.en: Some people get nausea, spotting or a period that is earlier or later than usual. If the period is much later than expected, take a pregnancy test. The pill does not protect against sex later in the cycle.
explain.hg: Kuch logon ko ulti jaisa lagna, spotting, ya period jaldi ya late aana ho sakta hai. Agar period umeed se kaafi late ho toh pregnancy test karo. Yeh pill cycle mein baad wale sex se protect nahi karti.

q.en: Does an emergency pill taken today protect against pregnancy from sex next week?
q.hg: Aaj li gayi emergency pill kya agle hafte ke sex se pregnancy se bachayegi?

options.en: Yes, for exactly seven days afterwards
options.hg: Haan, uske baad theek saat din tak

options.en: Yes, it protects for the whole month
options.hg: Haan, poore mahine protect karti hai

options.en: Yes, for as long as the next period has not started
options.hg: Haan, jab tak agla period shuru na ho

options.en: No, only for sex that has already happened
options.hg: Nahi, sirf pehle ho chuke sex ke liye

explain.en: Emergency contraception acts on sex that has already happened. For sex after that, a condom or a regular method is needed, otherwise pregnancy is still possible.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception sirf pehle ho chuke sex par kaam karti hai. Uske baad ke sex ke liye condom ya regular method chahiye, warna pregnancy ab bhi possible hai.

q.en: Does emergency contraception protect against STIs?
q.hg: Kya emergency contraception STIs se bachati hai?

options.en: Yes, if taken within 12 hours
options.hg: Haan, agar 12 ghante ke andar li jaaye

options.en: No, it gives no protection from STIs
options.hg: Nahi, yeh STIs se bilkul nahi bachati

options.en: Yes, but only against HIV
options.hg: Haan, par sirf HIV se

options.en: Yes, it kills bacteria as well as stopping ovulation
options.hg: Haan, ovulation rokne ke saath bacteria bhi maarti hai

explain.en: Emergency contraception only lowers the chance of pregnancy. If there is a risk of STIs or HIV, get tested, and for possible HIV exposure ask a doctor about PEP within 72 hours.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception sirf pregnancy ka chance kam karti hai. STI ya HIV ka risk ho toh test karao, aur HIV exposure ho sakta ho toh 72 ghante ke andar doctor se PEP ke baare mein poochho.

q.en: Someone takes an emergency pill without knowing she is already pregnant. What happens to the pregnancy?
q.hg: Kisi ne yeh jaane bina emergency pill le li ki woh pehle se pregnant hai. Pregnancy ka kya hoga?

options.en: It makes the pregnancy twins
options.hg: Isse twins ho jaate hain

options.en: It turns into an ectopic pregnancy
options.hg: Woh ectopic pregnancy ban jaati hai

options.en: It does not end an established pregnancy
options.hg: Pehle se ho chuki pregnancy khatam nahi hoti

options.en: The pregnancy will definitely end
options.hg: Pregnancy pakka khatam ho jayegi

explain.en: Emergency contraception works before ovulation and does not end a pregnancy that has already implanted. Anyone who may be pregnant should take a test and see a doctor for advice and care.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception ovulation se pehle kaam karti hai aur implant ho chuki pregnancy ko khatam nahi karti. Jise lage ki woh pregnant ho sakti hai, woh test kare aur doctor se mile.

q.en: A chemist refuses to sell an emergency pill to an adult woman, saying 'unmarried girls shouldn't need it'. What is true?
q.hg: Ek chemist adult woman ko emergency pill dene se mana karta hai, kehta hai 'unmarried ladkiyon ko iski kya zaroorat'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Marital status doesn't matter; try elsewhere
options.hg: Shaadi se fark nahi padta; kahin aur try karo

options.en: She has to file a police complaint first
options.hg: Pehle police complaint karni padegi

options.en: Only married women can legally buy it
options.hg: Sirf shaadishuda women legally khareed sakti hain

options.en: She must bring her parents' written permission
options.hg: Use parents ki likhit permission laani hogi

explain.en: Emergency contraception is sold without a prescription, and there is no rule that only married women can buy it. Time matters, so go to another chemist, a government hospital or a clinic quickly.
explain.hg: Emergency contraception bina prescription milti hai, aur aisa koi rule nahi ki sirf shaadishuda women hi le sakti hain. Time important hai, toh jaldi doosre chemist, government hospital ya clinic jao.

q.en: How should the combined oral contraceptive pill be taken?
q.hg: Combined oral contraceptive pill kaise leni chahiye?

options.en: Every day, at about the same time
options.hg: Roz, lagbhag ek hi time par

options.en: Once a month, after the period
options.hg: Mahine mein ek baar, period ke baad

options.en: Only on days when you have sex
options.hg: Sirf us din jab sex ho

options.en: Right after sex, as soon as possible
options.hg: Sex ke turant baad, jitna jaldi ho

explain.en: The combined pill works by being taken daily, which keeps ovulation from happening. Missing pills is the main reason it fails in real life, so a phone reminder helps.
explain.hg: Combined pill roz lene se kaam karti hai, jisse ovulation nahi hota. Real life mein pill fail hone ki sabse badi wajah goli miss karna hai, toh phone reminder madad karta hai.

q.en: Does taking the contraceptive pill for years make a woman permanently infertile?
q.hg: Kya saalon tak contraceptive pill lene se woman hamesha ke liye infertile ho jaati hai?

options.en: Only if she never had a baby before
options.hg: Sirf agar pehle koi baby na hua ho

options.en: Yes, after five years of use
options.hg: Haan, paanch saal use karne ke baad

options.en: Yes, if started before marriage
options.hg: Haan, agar shaadi se pehle shuru ki

options.en: No, fertility returns soon after stopping
options.hg: Nahi, band karne ke baad fertility jaldi laut aati hai

explain.en: The pill's effect wears off soon after stopping, and most people can get pregnant within a few months. Using it before a first pregnancy does not harm future fertility.
explain.hg: Pill band karne ke kuch time baad hi uska asar khatam ho jaata hai, aur zyaadatar log kuch mahino mein pregnant ho sakte hain. Pehli pregnancy se pehle use karne se aage ki fertility kharab nahi hoti.

q.en: With perfect use the pill fails for fewer than 1 in 100 users a year, but with typical use for about 7. What explains the gap?
q.hg: Perfect use mein pill 100 mein se 1 se kam users ke liye fail hoti hai, par typical use mein lagbhag 7 ke liye. Yeh gap kyun hai?

options.en: Fake pills are sold in most shops
options.hg: Zyaadatar dukaano mein nakli goliyan milti hain

options.en: The pill simply stops working after a few months of use
options.hg: Kuch mahine use ke baad pill kaam karna band kar deti hai

options.en: Pills get missed or taken late in real life
options.hg: Real life mein goliyan miss ya late ho jaati hain

options.en: The pill works only for married women
options.hg: Pill sirf shaadishuda women par kaam karti hai

explain.en: Per WHO family-planning data, the gap comes from everyday life: forgotten pills, late pills, or stopping without starting another method. Methods you don't have to remember, like IUDs and implants, have almost no gap.
explain.hg: WHO family-planning data ke hisaab se yeh gap roz ki zindagi se aata hai: bhooli hui goli, late goli, ya bina doosra method shuru kiye band karna. IUD aur implant jaise methods mein yaad nahi rakhna padta, toh gap lagbhag nahi hota.
