q.en: What is the name of the free combined contraceptive pill given through India's government health system?
q.hg: India ke government health system mein milne wali free combined contraceptive pill ka naam kya hai?

options.en: Chhaya
options.hg: Chhaya

options.en: Mala-N
options.hg: Mala-N

options.en: Nischay
options.hg: Nischay

options.en: Antara
options.hg: Antara

explain.en: Mala-N is the government's free combined pill. Chhaya is a non-hormonal weekly pill, Antara is a contraceptive injection, and Nischay is the pregnancy test kit. ASHA workers and health centres can supply them.
explain.hg: Mala-N government ki free combined pill hai. Chhaya non-hormonal weekly pill hai, Antara contraceptive injection hai, aur Nischay pregnancy test kit hai. ASHA workers aur health centres ye de sakte hain.

q.en: Which government contraceptive is a non-hormonal pill that, after the first three months, is taken once a week?
q.hg: Kaunsa government contraceptive ek non-hormonal pill hai jo pehle teen mahine ke baad hafte mein ek baar li jaati hai?

options.en: Mala-N
options.hg: Mala-N

options.en: Chhaya
options.hg: Chhaya

options.en: Antara
options.hg: Antara

options.en: Copper-T
options.hg: Copper-T

explain.en: Chhaya (centchroman) is a non-hormonal pill: it is taken twice a week for the first three months and then once a week. It is available free at government facilities.
explain.hg: Chhaya (centchroman) ek non-hormonal pill hai: pehle teen mahine hafte mein do baar aur phir hafte mein ek baar li jaati hai. Yeh government facilities par free milti hai.

q.en: What is Antara, offered at government health facilities?
q.hg: Government health facilities mein milne wala Antara kya hai?

options.en: A vaccine that prevents STIs
options.hg: STIs se bachane wali vaccine

options.en: An injection given every three months
options.hg: Har teen mahine lagne wala injection

options.en: A daily pill taken at bedtime
options.hg: Raat ko sone se pehle li jaane wali daily pill

options.en: A permanent operation for women
options.hg: Women ke liye permanent operation

explain.en: Antara is an injectable contraceptive given every three months by a health worker. With typical use about 4 in 100 users get pregnant in a year, fewer than with the pill, because there is nothing to remember daily.
explain.hg: Antara ek injectable contraceptive hai jo health worker har teen mahine lagate hain. Typical use mein saal mein 100 mein se lagbhag 4 users pregnant hote hain, pill se kam, kyunki roz kuch yaad nahi rakhna padta.

q.en: On the Antara injection, Kavita's periods have stopped. Her mother fears 'dirty blood' is collecting inside. What is true?
q.hg: Antara injection par Kavita ke periods ruk gaye hain. Uski mummy ko darr hai ki andar 'ganda khoon' jama ho raha hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Blood is collecting and must be removed
options.hg: Khoon jama ho raha hai, nikalwana padega

options.en: Her body is going into early menopause
options.hg: Uski body jaldi menopause mein ja rahi hai

options.en: It means she is pregnant despite getting the injection
options.hg: Matlab injection lene ke bawajood woh pregnant hai

options.en: No blood builds up; the uterus lining just stays thin
options.hg: Khoon jama nahi hota; bas uterus ki lining patli rehti hai

explain.en: Hormonal methods like the injection can keep the uterus lining thin, so periods become light or stop. Nothing is stored inside and it is not harmful; periods usually return some time after stopping.
explain.hg: Injection jaise hormonal methods uterus ki lining ko patla rakhte hain, isliye periods halke ho jaate hain ya ruk jaate hain. Andar kuch jama nahi hota aur yeh harmful nahi hai; band karne ke kuch time baad periods laut aate hain.

q.en: Meena stopped Antara injections and wants a baby soon. What should she know?
q.hg: Meena ne Antara injection band kar diye aur jaldi baby chahti hai. Use kya pata hona chahiye?

options.en: Fertility returns, but may take a few months longer
options.hg: Fertility laut aati hai, par kuch mahine zyada lag sakte hain

options.en: She will get pregnant the very next week
options.hg: Woh agle hi hafte pakka pregnant ho jayegi

options.en: She can never get pregnant after having had injections
options.hg: Injection lene ke baad woh kabhi pregnant nahi ho sakti

options.en: She must have an operation to reverse it
options.hg: Ise reverse karne ke liye operation chahiye

explain.en: After the injection, fertility does come back, but it can take a few months longer than after stopping the pill or removing an IUD. Couples planning a pregnancy soon may choose a different method.
explain.hg: Injection ke baad fertility wapas aati hai, par pill band karne ya IUD nikalwane ke muqable kuch mahine zyada lag sakte hain. Jo couple jaldi pregnancy plan kar rahe hain woh doosra method choose kar sakte hain.

q.en: In the first months on the pill, some users notice spotting or mild nausea. What is the usual advice?
q.hg: Pill ke pehle kuch mahino mein kuch users ko spotting ya halki nausea hoti hai. Aam taur par kya advice hai?

options.en: Take two pills a day to fix it
options.hg: Theek karne ke liye din mein do goli lo

options.en: Often settles; check with a doctor first
options.hg: Aksar theek ho jaata hai; pehle doctor se poochho

options.en: Stop at once; it means the pill is fake
options.hg: Turant band karo; matlab pill nakli hai

options.en: It means the person is now infertile
options.hg: Matlab woh ab infertile ho gayi hai

explain.en: Spotting and mild nausea are common early side effects and often settle within a few months. If they bother you, a doctor can suggest another pill or method; stopping suddenly without a backup risks pregnancy.
explain.hg: Spotting aur halki nausea shuru ke common side effects hain aur aksar kuch mahino mein theek ho jaate hain. Pareshaani ho toh doctor doosri pill ya method suggest kar sakte hain; bina backup ke achanak band karne se pregnancy ka risk hai.

q.en: Why is it a good idea to see a doctor or nurse before starting the combined pill?
q.hg: Combined pill shuru karne se pehle doctor ya nurse se milna kyun achha hai?

options.en: It only works after a weekly blood test
options.hg: Yeh sirf weekly blood test ke baad kaam karti hai

options.en: Some health conditions make it unsuitable
options.hg: Kuch health conditions mein yeh sahi nahi hoti

options.en: Doctors must inform the family first
options.hg: Doctor ko pehle family ko batana padta hai

options.en: It must be started with an injection
options.hg: Ise injection ke saath shuru karna padta hai

explain.en: Conditions such as a history of blood clots or certain migraines can make the combined pill unsafe. A short check helps pick a method that suits your body, and there are many options.
explain.hg: Blood clot ki history ya kuch tarah ke migraine jaisi conditions mein combined pill safe nahi hoti. Ek chhota check-up tumhari body ke liye sahi method chunne mein madad karta hai, aur options bahut hain.

q.en: Your friend offers you a strip of her contraceptive pills to 'try out'. Is sharing pills a good idea?
q.hg: Tumhari dost apni contraceptive pills ki strip 'try karne' ke liye deti hai. Kya pills share karna theek hai?

options.en: Yes, the pill works from the first pill
options.hg: Haan, pill pehli goli se kaam karti hai

options.en: Yes, if you take double the amount
options.hg: Haan, agar double quantity lo

options.en: No, a method should be chosen for your own health
options.hg: Nahi, method apni health ke hisaab se chunna chahiye

options.en: Yes, all pills suit everyone's body in exactly the same way
options.hg: Haan, saari pills har body ko bilkul ek jaisi suit karti hain

explain.en: Different pills suit different bodies, and starting one correctly needs guidance on when it begins to protect. A doctor, nurse or government health centre can help choose safely, often for free.
explain.hg: Alag pills alag body ko suit karti hain, aur sahi tarah shuru karne ke liye yeh jaanna zaroori hai ki protection kab se milega. Doctor, nurse ya government health centre safely chunne mein madad karte hain, aksar free.

q.en: What is a Copper-T (copper IUD)?
q.hg: Copper-T (copper IUD) kya hai?

options.en: A permanent operation on the tubes
options.hg: Tubes ka permanent operation

options.en: A small device in the uterus that lasts years
options.hg: Uterus mein lagne wala chhota device jo saalon chalta hai

options.en: A copper bracelet that balances hormones
options.hg: Copper ka kada jo hormones balance karta hai

options.en: A tablet taken daily with copper water
options.hg: Taambe ke paani ke saath roz li jaane wali tablet

explain.en: A Copper-T is a small T-shaped device that a trained provider places in the uterus. It prevents pregnancy for many years, depending on the type, and can be removed whenever the person wants.
explain.hg: Copper-T ek chhota T-shaped device hai jo trained provider uterus mein lagate hain. Type ke hisaab se yeh kai saal tak pregnancy rokta hai, aur jab chaaho tab nikalwaya ja sakta hai.

q.en: A couple using a Copper-T now wants a baby. What should they know?
q.hg: Copper-T use karne wala couple ab baby chahta hai. Unhe kya pata hona chahiye?

options.en: It can be removed and fertility returns quickly
options.hg: Ise nikalwa sakte hain, fertility jaldi laut aati hai

options.en: They must wait several years after it has been removed
options.hg: Nikalwane ke baad unhe kai saal wait karna hoga

options.en: A Copper-T cannot be removed once fitted
options.hg: Copper-T ek baar lagne ke baad nahi nikalta

options.en: They need surgery to reverse its effect
options.hg: Asar khatam karne ke liye surgery chahiye

explain.en: A trained provider can remove a Copper-T in a quick clinic visit, and the ability to get pregnant returns soon after. It is a reversible method, not a permanent one.
explain.hg: Trained provider clinic mein jaldi Copper-T nikaal sakte hain, aur uske baad pregnant hone ki ability jaldi wapas aati hai. Yeh reversible method hai, permanent nahi.

q.en: Sunita has just given birth at a government hospital and wants to space her next pregnancy. What can be offered before she goes home?
q.hg: Sunita ne abhi government hospital mein baby ko janm diya hai aur agli pregnancy mein gap chahti hai. Ghar jaane se pehle kya offer ho sakta hai?

options.en: A Copper-T fitted after delivery (PPIUCD)
options.hg: Delivery ke baad laga Copper-T (PPIUCD)

options.en: Only advice to count safe days
options.hg: Sirf safe days ginne ki advice

options.en: Emergency pills to take every month
options.hg: Har mahine lene ke liye emergency pills

options.en: Nothing, contraception waits a year
options.hg: Kuch nahi, contraception ek saal baad

explain.en: Government hospitals offer a post-partum IUCD (PPIUCD), a Copper-T placed shortly after delivery. It gives long-term spacing without daily effort. Condoms and other methods are options too.
explain.hg: Government hospital post-partum IUCD (PPIUCD) dete hain, yaani delivery ke thodi der baad lagaya gaya Copper-T. Isse bina roz ki mehnat ke lamba gap milta hai. Condom aur doosre methods bhi options hain.

q.en: A relative says a Copper-T can move up into the heart or stomach. What is true?
q.hg: Ek rishtedaar kehti hain ki Copper-T upar dil ya pet tak chala jaata hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It can't travel there; it stays in the uterus
options.hg: Wahan nahi ja sakta; uterus mein hi rehta hai

options.en: It moves to the stomach after every period
options.hg: Har period ke baad pet mein chala jaata hai

options.en: It often travels to the heart within a year
options.hg: Saal bhar mein aksar dil tak pahunch jaata hai

options.en: It dissolves into the blood over time
options.hg: Dheere dheere khoon mein ghul jaata hai

explain.en: A Copper-T sits in the uterus and cannot travel to the heart. Rarely it can slip out or, very rarely, push into the uterine wall, which is why a follow-up check is advised and any unusual pain should be shown to a doctor.
explain.hg: Copper-T uterus mein rehta hai aur dil tak nahi ja sakta. Kabhi kabhi yeh khisak kar bahar aa sakta hai ya bahut rarely uterus ki deewar mein dhans sakta hai, isliye follow-up check advise kiya jaata hai aur koi unusual dard ho toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: Why do IUDs and implants have almost the same success rate in typical use as in perfect use?
q.hg: IUD aur implant ka success rate typical use aur perfect use mein lagbhag same kyun hota hai?

options.en: They contain stronger hormones than pills
options.hg: Inme pills se zyada strong hormones hote hain

options.en: They are only given to married women
options.hg: Ye sirf shaadishuda women ko diye jaate hain

options.en: They also protect against all STIs
options.hg: Ye saare STIs se bhi bachaate hain

options.en: Once in place, there is nothing to remember
options.hg: Ek baar lagne ke baad kuch yaad nahi rakhna padta

explain.en: WHO figures put IUDs and implants under 1 pregnancy per 100 users a year in both typical and perfect use, because they work without daily action. The copper IUD has no hormones at all. Neither protects against STIs.
explain.hg: WHO figures ke hisaab se IUD aur implant mein typical aur perfect dono use mein saal mein 100 users mein 1 se kam pregnancy hoti hai, kyunki ye bina roz ke action ke kaam karte hain. Copper IUD mein hormone hote hi nahi. Dono STIs se nahi bachaate.

q.en: What is a contraceptive implant?
q.hg: Contraceptive implant kya hai?

options.en: A copper wire inserted into both of the fallopian tubes
options.hg: Dono fallopian tubes mein daala gaya copper wire

options.en: A tablet that dissolves under the tongue
options.hg: Jeebh ke neeche ghulne wali tablet

options.en: A plastic ring worn around the waist
options.hg: Kamar par pehna jaane wala plastic ring

options.en: A small rod placed under the skin of the upper arm
options.hg: Upper arm ki skin ke neeche lagne wali chhoti rod

explain.en: An implant is a small flexible rod placed under the skin of the upper arm. It releases a hormone and prevents pregnancy for several years, with fewer than 1 pregnancy per 100 users a year.
explain.hg: Implant ek chhoti flexible rod hai jo upper arm ki skin ke neeche lagti hai. Yeh hormone release karti hai aur kai saal tak pregnancy rokti hai, saal mein 100 users mein 1 se kam pregnancy.

q.en: A couple with one child wants a gap of a few years, and the wife does not want a daily pill. Which option fits best?
q.hg: Ek bachche wala couple kuch saal ka gap chahta hai, aur wife roz ki pill nahi chahti. Kaunsa option best fit hai?

options.en: Sterilisation, the only choice after a child
options.hg: Sterilisation, bachche ke baad ek hi option

options.en: Emergency pills every month
options.hg: Har mahine emergency pills

options.en: Counting safe days on a calendar
options.hg: Calendar par safe days ginna

options.en: A Copper-T or the Antara injection
options.hg: Copper-T ya Antara injection

explain.en: For spacing without daily effort, a Copper-T (lasts years) or the three-monthly Antara injection work well, and both are free at government facilities. Sterilisation is permanent, so it suits couples who want no more children.
explain.hg: Bina roz ki mehnat ke gap ke liye Copper-T (saalon chalta hai) ya teen mahine wala Antara injection achha hai, aur dono government facilities par free hain. Sterilisation permanent hai, toh yeh unke liye hai jinhe aur bachche nahi chahiye.

q.en: Is 'pulling out' (withdrawal) a reliable way to prevent pregnancy?
q.hg: Kya 'pull out' (withdrawal) pregnancy rokne ka reliable tareeka hai?

options.en: Yes, and it also prevents STIs
options.hg: Haan, aur yeh STIs bhi rokta hai

options.en: No, it often fails in real life
options.hg: Nahi, real life mein aksar fail hota hai

options.en: Yes, it is as good as the pill
options.hg: Haan, yeh pill jitna hi achha hai

options.en: Yes, if the couple is experienced
options.hg: Haan, agar couple experienced ho

explain.en: With typical use about 20 in 100 couples relying on withdrawal get pregnant in a year (WHO). Pre-ejaculate can carry sperm and timing is hard to control. It gives no STI protection.
explain.hg: Typical use mein withdrawal par nirbhar 100 mein se lagbhag 20 couples saal bhar mein pregnant ho jaate hain (WHO). Pre-ejaculate mein sperm ho sakte hain aur timing control karna mushkil hai. Isse STI protection nahi milta.

q.en: Why can pregnancy happen even if the man pulls out before ejaculating?
q.hg: Agar aadmi ejaculate karne se pehle pull out kar le, tab bhi pregnancy kyun ho sakti hai?

options.en: Pulling out releases a pregnancy hormone
options.hg: Pull out karne se pregnancy hormone nikalta hai

options.en: Sperm can jump across short distances
options.hg: Sperm thodi doori tak jump kar sakte hain

options.en: The woman's body makes its own sperm
options.hg: Woman ki body khud sperm banati hai

options.en: Pre-ejaculate fluid can contain sperm
options.hg: Pre-ejaculate fluid mein sperm ho sakte hain

explain.en: The fluid that comes out before ejaculation (pre-cum) can carry sperm, and pulling out in time is hard. That is why withdrawal is much less reliable than condoms or other methods.
explain.hg: Ejaculation se pehle nikalne wala fluid (pre-cum) bhi sperm le ja sakta hai, aur time par pull out karna mushkil hai. Isliye withdrawal condom ya doosre methods se kaafi kam reliable hai.

q.en: On a college WhatsApp group someone posts: 'Pull-out is 100% safe if you're careful.' What is the accurate reply?
q.hg: College WhatsApp group par koi post karta hai: 'Dhyan se karo toh pull-out 100% safe hai.' Sahi reply kya hai?

options.en: True: experts call it the safest method
options.hg: Sahi: experts ise sabse safe method kehte hain

options.en: True, if done during the first week of the cycle
options.hg: Sahi, agar cycle ke pehle hafte mein ho

options.en: True, and it protects against HIV too
options.hg: Sahi, aur yeh HIV se bhi bachata hai

options.en: False: about 20 in 100 users get pregnant a year
options.hg: Galat: saal mein ~20/100 users pregnant hote hain

explain.en: WHO figures show about 20 pregnancies per 100 couples a year with typical use of withdrawal, compared with under 1 for IUDs and implants. Reliable methods are free at government health centres.
explain.hg: WHO figures ke hisaab se withdrawal ke typical use mein saal mein 100 couples mein lagbhag 20 pregnancies hoti hain, jabki IUD aur implant mein 1 se kam. Reliable methods government health centres par free milte hain.

q.en: Why are 'safe day' calculations especially unreliable for someone with irregular periods?
q.hg: Irregular periods wale kisi insaan ke liye 'safe days' ka hisaab khaas taur par unreliable kyun hai?

options.en: Ovulation is hard to predict, and sperm live for days
options.hg: Ovulation ka andaza mushkil hai, aur sperm kai din jeete hain

options.en: Safe days only work for women over 30
options.hg: Safe days sirf 30+ women ke liye kaam karte hain

options.en: Irregular periods mean ovulation never actually happens
options.hg: Irregular periods matlab ovulation asal mein hota hi nahi

options.en: Calendar apps are banned for medical use
options.hg: Calendar apps medical use ke liye banned hain

explain.en: Safe-day methods guess when ovulation will happen. With irregular cycles the guess is often wrong, and sperm can survive several days, so sex on a 'safe' day can still lead to pregnancy.
explain.hg: Safe-day methods andaza lagate hain ki ovulation kab hoga. Irregular cycle mein yeh andaza aksar galat hota hai, aur sperm kai din zinda reh sakte hain, toh 'safe' din ke sex se bhi pregnancy ho sakti hai.

q.en: An aunty says eating raw papaya after sex prevents pregnancy. Is this true?
q.hg: Ek aunty kehti hain ki sex ke baad kachcha papita khaane se pregnancy nahi hoti. Kya yeh sach hai?

options.en: Yes, but only ripe papaya works
options.hg: Haan, par sirf pakka papita kaam karta hai

options.en: Yes, if combined with hot water
options.hg: Haan, agar garam paani ke saath liya jaaye

options.en: No, no food can prevent pregnancy
options.hg: Nahi, koi bhi khana pregnancy nahi rokta

options.en: Yes, if eaten within an hour
options.hg: Haan, agar ek ghante ke andar khaya jaaye

explain.en: Foods like papaya, pineapple or 'garam' items do not prevent pregnancy. If sex was unprotected, emergency contraception within 5 days is what actually works.
explain.hg: Papita, ananas ya 'garam' cheezein pregnancy nahi rokti. Agar sex unprotected tha, toh 5 din ke andar emergency contraception hi asli kaam karti hai.

q.en: Does peeing or washing right after sex prevent pregnancy?
q.hg: Kya sex ke turant baad peshaab karne ya dhone se pregnancy rukti hai?

options.en: No, sperm move into the uterus too quickly
options.hg: Nahi, sperm bahut jaldi uterus mein chale jaate hain

options.en: Yes, peeing flushes out all the sperm
options.hg: Haan, peshaab saare sperm baha deta hai

options.en: Yes, if you wash with salt water
options.hg: Haan, agar namak ke paani se dho

options.en: Yes, if done within five minutes
options.hg: Haan, agar paanch minute ke andar karo

explain.en: Urine comes out of a different opening (the urethra) from the vagina, and sperm swim up quickly, so peeing or washing cannot stop pregnancy. Douching can also irritate the vagina.
explain.hg: Peshaab vagina se alag opening (urethra) se aata hai, aur sperm jaldi upar tair jaate hain, isliye peshaab ya dhone se pregnancy nahi rukti. Andar dhone (douching) se vagina mein irritation bhi ho sakta hai.

q.en: Why is the 'fertile window' in a cycle about six days long, even though an egg lives only about a day?
q.hg: Cycle ki 'fertile window' lagbhag chhe din ki kyun hoti hai, jabki egg sirf lagbhag ek din jeeta hai?

options.en: The ovaries release a new egg every day
options.hg: Ovaries roz ek naya egg release karti hain

options.en: Pregnancy hormones last for six days
options.hg: Pregnancy hormones chhe din tak rehte hain

options.en: Sperm can survive in the body for several days
options.hg: Sperm body mein kai din tak zinda reh sakte hain

options.en: The uterus stores eggs for a week
options.hg: Uterus ek hafte tak egg store karta hai

explain.en: Because sperm can stay alive for up to about five days, sex in the days before ovulation can still lead to pregnancy. This is also why emergency contraception aims to delay ovulation.
explain.hg: Sperm lagbhag paanch din tak zinda reh sakte hain, isliye ovulation se pehle ke dino ka sex bhi pregnancy la sakta hai. Isi wajah se emergency contraception ovulation ko delay karne par kaam karti hai.

q.en: After childbirth, can a woman get pregnant again before her periods have returned?
q.hg: Delivery ke baad, kya periods wapas aane se pehle woman phir se pregnant ho sakti hai?

options.en: No, not for at least two years after birth
options.hg: Nahi, delivery ke baad kam se kam do saal tak nahi

options.en: No, never before the first period
options.hg: Nahi, pehle period se pehle kabhi nahi

options.en: Only if the baby is not being fed
options.hg: Sirf agar baby ko feed na kiya ja raha ho

options.en: Yes, ovulation comes before the first period
options.hg: Haan, pehle period se pehle ovulation ho jaata hai

explain.en: Ovulation happens before the first period returns, so pregnancy is possible without any warning period. Planning a method soon after delivery helps space births and gives the body time to recover.
explain.hg: Pehla period aane se pehle ovulation ho jaata hai, toh bina kisi warning period ke pregnancy ho sakti hai. Delivery ke baad jaldi method plan karne se bachchon mein gap rehta hai aur body ko recover hone ka time milta hai.

q.en: Can breastfeeding alone be relied on to prevent pregnancy?
q.hg: Kya sirf breastfeeding par pregnancy rokne ke liye bharosa kiya ja sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, if the mother eats a special diet
options.hg: Haan, agar mummy special diet le

options.en: Yes, for as long as the baby is still breastfeeding at all
options.hg: Haan, jab tak baby thoda bhi doodh pee raha hai

options.en: No, breastfeeding increases fertility
options.hg: Nahi, breastfeeding se fertility badhti hai

options.en: Only briefly, with full breastfeeding and no periods
options.hg: Thode time ke liye, poori breastfeeding aur periods na hon tab

explain.en: Breastfeeding protects only in the early months after birth, if the baby is fed only breast milk day and night and periods have not returned. Once any of these changes, another method is needed.
explain.hg: Breastfeeding sirf delivery ke baad shuru ke mahino mein bachaati hai, agar baby ko din-raat sirf maa ka doodh mile aur periods wapas na aaye hon. Inme se kuch bhi badle toh doosra method chahiye.

q.en: What is a vasectomy?
q.hg: Vasectomy kya hai?

options.en: A daily pill men take to stop sperm
options.hg: Aadmiyon ki daily goli jo sperm rokti hai

options.en: A minor procedure blocking the sperm tubes
options.hg: Chhota procedure jo sperm wali tubes band karta hai

options.en: An operation on a woman's fallopian tubes
options.hg: Woman ki fallopian tubes ka operation

options.en: Surgery to remove the testicles
options.hg: Testicles nikaalne ki surgery

explain.en: A vasectomy is male sterilisation: the tubes (vas deferens) that carry sperm are blocked. The testicles stay, hormones stay, and it is meant to be permanent.
explain.hg: Vasectomy male sterilisation hai: sperm le jaane wali tubes (vas deferens) band kar di jaati hain. Testicles wahi rehte hain, hormones wahi rehte hain, aur yeh permanent maana jaata hai.

q.en: Does a vasectomy make a man weak or affect his erections?
q.hg: Kya vasectomy se aadmi kamzor ho jaata hai ya uske erection par asar padta hai?

options.en: Yes, it lowers male hormones sharply
options.hg: Haan, male hormones bahut kam ho jaate hain

options.en: No, strength, hormones and erections stay the same
options.hg: Nahi, taakat, hormones aur erection same rehte hain

options.en: Yes, erections slowly stop after a few years have passed
options.hg: Haan, kuch saal baad erection dheere dheere band ho jaate hain

options.en: Yes, men lose strength for heavy work
options.hg: Haan, bhaari kaam ki taakat chali jaati hai

explain.en: A vasectomy only blocks the sperm tubes. Testosterone, strength, desire and erections are not affected. The fear of 'weakness' is one reason so few Indian men choose it, despite it being simple.
explain.hg: Vasectomy sirf sperm wali tubes band karti hai. Testosterone, taakat, ichha aur erection par asar nahi hota. 'Kamzori' ka darr ek wajah hai ki itne kam Indian aadmi ise chunte hain, jabki yeh simple hai.

q.en: After a vasectomy, does a man still release semen?
q.hg: Vasectomy ke baad kya aadmi ka semen ab bhi nikalta hai?

options.en: Yes, semen still comes out, just without sperm
options.hg: Haan, semen nikalta hai, bas usme sperm nahi hote

options.en: Only for the first year after surgery
options.hg: Sirf surgery ke baad pehle saal tak

options.en: Only blood comes out afterwards
options.hg: Uske baad sirf khoon nikalta hai

options.en: No, nothing comes out ever again
options.hg: Nahi, uske baad kuch bhi nahi nikalta

explain.en: Sperm make up only a small part of semen; most of the fluid comes from glands further along. After a vasectomy, semen looks and feels about the same but has no sperm.
explain.hg: Semen mein sperm bahut chhota hissa hote hain; zyaadatar fluid aage ke glands se aata hai. Vasectomy ke baad semen lagbhag waisa hi dikhta hai par usme sperm nahi hote.

q.en: Ravi had a vasectomy last week. Can the couple stop using other contraception straight away?
q.hg: Ravi ki pichhle hafte vasectomy hui. Kya couple turant doosra contraception band kar sakta hai?

options.en: Only if he rests for a full week
options.hg: Sirf agar woh poora hafta aaraam kare

options.en: Yes, once the stitches have healed
options.hg: Haan, jaise hi taanke bhar jaayein

options.en: Yes, it works from the same day
options.hg: Haan, usi din se kaam karta hai

options.en: No, use a backup until a semen test is clear
options.hg: Nahi, semen test clear aane tak backup use karo

explain.en: Sperm already beyond the blocked point can remain for some time. Couples should use condoms or another method until a semen test, usually a few months later, confirms there are no sperm.
explain.hg: Band ki gayi jagah se aage pehle se maujood sperm kuch time tak reh sakte hain. Jab tak semen test (aam taur par kuch mahino baad) sperm zero confirm na kare, couple ko condom ya doosra method use karna chahiye.

q.en: A couple has decided they want no more children. How does a vasectomy compare with female sterilisation (tubectomy)?
q.hg: Ek couple ne decide kiya hai ki aur bachche nahi chahiye. Vasectomy aur female sterilisation (tubectomy) mein kya fark hai?

options.en: Vasectomy needs a long hospital stay
options.hg: Vasectomy mein lamba hospital stay chahiye

options.en: Tubectomy is the only option the law allows for couples
options.hg: Law couples ke liye sirf tubectomy allow karta hai

options.en: Vasectomy is less effective than condoms
options.hg: Vasectomy condom se kam effective hai

options.en: Vasectomy is simpler, with fewer complications
options.hg: Vasectomy simple hai, complications kam

explain.en: No-scalpel vasectomy is a short procedure under local anaesthesia, and recovery is quick. Tubectomy is abdominal surgery for the woman. Both are free at government facilities; the choice should be the couple's.
explain.hg: No-scalpel vasectomy local anaesthesia mein chhota sa procedure hai, aur recovery jaldi hoti hai. Tubectomy woman ke pet ki surgery hai. Dono government facilities par free hain; faisla couple ka hona chahiye.

q.en: In NFHS-5 (2019-21), how did female and male sterilisation compare among currently married women in India?
q.hg: NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein India ki currently married women mein female aur male sterilisation ka kya comparison tha?

options.en: Male was higher than female
options.hg: Male, female se zyada tha

options.en: Both were roughly 20% each
options.hg: Dono lagbhag 20-20%

options.en: Both were under 5% each
options.hg: Dono 5% se kam

options.en: Female 37.9%, male just 0.3%
options.hg: Female 37.9%, male sirf 0.3%

explain.en: NFHS-5 (2019-21) found 37.9% of currently married women relied on female sterilisation and only 0.3% on male sterilisation, even though vasectomy is the simpler procedure. The burden falls mostly on women.
explain.hg: NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 37.9% currently married women female sterilisation par nirbhar thi aur sirf 0.3% male sterilisation par, jabki vasectomy zyada simple procedure hai. Bojh zyaadatar women par padta hai.

q.en: Which contraceptive methods are available to men today?
q.hg: Aaj aadmiyon ke liye kaunse contraceptive methods available hain?

options.en: A daily male pill sold at chemists
options.hg: Chemist par milne wali daily male pill

options.en: A monthly injection at every PHC
options.hg: Har PHC par monthly injection

options.en: Condoms and vasectomy
options.hg: Condom aur vasectomy

options.en: Herbal powders that stop sperm
options.hg: Sperm rokne wale herbal powder

explain.en: For now, men's options are condoms (which also lower STI risk) and vasectomy. Male pills and injections are still being researched and are not approved for sale. 'Herbal' sperm-stopping products are not proven.
explain.hg: Abhi aadmiyon ke options condom (jo STI risk bhi kam karta hai) aur vasectomy hain. Male pill aur injection abhi research mein hain, bikri ke liye approved nahi. 'Herbal' sperm rokne wale products proven nahi hain.

q.en: Karan says contraception is 'the wife's job' and a man shouldn't have to worry about it. What is true?
q.hg: Karan kehta hai contraception 'wife ka kaam' hai aur aadmi ko iski fikar nahi karni chahiye. Kya sach hai?

options.en: He is right; men cannot use any method
options.hg: Woh sahi hai; aadmi koi method use nahi kar sakte

options.en: Men should only decide if the wife agrees to sterilisation
options.hg: Aadmi tabhi decide karein jab wife sterilisation maane

options.en: It is a shared responsibility; men have methods too
options.hg: Yeh dono ki zimmedari hai; aadmiyon ke paas bhi methods hain

options.en: Only the elders of the family should decide
options.hg: Sirf ghar ke bade decide karein

explain.en: Pregnancy involves both partners, and men can use condoms or have a vasectomy. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 35.1% of Indian men aged 15-49 agreed that contraception is 'women's business', a belief that leaves women carrying most of the load.
explain.hg: Pregnancy mein dono partners shaamil hain, aur aadmi condom ya vasectomy use kar sakte hain. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 15-49 saal ke 35.1% Indian aadmi maante the ki contraception 'women ka kaam' hai, aur isi soch se zyaadatar bojh women par aata hai.

q.en: Can a vasectomy be easily undone if a man changes his mind later?
q.hg: Agar aadmi baad mein mann badal le, toh kya vasectomy aasaani se undo ho sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, it wears off by itself in a few years
options.hg: Haan, kuch saal mein apne aap khatam ho jaati hai

options.en: Yes, any clinic can reverse it in minutes
options.hg: Haan, koi bhi clinic minutes mein reverse kar deta hai

options.en: Yes, with a simple tablet
options.hg: Haan, ek simple tablet se

options.en: No, it should be treated as permanent
options.hg: Nahi, ise permanent hi maanna chahiye

explain.en: Reversal surgery exists but is complex and does not always work, so vasectomy (like tubectomy) is meant for people sure they want no more children. Couples still deciding can use long-acting reversible methods.
explain.hg: Reversal surgery hoti hai par complex hai aur hamesha kaam nahi karti, isliye vasectomy (tubectomy ki tarah) unke liye hai jo pakka aur bachche nahi chahte. Jo abhi decide kar rahe hain woh long-acting reversible methods use kar sakte hain.

q.en: Does female sterilisation (tubectomy) bring on early menopause or stop periods?
q.hg: Kya female sterilisation (tubectomy) se jaldi menopause aata hai ya periods ruk jaate hain?

options.en: Yes, the ovaries are removed in the operation
options.hg: Haan, operation mein ovaries nikaal di jaati hain

options.en: Yes, periods stop straight after surgery
options.hg: Haan, surgery ke turant baad periods ruk jaate hain

options.en: Yes, menopause starts within a year
options.hg: Haan, ek saal mein menopause shuru ho jaata hai

options.en: No, periods and hormones carry on as before
options.hg: Nahi, periods aur hormones pehle jaise chalte hain

explain.en: Tubectomy blocks or cuts the fallopian tubes so eggs and sperm cannot meet. The ovaries stay and keep making hormones, so periods continue and menopause comes at its usual time.
explain.hg: Tubectomy mein fallopian tubes band ya kaat di jaati hain taaki egg aur sperm na mil sakein. Ovaries wahi rehti hain aur hormones banati rehti hain, isliye periods chalte rehte hain aur menopause apne normal time par aata hai.

q.en: A health worker pushes a woman to get sterilised to meet a 'target'. What is true?
q.hg: Ek health worker 'target' poora karne ke liye ek woman par sterilisation ka pressure daalta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is compulsory after the second child
options.hg: Doosre bachche ke baad yeh compulsory hai

options.en: Her husband can sign consent on her behalf
options.hg: Uska pati uski jagah consent sign kar sakta hai

options.en: It must be her informed, voluntary choice
options.hg: Yeh uski informed, apni marzi ki choice honi chahiye

options.en: She must agree if the health worker insists
options.hg: Health worker zid kare toh use maanna padega

explain.en: Sterilisation needs the person's own informed and voluntary consent after hearing about all options, including reversible ones. No one can be forced, and no method is compulsory after any number of children.
explain.hg: Sterilisation ke liye us insaan ki apni informed aur voluntary consent chahiye, saare options (reversible bhi) jaanne ke baad. Kisi ko force nahi kiya ja sakta, aur kitne bhi bachchon ke baad koi method compulsory nahi hai.

q.en: What does a home pregnancy test detect?
q.hg: Home pregnancy test kya detect karta hai?

options.en: Sugar levels in the urine
options.hg: Urine mein sugar level

options.en: The hormone hCG in urine
options.hg: Urine mein hCG hormone

options.en: Iron levels in blood
options.hg: Blood mein iron level

options.en: Sperm cells in the urine
options.hg: Urine mein sperm cells

explain.en: After a pregnancy implants, the body makes a hormone called hCG, which shows up in urine. Home tests are cheap, private and accurate when used at the right time.
explain.hg: Pregnancy implant hone ke baad body hCG naam ka hormone banati hai, jo urine mein aata hai. Home test sasta, private aur sahi time par use karne par accurate hota hai.

q.en: When is a home pregnancy test most reliable?
q.hg: Home pregnancy test kab sabse reliable hota hai?

options.en: Only in the evening, after meals
options.hg: Sirf shaam ko, khaane ke baad

options.en: From the first day of a missed period
options.hg: Period miss hone ke pehle din se

options.en: Any day, the timing makes no difference
options.hg: Kisi bhi din, time se fark nahi padta

options.en: The morning right after sex
options.hg: Sex ke agli subah

explain.en: hCG takes time to build up after implantation. Testing from the first day of a missed period gives the most reliable result; testing too early can give a false negative.
explain.hg: Implantation ke baad hCG banne mein time lagta hai. Period miss hone ke pehle din se test karna sabse reliable hai; bahut jaldi test karne se galat negative aa sakta hai.

q.en: Pooja took a pregnancy test three days after unprotected sex. It was negative and she relaxed. What is true?
q.hg: Pooja ne unprotected sex ke teen din baad pregnancy test kiya. Negative aaya aur woh relax ho gayi. Kya sach hai?

options.en: A negative result is final at any time
options.hg: Negative result kabhi bhi final hota hai

options.en: She should take five tests the same day
options.hg: Use ek hi din paanch test karne chahiye

options.en: Tests only work three days after sex
options.hg: Test sirf sex ke teen din baad kaam karta hai

options.en: Too early to trust; retest after a missed period
options.hg: Itni jaldi bharosa nahi; period miss hone par dobara test

explain.en: Three days after sex, a pregnancy would not yet make enough hCG to show. She should test again once her period is late. If she is still within 5 days, emergency contraception can also help.
explain.hg: Sex ke teen din baad pregnancy itna hCG nahi banati ki test mein dikhe. Period late hone par dobara test karna chahiye. Agar abhi 5 din ke andar hai toh emergency contraception bhi madad kar sakti hai.

q.en: In many villages, who can give a woman a free pregnancy test kit and family-planning advice?
q.hg: Kai gaon mein woman ko free pregnancy test kit aur family planning advice kaun de sakta hai?

options.en: The gram panchayat clerk
options.hg: Gram panchayat clerk

options.en: The ASHA worker
options.hg: ASHA worker

options.en: The local police constable
options.hg: Local police constable

options.en: The school principal
options.hg: School principal

explain.en: ASHA workers are community health workers who can provide free pregnancy test kits (Nischay), condoms, pills and advice, and link women to the nearest health centre.
explain.hg: ASHA workers community health workers hain jo free pregnancy test kit (Nischay), condom, pills aur advice de sakti hain, aur paas ke health centre tak pahuncha sakti hain.

q.en: What can an ASHA worker help a family with?
q.hg: ASHA worker family ki kis cheez mein help kar sakti hai?

options.en: Selling abortion pills without a doctor
options.hg: Bina doctor ke abortion pills bechna

options.en: Contraceptives, pregnancy kits and advice
options.hg: Contraceptives, pregnancy kit aur advice

options.en: Registering marriages and births only
options.hg: Sirf shaadi aur janm ka registration

options.en: Only vaccines for small children
options.hg: Sirf chhote bachchon ke vaccines

explain.en: ASHAs support maternal and child health, including vaccines, but also deliver contraceptives at home, counsel couples and help people reach health centres. Abortion pills need a qualified doctor.
explain.hg: ASHAs maa aur bachche ki health mein madad karti hain, vaccines bhi, par ghar par contraceptives bhi deti hain, couples ko counsel karti hain aur health centre tak pahunchne mein madad karti hain. Abortion pills ke liye qualified doctor chahiye.

q.en: A woman with a positive pregnancy test gets sharp pain on one side of her lower belly and feels faint. What should she do?
q.hg: Positive pregnancy test wali ek woman ko pet ke neeche ek taraf tez dard hai aur chakkar aa rahe hain. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Wait for her next scheduled scan
options.hg: Agle scheduled scan ka wait kare

options.en: Take a painkiller and rest at home
options.hg: Painkiller lekar ghar par aaraam kare

options.en: Try a home remedy for gas first
options.hg: Pehle gas ka gharelu ilaaj try kare

options.en: Go to a hospital immediately
options.hg: Turant hospital jaaye

explain.en: One-sided lower belly pain, bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or fainting in early pregnancy can mean an ectopic pregnancy, which can be life-threatening. It needs urgent hospital care; call 108 or 112 if needed.
explain.hg: Shuruaati pregnancy mein ek taraf pet ka dard, bleeding, kandhe ke sire par dard ya behoshi ectopic pregnancy ka sign ho sakta hai, jo jaan ke liye khatarnak hai. Turant hospital jao; zaroorat ho toh 108 ya 112 call karo.

q.en: Which of these is a common early sign of pregnancy?
q.hg: Inme se kaunsa pregnancy ka common shuruaati sign hai?

options.en: Fever with a skin rash
options.hg: Bukhaar ke saath skin rash

options.en: Tender breasts and tiredness
options.hg: Breasts mein dard aur thakaan

options.en: Itchy, watery eyes
options.hg: Aankhon mein khujli aur paani

options.en: Sudden hair loss on the scalp
options.hg: Sar ke baal achanak girna

explain.en: Early pregnancy can bring tender breasts, tiredness, nausea, needing to pee more often and a missed period. These can have other causes too, so a test confirms it.
explain.hg: Shuruaati pregnancy mein breasts mein dard, thakaan, nausea, baar baar peshaab aur period miss hona ho sakta hai. Inki aur wajahein bhi ho sakti hain, isliye test se confirm karo.

q.en: Why are women advised to take folic acid before and in early pregnancy?
q.hg: Women ko pregnancy se pehle aur shuru mein folic acid lene ki salah kyun di jaati hai?

options.en: It prevents morning sickness completely
options.hg: Yeh morning sickness poori tarah rok deta hai

options.en: It lowers the risk of brain and spine defects
options.hg: Dimaag aur reedh ke defects ka risk kam karta hai

options.en: It decides whether the baby will be a boy or a girl
options.hg: Yeh tay karta hai ki baby ladka hoga ya ladki

options.en: It works as a contraceptive later
options.hg: Yeh baad mein contraceptive ka kaam karta hai

explain.en: Folic acid helps the baby's brain and spinal cord form properly and lowers the risk of neural tube defects. It is given free at government health centres; a doctor or ASHA can advise.
explain.hg: Folic acid baby ke dimaag aur spinal cord ko sahi se banne mein madad karta hai aur neural tube defects ka risk kam karta hai. Yeh government health centres par free milta hai; doctor ya ASHA advise kar sakti hain.

q.en: Is abortion legal in India?
q.hg: Kya India mein abortion legal hai?

options.en: Yes, under the MTP Act, with conditions
options.hg: Haan, MTP Act ke tahat, kuch conditions ke saath

options.en: No, it is banned in all cases
options.hg: Nahi, har case mein banned hai

options.en: Only if the husband signs for it
options.hg: Sirf agar pati sign kare

options.en: Only for women who already have children
options.hg: Sirf un women ke liye jinke bachche hain

explain.en: The Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971 (amended 2021) allows abortion by registered doctors at approved places under set conditions and time limits. It is general information, not legal advice.
explain.hg: Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971 (2021 mein amend) ke tahat registered doctor approved jagah par, tay conditions aur time limits mein abortion kar sakte hain. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

q.en: Under the MTP Act, does an adult woman need her husband's consent for an abortion?
q.hg: MTP Act ke tahat, kya adult woman ko abortion ke liye pati ki consent chahiye?

options.en: Yes, and her in-laws must agree too
options.hg: Haan, aur saas-sasur ki bhi manzoori chahiye

options.en: Only if they have been married a year
options.hg: Sirf agar shaadi ko ek saal hua ho

options.en: Yes, always in writing
options.hg: Haan, hamesha likhit mein

options.en: No, her own consent is enough
options.hg: Nahi, uski apni consent kaafi hai

explain.en: For an adult woman, only her own consent is required. The law does not ask for a husband's or family's consent. A guardian's written consent is needed only if she is under 18 or mentally ill.
explain.hg: Adult woman ke liye sirf uski apni consent chahiye. Law pati ya family ki consent nahi maangta. Guardian ki likhit consent sirf tab chahiye jab woh 18 se kam ho ya mentally ill ho.

q.en: Can an unmarried adult woman get a legal abortion in India?
q.hg: Kya ek unmarried adult woman India mein legal abortion karwa sakti hai?

options.en: No, only married women are covered
options.hg: Nahi, sirf shaadishuda women covered hain

options.en: Only after she files a police complaint
options.hg: Sirf police complaint ke baad

options.en: Only if her parents apply for her
options.hg: Sirf agar parents uski taraf se apply karein

options.en: Yes, the law applies to all women
options.hg: Haan, law sab women par lagu hota hai

explain.en: The 2021 amendment changed 'married woman or her husband' to 'any woman or her partner', and in 2022 the Supreme Court held that unmarried women have the same access as married women, including up to 24 weeks.
explain.hg: 2021 amendment ne 'married woman or her husband' ko 'any woman or her partner' kar diya, aur 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki unmarried women ko bhi married women jaisa hi access hai, 24 hafte tak bhi.

q.en: Under the amended MTP Act, up to how many weeks can a pregnancy be ended on one registered doctor's opinion?
q.hg: Amended MTP Act ke tahat, ek registered doctor ki opinion par kitne hafte tak pregnancy end ki ja sakti hai?

options.en: Up to 8 weeks
options.hg: 8 hafte tak

options.en: Up to 12 weeks only
options.hg: Sirf 12 hafte tak

options.en: Up to 20 weeks
options.hg: 20 hafte tak

options.en: Up to 30 weeks
options.hg: 30 hafte tak

explain.en: Since the 2021 amendment, one registered doctor's opinion is enough up to 20 weeks. Between 20 and 24 weeks, two doctors are needed and only specified categories of women qualify.
explain.hg: 2021 amendment ke baad, 20 hafte tak ek registered doctor ki opinion kaafi hai. 20 se 24 hafte ke beech do doctors chahiye aur sirf specified categories ki women eligible hain.

q.en: Who can seek an abortion between 20 and 24 weeks under the MTP Act?
q.hg: MTP Act ke tahat 20 se 24 hafte ke beech abortion kaun karwa sakta hai?

options.en: Only women whose husbands apply for it
options.hg: Sirf woh women jinke pati iske liye apply karein

options.en: Any woman, on just one doctor's opinion
options.hg: Koi bhi woman, sirf ek doctor ki opinion par

options.en: Specified groups, such as minors, with two doctors
options.hg: Specified groups, jaise minors, do doctors ke saath

options.en: Nobody; the limit is strictly 20 weeks
options.hg: Koi nahi; limit sirf 20 hafte hai

explain.en: The 2021 rules list categories for 20–24 weeks, including survivors of sexual assault or incest, minors, women whose marital status changes, women with disabilities, and humanitarian settings. Two doctors must agree.
explain.hg: 2021 ke rules mein 20–24 hafte ke liye categories hain, jaise sexual assault ya incest survivors, minors, jinki marital status badal gayi, disability wali women, aur humanitarian situations. Do doctors ki sahmati chahiye.

q.en: What does the MTP Act allow beyond 24 weeks of pregnancy?
q.hg: 24 hafte ke baad pregnancy ke liye MTP Act kya allow karta hai?

options.en: Only for substantial foetal abnormalities, via a Board
options.hg: Sirf gambhir foetal abnormality par, Board ke through

options.en: Abortion for any reason with two doctors
options.hg: Kisi bhi wajah se, do doctors ke saath

options.en: Abortion at home with pills bought from any chemist shop
options.hg: Kisi bhi chemist se li pills se ghar par abortion

options.en: No abortion at all, in any situation
options.hg: Kisi bhi situation mein koi abortion nahi

explain.en: Under the Act, abortion beyond 24 weeks is allowed only when a state Medical Board finds substantial foetal abnormalities. Separately, courts have sometimes allowed later abortions in exceptional cases, such as for minor rape survivors.
explain.hg: Act ke hisaab se 24 hafte ke baad abortion sirf tab allowed hai jab state ka Medical Board gambhir foetal abnormality paaye. Alag se, courts ne kuch khaas cases mein, jaise rape survivor minors ke liye, baad mein bhi abortion ki ijazat di hai.

q.en: Can a doctor who performed an abortion tell the woman's employer or neighbours about it?
q.hg: Kya abortion karne wala doctor woman ke employer ya padosiyon ko iske baare mein bata sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, employers have a right to know
options.hg: Haan, employer ko jaanne ka haq hai

options.en: No, the law bars revealing her identity
options.hg: Nahi, law uski pehchaan batane se rokta hai

options.en: Yes, if they ask her doctor politely
options.hg: Haan, agar woh doctor se politely poochein

options.en: Only if the woman is unmarried
options.hg: Sirf agar woman unmarried ho

explain.en: Section 5A of the MTP Act, added in 2021, forbids doctors from revealing a woman's name or details except to someone authorised by law. Breaking this can mean jail, a fine or both.
explain.hg: 2021 mein jode gaye MTP Act ke Section 5A ke tahat doctor woman ka naam ya details kisi ko nahi bata sakte, sirf law se authorised insaan ko. Iska ullanghan karne par jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain.

q.en: A friend wants to order an 'abortion kit' online and take it alone at home. What is the safest advice?
q.hg: Ek dost online 'abortion kit' mangwakar ghar par akele lena chahti hai. Sabse safe advice kya hai?

options.en: It's fine as long as she doubles the dose
options.hg: Theek hai, bas woh double dose le

options.en: Pills work at any stage, so timing doesn't matter
options.hg: Pills kisi bhi stage par kaam karti hain, time se fark nahi

options.en: Ask the delivery person how to take them
options.hg: Delivery wale se poochho kaise lena hai

options.en: See a registered doctor before taking anything
options.hg: Kuch bhi lene se pehle registered doctor se milo

explain.en: Medical abortion pills are approved up to nine weeks and should be prescribed by a qualified doctor, who checks the stage of pregnancy and rules out an ectopic pregnancy. Without care, bleeding or an incomplete abortion can be dangerous.
explain.hg: Medical abortion pills nau hafte tak approved hain aur qualified doctor ko prescribe karni chahiye, jo pregnancy ki stage check karte hain aur ectopic pregnancy rule out karte hain. Bina care ke bleeding ya incomplete abortion khatarnak ho sakta hai.

q.en: Where should a safe, legal abortion take place?
q.hg: Safe, legal abortion kahan hona chahiye?

options.en: At home with herbs a relative suggests
options.hg: Ghar par rishtedaar ke bataye herbs se

options.en: With a local dai or quack, to keep it secret
options.hg: Secret rakhne ke liye local dai ya jhola-chhaap ke paas

options.en: With a registered doctor at an approved facility
options.hg: Approved facility mein registered doctor ke paas

options.en: At any medical shop that sells pills
options.hg: Kisi bhi medical shop par jo pills bechti ho

explain.en: An abortion performed by someone who is not a registered medical practitioner, or at an unapproved place, is a crime for the person performing it, with two to seven years' rigorous imprisonment. Government hospitals provide safe, confidential care.
explain.hg: Agar registered medical practitioner ke alawa koi aur, ya unapproved jagah par, abortion kare toh yeh karne wale ka crime hai, jisme do se saat saal ki kathor saza hai. Government hospital safe aur confidential care dete hain.

q.en: Does a safe abortion by a qualified provider usually affect a woman's ability to have children later?
q.hg: Kya qualified provider dwara safe abortion se aage chalkar bachche hone ki ability par aam taur par asar padta hai?

options.en: Yes, every abortion causes infertility
options.hg: Haan, har abortion se infertility hoti hai

options.en: Yes, but only for unmarried women
options.hg: Haan, par sirf unmarried women ke liye

options.en: No, it usually does not affect fertility
options.hg: Nahi, aam taur par fertility par asar nahi

options.en: Yes, it blocks pregnancy for ten years
options.hg: Haan, das saal tak pregnancy nahi hoti

explain.en: Safe abortion by a trained provider rarely causes lasting harm, and WHO says deaths from safe abortion are under 1 per 100,000 abortions. Unsafe abortion by untrained people is what causes serious complications.
explain.hg: Trained provider se safe abortion mein lambe nuksaan ka chance bahut kam hai, aur WHO ke mutabik safe abortion mein maut 1 lakh abortions mein 1 se bhi kam hai. Gambhir complications untrained logon ke unsafe abortion se hote hain.

q.en: A married woman is pregnant after forced sex by her husband. What did the Supreme Court say in 2022 about her options under the MTP Act?
q.hg: Ek married woman pati dwara zabardasti sex se pregnant hai. 2022 mein Supreme Court ne MTP Act ke tahat uske options par kya kaha?

options.en: She must first prove the rape in a court
options.hg: Use pehle court mein rape prove karna hoga

options.en: She can seek abortion up to 24 weeks as a rape survivor
options.hg: Woh rape survivor ki tarah 24 hafte tak abortion le sakti hai

options.en: Married women have no such option under the MTP Act at all
options.hg: MTP Act mein married women ke paas aisa koi option nahi

options.en: She needs her husband's written consent
options.hg: Use pati ki likhit consent chahiye

explain.en: In September 2022 the Supreme Court held that 'rape' in the MTP Act and Rules includes marital rape, so she can seek abortion up to 24 weeks without filing an FIR or proving it in court.
explain.hg: September 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki MTP Act aur Rules mein 'rape' mein marital rape bhi shaamil hai, toh woh bina FIR ya court mein prove kiye 24 hafte tak abortion le sakti hai.

q.en: During an ultrasound, can a doctor in India tell a couple whether the foetus is a boy or a girl?
q.hg: Ultrasound ke dauraan, kya India mein doctor couple ko bata sakta hai ki foetus ladka hai ya ladki?

options.en: Yes, private clinics are allowed to
options.hg: Haan, private clinics ko allowed hai

options.en: Yes, if the couple asks in writing
options.hg: Haan, agar couple likhit mein maange

options.en: Yes, after 20 weeks it is allowed
options.hg: Haan, 20 hafte ke baad allowed hai

options.en: No, the PCPNDT Act bans revealing the sex
options.hg: Nahi, PCPNDT Act sex batane par rok lagata hai

explain.en: The PCPNDT Act bans sex selection and forbids anyone from telling the sex of a foetus 'by words, signs or in any other manner'. It exists to stop sex-selective abortion.
explain.hg: PCPNDT Act sex selection ko ban karta hai aur kisi ko bhi foetus ka sex 'words, signs ya kisi aur tareeke se' batane se rokta hai. Yeh sex-selective abortion rokne ke liye hai.

q.en: According to UNFPA India (2022), which age group faces the highest risk of dying from abortion complications?
q.hg: UNFPA India (2022) ke mutabik, abortion complications se maut ka sabse zyada risk kis age group ko hai?

options.en: Women aged 30-34
options.hg: 30-34 saal ki women

options.en: Young women aged 15-19
options.hg: 15-19 saal ki young women

options.en: Women aged 40-44
options.hg: 40-44 saal ki women

options.en: Women aged 25-29
options.hg: 25-29 saal ki women

explain.en: UNFPA India (2022) says unsafe abortion is the third leading cause of maternal deaths in India and that women aged 15-19 face the highest risk, often because fear and stigma push them to unsafe providers.
explain.hg: UNFPA India (2022) ke mutabik unsafe abortion India mein maternal deaths ki teesri sabse badi wajah hai aur 15-19 saal ki women ko sabse zyada risk hai, aksar kyunki darr aur stigma unhe unsafe providers tak le jaate hain.

q.en: A newly married couple wants to wait a few years before a first child. Family members say using contraception before the first baby causes infertility. What is true?
q.hg: Ek naya shaadishuda couple pehle bachche se pehle kuch saal rukna chahta hai. Ghar wale kehte hain pehle bachche se pehle contraception lene se infertility hoti hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Using a method for a year causes infertility
options.hg: Ek saal method use karne se infertility hoti hai

options.en: Only condoms are safe before a first child
options.hg: Pehle bachche se pehle sirf condom safe hai

options.en: The first pregnancy must come before any method
options.hg: Kisi bhi method se pehle pehli pregnancy honi chahiye

options.en: Reversible methods don't harm future fertility
options.hg: Reversible methods se aage ki fertility kharab nahi hoti

explain.en: Condoms, pills, IUDs and injectables are all reversible. Fertility returns after stopping (sometimes a few months later after the injection), so planning when to have a first child is safe and common.
explain.hg: Condom, pills, IUD aur injectable sab reversible hain. Band karne ke baad fertility wapas aati hai (injection ke baad kabhi kabhi kuch mahine baad), toh pehla bachcha kab ho yeh plan karna safe aur common hai.

q.en: Why do health workers encourage couples to space their children?
q.hg: Health workers couples ko bachchon mein gap rakhne ke liye kyun kehte hain?

options.en: Spacing is needed to get a ration card
options.hg: Ration card ke liye gap zaroori hai

options.en: Spacing gives the mother's body time to recover
options.hg: Gap se maa ki body ko recover hone ka time milta hai

options.en: Close births are illegal in India
options.hg: Jaldi jaldi bachche India mein illegal hain

options.en: Spacing guarantees that the next child will be a boy
options.hg: Gap rakhne se agla bachcha pakka ladka hota hai

explain.en: Pregnancies too close together carry higher risks for mother and baby. Spacing lets the mother recover, supports breastfeeding and helps the family plan. Methods are free at government health centres.
explain.hg: Bahut paas paas pregnancy mein maa aur baby dono ke liye risk zyada hota hai. Gap se maa recover karti hai, breastfeeding mein madad milti hai aur family plan kar paati hai. Methods government health centres par free hain.

q.en: Seema finds her husband has been secretly throwing away her contraceptive pills so she will get pregnant. What is this?
q.hg: Seema ko pata chalta hai ki uska pati chupke se uski contraceptive pills phenk raha hai taaki woh pregnant ho jaaye. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A sign that he loves her deeply
options.hg: Nishaani ki woh use bahut pyaar karta hai

options.en: A normal family planning decision
options.hg: Ek normal family planning decision

options.en: Her own fault for not hiding the pills
options.hg: Pills na chhupaane ki uski apni galti

options.en: Reproductive coercion, a form of abuse
options.hg: Reproductive coercion, ek tarah ka abuse

explain.en: Interfering with someone's contraception to control pregnancy is reproductive coercion, a form of abuse. Methods a partner cannot tamper with, like an IUD or injection, can help, and the Women Helpline 181 offers support.
explain.hg: Pregnancy control karne ke liye kisi ke contraception mein dakhal dena reproductive coercion hai, ek tarah ka abuse. IUD ya injection jaise methods jinse partner chhed-chhaad nahi kar sakta, madad kar sakte hain, aur Women Helpline 181 support deti hai.

q.en: Who should decide which contraceptive method a woman uses?
q.hg: Woman kaunsa contraceptive method use kare, yeh kaun decide kare?

options.en: The husband alone, as head of family
options.hg: Sirf pati, ghar ka mukhiya hone ke naate

options.en: The nearest chemist who sells it
options.hg: Paas ka chemist jo ise bechta hai

options.en: She does, ideally with her partner's input
options.hg: Woh khud, achha ho toh partner se baat karke

options.en: Her mother-in-law, as the elder
options.hg: Uski saas, ghar ki badi hone ke naate

explain.en: It is her body, so the final choice is hers. Talking openly with a partner helps, and a health worker can explain options so she can make an informed choice that fits her health and plans.
explain.hg: Body uski hai, toh aakhri faisla uska hai. Partner se khulkar baat karna madad karta hai, aur health worker options samjha sakte hain taaki woh apni health aur plans ke hisaab se informed choice kar sake.

q.en: After a sexual assault, which care should a survivor get at a hospital without waiting?
q.hg: Sexual assault ke baad, survivor ko hospital mein bina ruke kaunsi care milni chahiye?

options.en: Treatment only if a family member is present with her
options.hg: Sirf tab treatment jab family member saath ho

options.en: Treatment only after an FIR is filed
options.hg: FIR file hone ke baad hi treatment

options.en: Free care, including emergency pills and HIV PEP
options.hg: Free care, emergency pill aur HIV PEP samet

options.en: Only a virginity test for the police
options.hg: Police ke liye sirf virginity test

explain.en: Hospitals must give survivors free first aid and treatment immediately. Emergency contraception works best early and HIV PEP must start within 72 hours, so care should never wait for paperwork. 'Virginity tests' are banned.
explain.hg: Hospitals ko survivors ko turant free first aid aur treatment dena hota hai. Emergency contraception jaldi lene par behtar kaam karti hai aur HIV PEP 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye, isliye care kabhi paperwork ka wait nahi karti. 'Virginity test' banned hai.

q.en: Which statement about contraception and marriage is true?
q.hg: Contraception aur shaadi ke baare mein kaunsi baat sach hai?

options.en: Unmarried adults need police permission
options.hg: Unmarried adults ko police permission chahiye

options.en: Contraception is legally only for married couples
options.hg: Contraception legally sirf shaadishuda couples ke liye hai

options.en: Only women with two children can get it
options.hg: Sirf do bachchon wali women le sakti hain

options.en: Any adult can get contraception, married or not
options.hg: Koi bhi adult contraception le sakta hai, shaadishuda ho ya nahi

explain.en: No law limits contraception to married people. Adults can buy condoms and emergency pills at chemists and get counselling and methods at health centres, confidentially and without judgement.
explain.hg: Koi law contraception ko sirf shaadishuda logon tak seemit nahi karta. Adults chemist se condom aur emergency pill le sakte hain aur health centres par confidential, bina judgement ke counselling aur methods le sakte hain.

q.en: If no contraception is used at all, about how many in 100 sexually active women get pregnant within a year?
q.hg: Agar koi contraception use na ho, toh 100 sexually active women mein se lagbhag kitni saal bhar mein pregnant hoti hain?

options.en: About 20
options.hg: Lagbhag 20

options.en: About 85
options.hg: Lagbhag 85

options.en: About 5
options.hg: Lagbhag 5

options.en: About 45
options.hg: Lagbhag 45

explain.en: WHO family-planning figures put pregnancies at about 85 per 100 women a year with no method. That is why 'it won't happen to us' is a risky belief, and why reliable methods matter.
explain.hg: WHO family-planning figures ke hisaab se bina method ke saal mein 100 women mein lagbhag 85 pregnant hoti hain. Isliye 'humare saath nahi hoga' sochna risky hai, aur reliable methods zaroori hain.

q.en: A friend's period is two weeks late and she is scared to tell anyone. What is the best first step?
q.hg: Ek dost ka period do hafte late hai aur woh kisi ko batane se darti hai. Sabse achha pehla step kya hai?

options.en: Wait quietly for a few more months
options.hg: Chupchaap kuch mahine aur wait kare

options.en: Buy abortion pills online just in case
options.hg: Just in case online abortion pills mangaye

options.en: Take a pregnancy test and talk to someone trusted
options.hg: Pregnancy test kare aur kisi trusted se baat kare

options.en: Take an emergency pill now to fix it
options.hg: Ab emergency pill lekar theek kare

explain.en: A test gives a clear answer early, which keeps every option open. Emergency pills will not help now, and pills bought online without a doctor are risky. A doctor, counsellor or trusted adult can help with next steps.
explain.hg: Test jaldi clear answer deta hai, jisse saare options khule rehte hain. Ab emergency pill madad nahi karegi, aur bina doctor ke online pills risky hain. Doctor, counsellor ya trusted adult aage ke steps mein madad kar sakte hain.

q.en: Why is a pregnancy in the early teenage years riskier for health?
q.hg: Kam umar ke teenage saalon mein pregnancy health ke liye zyada risky kyun hai?

options.en: Teen pregnancies always end in twins
options.hg: Teen pregnancy mein hamesha twins hote hain

options.en: Hospitals are not allowed to treat teenagers
options.hg: Hospitals teenagers ka ilaaj nahi kar sakte

options.en: The body is still developing, raising risks
options.hg: Body abhi develop ho rahi hai, risk badhta hai

options.en: Teenagers cannot produce breast milk
options.hg: Teenagers breast milk nahi bana sakti

explain.en: A young mother's body is still growing, which raises the risk of complications for her and the baby. Teen pregnancy can also interrupt education. Health centres and AFHCs give young people confidential advice.
explain.hg: Kam umar ki maa ki body abhi badh rahi hoti hai, jisse maa aur baby dono ke liye complications ka risk badhta hai. Teen pregnancy padhai bhi rok sakti hai. Health centres aur AFHC young logon ko confidential advice dete hain.

q.en: Which statement about contraception after an abortion is correct?
q.hg: Abortion ke baad contraception ke baare mein kaunsi baat sahi hai?

options.en: Pregnancy is impossible for a year afterwards
options.hg: Uske baad ek saal tak pregnancy impossible hai

options.en: No method may be used for six months
options.hg: Chhe mahine tak koi method use nahi kar sakte

options.en: Only sterilisation is allowed for a woman after an abortion
options.hg: Abortion ke baad woman ke liye sirf sterilisation allowed hai

options.en: Fertility returns fast, so a method can start now
options.hg: Fertility jaldi lautti hai, toh method abhi shuru ho sakta hai

explain.en: Ovulation can return within weeks of an abortion, so pregnancy can happen again soon. Most methods, including pills, injections and an IUD, can be started at the time of the abortion care visit.
explain.hg: Abortion ke kuch hafton mein ovulation wapas aa sakta hai, toh jaldi phir pregnancy ho sakti hai. Pills, injection aur IUD samet zyaadatar methods abortion care ke time hi shuru kiye ja sakte hain.

q.en: Which of these is a permanent method of contraception?
q.hg: Inme se kaunsa contraception ka permanent method hai?

options.en: The Copper-T
options.hg: Copper-T

options.en: The Antara injection
options.hg: Antara injection

options.en: The combined pill
options.hg: Combined pill

options.en: Sterilisation
options.hg: Sterilisation

explain.en: Vasectomy and tubectomy are meant to be permanent. Copper-T, injections and pills are reversible: fertility comes back after they are removed or stopped.
explain.hg: Vasectomy aur tubectomy permanent maane jaate hain. Copper-T, injection aur pills reversible hain: nikalne ya band karne ke baad fertility wapas aati hai.

q.en: During the first months after starting the Copper-T, some women notice heavier periods. What is true?
q.hg: Copper-T lagwane ke baad pehle kuch mahino mein kuch women ke periods heavy ho jaate hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It means she has become infertile
options.hg: Matlab woh infertile ho gayi

options.en: It means the Copper-T has moved to the heart
options.hg: Matlab Copper-T dil tak chala gaya

options.en: A common early side effect that often eases
options.hg: Common shuruaati side effect jo aksar kam hota hai

options.en: It means she must remove it immediately
options.hg: Matlab use turant nikalwana padega

explain.en: Heavier or crampy periods are a common early side effect of the copper IUD and often ease over a few months. Very heavy bleeding, fever or severe pain should be checked by a doctor.
explain.hg: Heavy ya dard wale periods copper IUD ka common shuruaati side effect hai aur aksar kuch mahino mein kam ho jaata hai. Bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar ya tez dard ho toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: Your cousin says emergency pills are only for 'that kind of girl'. How do you respond?
q.hg: Tumhara cousin kehta hai emergency pills sirf 'aisi waisi ladkiyon' ke liye hain. Tum kya jawaab doge?

options.en: They're a health tool anyone may need, married or not
options.hg: Health tool hai, shaadi ho ya nahi, kisi ko bhi chahiye ho sakta hai

options.en: Only married women should be allowed to know about them
options.hg: Sirf shaadishuda women ko inke baare mein jaanne dena chahiye

options.en: It's better not to talk about such topics
options.hg: Aise topics par baat na karna behtar hai

options.en: He is right, decent girls never need them
options.hg: Woh sahi hai, sharif ladkiyon ko kabhi zaroorat nahi

explain.en: Condoms break, pills get missed and some people are forced into sex. Emergency contraception is a safe health option for anyone who needs it, and shaming people stops them from getting help in time.
explain.hg: Condom phat jaate hain, pills miss ho jaati hain aur kuch logon ke saath zabardasti hoti hai. Emergency contraception zaroorat padne par kisi ke liye bhi safe health option hai, aur sharminda karne se log time par madad nahi lete.

q.en: Rohan and Anjali want a baby next year and are using condoms now. What is a good step before trying?
q.hg: Rohan aur Anjali agle saal baby chahte hain aur abhi condom use kar rahe hain. Try karne se pehle kya achha step hai?

options.en: Take emergency pills to 'clean' the body
options.hg: Body 'saaf' karne ke liye emergency pills lena

options.en: Get an early ultrasound to choose the baby's sex
options.hg: Baby ka sex chunne ke liye jaldi ultrasound karwana

options.en: Stop all methods a year in advance
options.hg: Ek saal pehle se saare methods band karna

options.en: A pre-pregnancy check-up with folic acid advice
options.hg: Pregnancy se pehle check-up, folic acid advice ke saath

explain.en: A check-up before pregnancy can catch conditions like anaemia, update vaccinations and start folic acid early. Condoms can simply be stopped when they are ready. Choosing a baby's sex is illegal.
explain.hg: Pregnancy se pehle check-up se anaemia jaisi conditions pakdi ja sakti hain, vaccination update ho sakte hain aur folic acid jaldi shuru ho sakta hai. Ready hone par condom bas band kar sakte hain. Baby ka sex chunna illegal hai.

q.en: Your best friend asks for your Instagram password 'just to check something'. What is the safest answer?
q.hg: Best friend 'bas kuch check karna hai' bol kar tumhara Instagram password maangta hai. Sabse safe jawab kya hai?

options.en: Share it, because best friends don't misuse it
options.hg: De do, best friends misuse nahi karte

options.en: Keep it private, even from close friends
options.hg: Password private rakho, close friends se bhi

options.en: Share it but change it next month
options.hg: De do aur agle mahine badal lena

options.en: Share it only on a voice call, not in chat
options.hg: Sirf voice call par batao, chat mein nahi

explain.en: Passwords are like toothbrushes: not for sharing. Friendships change, and anyone with your password can post, read chats or lock you out. Only a parent of a younger child should help manage it.
explain.hg: Password toothbrush jaisa hai: share karne ki cheez nahi. Dostiyan badalti hain, aur password wala post kar sakta hai, chats padh sakta hai ya tumhe lock out kar sakta hai. Chhote bachchon ke case mein sirf parents madad karein.

q.en: You post a photo in your school uniform from outside your building, with live location on. What does this reveal?
q.hg: Tum apni building ke bahar school uniform mein photo daalte ho, live location on hai. Isse kya pata chalta hai?

options.en: Nothing that a stranger could use
options.hg: Kuch aisa nahi jo stranger use kar sake

options.en: Only your favourite colour
options.hg: Bas tumhara favourite colour

options.en: Nothing, if your account is new
options.hg: Kuch nahi, agar account naya hai

options.en: Your school and where you live
options.hg: Tumhara school aur tum kahan rehte ho

explain.en: Uniform badges, building names and location tags let strangers work out where to find you. Turn off location tags, and post such photos later, privately, or not at all.
explain.hg: Uniform ka badge, building ka naam aur location tag se anjaan log pata laga sakte hain ki tum kahan milte ho. Location tag off rakho, aur aisi photos baad mein, private mein ya bilkul mat daalo.

q.en: A player in an online game says, 'Let's chat on WhatsApp instead, it's easier.' What should you do?
q.hg: Online game ka ek player kehta hai, 'WhatsApp par baat karte hain, aasaan rahega.' Kya karoge?

options.en: Share your parent's number instead
options.hg: Apni jagah parents ka number de do

options.en: Say no and tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Mana karo aur trusted bade ko batao

options.en: Share your number if they seem nice
options.hg: Achha lage toh number de do

options.en: Agree, but only for a few days
options.hg: Haan bolo, par sirf kuch din ke liye

explain.en: Moving a chat from a game to a private app is a common grooming step, because it is harder for anyone to see. Keep chats inside the game, and tell an adult if someone keeps pushing.
explain.hg: Game se chat ko private app par le jaana grooming ka common step hai, kyunki wahan koi dekh nahi paata. Chats game ke andar hi rakho, aur koi baar-baar force kare toh bade ko batao.

q.en: An online friend says they are 12, just like you. How can you be sure?
q.hg: Ek online dost kehta hai ki woh bhi tumhari tarah 12 saal ka hai. Tum pakka kaise jaanoge?

options.en: If they type with spelling mistakes
options.hg: Agar woh spelling mistakes ke saath type karein

options.en: If they know about your favourite game
options.hg: Agar unhe tumhara favourite game pata ho

options.en: If their profile photo looks young
options.hg: Agar profile photo chhote bachche ki lage

options.en: You can't be sure; anyone can pretend online
options.hg: Pakka nahi jaan sakte; online koi bhi natak kar sakta hai

explain.en: Photos, ages and names online can all be fake, and some adults pretend to be children to gain trust. Treat online-only friends as strangers and keep personal details private.
explain.hg: Online photos, umar aur naam sab fake ho sakte hain, aur kuch adults trust jeetne ke liye bachche ban jaate hain. Sirf online wale doston ko anjaan hi samjho aur personal details private rakho.

q.en: An online friend you have chatted with for months wants to meet. What is the safest plan?
q.hg: Jis online dost se mahino se baat ho rahi hai, woh milna chahta hai. Sabse safe plan kya hai?

options.en: Go with a friend your age, without telling
options.hg: Hum-umar dost ke saath jao, bina bataye

options.en: Meet at their home so it feels comfortable
options.hg: Unke ghar milo taaki comfortable lage

options.en: Go alone, since you know them well by now
options.hg: Akele jao, ab toh achhe se jaante ho

options.en: Tell a parent; meet only with them, in a public place
options.hg: Parents ko batao; sirf unke saath, public jagah par milo

explain.en: Months of chatting do not prove who someone is. If a meeting happens at all, a parent should know, come along, and choose a busy public place. A genuine friend will understand.
explain.hg: Mahino ki chatting se saabit nahi hota ki koi asal mein kaun hai. Agar milna ho bhi, toh parents ko pata ho, woh saath aayein, aur bheed wali public jagah ho. Asli dost yeh samjhega.

q.en: A video forwarded in your class group shows adult sexual content you didn't want to see. What should you do?
q.hg: Class group mein forward hua video adult sexual content dikhata hai jo tum dekhna nahi chahte the. Kya karoge?

options.en: Save it to show the teacher later
options.hg: Teacher ko baad mein dikhane ke liye save karo

options.en: Close it, don't forward it, and tell an adult
options.hg: Band karo, forward mat karo, aur bade ko batao

options.en: Watch it all so you know what it is
options.hg: Poora dekho taaki pata chale kya hai

options.en: Forward it to warn other friends
options.hg: Doston ko warn karne ke liye forward karo

explain.en: Seeing it by accident is not your fault and you are not in trouble. Do not save or forward it. Tell a parent or teacher who sent it and in which group, so they can deal with it.
explain.hg: Galti se dikh jaana tumhari galti nahi, aur tum trouble mein nahi ho. Save ya forward mat karo. Parents ya teacher ko batao kisne bheja aur kis group mein, taaki woh sambhaal sakein.

q.en: Some classmates make a group chat just to mock a student and add you. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Kuch classmates ek student ka mazaak udaane ke liye group banate hain aur tumhe add karte hain. Sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Add a few jokes of your own so you fit in
options.hg: Fit hone ke liye apne bhi kuch jokes daal do

options.en: Don't join in, keep screenshots, and tell a teacher
options.hg: Shaamil mat ho, screenshots rakho, aur teacher ko batao

options.en: Forward the chat to the student being mocked
options.hg: Chat us student ko forward kar do

options.en: Stay silent in the group so you're not next
options.hg: Group mein chup raho taaki agla number tumhara na ho

explain.en: Cyberbullying grows when people watch or join in. Not taking part, saving evidence and telling a trusted adult helps stop it. A kind private message to the student also helps.
explain.hg: Cyberbullying tab badhti hai jab log dekhte ya shaamil hote hain. Shaamil na hona, saboot rakhna aur trusted bade ko batana ise rokne mein madad karta hai. Student ko ek pyaara private message bhi madad karta hai.

q.en: Someone keeps posting mean comments on your photos. What is the best first response?
q.hg: Koi baar-baar tumhari photos par gande comments karta hai. Sabse pehla sahi response kya hai?

options.en: Ask friends to attack their account
options.hg: Doston se uske account par hamla karwao

options.en: Delete your whole account right away
options.hg: Turant apna poora account delete kar do

options.en: Reply with meaner comments of your own
options.hg: Usse bhi gande comments karo

options.en: Don't reply; screenshot, block, report and tell
options.hg: Reply mat karo; screenshot, block, report aur kisi ko batao

explain.en: Angry replies give bullies what they want. Keep screenshots first, then block and report the account, and tell a parent or teacher. Being bullied is never your fault.
explain.hg: Gusse wale reply bully ko wahi dete hain jo woh chahta hai. Pehle screenshots rakho, phir block aur report karo, aur parents ya teacher ko batao. Bully kiya jaana kabhi tumhari galti nahi.

q.en: Which of these is okay to share on a public profile?
q.hg: Public profile par kya share karna theek hai?

options.en: Your favourite cricket team
options.hg: Tumhari favourite cricket team
