options.en: Your full home address
options.hg: Tumhare ghar ka poora address

options.en: Your mobile phone number
options.hg: Tumhara mobile number

options.en: Your school timetable
options.hg: Tumhara school timetable

explain.en: Interests like a favourite team are fine. Address, phone number and daily routine help strangers find or contact you, so keep them private.
explain.hg: Favourite team jaisi pasand share karna theek hai. Address, phone number aur daily routine se anjaan log tumhe dhundh ya contact kar sakte hain, isliye inhe private rakho.

q.en: What does setting your account to 'private' mainly do?
q.hg: Account ko 'private' karne se mainly kya hota hai?

options.en: It deletes all your old posts
options.hg: Saare purane posts delete ho jaate hain

options.en: It hides your account from the police
options.hg: Account police se chhup jaata hai

options.en: Only people you approve can see your posts
options.hg: Sirf woh log posts dekh sakte hain jinhe tum approve karo

options.en: It makes your posts impossible to screenshot
options.hg: Posts ka screenshot lena impossible ho jaata hai

explain.en: A private account limits who sees your posts, but approved followers can still screenshot and share them. Accept only people you know in real life, and still think before you post.
explain.hg: Private account se limit hoti hai ki posts kaun dekhe, par approved followers phir bhi screenshot karke share kar sakte hain. Sirf asal zindagi mein jaane-pehchaane logon ko accept karo, aur post se pehle socho.

q.en: A message says you can get free game diamonds if you share the OTP that just came to your mum's phone. What is it?
q.hg: Message aata hai ki mummy ke phone par aaya OTP batao toh free game diamonds milenge. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A real reward from the game company
options.hg: Game company ka asli reward

options.en: A scam to steal money or the account
options.hg: Paise ya account chura ne ka scam

options.en: A safe way to verify your age
options.hg: Umar verify karne ka safe tareeka

options.en: A normal step to update the game
options.hg: Game update karne ka normal step

explain.en: No real company asks for an OTP to give rewards. An OTP is a key to an account or a payment. Never share it, and tell a parent; fraud can be reported on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Koi asli company reward ke liye OTP nahi maangti. OTP kisi account ya payment ki chaabi hai. Kabhi share mat karo, aur parents ko batao; fraud 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report ho sakta hai.

q.en: An account DMs you: 'You're so pretty! Send a few photos for our kids' modelling contest.' What is the safest move?
q.hg: Ek account DM karta hai: 'Tum bahut cute ho! Bachchon ke modelling contest ke liye kuch photos bhejo.' Sabse safe kya hai?

options.en: Send school photos, they are harmless
options.hg: School ki photos bhejo, unme kya hai

options.en: Send photos but ask them to keep it secret
options.hg: Photos bhejo par secret rakhne ko kaho

options.en: Don't send anything; show a parent
options.hg: Kuch mat bhejo; parents ko dikhao

options.en: Send one photo to see if it's real
options.hg: Asli hai ya nahi dekhne ke liye ek photo bhejo

explain.en: Fake contests and flattery are common ways to get photos from children. Real modelling agencies talk to parents, not to kids in DMs. Block, report and tell a parent.
explain.hg: Fake contests aur taareef bachchon se photos lene ke common tareeke hain. Asli modelling agencies parents se baat karti hain, DMs mein bachchon se nahi. Block, report karo aur parents ko batao.

q.en: Why should you turn off location tags on the photos and stories you post?
q.hg: Post ki gayi photos aur stories par location tag off kyun karna chahiye?

options.en: They can show strangers exactly where you are
options.hg: Isse anjaan log jaan sakte hain tum kahan ho

options.en: They use up your phone's storage
options.hg: Isse phone ki storage bhar jaati hai

options.en: They make the photo quality worse
options.hg: Isse photo ki quality kharab hoti hai

options.en: They stop friends from liking posts
options.hg: Isse dost post like nahi kar paate

explain.en: Location tags and live maps can reveal your home, school and routine to anyone who sees the post. Share live location only with a few people you trust, and switch it off when not needed.
explain.hg: Location tag aur live maps post dekhne wale kisi ko bhi tumhara ghar, school aur routine bata sakte hain. Live location sirf kuch trusted logon se share karo, aur zaroorat na ho toh off rakho.

q.en: You posted something and deleted it after five minutes. Is it gone for good?
q.hg: Tumne kuch post kiya aur paanch minute baad delete kar diya. Kya woh hamesha ke liye chala gaya?

options.en: Not necessarily; someone may have saved it
options.hg: Zaroori nahi; kisi ne save kar liya ho sakta hai

options.en: Yes, if you delete it within an hour
options.hg: Haan, agar ek ghante mein delete kar do

options.en: Yes, if you had fewer than 100 followers
options.hg: Haan, agar 100 se kam followers the

options.en: Yes, deleted posts vanish everywhere
options.hg: Haan, delete kiye posts har jagah se gayab

explain.en: Screenshots, screen recordings and forwards can keep a post alive after you delete it. That is why it helps to pause before posting anything you might regret.
explain.hg: Screenshot, screen recording aur forwards se delete karne ke baad bhi post bacha reh sakta hai. Isliye kuch bhi post karne se pehle ek pal ruk kar sochna achha hai.

q.en: You want to post a funny photo of your friend. What should you do first?
q.hg: Tum apne dost ki ek funny photo post karna chahte ho. Pehle kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Post it; friends never mind
options.hg: Post kar do; dost bura nahi maante

options.en: Post it if it gets many likes
options.hg: Bahut likes aayein toh post karo

options.en: Ask your friend if it's okay
options.hg: Dost se poocho ki theek hai ya nahi

options.en: Post it and tag them as a surprise
options.hg: Post karke surprise mein tag kar do

explain.en: Consent applies online too. A photo you find funny may embarrass someone else. Asking first keeps friendships and privacy safe.
explain.hg: Consent online bhi lagta hai. Jo photo tumhe funny lage, woh kisi aur ko sharminda kar sakti hai. Pehle poochna dosti aur privacy dono ko safe rakhta hai.

q.en: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, who counts as a 'child' for apps using personal data?
q.hg: India ke Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ke hisaab se personal data use karne wale apps ke liye 'child' kaun hai?

options.en: Anyone under 13
options.hg: 13 se kam umar ka koi bhi

options.en: Anyone under 16
options.hg: 16 se kam umar ka koi bhi

options.en: Anyone under 18
options.hg: 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi

options.en: Only children under 10
options.hg: Sirf 10 se chhote bachche

explain.en: The DPDP Act defines a child as anyone under 18. Platforms need verifiable parental consent to process a child's data, and may not track or target ads at children.
explain.hg: DPDP Act 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai. Platforms ko bachche ka data use karne ke liye verifiable parental consent chahiye, aur bachchon ko track ya targeted ads nahi dikha sakte.

q.en: A friend says, 'Send it on Snapchat, it disappears.' What is true?
q.hg: Dost kehta hai, 'Snapchat par bhejo, gayab ho jaata hai.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: Screenshots are impossible on that app
options.hg: Us app par screenshot ho hi nahi sakta

options.en: It can still be screenshotted or recorded
options.hg: Screenshot ya record phir bhi ho sakta hai

options.en: Only the app company can ever see it
options.hg: Sirf app company dekh sakti hai

options.en: It is deleted forever with no copy
options.hg: Hamesha ke liye delete, koi copy nahi

explain.en: Disappearing messages can be captured with a screenshot or another phone's camera. Once an image is sent, you lose control of it. If anyone pressures you to send one, you can say no.
explain.hg: Gayab hone wale messages bhi screenshot ya doosre phone ke camera se capture ho sakte hain. Image bhejte hi control chala jaata hai. Koi bhejne ka pressure daale toh tum mana kar sakte ho.

q.en: A 15-year-old's boyfriend keeps asking for a nude photo and says, 'If you loved me, you would.' What is true?
q.hg: Ek 15 saal ki ladki ka boyfriend baar-baar nude photo maangta hai aur kehta hai, 'Pyaar karti toh bhejti.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is a normal part of being in a relationship
options.hg: Relationship mein yeh normal hai

options.en: It is fine if the photo hides her face
options.hg: Chehra na dikhe toh theek hai

options.en: It's pressure, not love; she can say no and tell someone
options.hg: Yeh pressure hai, pyaar nahi; woh mana karke kisi ko bata sakti hai

options.en: She must send it to prove she loves him
options.hg: Pyaar saabit karne ke liye use bhejna padega

explain.en: Love does not need proof through photos. Repeated pressure is coercion. Sexual images of anyone under 18 are illegal for anyone to ask for, keep or share, and she is never to blame for being asked.
explain.hg: Pyaar ko photo se saabit nahi karna padta. Baar-baar pressure dena coercion hai. 18 se kam umar ki sexual images maangna, rakhna ya share karna kisi ke liye bhi illegal hai, aur maange jaane mein uski koi galti nahi.

q.en: What is 'sextortion'?
q.hg: 'Sextortion' kya hai?

options.en: Threatening to leak someone's intimate images to get what they want
options.hg: Kisi ki intimate images leak karne ki dhamki dekar apni baat manwaana

options.en: Sending a flirty message to a partner you are dating
options.hg: Jisse date kar rahe ho use flirty message bhejna

options.en: Reporting a fake account to the app's safety team
options.hg: App ki safety team ko fake account report karna

options.en: A website that teaches adults about sex and health
options.hg: Adults ko sex aur health ke baare mein sikhane wali website

explain.en: Sextortion is blackmail: someone threatens to share sexual images or videos unless the person pays money, sends more images or does what they demand. It is a crime, and the target is never to blame.
explain.hg: Sextortion blackmail hai: koi sexual images ya videos share karne ki dhamki deta hai jab tak insaan paise na de, aur images na bheje ya unki baat na maane. Yeh crime hai, aur target ki kabhi galti nahi.

q.en: A blackmailer threatens to leak your photos unless you pay Rs 5,000. Should you pay?
q.hg: Ek blackmailer dhamki deta hai ki Rs 5,000 nahi diye toh photos leak kar dega. Kya paise dene chahiye?

options.en: No; paying usually leads to more demands
options.hg: Nahi; paise dene se aksar aur maangein aati hain

options.en: Yes, if they promise in writing
options.hg: Haan, agar likh kar promise karein

options.en: Yes, then they will delete everything
options.hg: Haan, phir woh sab delete kar denge

options.en: Yes, but only half the amount
options.hg: Haan, par sirf aadhe paise

explain.en: Paying tells the blackmailer you can be pushed, and demands usually grow. Stop replying, keep the evidence, tell someone you trust and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Paise dene se blackmailer samajh jaata hai ki tum dabaav mein aa sakte ho, aur maangein badhti hain. Reply band karo, saboot rakho, kisi trusted insaan ko batao aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

q.en: According to WeProtect (2024), what happened to most sextortion victims who ignored the criminals' payment demands?
q.hg: WeProtect (2024) ke mutabik, jin sextortion victims ne criminals ki paise ki maang ignore ki, unme se zyada tar ke saath kya hua?

options.en: Their images were not distributed
options.hg: Unki images share nahi ki gayi

options.en: Their families were contacted by police
options.hg: Police ne unki family se sampark kiya

options.en: They were asked for even more money
options.hg: Unse aur zyada paise maange gaye

options.en: Their images were always posted at once
options.hg: Unki images hamesha turant post hui

explain.en: WeProtect cites a study finding that 70% of victims who ignore payment demands do not have their images distributed. There is no guarantee, but paying rarely ends it. Report and get support.
explain.hg: WeProtect ek study ka hawala deta hai: jo victims paise ki maang ignore karte hain, unme se 70% ki images share nahi hoti. Guarantee nahi, par paise dene se maamla shaayad hi khatam hota hai. Report karo aur support lo.

q.en: In a sextortion case, who is to blame?
q.hg: Sextortion case mein galti kiski hai?

options.en: Both people equally
options.hg: Dono ki barabar

options.en: The app where it happened
options.hg: Jis app par hua uski

options.en: The person making the threats
options.hg: Dhamki dene wale ki

options.en: The person who shared a photo first
options.hg: Jisne pehle photo bheji uski

explain.en: Trusting someone is not a crime; blackmail is. Whatever happened before, the person threatening is the one breaking the law. Victims deserve help, not judgement.
explain.hg: Kisi par trust karna crime nahi; blackmail crime hai. Pehle jo bhi hua, kanoon dhamki dene wala tod raha hai. Victims ko madad chahiye, judgement nahi.

q.en: You are being blackmailed online. What evidence should you keep?
q.hg: Tumhe online blackmail kiya ja raha hai. Kaunsa saboot sambhal kar rakhna chahiye?

options.en: Nothing; delete the whole chat at once
options.hg: Kuch nahi; poori chat turant delete karo

options.en: Screenshots of chats, profile links and payment IDs
options.hg: Chats ke screenshots, profile links aur payment IDs

options.en: Only your own messages, not theirs
options.hg: Sirf apne messages, unke nahi

options.en: Only the blackmailer's display name
options.hg: Sirf blackmailer ka display name

explain.en: Screenshots showing threats, usernames, profile URLs, phone numbers, dates and UPI or bank details help police trace the person. Don't delete the chat. Never forward a sexual image of anyone under 18, even as proof.
explain.hg: Dhamkiyon, usernames, profile URLs, phone numbers, dates aur UPI ya bank details ke screenshots police ko trace karne mein madad karte hain. Chat delete mat karo. 18 se kam umar ki sexual image kabhi forward mat karo, saboot ke liye bhi nahi.

q.en: You want to show the police what the blackmailer sent. Should you forward the intimate image to a friend for safekeeping?
q.hg: Tum police ko dikhana chahte ho ki blackmailer ne kya bheja. Kya intimate image safe rakhne ke liye dost ko forward karni chahiye?

options.en: Yes, the more copies there are, the safer you are
options.hg: Haan, jitni zyada copies, utna safe

options.en: Yes, but only to one close friend you trust
options.hg: Haan, par sirf ek trusted close friend ko

options.en: Yes, and post it publicly to warn others
options.hg: Haan, aur doosron ko warn karne ke liye public mein post karo

options.en: No; keep the chat and describe it, but don't forward it
options.hg: Nahi; chat rakho aur batao kya tha, par forward mat karo

explain.en: Every forward spreads the image further. Keep the original chat and screenshots of threats and profile details, and let the police or the portal handle the image itself.
explain.hg: Har forward image ko aur failata hai. Original chat aur dhamkiyon aur profile details ke screenshots rakho, aur image ko police ya portal ko sambhalne do.

q.en: Where can you report online blackmail or sextortion in India?
q.hg: India mein online blackmail ya sextortion kahan report kar sakte hain?

options.en: Only by emailing the app's owner
options.hg: Sirf app ke owner ko email karke

options.en: Only at a court, with a lawyer
options.hg: Sirf court mein, vakeel ke saath

options.en: Call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in
options.hg: 1930 call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint karo

options.en: Nowhere; online crimes can't be reported
options.hg: Kahin nahi; online crime report nahi hota

explain.en: 1930 is India's toll-free cyber crime helpline, and cybercrime.gov.in is the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal. You can also go to any police station. Under 18? 1098 can help too.
explain.hg: 1930 India ki toll-free cyber crime helpline hai, aur cybercrime.gov.in National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal hai. Kisi bhi police station bhi ja sakte ho. 18 se kam ho? 1098 bhi madad kar sakti hai.

q.en: Someone is threatening you on Instagram. In what order should you act?
q.hg: Koi Instagram par tumhe dhamki de raha hai. Kis order mein kaam karna chahiye?

options.en: Delete the chat, then report from memory
options.hg: Chat delete karo, phir yaad se report karo

options.en: Argue with them, then block them
options.hg: Pehle unse behas karo, phir block

options.en: Save evidence first, then block and report
options.hg: Pehle saboot save karo, phir block aur report

options.en: Block first, then try to find the evidence
options.hg: Pehle block karo, phir saboot dhundho

explain.en: Blocking can hide the profile and chat, making evidence harder to collect. Take screenshots and copy the profile link first, then block and report on the app, and to 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Block karne se profile aur chat chhup sakti hai, phir saboot jutana mushkil hota hai. Pehle screenshots lo aur profile link copy karo, phir app par block aur report karo, aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par bhi.

q.en: Who are the most common targets of financial sextortion, according to WeProtect (2024)?
q.hg: WeProtect (2024) ke mutabik financial sextortion ke sabse common targets kaun hain?

options.en: Teenage boys aged 13 to 17
options.hg: 13 se 17 saal ke teenage ladke

options.en: Only famous influencers
options.hg: Sirf famous influencers

options.en: Women over the age of 50
options.hg: 50 saal se zyada umar ki aurtein

options.en: Children under eight years old
options.hg: Aath saal se chhote bachche

explain.en: Financial sextortion mainly targets boys aged 13 to 17, usually tricked into believing they are chatting with a young woman. Boys deserve the same support: it is not their fault, and they should not pay.
explain.hg: Financial sextortion mostly 13 se 17 saal ke ladkon ko target karta hai, jinhe lagta hai woh kisi young ladki se baat kar rahe hain. Ladkon ko bhi wahi support chahiye: galti unki nahi, aur paise nahi dene chahiye.

q.en: A stranger video calls you, then sends a screen recording edited to look sexual and demands money. What should you do?
q.hg: Ek anjaan video call karta hai, phir edit karke sexual dikhne wali screen recording bhejta hai aur paise maangta hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Don't pay; save details, block and report on 1930
options.hg: Paise mat do; details save karo, block karo aur 1930 par report karo

options.en: Send a video of yourself to prove it's fake
options.hg: Fake saabit karne ke liye apna video bhejo

options.en: Pay quickly before the video is shared
options.hg: Video share ho, usse pehle jaldi paise de do

options.en: Call back and beg them to delete it
options.hg: Wapas call karke delete karne ki request karo

explain.en: This video-call trap is a common sextortion scam. Do not pay or engage. Save the number, profile and messages, block, tell someone you trust and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in. You did nothing wrong.
explain.hg: Yeh video-call trap ek common sextortion scam hai. Paise mat do, baat mat badhao. Number, profile aur messages save karo, block karo, kisi trusted insaan ko batao aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo. Tumne kuch galat nahi kiya.

q.en: After a sextortion threat, someone calls claiming to be a police officer and asks for money to 'delete the video and close the case'. What is this?
q.hg: Sextortion ki dhamki ke baad koi khud ko police officer bata kar call karta hai aur 'video delete karke case band karne' ke paise maangta hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A legal fine that you must pay online at once
options.hg: Legal fine jo turant online bharna hai

options.en: A genuine police fee for deleting the video
options.hg: Video delete karwane ki asli police fees

options.en: Likely a scam; real police don't take money to close cases
options.hg: Shaayad scam; asli police case band karne ke paise nahi leti

options.en: Normal police procedure for online cases like this
options.hg: Aise online cases ka normal police procedure

explain.en: Fake 'police', 'cyber cell' or 'YouTube officer' calls often follow sextortion to extract more money. Real police do not take payments over the phone to delete videos. Hang up and report on 1930.
explain.hg: Sextortion ke baad aksar fake 'police', 'cyber cell' ya 'YouTube officer' ki calls aati hain aur paise maange jaate hain. Asli police phone par video delete karne ke paise nahi leti. Call kaato aur 1930 par report karo.

q.en: A nude image taken when you were 16 is being shared online. Which free service can help stop it spreading on participating platforms?
q.hg: 16 saal ki umar mein li gayi tumhari nude image online share ho rahi hai. Kaunsi free service participating platforms par ise failne se rok sakti hai?

options.en: A VPN app
options.hg: Koi VPN app

options.en: A paid 'reputation repair' agency
options.hg: Paid 'reputation repair' agency

options.en: NCMEC's Take It Down
options.hg: NCMEC ka Take It Down

options.en: An antivirus scan
options.hg: Antivirus scan

explain.en: Take It Down is free and anonymous, for images taken before 18. It sends only a digital fingerprint (hash) to participating platforms, not the image. Also report on cybercrime.gov.in or 1930 with a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Take It Down free aur anonymous hai, 18 se pehle li gayi images ke liye. Yeh participating platforms ko sirf ek digital fingerprint (hash) bhejta hai, image nahi. Saath mein trusted bade ke saath cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo.

q.en: An adult's intimate images are being threatened or shared without consent. Which tool helps block them on partner platforms?
q.hg: Ek adult ki intimate images bina consent share karne ki dhamki di ja rahi hai ya share ho rahi hain. Partner platforms par rokne mein kaunsa tool madad karta hai?

options.en: StopNCII.org
options.hg: StopNCII.org

options.en: A photo-editing app
options.hg: Photo-editing app

options.en: A screen-time tracker
options.hg: Screen-time tracker

options.en: A cloud backup service
options.hg: Cloud backup service

explain.en: StopNCII.org, run by the UK charity SWGfL, is for images taken at 18 or older. It shares a digital fingerprint (hash) with partner platforms so they can block matches. Report the crime on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in too.
explain.hg: StopNCII.org, jo UK charity SWGfL chalati hai, 18 ya usse zyada umar mein li gayi images ke liye hai. Yeh partner platforms ke saath digital fingerprint (hash) share karta hai taaki woh matching images block karein. Crime 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par bhi report karo.

q.en: How do Take It Down and StopNCII stop an image spreading without you uploading it to them?
q.hg: Take It Down aur StopNCII bina image upload karwaye use failne se kaise rokte hain?

options.en: A digital fingerprint (hash) that platforms match
options.hg: Ek digital fingerprint (hash) jise platforms match karte hain

options.en: They blur the image across the internet
options.hg: Woh poore internet par image blur kar dete hain

options.en: They track down who took the image
options.hg: Woh pata lagate hain image kisne li

options.en: They delete the image from every phone
options.hg: Woh har phone se image delete kar dete hain

explain.en: A hash is a code made from the image. Partner platforms compare uploads against it and block matches. It works only on participating platforms, so also report to the app and on cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Hash image se bana ek code hai. Partner platforms uploads ko isse match karke block karte hain. Yeh sirf participating platforms par kaam karta hai, isliye app aur cybercrime.gov.in par bhi report karo.

q.en: Since 20 February 2026, how quickly must platforms in India remove nude, sexual or morphed images of a person after that person complains?
q.hg: 20 February 2026 se, India mein platforms ko kisi ki nude, sexual ya morphed images uski complaint ke baad kitni der mein hatani hoti hain?

options.en: Only after a court order
options.hg: Sirf court order ke baad

options.en: Within 15 days
options.hg: 15 din ke andar

options.en: Within 24 hours
options.hg: 24 ghante ke andar

options.en: Within two hours
options.hg: Do ghante ke andar

explain.en: The IT Amendment Rules, 2026 cut the deadline from 24 hours to two hours for such complaints by the person shown or someone on their behalf. Report on the platform and keep the complaint number.
explain.hg: IT Amendment Rules, 2026 ne aisi complaints, jo dikhaya gaya insaan ya uski taraf se koi kare, ki deadline 24 ghante se ghata kar do ghante kar di. Platform par report karo aur complaint number sambhal kar rakho.

q.en: Under the IT Amendment Rules, 2026, how long do platforms have to remove unlawful content after a court order or authorised government notice?
q.hg: IT Amendment Rules, 2026 ke under court order ya authorised government notice ke baad platforms ko unlawful content kitni der mein hatana hai?

options.en: 36 hours
options.hg: 36 ghante

options.en: Thirty days
options.hg: Tees din

options.en: Seven days
options.hg: Saat din

options.en: Three hours
options.hg: Teen ghante

explain.en: The 2026 amendment cut this from 36 hours to three hours, and cut the deadline for resolving ordinary user grievances from 15 days to seven.
explain.hg: 2026 ke amendment ne ise 36 ghante se ghata kar teen ghante kar diya, aur aam user grievances suljhaane ki deadline 15 din se saat din kar di.

q.en: What is a 'deepfake'?
q.hg: 'Deepfake' kya hota hai?

options.en: A photo taken with a very good camera
options.hg: Bahut achhe camera se li gayi photo

options.en: A private account with no followers
options.hg: Private account jiske koi followers nahi

options.en: A post that gets many likes quickly
options.hg: Post jo jaldi bahut likes paaye

options.en: AI-made or altered media that looks real
options.hg: AI se bana ya badla gaya media jo asli lage

explain.en: Deepfakes use AI to create or change videos, images or audio so a person seems to say or do something they never did. India's 2026 IT rules call this 'synthetically generated information'.
explain.hg: Deepfake mein AI se videos, images ya audio banaye ya badle jaate hain taaki lage koi insaan woh bol ya kar raha hai jo usne kabhi nahi kiya. India ke 2026 IT rules ise 'synthetically generated information' kehte hain.

q.en: Someone makes a fake nude image of you using AI. What is true?
q.hg: Koi AI se tumhari fake nude image banata hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is abuse, it's not your fault, and you can report it
options.hg: Yeh abuse hai, tumhari galti nahi, aur report kar sakte ho

options.en: You can't report it since you never posed
options.hg: Tumne pose nahi kiya toh report nahi kar sakte

options.en: It's harmless because the image isn't real
options.hg: Image asli nahi hai toh koi nuksaan nahi

options.en: It's your fault for posting public photos
options.hg: Public photos daalne ki tumhari galti hai

explain.en: Morphed and AI-made sexual images are abuse and can be reported to the platform and on cybercrime.gov.in or 1930. Platforms must act fast on such complaints. Posting normal photos never makes it your fault.
explain.hg: Morphed aur AI se bani sexual images abuse hain, inhe platform par aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report kar sakte ho. Platforms ko aisi complaints par jaldi action lena hota hai. Normal photos daalne se galti kabhi tumhari nahi ho jaati.

q.en: A classmate uses an AI app to make a 'funny' fake video of another student kissing someone. What is true?
q.hg: Ek classmate AI app se ek doosre student ka kisi ko kiss karte hue 'funny' fake video banata hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is fine if only shared in one group
options.hg: Sirf ek group mein share ho toh theek hai

options.en: It is harassment that can seriously hurt them
options.hg: Yeh harassment hai jo unhe bahut hurt kar sakta hai

options.en: It is fine because everyone knows it's fake
options.hg: Theek hai kyunki sab jaante hain fake hai

options.en: It is fine if the student is popular
options.hg: Student popular ho toh theek hai

explain.en: Fake intimate content can humiliate someone and spread far beyond one group. Making or sharing it can be an offence. Don't forward it, report it, tell a teacher and check on the student.
explain.hg: Fake intimate content kisi ko bahut sharminda kar sakta hai aur ek group se bahut aage fail sakta hai. Banana ya share karna offence ho sakta hai. Forward mat karo, report karo, teacher ko batao aur student ka haal poocho.

q.en: What do India's 2026 IT rules require for AI-generated content that is allowed on platforms?
q.hg: India ke 2026 IT rules allowed AI-generated content ke liye kya maangte hain?

options.en: It must be deleted after 24 hours
options.hg: Use 24 ghante baad delete karna hoga

options.en: It needs no label or marking at all
options.hg: Kisi label ya marking ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: It must cover only famous people
options.hg: Woh sirf famous logon ka ho sakta hai

options.en: It must be prominently labelled as synthetic
options.hg: Use saaf-saaf synthetic label kiya jaana chahiye

explain.en: Platforms offering AI tools must prominently label synthetic content and, where feasible, embed metadata showing the tool used. They must also block AI-made child sexual abuse material and non-consensual intimate imagery.
explain.hg: AI tools dene wale platforms ko synthetic content par saaf label lagana hai aur jahan ho sake metadata daalna hai jo bataye kaunsa tool use hua. Unhe AI se bana child sexual abuse material aur non-consensual intimate imagery block bhi karna hai.

q.en: Someone has made a fake profile of your friend and is asking her contacts for money. What should you do?
q.hg: Kisi ne tumhari dost ka fake profile banaya hai aur uske contacts se paise maang raha hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Ignore it; fake profiles vanish on their own
options.hg: Ignore karo; fake profiles khud gayab ho jaate hain

options.en: Make a fake profile of the scammer back
options.hg: Badle mein scammer ka fake profile banao

options.en: Send a small amount to check if it's real
options.hg: Asli hai ya nahi dekhne ke liye thode paise bhejo

options.en: Warn contacts, report the profile, and report on 1930
options.hg: Contacts ko warn karo, profile report karo, aur 1930 par report karo

explain.en: Impersonation is reported fastest through the platform's 'pretending to be someone' option. Tell your friend, warn contacts not to pay, screenshot the profile and messages, and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Impersonation sabse jaldi platform ke 'pretending to be someone' option se report hoti hai. Dost ko batao, contacts ko paise na dene ki warning do, profile aur messages ka screenshot lo, aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

q.en: Which is a common sign that an online profile may be a catfish?
q.hg: Kaunsa common sign hai ki online profile catfish ho sakta hai?

options.en: Always avoids video calls but rushes into intimacy
options.hg: Video call se hamesha bachta hai par jaldi intimacy chahta hai

options.en: Has a few photos with friends and family
options.hg: Doston aur family ke saath kuch photos hain

options.en: Says they live in the same city as you
options.hg: Kehta hai ki tumhare hi shehar mein rehta hai

options.en: Takes a day or two to reply to messages
options.hg: Messages ka reply ek-do din mein karta hai

explain.en: Catfish accounts often use stolen photos, dodge live video, move fast to flattery or romance, and soon ask for photos or money. A reverse image search on their pictures can reveal a stolen identity.
explain.hg: Catfish accounts aksar chori ki photos use karte hain, live video se bachte hain, jaldi taareef ya romance par aate hain, aur phir photos ya paise maangte hain. Unki photos ka reverse image search chori ki pehchaan dikha sakta hai.

q.en: How can you check whether an online profile photo is stolen from someone else?
q.hg: Kaise check karoge ki online profile photo kisi aur se chori ki gayi hai?

options.en: Count how many followers they have
options.hg: Unke followers gino

options.en: Ask them to promise it is really them
options.hg: Unse promise karwao ki photo unki hai

options.en: Do a reverse image search on the photo
options.hg: Photo ka reverse image search karo

options.en: Check if the photo is high quality
options.hg: Dekho photo high quality hai ya nahi

explain.en: A reverse image search (for example with Google Lens) shows where else a picture appears online. If it belongs to a model or another person's account, the profile is likely fake.
explain.hg: Reverse image search (jaise Google Lens se) dikhata hai ki photo online aur kahan hai. Agar woh kisi model ya doosre insaan ke account ki hai, toh profile shaayad fake hai.

q.en: Online grooming usually follows a pattern. Which sequence fits best?
q.hg: Online grooming aksar ek pattern follow karti hai. Kaunsa sequence sabse sahi hai?

options.en: Flattery, secrecy, private chats, photo requests, threats
options.hg: Taareef, secrecy, private chats, photo ki maang, dhamki

options.en: Meeting parents first, then private chats
options.hg: Pehle parents se milna, phir private chats

options.en: Photo requests first, then friendship and gifts
options.hg: Pehle photo ki maang, phir dosti aur gifts

options.en: Threats first, then flattery, then gifts
options.hg: Pehle dhamki, phir taareef, phir gifts

explain.en: Groomers build trust with attention and flattery, ask for secrecy, move to private apps, then request images and use them to threaten. Spotting the early steps means you can stop and tell someone.
explain.hg: Groomer pehle attention aur taareef se trust banate hain, secret rakhne ko kehte hain, private apps par le jaate hain, phir images maang kar unse dhamkaate hain. Shuru ke steps pehchaan lo toh ruk kar kisi ko bata sakte ho.

q.en: An adult you met online says, 'You're so mature, not like other kids. Our chats are just between us.' What is this?
q.hg: Online mila ek adult kehta hai, 'Tum bahut mature ho, baaki bachchon jaise nahi. Hamari baatein sirf hamare beech.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A compliment you should return
options.hg: Compliment jiska jawab dena chahiye

options.en: A normal thing adults say to kids
options.hg: Adults bachchon se aisa normal mein kehte hain

options.en: A sign of a genuine friendship
options.hg: Sachchi dosti ka sign

options.en: A grooming red flag; tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Grooming ka red flag; trusted bade ko batao

explain.en: Making a young person feel special and asking for secrecy are two classic grooming signs. You have done nothing wrong. Save the chat and tell a trusted adult or call 1098.
explain.hg: Kisi young insaan ko special feel karana aur secret rakhne ko kehna, grooming ke do classic signs hain. Tumne kuch galat nahi kiya. Chat save karo aur trusted bade ko batao ya 1098 call karo.

q.en: WeProtect's Global Threat Assessment 2023 cited data on grooming in social gaming. How fast can offenders draw a child into a high-risk conversation?
q.hg: WeProtect ke Global Threat Assessment 2023 ne social gaming mein grooming ka data diya. Offenders kitni jaldi bachche ko high-risk baatcheet mein le aate hain?

options.en: In as little as 19 seconds; 45 minutes on average
options.hg: Sirf 19 seconds mein; average 45 minute

options.en: Never in less than a month of chatting
options.hg: Ek mahine ki chatting se pehle kabhi nahi

options.en: Only after they have met in person
options.hg: Sirf aamne-saamne milne ke baad

options.en: Only after several years of chats
options.hg: Sirf kai saal ki chats ke baad

explain.en: Risk-intelligence data cited by WeProtect in 2023 found high-risk grooming conversations could start within 19 seconds of a first message, and within 45 minutes on average. Talk with children about games early and often.
explain.hg: WeProtect ke 2023 report mein diye gaye data ke mutabik high-risk grooming baatcheet pehle message ke 19 seconds mein, aur average 45 minute mein shuru ho sakti hai. Bachchon se games ke baare mein jaldi aur baar-baar baat karo.

q.en: Your intimate image has just been leaked. What is the best plan for the first hour?
q.hg: Tumhari intimate image abhi leak hui hai. Pehle ghante ka sabse achha plan kya hai?

options.en: Message everyone who saw it to explain
options.hg: Jisne dekha sabko message karke safai do

options.en: Pay the person who leaked it to remove it
options.hg: Leak karne wale ko hatane ke paise do

options.en: Save links, report it, call 1930, tell someone you trust
options.hg: Links save karo, report karo, 1930 call karo, kisi trusted ko batao

options.en: Delete all your accounts and stay offline
options.hg: Saare accounts delete karke offline ho jao

explain.en: Note links, usernames and screenshots of where it appears, use the platform's report option, report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, and use StopNCII (18+) or Take It Down (under 18). Tell someone you trust; it is not your fault.
explain.hg: Jahan image dikh rahi hai uske links, usernames aur screenshots note karo, platform par report karo, 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo, aur StopNCII (18+) ya Take It Down (18 se kam) use karo. Kisi trusted insaan ko batao; tumhari galti nahi.

q.en: A friend's private photo is being shared in a group you are in. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Tumhare group mein ek dost ki private photo share ho rahi hai. Sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Don't forward it, report it, and support your friend
options.hg: Forward mat karo, report karo, aur dost ka saath do

options.en: Leave the group quietly and say nothing
options.hg: Chupchaap group chhod do aur kuch mat bolo

options.en: Forward it to your friend so she knows
options.hg: Dost ko forward karo taaki use pata chale

options.en: Save it in case it gets deleted later
options.hg: Baad mein delete ho jaaye, isliye save kar lo

explain.en: Every forward hurts the person again and can be an offence. Report the message, tell the group to stop, and let your friend know, gently and privately, that you are on their side and can help them report.
explain.hg: Har forward us insaan ko phir se hurt karta hai aur offence ho sakta hai. Message report karo, group ko rukne ko kaho, aur dost ko pyaar se akele mein batao ki tum uske saath ho aur report karne mein madad kar sakte ho.

q.en: After a breakup, your ex threatens to post your private photos unless you get back together. What is true?
q.hg: Breakup ke baad ex dhamki deta hai ki wapas nahi aaye toh tumhari private photos post kar dega. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's legal because you sent the photos
options.hg: Photos tumne bheji thi toh legal hai

options.en: It's a crime; don't negotiate, keep evidence, report
options.hg: Yeh crime hai; samjhauta mat karo, saboot rakho, report karo

options.en: It's a private matter between ex-partners
options.hg: Yeh ex-partners ka private maamla hai

options.en: You must get back together to stay safe
options.hg: Safe rehne ke liye wapas jaana padega

explain.en: Threatening to share intimate images is criminal intimidation and image-based abuse. Sharing them without consent is an offence under the IT Act. Save the threats, use StopNCII if you're 18+, and report on 1930.
explain.hg: Intimate images share karne ki dhamki dena criminal intimidation aur image-based abuse hai. Bina consent share karna IT Act ke under offence hai. Dhamkiyan save karo, 18+ ho toh StopNCII use karo, aur 1930 par report karo.

q.en: Someone shares a screenshot of a private chat with you 'to prove a point' in a public group. What best describes this?
q.hg: Koi tumhari private chat ka screenshot 'point prove karne' ke liye public group mein share karta hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A breach of trust and privacy
options.hg: Trust aur privacy ka ullanghan

options.en: Only wrong if it has photos
options.hg: Sirf photos ho toh galat

options.en: A normal way to settle fights
options.hg: Ladai suljhaane ka normal tareeka

options.en: Fair, since you sent the messages
options.hg: Theek hai, messages tumne bheje the

explain.en: A private message is shared for one person, not for a crowd. Posting screenshots to shame someone is a form of cyberbullying. Ask for it to be removed, report it, and tell someone you trust if it continues.
explain.hg: Private message ek insaan ke liye hota hai, bheed ke liye nahi. Kisi ko sharminda karne ke liye screenshots daalna cyberbullying ka ek roop hai. Hatane ko kaho, report karo, aur jaari rahe toh kisi trusted insaan ko batao.

q.en: You blocked someone, but they keep making new accounts to message you. What is this?
q.hg: Tumne kisi ko block kiya, par woh naye accounts bana kar message karta rehta hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Normal behaviour after a fight
options.hg: Ladai ke baad normal behaviour

options.en: Online stalking, which can be an offence
options.hg: Online stalking, jo offence ho sakta hai

options.en: A sign they care about you
options.hg: Sign ki unhe tumhari parwaah hai

options.en: Nothing that you can report anywhere
options.hg: Kuch nahi jo kahin report ho sake

explain.en: Repeatedly contacting someone who has clearly said no is stalking, which can be a crime online as well as offline. Keep screenshots of each account, report them, tell someone you trust and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Jisne saaf mana kar diya ho, use baar-baar contact karna stalking hai, jo online aur offline dono jagah crime ho sakta hai. Har account ka screenshot rakho, report karo, kisi trusted insaan ko batao aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

q.en: Which IT Act section punishes capturing or publishing images of a person's private parts without consent?
q.hg: IT Act ka kaunsa section bina consent kisi ke private parts ki images lene ya publish karne ki saza deta hai?

options.en: Section 43
options.hg: Section 43

options.en: Section 66E
options.hg: Section 66E

options.en: Section 79
options.hg: Section 79

options.en: Section 80
options.hg: Section 80

explain.en: Section 66E of the IT Act punishes capturing or sharing images of a person's private parts without consent, with up to three years in jail or a fine of up to Rs 2 lakh. Hidden cameras and secret recordings are covered.
explain.hg: IT Act ka Section 66E bina consent kisi ke private parts ki images lene ya share karne par teen saal tak jail ya Rs 2 lakh tak fine ki saza deta hai. Hidden cameras aur chupke se recording bhi isme aati hai.

q.en: What did the Supreme Court rule in September 2024 about child sexual abuse material?
q.hg: September 2024 mein Supreme Court ne child sexual abuse material ke baare mein kya faisla diya?

options.en: Only selling it for money is an offence
options.hg: Sirf paise ke liye bechna offence hai

options.en: Watching it privately is always legal
options.hg: Private mein dekhna hamesha legal hai

options.en: Only the adults shown in it are protected
options.hg: Sirf usme dikhe adults protected hain

options.en: Viewing, storing or possessing it can be an offence
options.hg: Use dekhna, store karna ya rakhna offence ho sakta hai

explain.en: The court held that viewing, storing or possessing such material can be an offence under POCSO and the IT Act, even if it is never shared, and told courts to say 'child sexual exploitation and abuse material'.
explain.hg: Court ne kaha ki aisa material dekhna, store karna ya rakhna POCSO aur IT Act ke under offence ho sakta hai, chahe share na kiya ho, aur courts ko 'child sexual exploitation and abuse material' kehne ko kaha.

q.en: Someone sends you a video that seems to show a child being sexually abused. What should you do?
q.hg: Koi tumhe ek video bhejta hai jisme lagta hai ki ek bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Download it as proof before reporting
options.hg: Report se pehle saboot ke liye download karo

options.en: Don't save or forward it; report on cybercrime.gov.in
options.hg: Save ya forward mat karo; cybercrime.gov.in par report karo

options.en: Share it to find out who the child is
options.hg: Bachcha kaun hai pata karne ke liye share karo

options.en: Forward it to the police on WhatsApp
options.hg: Police ko WhatsApp par forward karo

explain.en: Saving or forwarding such material is itself an offence and spreads the child's abuse. Note who sent it and where, report it with the platform and on cybercrime.gov.in, which accepts anonymous reports, or call 1930. Call 1098 or 112 if a child is in danger.
explain.hg: Aisa material save ya forward karna khud ek offence hai aur bachche ka abuse failata hai. Kisne aur kahan bheja note karo, platform aur cybercrime.gov.in par report karo, jo anonymous report bhi leta hai, ya 1930 call karo. Bachcha khatre mein ho toh 1098 ya 112.

q.en: A woman you've been chatting with online for weeks suddenly needs money for a 'medical emergency' but never video calls. What is most likely?
q.hg: Jis ladki se hafton se online baat ho rahi hai, use achaanak 'medical emergency' ke liye paise chahiye, par woh kabhi video call nahi karti. Sabse zyada kya sambhav hai?

options.en: A romance scam; don't send money
options.hg: Romance scam; paise mat bhejo

options.en: A genuine emergency you must help with
options.hg: Asli emergency jisme madad karni padegi

options.en: A test of how much you care
options.hg: Test ki tumhe kitni parwaah hai

options.en: Shyness about video calls
options.hg: Video call se sharmana

explain.en: Fast romance, excuses to avoid video, then an urgent money request is the classic romance-scam pattern and can target anyone. Stop sending money, keep chats and payment details, and report on 1930.
explain.hg: Jaldi romance, video se bachne ke bahaane, phir achaanak paise ki maang, yeh classic romance-scam pattern hai aur kisi ko bhi target kar sakta hai. Paise bhejna band karo, chats aur payment details rakho, aur 1930 par report karo.

q.en: Your partner insists on knowing your passwords and wants your live location on all the time. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara partner zid karta hai ki use tumhare passwords pata hon aur live location hamesha on rahe. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Proof that they care the most
options.hg: Saboot ki unhe sabse zyada parwaah hai

options.en: Controlling behaviour, not a sign of love
options.hg: Controlling behaviour, pyaar ka sign nahi

options.en: Only a problem if they are older
options.hg: Sirf problem agar woh bade hon

options.en: Normal trust between partners
options.hg: Partners ke beech normal trust

explain.en: Healthy relationships respect privacy. Demanding passwords, checking phones or constant location-tracking is digital control and can be a sign of an abusive relationship. Talk to someone you trust.
explain.hg: Healthy relationships privacy ki respect karte hain. Passwords maangna, phone check karna ya hamesha location track karna digital control hai aur abusive relationship ka sign ho sakta hai. Kisi trusted insaan se baat karo.

q.en: Your Instagram account has been hacked. What should you do first?
q.hg: Tumhara Instagram account hack ho gaya hai. Pehle kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Reset password, turn on two-step login, warn followers
options.hg: Password reset karo, two-step login on karo, followers ko warn karo

options.en: Make a new account and forget the old one
options.hg: Naya account banao aur purana bhool jao

options.en: Message the hacker and ask them to stop
options.hg: Hacker ko message karke rukne ko kaho

options.en: Wait a week to see if it fixes itself
options.hg: Ek hafta wait karo, shaayad khud theek ho jaaye

explain.en: Use the app's account recovery, set a new strong password, turn on two-step verification and log out unknown devices. Warn friends not to trust messages from your account. Report misuse on cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: App ki account recovery use karo, naya strong password rakho, two-step verification on karo aur anjaan devices logout karo. Doston ko warn karo ki tumhare account ke messages par trust na karein. Misuse cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

q.en: A link says, 'See who viewed your profile! Log in here.' What should you do?
q.hg: Ek link kehta hai, 'Dekho kisne tumhara profile dekha! Yahan login karo.' Kya karoge?

options.en: Forward it to friends to try first
options.hg: Pehle doston ko try karne ke liye bhejo

options.en: Log in, then change your password
options.hg: Login karo, phir password badal lo

options.en: Don't click; it is probably phishing
options.hg: Click mat karo; shaayad phishing hai

options.en: Log in quickly before it expires
options.hg: Expire hone se pehle jaldi login karo

explain.en: Fake login pages steal passwords. Most apps do not show who viewed your profile through outside links. Only log in through the official app, and report suspicious messages.
explain.hg: Fake login pages password churaate hain. Zyada tar apps bahar ke links se profile viewers nahi dikhate. Sirf official app se login karo, aur shak wale messages report karo.

q.en: An unknown number adds you to a group that starts sending sexual pictures. What should you do?
q.hg: Ek anjaan number tumhe group mein add karta hai jisme sexual photos aane lagti hain. Kya karoge?

options.en: Leave, report the group, and tell an adult
options.hg: Group chhodo, report karo, aur bade ko batao

options.en: Stay in it to see what happens next
options.hg: Group mein ruk kar dekho aage kya hota hai

options.en: Add friends so they can see too
options.hg: Doston ko bhi add karo taaki woh dekhein

options.en: Reply and ask them who they are
options.hg: Reply karke poocho woh kaun hain

explain.en: You did nothing wrong by being added. Leave and report the group, don't save or forward anything, and tell a parent or teacher. Change your settings so only contacts can add you to groups.
explain.hg: Add hone mein tumhari koi galti nahi. Group chhodo aur report karo, kuch save ya forward mat karo, aur parents ya teacher ko batao. Settings badlo taaki sirf contacts hi group mein add kar sakein.

q.en: A viral online 'challenge' dares kids to do something risky and post it. What is the smart choice?
q.hg: Ek viral online 'challenge' bachchon ko kuch risky karke post karne ka dare deta hai. Samajhdaari kya hai?

options.en: Do it carefully so you don't get hurt
options.hg: Dhyaan se karo taaki chot na lage

options.en: Skip it and talk to an adult about it
options.hg: Mat karo aur kisi bade se baat karo

options.en: Do it once so you aren't left out
options.hg: Ek baar kar lo taaki peeche na raho

options.en: Dare your friends to do it first
options.hg: Pehle doston ko dare do

explain.en: Some challenges cause real injuries, and the views are not worth it. You can say no to dares online as well as offline. If a challenge worries you, tell a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Kuch challenges se asli chot lagti hai, aur views iske layak nahi. Online bhi dare ko mana kar sakte ho, jaise offline. Koi challenge pareshan kare toh trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: A sextortion target says they feel hopeless and are thinking of hurting themselves. What is the best immediate step?
q.hg: Sextortion ka shikaar insaan kehta hai ki use koi ummeed nahi dikhti aur khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ka soch raha hai. Turant sabse sahi step kya hai?

options.en: Tell them to sleep on it and talk tomorrow
options.hg: Kaho so jao, kal baat karenge

options.en: Tell them to just pay so it ends
options.hg: Kaho bas paise de do taaki khatam ho

options.en: Stay with them and call 14416 or 112 now
options.hg: Unke saath raho aur abhi 14416 ya 112 call karo

options.en: Leave them alone to calm down
options.hg: Shaant hone ke liye akela chhod do

explain.en: Sextortion can feel overwhelming, but it can be dealt with, and no image is worth a life. Stay with them, call Tele-MANAS 14416 or 112 in an emergency, and involve a trusted adult. It is not their fault.
explain.hg: Sextortion bahut bhaari lag sakta hai, par isse nipta ja sakta hai, aur koi image zindagi se badi nahi. Unke saath raho, Tele-MANAS 14416 ya emergency mein 112 call karo, aur kisi trusted bade ko shaamil karo. Galti unki nahi.

q.en: People comment, 'She shouldn't have sent the photo,' after a girl's image is leaked. What is the right response?
q.hg: Ek ladki ki image leak hone par log comment karte hain, 'Use photo bhejni hi nahi chahiye thi.' Sahi response kya hai?

options.en: It's both people's fault, equally shared
options.hg: Dono ki barabar galti hai

options.en: It's nobody's fault, it's just the internet
options.hg: Kisi ki galti nahi, internet hi aisa hai

options.en: The blame lies with whoever shared it without consent
options.hg: Galti us ki hai jisne bina consent share kiya

options.en: They are right; she brought it on herself
options.hg: Woh sahi hain; usne khud musibat bulayi

explain.en: Trusting someone with an image is not a crime; sharing it without consent is. Victim-blaming makes survivors stay silent. Support the person and report the content.
explain.hg: Kisi par trust karke image bhejna crime nahi; bina consent share karna crime hai. Victim-blaming se survivors chup ho jaate hain. Us insaan ka saath do aur content report karo.

q.en: Your 14-year-old admits they are being blackmailed over a photo. What is the most helpful first reaction?
q.hg: Aapka 14 saal ka bachcha batata hai ki ek photo ko lekar use blackmail kiya ja raha hai. Sabse helpful pehla reaction kya hai?

options.en: Pay quickly before anyone finds out
options.hg: Kisi ko pata chale, usse pehle paise de do

options.en: Scold them for sending the photo
options.hg: Photo bhejne ke liye daanto

options.en: Stay calm, thank them, say it's not their fault
options.hg: Shaant raho, thank you bolo, kaho ki galti unki nahi

options.en: Take the phone away as punishment
options.hg: Saza ke taur par phone le lo

explain.en: Children often hide sextortion because they fear punishment. A calm, blame-free response keeps them talking. Then: don't pay, keep the chat, don't forward images, and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Bachche aksar saza ke darr se sextortion chhupate hain. Shaant, bina blame ka response unhe baat karte rehne deta hai. Phir: paise mat do, chat rakho, images forward mat karo, aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

q.en: Which approach best keeps a 10-year-old safe online?
q.hg: 10 saal ke bachche ko online safe rakhne ka sabse achha tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Secretly reading every message without telling
options.hg: Bina bataye chupke se har message padhna

options.en: Parental controls plus regular, calm conversations
options.hg: Parental controls ke saath regular, shaant baatcheet

options.en: Banning all phones and devices until age 18
options.hg: 18 saal tak saare phones aur devices band

options.en: Letting them use any app they like
options.hg: Jo app chahe use karne dena

explain.en: Age-appropriate controls help, but talking matters most: children who feel safe telling a parent about something strange online are better protected. Agree on rules together and review them as they grow.
explain.hg: Umar ke hisaab se controls madad karte hain, par sabse zyada zaroori baatcheet hai: jo bachche online kuch ajeeb hone par parents ko bina darr bata paate hain, woh zyada safe hain. Rules saath mein tay karo aur badhti umar ke saath badlo.

q.en: Which change might suggest a child is distressed by something that happened online?
q.hg: Kaunsa badlaav dikha sakta hai ki bachcha online hui kisi baat se pareshan hai?

options.en: Showing you a funny video they found
options.hg: Aapko mila hua funny video dikhana

options.en: Watching cartoons with siblings on weekends
options.hg: Weekend par bhai-behen ke saath cartoon dekhna

options.en: Asking for help with an online class
options.hg: Online class mein madad maangna

options.en: Hiding or avoiding the phone, plus trouble sleeping
options.hg: Phone chhupana ya usse bachna, aur neend ki dikkat

explain.en: UNICEF lists signs such as distress after being online, unusual secrecy or avoiding devices, sleep and appetite changes, and fear of school. Ask gently and listen without blame.
explain.hg: UNICEF ke bataaye signs: online hone ke baad pareshaani, ajeeb secrecy ya devices se bachna, neend aur bhookh mein badlaav, aur school se darr. Pyaar se poocho aur bina blame ke suno.

q.en: A student tells a teacher that a nude photo of a classmate is circulating. What should the teacher NOT do?
q.hg: Ek student teacher ko batata hai ki ek classmate ki nude photo ghoom rahi hai. Teacher ko kya NAHI karna chahiye?

options.en: Ask students to send the photo to them as evidence
options.hg: Students se saboot ke liye photo khud ko bhejne ko kehna

options.en: Inform the principal and follow the reporting process
options.hg: Principal ko batana aur reporting process follow karna

options.en: Make sure the classmate is supported
options.hg: Classmate ko support milna pakka karna

options.en: Note the group names and who shared it
options.hg: Group ke naam aur kisne share kiya note karna

explain.en: If the classmate is under 18, the image is child sexual abuse material, and collecting it on your own phone is itself an offence. Record where it is and who shared it, and report to the police or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Agar classmate 18 se kam hai, toh image child sexual abuse material hai, aur use apne phone par jama karna khud ek offence hai. Kahan hai aur kisne share kiya, yeh record karo, aur police ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

q.en: An anonymous 'confessions' page at your college posts rumours about students' sex lives. What can students do?
q.hg: College ka ek anonymous 'confessions' page students ki sex life ke baare mein afwahein post karta hai. Students kya kar sakte hain?

options.en: Report the page and posts, and tell the college
options.hg: Page aur posts report karo, aur college ko batao

options.en: Share it widely so it gets taken down
options.hg: Khoob share karo taaki hata diya jaaye

options.en: Ignore it; rumours online are harmless
options.hg: Ignore karo; online afwahein harmless hain

options.en: Post counter-rumours about the admins
options.hg: Admins ke baare mein ulti afwahein post karo

explain.en: Such pages can be harassment and defamation. Report the page and posts on the platform, tell the college's grievance or anti-ragging cell, and report serious cases on cybercrime.gov.in. Support those targeted.
explain.hg: Aise pages harassment aur defamation ho sakte hain. Platform par page aur posts report karo, college ke grievance ya anti-ragging cell ko batao, aur serious cases cybercrime.gov.in par report karo. Jinhe target kiya gaya, unka saath do.

q.en: While you're live-streaming, a stranger offers gifts if you change clothes or do 'a dare'. What should you do?
q.hg: Tum live-stream kar rahe ho aur ek anjaan kapde badalne ya 'ek dare' karne par gifts offer karta hai. Kya karoge?

options.en: Do a small dare to get the gifts
options.hg: Gifts ke liye chhota sa dare kar lo

options.en: End the stream, block, report and tell an adult
options.hg: Stream band karo, block, report karo aur bade ko batao

options.en: Ask them to send the gift first, then decide
options.hg: Pehle gift bhejne ko kaho, phir sochna

options.en: Keep streaming and ignore the comment
options.hg: Stream chalu rakho aur comment ignore karo

explain.en: Strangers sometimes use gifts on live streams to push young people into sexual or risky acts. It's not your fault. End the stream, block and report, and tell a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Anjaan log kabhi live streams par gifts dekar young logon ko sexual ya risky kaam karwane ki koshish karte hain. Tumhari galti nahi. Stream band karo, block aur report karo, aur trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: A stranger in a game keeps sending you free skins and coins. Later he asks for 'a small favour'. What is happening?
q.hg: Game mein ek anjaan tumhe free skins aur coins bhejta rehta hai. Baad mein 'chhota sa favour' maangta hai. Kya ho raha hai?

options.en: He is just a generous, friendly gamer
options.hg: Woh bas ek dildaar, friendly gamer hai

options.en: You must repay him by doing the favour
options.hg: Favour karke badla chukana padega

options.en: Gifts may be used to make you feel you owe him
options.hg: Gifts se tumhe ehsaan-mand feel karaya ja raha hai

options.en: Gifts are normal and mean nothing
options.hg: Gifts normal hain, koi matlab nahi

explain.en: Gifts can be used to create a sense of debt before asking for photos, secrets or meetings. You owe him nothing. Stop chatting, block, report and tell a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Gifts se pehle ehsaan ka bojh banaya jaata hai, phir photos, secrets ya milne ki maang hoti hai. Tum par uska kuch udhaar nahi. Baat band karo, block, report karo aur trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: A torch app asks for access to your contacts, photos and microphone. What is the smartest choice?
q.hg: Ek torch app tumhare contacts, photos aur microphone ka access maangta hai. Sabse samajhdaari kya hai?

options.en: Allow everything so the app works well
options.hg: Sab allow karo taaki app achha chale

options.en: Allow it if it has many downloads
options.hg: Bahut downloads hain toh allow karo

options.en: Allow it if the app looks colourful
options.hg: App colourful dikhe toh allow karo

options.en: Deny what it doesn't need, or uninstall it
options.hg: Jo zaroori nahi woh deny karo, ya uninstall karo

explain.en: A torch does not need your contacts or photos. Extra permissions can leak private data or images. Give apps only what they need, and review permissions in settings regularly.
explain.hg: Torch ko contacts ya photos ki zaroorat nahi. Extra permissions se private data ya images leak ho sakti hain. Apps ko sirf zaroori permissions do, aur settings mein permissions time-time par check karo.

q.en: Two adults exchanged intimate photos consensually. After a fight, one forwards the other's photo to friends. What is true?
q.hg: Do adults ne consent se intimate photos share ki. Ladai ke baad ek ne doosre ki photo doston ko forward kar di. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's legal if only close friends saw it
options.hg: Sirf close friends ne dekhi toh legal hai

options.en: Forwarding without consent can be a crime
options.hg: Bina consent forward karna crime ho sakta hai

options.en: It's legal if the face is not visible
options.hg: Chehra na dikhe toh legal hai

options.en: It's legal because it was sent willingly
options.hg: Khushi se bheji thi toh legal hai

explain.en: Consent to send a photo to one person is not consent to share it. Sharing intimate images without consent can be an offence under the IT Act. The person shown can report on 1930 and use StopNCII.
explain.hg: Ek insaan ko photo bhejne ka consent share karne ka consent nahi hai. Bina consent intimate images share karna IT Act ke under offence ho sakta hai. Jo dikh raha hai woh 1930 par report kar sakta hai aur StopNCII use kar sakta hai.

q.en: You get a voice call that sounds exactly like your cousin, urgently asking for money. What should you do?
q.hg: Ek voice call aati hai jo bilkul tumhare cousin jaisi lagti hai, aur jaldi paise maangti hai. Kya karoge?

options.en: Send the money; the voice is clearly theirs
options.hg: Paise bhej do; awaaz toh unki hi hai

options.en: Share your OTP with them to speed things up
options.hg: Jaldi ke liye unhe apna OTP de do

options.en: Hang up and call your cousin on their usual number
options.hg: Call kaato aur cousin ko unke usual number par call karo

options.en: Send half the money now and half later
options.hg: Aadhe paise abhi, aadhe baad mein bhejo

explain.en: AI can clone voices from short clips. Always verify urgent money requests by calling the person back on a number you already have, or asking a family question. Report fraud on 1930.
explain.hg: AI chhoti clips se awaaz copy kar sakta hai. Paise ki urgent maang ko hamesha us insaan ko apne paas wale number par wapas call karke, ya family wala sawaal poochkar verify karo. Fraud 1930 par report karo.

q.en: An instant-loan app you once installed sends your contacts morphed obscene images of you and demands money. What is true?
q.hg: Ek instant-loan app jo tumne kabhi install kiya tha, tumhare contacts ko tumhari morphed obscene images bhejta hai aur paise maangta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: You must pay now, since the images are already out
options.hg: Images bahar aa chuki hain, ab paise dene padenge

options.en: It's a legal way for lenders to recover a debt
options.hg: Yeh lenders ka karz vasoolne ka legal tareeka hai

options.en: Nothing can be done about morphed images
options.hg: Morphed images ke baare mein kuch nahi ho sakta

options.en: It's extortion; don't pay, warn contacts, report on 1930
options.hg: Yeh extortion hai; paise mat do, contacts ko warn karo, 1930 par report karo

explain.en: Illegal lending apps sometimes morph photos to shame and extort people. It is a crime and not your fault. Don't pay, tell contacts the images are fake, keep evidence, uninstall the app and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Illegal lending apps kabhi photos morph karke logon ko sharminda aur blackmail karte hain. Yeh crime hai aur tumhari galti nahi. Paise mat do, contacts ko batao ki images fake hain, saboot rakho, app uninstall karo aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

q.en: Which of these can count as cyberbullying?
q.hg: In mein se kya cyberbullying ho sakta hai?

options.en: Not replying to a message right away
options.hg: Message ka turant reply na karna

options.en: Repeatedly leaving someone out of a group to hurt them
options.hg: Hurt karne ke liye kisi ko baar-baar group se bahar rakhna

options.en: Disagreeing politely with someone in a comment
options.hg: Comment mein kisi se politely asehmati jataana

options.en: Muting a group that sends too many memes
options.hg: Bahut memes bhejne wale group ko mute karna

explain.en: Cyberbullying is repeated, deliberate hurting online: mean messages, spreading rumours, posting embarrassing images or deliberately excluding someone. Disagreeing politely is not bullying.
explain.hg: Cyberbullying online jaan-boojh kar baar-baar hurt karna hai: gande messages, afwahein failana, sharminda karne wali images daalna ya jaan-boojh kar kisi ko bahar rakhna. Politely asehmat hona bullying nahi.

q.en: Someone posts a rude comment about your body on your photo. What is true?
q.hg: Koi tumhari photo par tumhari body ke baare mein rude comment karta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It says more about them; delete, block and tell someone
options.hg: Isse unke baare mein pata chalta hai; delete, block karo aur kisi ko batao

options.en: You should reply with an even worse insult
options.hg: Tumhe aur bade insult se jawab dena chahiye

options.en: It means you should change how you look
options.hg: Iska matlab tumhe apna look badalna chahiye

options.en: You should stop posting photos forever
options.hg: Hamesha ke liye photos post karna band kar do

explain.en: Body-shaming is a form of bullying. Every body is worth respect. Delete or hide the comment, block and report the account, and talk to someone you trust if it hurts.
explain.hg: Body-shaming bullying ka ek roop hai. Har body respect ke layak hai. Comment delete ya hide karo, account block aur report karo, aur bura lage toh kisi trusted insaan se baat karo.

q.en: Your partner says, 'If you trust me, send a pic.' What is the truth?
q.hg: Tumhara partner kehta hai, 'Trust karti/karte ho toh pic bhejo.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's fine if the picture disappears
options.hg: Picture gayab ho jaaye toh theek hai

options.en: You owe them a picture in return
options.hg: Badle mein tumhe unhe picture deni hi chahiye

options.en: Saying no means you don't love them
options.hg: Mana karna matlab tum pyaar nahi karte

options.en: Pressure is not trust; you can say no
options.hg: Pressure trust nahi; tum mana kar sakte ho

explain.en: Someone who respects you accepts no. Guilt-tripping is pressure. Images of anyone under 18 are illegal to request, keep or share, and if you've been pressured, you are not to blame.
explain.hg: Jo tumhari respect karta hai, woh no accept karta hai. Guilt dilana pressure hai. 18 se kam umar ki images maangna, rakhna ya share karna illegal hai, aur agar tum par pressure daala gaya toh tumhari galti nahi.

q.en: You sent a photo you now regret to someone you were dating. What is a sensible next step?
q.hg: Tumne jisko date kar rahe the use ek photo bheji jiska ab pachhtava hai. Samajhdaari ka agla step kya hai?

options.en: Calmly ask them to delete it and tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Shaanti se delete karne ko kaho aur trusted bade ko batao

options.en: Threaten them so that they delete it quickly
options.hg: Dhamki do taaki woh jaldi delete karein

options.en: Do nothing at all and just hope for the best
options.hg: Kuch mat karo aur bas achhe ki ummeed karo

options.en: Send more photos so they stay happy with you
options.hg: Aur photos bhejo taaki woh tumse khush rahein

explain.en: Regret doesn't make you a bad person. Ask once to delete it, don't send more, keep the chat, and tell a trusted adult. If it's shared or you're threatened, report it; Take It Down helps with images taken under 18.
explain.hg: Pachhtava tumhe bura insaan nahi banata. Ek baar delete karne ko kaho, aur mat bhejo, chat rakho, aur trusted bade ko batao. Share ho ya dhamki mile toh report karo; 18 se pehle li gayi images ke liye Take It Down madad karta hai.

q.en: What makes a screenshot most useful as evidence of online abuse?
q.hg: Online abuse ke saboot ke roop mein screenshot sabse useful kab hota hai?

options.en: It is taken weeks later from memory
options.hg: Hafton baad yaad se banaya gaya ho

options.en: It has stickers to highlight the problem
options.hg: Problem highlight karne ke liye stickers lage hon

options.en: It is cropped to show only the worst word
options.hg: Crop karke sirf sabse bura word dikhe

options.en: It shows the username, message, date and time
options.hg: Usme username, message, date aur time dikhe

explain.en: Uncropped screenshots with the username or profile link, the full message, and the date and time are much stronger evidence. Copy profile URLs too, and keep originals unedited.
explain.hg: Bina crop ke screenshots jinme username ya profile link, poora message, aur date-time ho, kaafi mazboot saboot hote hain. Profile URLs bhi copy karo, aur originals ko edit mat karo.

q.en: A blackmailer is using disappearing messages. How can you keep evidence before the chat vanishes?
q.hg: Blackmailer disappearing messages use kar raha hai. Chat gayab hone se pehle saboot kaise rakhoge?

options.en: Wait for them to send the threats again
options.hg: Unke dobara dhamki bhejne ka wait karo

options.en: Screenshot or screen-record the threats and profile
options.hg: Dhamkiyon aur profile ka screenshot ya screen-record karo

options.en: Reply and ask them to stop disappearing mode
options.hg: Reply karke disappearing mode band karne ko kaho

options.en: Memorise the messages instead of saving them
options.hg: Save karne ki jagah messages yaad kar lo

explain.en: Capture threats, usernames and payment requests as soon as they arrive; if your phone blocks screenshots, photograph the screen with another device. Never capture a sexual image of a minor; describe it instead.
explain.hg: Dhamkiyan, usernames aur payment ki maang aate hi capture karo; phone screenshot block kare toh doosre device se screen ki photo lo. Kisi minor ki sexual image kabhi capture mat karo; uske bajaaye bata do ki kya tha.

q.en: A forward in a group names the girl in a sexual assault case and asks people to share. What should you do?
q.hg: Ek group forward sexual assault case ki ladki ka naam batata hai aur share karne ko kehta hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Share it so that people know the truth
options.hg: Share karo taaki logon ko sach pata chale

options.en: Don't share it; naming a survivor is illegal
options.hg: Share mat karo; survivor ka naam batana illegal hai

options.en: Share it only in your family groups
options.hg: Sirf apne family groups mein share karo

options.en: Share it, but remove the photo first
options.hg: Share karo, par pehle photo hata do

explain.en: Indian law bars revealing the identity of a sexual assault survivor (Section 72 BNS) and of a child victim (POCSO). Sharing it harms them. Don't forward it; ask the group to delete it and report it.
explain.hg: Indian law sexual assault survivor (Section 72 BNS) aur child victim (POCSO) ki pehchaan batane se rokta hai. Share karne se unhe nuksaan hota hai. Forward mat karo; group ko delete karne ko kaho aur report karo.

q.en: Someone angry with a classmate posts her home address and phone number online. What is this called?
q.hg: Classmate se naraz koi uska ghar ka address aur phone number online post kar deta hai. Ise kya kehte hain?

options.en: Free speech that can't be reported
options.hg: Free speech jo report nahi ho sakti

options.en: A harmless prank between classmates
options.hg: Classmates ke beech harmless prank

options.en: Doxxing, a serious form of harassment
options.hg: Doxxing, harassment ka serious roop

options.en: Normal sharing of public information
options.hg: Public jaankari ka normal sharing

explain.en: Posting someone's private details to target them is doxxing and can put them in danger. Report the post, don't share it, tell a trusted adult, and report threats on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Kisi ko target karne ke liye uski private details post karna doxxing hai aur use khatre mein daal sakta hai. Post report karo, share mat karo, trusted bade ko batao, aur dhamkiyan 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

q.en: A player in voice chat keeps abusing and insulting you. What is a good move?
q.hg: Voice chat mein ek player baar-baar gaali aur insult karta hai. Achha step kya hai?

options.en: Abuse them back even louder than them
options.hg: Unse bhi zor se gaali do

options.en: Give them your number to sort it out
options.hg: Suljhaane ke liye apna number do

options.en: Mute and report them; tell an adult if it continues
options.hg: Mute aur report karo; jaari rahe toh bade ko batao

options.en: Keep playing and never say anything about it
options.hg: Khelte raho aur iske baare mein kabhi kuch mat bolo

explain.en: Games have mute, block and report tools for exactly this. Abuse is not your fault. If it continues or turns into threats, tell a parent and keep screenshots or recordings.
explain.hg: Games mein isi ke liye mute, block aur report tools hote hain. Gaali tumhari galti nahi. Jaari rahe ya dhamki ban jaaye, toh parents ko batao aur screenshots ya recordings rakho.

q.en: An Instagram account offers you a 'brand deal' but first wants photos in your underwear 'for sizing'. What is this likely to be?
q.hg: Ek Instagram account 'brand deal' offer karta hai par pehle 'sizing ke liye' underwear mein photos maangta hai. Yeh kya ho sakta hai?

options.en: Safe if the brand has a blue tick
options.hg: Blue tick wala brand ho toh safe

options.en: A trick to get intimate images; refuse and report
options.hg: Intimate images lene ki trick; mana karo aur report karo

options.en: Fine as long as you blur your face
options.hg: Chehra blur karo toh theek

options.en: A normal step for influencer deals
options.hg: Influencer deals ka normal step

explain.en: Real brands don't need underwear photos for sizing. Fake modelling and brand offers are a common route to sextortion. Refuse, block, report and tell someone you trust.
explain.hg: Asli brands ko sizing ke liye underwear photos nahi chahiye. Fake modelling aur brand offers sextortion ka common raasta hain. Mana karo, block, report karo aur kisi trusted insaan ko batao.

q.en: A 'fan' in your DMs sends you money on UPI, then asks for 'cute pics only for him'. What is happening?
q.hg: DMs mein ek 'fan' UPI par paise bhejta hai, phir 'sirf uske liye cute pics' maangta hai. Kya ho raha hai?

options.en: It's fine to send them since he paid first
options.hg: Pehle paise diye toh bhejna theek hai

options.en: He is using money to groom you; stop and tell an adult
options.hg: Woh paison se groom kar raha hai; ruko aur bade ko batao

options.en: He is just a supportive, generous fan
options.hg: Woh bas ek supportive, dildaar fan hai

options.en: You now owe him some pictures in return
options.hg: Ab badle mein tum par pictures ka udhaar hai

explain.en: Money creates a feeling of debt, which groomers use to push for images. You owe nothing. Stop replying, keep the chat and payment details, and tell a trusted adult or call 1098 or 1930.
explain.hg: Paise se ehsaan ka bojh banta hai, jiska groomer images maangne ke liye fayda uthate hain. Tum par koi udhaar nahi. Reply band karo, chat aur payment details rakho, aur trusted bade ko batao ya 1098 ya 1930 call karo.

q.en: Your image has leaked. Should you delete your social media account immediately?
q.hg: Tumhari image leak ho gayi hai. Kya turant social media account delete kar dena chahiye?

options.en: Yes, deleting removes the leaked image everywhere
options.hg: Haan, delete karne se image har jagah se hat jaati hai

options.en: Not before saving evidence; you can deactivate later
options.hg: Saboot save karne se pehle nahi; baad mein deactivate kar sakte ho

options.en: Yes, otherwise people will blame you for it
options.hg: Haan, warna log tumhe hi blame karenge

options.en: Yes, the police prefer deleted accounts
options.hg: Haan, police ko deleted accounts pasand hain

explain.en: Deleting your account does not remove copies elsewhere and can destroy chats and details the police need. Save evidence first, report, then make your account private or deactivate it if you need a break.
explain.hg: Account delete karne se baaki jagah ki copies nahi hatti, aur police ko zaroori chats aur details mit sakti hain. Pehle saboot save karo, report karo, phir break chahiye toh account private ya deactivate karo.

q.en: What is two-step verification?
q.hg: Two-step verification kya hai?

options.en: Having two separate accounts on one app
options.hg: Ek app par do alag accounts rakhna

options.en: Typing your password twice to log in
options.hg: Login ke liye password do baar type karna

options.en: Sharing your password with two friends
options.hg: Password do doston ke saath share karna

options.en: A second check, like a code, after your password
options.hg: Password ke baad ek aur check, jaise ek code

explain.en: Two-step verification asks for a second proof, such as a code from an authenticator app or SMS, so a stolen password alone can't open your account. Never share that code with anyone.
explain.hg: Two-step verification ek doosra saboot maangta hai, jaise authenticator app ya SMS ka code, taaki sirf chori ka password se account na khule. Woh code kabhi kisi ke saath share mat karo.

q.en: A stranger keeps commenting on a classmate's posts with sexual remarks. What can you do as a bystander?
q.hg: Ek anjaan classmate ke posts par baar-baar sexual comments karta hai. Bystander ke roop mein tum kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Like the comments to keep the peace
options.hg: Shaanti ke liye comments like kar do

options.en: Tell your classmate to delete their account
options.hg: Classmate ko account delete karne ko kaho

options.en: Screenshot and post them in a group for laughs
options.hg: Screenshot lekar group mein mazaak ke liye daalo

options.en: Report the comments and check in with your classmate
options.hg: Comments report karo aur classmate ka haal poocho
