explain.en: Online sexual harassment is not 'just comments'. Reporting it and quietly asking your classmate if they're okay helps. They choose whether to block or report further; it is never their fault.
explain.hg: Online sexual harassment 'bas comments' nahi hai. Report karna aur chupke se classmate se poochna ki woh theek hai, madad karta hai. Block ya aage report karna unki marzi; galti kabhi unki nahi.

q.en: Is it okay to share a classmate's embarrassing video 'because everyone has already seen it'?
q.hg: Kya classmate ka sharminda karne wala video share karna theek hai 'kyunki sab dekh chuke hain'?

options.en: Yes, if it's only on your story
options.hg: Haan, agar sirf tumhari story par ho

options.en: Yes, once it's viral it doesn't matter
options.hg: Haan, viral ho gaya toh farak nahi padta

options.en: Yes, if you add a funny caption
options.hg: Haan, agar funny caption daalo

options.en: No, every share hurts them again
options.hg: Nahi, har share unhe phir se hurt karta hai

explain.en: Each share spreads the hurt further and keeps the video alive longer. 'Already viral' is not an excuse. Not sharing, reporting and supporting the person makes a real difference.
explain.hg: Har share dard ko aage failata hai aur video ko zyada din zinda rakhta hai. 'Pehle se viral hai' koi bahaana nahi. Share na karna, report karna aur us insaan ka saath dena asli farak laata hai.

q.en: Your teenage cousin says an online 'girlfriend' is now demanding money or she'll send his photos to his family. What should you advise?
q.hg: Tumhara teenage cousin batata hai ki ek online 'girlfriend' ab paise maang rahi hai warna uski photos family ko bhej degi. Kya salah doge?

options.en: Send more photos so that she stays calm
options.hg: Aur photos bhejo taaki woh shaant rahe

options.en: Pay a small amount now to buy some time
options.hg: Time lene ke liye abhi thode paise de do

options.en: Don't pay or reply; keep evidence and report with an adult
options.hg: Paise mat do, reply mat karo; saboot rakho aur bade ke saath report karo

options.en: Delete everything and hope that she stops
options.hg: Sab delete karo aur ummeed karo ki woh ruk jaaye

explain.en: This is a common sextortion script aimed at teenage boys, often run by organised gangs behind fake profiles. He is not to blame. A trusted adult can help report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in; 1098 can help too.
explain.hg: Yeh teenage ladkon ko target karne wala common sextortion script hai, aksar fake profiles ke peeche organised gangs. Uski galti nahi. Trusted bada 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karne mein madad kar sakta hai; 1098 bhi madad karti hai.

q.en: Your younger brother accidentally shared the family's address in a game chat. What should you do?
q.hg: Tumhare chhote bhai ne galti se game chat mein ghar ka address share kar diya. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Share your own number too, so it's fair
options.hg: Fair rehne ke liye apna number bhi share karo

options.en: Ignore it, because nobody reads game chat
options.hg: Ignore karo, kyunki game chat koi nahi padhta

options.en: Scold him so he never plays online again
options.hg: Daanto taaki woh kabhi online na khele

options.en: Help him delete it, block anyone asking more, tell parents
options.hg: Delete karne mein madad karo, aur sawaal poochne walon ko block karo, parents ko batao

explain.en: Mistakes happen. Delete the message if possible, block anyone asking more questions, and tell a parent so the family can stay alert. Calm help makes him more likely to tell next time.
explain.hg: Galtiyan hoti hain. Ho sake toh message delete karo, aur sawaal poochne walon ko block karo, aur parents ko batao taaki family alert rahe. Shaanti se madad karoge toh agli baar woh zaroor batayega.

q.en: What does 'NCII' stand for in online safety?
q.hg: Online safety mein 'NCII' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Network Control and Internet Inspection
options.hg: Network Control and Internet Inspection

options.en: New Content Identification Initiative
options.hg: New Content Identification Initiative

options.en: Non-consensual intimate imagery
options.hg: Non-consensual intimate imagery

options.en: National Cyber Investigation Index
options.hg: National Cyber Investigation Index

explain.en: NCII means intimate images or videos shared or threatened without the consent of the person shown, including morphed or AI-made ones. StopNCII.org is named after it. It is abuse, never the victim's fault.
explain.hg: NCII matlab intimate images ya videos jo dikhaye gaye insaan ke consent ke bina share ki jaayein ya dhamki di jaaye, morphed ya AI-made bhi. StopNCII.org ka naam isi se hai. Yeh abuse hai, victim ki galti kabhi nahi.

q.en: Why do experts say parents should not punish a child who reports online abuse by taking away their phone?
q.hg: Experts kyun kehte hain ki online abuse batane wale bachche ka phone saza ke taur par nahi chheenna chahiye?

options.en: Taking a child's phone away is illegal
options.hg: Bachche ka phone chheenna illegal hai

options.en: Phones are always good for growing children
options.hg: Phone badhte bachchon ke liye hamesha achha hai

options.en: Children may stop telling if it means losing the phone
options.hg: Batane par phone chhin jaaye toh bachche batana band kar sakte hain

options.en: It makes no real difference either way
options.hg: Isse koi khaas farak nahi padta

explain.en: Fear of losing devices is a major reason children hide grooming and sextortion. Make it clear that telling never leads to punishment. Adjust rules later, together, if needed.
explain.hg: Device chhin jaane ka darr ek badi wajah hai ki bachche grooming aur sextortion chhupate hain. Saaf kaho ki batane par kabhi saza nahi milegi. Zaroorat ho toh rules baad mein, saath mein badlo.

q.en: Someone threatens to share your images unless you send more. You're scared to tell your parents. What is true?
q.hg: Koi dhamki deta hai ki aur images nahi bheji toh tumhari images share kar dega. Tumhe parents ko batane se darr lagta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Telling an adult early makes it much easier to handle
options.hg: Jaldi kisi bade ko batane se yeh kaafi aasaan ho jaata hai

options.en: Sending more will finally make them stop
options.hg: Aur bhejne se woh aakhir ruk jaayenge

options.en: You have to deal with it all by yourself
options.hg: Tumhe yeh sab akele hi nipatna hoga

options.en: Once you've shared once, you have no rights
options.hg: Ek baar share kiya toh koi haq nahi

explain.en: Blackmailers rely on fear and secrecy. Sending more never ends it. If parents feel hard to tell, choose another trusted adult, or call 1098 or 1930. You are the victim of a crime, not the one at fault.
explain.hg: Blackmailers darr aur secrecy par chalte hain. Aur bhejne se yeh kabhi khatam nahi hota. Parents ko batana mushkil lage toh kisi aur trusted bade ko chuno, ya 1098 ya 1930 call karo. Tum crime ke victim ho, galti tumhari nahi.

q.en: Under Section 67B of the IT Act, which of these is an offence?
q.hg: IT Act ke Section 67B ke under in mein se kya offence hai?

options.en: Using parental controls on a child's phone
options.hg: Bachche ke phone par parental controls lagana

options.en: Teaching children about online safety
options.hg: Bachchon ko online safety sikhana

options.en: Reporting abuse material to cybercrime.gov.in
options.hg: Abuse material ko cybercrime.gov.in par report karna

options.en: Enticing a child into an online sexual relationship
options.hg: Kisi bachche ko online sexual relationship mein phansana

explain.en: Section 67B covers creating, collecting, browsing, downloading or sharing child sexual abuse material, and also enticing children into online sexual relationships, with up to five years in jail on first conviction.
explain.hg: Section 67B child sexual abuse material banana, jama karna, browse, download ya share karna, aur bachchon ko online sexual relationships mein phansana cover karta hai, pehli baar mein paanch saal tak jail ke saath.

q.en: A classmate is being targeted with hateful memes in a group. You're worried about becoming the next target. What is a safe way to help?
q.hg: Ek classmate ko group mein nafrat bhare memes se target kiya ja raha hai. Tumhe darr hai agla number tumhara na ho. Madad ka safe tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Argue with the bullies in the group chat
options.hg: Group chat mein bullies se behas karo

options.en: Join in so the bullies leave you alone
options.hg: Shaamil ho jao taaki bullies tumhe chhod dein

options.en: Do nothing, because helping is too risky
options.hg: Kuch mat karo, kyunki madad karna bahut risky hai

options.en: Report it quietly and message the classmate privately
options.hg: Chupke se report karo aur classmate ko private message karo

explain.en: You don't have to confront anyone publicly. Quiet reporting, saving screenshots for a teacher, and a kind private message are safe and powerful ways to help.
explain.hg: Public mein kisi se ladna zaroori nahi. Chupke se report karna, teacher ke liye screenshots rakhna, aur pyaara private message, yeh safe aur asardaar tareeke hain.

q.en: A parent finds out their teenager has been sharing images with an online 'friend' who turned out to be an adult. What should the parent do?
q.hg: Parents ko pata chalta hai ki unka teenager ek online 'dost' ke saath images share kar raha tha jo asal mein adult nikla. Parents ko kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Reassure the teen, keep the chats and report it
options.hg: Teen ko bharosa do, chats rakho aur report karo

options.en: Contact the adult and demand an apology
options.hg: Adult se sampark karke maafi maango

options.en: Punish the teen first, report later
options.hg: Pehle teen ko saza do, report baad mein

options.en: Delete the chats to protect the family name
options.hg: Family ki izzat ke liye chats delete karo

explain.en: The adult committed a serious offence; the teen is a victim. Keep usernames and chats without forwarding any images, report on cybercrime.gov.in or 1930 or to the police, and use Take It Down to limit spread.
explain.hg: Adult ne serious offence kiya hai; teen victim hai. Images forward kiye bina usernames aur chats rakho, cybercrime.gov.in, 1930 ya police par report karo, aur failne se rokne ke liye Take It Down use karo.

q.en: Which is the strongest password?
q.hg: Kaunsa password sabse strong hai?

options.en: Your pet's name, the same for every app
options.hg: Pet ka naam, har app ke liye same

options.en: A long phrase like 'MangoBus!Rain42Tiger'
options.hg: Lamba phrase jaise 'MangoBus!Rain42Tiger'

options.en: Your name followed by your birth year
options.hg: Tumhara naam aur uske baad birth year

options.en: '123456' because it's easy to remember
options.hg: '123456' kyunki yaad rehta hai

explain.en: Long, unique passphrases are hard to guess. Names, birthdays and simple numbers are guessed first. Use a different password for each important account.
explain.hg: Lambe, unique passphrases guess karna mushkil hai. Naam, birthday aur simple numbers sabse pehle guess hote hain. Har important account ka alag password rakho.

q.en: Someone you don't know sends a friend request with mutual friends listed. Does that make them safe?
q.hg: Ek anjaan insaan friend request bhejta hai aur mutual friends dikh rahe hain. Kya isse woh safe ho jaata hai?

options.en: Yes, if their profile has a nice photo
options.hg: Haan, agar profile photo achhi ho

options.en: Yes, mutual friends prove they are real
options.hg: Haan, mutual friends saboot hain ki woh asli hai

options.en: No, fake accounts often add many people to look real
options.hg: Nahi, fake accounts asli dikhne ke liye bahut logon ko add karte hain

options.en: Yes, if there are more than five mutuals
options.hg: Haan, agar paanch se zyada mutuals hon

explain.en: Fake and predatory accounts add many people so they look trustworthy. Ask your friends if they actually know the person in real life before accepting.
explain.hg: Fake aur predatory accounts bahut logon ko add karte hain taaki trusted lagein. Accept karne se pehle doston se poocho ki kya woh us insaan ko asal mein jaante hain.

q.en: A friend secretly installed a tracking app on your phone 'to keep you safe'. What best describes this?
q.hg: Ek dost ne 'tumhe safe rakhne ke liye' chupke se tumhare phone par tracking app daal diya. Ise kya kahenge?

options.en: A caring gesture you should thank them for
options.hg: Pyaar bhara kadam jiske liye thank you bolna chahiye

options.en: Normal behaviour between close friends
options.hg: Close friends ke beech normal behaviour

options.en: Fine as long as they never misuse it
options.hg: Theek hai jab tak woh misuse na karein

options.en: A violation of your privacy, done without consent
options.hg: Bina consent tumhari privacy ka ullanghan

explain.en: Secretly tracking someone's phone is surveillance, not care, and can be part of stalking or abuse. Remove the app, change passwords, and talk to someone you trust; report if it continues.
explain.hg: Chupke se kisi ka phone track karna nigraani hai, parwaah nahi, aur stalking ya abuse ka hissa ho sakta hai. App hatao, passwords badlo, aur kisi trusted insaan se baat karo; jaari rahe toh report karo.

q.en: Which is true about a sexual image of a 16-year-old that their partner forwards to friends?
q.hg: 16 saal ke kisi ki sexual image, jo uska partner doston ko forward karta hai, uske baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: It becomes legal once it has been forwarded
options.hg: Forward hone ke baad legal ho jaata hai

options.en: Only the person in the image can be punished
options.hg: Sirf image wale ko saza ho sakti hai

options.en: It counts as child sexual abuse material; sharing is a crime
options.hg: Yeh child sexual abuse material hai; share karna crime hai

options.en: It is fine because they are the same age
options.hg: Theek hai kyunki dono hum-umar hain

explain.en: Sexual images of anyone under 18 are treated as child sexual abuse material, and sharing them is a serious offence. The person shown is a victim. Report it on cybercrime.gov.in with a trusted adult and use Take It Down.
explain.hg: 18 se kam umar ke kisi ki sexual images child sexual abuse material maani jaati hain, aur share karna serious offence hai. Image wala insaan victim hai. Trusted bade ke saath cybercrime.gov.in par report karo aur Take It Down use karo.

q.en: You see a message that says, 'Forward this to 10 people or something bad will happen.' What should you do?
q.hg: Ek message aata hai, '10 logon ko forward karo warna kuch bura hoga.' Kya karoge?

options.en: Forward it just to be on the safe side
options.hg: Safe side par rehne ke liye forward kar do

options.en: Ignore it; such chain messages are fake
options.hg: Ignore karo; aise chain messages fake hote hain

options.en: Forward it to only five people
options.hg: Sirf paanch logon ko forward karo

options.en: Reply to the sender in panic
options.hg: Ghabra kar bhejne wale ko reply karo

explain.en: Chain messages use fear to spread. Nothing happens if you don't forward them. If one frightens a younger child, reassure them and tell them they can always ask an adult.
explain.hg: Chain messages darr se failte hain. Forward na karne se kuch nahi hota. Agar koi chhote bachche ko daraaye, toh use bharosa do aur batao ki woh hamesha bade se pooch sakta hai.

q.en: An older student offers to 'help you get famous' online but says you must send him private photos first. What is the best response?
q.hg: Ek senior online 'famous banane mein madad' offer karta hai par kehta hai pehle private photos bhejo. Sabse sahi response kya hai?

options.en: Send old photos instead of new ones
options.hg: Naye ki jagah purani photos bhejo

options.en: Send one photo to test his promise
options.hg: Uska promise test karne ke liye ek photo bhejo

options.en: Agree if he's a senior from your school
options.hg: Haan bolo agar woh tumhare school ka senior hai

options.en: Refuse, save the chat and tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Mana karo, chat save karo aur trusted bade ko batao

explain.en: Promises of fame, followers or modelling in exchange for private photos are manipulation. You don't need to send anything. Save the chat and tell a parent, teacher or 1098.
explain.hg: Private photos ke badle fame, followers ya modelling ke vaade manipulation hain. Tumhe kuch bhejne ki zaroorat nahi. Chat save karo aur parents, teacher ya 1098 ko batao.

q.en: What is the difference between 'sex' and 'gender'?
q.hg: 'Sex' aur 'gender' mein kya farak hai?

options.en: Gender is a word that is used only for women
options.hg: Gender shabd sirf mahilaon ke liye use hota hai

options.en: Sex is about the body; gender is about identity and social roles
options.hg: Sex body ki baat hai; gender identity aur samaaj ke roles ki

options.en: Sex is chosen later; gender is fixed by the doctor
options.hg: Sex baad mein chuna jaata hai; gender doctor tay karta hai

options.en: They mean exactly the same thing in every situation
options.hg: Har situation mein dono ka matlab bilkul same hai

explain.en: Sex refers to body characteristics like chromosomes, hormones and anatomy. Gender is about a person's inner identity and the roles and expectations society attaches to being a man or a woman.
explain.hg: Sex body ki cheezon ki baat hai jaise chromosomes, hormones aur anatomy. Gender insaan ki andar ki pehchaan aur un roles aur ummeedon ki baat hai jo samaaj aadmi ya aurat hone se jodta hai.

q.en: Which of these is a gender stereotype, not a fact?
q.hg: Inme se kaunsi baat gender stereotype hai, fact nahi?

options.en: Babies need care and feeding
options.hg: Babies ko dekhbhaal aur khaana chahiye

options.en: 'Boys should not cry'
options.hg: 'Ladke rote nahi'

options.en: People of all genders feel emotions
options.hg: Har gender ke log emotions feel karte hain

options.en: Everyone needs sleep to stay healthy
options.hg: Healthy rehne ke liye sabko neend chahiye

explain.en: A stereotype is a fixed idea about what a group 'should' be like. Crying is a normal human response for everyone; telling boys to hide it can harm their mental health.
explain.hg: Stereotype ek fixed soch hai ki koi group 'kaisa hona chahiye'. Rona sabke liye normal hai; ladkon ko ise chhupane ko kehna unki mental health ko nuksaan de sakta hai.

q.en: Your brother wants to learn cooking. An uncle laughs and says, 'Kitchen is for girls.' What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara bhai cooking seekhna chahta hai. Ek chacha hans ke bolte hain, 'Kitchen ladkiyon ke liye hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: The uncle is right; boys shouldn't cook
options.hg: Chacha sahi hain; ladkon ko cook nahi karna chahiye

options.en: Boys may cook only as hotel chefs
options.hg: Ladke sirf hotel chef ban ke cook kar sakte hain

options.en: Cooking is a life skill for everyone
options.hg: Cooking sabke liye ek life skill hai

options.en: Boys should cook only if no girl is home
options.hg: Ladke tabhi cook karein jab ghar mein koi ladki na ho

explain.en: Everyone needs to eat, so everyone can learn to cook. Skills are not assigned by gender, and boys who share home tasks grow into more capable, fairer adults.
explain.hg: Khaana sabko chahiye, toh cooking sab seekh sakte hain. Skills gender se tay nahi hoti, aur jo ladke ghar ke kaam baant-te hain woh zyada capable aur fair adults bante hain.

q.en: Who should share household chores like washing dishes and sweeping?
q.hg: Bartan dhona, jhaadu lagana jaise ghar ke kaam kaun baante?

options.en: Only the daughters, to train them
options.hg: Sirf betiyan, unki training ke liye

options.en: Only the mother, as it is her job
options.hg: Sirf mummy, kyunki yeh unka kaam hai

options.en: Only a paid helper, if there is one
options.hg: Sirf paid helper, agar ho toh

options.en: Everyone in the family who is able to
options.hg: Family ka har woh insaan jo kar sakta hai

explain.en: A home belongs to everyone who lives in it, so the work does too. Sharing chores by ability, not by gender, is fair and teaches responsibility.
explain.hg: Ghar sabka hai jo usme rehte hain, toh kaam bhi sabka hai. Gender ke bajaye kaabiliyat ke hisaab se kaam baantna fair hai aur zimmedari sikhaata hai.

q.en: A 2014 ICRW-UNFPA study in seven Indian states found that men raised in families where fathers did household chores were…
q.hg: 2014 ki ICRW-UNFPA study ne 7 Indian states mein paaya ki jin aadmiyon ke ghar mein papa ghar ke kaam karte the, woh…

options.en: No different from men whose fathers did no chores
options.hg: Un aadmiyon se alag nahi the jinke papa ghar ka kaam nahi karte the

options.en: Less likely to have a paid job as adults
options.hg: Bade hoke paid job hone ki kam sambhavna rakhte the

options.en: More likely to be violent towards their partners
options.hg: Partners ke saath violent hone ki zyada sambhavna rakhte the

options.en: Two times more likely to hold gender-equal attitudes
options.hg: Gender-equal soch rakhne ki do guna zyada sambhavna rakhte the

explain.en: Children learn from what they see. The same study found that families where parents made decisions jointly were 1.4 times more likely to raise gender-equitable men.
explain.hg: Bachche jo dekhte hain wahi seekhte hain. Isi study mein paaya gaya ki jin families mein parents milke faisle lete the, wahan gender-equal aadmi banne ki sambhavna 1.4 guna zyada thi.

q.en: Meera loves fixing bikes and wants to be a mechanic. Some classmates laugh, 'That's a boys' job.' What is true?
q.hg: Meera ko bikes theek karna pasand hai aur woh mechanic banna chahti hai. Kuch classmates hanste hain, 'Yeh ladkon ka kaam hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: She should choose a 'softer' career
options.hg: Use koi 'naram' career chunna chahiye

options.en: Girls are not strong enough for machines
options.hg: Ladkiyan machines ke liye strong nahi hoti

options.en: Any job can be done by anyone with the skill
options.hg: Koi bhi kaam koi bhi kar sakta hai jiske paas skill ho

options.en: Only if her family has no sons
options.hg: Sirf agar family mein koi beta na ho

explain.en: Careers are about interest, training and skill, not gender. Laughing at someone's dream is a kind of bullying that stops talent from growing.
explain.hg: Career interest, training aur skill ki baat hai, gender ki nahi. Kisi ke sapne pe hansna ek tarah ki bullying hai jo talent ko badhne se rokti hai.

q.en: Kabir wants to become a nursery school teacher. A relative says, 'Men don't do that.' What is the best response?
q.hg: Kabir nursery school teacher banna chahta hai. Ek rishtedaar kehte hain, 'Aadmi yeh kaam nahi karte.' Sabse accha jawab kya hai?

options.en: He should pick an engineering job instead
options.hg: Use engineering job chunni chahiye

options.en: He can teach only older students
options.hg: Woh sirf bade students ko padha sakta hai

options.en: Caring for children is valuable work for any gender
options.hg: Bachchon ki dekhbhaal kisi bhi gender ke liye valuable kaam hai

options.en: Men are not patient enough for children
options.hg: Aadmiyon mein bachchon ke liye patience nahi hota

explain.en: Patience and care are human qualities, not female ones. Children benefit from caring adults of every gender, including male teachers.
explain.hg: Patience aur care insaani gun hain, sirf mahilaon ke nahi. Bachchon ko har gender ke caring adults se fayda hota hai, male teachers se bhi.

q.en: Are colours like pink and blue meant for a particular gender?
q.hg: Kya pink aur blue jaise colours kisi khaas gender ke liye hote hain?

options.en: Only until the age of ten
options.hg: Sirf das saal ki umar tak

options.en: Yes, blue is only for boys
options.hg: Haan, blue sirf ladkon ke liye

options.en: No, any colour is for anyone
options.hg: Nahi, koi bhi colour kisi ke liye bhi hai

options.en: Yes, pink is only for girls
options.hg: Haan, pink sirf ladkiyon ke liye

explain.en: Colours have no gender. Ideas like 'pink for girls' are habits that shops and ads repeat, and they change over time and between cultures.
explain.hg: Colours ka koi gender nahi hota. 'Pink ladkiyon ke liye' jaisi soch dukaanon aur ads ki aadat hai, aur yeh time aur culture ke saath badalti rehti hai.

q.en: Can boys play with dolls and girls play cricket?
q.hg: Kya ladke gudiyon se aur ladkiyan cricket khel sakti hain?

options.en: Yes, toys and games are for everyone
options.hg: Haan, khilaune aur games sabke liye hain

options.en: Only at home, never in public
options.hg: Sirf ghar pe, bahar kabhi nahi

options.en: Only if their parents play too
options.hg: Sirf agar parents bhi khelein

options.en: No, it will confuse them
options.hg: Nahi, isse woh confuse ho jaayenge

explain.en: Play builds skills: dolls teach caring and storytelling, sports teach teamwork and strength. Every child deserves to build all of these.
explain.hg: Khel se skills banti hain: gudiyan care aur kahani sikhati hain, sports teamwork aur taakat. Har bachche ko yeh sab seekhne ka haq hai.

q.en: A boy in your class is crying after losing a match. Someone says, 'Be a man!' What is the best response?
q.hg: Match haarne ke baad tumhari class ka ek ladka ro raha hai. Koi bolta hai, 'Mard ban!' Sabse accha jawab kya hai?

options.en: Real men never show sadness
options.hg: Asli mard kabhi dukh nahi dikhate

options.en: Crying is fine only for small kids
options.hg: Rona sirf chhote bachchon ke liye theek hai

options.en: Crying is a healthy way to show feelings
options.hg: Rona feelings dikhane ka healthy tareeka hai

options.en: He should hide it till he gets home
options.hg: Use ghar pahunchne tak chhupana chahiye

explain.en: Feelings are human, not 'girly'. Boys who are allowed to express sadness cope better, while bottling it up can turn into anger or loneliness.
explain.hg: Feelings insaani hain, 'ladkiyon wali' nahi. Jin ladkon ko dukh dikhane diya jaata hai woh behtar sambhalte hain, aur andar dabane se gussa ya akelapan badh sakta hai.

q.en: What do people mean by 'harmful' or 'toxic' masculinity?
q.hg: Log 'harmful' ya 'toxic' masculinity kehte hain toh unka matlab kya hota hai?

options.en: Pressure on boys to be tough, dominant and hide feelings
options.hg: Ladkon pe sakht, dominant banne aur feelings chhupane ka pressure

options.en: Any man who plays a rough contact sport
options.hg: Koi bhi aadmi jo rough contact sport khelta hai

options.en: Men naturally having male hormones like testosterone
options.hg: Aadmiyon mein naturally testosterone jaise male hormones hona

options.en: The idea that all men are bad by nature
options.hg: Yeh soch ki saare aadmi fitrat se bure hain

explain.en: It is not about men being bad; it is about narrow rules like 'never cry', 'always win', 'control women'. These rules hurt boys and men themselves as well as the people around them.
explain.hg: Yeh aadmiyon ko bura kehna nahi hai; yeh 'kabhi mat ro', 'hamesha jeeto', 'aurton ko control karo' jaise tang rules ki baat hai. Yeh rules khud ladkon aur aadmiyon ko aur unke aas-paas walon ko nuksaan dete hain.

q.en: Asking for help when you are struggling is a sign of…
q.hg: Mushkil mein madad maangna kis baat ki nishaani hai?

options.en: Strength and good sense
options.hg: Himmat aur samajhdaari ki

options.en: Laziness about solving problems
options.hg: Problems solve karne mein aalas ki

options.en: Weakness, especially for boys
options.hg: Kamzori ki, khaas kar ladkon ke liye

options.en: Wanting attention from others
options.hg: Doosron ka attention chahne ki

explain.en: Everyone needs support sometimes. Recognising that and reaching out to a trusted person, a counsellor or a helpline takes courage, whatever your gender.
explain.hg: Kabhi na kabhi sabko support chahiye. Yeh samajhna aur kisi bharosemand insaan, counsellor ya helpline tak pahunchna himmat ka kaam hai, gender kuch bhi ho.

q.en: A male friend, 19, has felt low for weeks but says, 'Men don't need therapy.' What can you tell him?
q.hg: Tumhara 19 saal ka dost hafton se udaas hai par kehta hai, 'Mardon ko therapy ki zaroorat nahi.' Tum use kya bata sakte ho?

options.en: Talking helps, and Tele-MANAS 14416 is free for anyone
options.hg: Baat karne se madad milti hai, aur Tele-MANAS 14416 sabke liye free hai

options.en: He should just go to the gym and forget it
options.hg: Bas gym jaaye aur bhool jaaye

options.en: Therapy is only for serious mental illness
options.hg: Therapy sirf gambhir mental illness ke liye hai

options.en: He is right, men should handle it alone
options.hg: Woh sahi hai, mard khud sambhalte hain

explain.en: Tele-MANAS (14416) is the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline for anyone in need. Feeling low for weeks deserves attention, and reaching out is a strong step.
explain.hg: Tele-MANAS (14416) Health Ministry ki free, 24 ghante wali mental-health helpline hai, har kisi ke liye. Hafton tak udaas rehna dhyaan dene layak hai, aur madad maangna ek strong kadam hai.

q.en: What does 'gender identity' mean?
q.hg: 'Gender identity' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: The sex written on a birth certificate
options.hg: Birth certificate pe likha sex

options.en: Who a person is romantically attracted to
options.hg: Insaan romantically kisse attract hota hai

options.en: The kind of clothes a person wears
options.hg: Insaan kis tarah ke kapde pehenta hai

options.en: A person's inner sense of their own gender
options.hg: Insaan ka andar ka ehsaas ki uska gender kya hai

explain.en: Gender identity is how you know yourself inside. It may or may not match the sex recorded at birth, and it is different from sexual orientation, which is about attraction.
explain.hg: Gender identity yeh hai ki tum andar se khud ko kaise jaante ho. Yeh birth pe likhe sex se match kare ya na kare, aur yeh sexual orientation se alag hai, jo attraction ki baat hai.

q.en: What does 'sexual orientation' describe?
q.hg: 'Sexual orientation' kya batata hai?

options.en: Whether a person feels like a man or a woman
options.hg: Insaan khud ko aadmi feel karta hai ya aurat

options.en: How a person was brought up by parents
options.hg: Parents ne kaise paala

options.en: Who a person is romantically or sexually attracted to
options.hg: Insaan romantically ya sexually kisse attract hota hai

options.en: Which career a person prefers
options.hg: Insaan ko kaunsa career pasand hai

explain.en: Orientation is about attraction: for example to a different gender, the same gender, more than one gender, or little or none. It is separate from gender identity.
explain.hg: Orientation attraction ki baat hai: jaise doosre gender, same gender, ek se zyada gender, ya bahut kam ya bilkul nahi. Yeh gender identity se alag hai.

q.en: What does 'transgender' mean?
q.hg: 'Transgender' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Someone attracted to people of the same gender
options.hg: Jo same gender ke logon se attract ho

options.en: Someone whose gender identity differs from their sex at birth
options.hg: Jiski gender identity birth pe diye gaye sex se alag ho

options.en: Someone who dresses up for a costume party
options.hg: Jo costume party ke liye kapde badle

options.en: Someone who was born with a contagious illness
options.hg: Jo kisi failne wali bimari ke saath paida hua ho

explain.en: A transgender person's gender identity is different from the sex they were assigned at birth. Being transgender is about who you are, not who you are attracted to, and it is not an illness.
explain.hg: Transgender insaan ki gender identity birth pe diye gaye sex se alag hoti hai. Transgender hona tum kaun ho uski baat hai, tum kisse attract ho uski nahi, aur yeh bimari nahi hai.

q.en: What does 'non-binary' mean?
q.hg: 'Non-binary' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Someone who is not interested in computers
options.hg: Jise computers mein interest nahi

options.en: A gender identity that is not only man or only woman
options.hg: Aisi gender identity jo sirf aadmi ya sirf aurat nahi

options.en: A person who has not decided a career yet
options.hg: Jisne abhi career tay nahi kiya

options.en: Just another word for being bisexual
options.hg: Bas bisexual hone ka doosra naam

explain.en: Some people's gender identity falls outside the two boxes of 'man' and 'woman'. Non-binary describes identity, not attraction, so it is different from bisexual.
explain.hg: Kuch logon ki gender identity 'aadmi' aur 'aurat' ke do dabbon se bahar hoti hai. Non-binary identity ki baat hai, attraction ki nahi, isliye yeh bisexual se alag hai.

q.en: What is 'gender expression'?
q.hg: 'Gender expression' kya hai?

options.en: How someone shows gender through looks and behaviour
options.hg: Looks aur vyavhaar se gender dikhane ka tareeka

options.en: The gender printed on an Aadhaar card
options.hg: Aadhaar card pe chhapa gender

options.en: Who a person falls in love with in life
options.hg: Zindagi mein insaan kisse pyaar karta hai

options.en: A person's chromosomes and hormones
options.hg: Insaan ke chromosomes aur hormones

explain.en: Expression is the outside style a person chooses, and it can vary from day to day. It does not tell you someone's identity or orientation.
explain.hg: Expression woh bahari style hai jo insaan chunta hai, aur yeh roz badal bhi sakta hai. Isse kisi ki identity ya orientation pata nahi chalti.

q.en: A boy in your class likes wearing kajal and nail polish. Does that tell you his sexual orientation?
q.hg: Tumhari class ke ek ladke ko kajal aur nail polish lagana pasand hai. Kya isse uski sexual orientation pata chalti hai?

options.en: Yes, but only if he also dances
options.hg: Haan, par sirf agar woh dance bhi kare

options.en: No, how someone dresses doesn't reveal orientation
options.hg: Nahi, kaise koi sajta hai isse orientation pata nahi chalti

options.en: Yes, it clearly shows he is gay
options.hg: Haan, saaf dikhta hai ki woh gay hai

options.en: Yes, it means he wants to be a girl
options.hg: Haan, iska matlab woh ladki banna chahta hai

explain.en: Style is gender expression. Orientation and identity are different things, and the only person who can tell you about them is the person themselves, if they choose to.
explain.hg: Style gender expression hai. Orientation aur identity alag cheezein hain, aur unke baare mein sirf woh insaan khud bata sakta hai, agar woh chahe.

q.en: What does LGBTQ+ stand for?
q.hg: LGBTQ+ ka poora matlab kya hai?

options.en: The short name of a political party
options.hg: Ek political party ka short naam

options.en: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and more
options.hg: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer aur bhi

options.en: Laws for gender-based treatment of queers
options.hg: Queers ke gender-based treatment ke laws

options.en: A medical list of hormone disorders
options.hg: Hormone disorders ki medical list

explain.en: LGBTQ+ is an umbrella term for people of diverse sexual orientations and gender identities. The '+' includes others such as intersex and asexual people.
explain.hg: LGBTQ+ alag-alag sexual orientations aur gender identities wale logon ke liye ek umbrella term hai. '+' mein aur log bhi aate hain jaise intersex aur asexual.

q.en: What does 'bisexual' mean?
q.hg: 'Bisexual' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Being confused and unable to decide
options.hg: Confused hona aur decide na kar paana

options.en: Having two partners at the same time
options.hg: Ek saath do partners hona

options.en: Being attracted to more than one gender
options.hg: Ek se zyada gender ke logon se attract hona

options.en: Having two gender identities at once
options.hg: Ek saath do gender identities hona

explain.en: Bisexual describes attraction to more than one gender. It is a real orientation, not confusion or a phase, and it says nothing about how many partners someone has.
explain.hg: Bisexual ek se zyada gender ke prati attraction batata hai. Yeh asli orientation hai, confusion ya phase nahi, aur isse yeh pata nahi chalta ki kisi ke kitne partners hain.

q.en: What does 'asexual' mean?
q.hg: 'Asexual' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Having a hormone problem to treat
options.hg: Hormone ki problem jiska ilaaj chahiye

options.en: Being too young to have crushes
options.hg: Crush ke liye bahut chhota hona

options.en: Feeling little or no sexual attraction to others
options.hg: Doosron ke prati bahut kam ya bilkul sexual attraction na hona

options.en: Being unable to love anyone
options.hg: Kisi se bhi pyaar na kar paana

explain.en: Asexual people feel little or no sexual attraction. Many still have deep friendships and romantic relationships. It is an orientation, not an illness.
explain.hg: Asexual logon ko bahut kam ya bilkul sexual attraction nahi hota. Kai log phir bhi gehri dosti aur romantic rishte rakhte hain. Yeh orientation hai, bimari nahi.

q.en: What does it mean if someone is intersex?
q.hg: Agar koi intersex hai toh iska matlab kya hai?

options.en: Their chromosomes, hormones or anatomy vary from typical
options.hg: Unke chromosomes, hormones ya anatomy typical se alag hain

options.en: They have chosen to change their gender
options.hg: Unhone apna gender badalne ka faisla kiya

options.en: They are attracted to people of all genders
options.hg: Woh sab genders ke logon se attract hote hain

options.en: They caught an infection in the womb before birth
options.hg: Unhe paida hone se pehle pet mein infection hua

explain.en: Intersex variations are natural differences in sex characteristics such as chromosomes, hormones or anatomy. They are about the body, not identity or attraction, and they are nobody's fault.
explain.hg: Intersex variations sex characteristics mein natural fark hain, jaise chromosomes, hormones ya anatomy. Yeh body ki baat hai, identity ya attraction ki nahi, aur isme kisi ki galti nahi.

q.en: Is being gay or lesbian a mental illness?
q.hg: Kya gay ya lesbian hona mental illness hai?

options.en: Yes, but only in adults
options.hg: Haan, par sirf adults mein

options.en: Yes, and it can be cured with medicine
options.hg: Haan, aur dawai se theek ho sakta hai

options.en: Only if the person is unhappy about it
options.hg: Sirf agar insaan isse dukhi ho

options.en: No, it is a natural variation in human attraction
options.hg: Nahi, yeh insaani attraction ka natural roop hai

explain.en: Being lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, asexual or intersex is not an illness. Stress some LGBTQ+ people feel usually comes from stigma and rejection, not from who they are.
explain.hg: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, asexual ya intersex hona bimari nahi hai. Kuch LGBTQ+ log jo stress feel karte hain woh aksar stigma aur rejection se aata hai, unki pehchaan se nahi.

q.en: Is being transgender a mental illness?
q.hg: Kya transgender hona mental illness hai?

options.en: Only if it starts after age 18
options.hg: Sirf agar 18 ke baad shuru ho

options.en: Yes, it needs to be treated away
options.hg: Haan, ise ilaaj se hataana chahiye

options.en: Yes, it is caused by bad parenting
options.hg: Haan, yeh galat parvarish se hota hai

options.en: No, it is part of human diversity
options.hg: Nahi, yeh insaani vividhata ka hissa hai

explain.en: Being transgender is not an illness. Health care can support trans people who want it, but attempts to 'change' someone's gender identity are harmful.
explain.hg: Transgender hona bimari nahi hai. Health care trans logon ka saath de sakti hai agar woh chahein, par kisi ki gender identity ko 'badalne' ki koshish nuksaan karti hai.

q.en: A relative suggests 'treatment' to make a gay cousin straight. What is true?
q.hg: Ek rishtedaar suggest karte hain ki gay cousin ko straight banane ke liye 'ilaaj' karwao. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is a standard, approved treatment
options.hg: Yeh ek standard, approved ilaaj hai

options.en: It works well if started when young
options.hg: Agar jaldi shuru karo toh accha kaam karti hai

options.en: It is fine if done by a spiritual healer
options.hg: Agar koi baba kare toh theek hai

options.en: It is harmful and is misconduct for doctors in India
options.hg: Yeh nuksaan karti hai aur India mein doctors ke liye misconduct hai

explain.en: Conversion therapy has no scientific basis and causes harm. In 2022 India's National Medical Commission declared it professional misconduct. What helps is family acceptance.
explain.hg: Conversion therapy ka koi scientific basis nahi aur yeh nuksaan karti hai. 2022 mein India ki National Medical Commission ne ise professional misconduct ghoshit kiya. Jo madad karta hai woh hai family ka apnaapan.

q.en: In 2022, which body told all state medical councils that 'conversion therapy' on LGBTQIA+ people is professional misconduct?
q.hg: 2022 mein kis body ne saare state medical councils ko bataya ki LGBTQIA+ logon pe 'conversion therapy' professional misconduct hai?

options.en: The University Grants Commission
options.hg: University Grants Commission

options.en: The Press Council of India
options.hg: Press Council of India

options.en: The Election Commission of India
options.hg: Election Commission of India

options.en: The National Medical Commission
options.hg: National Medical Commission

explain.en: The National Medical Commission's August 2022 letter followed a Madras High Court direction. Doctors who attempt to 'cure' sexual orientation or gender identity can face disciplinary action.
explain.hg: National Medical Commission ka August 2022 ka letter Madras High Court ke direction ke baad aaya. Jo doctor sexual orientation ya gender identity ko 'theek' karne ki koshish karein, un pe disciplinary action ho sakta hai.

q.en: Which High Court in 2021 directed that attempts to medically 'cure' LGBTQIA+ people be prohibited?
q.hg: 2021 mein kis High Court ne kaha ki LGBTQIA+ logon ko medically 'theek' karne ki koshish pe rok lage?

options.en: The Bombay High Court
options.hg: Bombay High Court

options.en: The Gauhati High Court
options.hg: Gauhati High Court

options.en: The Calcutta High Court
options.hg: Calcutta High Court

options.en: The Madras High Court
options.hg: Madras High Court

explain.en: In S. Sushma v. Commissioner of Police (2021), filed by a lesbian couple, the Madras High Court prohibited conversion attempts and ordered sensitisation of police, courts, schools and health workers.
explain.hg: S. Sushma v. Commissioner of Police (2021) mein, jo ek lesbian couple ne file kiya tha, Madras High Court ne conversion ki koshishon pe rok lagayi aur police, courts, schools aur health workers ki sensitisation ka order diya.

q.en: Is consensual sex between two adults of the same sex a crime in India today?
q.hg: Kya aaj India mein do same-sex adults ke beech consent wala sex crime hai?

options.en: Yes, it is a crime under the BNS
options.hg: Haan, BNS ke under crime hai

options.en: It is legal only for married couples
options.hg: Yeh sirf married couples ke liye legal hai

options.en: No, the Supreme Court decriminalised it in 2018
options.hg: Nahi, Supreme Court ne 2018 mein ise crime se bahar kiya

options.en: Yes, but only in some states
options.hg: Haan, par sirf kuch states mein

explain.en: In Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018) a five-judge bench unanimously read down Section 377 of the IPC, so consensual same-sex relations between adults are no longer a crime.
explain.hg: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018) mein paanch judges ki bench ne sarvsammati se IPC ke Section 377 ko read down kiya, toh adults ke beech consent wale same-sex rishte ab crime nahi hain.

q.en: Which 2018 Supreme Court case read down Section 377 of the IPC?
q.hg: 2018 ke kis Supreme Court case ne IPC ke Section 377 ko read down kiya?

options.en: Supriyo v. Union of India
options.hg: Supriyo v. Union of India

options.en: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan
options.hg: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan

options.en: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
options.hg: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India

options.en: NALSA v. Union of India
options.hg: NALSA v. Union of India

explain.en: Navtej (6 September 2018) decriminalised consensual same-sex relations between adults, while keeping non-consensual acts a crime. NALSA (2014) was about transgender rights, and Supriyo (2023) about marriage.
explain.hg: Navtej (6 September 2018) ne adults ke consent wale same-sex rishton ko crime se bahar kiya, aur bina consent wale acts ko crime rakha. NALSA (2014) transgender rights pe tha, aur Supriyo (2023) shaadi pe.

q.en: Before 2018, which Supreme Court judgment of 2013 had recriminalised gay sex after the Delhi High Court's 2009 ruling?
q.hg: 2018 se pehle, 2013 ke kis Supreme Court faisle ne Delhi High Court ke 2009 ke ruling ke baad gay sex ko phir se crime bana diya tha?

options.en: Supriyo
options.hg: Supriyo

options.en: Navtej Singh Johar
options.hg: Navtej Singh Johar

options.en: Suresh Kumar Koushal
options.hg: Suresh Kumar Koushal

options.en: Naz Foundation
options.hg: Naz Foundation

explain.en: The Delhi High Court decriminalised it in Naz Foundation (2009); the Supreme Court reversed that in Suresh Kumar Koushal (December 2013), and Navtej Singh Johar overturned Koushal nearly five years later.
explain.hg: Delhi High Court ne Naz Foundation (2009) mein ise crime se bahar kiya; Supreme Court ne Suresh Kumar Koushal (December 2013) mein use palat diya, aur lagbhag paanch saal baad Navtej Singh Johar ne Koushal ko palta.

q.en: How was the Navtej Singh Johar judgment of 2018 decided?
q.hg: 2018 ka Navtej Singh Johar faisla kaise hua tha?

options.en: By a public vote in Parliament
options.hg: Parliament mein public vote se

options.en: Unanimously, by a five-judge bench
options.hg: Paanch judges ki bench ne sarvsammati se

options.en: By a 3:2 split among five judges
options.hg: Paanch judges mein 3:2 ke bantwaare se

options.en: By a single judge of the Supreme Court
options.hg: Supreme Court ke ek judge ne

explain.en: A five-judge Constitution Bench led by Chief Justice Dipak Misra was unanimous. A unanimous larger bench sends a strong signal of constitutional protection.
explain.hg: Chief Justice Dipak Misra ki paanch judges wali Constitution Bench sarvsammat thi. Badi bench ka sarvsammat faisla constitutional protection ka strong signal deta hai.

q.en: Can two people of the same sex legally marry in India today?
q.hg: Kya aaj India mein same sex ke do log legally shaadi kar sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, in a few union territories
options.hg: Haan, kuch union territories mein

options.en: Yes, but only by registering online
options.hg: Haan, par sirf online register karke

options.en: No; in 2023 the Supreme Court left it to Parliament
options.hg: Nahi; 2023 mein Supreme Court ne ise Parliament pe chhoda

options.en: Yes, since the 2018 Navtej judgment
options.hg: Haan, 2018 ke Navtej faisle se

explain.en: In Supriyo v. Union of India (October 2023) the Supreme Court declined to recognise same-sex marriage and said it is for Parliament. Navtej decriminalised relationships; it did not create marriage rights.
explain.hg: Supriyo v. Union of India (October 2023) mein Supreme Court ne same-sex marriage ko manyata nahi di aur kaha yeh Parliament ka kaam hai. Navtej ne rishton ko crime se bahar kiya; shaadi ka haq nahi banaya.

q.en: In the 2023 Supriyo judgment, what did the Supreme Court say about a transgender person in a heterosexual relationship?
q.hg: 2023 ke Supriyo faisle mein Supreme Court ne heterosexual relationship wale transgender insaan ke baare mein kya kaha?

options.en: They cannot marry under any law
options.hg: Woh kisi bhi law ke under shaadi nahi kar sakte

options.en: They need a High Court's permission to marry
options.hg: Shaadi ke liye High Court ki permission chahiye

options.en: They can marry under existing marriage laws
options.hg: Woh maujooda marriage laws ke under shaadi kar sakte hain

options.en: They may marry only after the age of 30
options.hg: Woh sirf 30 saal ke baad shaadi kar sakte hain

explain.en: The Court held that a transgender person in a heterosexual relationship is entitled to marry under existing laws, even though it declined to recognise same-sex marriage.
explain.hg: Court ne kaha ki heterosexual relationship wala transgender insaan maujooda laws ke under shaadi ka haqdaar hai, bhale hi usne same-sex marriage ko manyata nahi di.

q.en: In April 2024, after the Supriyo judgment, the Centre set up a committee chaired by the Cabinet Secretary to…
q.hg: April 2024 mein, Supriyo faisle ke baad, Centre ne Cabinet Secretary ki adhyakshta mein ek committee banayi taaki…

options.en: Bring back an offence like Section 377 in the BNS
options.hg: BNS mein Section 377 jaisa offence wapas laaye

options.en: Count LGBTQ+ people in the next national census
options.hg: Agli national census mein LGBTQ+ logon ko gine

options.en: Recommend steps against discrimination faced by queer people
options.hg: Queer logon ke saath bhedbhaav ke khilaaf kadam suggest kare

options.en: Draft a law making same-sex marriage legal
options.hg: Same-sex marriage ko legal karne ka law banaye

explain.en: The six-member committee was asked to recommend measures against discrimination, violence and involuntary medical treatment of queer persons. Its terms do not mention legal recognition of couples.
explain.hg: Chhe members wali committee ko queer logon ke saath bhedbhaav, violence aur zabardasti ke medical treatment ke khilaaf kadam suggest karne ko kaha gaya. Iske terms mein couples ki legal manyata ki baat nahi hai.

q.en: What did the Supreme Court decide in NALSA v. Union of India (2014)?
q.hg: NALSA v. Union of India (2014) mein Supreme Court ne kya decide kiya?

options.en: Same-sex couples have the right to legally marry
options.hg: Same-sex couples ko legally shaadi ka haq hai

options.en: Same-sex relations between adults are not a crime
options.hg: Adults ke same-sex rishte crime nahi hain

options.en: Every workplace must have a complaints committee
options.hg: Har workplace mein complaints committee honi chahiye

options.en: Transgender people are a 'third gender' who can self-identify
options.hg: Transgender log 'third gender' hain aur khud apni pehchaan bata sakte hain

explain.en: On 15 April 2014 the Court recognised transgender persons as a 'third gender', upheld their right to self-identify their gender, and extended them fundamental rights protections.
explain.hg: 15 April 2014 ko Court ne transgender logon ko 'third gender' maana, unke apna gender khud batane ke haq ko sahi kaha, aur unhe fundamental rights ki suraksha di.

q.en: The NALSA judgment (2014) extended to transgender persons the protection of which constitutional rights?
q.hg: NALSA faisle (2014) ne transgender logon ko kaunse constitutional rights ki suraksha di?

options.en: Only the right to own and inherit property
options.hg: Sirf property rakhne aur virasat ka haq

options.en: Only the right to vote in elections (Article 326)
options.hg: Sirf elections mein vote ka haq (Article 326)

options.en: Equality, freedom and life (Articles 14, 15, 16, 19, 21)
options.hg: Barabari, azaadi aur jeevan (Articles 14, 15, 16, 19, 21)

options.en: No rights until Parliament passed a law
options.hg: Parliament ke law tak koi haq nahi

explain.en: The Court held that Articles 14, 15, 16, 19 and 21 protect transgender persons. Fundamental rights belong to every person, whatever their gender identity.
explain.hg: Court ne kaha ki Articles 14, 15, 16, 19 aur 21 transgender logon ko protect karte hain. Fundamental rights har insaan ke hain, gender identity kuch bhi ho.

q.en: Through which platform can a transgender person apply online for a transgender certificate and ID card?
q.hg: Transgender insaan transgender certificate aur ID card ke liye online kahan apply kar sakta hai?

options.en: The voter helpline app only
options.hg: Sirf voter helpline app

options.en: The National Portal for Transgender Persons
options.hg: National Portal for Transgender Persons

options.en: The railway ticket booking site
options.hg: Railway ticket booking site

options.en: The income tax e-filing website
options.hg: Income tax e-filing website

explain.en: The national portal was launched in November 2020 under the Transgender Persons Act, 2019. A 2026 amendment added a medical board step for certificates and is being challenged in the Supreme Court.
explain.hg: National portal November 2020 mein Transgender Persons Act, 2019 ke under shuru hua. 2026 ke amendment ne certificate ke liye medical board ka step joda, jise Supreme Court mein challenge kiya gaya hai.

q.en: What did the 2026 amendment to the Transgender Persons Act change, which is now being challenged in the Supreme Court?
q.hg: Transgender Persons Act mein 2026 ke amendment ne kya badla, jise ab Supreme Court mein challenge kiya gaya hai?

options.en: It abolished all transgender certificates
options.hg: Saare transgender certificates khatam kar diye

options.en: It lowered the voting age for trans persons
options.hg: Trans logon ki voting umar kam kar di

options.en: Dropped self-identification and added a medical board step
options.hg: Self-identification hata di aur medical board ka step joda

options.en: It made same-sex marriage legal across India
options.hg: Poore India mein same-sex marriage legal kar di

explain.en: The 2026 amendment deleted the right to self-perceived gender identity and requires a medical board's recommendation before a certificate. Critics say this reverses NALSA's self-identification principle; the Union told the Court existing ID cards stay valid while the case is heard.
explain.hg: 2026 amendment ne self-perceived gender identity ka haq hata diya aur certificate se pehle medical board ki recommendation zaroori ki. Critics kehte hain yeh NALSA ke self-identification ke usool ko palat-ta hai; Union ne Court ko bataya ki case chalne tak purane ID cards valid rahenge.

q.en: Under the Transgender Persons Act, what is the punishment for sexual abuse of a transgender person?
q.hg: Transgender Persons Act ke under transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki saza kya hai?

options.en: Only a written apology
options.hg: Sirf likhit maafi

options.en: 6 months to 2 years in prison and a fine
options.hg: 6 mahine se 2 saal jail aur fine

options.en: At least 10 years, up to life
options.hg: Kam se kam 10 saal, umar qaid tak

options.en: A fine with no prison term
options.hg: Sirf fine, jail nahi

explain.en: Section 18 sets 6 months to 2 years and a fine, and the 2026 amendment kept that range. Rape under BNS Section 63 covers only women as victims, so activists point out that trans survivors get far weaker protection.
explain.hg: Section 18 mein 6 mahine se 2 saal aur fine hai, aur 2026 amendment ne yahi range rakhi. BNS Section 63 ka rape sirf mahilaon ko victim maanta hai, isliye activists kehte hain ki trans survivors ko kaafi kamzor suraksha milti hai.

q.en: What are 'Garima Greh'?
q.hg: 'Garima Greh' kya hain?

options.en: Old-age homes for retired soldiers
options.hg: Retired sainikon ke old-age homes

options.en: Special courts for property disputes
options.hg: Property jhagdon ke special courts

options.en: Government hostels only for girl students
options.hg: Sirf ladkiyon ke sarkari hostels

options.en: Shelter homes for transgender persons in need
options.hg: Zaroorat-mand transgender logon ke shelter homes

explain.en: Garima Greh shelters support destitute transgender persons. As of November 2025 there were 21 across 17 states, under the SMILE scheme launched in February 2022.
explain.hg: Garima Greh shelters besahara transgender logon ki madad karte hain. November 2025 tak 17 states mein 21 the, February 2022 mein shuru hui SMILE scheme ke under.

q.en: The 2020 Rules under the Transgender Persons Act required every state to set up which body?
q.hg: Transgender Persons Act ke 2020 Rules ne har state ko kaunsi body banane ko kaha?

options.en: A Transgender Protection Cell
options.hg: Transgender Protection Cell

options.en: A Transgender Marriage Board
options.hg: Transgender Marriage Board

options.en: A separate transgender police force
options.hg: Alag transgender police force

options.en: A transgender-only university
options.hg: Sirf transgender logon ki university

explain.en: Protection cells are meant to handle offences against transgender persons. By November 2025 only 20 states and union territories had set them up, five years after the Rules.
explain.hg: Protection cells transgender logon ke khilaaf offences sambhalne ke liye hain. November 2025 tak sirf 20 states aur union territories ne inhe banaya tha, Rules ke paanch saal baad.

q.en: India's National Education Policy 2020 commits to a 'Gender-Inclusion Fund' for which students?
q.hg: India ki National Education Policy 2020 kin students ke liye 'Gender-Inclusion Fund' ka vaada karti hai?

options.en: Only students studying abroad
options.hg: Sirf videsh mein padhne wale students ke liye

options.en: Only boys in sports schools
options.hg: Sirf sports schools ke ladkon ke liye

options.en: Only students in private schools
options.hg: Sirf private school ke students ke liye

options.en: Girls and transgender students
options.hg: Ladkiyon aur transgender students ke liye

explain.en: NEP 2020 lists girls and transgender students among socio-economically disadvantaged groups and commits to a Gender-Inclusion Fund to help them access education.
explain.hg: NEP 2020 ladkiyon aur transgender students ko socio-economically disadvantaged groups mein ginti hai aur unki padhai tak pahunch ke liye Gender-Inclusion Fund ka vaada karti hai.

q.en: Under the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017, can a mental-health service discriminate against someone because of their sexual orientation?
q.hg: Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ke under kya mental-health service kisi ki sexual orientation ki wajah se bhedbhaav kar sakti hai?

options.en: No, the Act bars it
options.hg: Nahi, Act ise mana karta hai

options.en: Yes, in private clinics
options.hg: Haan, private clinics mein

options.en: Only for patients under 18
options.hg: Sirf 18 se kam umar ke patients ke liye

options.en: Yes, if the family requests it
options.hg: Haan, agar family kahe

explain.en: Section 21 of the Mental Healthcare Act names gender, sex and sexual orientation among the grounds on which mental-health care must not discriminate.
explain.hg: Mental Healthcare Act ka Section 21 gender, sex aur sexual orientation ko un aadhaaron mein ginta hai jin pe mental-health care mein bhedbhaav nahi ho sakta.

q.en: A queer teenager feels anxious and alone late at night. Which free 24x7 helpline offers mental-health support?
q.hg: Ek queer teenager raat ko der se anxious aur akela feel kar raha hai. Kaunsi free 24x7 helpline mental-health support deti hai?

options.en: Women Helpline, 181
options.hg: Women Helpline, 181

options.en: NACO helpline, 1097
options.hg: NACO helpline, 1097

options.en: Cybercrime helpline, 1930
options.hg: Cybercrime helpline, 1930

options.en: Tele-MANAS, 14416
options.hg: Tele-MANAS, 14416

explain.en: Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free, round-the-clock counselling to anyone, including transgender and queer people. Reaching out is a strong step, not a weak one.
explain.hg: Tele-MANAS (14416) har kisi ko free, 24 ghante counselling deti hai, transgender aur queer logon ko bhi. Madad maangna strong kadam hai, kamzor nahi.

q.en: Your friend tells you they are gay and asks you to keep it private for now. What should you do?
q.hg: Tumhara dost batata hai ki woh gay hai aur abhi ke liye private rakhne ko kehta hai. Tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Inform their parents so they can help
options.hg: Unke parents ko batao taaki woh help karein

options.en: Tell them to try dating someone else first
options.hg: Bolo pehle kisi aur ko date karke dekho

options.en: Tell others so they get accepted faster
options.hg: Doosron ko batao taaki jaldi accept ho jaaye

options.en: Thank them for trusting you and keep it private
options.hg: Bharosa karne ke liye shukriya kaho aur baat private rakho

explain.en: Coming out to someone is an act of trust. Your job is to listen and keep their confidence; they decide who else hears it and when. If they are ever in danger, help them reach support.
explain.hg: Kisi ko coming out karna bharosa hai. Tumhara kaam sunna aur baat apne tak rakhna hai; kise aur kab batana hai, yeh woh tay karenge. Agar kabhi khatra ho toh unhe madad tak pahunchne mein help karo.

q.en: What does 'outing' someone mean?
q.hg: Kisi ko 'out' karna kya hota hai?

options.en: Taking part in a Pride walk in your city
options.hg: Apne shehar ki Pride walk mein hissa lena

options.en: Coming out about yourself in a public post
options.hg: Public post mein khud ke baare mein batana

options.en: Revealing someone's LGBTQ+ identity without permission
options.hg: Kisi ki LGBTQ+ pehchaan bina permission ke batana

options.en: Inviting someone to go out with friends
options.hg: Kisi ko doston ke saath bahar bulana

explain.en: Outing takes away a person's choice and can put them at risk at home, school or work. Even if you mean well, someone's identity is theirs to share.
explain.hg: Out karna insaan se uski choice chheen leta hai aur use ghar, school ya kaam pe khatre mein daal sakta hai. Iraada accha ho tab bhi, kisi ki pehchaan batane ka haq sirf uska hai.

q.en: Who decides when, and to whom, a person comes out?
q.hg: Koi insaan kab aur kise coming out kare, yeh kaun tay karta hai?

options.en: Their closest friend
options.hg: Unka sabse kareebi dost

options.en: Only that person
options.hg: Sirf woh insaan

options.en: Their class teacher
options.hg: Unke class teacher

options.en: Their parents
options.hg: Unke parents

explain.en: Coming out is personal and can happen slowly, to different people at different times. Some people never come out to everyone, and that is their right.
explain.hg: Coming out personal hai aur dheere-dheere, alag logon ko alag time pe ho sakta hai. Kuch log kabhi sabko nahi batate, aur yeh unka haq hai.

q.en: Before coming out to family, what is a sensible step?
q.hg: Family ko coming out karne se pehle kya samajhdaari ka kadam hai?

options.en: Wait until you are sure no one will object
options.hg: Tab tak ruko jab tak pakka na ho ki koi objection nahi karega

options.en: Post it online first to test reactions
options.hg: Pehle online post karke reaction dekho

options.en: Announce it at a big family function
options.hg: Bade family function mein announce karo

options.en: Think about safety and have a support person
options.hg: Safety ke baare mein socho aur ek support person tayyar rakho

explain.en: There is no single right way, but safety matters. It helps to have a trusted friend, counsellor or a helpline like Tele-MANAS 14416 ready, especially if you depend on family for housing or money.
explain.hg: Koi ek sahi tareeka nahi, par safety zaroori hai. Ek bharosemand dost, counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 jaisi helpline tayyar rakhna madad karta hai, khaas kar agar ghar ya paison ke liye family pe nirbhar ho.

q.en: A new classmate says, 'My pronouns are they/them.' What is the respectful thing to do?
q.hg: Ek naya classmate kehta hai, 'Mere pronouns they/them hain.' Respectful kya hai?

options.en: Use the pronouns they asked for
options.hg: Jo pronouns unhone bataye wahi use karo

options.en: Ask them to prove why
options.hg: Unse saboot maango kyun

options.en: Avoid talking to them at all
options.hg: Unse baat hi mat karo

options.en: Use whatever fits how they look
options.hg: Jo unke looks se lage woh use karo

explain.en: Using someone's chosen name and pronouns is basic respect, like pronouncing their name correctly. It costs you little and means a lot to them.
explain.hg: Kisi ka chuna hua naam aur pronouns use karna basic respect hai, jaise unka naam sahi bolna. Tumhara kuch nahi jaata aur unke liye bahut maayne rakhta hai.

q.en: You accidentally use the wrong pronoun for a trans friend. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Tum galti se ek trans dost ke liye galat pronoun use kar dete ho. Sabse accha kya hai?

options.en: Correct yourself quickly and carry on
options.hg: Jaldi se khud ko sahi karo aur aage badho

options.en: Make a long, emotional apology speech
options.hg: Lambi emotional maafi ki speech do

options.en: Ignore it every time it happens
options.hg: Har baar ignore karo

options.en: Tell them it is too hard to remember
options.hg: Bolo ki yaad rakhna bahut mushkil hai

explain.en: Everyone slips sometimes. A quick 'sorry, she' and moving on keeps the focus off the mistake. Practising makes it natural.
explain.hg: Galti sabse hoti hai. Ek chhota sa 'sorry, she' bolke aage badhna galti pe dhyaan nahi jaane deta. Practice se aadat ban jaati hai.

q.en: What is 'deadnaming'?
q.hg: 'Deadnaming' kya hai?

options.en: Writing a name in a death certificate
options.hg: Death certificate mein naam likhna

options.en: Forgetting the name of someone who died
options.hg: Kisi guzre hue insaan ka naam bhoolna

options.en: Calling someone by a funny nickname
options.hg: Kisi ko funny nickname se bulana

options.en: Using a trans person's old name they no longer use
options.hg: Trans insaan ka purana naam jo woh ab use nahi karte

explain.en: Calling a trans person by their old name can be hurtful and can out them to others. Use the name they use now, in person and online.
explain.hg: Trans insaan ko unke purane naam se bulana dukh de sakta hai aur doosron ke saamne unhe out kar sakta hai. Jo naam woh ab use karte hain wahi use karo, saamne bhi aur online bhi.

q.en: Some classmates call a boy names because he is soft-spoken and likes drawing. What is the right thing to do?
q.hg: Kuch classmates ek ladke ko naam rakhte hain kyunki woh dheere bolta hai aur drawing pasand karta hai. Sahi kya hai?

options.en: Speak up if safe, or tell a teacher; it's bullying
options.hg: Safe ho toh bolo, ya teacher ko batao; yeh bullying hai

options.en: Ignore it, it is not your business
options.hg: Ignore karo, tumhara maamla nahi

options.en: Join in, since it is only a harmless joke
options.hg: Saath mein hanso, yeh bas harmless mazaak hai

options.en: Tell the boy to act tougher so it stops
options.hg: Ladke ko bolo tough bane taaki yeh ruk jaaye

explain.en: Mocking someone for not fitting gender rules is bullying. You can support them, refuse to laugh and tell a teacher. Changing who they are is not the fix; stopping the bullying is.
explain.hg: Kisi ko gender ke rules mein fit na hone pe chidhaana bullying hai. Tum unka saath de sakte ho, hansne se mana kar sakte ho aur teacher ko bata sakte ho. Unhe badalna hal nahi; bullying rokna hal hai.

q.en: A class WhatsApp group starts sharing memes that mock a transgender student. What can you do?
q.hg: Class ke WhatsApp group mein ek transgender student ka mazaak udaane wale memes share hone lagte hain. Tum kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Leave the group and say nothing to anyone
options.hg: Group chhod do aur kisi ko kuch mat batao

options.en: Forward it to show how funny it is
options.hg: Forward karo dikhane ke liye ki kitna funny hai

options.en: Don't forward, call it out, and tell a teacher
options.hg: Forward mat karo, galat bolo, aur teacher ko batao

options.en: React with a laughing emoji to fit in
options.hg: Fit hone ke liye hansne wala emoji bhejo

explain.en: Online mocking is bullying too, and every forward spreads it. Checking in privately with the student also helps them know they are not alone.
explain.hg: Online mazaak bhi bullying hai, aur har forward ise failata hai. Student se private mein haal poochna bhi unhe batata hai ki woh akele nahi.

q.en: Hijra, kinnar, aravani and jogta are…
q.hg: Hijra, kinnar, aravani aur jogta kya hain?

options.en: Names of medical conditions in old textbooks
options.hg: Purani textbooks mein medical conditions ke naam

options.en: Groups with no legal recognition at all
options.hg: Aise groups jinhe koi legal manyata nahi

options.en: Recent internet slang words for insults
options.hg: Gaali ke liye naye internet slang words

options.en: Transgender community identities that deserve respect
options.hg: Transgender community identities jo respect ki haqdaar hain

explain.en: These are community identities named in Indian law on transgender persons. People in these communities have the same dignity and rights as anyone else, and these words should never be used as insults.
explain.hg: Yeh community identities hain jinka zikr transgender logon ke Indian law mein hai. In communities ke logon ki izzat aur haq baaki sabke jaise hain, aur in shabdon ko kabhi gaali ki tarah use nahi karna chahiye.

q.en: On a train, some passengers laugh and stare at a transgender woman. What is respectful?
q.hg: Train mein kuch log ek transgender mahila pe hanste aur ghoorte hain. Respectful kya hai?

options.en: Ask her personal questions out of curiosity
options.hg: Curiosity mein usse personal sawaal poochho

options.en: Move to another coach to avoid her
options.hg: Usse bachne ke liye doosre coach mein chale jao

options.en: Treat her like any other passenger
options.hg: Use kisi bhi aur passenger ki tarah treat karo

options.en: Laugh along so the group stays happy
options.hg: Group khush rahe isliye saath mein hanso

explain.en: Respect means ordinary courtesy: no staring, mocking or intrusive questions. If others harass her, you can stand near her, speak up if safe, or alert railway staff.
explain.hg: Respect ka matlab aam tameez: na ghoorna, na mazaak, na personal sawaal. Agar log use pareshan karein toh tum uske paas khade ho sakte ho, safe ho toh bol sakte ho, ya railway staff ko bata sakte ho.

q.en: You and your sister both have exams, but only she is asked to make tea for guests. What is fair?
q.hg: Tumhari aur tumhari behen dono ki exams hain, par sirf use guests ke liye chai banane ko kaha jaata hai. Fair kya hai?

options.en: She should do it because she is a girl
options.hg: Woh kare kyunki woh ladki hai

options.en: Take turns or share the task
options.hg: Baari-baari karo ya kaam baanto

options.en: Guests should be told to leave
options.hg: Guests ko jaane ko bolo

options.en: Nobody should ever make tea
options.hg: Kisi ko kabhi chai nahi banani chahiye

explain.en: Her study time matters as much as yours. Small, repeated unfairness at home teaches girls their time is worth less; sharing the work changes that.
explain.hg: Uski padhai ka time utna hi zaroori hai jitna tumhara. Ghar pe chhoti-chhoti baar-baar ki naainsaafi ladkiyon ko sikhati hai ki unka time kam keemti hai; kaam baantne se yeh badalta hai.

q.en: Relatives keep saying a couple 'needs a son'. Which is true?
q.hg: Rishtedaar baar-baar kehte hain ki couple ko 'beta chahiye'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Families are always incomplete without a son
options.hg: Bete ke bina family hamesha adhoori hai

options.en: Daughters and sons are equal; sex selection is a crime
options.hg: Betiyan aur bete barabar hain; sex selection crime hai

options.en: Testing the baby's sex is a private choice
options.hg: Bachche ka sex test karwana private choice hai

options.en: A son is needed to look after parents in old age
options.hg: Budhape mein parents ki dekhbhaal ke liye beta zaroori hai

explain.en: Daughters can do everything sons can, including caring for parents. Pre-natal sex determination is punishable under the PC-PNDT Act, 1994.
explain.hg: Betiyan woh sab kar sakti hain jo bete karte hain, parents ki dekhbhaal bhi. PC-PNDT Act, 1994 ke under paidaish se pehle sex determination punishable hai.

q.en: A neighbour says girls don't need to study science because 'they'll get married anyway'. What is the best reply?
q.hg: Ek padosi kehte hain ki ladkiyon ko science padhne ki zaroorat nahi kyunki 'shaadi toh honi hi hai'. Sabse accha jawab kya hai?

options.en: Girls should study only cooking and art
options.hg: Ladkiyan sirf cooking aur art padhein

options.en: Girls have the same right to study any subject
options.hg: Ladkiyon ko bhi koi bhi subject padhne ka barabar haq hai

options.en: Girls may study science only until Class 8
options.hg: Ladkiyan sirf Class 8 tak science padhein

options.en: He is right; science is too hard for girls
options.hg: Woh sahi hain; science ladkiyon ke liye mushkil hai

explain.en: Education is a right, not a 'waste' before marriage. Whether or not someone marries, knowledge and skills shape their health, income and choices.
explain.hg: Padhai ek haq hai, shaadi se pehle ka 'waste' nahi. Shaadi ho ya na ho, gyaan aur skills insaan ki sehat, kamaai aur choices banati hain.

q.en: Can girls play kabaddi, wrestling or cricket?
q.hg: Kya ladkiyan kabaddi, kushti ya cricket khel sakti hain?

options.en: Only if they play against other girls in secret
options.hg: Sirf agar chhup ke ladkiyon ke saath khelein

options.en: Yes, any sport is open to anyone
options.hg: Haan, koi bhi sport kisi ke liye bhi hai

options.en: No, contact sports are only for boys
options.hg: Nahi, contact sports sirf ladkon ke liye

options.en: Only until they reach puberty
options.hg: Sirf puberty tak

explain.en: Sport builds health, confidence and teamwork for everyone. Women in India play all of these sports, from school teams to national level.
explain.hg: Sport sabke liye sehat, confidence aur teamwork banata hai. India mein mahilayein yeh saare sports khelti hain, school team se national level tak.

q.en: Many ads show only women cleaning and only men driving or investing. What effect can this have?
q.hg: Bahut se ads mein sirf aurtein safai karti aur sirf aadmi gaadi chalate ya invest karte dikhte hain. Iska kya asar ho sakta hai?

options.en: None, as ads only sell products
options.hg: Koi nahi, ads sirf products bechte hain

options.en: It shows what is biologically natural
options.hg: Yeh dikhata hai ki biologically natural kya hai

options.en: It makes housework fairer at home
options.hg: Ghar pe kaam ko zyada fair banata hai

options.en: It reinforces stereotypes about who does what
options.hg: Kaun kya karega, is baare mein stereotypes ko mazboot karta hai

explain.en: Media repeated day after day shapes what people see as 'normal'. Noticing these patterns, and questioning them, is part of media literacy.
explain.hg: Roz-roz dikhaya gaya media logon ke liye 'normal' tay karta hai. In patterns ko notice karna aur unpe sawaal uthana media literacy ka hissa hai.

q.en: In a marriage, who should make decisions about family money and big purchases?
q.hg: Shaadi mein family ke paise aur bade kharche ke faisle kaun le?

options.en: Only the husband's parents
options.hg: Sirf pati ke maa-baap

options.en: Only whoever earns more
options.hg: Sirf jo zyada kamaata hai

options.en: Only the husband, as head of family
options.hg: Sirf pati, ghar ka mukhiya hone ke naate

options.en: Both partners together
options.hg: Dono partners milke

explain.en: Shared decisions make families stronger and fairer. Controlling all the money can also be a form of abuse, especially when one partner is kept dependent.
explain.hg: Milke liye faisle family ko mazboot aur fair banate hain. Saara paisa control karna bhi abuse ka ek roop ho sakta hai, khaas kar jab ek partner ko nirbhar rakha jaaye.

q.en: In NFHS-5 (2019-21), what share of Indian men aged 15-49 agreed that a husband is justified in beating his wife in at least one situation?
q.hg: NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 15-49 saal ke kitne Indian aadmiyon ne maana ki kam se kam ek situation mein pati ka patni ko maarna sahi hai?

explain.en: 44% of men agreed, up from 42% in NFHS-4, while among women it fell from 52% to 45%. No situation justifies violence; attitudes like these are what gender-equality education tries to change.
explain.hg: 44% aadmiyon ne maana, jo NFHS-4 ke 42% se zyada hai, jabki mahilaon mein yeh 52% se ghatke 45% hua. Koi bhi situation violence ko sahi nahi banati; aisi soch hi gender-equality education badalna chahti hai.

q.en: Can boys and men be survivors of sexual abuse?
q.hg: Kya ladke aur aadmi bhi sexual abuse ke survivor ho sakte hain?

options.en: Only if the abuser is an adult man
options.hg: Sirf agar abuser adult aadmi ho

options.en: Only very young boys under five years old
options.hg: Sirf paanch saal se chhote bahut chhote ladke

options.en: Yes, and they deserve to be believed and helped
options.hg: Haan, aur unhe believe aur help kiya jaana chahiye

options.en: No, only girls can be sexually abused
options.hg: Nahi, sirf ladkiyon ka sexual abuse hota hai

explain.en: Boys and men are abused too, and the 'boys don't get abused' myth keeps them silent. POCSO protects every child under 18, boys included. Childline 1098 and Tele-MANAS 14416 are there for support.
explain.hg: Ladkon aur aadmiyon ka bhi abuse hota hai, aur 'ladkon ka abuse nahi hota' wala myth unhe chup karata hai. POCSO 18 se kam har bachche ko protect karta hai, ladkon ko bhi. Support ke liye Childline 1098 aur Tele-MANAS 14416 hain.

q.en: In India's 2007 national Study on Child Abuse by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, boys made up what share of the children who reported sexual abuse?
q.hg: Ministry of Women and Child Development ki 2007 ki national Study on Child Abuse mein, sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein ladke kitne pratishat the?

options.en: 0%, as no boys reported abuse
options.hg: 0%, kisi ladke ne report nahi kiya

options.en: About 25%, a quarter
options.hg: Lagbhag 25%, ek chauthai

options.en: 52.94%, more than girls
options.hg: 52.94%, ladkiyon se zyada

options.en: About 5%, a small minority
options.hg: Lagbhag 5%, bahut kam

explain.en: The 2007 study used a convenience sample, so treat it as indicative, but it showed clearly that boys are abused too. The share is of abused children, not a rate among all boys.
explain.hg: 2007 ki study convenience sample pe thi, toh ise indicative maano, par isne saaf dikhaya ki ladkon ka bhi abuse hota hai. Yeh abuse hue bachchon mein hissa hai, saare ladkon mein rate nahi.

q.en: Can a boy be sexually harassed by a girl?
q.hg: Kya ek ladke ko ladki sexually harass kar sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, anyone can face harassment and can report it
options.hg: Haan, koi bhi harassment jhel sakta hai aur report kar sakta hai

options.en: Only if she is much older than him
options.hg: Sirf agar woh usse bahut badi ho

options.en: Only if it happens online, not in person
options.hg: Sirf online ho tab, saamne nahi

options.en: No, boys always enjoy that kind of attention
options.hg: Nahi, ladkon ko aisa attention hamesha accha lagta hai

explain.en: Unwanted sexual attention is harassment whoever does it. Assuming boys 'always want it' denies their right to say no.
explain.hg: Unwanted sexual attention harassment hai, chahe koi bhi kare. Yeh maan lena ki ladke 'hamesha chahte hain' unke na kehne ke haq ko nakaarta hai.

q.en: Does a person's gender change whether their 'no' counts?
q.hg: Kya kisi ka gender yeh badalta hai ki uski 'na' maani jaaye ya nahi?

options.en: Only adults' no counts, of any gender
options.hg: Sirf adults ki na maani jaati hai

options.en: Yes, women's no often means yes
options.hg: Haan, aurat ki na ka matlab aksar haan hota hai

options.en: Yes, men can't really say no
options.hg: Haan, aadmi asal mein na nahi keh sakte

options.en: No, everyone's consent matters equally
options.hg: Nahi, sabki consent barabar maayne rakhti hai

explain.en: Consent rules are the same for every gender: no means no, and only a clear, free yes is a yes. Myths like 'her no means yes' fuel harassment.
explain.hg: Consent ke rules har gender ke liye same hain: na matlab na, aur sirf saaf, apni marzi ki haan hi haan hai. 'Uski na mein haan hai' jaise myths harassment ko badhava dete hain.

q.en: Friends tease a 17-year-old boy for never having had a girlfriend, saying he is 'not a real man'. What is true?
q.hg: Dost ek 17 saal ke ladke ko chidhate hain ki uski kabhi girlfriend nahi rahi, 'asli mard nahi hai'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: A real man must have dated someone by 18
options.hg: Asli mard ne 18 tak kisi ko date kiya hona chahiye
