options.en: He should date someone just to stop the teasing
options.hg: Chidhana rokne ke liye kisi ko bhi date kare

options.en: It means something is wrong with him
options.hg: Iska matlab usme kuch gadbad hai

options.en: There's no deadline; that pressure is a stereotype
options.hg: Koi deadline nahi; yeh pressure ek stereotype hai

explain.en: People feel ready for relationships at different times, and some never want one. Being a man is not proven by dating. Pressure like this can push people into choices they don't want.
explain.hg: Log alag time pe rishton ke liye ready hote hain, aur kuch kabhi nahi chahte. Mard hona dating se prove nahi hota. Aisa pressure logon ko anchahe faislon mein dhakel sakta hai.

q.en: A girl with visible facial hair is teased at school. What is true?
q.hg: Ek ladki ke chehre pe dikhne wale baal hain aur school mein use chidhaya jaata hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: She must remove it to be allowed in class
options.hg: Class mein aane ke liye use hataana hoga

options.en: Girls with facial hair are not 'real' girls
options.hg: Chehre pe baal wali ladkiyan 'asli' ladkiyan nahi

options.en: Body hair varies naturally in every gender
options.hg: Body hair har gender mein natural tareeke se alag hota hai

options.en: It means she will grow up to be a boy
options.hg: Iska matlab woh bade hoke ladka banegi

explain.en: Hair growth differs from person to person because of genes and hormones. Removing it is a personal choice. If hair growth changes suddenly, a doctor can check, but teasing is never okay.
explain.hg: Genes aur hormones ki wajah se baal har insaan mein alag ugte hain. Hataana personal choice hai. Agar achanak badlaav ho toh doctor check kar sakta hai, par chidhaana kabhi theek nahi.

q.en: Should boys also learn about periods?
q.hg: Kya ladkon ko bhi periods ke baare mein seekhna chahiye?

options.en: No, it is a girls-only topic
options.hg: Nahi, yeh sirf ladkiyon ka topic hai

options.en: Only after they get married themselves
options.hg: Sirf khud ki shaadi ke baad

options.en: Yes, understanding periods helps everyone
options.hg: Haan, periods samajhna sabke liye accha hai

options.en: Only if they plan to become doctors
options.hg: Sirf agar doctor banne ka plan ho

explain.en: When boys understand periods, there is less teasing and shame, and they can support sisters, friends and future partners. Periods are biology, not a secret.
explain.hg: Jab ladke periods samajhte hain, toh chidhana aur sharm kam hoti hai, aur woh behen, dost aur future partners ka saath de sakte hain. Periods biology hain, secret nahi.

q.en: A woman and a man do the same job equally well, but she is paid less because 'men support families'. What is this?
q.hg: Ek aurat aur aadmi same kaam utna hi accha karte hain, par use kam paise milte hain kyunki 'aadmi family chalate hain'. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A tax saving for the company
options.hg: Company ki tax bachat

options.en: A fair reward for experience
options.hg: Experience ka fair inaam

options.en: Gender pay discrimination
options.hg: Gender pay discrimination

options.en: A normal market price
options.hg: Normal market rate

explain.en: Pay should follow the work, not the worker's gender. Many women also support families, and assumptions like this keep women's earnings and savings lower.
explain.hg: Tankhwah kaam ke hisaab se honi chahiye, gender ke hisaab se nahi. Bahut si aurtein bhi family chalati hain, aur aisi soch aurton ki kamaai aur bachat ko kam rakhti hai.

q.en: Which is a gender-neutral word for 'chairman'?
q.hg: 'Chairman' ke liye gender-neutral shabd kaunsa hai?

options.en: Chairlady
options.hg: Chairlady

options.en: Head-man
options.hg: Head-man

options.en: Chairperson
options.hg: Chairperson

options.en: Chairboy
options.hg: Chairboy

explain.en: Gender-neutral words like chairperson, firefighter or police officer remind us that any gender can hold these roles.
explain.hg: Chairperson, firefighter ya police officer jaise gender-neutral shabd yaad dilaate hain ki yeh roles koi bhi gender nibha sakta hai.

q.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook asks judges to replace labels like 'chaste woman', 'fallen woman' or 'seductress' with…
q.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook judges ko 'chaste woman', 'fallen woman' ya 'seductress' jaise labels ki jagah kya kehne ko kehti hai?

options.en: Lady of the house
options.hg: Ghar ki maalkin

options.en: Modern woman
options.hg: Modern mahila

options.en: Unmarried girl
options.hg: Unmarried ladki

options.en: Woman
options.hg: Woman (mahila)

explain.en: Such labels judge women by their sexual history. The handbook says a woman should simply be called a woman, because her 'character' is irrelevant to her rights.
explain.hg: Aise labels aurton ko unki sexual history se judge karte hain. Handbook kehti hai ki aurat ko bas aurat kaha jaaye, kyunki uska 'character' uske haq ke liye irrelevant hai.

q.en: Is cooking, cleaning and caring for family members at home 'real work'?
q.hg: Kya ghar pe khaana banana, safai aur family ki dekhbhaal 'asli kaam' hai?

options.en: Yes, it is unpaid work with real value
options.hg: Haan, yeh bina paise ka kaam hai jiski asli keemat hai

options.en: Only if a servant does it for money
options.hg: Sirf jab naukar paise leke kare

options.en: Only when a man in the family does it
options.hg: Sirf jab family ka koi aadmi kare

options.en: No, it is just free time at home
options.hg: Nahi, yeh ghar pe bas free time hai

explain.en: Care work takes time, skill and energy, and families could not run without it. Calling it 'nothing' is one reason it is so often left to women alone.
explain.hg: Dekhbhaal ke kaam mein time, skill aur mehnat lagti hai, aur iske bina family nahi chal sakti. Ise 'kuch nahi' kehna ek wajah hai ki yeh aksar sirf aurton pe chhod diya jaata hai.

q.en: A 14-year-old isn't sure about their sexual orientation yet. Is that okay?
q.hg: Ek 14 saal ka teen abhi apni sexual orientation ke baare mein pakka nahi hai. Kya yeh theek hai?

options.en: No, everyone knows for sure by age 10
options.hg: Nahi, sab 10 saal tak pakka jaan jaate hain

options.en: Yes, many people take time to figure it out
options.hg: Haan, bahut log samajhne mein time lete hain

options.en: Only if their parents decide for them
options.hg: Sirf agar parents unke liye decide karein

options.en: No, it means something is wrong
options.hg: Nahi, iska matlab kuch gadbad hai

explain.en: Questioning is normal, especially during the teen years. There is no deadline to have a label, and no need to have one at all.
explain.hg: Sawaal hona normal hai, khaas kar teen years mein. Label rakhne ki koi deadline nahi, aur label hona zaroori bhi nahi.

q.en: When someone comes out, a relative says, 'It's just a phase.' What is a more respectful response?
q.hg: Jab koi coming out karta hai, ek rishtedaar kehte hain, 'Yeh bas ek phase hai.' Zyada respectful jawab kya hai?

options.en: Tell them to keep it hidden until it passes
options.hg: Bolo jab tak 'guzar' na jaaye chhupa ke rakho

options.en: Wait a few years before taking them seriously
options.hg: Kuch saal ruko, phir serious lo

options.en: Believe them and accept who they say they are
options.hg: Unpe bharosa karo aur jo woh khud ko bataate hain use maano

options.en: Ask them to prove it with a relationship
options.hg: Unse relationship se prove karne ko kaho

explain.en: Identities are real when people share them, even if understanding grows over time. Dismissing someone as a 'phase' can make them feel unseen and less likely to come to you again.
explain.hg: Jab log apni pehchaan batate hain toh woh asli hai, chahe samajh time ke saath badhe. Kisi ko 'phase' bolke taal dena unhe anadekha mehsoos karata hai aur woh dobara tumhare paas aane se katrate hain.

q.en: Can you tell whether someone is gay or lesbian just by looking at them?
q.hg: Kya sirf dekh ke bataya ja sakta hai ki koi gay ya lesbian hai?

options.en: Yes, from the clothes they wear
options.hg: Haan, unke kapdon se

options.en: Yes, from the hobbies they enjoy
options.hg: Haan, unki hobbies se

options.en: Yes, from how they walk and talk
options.hg: Haan, unke chalne aur bolne se

options.en: No, orientation can't be seen from looks
options.hg: Nahi, orientation looks se nahi dikhti

explain.en: There is no 'look' for any orientation. Guessing based on walk, voice or style relies on stereotypes and can lead to bullying of anyone who doesn't fit gender rules.
explain.hg: Kisi bhi orientation ka koi 'look' nahi hota. Chaal, awaaz ya style se andaaza lagana stereotypes pe tika hai aur gender rules mein fit na hone wale kisi ki bhi bullying karwa sakta hai.

q.en: Can watching LGBTQ+ characters in a web series 'make' a teenager gay?
q.hg: Kya web series mein LGBTQ+ characters dekhne se koi teenager gay 'ban' sakta hai?

options.en: No, orientation isn't caught from shows or friends
options.hg: Nahi, orientation shows ya doston se nahi lagti

options.en: Yes, it spreads to those who keep watching
options.hg: Haan, dekhte rehne walon mein fail jaati hai

options.en: Only if their best friend is also gay
options.hg: Sirf agar best friend bhi gay ho

options.en: Yes, if they watch for long enough
options.hg: Haan, agar kaafi der dekhein

explain.en: Seeing diverse characters can help people understand themselves and others, but it does not change anyone's orientation. Orientation is not a trend or an infection.
explain.hg: Alag-alag characters dekhna logon ko khud ko aur doosron ko samajhne mein madad karta hai, par kisi ki orientation nahi badalta. Orientation koi trend ya infection nahi.

q.en: Do all transgender people have surgery?
q.hg: Kya saare transgender log surgery karwate hain?

options.en: No, transition is personal and may not involve surgery
options.hg: Nahi, transition personal hai aur zaroori nahi ki surgery ho

options.en: Yes, but only once they are over the age of 30
options.hg: Haan, par sirf 30 saal se upar hone pe

options.en: No, because surgery is banned in India
options.hg: Nahi, kyunki India mein surgery banned hai

options.en: Yes, it is required to be transgender
options.hg: Haan, transgender hone ke liye zaroori hai

explain.en: Some trans people change their name, clothes or documents; some use medical care; some do all or none of these. A person's identity does not depend on surgery.
explain.hg: Kuch trans log apna naam, kapde ya documents badalte hain; kuch medical care lete hain; kuch yeh sab karte hain ya kuch nahi. Kisi ki pehchaan surgery pe nirbhar nahi karti.

q.en: Is it okay to ask a transgender classmate about their body or surgeries?
q.hg: Kya transgender classmate se unki body ya surgeries ke baare mein poochna theek hai?

options.en: Yes, they should expect such questions
options.hg: Haan, unhe aise sawaalon ki ummeed rakhni chahiye

options.en: Yes, if you ask in front of others
options.hg: Haan, agar sabke saamne poochho

options.en: No, that's private, as it would be for anyone
options.hg: Nahi, yeh private hai, jaise kisi ke liye bhi hota

options.en: Yes, it helps you understand them
options.hg: Haan, isse unhe samajhne mein madad milti hai

explain.en: You wouldn't ask other classmates about their private parts, so don't ask trans classmates either. If you want to learn, read reliable sources or ask what name and pronouns they use.
explain.hg: Tum doosre classmates se unke private parts ke baare mein nahi poochte, toh trans classmates se bhi mat poochho. Seekhna hai toh reliable sources padho, ya poochho ki woh kaunsa naam aur pronouns use karte hain.

q.en: What does it mean to be an 'ally' to LGBTQ+ people?
q.hg: LGBTQ+ logon ka 'ally' hone ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Pretending to be LGBTQ+ yourself to fit in
options.hg: Fit hone ke liye khud LGBTQ+ hone ka naatak karna

options.en: Avoiding the topic to stay neutral
options.hg: Neutral rehne ke liye topic se bachna

options.en: Telling others who is LGBTQ+ in your class
options.hg: Doosron ko batana ki class mein kaun LGBTQ+ hai

options.en: Supporting their dignity and speaking up for them
options.hg: Unki izzat ka saath dena aur unke liye bolna

explain.en: An ally listens, respects people's names and privacy, refuses to laugh at mocking jokes and speaks up when it is safe. Small acts make schools and workplaces safer.
explain.hg: Ally sunta hai, logon ke naam aur privacy ki izzat karta hai, mazaak udaane wale jokes pe hansne se mana karta hai aur safe ho toh bolta hai. Chhote kadam schools aur workplaces ko safe banate hain.

q.en: A parent asks how to support a teenager who has just come out as gay. What is the best advice?
q.hg: Ek parent poochte hain ki abhi-abhi gay hone ka bataane wale teenager ka saath kaise dein. Sabse acchi salah kya hai?

options.en: Ban their phone and friends for a while
options.hg: Kuch time ke liye phone aur dost band karo

options.en: Take them to a 'cure' programme or camp
options.hg: Unhe 'ilaaj' programme ya camp mein le jao

options.en: Arrange their marriage quickly to 'fix' it
options.hg: Ise 'theek' karne ke liye jaldi shaadi karwa do

options.en: Listen, show love, and find accurate information
options.hg: Suno, pyaar dikhao, aur sahi jaankari dhoondho

explain.en: Family acceptance protects young people's mental health. 'Cures' are harmful and marriage does not change orientation. Parents can also call Tele-MANAS 14416 for guidance.
explain.hg: Family ka apnaapan young logon ki mental health ko bachata hai. 'Ilaaj' nuksaan karte hain aur shaadi se orientation nahi badalti. Parents guidance ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 pe bhi call kar sakte hain.

q.en: Who has the right to decide whom an adult woman marries?
q.hg: Ek adult mahila kisse shaadi kare, yeh tay karne ka haq kiska hai?

options.en: The woman herself
options.hg: Mahila khud

options.en: Her elder brother
options.hg: Uska bada bhai

options.en: Her father
options.hg: Uske pita

options.en: The community elders
options.hg: Samaaj ke buzurg

explain.en: The Supreme Court held in Shakti Vahini (2018) that choosing a life partner is part of individual liberty. Families can advise, but an adult's choice is her own.
explain.hg: Supreme Court ne Shakti Vahini (2018) mein kaha ki jeevan saathi chunna individual liberty ka hissa hai. Family salah de sakti hai, par adult ka faisla uska apna hai.

q.en: A family pays for their son's college but says their 19-year-old daughter must stay home. What is this?
q.hg: Ek family bete ki college fees bharti hai par 19 saal ki beti ko ghar pe rehne ko kehti hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Normal protection of daughters
options.hg: Betiyon ki normal hifaazat

options.en: Gender discrimination
options.hg: Gender discrimination

options.en: A choice that boosts her future
options.hg: Uske future ko behtar karne wali choice

options.en: A fair way to save money
options.hg: Paise bachane ka fair tareeka

explain.en: Treating children differently only because of gender limits a daughter's future. Education and freedom of movement matter for every child.
explain.hg: Sirf gender ki wajah se bachchon se alag vyavhaar beti ke future ko seemit karta hai. Padhai aur aane-jaane ki azaadi har bachche ke liye zaroori hai.

q.en: At birth, a baby's sex is usually recorded based on…
q.hg: Paidaish pe bachche ka sex aam taur par kis basis pe record hota hai?

options.en: A blood test for personality
options.hg: Personality ke liye blood test

options.en: The body parts seen at birth
options.hg: Paidaish pe dikhne wale body parts

options.en: The baby's first cry
options.hg: Bachche ka pehla rona

options.en: The parents' wishes
options.hg: Parents ki ichha

explain.en: Sex is usually 'assigned' from external anatomy at birth. Most people's gender identity matches it, but not everyone's, and some people are born with intersex variations.
explain.hg: Sex aam taur par paidaish pe bahari anatomy dekh ke 'assign' hota hai. Zyaadatar logon ki gender identity isse match karti hai, par sabki nahi, aur kuch log intersex variations ke saath paida hote hain.

q.en: A girl is told, 'Don't be so loud and ambitious, it's not ladylike.' This is…
q.hg: Ek ladki ko kaha jaata hai, 'Itni loud aur ambitious mat bano, ladkiyon ko shobha nahi deta.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A stereotype that limits girls
options.hg: Ek stereotype jo ladkiyon ko rokta hai

options.en: A scientific fact about girls
options.hg: Ladkiyon ke baare mein scientific fact

options.en: Good advice for success
options.hg: Success ke liye acchi salah

options.en: A school rule for everyone
options.hg: Sabke liye school ka rule

explain.en: Confidence and ambition are strengths in anyone. Telling girls to shrink themselves holds them back in class, sport and careers.
explain.hg: Confidence aur ambition kisi mein bhi taakat hain. Ladkiyon ko khud ko chhota karne ko kehna unhe class, sport aur career mein peeche rakhta hai.

q.en: Your uncle stays home to look after the baby while your aunt goes to work. Neighbours tease him. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhare chacha ghar pe baby sambhalte hain jab chachi kaam pe jaati hain. Padosi unhe chidhate hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Only mothers know how to raise babies
options.hg: Sirf mummy ko baby paalna aata hai

options.en: It is fine only for a few days at most
options.hg: Zyada se zyada kuch dino ke liye theek hai

options.en: He should find an office job at once
options.hg: Unhe turant office ki naukri dhoondhni chahiye

options.en: Fathers caring for babies is normal and valuable
options.hg: Papa ka baby sambhalna normal aur keemti hai

explain.en: Babies need loving care, and any parent can give it. Families decide roles that work for them; teasing a caring father reinforces old stereotypes.
explain.hg: Babies ko pyaar bhari dekhbhaal chahiye, aur koi bhi parent de sakta hai. Families apne liye sahi roles khud tay karti hain; caring papa ko chidhana purane stereotypes ko mazboot karta hai.

q.en: Someone says, 'Girls are naturally bad at maths.' What is true?
q.hg: Koi kehta hai, 'Ladkiyan naturally maths mein kamzor hoti hain.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is true, it's in girls' genes
options.hg: Sach hai, ladkiyon ke genes mein hai

options.en: Girls are good only at languages
options.hg: Ladkiyan sirf languages mein acchi hoti hain

options.en: Maths skills grow with practice, not gender
options.hg: Maths skills practice se badhti hain, gender se nahi

options.en: Girls can learn maths only up to Class 5
options.hg: Ladkiyan sirf Class 5 tak maths seekh sakti hain

explain.en: Ability comes from teaching, practice and encouragement. When girls hear they are 'bad at maths', they may stop trying, which makes the stereotype look true.
explain.hg: Kaabiliyat teaching, practice aur hausla-afzai se aati hai. Jab ladkiyan sunti hain ki woh 'maths mein kamzor' hain, toh woh koshish chhod sakti hain, jisse stereotype sach lagne lagta hai.

q.en: A boy is told, 'If someone pushes you, hit back, or you're weak.' What is true?
q.hg: Ek ladke ko kaha jaata hai, 'Koi dhakka de toh maar, warna tu kamzor hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Real boys always fight back, no matter what
options.hg: Asli ladke hamesha palat ke maarte hain, chahe kuch bhi ho

options.en: Walking away and getting help is also strength
options.hg: Wahan se hatna aur madad lena bhi taakat hai

options.en: Telling a teacher makes you a coward
options.hg: Teacher ko batana kaayarta hai

options.en: Violence is the only way to get respect
options.hg: Respect paane ka ek hi tareeka violence hai

explain.en: Strength includes self-control and solving problems safely. Fighting back can lead to injury or trouble; telling a trusted adult stops bullying more reliably.
explain.hg: Taakat mein self-control aur problems ko safely suljhana bhi aata hai. Palat ke maarne se chot ya musibat ho sakti hai; kisi bharosemand adult ko batana bullying ko zyada pakke taur pe rokta hai.

q.en: A 15-year-old feels uncomfortable with the gender they were raised as and is unsure what it means. What would help most?
q.hg: Ek 15 saal ka teen us gender ke saath uncomfortable feel karta hai jisme use paala gaya, aur samajh nahi pa raha iska matlab kya hai. Sabse zyada kya madad karega?

options.en: Forcing themselves to act more 'manly' or 'girly'
options.hg: Khud ko zyada 'mard' ya 'ladki' jaisa dikhne pe majboor karna

options.en: Searching random forums for a quick answer
options.hg: Jaldi jawab ke liye random forums dhoondhna

options.en: Talking to a trusted adult or counsellor, without rushing
options.hg: Kisi bharosemand adult ya counsellor se baat karna, bina jaldi ke

options.en: Hiding the feelings until they go away on their own
options.hg: Feelings ko chhupana jab tak apne aap chali na jaayein

explain.en: Questioning gender is okay, and a supportive person can help you think it through safely. Tele-MANAS 14416 is free and confidential if there's no one nearby to talk to.
explain.hg: Gender pe sawaal hona theek hai, aur ek supportive insaan safely sochne mein madad kar sakta hai. Agar paas koi na ho toh Tele-MANAS 14416 free aur confidential hai.

q.en: A transgender colleague joins your office. What is the respectful approach?
q.hg: Tumhare office mein ek transgender colleague join karti hai. Respectful approach kya hai?

options.en: Use her name and pronouns and treat her like any colleague
options.hg: Uska naam aur pronouns use karo aur kisi bhi colleague jaisa treat karo

options.en: Ask her about her transition over lunch on day one
options.hg: Pehle hi din lunch pe uske transition ke baare mein poochho

options.en: Ask HR to seat her separately from the team
options.hg: HR se kaho use team se alag bithaayein

options.en: Leave her out of team outings to avoid awkwardness
options.hg: Awkwardness se bachne ke liye team outings se bahar rakho

explain.en: Inclusion is simple: same courtesy, same opportunities, same privacy as everyone else. Harassment at work can be reported to HR or the appropriate committee.
explain.hg: Inclusion simple hai: wahi tameez, wahi mauke, wahi privacy jo sabko milti hai. Kaam pe harassment ho toh HR ya sahi committee ko report kiya ja sakta hai.

q.en: How is the word 'queer' often used today?
q.hg: Aaj 'queer' shabd aksar kaise use hota hai?

options.en: As the name of a medical diagnosis
options.hg: Ek medical diagnosis ke naam ki tarah

options.en: A broad label some LGBTQ+ people use for themselves
options.hg: Ek broad label jo kuch LGBTQ+ log khud ke liye use karte hain

options.en: As a word only for straight people
options.hg: Sirf straight logon ke liye shabd

options.en: As an official legal category on ID cards
options.hg: ID cards pe official legal category ki tarah

explain.en: Many people reclaim 'queer' as a broad, proud label, though some still find it hurtful. A good rule is to use the words people use for themselves.
explain.hg: Bahut log 'queer' ko ek broad, proud label ki tarah apnaate hain, par kuch ko yeh ab bhi chubhta hai. Accha rule hai: log khud ke liye jo shabd use karein wahi use karo.

q.en: What does 'lesbian' mean?
q.hg: 'Lesbian' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: A woman who wears short hair
options.hg: Aisi aurat jiske baal chhote hon

options.en: A woman who doesn't want to marry
options.hg: Aisi aurat jo shaadi nahi karna chahti

options.en: A woman who plays sports
options.hg: Aisi aurat jo sports khelti hai

options.en: A woman who is attracted to women
options.hg: Aisi aurat jo aurton se attract hoti hai

explain.en: Lesbian describes attraction, not hairstyle, hobbies or marriage plans. Stereotypes about how lesbians 'look' are often used to tease women who don't fit gender rules.
explain.hg: Lesbian attraction batata hai, hairstyle, hobbies ya shaadi ke plans nahi. Lesbians kaisi 'dikhti' hain, is baare mein stereotypes aksar un aurton ko chidhaane mein use hote hain jo gender rules mein fit nahi hoti.

q.en: What does 'heterosexual' (straight) mean?
q.hg: 'Heterosexual' (straight) ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Being attracted to people of a different gender
options.hg: Doosre gender ke logon se attract hona

options.en: Being attracted to people of the same gender
options.hg: Same gender ke logon se attract hona

options.en: Feeling no attraction to anyone at all
options.hg: Kisi se bhi bilkul attraction na hona

options.en: Having a gender identity that changes
options.hg: Badalti rehne wali gender identity hona

explain.en: Heterosexual is one sexual orientation among several. Like every orientation, it describes attraction and says nothing about a person's worth.
explain.hg: Heterosexual kai sexual orientations mein se ek hai. Har orientation ki tarah yeh attraction batata hai, insaan ki keemat ke baare mein kuch nahi kehta.

q.en: A 2014 ICRW-UNFPA survey of men in seven Indian states classified only what share of men as 'gender-equitable'?
q.hg: 2014 ke ICRW-UNFPA survey ne 7 Indian states ke kitne pratishat aadmiyon ko 'gender-equitable' maana?

explain.en: The study classified 32% of men as having 'rigid' masculinity, 45% as moderate and only 23% as gender-equitable. Attitudes are learned, which means they can also be changed.
explain.hg: Study ne 32% aadmiyon ko 'rigid' masculinity wala, 45% ko moderate aur sirf 23% ko gender-equitable maana. Soch seekhi jaati hai, matlab badli bhi ja sakti hai.

q.en: Women and queer people who post online are often trolled about their looks or identity. What can a bystander do?
q.hg: Online post karne wali aurton aur queer logon ko aksar unke looks ya identity pe troll kiya jaata hai. Ek bystander kya kar sakta hai?

options.en: Report the abuse and send the target a supportive message
options.hg: Abuse ko report karo aur target ko supportive message bhejo

options.en: Share the post so more people see the drama
options.hg: Post share karo taaki zyada log drama dekhein

options.en: Tell the target to delete their account
options.hg: Target ko account delete karne ko kaho

options.en: Join in lightly so you don't become a target
options.hg: Halka sa saath do taaki tum target na bano

explain.en: Platform reporting tools work better when many people use them, and a kind message reduces the isolation trolling causes. Threats or sexual abuse can be reported at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.
explain.hg: Platform ke report tools tab zyada kaam karte hain jab bahut log use karein, aur ek pyaar bhara message trolling se hone wale akelepan ko kam karta hai. Dhamki ya sexual abuse cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report ho sakta hai.

q.en: For a school event, teachers ask only the boys to carry benches and only the girls to decorate. What would be fairer?
q.hg: School event ke liye teachers sirf ladkon ko bench uthane aur sirf ladkiyon ko decoration karne ko kehte hain. Zyada fair kya hoga?

options.en: Keep it as is, since that is how it's always done
options.hg: Jaisa hai waisa rehne do, hamesha aise hi hota hai

options.en: Let students pick tasks by interest and ability
options.hg: Students ko interest aur kaabiliyat ke hisaab se kaam chunne do

options.en: Cancel the decorations to avoid any argument
options.hg: Behes se bachne ke liye decoration hi cancel karo

options.en: Let only the boys do both jobs to save time
options.hg: Time bachane ke liye dono kaam sirf ladke karein

explain.en: Splitting tasks by gender teaches that some skills belong to boys and others to girls. Mixing teams lets everyone learn both, and many girls can lift and many boys can decorate.
explain.hg: Gender ke hisaab se kaam baantna sikhata hai ki kuch skills ladkon ki aur kuch ladkiyon ki hain. Mixed teams se sab dono seekhte hain, aur bahut ladkiyan utha sakti hain aur bahut ladke sajaa sakte hain.

q.en: Your young cousin, a boy, wants to grow his hair long. Relatives say, 'Cut it, you look like a girl.' What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara chhota cousin, ek ladka, lambe baal rakhna chahta hai. Rishtedaar kehte hain, 'Kaat lo, ladki jaise lagte ho.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: He must cut it so others are not confused
options.hg: Doosre confuse na hon isliye kaatne hi chahiye

options.en: Long hair will make him less of a boy
options.hg: Lambe baal se woh kam ladka ho jaayega

options.en: Hair length has no gender; styles are personal choices
options.hg: Baalon ki lambai ka koi gender nahi; style personal choice hai

options.en: Only girls are allowed to have long hair
options.hg: Sirf ladkiyon ko lambe baal rakhne ki ijaazat hai

explain.en: Many men across cultures and traditions keep long hair. A hairstyle is self-expression, within reasonable school or family rules that apply to everyone, not a test of being a 'real' boy.
explain.hg: Kai culture aur paramparaon mein aadmi lambe baal rakhte hain. Hairstyle self-expression hai, school ya family ke un rules ke andar jo sab pe barabar lagte hain, 'asli' ladka hone ka test nahi.

q.en: Who can be a good class monitor or team captain?
q.hg: Achha class monitor ya team captain kaun ban sakta hai?

options.en: Only the tallest student in the class
options.hg: Sirf class ka sabse lamba student

options.en: Anyone who is fair and responsible, of any gender
options.hg: Koi bhi jo fair aur zimmedaar ho, kisi bhi gender ka

options.en: Only girls, because they are quieter
options.hg: Sirf ladkiyan, kyunki woh shaant hoti hain

options.en: Only boys, because they are natural leaders
options.hg: Sirf ladke, kyunki woh natural leaders hote hain

explain.en: Leadership is a set of skills like listening, fairness and planning, and anyone can learn them. Giving every child a turn helps them all grow.
explain.hg: Leadership kuch skills ka mel hai jaise sunna, fair rehna aur planning, aur koi bhi inhe seekh sakta hai. Har bachche ko mauka dene se sab aage badhte hain.

q.en: In the school play, a girl is cast as the king. Some parents object. What is true?
q.hg: School play mein ek ladki ko raja ka role milta hai. Kuch parents objection karte hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Any student can play any role; acting is pretending
options.hg: Koi bhi student koi bhi role kar sakta hai; acting naatak hai

options.en: Girls must only play female characters
options.hg: Ladkiyan sirf female characters hi karein

options.en: The role should go to the tallest boy
options.hg: Role sabse lambe ladke ko milna chahiye

options.en: It will confuse the girl about her gender
options.hg: Isse ladki apne gender ko lekar confuse ho jaayegi

explain.en: Theatre has long had actors playing roles of another gender. Playing a king doesn't change who the girl is; it lets her practise confidence and stage skills.
explain.hg: Theatre mein lambe samay se actors doosre gender ke roles karte aaye hain. Raja ka role karne se ladki kaun hai yeh nahi badalta; isse woh confidence aur stage skills seekhti hai.

q.en: A friend says, 'Men can't be abused by a girlfriend or wife.' What is true?
q.hg: Ek dost kehta hai, 'Aadmiyon ka girlfriend ya wife abuse nahi kar sakti.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Anyone can face abuse in a relationship, men included
options.hg: Rishte mein koi bhi abuse jhel sakta hai, aadmi bhi

options.en: A man who is abused should keep it secret
options.hg: Jis aadmi ka abuse ho use chhupa ke rakhna chahiye

options.en: Only physical hitting counts as abuse
options.hg: Sirf maar-peet hi abuse maani jaati hai

options.en: Men are too strong to ever be abused
options.hg: Aadmi itne strong hain ki unka abuse ho hi nahi sakta

explain.en: Abuse can be emotional, controlling or physical, and it can happen to anyone. Shame stops many men from speaking up; talking to someone or calling Tele-MANAS 14416 is a good first step.
explain.hg: Abuse emotional, control karne wala ya physical ho sakta hai, aur kisi ke saath bhi ho sakta hai. Sharm ki wajah se bahut aadmi nahi bolte; kisi se baat karna ya Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karna accha pehla kadam hai.

q.en: On 1 July 2024 the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) came into force. Which old law did it replace?
q.hg: 1 July 2024 se Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) lagu hui. Isne kaunsa purana law replace kiya?

options.en: The POCSO Act
options.hg: POCSO Act

options.en: The Indian Evidence Act
options.hg: Indian Evidence Act

options.en: The Indian Penal Code (IPC)
options.hg: Indian Penal Code (IPC)

options.en: The Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC)
options.hg: Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC)

explain.en: Three new laws started on 1 July 2024: the BNS replaced the IPC, the BNSS replaced the CrPC (police and court procedure), and the BSA replaced the Evidence Act. POCSO is a separate law and still applies.
explain.hg: 1 July 2024 se teen naye laws aaye: BNS ne IPC ki jagah li, BNSS ne CrPC ki (police aur court ka procedure), aur BSA ne Evidence Act ki. POCSO alag law hai aur abhi bhi lagu hai.

q.en: Which new law replaced the Indian Evidence Act, 1872?
q.hg: Indian Evidence Act, 1872 ki jagah kaunsa naya law aaya?

options.en: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS)
options.hg: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS)

options.en: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA)
options.hg: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA)

options.en: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)
options.hg: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)

options.en: Information Technology Act
options.hg: Information Technology Act

explain.en: 'Sakshya' means evidence. The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 took over from the Evidence Act on 1 July 2024. It decides what counts as proof in court, including rules that protect survivors.
explain.hg: 'Sakshya' ka matlab hai saboot. Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 ne 1 July 2024 se Evidence Act ki jagah li. Court mein kya saboot maana jaayega, yeh wahi decide karta hai, survivors ko protect karne wale rules bhi.

q.en: A crime happened in May 2024, but the case is filed in 2025. Under which code is the offence itself usually charged?
q.hg: Ek crime May 2024 mein hua, par case 2025 mein file hua. Offence aam taur par kis code ke under charge hoga?

options.en: Neither, because the case lapses when the law changes
options.hg: Koi nahi, law badalne se case khatam ho jaata hai

options.en: The BNS, since the case was filed after 1 July 2024
options.hg: BNS, kyunki case 1 July 2024 ke baad file hua

options.en: The IPC, since the crime happened before 1 July 2024
options.hg: IPC, kyunki crime 1 July 2024 se pehle hua

options.en: Whichever code the police officer prefers
options.hg: Jo code police officer ko pasand ho

explain.en: Crimes committed before 1 July 2024 are still prosecuted under the IPC, even if reported later. A law change does not wipe out old crimes, so it is never 'too late because the law changed'.
explain.hg: 1 July 2024 se pehle hue crimes ka case ab bhi IPC ke under chalta hai, chahe report baad mein ho. Law badalne se purane crimes khatam nahi hote, toh 'law badal gaya, ab kuch nahi ho sakta' sach nahi hai.

q.en: At the police station, the officer says, 'This happened in another area. Go to the station there.' What does the law say?
q.hg: Police station pe officer bolta hai, 'Yeh doosre area mein hua hai, wahan ke thane jao.' Law kya kehta hai?

options.en: He is right; only that area's station can take it
options.hg: Woh sahi hai, sirf us area ka thana hi le sakta hai

options.en: You can only complain online in such cases
options.hg: Aise case mein sirf online complaint ho sakti hai

options.en: You first need a lawyer's letter to file anywhere
options.hg: Kahin bhi file karne se pehle lawyer ka letter chahiye

options.en: He must register it here, wherever it happened (Zero FIR)
options.hg: Use yahin register karna padega, chahe crime kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR)

explain.en: Under Section 173 of the BNSS, any police station must record information about a cognizable offence 'irrespective of the area where the offence is committed'. This is called a Zero FIR. You do not have to run from station to station.
explain.hg: BNSS ke Section 173 ke under koi bhi police station cognizable offence ki information record karega, 'chahe offence kisi bhi area mein hua ho'. Ise Zero FIR kehte hain. Aapko ek thane se doosre thane bhaagne ki zaroorat nahi.

q.en: What is a 'Zero FIR'?
q.hg: 'Zero FIR' kya hota hai?

options.en: An FIR that lists zero charges until proof arrives
options.hg: Aisi FIR jisme saboot aane tak zero charges hote hain

options.en: An FIR any police station must register, wherever the crime happened
options.hg: Aisi FIR jo koi bhi police station register karega, crime kahin bhi hua ho

options.en: An FIR used only for small crimes like theft or a lost phone
options.hg: Aisi FIR jo sirf choti crimes jaise chori ya phone khone ke liye hoti hai

options.en: A complaint the police may ignore if there is no witness
options.hg: Aisi complaint jo witness na ho toh police ignore kar sakti hai

explain.en: A Zero FIR lets a survivor report at the nearest or safest police station without arguing about jurisdiction. The BNSS (Section 173) makes this a legal duty for every police station.
explain.hg: Zero FIR se survivor sabse paas wale ya safe police station pe report kar sakti hai, jurisdiction ki behes ke bina. BNSS (Section 173) ise har police station ki legal duty banata hai.

q.en: You report a crime to the police by e-mail or an online portal (an e-FIR). Under the BNSS, what has to happen next?
q.hg: Aap police ko e-mail ya online portal se crime report karte ho (e-FIR). BNSS ke hisaab se aage kya hona zaroori hai?

options.en: You sign it within 3 days so it is taken on record
options.hg: 3 din ke andar aap use sign karte ho taaki woh record pe aaye

options.en: Nothing, online reports are only for traffic fines
options.hg: Kuch nahi, online report sirf traffic challan ke liye hoti hai

options.en: You must appear before a judge within 24 hours
options.hg: 24 ghante mein judge ke saamne aana padega

options.en: It counts only if a lawyer sends it for you
options.hg: Woh tabhi maani jaayegi jab lawyer bheje

explain.en: Section 173 of the BNSS allows information by electronic communication (e-FIR), which must be signed within 3 days. It is a real way to report, not a lesser one.
explain.hg: BNSS ka Section 173 electronic communication se information dene deta hai (e-FIR), jise 3 din ke andar sign karna hota hai. Yeh report karne ka asli tareeka hai, koi chhota option nahi.

q.en: Does a victim have to pay to get a copy of the FIR?
q.hg: Kya victim ko FIR ki copy ke liye paise dene padte hain?

options.en: Only if she has hired a lawyer
options.hg: Sirf tab jab usne lawyer kiya ho

options.en: Yes, there is a fixed court fee for it
options.hg: Haan, uski fixed court fee hoti hai

options.en: Copies are given only after the trial ends
options.hg: Copy sirf trial khatam hone ke baad milti hai

options.en: No, the copy must be given free of cost
options.hg: Nahi, copy free mein deni hoti hai

explain.en: Under Section 173 of the BNSS the informant or victim must get a free copy of the FIR. Keep it safe; it has the FIR number you will need to follow up.
explain.hg: BNSS ke Section 173 ke under informant ya victim ko FIR ki copy free milni chahiye. Ise sambhal ke rakho, isme FIR number hota hai jo follow-up mein kaam aata hai.

q.en: A woman goes to the police to report that a man is stalking her. Under the BNSS, who should record her complaint?
q.hg: Ek mahila police ke paas report karne jaati hai ki ek aadmi use stalk kar raha hai. BNSS ke hisaab se uski complaint kaun record kare?

options.en: Only a magistrate, never the police
options.hg: Sirf magistrate, police kabhi nahi

options.en: A woman police officer or woman officer
options.hg: Ek woman police officer ya mahila officer

options.en: The most senior male officer present
options.hg: Wahan maujood sabse senior male officer

options.en: Any constable who is at the front desk
options.hg: Front desk pe baitha koi bhi constable

explain.en: Section 173 of the BNSS says complaints by a woman about rape, sexual harassment, stalking, voyeurism or acid attack are to be recorded by a woman police officer or woman officer. You can ask for one.
explain.hg: BNSS ka Section 173 kehta hai ki rape, sexual harassment, stalking, voyeurism ya acid attack ki mahila ki complaint woman police officer ya mahila officer record karegi. Aap iski maang kar sakti ho.

q.en: Where can the police record a rape survivor's statement under the BNSS?
q.hg: BNSS ke under police rape survivor ka statement kahan record kar sakti hai?

options.en: Only inside the police station, in the lock-up area
options.hg: Sirf police station ke andar, lock-up ke paas

options.en: Only in a courtroom with the accused present
options.hg: Sirf courtroom mein, accused ke saamne

options.en: At her home or a place of her choice, where practicable
options.hg: Uske ghar ya uski pasand ki jagah pe, jahan tak ho sake

options.en: Only at a government hospital, nowhere else
options.hg: Sirf sarkari hospital mein, aur kahin nahi

explain.en: Section 176 of the BNSS says a rape survivor's statement is to be taken at her home or a place of her choice, as far as practicable by a woman officer. The idea is to make reporting less frightening.
explain.hg: BNSS ka Section 176 kehta hai ki rape survivor ka statement uske ghar ya uski pasand ki jagah pe liya jaaye, jahan tak ho sake woman officer dwara. Maqsad hai ki report karna kam darawna ho.

q.en: Under Section 176 of the BNSS, how may a rape survivor's statement to the police be recorded?
q.hg: BNSS ke Section 176 ke under rape survivor ka police statement kaise record ho sakta hai?

options.en: Only on stamp paper signed before a notary
options.hg: Sirf stamp paper pe, notary ke saamne sign karke

options.en: Only after the accused has been arrested
options.hg: Sirf accused ke arrest hone ke baad

options.en: Only in handwriting by the station head
options.hg: Sirf station head ki handwriting mein

options.en: On video, which can include a mobile phone
options.hg: Video pe, jisme mobile phone bhi shaamil hai

explain.en: The BNSS allows the statement to be recorded by audio-video means, including a mobile phone. A recording can reduce how often a survivor has to repeat a painful account.
explain.hg: BNSS statement ko audio-video se record karne deta hai, mobile phone se bhi. Recording hone se survivor ko baar-baar dardnaak baat dohrani nahi padti.

q.en: A survivor has a disability. Under the BNSS, how should her complaint of a sexual offence be recorded?
q.hg: Ek survivor ko disability hai. BNSS ke hisaab se uski sexual offence ki complaint kaise record honi chahiye?

options.en: At the police station in writing, the same way as anyone else
options.hg: Police station pe likhit mein, baaki sab ki tarah

options.en: Only after a court has appointed a legal guardian to act for her
options.hg: Sirf tab jab court uske liye legal guardian appoint kar de

options.en: At her home or chosen place, with an interpreter or special educator, on video
options.hg: Uske ghar ya pasand ki jagah, interpreter ya special educator ke saath, video pe

options.en: Only through her husband or father, who will speak on her behalf
options.hg: Sirf uske pati ya pita ke zariye, jo uski taraf se bolenge

explain.en: For a survivor with a disability, the FIR must be recorded at her home or a place of her choice, with an interpreter or special educator, and videographed. She speaks for herself, with support.
explain.hg: Disability wali survivor ke liye FIR uske ghar ya pasand ki jagah pe, interpreter ya special educator ke saath record honi chahiye, aur video bhi banega. Woh khud apni baat kehti hai, support ke saath.

q.en: Police refuse to register a rape complaint and tell the family to 'settle it at home'. Which is true?
q.hg: Police rape ki complaint register karne se mana karti hai aur family ko 'ghar pe settle karo' bolti hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Only a lawyer can file the complaint after a refusal
options.hg: Mana hone ke baad sirf lawyer complaint file kar sakta hai

options.en: The family must wait 7 days and then try again
options.hg: Family ko 7 din ruk ke phir try karna hoga

options.en: Refusing to record it is itself a crime for the officer
options.hg: Complaint record na karna officer ke liye khud ek crime hai

options.en: Police can refuse if the accused is a powerful person
options.hg: Accused powerful ho toh police mana kar sakti hai

explain.en: Under Section 199 of the BNS, a police officer who fails to record information about rape, sexual assault, acid attack or trafficking faces 6 months to 2 years in prison. Rape cannot be 'settled at home'.
explain.hg: BNS ke Section 199 ke under jo police officer rape, sexual assault, acid attack ya trafficking ki information record nahi karta, use 6 mahine se 2 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai. Rape 'ghar pe settle' nahi hota.

q.en: If a police station will not register your complaint about a cognizable offence, whom can you write to next under the BNSS?
q.hg: Agar police station aapki cognizable offence ki complaint register nahi karta, toh BNSS ke hisaab se aage kise likh sakte ho?

options.en: The accused person's employer
options.hg: Accused ke employer ko

options.en: The bank where you hold an account
options.hg: Jis bank mein aapka account hai

options.en: The local municipal corporation
options.hg: Local municipal corporation ko

options.en: The Superintendent of Police (SP)
options.hg: Superintendent of Police (SP) ko

explain.en: Section 173(4) of the BNSS lets a complainant send the information to the Superintendent of Police, and after that approach a Magistrate. Keep a copy of what you send. This is general information, not legal advice.
explain.hg: BNSS ka Section 173(4) complainant ko information Superintendent of Police ko bhejne deta hai, aur uske baad Magistrate ke paas jaa sakte ho. Jo bhejo uski copy rakho. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

q.en: A rape survivor is brought to a private hospital. The staff ask for a deposit before treating her. What does the law say?
q.hg: Ek rape survivor ko private hospital laaya jaata hai. Staff ilaaj se pehle deposit maangta hai. Law kya kehta hai?

options.en: Treatment can start only after an FIR is filed
options.hg: Ilaaj sirf FIR file hone ke baad shuru ho sakta hai

options.en: Every hospital must treat her at once, free of cost
options.hg: Har hospital ko turant aur free ilaaj karna hoga

options.en: Only government hospitals have to treat her for free
options.hg: Sirf sarkari hospital ko free ilaaj karna hota hai

options.en: A private hospital may ask for a deposit first
options.hg: Private hospital pehle deposit maang sakta hai

explain.en: Section 397 of the BNSS obliges every hospital, public or private, to give immediate free first aid or treatment to survivors of rape, acid attack and POCSO offences. No FIR is needed first; the hospital informs the police.
explain.hg: BNSS ka Section 397 har hospital, sarkari ho ya private, ko rape, acid attack aur POCSO survivors ka turant free first aid ya ilaaj karne ko bolta hai. Pehle FIR ki zaroorat nahi; hospital khud police ko inform karta hai.

q.en: What can happen to a hospital in-charge who refuses free treatment to a rape or acid-attack survivor?
q.hg: Jo hospital in-charge rape ya acid-attack survivor ko free ilaaj dene se mana kare, uske saath kya ho sakta hai?

options.en: Only a warning letter from the hospital board
options.hg: Sirf hospital board ka warning letter

options.en: Up to 1 year in prison under the BNS
options.hg: BNS ke under 1 saal tak ki jail

options.en: A small fine paid to the patient's family
options.hg: Patient ki family ko chhota sa fine

options.en: Nothing, as free treatment is only advice
options.hg: Kuch nahi, free ilaaj sirf ek salah hai

explain.en: Section 200 of the BNS makes refusing free treatment to a rape or acid-attack survivor an offence, punishable with up to 1 year in prison. Free treatment is a legal duty, not a favour.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 200 rape ya acid-attack survivor ko free ilaaj se mana karna offence banata hai, jiski saza 1 saal tak ki jail hai. Free ilaaj legal duty hai, ehsaan nahi.

q.en: Under the BNSS, a rape survivor's medical examination can be done…
q.hg: BNSS ke under rape survivor ka medical examination…

options.en: Only with her consent
options.hg: Sirf uski consent se ho sakta hai

options.en: Even if she refuses, on police orders
options.hg: Woh mana kare tab bhi, police ke order pe

options.en: Only by her own family doctor
options.hg: Sirf uske family doctor se

options.en: Only after a court case has been filed
options.hg: Sirf court case file hone ke baad

explain.en: Section 184 of the BNSS says the medical examination needs her consent and should preferably be done by a government doctor. Her body, her decision, even during an investigation.
explain.hg: BNSS ka Section 184 kehta hai ki medical examination ke liye uski consent zaroori hai, aur behtar hai sarkari doctor kare. Investigation ke dauran bhi, body uski, faisla uska.

q.en: What did the Supreme Court say in 2022 about the 'two-finger test' on rape survivors?
q.hg: 2022 mein Supreme Court ne rape survivors pe 'two-finger test' ke baare mein kya kaha?

options.en: It is allowed if the survivor's family agrees
options.hg: Family maan jaaye toh allowed hai

options.en: It is needed as proof in every rape case
options.hg: Har rape case mein proof ke liye zaroori hai

options.en: It is optional and up to private hospitals
options.hg: Yeh optional hai, private hospital decide karein

options.en: It has no scientific basis, and doing it is misconduct
options.hg: Iska koi scientific basis nahi, aur ise karna misconduct hai

explain.en: In State of Jharkhand v. Shailendra Kumar Rai (2022) the Supreme Court said the test 're-victimizes and re-traumatizes' women and that anyone who conducts it is guilty of misconduct. It cannot show whether someone has had sex.
explain.hg: State of Jharkhand v. Shailendra Kumar Rai (2022) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki yeh test mahilaon ko 'phir se victim aur phir se trauma' deta hai, aur jo ise kare woh misconduct ka doshi hai. Isse yeh pata nahi chal sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya ya nahi.

q.en: A news channel plans to hide a rape survivor's name but show her village and her school. Is that allowed?
q.hg: Ek news channel rape survivor ka naam chhupa ke uska gaon aur school dikhane wala hai. Kya yeh allowed hai?

options.en: Yes, if the police give permission
options.hg: Haan, agar police permission de

options.en: Yes, as long as her name stays hidden
options.hg: Haan, jab tak naam chhupa hai

options.en: No, any detail that could identify her is barred
options.hg: Nahi, koi bhi detail jisse uski pehchaan ho sake, mana hai

options.en: Yes, once the trial has formally started in court
options.hg: Haan, court mein trial formally shuru hone ke baad

explain.en: Section 72 of the BNS punishes publishing a survivor's name or any detail that could identify her. The Supreme Court in Nipun Saxena (2018) said not even 'in a remote manner' can facts that identify her be disclosed.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 72 survivor ka naam ya koi bhi detail jisse pehchaan ho, publish karne pe saza deta hai. Nipun Saxena (2018) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki 'door se bhi' aisi baatein nahi batayi ja sakti jisse uski pehchaan ho.

q.en: Your friend wants to post a rape survivor's photo on Instagram 'to get her justice'. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara dost ek rape survivor ki photo Instagram pe daalna chahta hai 'usko justice dilane ke liye'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is fine because the cause is good
options.hg: Theek hai, kyunki maqsad accha hai

options.en: Posting it is a crime and can deeply harm her
options.hg: Post karna crime hai aur use bahut nuksaan ho sakta hai

options.en: It is legal on a personal account
options.hg: Personal account pe legal hai

options.en: It is fine if a justice hashtag is added
options.hg: Justice wala hashtag laga do toh theek hai

explain.en: Identifying a survivor is punishable with up to 2 years under Section 72 of the BNS, whatever the intention. You can support justice by sharing helplines and facts, never her identity.
explain.hg: Survivor ki pehchaan batana BNS ke Section 72 ke under 2 saal tak ki saza wala crime hai, iraada kuch bhi ho. Justice ke liye helplines aur facts share karo, uski pehchaan kabhi nahi.

q.en: A rape survivor has died. Can her family alone allow the media to publish her name?
q.hg: Ek rape survivor ki maut ho gayi hai. Kya sirf uski family media ko uska naam chhaapne ki permission de sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, after the accused has been convicted in court
options.hg: Haan, court mein accused ke convict hone ke baad

options.en: No; only a Sessions Judge can allow it, in rare cases
options.hg: Nahi, sirf Sessions Judge kuch khaas cases mein allow kar sakta hai

options.en: Yes, once one full year has passed since her death
options.hg: Haan, uski maut ke ek poore saal baad

options.en: Yes, the next of kin can give written consent
options.hg: Haan, nazdeeki rishtedaar likhit consent de sakte hain

explain.en: In Nipun Saxena (2018) the Supreme Court said the bar applies even when the victim has died; next of kin cannot authorise disclosure unless a Sessions Judge finds justifying circumstances.
explain.hg: Nipun Saxena (2018) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki victim ki maut ke baad bhi yeh rok lagu hai; rishtedaar tab tak permission nahi de sakte jab tak Sessions Judge ko koi khaas wajah na mile.

q.en: What does it mean that rape and POCSO trials are held 'in camera'?
q.hg: Rape aur POCSO trials 'in camera' hote hain, iska matlab kya hai?

options.en: The judge decides the case over the phone
options.hg: Judge phone pe case decide karta hai

options.en: The trial is filmed and shown on TV
options.hg: Trial ki filming hoti hai aur TV pe dikhaya jaata hai

options.en: The trial takes place inside a police station
options.hg: Trial police station ke andar hota hai

options.en: The hearing is private, not open to the public
options.hg: Hearing private hoti hai, public ke liye open nahi

explain.en: Section 366 of the BNSS says rape and POCSO trials are held in camera, as far as practicable before a woman judge, and nothing about them may be published without the court's permission.
explain.hg: BNSS ka Section 366 kehta hai ki rape aur POCSO trials in camera honge, jahan tak ho sake woman judge ke saamne, aur court ki permission ke bina unke baare mein kuch publish nahi ho sakta.

q.en: In a rape trial, can the defence argue she consented because of her past sexual experience or 'character'?
q.hg: Rape trial mein kya defence yeh keh sakta hai ki usne consent diya kyunki uska past sexual experience ya 'character' aisa tha?

options.en: Yes, it is the strongest proof of consent
options.hg: Haan, yeh consent ka sabse strong proof hai

options.en: Only if she is married and lives with him
options.hg: Sirf agar woh shaadishuda hai aur uske saath rehti hai

options.en: No, that is irrelevant to consent under the BSA
options.hg: Nahi, BSA ke under consent ke liye yeh irrelevant hai

options.en: Yes, if she had a boyfriend before
options.hg: Haan, agar pehle uska boyfriend tha

explain.en: Sections 48 and 149 of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam make a survivor's character or previous sexual experience irrelevant to consent and bar such questions in cross-examination in rape cases. Consent is about that moment, with that person.
explain.hg: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam ke Sections 48 aur 149 survivor ke character ya past sexual experience ko consent ke liye irrelevant banate hain aur rape cases mein aise sawaal cross-examination mein mana hain. Consent us waqt, us insaan ke saath ki baat hai.

q.en: How does the BNS describe consent to a sexual act?
q.hg: BNS sexual act ke liye consent ko kaise describe karta hai?

options.en: Not shouting or running away
options.hg: Na chillana, na bhaagna

options.en: Being in a relationship with the person
options.hg: Us insaan ke saath relationship mein hona

options.en: An unequivocal voluntary agreement
options.hg: Ek saaf (unequivocal) aur apni marzi ka agreement

options.en: Having said yes once before
options.hg: Pehle kabhi ek baar haan bola ho

explain.en: Section 63 of the BNS defines consent as an 'unequivocal voluntary agreement', shown by words, gestures or other communication. Silence, a relationship or an old yes is not the same thing.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 63 consent ko 'unequivocal voluntary agreement' kehta hai, jo words, gestures ya kisi aur tarah se bataya jaaye. Chup rehna, relationship ya purani haan, yeh consent nahi hai.

q.en: Someone says, 'She didn't fight back, so it was consent.' What does the law say?
q.hg: Koi kehta hai, 'Usne virodh nahi kiya, toh consent tha.' Law kya kehta hai?

options.en: Consent is assumed unless she has injuries
options.hg: Jab tak chot na ho, consent maan liya jaata hai

options.en: Not physically resisting does not, by itself, mean consent
options.hg: Physically virodh na karna, sirf isse consent nahi maana jaata

options.en: Not fighting back always counts as consent
options.hg: Virodh na karna hamesha consent maana jaata hai

options.en: Only screaming for help can prove no consent
options.hg: Sirf madad ke liye chillana hi no-consent prove karta hai

explain.en: The BNS says a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting. Fear can make people freeze. The law looks for a clear, voluntary yes.
explain.hg: BNS kehta hai ki jo mahila physically virodh nahi karti, sirf is wajah se use consenting nahi maana jaayega. Darr se log freeze ho jaate hain. Law ek saaf, apni marzi ki haan dhoondhta hai.

q.en: At a party, a woman is so drunk she can barely speak. Can she give valid consent to sex?
q.hg: Party mein ek mahila itni nashe mein hai ki theek se bol bhi nahi paa rahi. Kya woh sex ke liye valid consent de sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, if they are already dating
options.hg: Haan, agar woh already date kar rahe hain

options.en: Yes, as long as she did not say no
options.hg: Haan, jab tak usne na nahi bola

options.en: No, consent while that intoxicated is not valid
options.hg: Nahi, itne nashe mein di gayi consent valid nahi

options.en: Yes, if she was flirting with him earlier that night
options.hg: Haan, agar woh us raat pehle usse flirt kar rahi thi

explain.en: Under Section 63 of the BNS, consent given while intoxicated, or when she cannot communicate consent, does not count. If someone cannot clearly say yes, the answer is no.
explain.hg: BNS ke Section 63 ke under nashe mein di gayi consent, ya jab woh consent bata hi na paaye, maani nahi jaati. Agar koi saaf haan nahi bol sakta, toh jawab na hai.

q.en: What is the age of consent for sexual activity in India?
q.hg: India mein sexual activity ke liye age of consent kya hai?

options.en: 18 years
options.hg: 18 saal

options.en: 14 years
options.hg: 14 saal

options.en: 21 years
options.hg: 21 saal

options.en: 16 years
options.hg: 16 saal

explain.en: The Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 raised the age of consent from 16 to 18, and POCSO treats everyone under 18 as a child. Sexual activity with anyone under 18 is an offence, whatever they say.
explain.hg: Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 ne age of consent 16 se 18 kar di, aur POCSO 18 se kam har insaan ko child maanta hai. 18 se kam umar ke kisi ke saath sexual activity offence hai, woh kuch bhi kahe.

q.en: A 17-year-old says she 'agreed' to sex with a 22-year-old. Under POCSO, what is true?
q.hg: Ek 17 saal ki ladki kehti hai ki usne 22 saal ke ladke ke saath sex ke liye 'haan' boli thi. POCSO ke under kya sach hai?

options.en: It is legal if they plan to marry
options.hg: Shaadi ka plan ho toh legal hai

options.en: It is still an offence, as she is legally a child
options.hg: Phir bhi offence hai, kyunki law mein woh child hai

options.en: It is legal because she agreed
options.hg: Legal hai, kyunki usne haan boli

options.en: It is legal if her parents approve of the relationship
options.hg: Legal hai agar parents rishte ko approve karein

explain.en: POCSO defines a child as anyone under 18, and a minor cannot legally consent to sex. Parents' approval or marriage plans change nothing.
explain.hg: POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai, aur minor legally sex ke liye consent nahi de sakta. Parents ki approval ya shaadi ka plan isme kuch nahi badalta.

q.en: Does the POCSO Act protect boys?
q.hg: Kya POCSO Act ladkon ko bhi protect karta hai?

options.en: Only boys under 12 years
options.hg: Sirf 12 saal se chhote ladkon ko

options.en: Only if the abuser is a woman or a stranger
options.hg: Sirf agar abuser mahila ya ajnabi ho

options.en: Yes, it protects every child under 18
options.hg: Haan, 18 se kam har bachche ko

options.en: No, it only protects girls
options.hg: Nahi, sirf ladkiyon ko

explain.en: POCSO is gender-neutral for victims: it protects any person under 18. Boys are abused too, and they deserve to be believed and helped in the same way.
explain.hg: POCSO victims ke liye gender-neutral hai: 18 se kam har insaan ko protect karta hai. Ladkon ke saath bhi abuse hota hai, aur unhe bhi utna hi believe aur help kiya jaana chahiye.

q.en: A school counsellor learns that a 15-year-old is being sexually abused by a relative. The child begs her to tell no one. What must she do?
q.hg: School counsellor ko pata chalta hai ki ek 15 saal ke bachche ka ek rishtedaar sexual abuse kar raha hai. Bachcha request karta hai ki kisi ko mat batana. Counsellor ko kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Wait until the child turns 18 to act
options.hg: Bachche ke 18 ka hone tak ruke

options.en: Report it to the police or SJPU and gently tell the child why
options.hg: Police ya SJPU ko report kare aur bachche ko pyaar se wajah samjhaye

options.en: Keep it secret, because breaking a promise to a child destroys trust
options.hg: Secret rakhe, kyunki bachche se kiya promise todna bharosa tod deta hai

options.en: Inform only the relative's own family
options.hg: Sirf us rishtedaar ki family ko bataye

explain.en: POCSO Sections 19 and 21 make reporting mandatory for anyone who knows of child sexual abuse. That is why adults cannot promise total secrecy; being honest about it helps the child trust the process.
explain.hg: POCSO ke Sections 19 aur 21 kehte hain ki child sexual abuse ka pata ho toh report karna zaroori hai. Isliye adults poori secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte; imaandari se batana bachche ka bharosa banaye rakhta hai.

q.en: Under POCSO's duty to report abuse, can a child be punished for not reporting?
q.hg: POCSO ki report karne wali duty ke under, kya report na karne pe child ko saza ho sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, up to 6 months in a juvenile home or jail
options.hg: Haan, 6 mahine tak juvenile home ya jail

options.en: Yes, but only a fine paid by the parents
options.hg: Haan, par sirf fine jo parents bharein

options.en: Only if the child is above 16
options.hg: Sirf agar child 16 se upar ho

options.en: No, the law exempts children from punishment
options.hg: Nahi, law children ko saza se chhoot deta hai

explain.en: Section 21(3) of POCSO says a child cannot be punished for not reporting. A child who speaks up late, or never, is never at fault.
explain.hg: POCSO ka Section 21(3) kehta hai ki report na karne pe child ko saza nahi ho sakti. Jo bachcha der se bole, ya kabhi na bole, uski koi galti nahi.

q.en: Under POCSO, what can happen to an adult who knows about child sexual abuse but does not report it?
q.hg: POCSO ke under, jo adult child sexual abuse ke baare mein jaanta hai par report nahi karta, uske saath kya ho sakta hai?

options.en: Nothing, reporting is only a moral duty
options.hg: Kuch nahi, report karna sirf moral duty hai

options.en: Life imprisonment in every case
options.hg: Har case mein umar qaid

options.en: Only a warning from the police
options.hg: Sirf police ki warning

options.en: Up to 6 months in jail, a fine, or both
options.hg: 6 mahine tak jail, fine, ya dono

explain.en: Failing to report under POCSO is punishable with up to 6 months, a fine or both. Heads of companies or institutions who fail to report abuse by people under them face up to 1 year.
explain.hg: POCSO mein report na karne pe 6 mahine tak ki jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain. Company ya institution ke head, jo apne neeche kaam karne walon ka abuse report na karein, unhe 1 saal tak ho sakti hai.

q.en: A school principal learns a teacher abused a student and hushes it up 'to protect the school's name'. Under POCSO, what is true?
q.hg: School principal ko pata chalta hai ki ek teacher ne student ka abuse kiya, aur woh 'school ka naam bachane' ke liye baat daba deti hai. POCSO ke under kya sach hai?

options.en: Only the teacher can ever be punished
options.hg: Saza sirf teacher ko ho sakti hai

options.en: It is a matter for the school board alone
options.hg: Yeh sirf school board ka maamla hai

options.en: She is protected as head of the school
options.hg: School head hone ki wajah se woh safe hai

options.en: She can face up to 1 year in jail and a fine
options.hg: Use 1 saal tak ki jail aur fine ho sakta hai

explain.en: POCSO punishes the head of an institution who fails to report abuse by a subordinate with up to 1 year and a fine. In 2024 the Supreme Court told courts not to go easy on schools and institutions that fail to report.
explain.hg: POCSO mein institution ka head agar apne staff ka abuse report na kare, toh 1 saal tak ki jail aur fine ho sakta hai. 2024 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki report na karne wale schools aur institutions pe narmi na ho.

q.en: When police record a child's statement in a POCSO case, which of these is the rule?
q.hg: POCSO case mein jab police bachche ka statement record karti hai, toh rule kya hai?

options.en: An officer in full uniform, at the station, to show authority
options.hg: Poori uniform mein officer, thane mein, taaki authority dikhe

options.en: Late at night at the police station, when it is quiet and private
options.hg: Raat ko der se police station pe, jab shaant aur private ho

options.en: Where practicable, a woman officer not in uniform, at a place the child chooses
options.hg: Jahan tak ho sake, bina uniform ki woman officer, bachche ki pasand ki jagah

options.en: With the accused present, so the child can point him out
options.hg: Accused ke saamne, taaki bachcha use pehchaan sake

explain.en: Section 24 of POCSO says the statement is taken at the child's home or a place of the child's choice, as far as practicable by a woman officer not in uniform, and the child must never come into contact with the accused.
explain.hg: POCSO ka Section 24 kehta hai ki statement bachche ke ghar ya uski pasand ki jagah pe liya jaaye, jahan tak ho sake bina uniform wali woman officer dwara, aur bachche ka accused se saamna kabhi nahi hona chahiye.

q.en: Which court hears cases under the POCSO Act?
q.hg: POCSO Act ke cases kaunsa court sunta hai?

options.en: The local family court
options.hg: Local family court

options.en: A designated Special Court
options.hg: Ek designated Special Court

options.en: A district consumer court
options.hg: District consumer court

options.en: The village panchayat
options.hg: Gaon ki panchayat

explain.en: POCSO requires a Special Court in each district (Section 28). Panchayats and family 'settlements' have no power to decide a sexual offence against a child.
explain.hg: POCSO har district mein Special Court maangta hai (Section 28). Panchayat ya family 'settlement' ko bachche ke khilaaf sexual offence ka faisla karne ka koi haq nahi.

q.en: In a POCSO trial, how do lawyers put questions to the child?
q.hg: POCSO trial mein lawyers bachche se sawaal kaise poochte hain?

options.en: Through the judge
options.hg: Judge ke zariye

options.en: By giving the child a written test
options.hg: Bachche ko likhit test dekar

options.en: Directly, with tough cross-examination
options.hg: Seedhe, sakht cross-examination se

options.en: Through the accused person
options.hg: Accused ke zariye

explain.en: Section 33 of POCSO says questions go through the judge, aggressive questioning and character attacks are not allowed, and the child should not be called again and again. Screens or video links can keep the accused out of sight.
explain.hg: POCSO ka Section 33 kehta hai ki sawaal judge ke zariye jaayenge, aggressive sawaal aur character pe hamla allowed nahi, aur bachche ko baar-baar nahi bulaya jaayega. Screen ya video link se accused nazar nahi aata.

q.en: In 2021 the Supreme Court overturned a 'skin-to-skin' ruling. What did it say is the key ingredient of sexual assault under POCSO?
q.hg: 2021 mein Supreme Court ne ek 'skin-to-skin' ruling palat di. Usne POCSO ke under sexual assault ka main element kya bataya?

options.en: Whether an adult witness saw it
options.hg: Kya kisi adult witness ne dekha

options.en: Sexual intent, not skin-to-skin contact
options.hg: Sexual intent, na ki skin-to-skin contact

options.en: Direct skin-to-skin contact with the child
options.hg: Bachche ke saath seedha skin-to-skin contact

options.en: Whether the child cried at the time
options.hg: Kya bachcha us waqt roya tha

explain.en: In Attorney General for India v. Satish (2021) the Supreme Court held that sexual intent, not skin-to-skin contact, is what matters. Touching a child sexually over clothes is still sexual assault.
explain.hg: Attorney General for India v. Satish (2021) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki sexual intent maayne rakhta hai, skin-to-skin contact nahi. Kapdon ke upar se bachche ko sexually touch karna bhi sexual assault hai.

q.en: Two 16-year-olds in a relationship ask a doctor about contraception and ask her to keep it secret. Why can't she promise total secrecy?
q.hg: Relationship mein do 16 saal ke teens doctor se contraception ke baare mein poochte hain aur secret rakhne ko kehte hain. Doctor poori secrecy ka promise kyun nahi kar sakti?

options.en: Doctors must always phone the school first
options.hg: Doctor ko hamesha pehle school ko phone karna hota hai

options.en: POCSO reporting duties cover sexual activity under 18
options.hg: POCSO ki reporting duty 18 se kam umar ki sexual activity pe lagti hai

options.en: Clinics need a parent's signature for any visit
options.hg: Har visit ke liye parent ka signature chahiye

options.en: Contraception is banned for anyone under 21
options.hg: 21 se kam umar walon ke liye contraception banned hai

explain.en: POCSO treats any sexual activity with a person under 18 as an offence, so doctors have a reporting duty. A good doctor says this honestly upfront and still helps keep the young person safe and informed.
explain.hg: POCSO 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sexual activity ko offence maanta hai, isliye doctor ki reporting duty hoti hai. Accha doctor yeh pehle hi imaandari se bata deta hai aur phir bhi safe aur informed rehne mein help karta hai.

q.en: A 17-year-old needs an abortion, and the doctor has to report it under POCSO. What did the Supreme Court say in 2022?
q.hg: Ek 17 saal ki ladki ko abortion chahiye, aur doctor ko POCSO ke under report karna hai. 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kya kaha?

options.en: The report need not name her if she and her guardian ask
options.hg: Agar woh aur uska guardian kahein, toh report mein uska naam dena zaroori nahi

options.en: The doctor must refuse until the police approve
options.hg: Police approve kare tab tak doctor mana kare

options.en: Her school must be told about the abortion
options.hg: Uske school ko abortion ke baare mein batana hoga

options.en: Her full name must appear in a public FIR
options.hg: Uska poora naam public FIR mein hona chahiye

explain.en: The Supreme Court said the doctor still reports under Section 19 of POCSO but need not disclose the minor's identity if she and her guardian request it. This is meant to stop girls going to unsafe, unqualified providers.
explain.hg: Supreme Court ne kaha ki doctor POCSO ke Section 19 ke under report karega, par agar minor aur guardian kahein toh uski pehchaan batana zaroori nahi. Maqsad hai ki ladkiyan unsafe, bina degree wale logon ke paas na jaayein.

q.en: Under the MTP Act (as amended in 2021), an abortion up to 20 weeks of pregnancy needs…
q.hg: MTP Act (2021 amendment ke baad) ke under 20 hafte tak ki pregnancy ka abortion ke liye kya chahiye?

options.en: The opinion of one registered doctor
options.hg: Ek registered doctor ki opinion

options.en: The husband's written consent
options.hg: Pati ki likhit consent

options.en: Approval from a Medical Board
options.hg: Medical Board ki approval

options.en: An order from a district court
options.hg: District court ka order

explain.en: Up to 20 weeks, one registered medical practitioner's opinion is enough. From 20 to 24 weeks, specified categories need two doctors; beyond 24 weeks only a Medical Board can approve, for substantial foetal abnormality.
explain.hg: 20 hafte tak ek registered doctor ki opinion kaafi hai. 20 se 24 hafte tak kuch categories ke liye do doctors chahiye; 24 hafte ke baad sirf Medical Board, gambhir foetal abnormality ke liye.

q.en: A married woman, 26, wants an abortion at 8 weeks. Her husband objects. Legally, whose consent is needed?
q.hg: Ek 26 saal ki shaadishuda mahila 8 hafte pe abortion chahti hai. Pati mana karta hai. Law ke hisaab se kiski consent chahiye?

options.en: Only her own consent
options.hg: Sirf uski apni consent

options.en: Her in-laws' approval
options.hg: Sasural walon ki approval

options.en: Her husband's written signature
options.hg: Pati ka likhit signature

options.en: A court's permission first
options.hg: Pehle court ki permission

explain.en: Under the MTP Act an adult woman's own consent is the only consent needed; a guardian's consent is required only if she is under 18. The law does not ask for a husband's consent.
explain.hg: MTP Act ke under adult mahila ki apni consent hi kaafi hai; guardian ki consent sirf tab chahiye jab woh 18 se kam ho. Law pati ki consent nahi maangta.

q.en: Can an unmarried woman get a legal abortion in India?
q.hg: Kya India mein ek unmarried mahila legal abortion karwa sakti hai?

options.en: Only with a parent's consent at any age
options.hg: Sirf parent ki consent se, umar kuch bhi ho

options.en: Yes, the law applies to married and unmarried women
options.hg: Haan, law shaadishuda aur unmarried dono pe lagu hai

options.en: No, abortion is only for married women
options.hg: Nahi, abortion sirf shaadishuda mahilaon ke liye hai

options.en: Only if she was formally engaged to be married
options.hg: Sirf agar shaadi ke liye uski formal sagai hui thi

explain.en: The 2021 amendment changed 'married woman or her husband' to 'any woman or her partner', and in 2022 the Supreme Court said unmarried women have the same rights up to 24 weeks. Only a minor needs a guardian's consent.
explain.hg: 2021 amendment ne 'married woman or her husband' ko 'any woman or her partner' kar diya, aur 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki unmarried mahilaon ke 24 hafte tak same rights hain. Sirf minor ko guardian ki consent chahiye.

q.en: Between 20 and 24 weeks of pregnancy, when does the MTP Act allow an abortion?
q.hg: Pregnancy ke 20 se 24 hafte ke beech MTP Act abortion kab allow karta hai?

options.en: Only for married women, with the husband's consent
options.hg: Sirf shaadishuda, pati ki consent ke saath

options.en: For listed groups, like rape survivors and minors, with two doctors
options.hg: Listed groups, jaise rape survivors aur minors, ke liye do doctors ke saath

options.en: Never, the legal limit is strictly 20 weeks for all
options.hg: Kabhi nahi, sabke liye legal limit sakhti se 20 hafte hai

options.en: For any woman, with the opinion of one doctor
options.hg: Kisi bhi mahila ke liye, ek doctor ki opinion se

explain.en: The 2021 rules list categories such as survivors of sexual assault, rape or incest, minors, women whose marital status changes, and women with major physical disabilities. At least two registered doctors must agree.
explain.hg: 2021 ke rules mein categories hain jaise sexual assault, rape ya incest survivors, minors, jinki marital status badal gayi, aur badi physical disability wali mahilayein. Kam se kam do registered doctors ki sahmati chahiye.

q.en: A 16-year-old needs an abortion. Under the MTP Act, whose written consent is required?
q.hg: Ek 16 saal ki ladki ko abortion chahiye. MTP Act ke under kiski likhit consent zaroori hai?

options.en: Her school principal's
options.hg: School principal ki

options.en: Her guardian's
options.hg: Uske guardian ki

options.en: The local police station's
options.hg: Local police station ki

options.en: No one's, not even hers
options.hg: Kisi ki nahi, uski bhi nahi

explain.en: Under the MTP Act a guardian's written consent is required for anyone under 18. Because of POCSO, the doctor also has a duty to report, though the minor's identity can be kept out of the report if she and her guardian ask.
explain.hg: MTP Act ke under 18 se kam umar ke liye guardian ki likhit consent zaroori hai. POCSO ki wajah se doctor ko report bhi karna hota hai, par minor aur guardian kahein toh report mein uski pehchaan nahi di jaati.

q.en: In 2022 the Supreme Court said 'rape' in the MTP Act includes marital rape. What does that mean?
q.hg: 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki MTP Act mein 'rape' mein marital rape bhi shaamil hai. Iska matlab kya hai?

options.en: Husbands must now sign every abortion form for their wives
options.hg: Ab har abortion form pe pati ka sign zaroori hai

options.en: A wife made pregnant by forced sex can seek abortion up to 24 weeks
options.hg: Zabardasti sex se pregnant hui patni 24 hafte tak abortion le sakti hai

options.en: Marital rape became a crime under the BNS from that day
options.hg: Usi din se marital rape BNS mein crime ban gaya

options.en: Married women lost the right to abort after 20 weeks
options.hg: Shaadishuda mahilaon ka 20 hafte ke baad ka haq khatam hua

explain.en: In X v. Principal Secretary (2022) the Court applied this only to the abortion law: a married woman can seek termination as a rape survivor without an FIR. It did not change the criminal-law exception, which is a separate pending case.
explain.hg: X v. Principal Secretary (2022) mein Court ne yeh sirf abortion law pe lagu kiya: shaadishuda mahila bina FIR ke rape survivor ke taur pe termination maang sakti hai. Criminal law ka exception isse nahi badla, woh alag pending case hai.

q.en: Does a rape survivor need to file an FIR before getting an abortion under the MTP Act's rape ground?
q.hg: Kya MTP Act ke rape wale ground pe abortion se pehle rape survivor ko FIR file karna zaroori hai?

options.en: No, no FIR or court finding is needed
options.hg: Nahi, FIR ya court ka faisla zaroori nahi

options.en: Yes, plus the accused must be convicted
options.hg: Haan, aur accused convict bhi hona chahiye

options.en: Yes, an FIR must be filed first
options.hg: Haan, pehle FIR file karni hogi

options.en: Only if she is unmarried
options.hg: Sirf agar woh unmarried hai

explain.en: The MTP Act presumes that a pregnancy from rape gravely harms mental health. The Supreme Court said in 2022 that no FIR, court finding or conviction is needed before a woman can rely on it. For minors, POCSO reporting still applies.
explain.hg: MTP Act maanta hai ki rape se hui pregnancy mental health ko gambhir nuksaan deti hai. 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki iske liye FIR, court ka faisla ya conviction zaroori nahi. Minors ke liye POCSO reporting phir bhi lagu hai.

q.en: Can a doctor reveal the name of a woman whose pregnancy was terminated?
q.hg: Kya doctor us mahila ka naam bata sakta hai jiska abortion hua?

options.en: Yes, to her family if they ask
options.hg: Haan, family pooche toh

options.en: No, except to a person authorised by law
options.hg: Nahi, sirf law dwara authorised insaan ko

options.en: Yes, to her employer for leave records
options.hg: Haan, chhutti ke record ke liye employer ko

options.en: Yes, to her college if she is a student
options.hg: Haan, student ho toh college ko
