explain.en: Section 5A of the MTP Act, added in 2021, bars a doctor from revealing her name or details except to someone authorised by law, with up to a year in prison for breaking it.
explain.hg: MTP Act ka Section 5A, jo 2021 mein juda, doctor ko uska naam ya details batane se rokta hai, sirf law dwara authorised insaan ko chhod ke; todne pe 1 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai.

q.en: Under the MTP Act, who can legally end a pregnancy?
q.hg: MTP Act ke under legally pregnancy kaun khatam kar sakta hai?

options.en: A registered medical practitioner at an approved place
options.hg: Approved jagah pe ek registered medical practitioner

options.en: Any trained nurse at any private clinic
options.hg: Kisi bhi private clinic ki koi bhi trained nurse

options.en: A trusted dai or traditional healer at home
options.hg: Ghar pe koi bharosemand dai ya traditional healer

options.en: Any chemist who sells the right tablets
options.hg: Koi bhi chemist jo sahi goliyan bechta ho

explain.en: Only a registered medical practitioner, at a place approved under the Act, is protected. Abortion by anyone else is punishable with 2 to 7 years. Never self-medicate; see a qualified doctor.
explain.hg: Sirf registered medical practitioner, Act ke under approved jagah pe, protected hai. Kisi aur se abortion karwana 2 se 7 saal ki saza wala offence hai. Khud se dawai mat lo; qualified doctor ke paas jao.

q.en: Under the BNS today, is forced sex by a husband on his wife aged 18 or older legally 'rape'?
q.hg: Aaj BNS ke under, kya 18 ya usse zyada umar ki patni ke saath pati ka zabardasti sex legally 'rape' hai?

options.en: No, an exception says it isn't, and it is being challenged in the Supreme Court
options.hg: Nahi, ek exception kehta hai ki nahi hai, aur ise Supreme Court mein challenge kiya gaya hai

options.en: Yes, the BNS made it rape when it came into force in 2024
options.hg: Haan, 2024 mein BNS ne ise rape bana diya

options.en: No, and the Supreme Court has finally settled the question
options.hg: Nahi, aur Supreme Court ne yeh sawaal hamesha ke liye tay kar diya

options.en: Yes, it has been rape since the Supreme Court ruled in 2017
options.hg: Haan, 2017 ke Supreme Court faisle se yeh rape hai

explain.en: Exception 2 to Section 63 of the BNS says it is not rape if the wife is 18 or older. Petitions against it are pending before the Supreme Court. Ethically, marriage is never consent, and the Domestic Violence Act treats sexual abuse as violence.
explain.hg: BNS ke Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki patni 18 ya usse badi ho toh yeh rape nahi. Iske khilaaf petitions Supreme Court mein pending hain. Naitik roop se shaadi kabhi consent nahi hai, aur Domestic Violence Act sexual abuse ko violence maanta hai.

q.en: What did the Supreme Court decide in Independent Thought v. Union of India (2017)?
q.hg: Independent Thought v. Union of India (2017) mein Supreme Court ne kya decide kiya?

options.en: Sex with a wife under 18 is rape
options.hg: 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sex rape hai

options.en: Every child marriage is automatically void
options.hg: Har child marriage apne aap void hai

options.en: Marital rape of every wife is a crime
options.hg: Har patni ke saath marital rape crime hai

options.en: The age of consent is 16 for married girls
options.hg: Shaadishuda ladkiyon ke liye age of consent 16 hai

explain.en: Before 2017 the exception covered wives aged 15 and above. The Court read it down so that sex with a wife under 18 is rape, but expressly did not decide the question for adult wives.
explain.hg: 2017 se pehle exception 15 saal aur usse upar ki patniyon pe lagta tha. Court ne ise badal ke kaha ki 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sex rape hai, par adult patniyon ka sawaal saaf taur pe decide nahi kiya.

q.en: Under Section 67 of the BNS, what is the law when a husband has sex without consent with his wife while they are living separately?
q.hg: BNS ke Section 67 ke under, jab pati alag reh rahi patni ke saath bina consent sex karta hai, toh law kya kehta hai?

options.en: It is only a civil matter for the family court
options.hg: Yeh sirf family court ka civil maamla hai

options.en: It is a crime, punishable with 2 to 7 years
options.hg: Yeh crime hai, 2 se 7 saal ki saza

options.en: It is not a crime, as they are still married
options.hg: Crime nahi, kyunki woh ab bhi shaadishuda hain

options.en: It is a crime only if they have children
options.hg: Crime sirf tab hai jab bachche hon

explain.en: Section 67 makes it a crime with 2 to 7 years in prison, which is far below the 10-year minimum for rape of any other woman. This gap is part of the wider debate on the marital exception.
explain.hg: Section 67 ise crime banata hai, 2 se 7 saal ki jail ke saath, jo kisi aur mahila ke rape ki 10 saal ki minimum saza se kaafi kam hai. Yeh fark marital exception ki badi behes ka hissa hai.

q.en: Your married friend says her husband forces sex on her and asks what the law offers. Which is true?
q.hg: Tumhari shaadishuda dost batati hai ki uska pati uske saath zabardasti sex karta hai aur poochti hai ki law kya madad deta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Only her parents are allowed to complain for her
options.hg: Sirf uske parents uski taraf se complaint kar sakte hain

options.en: She must get a divorce before any help is possible
options.hg: Koi bhi madad se pehle use divorce lena hoga

options.en: Nothing, because marriage means permanent consent
options.hg: Kuch nahi, kyunki shaadi ka matlab hamesha ki consent

options.en: The Domestic Violence Act counts sexual abuse as domestic violence
options.hg: Domestic Violence Act sexual abuse ko domestic violence maanta hai

explain.en: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 counts sexual conduct that abuses, humiliates or degrades a woman as domestic violence and offers protection, residence and maintenance orders. She can also call 181.
explain.hg: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 aise sexual conduct ko, jo mahila ko abuse, zaleel ya neecha kare, domestic violence maanta hai aur protection, residence aur maintenance orders deta hai. Woh 181 pe bhi call kar sakti hai.

q.en: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 (PWDVA) is mainly about…
q.hg: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 (PWDVA) mainly kis baare mein hai?

options.en: Sending every abusive husband to jail for life
options.hg: Har maarne wale pati ko umar qaid dena

options.en: Fixing the value of gifts given at a wedding
options.hg: Shaadi mein diye gifts ki keemat tay karna

options.en: Civil relief like protection, residence and maintenance orders
options.hg: Civil relief jaise protection, residence aur maintenance orders

options.en: Setting out the rules and steps for getting a divorce
options.hg: Divorce lene ke rules aur steps tay karna

explain.en: The PWDVA is mainly a civil law. A woman can get orders that stop the abuse, protect her right to live in the home and secure maintenance, without having to start a criminal case.
explain.hg: PWDVA mainly civil law hai. Mahila aise orders le sakti hai jo abuse rokein, ghar mein rehne ka haq bachayein aur maintenance dilayein, bina criminal case shuru kiye.

q.en: Under the PWDVA, what happens if someone breaks a protection order?
q.hg: PWDVA ke under agar koi protection order todta hai toh kya hota hai?

options.en: The order is simply cancelled by the court
options.hg: Court order ko bas cancel kar deta hai

options.en: Nothing, as orders are only advice
options.hg: Kuch nahi, orders sirf salah hain

options.en: The woman who asked for the order is fined
options.hg: Order maangne wali mahila pe fine lagta hai

options.en: It is an offence: up to 1 year or a Rs 20,000 fine
options.hg: Yeh offence hai: 1 saal tak ya Rs 20,000 tak fine

explain.en: Breaching a protection order is one of the few criminal offences in the PWDVA, punishable with up to 1 year in prison or a Rs 20,000 fine. Report any breach to the police.
explain.hg: Protection order todna PWDVA ke gine-chune criminal offences mein se ek hai, jiski saza 1 saal tak jail ya Rs 20,000 tak fine hai. Koi bhi breach ho toh police ko report karo.

q.en: Under the Domestic Violence Act, which of these can count as domestic violence against a woman?
q.hg: Domestic Violence Act ke under inme se kya mahila ke khilaaf domestic violence maana ja sakta hai?

options.en: Only beating that leaves visible marks
options.hg: Sirf aisi maar-peet jiske nishaan dikhein

options.en: Only abuse by strangers outside the home
options.hg: Sirf ghar ke bahar ajnabiyon ka abuse

options.en: Only abuse reported within one week
options.hg: Sirf ek hafte ke andar report hua abuse

options.en: Sexual conduct by her husband that degrades her
options.hg: Pati ka aisa sexual vyavhaar jo use neecha dikhaye

explain.en: The PWDVA counts 'sexual abuse', meaning sexual conduct that abuses, humiliates, degrades or violates a woman's dignity, as domestic violence. Violence does not need visible injuries to count.
explain.hg: PWDVA 'sexual abuse', yaani aisa sexual vyavhaar jo mahila ki izzat ko thes pahunchaye, zaleel ya neecha kare, ko domestic violence maanta hai. Violence maane jaane ke liye chot dikhna zaroori nahi.

q.en: Where does a woman usually apply for a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act?
q.hg: Domestic Violence Act ke under mahila protection order ke liye aam taur par kahan apply karti hai?

options.en: With her husband's employer
options.hg: Pati ke employer ke paas

options.en: At the village panchayat
options.hg: Gaon ki panchayat mein

options.en: At a local temple trust
options.hg: Local mandir trust ke paas

options.en: Before a magistrate
options.hg: Magistrate ke paas

explain.en: Protection, residence and other civil orders under the PWDVA are sought from magistrates. A Protection Officer under the Act can help, and the women helpline 181 can guide her.
explain.hg: PWDVA ke protection, residence aur doosre civil orders magistrate se maange jaate hain. Act ke under Protection Officer madad kar sakta hai, aur women helpline 181 guide kar sakti hai.

q.en: Under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, who commits an offence?
q.hg: Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 ke under offence kaun karta hai?

options.en: No one, if both families agree
options.hg: Koi nahi, agar dono families raazi hon

options.en: Anyone who gives, takes or helps with dowry
options.hg: Jo bhi dahej deta, leta ya dilwane mein madad karta hai

options.en: Only if the amount is above Rs 1 lakh
options.hg: Sirf agar amount Rs 1 lakh se zyada ho

options.en: Only the groom's family who take it
options.hg: Sirf ladke wale jo dahej lete hain

explain.en: Giving, taking and abetting dowry are all offences under the 1961 Act, and they are non-bailable. 'Both sides agreed' is not a defence.
explain.hg: 1961 ke Act ke under dahej dena, lena aur dilwana, sab offence hain, aur non-bailable hain. 'Dono taraf raazi the' koi bachaav nahi hai.

q.en: Before the wedding, the groom's family demands a car 'or the wedding is off'. What is true?
q.hg: Shaadi se pehle ladke wale car maangte hain, 'warna shaadi cancel'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is legal if the bride's family can afford it
options.hg: Ladki wale afford kar sakein toh legal hai

options.en: It is a crime only if cash is asked for
options.hg: Sirf cash maanga ho tabhi crime hai

options.en: It is legal until the wedding takes place
options.hg: Shaadi hone tak yeh legal hai

options.en: Demanding dowry is itself a crime
options.hg: Dahej maangna khud ek crime hai

explain.en: Under the Dowry Prohibition Act, demanding dowry is punishable with 6 months to 2 years in prison and a fine. The family can report it to the police; walking away from such a demand is the bride's right.
explain.hg: Dowry Prohibition Act mein dahej maangne ki saza 6 mahine se 2 saal jail aur fine hai. Family police ko report kar sakti hai; aisi demand pe shaadi se peeche hatna ladki ka haq hai.

q.en: What is the minimum punishment for giving or taking dowry under the Dowry Prohibition Act?
q.hg: Dowry Prohibition Act mein dahej dene ya lene ki minimum saza kya hai?

options.en: 1 month of community service
options.hg: 1 mahine ki community service

options.en: 6 months, with no fine at all
options.hg: 6 mahine, bilkul fine nahi

options.en: At least 5 years in prison, plus a fine
options.hg: Kam se kam 5 saal jail, aur fine

options.en: Only a fine, never any jail time
options.hg: Sirf fine, jail kabhi nahi

explain.en: The Act sets at least 5 years and a fine of at least Rs 15,000 or the value of the dowry, whichever is more. Courts may go lower only for adequate and special reasons written in the judgment.
explain.hg: Act kam se kam 5 saal aur kam se kam Rs 15,000 ya dahej ki keemat, jo zyada ho, utna fine tay karta hai. Court isse kam sirf likhit 'adequate and special reasons' pe de sakta hai.

q.en: Under Section 80 of the BNS, a death can be a 'dowry death' if a woman dies in abnormal circumstances within how many years of marriage, after dowry-related cruelty?
q.hg: BNS ke Section 80 ke under, shaadi ke kitne saal ke andar dahej se judi cruelty ke baad asaamanya haalaat mein mahila ki maut 'dowry death' ho sakti hai?

options.en: 7 years
options.hg: 7 saal

options.en: 15 years
options.hg: 15 saal

options.en: 1 year
options.hg: 1 saal

options.en: 3 years
options.hg: 3 saal

explain.en: If such a death happens within 7 years of marriage after dowry cruelty 'soon before her death', the husband or in-laws are deemed to have caused it. The punishment is 7 years to life imprisonment.
explain.hg: Agar shaadi ke 7 saal ke andar, maut se 'kuch hi pehle' dahej cruelty ke baad aisi maut ho, toh pati ya sasural walon ko zimmedaar maana jaata hai. Saza 7 saal se umar qaid tak hai.

q.en: In-laws harass a woman every day to make her parents pay more money. Under the BNS this is…
q.hg: Sasural wale roz ek mahila ko pareshan karte hain taaki uske maa-baap aur paise dein. BNS ke under yeh kya hai?

options.en: A private family matter, not a crime
options.hg: Ghar ka maamla, crime nahi

options.en: Cruelty, punishable with up to 3 years
options.hg: Cruelty, jiski saza 3 saal tak hai

options.en: A crime only if she is physically injured
options.hg: Crime sirf tab jab use chot lage

options.en: A crime only if it happens in public
options.hg: Crime sirf tab jab public mein ho

explain.en: Harassing a woman to force her or her family to meet unlawful demands for money or property is 'cruelty' under Sections 85 and 86 of the BNS. It does not need physical injury.
explain.hg: Mahila ya uski family se paise ya property ki galat demands poori karwane ke liye pareshan karna BNS ke Sections 85 aur 86 ke under 'cruelty' hai. Iske liye physical chot zaroori nahi.

q.en: Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, a marriage is a child marriage when…
q.hg: Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 ke under shaadi kab child marriage hoti hai?

options.en: The bride is under 18 or the groom is under 21
options.hg: Ladki 18 se kam ya ladka 21 se kam ho

options.en: No religious ceremony has taken place
options.hg: Koi dharmik rasam na hui ho

options.en: The bride is under 21 or the groom under 25
options.hg: Ladki 21 se kam ya ladka 25 se kam ho

options.en: Both the bride and groom are under 16
options.hg: Ladki aur ladka dono 16 se kam hon

explain.en: The law counts a female under 18 or a male under 21 as a child for marriage. If either one is a child, it is a child marriage, whatever the custom.
explain.hg: Law shaadi ke liye 18 se kam ladki ya 21 se kam ladke ko child maanta hai. Dono mein se ek bhi child ho toh child marriage hai, rivaaj kuch bhi ho.

q.en: Your cousin, 16, is being married off next month. What can you do?
q.hg: Tumhari 16 saal ki cousin ki agle mahine shaadi karwayi ja rahi hai. Tum kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Wait till after the wedding to complain
options.hg: Shaadi ke baad complaint karna

options.en: Nothing, because it is the family's private decision
options.hg: Kuch nahi, kyunki yeh family ka private faisla hai

options.en: Only her parents are allowed to stop it
options.hg: Sirf uske parents hi rok sakte hain

options.en: Call 1098 or 112, or tell a teacher, to help stop it
options.hg: 1098 ya 112 pe call karo, ya teacher ko batao, taaki rok sakein

explain.en: Child marriage is a crime, and the Supreme Court has said prevention comes first. The Child Helpline 1098, police (112) or a trusted adult can alert officials, who can step in before the wedding.
explain.hg: Child marriage crime hai, aur Supreme Court ne kaha hai ki rokna sabse pehle hai. Child Helpline 1098, police (112) ya koi bharosemand adult officials ko bata sakte hain, jo shaadi se pehle kadam utha sakte hain.

q.en: Who can be punished under the child marriage law?
q.hg: Child marriage law ke under kise saza ho sakti hai?

options.en: No one; the marriage is simply cancelled
options.hg: Koi nahi; shaadi bas cancel hoti hai

options.en: Only the child bride, for agreeing to it
options.hg: Sirf bachchi dulhan, haan bolne ke liye

options.en: Only the priest who conducts the ceremony
options.hg: Sirf woh pandit/qazi jo rasam karwata hai

options.en: An adult groom, and anyone who performs or promotes it
options.hg: Adult dulha, aur jo bhi shaadi karwaye ya badhava de

explain.en: An adult man who marries a child, and anyone who performs, promotes or permits a child marriage, faces up to 2 years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh. The offences are cognizable and non-bailable.
explain.hg: Jo adult aadmi bachchi se shaadi kare, aur jo bhi child marriage karwaye, badhava de ya hone de, use 2 saal tak ki sakht jail aur Rs 1 lakh tak fine ho sakta hai. Yeh offences cognizable aur non-bailable hain.

q.en: A girl was married at 16. Until what age can she ask a district court to annul the marriage?
q.hg: Ek ladki ki shaadi 16 saal mein hui. Woh kis umar tak district court se shaadi radd karwa sakti hai?

options.en: 18, the day she becomes an adult
options.hg: 18 tak, jis din woh adult hoti hai

options.en: 25, seven years after adulthood
options.hg: 25 tak, adult hone ke 7 saal baad

options.en: 20, two years after turning 18
options.hg: 20 tak, yaani 18 ke do saal baad tak

options.en: Never, a marriage is permanent
options.hg: Kabhi nahi, shaadi hamesha ke liye hai

explain.en: A child marriage is voidable at the option of the person who was a child, who can petition within two years of reaching majority. For a girl, majority is 18, so the window closes at 20.
explain.hg: Child marriage us insaan ki marzi pe radd ho sakti hai jo shaadi ke waqt child tha; adult hone ke do saal ke andar petition daal sakte hain. Ladki ke liye adult umar 18 hai, toh window 20 pe band hoti hai.

q.en: A man keeps following a girl from college and messaging her even after she clearly says stop. Under the BNS this is…
q.hg: Ek aadmi college se ladki ka peecha karta hai aur uske saaf mana karne ke baad bhi message karta rehta hai. BNS ke under yeh kya hai?

options.en: Legal unless he touches her
options.hg: Legal, jab tak woh chhuye nahi

options.en: Stalking, which is a crime
options.hg: Stalking, jo crime hai

options.en: A crime only if he threatens her
options.hg: Crime sirf tab jab woh dhamki de

options.en: Just persistent love
options.hg: Bas sachcha pyaar

explain.en: Section 78 of the BNS makes stalking punishable with up to 3 years, and up to 5 years on a repeat conviction. Films often show this as romance; the law calls it a crime.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 78 stalking pe 3 saal tak ki saza deta hai, aur dobara hone pe 5 saal tak. Filmon mein ise romance dikhaya jaata hai; law ise crime kehta hai.

q.en: Does stalking law cover someone who keeps monitoring a woman's online activity and messages?
q.hg: Kya stalking law us insaan pe bhi lagta hai jo ek mahila ki online activity aur messages pe lagataar nazar rakhta hai?

options.en: Only if he hacks her account
options.hg: Sirf agar woh uska account hack kare

options.en: Only if they have never met
options.hg: Sirf agar woh kabhi mile na hon

options.en: No, only following in person counts
options.hg: Nahi, sirf saamne se peecha karna count hota hai

options.en: Yes, stalking includes online monitoring
options.hg: Haan, stalking mein online nazar rakhna bhi aata hai

explain.en: Section 78 of the BNS covers monitoring a woman's use of the internet, email or other electronic communication, not only following her. Save screenshots and report at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930, or to the police.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 78 mahila ke internet, email ya electronic communication pe nazar rakhne ko bhi cover karta hai, sirf peecha karne ko nahi. Screenshots save karo aur cybercrime.gov.in, 1930 ya police ko report karo.

q.en: Someone secretly records a woman in a changing room. This is…
q.hg: Koi changing room mein chupke se ek mahila ki recording karta hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A crime only if she is a minor
options.hg: Crime sirf tab jab woh minor ho

options.en: Voyeurism, a crime under the BNS
options.hg: Voyeurism, BNS ke under crime

options.en: Only a breach of the shop's rules
options.hg: Sirf dukaan ke rules ka ulanghan

options.en: Legal, if the video is never posted
options.hg: Legal, agar video kabhi post na ho

explain.en: Section 77 of the BNS punishes voyeurism with 1 to 3 years on first conviction and 3 to 7 years on a repeat. Recording alone is enough; it does not have to be shared.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 77 voyeurism pe pehli baar 1 se 3 saal aur dobara 3 se 7 saal ki saza deta hai. Sirf recording karna hi kaafi hai; share hona zaroori nahi.

q.en: She agreed to a private photo being taken, but never agreed to it being shared. He shares it with friends. Legally…
q.hg: Usne private photo lene ki permission di thi, share karne ki kabhi nahi. Woh use doston ko bhej deta hai. Law ke hisaab se…

options.en: It is no crime, as she agreed to the photo
options.hg: Koi crime nahi, kyunki photo ke liye usne haan boli thi

options.en: It is a crime only if he was paid for it
options.hg: Crime sirf tab jab use paise mile hon

options.en: Sharing it without her consent is still voyeurism
options.hg: Uski consent ke bina share karna phir bhi voyeurism hai

options.en: It is only a breach of trust, not a crime
options.hg: Yeh sirf bharosa todna hai, crime nahi

explain.en: Under Section 77 of the BNS, sharing a woman's private image without consent is voyeurism even if she agreed to it being taken. Consent to a photo is not consent to sharing it.
explain.hg: BNS ke Section 77 ke under mahila ki private image bina consent share karna voyeurism hai, chahe photo lene ke liye usne haan boli ho. Photo ki consent share karne ki consent nahi hai.

q.en: A neighbour keeps making sexually coloured remarks to a woman whenever she passes. Under the BNS this is…
q.hg: Ek padosi jab bhi mahila guzarti hai, uspe sexual comments karta hai. BNS ke under yeh kya hai?

options.en: Free speech, so it is allowed
options.hg: Free speech, toh allowed hai

options.en: Sexual harassment, an offence
options.hg: Sexual harassment, ek offence

options.en: A crime only inside a workplace
options.hg: Crime sirf workplace ke andar

options.en: Only bad manners, not a crime
options.hg: Sirf badtameezi, crime nahi

explain.en: Section 75 of the BNS lists sexually coloured remarks as sexual harassment, punishable with up to 1 year; other forms carry up to 3 years. It applies on the street, not only at work.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 75 sexual comments ko sexual harassment maanta hai, jiski saza 1 saal tak hai; baaki forms pe 3 saal tak. Yeh sadak pe bhi lagta hai, sirf office mein nahi.

q.en: A group of men make obscene gestures and comments at a girl at a bus stop but never touch her. Which is true?
q.hg: Bus stop pe kuch aadmi ek ladki ko gande ishaare aur comments karte hain, par chhoote nahi. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is not a crime because no one touched her
options.hg: Crime nahi, kyunki kisi ne chhua nahi

options.en: It is a crime only if she knows the men
options.hg: Crime sirf tab jab woh unhe jaanti ho

options.en: It is a crime only if it happens at night
options.hg: Crime sirf raat mein ho tab

options.en: Gestures or words meant to insult her are a crime
options.hg: Use zaleel karne wale ishaare ya shabd crime hain

explain.en: Section 79 of the BNS punishes words, gestures or acts intended to insult a woman's modesty with up to 3 years. Harassment does not need touch. Bystanders can help by calling 112.
explain.hg: BNS ka Section 79 mahila ki izzat ko thes pahunchane wale shabd, ishaare ya harkat pe 3 saal tak ki saza deta hai. Harassment ke liye chhoona zaroori nahi. Aas-paas ke log 112 pe call karke madad kar sakte hain.

q.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes tells judges to replace the term 'eve teasing' with…
q.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 ki gender stereotypes wali handbook judges ko 'eve teasing' ki jagah kaunsa shabd use karne ko kehti hai?

options.en: Romantic attention
options.hg: Romantic attention

options.en: Street sexual harassment
options.hg: Street sexual harassment

options.en: Public nuisance offence
options.hg: Public nuisance offence

options.en: Harmless street teasing
options.hg: Harmless sadak ki chhed-chhaad

explain.en: 'Eve teasing' makes harassment sound like a joke. Calling it street sexual harassment names it correctly, as a harm and an offence.
explain.hg: 'Eve teasing' harassment ko mazaak jaisa bana deta hai. Ise street sexual harassment kehna use sahi naam deta hai, ek nuksaan aur offence ke roop mein.

q.en: Under Section 69 of the BNS, sex obtained through a promise of marriage that the man never intended to keep is…
q.hg: BNS ke Section 69 ke under, shaadi ka aisa vaada karke sex karna jise aadmi ka nibhane ka koi iraada hi nahi tha, kya hai?

options.en: A crime, punishable with up to 10 years
options.hg: Crime, jiski saza 10 saal tak hai

options.en: Legal, since both were adults
options.hg: Legal, kyunki dono adults the

options.en: A crime only if they were engaged
options.hg: Crime sirf tab jab sagai hui ho

options.en: Only a civil dispute for compensation
options.hg: Sirf compensation ka civil dispute

explain.en: Section 69 is a new BNS offence covering sex by 'deceitful means', including a false promise of marriage, a job or promotion, or hiding one's identity. The key is that the promise was false from the start.
explain.hg: Section 69 BNS ka naya offence hai jo 'dhokhe' se sex ko cover karta hai, jaise shaadi, naukri ya promotion ka jhootha vaada, ya apni pehchaan chhupana. Zaroori baat yeh hai ki vaada shuru se jhootha tha.

q.en: What is the punishment under Section 124(1) of the BNS for an acid attack that causes injury or disfigurement?
q.hg: BNS ke Section 124(1) ke under chot ya chehra bigaadne wale acid attack ki saza kya hai?

options.en: Only a fine paid to the government
options.hg: Sirf sarkar ko fine

options.en: 10 years to life, plus a fine for the victim
options.hg: 10 saal se umar qaid, aur victim ke liye fine

options.en: Up to 1 year in prison, or a fine
options.hg: 1 saal tak jail, ya fine

options.en: Up to 3 years, with no fine at all
options.hg: 3 saal tak, bilkul fine nahi

explain.en: Acid attack carries at least 10 years up to life imprisonment, with the fine going to the victim for treatment. Even throwing or attempting to throw acid carries 5 to 7 years.
explain.hg: Acid attack pe kam se kam 10 saal se umar qaid tak ki saza hai, aur fine victim ke ilaaj ke liye jaata hai. Acid phenkne ki koshish pe bhi 5 se 7 saal hai.

q.en: Can a shop legally sell acid over the counter to a 16-year-old?
q.hg: Kya dukaan 16 saal ke bachche ko counter pe acid bech sakti hai?

options.en: No, sales to anyone under 18 are banned
options.hg: Nahi, 18 se kam umar walon ko bechna mana hai

options.en: Yes, if it is for toilet cleaning
options.hg: Haan, agar toilet saaf karne ke liye ho

options.en: Yes, if the child shows a school ID
options.hg: Haan, agar bachcha school ID dikhaye

options.en: Yes, in small bottles only
options.hg: Haan, sirf chhoti bottles mein

explain.en: In Laxmi v. Union of India (2013) the Supreme Court banned acid sales to anyone under 18 and required sellers to keep a register and check photo ID. In 2026 the Court said these rules had 'miserably failed' and asked for a rethink.
explain.hg: Laxmi v. Union of India (2013) mein Supreme Court ne 18 se kam umar walon ko acid bechna band kiya aur sellers ke liye register aur photo ID check zaroori kiya. 2026 mein Court ne kaha yeh rules 'miserably failed' aur dobara sochne ko kaha.

q.en: Can a survivor get compensation if the offender is never caught or no trial takes place?
q.hg: Agar offender kabhi pakda na jaaye ya trial na ho, toh kya survivor ko compensation mil sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, by applying to the Legal Services Authority
options.hg: Haan, Legal Services Authority ko apply karke

options.en: Only if she hires a private lawyer
options.hg: Sirf agar woh private lawyer kare

options.en: No, only after the accused is convicted
options.hg: Nahi, sirf accused ke convict hone ke baad

options.en: Only if the accused agrees to pay
options.hg: Sirf agar accused paise dene ko raazi ho

explain.en: Under Section 396 of the BNSS every state runs a victim compensation scheme. A victim can apply directly to the State or District Legal Services Authority even if the offender is never traced.
explain.hg: BNSS ke Section 396 ke under har state victim compensation scheme chalata hai. Victim seedhe State ya District Legal Services Authority ko apply kar sakti hai, chahe offender kabhi na mile.

q.en: Can a person accused of raping a girl under 16 get anticipatory bail?
q.hg: Kya 16 saal se kam umar ki ladki ke rape ke accused ko anticipatory bail mil sakti hai?

options.en: No, the BNSS bars it
options.hg: Nahi, BNSS ise mana karta hai

options.en: Yes, if her family agrees
options.hg: Haan, agar uski family maan jaaye

options.en: Yes, in every case
options.hg: Haan, har case mein

options.en: Yes, if it is his first offence
options.hg: Haan, agar pehla offence ho

explain.en: Section 482(4) of the BNSS bars anticipatory bail for rape of a girl under 16 and for gang rape of a girl under 18. This rule first came in with the 2018 amendment.
explain.hg: BNSS ka Section 482(4) 16 se kam umar ki ladki ke rape aur 18 se kam ki ladki ke gang rape mein anticipatory bail mana karta hai. Yeh rule pehli baar 2018 amendment mein aaya.

q.en: A court grants bail to a man accused of sexual assault on condition that the complainant ties a rakhi on him. What did the Supreme Court rule in 2021?
q.hg: Ek court sexual assault ke accused ko is shart pe bail deta hai ki complainant use rakhi baandhe. 2021 mein Supreme Court ne kya kaha?

options.en: It is allowed as long as the survivor agrees to it
options.hg: Allowed hai jab tak survivor raazi ho

options.en: Bail conditions must never require contact with the victim
options.hg: Bail ki shart mein victim se contact kabhi nahi hona chahiye

options.en: It is a good way to restore peace between families
options.hg: Families ke beech shanti laane ka accha tareeka hai

options.en: Only a High Court can set such a bail condition
options.hg: Aisi bail shart sirf High Court laga sakta hai

explain.en: In Aparna Bhat v. State of Madhya Pradesh (2021) the Supreme Court struck down that condition, ruled that bail conditions must not require or permit contact with the victim, and ordered gender-sensitisation training for judges.
explain.hg: Aparna Bhat v. State of Madhya Pradesh (2021) mein Supreme Court ne woh shart hata di, kaha ki bail ki shart mein victim se contact na ho, aur judges ki gender-sensitisation training ka order diya.

q.en: Elders suggest that a survivor should marry the man who raped her 'to save the family's honour'. What does the Supreme Court say?
q.hg: Bade-buzurg kehte hain ki survivor ko 'family ki izzat bachane' ke liye rape karne wale se shaadi kar leni chahiye. Supreme Court kya kehta hai?

options.en: It is fine as long as both families agree to it
options.hg: Theek hai jab tak dono families raazi hon

options.en: It is the solution that courts usually prefer
options.hg: Courts aam taur par yahi solution pasand karte hain

options.en: Marriage legally closes the criminal case
options.hg: Shaadi se criminal case legally band ho jaata hai

options.en: Marriage is not a remedy, and courts must not suggest it
options.hg: Shaadi koi ilaaj nahi, aur courts ise suggest nahi kar sakte

explain.en: In Aparna Bhat (2021) the Court said judges must not suggest compromise or marriage, and its 2023 handbook says marrying the rapist does not restore anyone's 'honour'. The survivor did nothing to lose honour.
explain.hg: Aparna Bhat (2021) mein Court ne kaha ki judges compromise ya shaadi suggest nahi kar sakte, aur 2023 ki handbook kehti hai ki rapist se shaadi se kisi ki 'izzat' wapas nahi aati. Survivor ne izzat khone wala kuch nahi kiya.

q.en: Someone says, 'She reported it months later, so she must be lying.' What does the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook say?
q.hg: Koi kehta hai, 'Usne mahino baad report kiya, matlab jhooth bol rahi hai.' Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook kya kehti hai?

options.en: Reports made after a week are invalid
options.hg: Ek hafte baad ki report invalid hai

options.en: Any delay proves the complaint is false
options.hg: Koi bhi der complaint ko jhootha saabit karti hai

options.en: Only same-day reports are believed
options.hg: Sirf usi din ki report maani jaati hai

options.en: A delay in reporting does not mean she is lying
options.hg: Der se report karne ka matlab jhooth nahi

explain.en: The handbook lists 'a woman who delays reporting rape is lying' as a false stereotype. Fear, shame, pressure and trauma all cause delays, especially when the abuser is someone known.
explain.hg: Handbook 'der se report karne wali mahila jhooth bol rahi hai' ko galat stereotype kehti hai. Darr, sharm, pressure aur trauma se der hoti hai, khaas kar jab abuser koi jaan-pehchaan wala ho.

q.en: According to the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook, the idea that a woman's clothes invite sexual contact is…
q.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook ke hisaab se yeh soch ki mahila ke kapde sexual contact ko 'invite' karte hain, kya hai?

options.en: True if she was out at night
options.hg: Sach, agar woh raat ko bahar thi

options.en: A false stereotype
options.hg: Ek galat stereotype

options.en: A reason to reduce punishment
options.hg: Saza kam karne ki wajah

options.en: Valid evidence of consent
options.hg: Consent ka valid saboot

explain.en: The handbook rejects the beliefs that clothing, drinking or smoking invite sexual contact. Only the person who chooses to assault is responsible.
explain.hg: Handbook yeh maanyatayein reject karti hai ki kapde, peena ya smoking sexual contact ko invite karte hain. Zimmedaar sirf woh hai jo assault karne ka faisla karta hai.

q.en: Under the POSH Act, 2013, an office with 10 or more employees must have…
q.hg: POSH Act, 2013 ke under 10 ya zyada employees wale office mein kya hona zaroori hai?

options.en: A police outpost inside the office
options.hg: Office ke andar police chowki

options.en: An Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)
options.hg: Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)

options.en: A CCTV camera at every desk
options.hg: Har desk pe CCTV camera

options.en: A women-only canteen and rest room
options.hg: Sirf mahilaon ki canteen aur rest room

explain.en: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013 requires an Internal Complaints Committee at each office or branch with 10 or more employees. Smaller workplaces are covered by the district's Local Committee.
explain.hg: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013 ke under 10 ya zyada employees wale har office ya branch mein Internal Complaints Committee chahiye. Chhote workplaces district ki Local Committee mein aate hain.

q.en: Your manager keeps sending you late-night messages with sexual comments. Where can you complain at work?
q.hg: Tumhara manager raat ko der se sexual comments wale messages bhejta rehta hai. Office mein kahan complaint kar sakte ho?

options.en: Only to the same manager who sent them
options.hg: Sirf usi manager ko jisne bheje

options.en: Nowhere, because it is after office hours
options.hg: Kahin nahi, kyunki office time ke baad hai

options.en: Only in a court, never inside the company
options.hg: Sirf court mein, company ke andar kabhi nahi

options.en: The Internal Complaints Committee under the POSH Act
options.hg: POSH Act ke under Internal Complaints Committee

explain.en: Unwelcome sexual messages from a boss are sexual harassment linked to work, wherever and whenever they arrive. Save the messages and complain in writing to the ICC; you can also go to the police.
explain.hg: Boss ke unwanted sexual messages kaam se jude sexual harassment hain, kahin bhi aur kabhi bhi aayein. Messages save karo aur ICC ko likhit complaint do; police ke paas bhi ja sakte ho.

q.en: A domestic worker is harassed by her employer in the house where she works. Where does her POSH complaint go?
q.hg: Ek domestic worker ko jis ghar mein woh kaam karti hai wahan employer pareshan karta hai. Uski POSH complaint kahan jaayegi?

options.en: The employer's own family
options.hg: Employer ki apni family

options.en: The district's Local Committee
options.hg: District ki Local Committee

options.en: Nowhere, since homes are not workplaces
options.hg: Kahin nahi, ghar workplace nahi hota

options.en: The housing society's committee
options.hg: Housing society ki committee

explain.en: The POSH Act counts a house where a domestic worker is employed as a workplace. Her complaint goes to the Local Committee, which must forward a prima facie case to the police within seven days.
explain.hg: POSH Act us ghar ko workplace maanta hai jahan domestic worker kaam karti hai. Uski complaint Local Committee jaati hai, jo prima facie case 7 din mein police ko bhejti hai.

q.en: Under the POSH Act, if a woman's complaint is against the employer himself, where does it go?
q.hg: POSH Act ke under agar mahila ki complaint khud employer ke khilaaf hai, toh woh kahan jaayegi?

options.en: The ICC that the employer set up
options.hg: Employer ki banayi ICC

options.en: The employer's personal lawyer
options.hg: Employer ka personal lawyer

options.en: The district's Local Committee
options.hg: District ki Local Committee

options.en: The company's annual general meeting
options.hg: Company ki annual general meeting

explain.en: A complaint against the employer goes to the Local Committee set up by the District Officer, because a committee the employer controls cannot fairly judge the employer.
explain.hg: Employer ke khilaaf complaint District Officer ki banayi Local Committee mein jaati hai, kyunki employer ki apni committee usi employer ka nyaay nahi kar sakti.

q.en: Within how long after the incident should a written POSH complaint usually be filed?
q.hg: Incident ke kitne time ke andar POSH ki likhit complaint aam taur par file honi chahiye?

options.en: 2 years from the incident
options.hg: Incident se 2 saal

options.en: 7 days, with no extension
options.hg: 7 din, koi extension nahi

options.en: Only on the very same day
options.hg: Sirf bilkul usi din

options.en: 3 months, extendable by up to 3 more
options.hg: 3 mahine, jo 3 aur mahine tak badh sakte hain

explain.en: The complaint is due within 3 months of the incident, or of the last one in a series. The committee can extend this by up to 3 more months if it records that circumstances prevented her from complaining earlier.
explain.hg: Complaint incident ke, ya series ke aakhri incident ke, 3 mahine ke andar deni hoti hai. Agar committee likhe ki haalaat ki wajah se woh pehle complaint nahi kar paayi, toh 3 mahine aur badha sakti hai.

q.en: Under the POSH Act, who must head an Internal Complaints Committee?
q.hg: POSH Act ke under Internal Complaints Committee ka head kaun hona chahiye?

options.en: The company's CEO
options.hg: Company ka CEO

options.en: A local police officer
options.hg: Local police officer

options.en: The accused person's manager
options.hg: Accused ka manager

options.en: A senior woman employee
options.hg: Ek senior mahila employee

explain.en: The ICC is headed by a senior woman employee, at least half its members must be women, and it must include an external member from an NGO or someone familiar with sexual harassment issues.
explain.hg: ICC ki head senior mahila employee hoti hai, kam se kam aadhe members mahilayein hon, aur ek external member NGO se ya sexual harassment ke issues jaanne wala hona chahiye.

q.en: Can a POSH complaint be settled by paying the complainant money?
q.hg: Kya POSH complaint complainant ko paise dekar settle ho sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, if the committee decides so
options.hg: Haan, agar committee aisa decide kare

options.en: Yes, that is the usual route for such cases
options.hg: Haan, aise cases mein yahi normal tareeka hai

options.en: No, money cannot be the basis of a settlement
options.hg: Nahi, paise settlement ka aadhaar nahi ho sakte

options.en: Yes, if the amount is under Rs 50,000
options.hg: Haan, agar amount Rs 50,000 se kam ho

explain.en: The Act allows conciliation only if the woman asks for it, and forbids any monetary settlement as its basis. Harassment cannot be bought off.
explain.hg: Act conciliation sirf tab allow karta hai jab mahila khud maange, aur paise ke settlement ko iska aadhaar banane se mana karta hai. Harassment ko paise se dabaya nahi ja sakta.

q.en: If a woman cannot fully prove her POSH complaint, will she be punished for a 'false complaint'?
q.hg: Agar mahila apni POSH complaint poori tarah prove na kar paaye, toh kya use 'false complaint' ki saza milegi?

options.en: Yes, she will lose her job
options.hg: Haan, uski naukri jaayegi

options.en: No; lack of proof alone is not malice
options.hg: Nahi; sirf saboot ki kami malice nahi hai

options.en: Yes, automatically, under the Act
options.hg: Haan, Act ke under apne aap

options.en: Yes, she must pay a fixed fine
options.hg: Haan, use fixed fine dena hoga

explain.en: The POSH Act says a mere inability to substantiate a complaint need not attract action against the complainant. Malicious intent has to be established through an inquiry first.
explain.hg: POSH Act kehta hai ki sirf complaint prove na kar paana complainant ke khilaaf action ki wajah nahi. Pehle inquiry se malicious intent saabit karna padta hai.

q.en: A colleague harasses you in the company cab on the way home. Is that covered by the POSH Act?
q.hg: Ghar jaate waqt company cab mein ek colleague tumhe harass karta hai. Kya yeh POSH Act mein aata hai?

options.en: No, only the office building counts
options.hg: Nahi, sirf office building count hoti hai

options.en: Only if another colleague saw it happen
options.hg: Sirf agar kisi aur colleague ne hote dekha ho

options.en: Only if it happens during office hours
options.hg: Sirf office time mein ho tab

options.en: Yes, employer-provided transport counts as workplace
options.hg: Haan, employer ki di hui transport workplace maani jaati hai

explain.en: The Act's definition of workplace includes places visited during work and transport provided by the employer, as well as hospitals, sports venues and homes where domestic workers are employed.
explain.hg: Act ki workplace ki definition mein kaam ke dauran jaane wali jagahein aur employer ki di hui transport aati hai, saath hi hospitals, sports venues aur woh ghar jahan domestic workers kaam karti hain.

q.en: Does the POSH Act protect an intern or a visitor, or only paid employees?
q.hg: Kya POSH Act intern ya visitor ko bhi protect karta hai, ya sirf paid employees ko?

options.en: Only women with at least a year of service
options.hg: Sirf kam se kam ek saal ki service wali mahilayein

options.en: Only permanent staff on the payroll
options.hg: Sirf payroll pe permanent staff

options.en: Any woman harassed at a workplace, employed or not
options.hg: Workplace pe harass hui koi bhi mahila, employed ho ya nahi

options.en: Only government employees and officers
options.hg: Sirf sarkari employees aur officers

explain.en: The Act protects a woman 'of any age whether employed or not' who alleges sexual harassment at a workplace. Interns, trainees, clients and visitors can all use it.
explain.hg: Act us mahila ko protect karta hai jo 'kisi bhi umar ki ho, employed ho ya nahi' aur workplace pe harassment ki shikayat kare. Interns, trainees, clients aur visitors sab ise use kar sakte hain.

q.en: India's POSH Act grew out of guidelines laid down by the Supreme Court in which 1997 judgment?
q.hg: India ka POSH Act Supreme Court ke kis 1997 ke faisle ki guidelines se nikla?

options.en: NALSA v. Union of India
options.hg: NALSA v. Union of India

options.en: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
options.hg: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India

options.en: Independent Thought v. Union of India
options.hg: Independent Thought v. Union of India

options.en: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan
options.hg: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan

explain.en: In Vishaka (1997) the Supreme Court laid down binding workplace sexual harassment guidelines after the gang rape of a social worker in Rajasthan. Parliament turned them into the POSH Act in 2013.
explain.hg: Vishaka (1997) mein Supreme Court ne Rajasthan mein ek social worker ke gang rape ke baad workplace sexual harassment ki binding guidelines di. Parliament ne 2013 mein inhe POSH Act banaya.

q.en: Which of these is sexual harassment at work under the POSH law?
q.hg: POSH law ke hisaab se inme se kya workplace pe sexual harassment hai?

options.en: Being asked to stay late for a deadline
options.hg: Deadline ke liye der tak rukne ko kehna

options.en: A manager giving firm feedback on your work
options.hg: Manager ka tumhare kaam pe sakht feedback

options.en: Unwelcome sexual remarks or requests for sexual favours
options.hg: Unwanted sexual comments ya sexual favours ki maang

options.en: A colleague saying no to your lunch invite
options.hg: Colleague ka lunch invite ko mana karna

explain.en: Sexual harassment means unwelcome sexually determined behaviour: physical advances, demands for sexual favours, sexually coloured remarks, showing pornography or other unwelcome sexual conduct. Tough feedback is not harassment.
explain.hg: Sexual harassment ka matlab hai unwanted sexual vyavhaar: physical advances, sexual favours ki maang, sexual comments, porn dikhana ya koi aur unwanted sexual harkat. Sakht feedback harassment nahi hai.

q.en: Under Section 63 of the BNS, can an adult man be legally recognised as a victim of 'rape'?
q.hg: BNS ke Section 63 ke under kya ek adult aadmi legally 'rape' ka victim maana ja sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, but only if he is under 21
options.hg: Haan, par sirf agar woh 21 se kam ho

options.en: Yes, the BNS made rape gender-neutral in 2024
options.hg: Haan, 2024 mein BNS ne rape gender-neutral kar diya

options.en: No, the section covers only women as victims
options.hg: Nahi, yeh section sirf mahilaon ko victim maanta hai

options.en: Yes, but only if the accused is a woman
options.hg: Haan, par sirf agar accused mahila ho

explain.en: Section 63 defines rape as an act by a man against a woman, and the BNS has no counterpart to old IPC Section 377. Boys under 18 are protected by POCSO; for adult men the gap has been raised in Parliament and the courts.
explain.hg: Section 63 rape ko mard dwara mahila ke khilaaf act maanta hai, aur BNS mein purane IPC Section 377 jaisa kuch nahi. 18 se kam ladkon ko POCSO protect karta hai; adult mardon ke liye yeh kami Parliament aur courts mein uthayi gayi hai.

q.en: In trafficking for sexual exploitation, does the victim's 'consent' change anything under Section 143 of the BNS?
q.hg: Sexual exploitation ke liye trafficking mein, kya BNS ke Section 143 ke under victim ki 'consent' se kuch badalta hai?

options.en: Only if she signed a contract
options.hg: Sirf agar usne contract sign kiya ho

options.en: Yes, consent makes it fully legal
options.hg: Haan, consent se yeh legal ho jaata hai

options.en: No, consent is immaterial to the offence
options.hg: Nahi, offence mein consent ka koi matlab nahi

options.en: Yes, consent halves the punishment
options.hg: Haan, consent se saza aadhi ho jaati hai

explain.en: Section 143 says the victim's consent is immaterial. Trafficking carries 7 to 10 years, at least 10 years when the victim is a child.
explain.hg: Section 143 kehta hai ki victim ki consent ka koi matlab nahi. Trafficking pe 7 se 10 saal ki saza hai, aur victim child ho toh kam se kam 10 saal.

q.en: A clinic offers to tell a pregnant couple the baby's sex 'for a fee'. What is true?
q.hg: Ek clinic pregnant couple ko 'fees leke' bachche ka sex batane ki offer deta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Sex determination is a crime for the clinic and those who seek it
options.hg: Sex determination clinic aur maangne wale dono ke liye crime hai

options.en: It is legal after 20 weeks of pregnancy
options.hg: 20 hafte ki pregnancy ke baad legal hai

options.en: It is legal in private clinics
options.hg: Private clinics mein legal hai

options.en: It is legal if the couple has two daughters
options.hg: Agar couple ki do betiyan hon toh legal hai

explain.en: Under the PC-PNDT Act, 1994, a doctor or clinic conducting sex determination faces up to 3 years in prison, and anyone seeking sex selection faces up to 3 years and Rs 50,000. A woman compelled to undergo it is not punishable.
explain.hg: PC-PNDT Act, 1994 ke under sex determination karne wale doctor ya clinic ko 3 saal tak ki jail, aur sex selection maangne wale ko 3 saal tak aur Rs 50,000. Jis mahila ko majboor kiya gaya, use saza nahi hoti.

q.en: Which number is the Women Helpline in India?
q.hg: India mein Women Helpline ka number kya hai?

explain.en: 181 is the Women Helpline. 1098 is the Child Helpline, 1930 is for cybercrime, 14416 is Tele-MANAS for mental health, and 112 is for any emergency.
explain.hg: 181 Women Helpline hai. 1098 Child Helpline, 1930 cybercrime ke liye, 14416 Tele-MANAS mental health ke liye, aur 112 kisi bhi emergency ke liye.

q.en: Someone is being attacked right now on your street. Which single number should you call?
q.hg: Tumhari gali mein abhi kisi pe hamla ho raha hai. Kaunsa ek number call karna chahiye?

explain.en: 112 is India's single emergency number for police, fire and ambulance. Call from a safe place and give the exact location. 1097 is the HIV helpline and 1930 is for cybercrime.
explain.hg: 112 India ka ek emergency number hai police, fire aur ambulance ke liye. Safe jagah se call karo aur exact location batao. 1097 HIV helpline hai aur 1930 cybercrime ke liye.

q.en: What is a One Stop Centre (Sakhi)?
q.hg: One Stop Centre (Sakhi) kya hai?

options.en: A shop that sells safety gadgets
options.hg: Safety gadgets bechne wali dukaan

options.en: A court that handles property disputes
options.hg: Property ke jhagde sunne wala court

options.en: A centre where women facing violence can get help in one place
options.hg: Aisa centre jahan violence jhel rahi mahilayein ek hi jagah madad le sakti hain

options.en: A police station only for traffic cases
options.hg: Sirf traffic cases wala police station

explain.en: One Stop Centres support women survivors of violence. In 2018 the Supreme Court asked every state to set up at least one in every district, and more than 900 were operating by 2026.
explain.hg: One Stop Centres violence ki survivor mahilaon ki madad karte hain. 2018 mein Supreme Court ne har state ko har district mein kam se kam ek banane ko kaha, aur 2026 tak 900 se zyada chal rahe the.

q.en: Two adults from different castes want to marry, and a village panchayat threatens them. What did the Supreme Court say in Shakti Vahini (2018)?
q.hg: Alag-alag caste ke do adults shaadi karna chahte hain, aur gaon ki panchayat unhe dhamkati hai. Shakti Vahini (2018) mein Supreme Court ne kya kaha?

options.en: Inter-caste marriage needs a court's approval
options.hg: Inter-caste shaadi ke liye court ki approval chahiye

options.en: Adults need their parents' written consent
options.hg: Adults ko parents ki likhit consent chahiye

options.en: Choosing a life partner is part of personal liberty
options.hg: Jeevan saathi chunna personal liberty ka hissa hai

options.en: Village elders' permission is legally required
options.hg: Gaon ke buzurgon ki permission legally zaroori hai

explain.en: The Court held that the right of adults to choose a life partner is a facet of individual liberty, and ordered measures to protect couples from so-called honour crimes. Threatened couples can call 112.
explain.hg: Court ne kaha ki adults ka jeevan saathi chunne ka haq individual liberty ka hissa hai, aur couples ko so-called honour crimes se bachane ke kadam uthane ka order diya. Dhamki mile toh couple 112 pe call kar sakta hai.

q.en: In 2024 the Supreme Court told courts to use which term instead of 'child pornography'?
q.hg: 2024 mein Supreme Court ne courts ko 'child pornography' ki jagah kaunsa term use karne ko kaha?

options.en: Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse Material (CSEAM)
options.hg: Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse Material (CSEAM)

options.en: Underage entertainment media
options.hg: Underage entertainment media

options.en: Adult content involving minors
options.hg: Minors wala adult content

options.en: Private teenage content
options.hg: Private teenage content

explain.en: The Court said such images are not 'pornography' but records of abuse. It also held that viewing, possessing and storing such material can be punished under POCSO and the IT Act. Never forward it; report it to 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Court ne kaha ki aisi images 'pornography' nahi, balki abuse ka record hain. Usne yeh bhi kaha ki aisa material dekhna, rakhna aur store karna POCSO aur IT Act mein punishable ho sakta hai. Kabhi forward mat karo; 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.

q.en: What is the minimum punishment for rape under Section 64 of the BNS?
q.hg: BNS ke Section 64 ke under rape ki minimum saza kya hai?

options.en: 10 years' rigorous imprisonment
options.hg: 10 saal ki sakht jail

options.en: 2 years' simple imprisonment
options.hg: 2 saal ki saadi jail

options.en: 6 months of community service
options.hg: 6 mahine ki community service

options.en: 1 year, or only a fine
options.hg: 1 saal, ya sirf fine

explain.en: Rape carries at least 10 years' rigorous imprisonment, up to life, under Section 64. The minimum was raised from 7 to 10 years in 2018, and aggravated forms carry heavier terms.
explain.hg: Section 64 ke under rape pe kam se kam 10 saal ki sakht jail, umar qaid tak hai. Minimum 2018 mein 7 se 10 saal kiya gaya, aur aggravated cases mein saza aur zyada hai.

q.en: Under the BNS, is rape limited to penile-vaginal penetration?
q.hg: BNS ke under kya rape sirf penis-vagina penetration tak seemit hai?

options.en: Only acts by a stranger are covered
options.hg: Sirf ajnabi ke acts aate hain

options.en: No, it also covers insertion of objects or body parts and other acts
options.hg: Nahi, isme cheezein ya body parts daalna aur doosre acts bhi aate hain

options.en: Yes, unless there are visible injuries
options.hg: Haan, jab tak chot na dikhe

options.en: Yes, nothing else legally counts as rape
options.hg: Haan, legally aur kuch rape nahi

explain.en: Since 2013, and now in Section 63 of the BNS, rape includes penetration of the vagina, mouth, urethra or anus, insertion of any object or body part, and oral contact, when done without consent.
explain.hg: 2013 se, aur ab BNS ke Section 63 mein, rape mein vagina, mouth, urethra ya anus ka penetration, koi cheez ya body part daalna, aur oral contact shaamil hain, jab bina consent ho.

q.en: During puberty, your mood can swing from happy to irritated in the same hour. What is the most accurate explanation?
q.hg: Puberty mein mood ek hi ghante mein happy se irritated ho jaata hai. Iska sabse sahi explanation kya hai?

options.en: It means you are becoming a rude person and must be scolded more
options.hg: Iska matlab tum badtameez ban rahe ho aur tumhe aur daantna chahiye

options.en: Changing hormones and a still-developing brain make strong moods common
options.hg: Hormones badal rahe hote hain aur brain abhi develop ho raha hota hai, isliye strong moods common hain

options.en: It is a sign of a serious mental illness that needs medicines
options.hg: Ye kisi serious mental illness ka sign hai jisme medicine chahiye

options.en: It only happens to girls, because of their periods
options.hg: Ye sirf ladkiyon ke saath hota hai, periods ki wajah se

explain.en: Mood swings are a normal part of puberty for all genders: hormones shift and the brain areas that manage emotions are still maturing. Sleep, food, movement and talking help. If low moods last for weeks, talk to someone.
explain.hg: Mood swings har gender ke liye puberty ka normal hissa hain: hormones badalte hain aur emotions sambhalne wala brain abhi mature ho raha hota hai. Neend, khana, exercise aur baat karna help karta hai. Agar low mood hafton tak rahe, toh kisi se baat karo.

q.en: Feeling sad after a bad day is normal. When is low mood a sign that you should talk to a doctor or counsellor?
q.hg: Bura din ho toh udaas lagna normal hai. Low mood kab sign hai ki doctor ya counsellor se baat karni chahiye?

options.en: When it lasts most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks or more
options.hg: Jab ye din ka zyadatar time, lagbhag roz, do hafte ya usse zyada rahe

options.en: Only when you have cried in front of other people at school
options.hg: Sirf tab jab tum school mein sabke saamne ro chuke ho

options.en: Never, because sadness always goes away if you ignore it
options.hg: Kabhi nahi, kyunki ignore karo toh udaasi hamesha chali jaati hai

options.en: Only after your marks start falling in the exams
options.hg: Sirf tab jab exams mein marks girne lagein

explain.en: Doctors look at how long and how much: low mood or losing interest in things on most days for two weeks or more is a reason to get checked. You do not have to wait for marks to fall or for a crisis.
explain.hg: Doctor dekhte hain ki kitne time se aur kitna: do hafte ya usse zyada, zyadatar din low mood ya cheezon mein interest khatam ho jaana check-up ka reason hai. Marks girne ya crisis ka wait karne ki zaroorat nahi.

q.en: Riya, 15, scrolls her phone till 2 am most nights and feels cranky and teary all day. What is the most useful first change?
q.hg: Riya, 15, zyadatar raat 2 baje tak phone scroll karti hai aur din bhar chidchidi aur rone jaisi feel karti hai. Sabse useful pehla change kya hai?

options.en: Drink more tea and coffee so she can stay alert in class
options.hg: Zyada chai-coffee piyo taaki class mein alert rahe

options.en: Sleep for 14 hours every Sunday to make up for the week
options.hg: Har Sunday 14 ghante so jao taaki hafte ki kami poori ho jaaye

options.en: Ignore it, because tiredness has nothing to do with mood
options.hg: Ignore karo, kyunki thakaan ka mood se koi lena-dena nahi

options.en: Keep the phone out of bed and aim for a regular sleep time
options.hg: Phone bed se door rakho aur roz ek fixed time pe sone ki koshish karo

explain.en: Teenagers need plenty of sleep, and too little makes people more irritable, anxious and low. A regular bedtime with the phone kept away usually helps mood more than caffeine or one long weekend sleep.
explain.hg: Teenagers ko achhi neend chahiye, aur kam neend se chidchidapan, anxiety aur low mood badhta hai. Phone door rakh ke fixed bedtime rakhna caffeine ya weekend ki lambi neend se zyada mood ki help karta hai.

q.en: Before a presentation your heart races, your palms sweat and your stomach churns. What is happening?
q.hg: Presentation se pehle dil tez dhadakta hai, haath pasine se geele aur pet mein ajeeb sa lagta hai. Kya ho raha hai?

options.en: You are probably having a heart attack and should panic
options.hg: Shayad heart attack aa raha hai, ghabra jaana chahiye

options.en: It proves you are not smart enough to give presentations
options.hg: Ye prove karta hai ki tum presentation ke laayak smart nahi ho

options.en: Your body's stress response is getting you ready, which is normal
options.hg: Body ka stress response tumhe ready kar raha hai, jo normal hai

options.en: It only happens to people who did not prepare at all
options.hg: Ye sirf unke saath hota hai jinhone bilkul taiyari nahi ki

explain.en: Anxiety is the body's alarm system: adrenaline speeds the heart and breathing to prepare you for a challenge. Slow breathing, practice and reminding yourself it will pass help the feelings settle.
explain.hg: Anxiety body ka alarm system hai: adrenaline dil aur saans tez karta hai taaki tum challenge ke liye ready raho. Dheemi saans, practice aur ye yaad rakhna ki ye guzar jaayega, feelings ko shaant karta hai.

q.en: Your friend suddenly feels intense fear, a pounding heart and shaky breathing in the canteen, and says it came from nowhere. What is true about panic attacks?
q.hg: Canteen mein dost ko achanak bahut darr, dhak-dhak karta dil aur kaanpti saans feel hoti hai, aur woh kehta hai ye bina wajah aaya. Panic attacks ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: They are always a sign of madness and the person must be locked in a room
options.hg: Ye hamesha paagalpan ka sign hain aur insaan ko kamre mein band kar dena chahiye

options.en: They peak within minutes and pass; slow breathing and a calm person nearby help
options.hg: Ye kuch minute mein peak karke chale jaate hain; dheemi saans aur paas mein shaant insaan help karta hai

options.en: They are just acting for attention, so it is best to walk away
options.hg: Ye bas attention ke liye acting hai, isliye wahan se chale jaana best hai

options.en: They last for days and nothing can be done to make them easier
options.hg: Ye kai din chalte hain aur inhe aasaan karne ke liye kuch nahi kiya ja sakta

explain.en: Panic attacks feel frightening but usually peak within minutes and then ease. Stay with the person, speak calmly and breathe slowly together. If attacks repeat, or it is the first time, a doctor should check them.
explain.hg: Panic attack bahut darawna lagta hai par aam taur pe kuch hi minute mein peak karke kam ho jaata hai. Saath raho, shaanti se baat karo aur saath mein dheemi saans lo. Baar baar ho ya pehli baar ho, toh doctor se check karwao.

q.en: Which is a simple 'grounding' trick to calm a wave of anxiety?
q.hg: Anxiety ki lehar ko shaant karne ka simple 'grounding' trick kaunsa hai?

options.en: Name five things you see, four you hear, three you can touch
options.hg: Paanch cheezein jo dikh rahi hain, chaar jo sun rahe ho, teen jo chhoo sakte ho, unke naam lo

options.en: Hold your breath for as long as you possibly can
options.hg: Jitni der ho sake utni der saans rok ke rakho

options.en: Scroll through social media until the feeling disappears
options.hg: Social media scroll karte raho jab tak feeling chali na jaaye

options.en: Tell yourself to stop being silly and force the feeling away
options.hg: Khud ko bolo ki bewakoofi band karo aur feeling ko zabardasti bhagao

explain.en: Grounding pulls your attention back to the present moment through your senses, which helps the body's alarm switch off. Holding your breath or fighting the feeling usually makes anxiety stronger.
explain.hg: Grounding senses ke through dhyaan ko abhi ke pal mein wapas laata hai, jisse body ka alarm band hone lagta hai. Saans rokna ya feeling se ladna aksar anxiety ko aur badha deta hai.

q.en: Board exams are a month away. Arjun studies 15 hours a day, skips meals and cannot sleep. What would help him perform better?
q.hg: Board exams mein ek mahina bacha hai. Arjun roz 15 ghante padhta hai, khana skip karta hai aur so nahi paata. Kya cheez usko better perform karne mein help karegi?

options.en: Studying even longer, since sleep is a waste before exams
options.hg: Aur zyada der padhna, kyunki exam se pehle neend waste of time hai

options.en: Energy drinks every few hours so he never feels sleepy
options.hg: Har kuch ghante mein energy drink taaki neend aaye hi na

options.en: Avoiding everyone so nobody can distract him at all
options.hg: Sabse door rehna taaki koi bhi distract na kare

options.en: Regular breaks, meals and sleep, because a tired brain remembers less
options.hg: Regular break, khana aur neend, kyunki thaka hua brain kam yaad rakhta hai

explain.en: Sleep is when the brain stores what you learned, and food and short breaks keep concentration up. Pushing without rest raises stress and lowers marks. If exam stress feels unbearable, talk to someone or call Tele-MANAS 14416.
explain.hg: Neend mein hi brain padhi hui cheezein store karta hai, aur khana aur chhote break concentration banaye rakhte hain. Bina aaram ke push karne se stress badhta hai aur marks girte hain. Exam stress bardaasht se bahar lage toh kisi se baat karo ya Tele-MANAS 14416 call karo.

q.en: At 2 am your cousin texts that she feels overwhelmed and alone and cannot stop crying. Which number can she call right now to talk to a trained counsellor for free?
q.hg: Raat 2 baje tumhari cousin message karti hai ki woh bahut overwhelmed aur akeli feel kar rahi hai aur rona nahi ruk raha. Abhi free mein trained counsellor se baat karne ke liye woh kaunsa number call kar sakti hai?

options.en: The NACO helpline on 1097
options.hg: NACO helpline, 1097

options.en: The cybercrime helpline on 1930
options.hg: Cybercrime helpline, 1930

options.en: Tele-MANAS on 14416
options.hg: Tele-MANAS, 14416

options.en: Her school office landline
options.hg: Uske school office ka landline

explain.en: Tele-MANAS (14416) is the Health Ministry's free, 24x7 tele-mental-health helpline, launched in October 2022. Anyone feeling stressed, anxious, low or unsafe with their thoughts can call and talk to a trained counsellor.
explain.hg: Tele-MANAS (14416) Health Ministry ki free, 24x7 tele-mental-health helpline hai, jo October 2022 mein shuru hui. Koi bhi jo stressed, anxious, low ya apne khayalon se unsafe feel kare, call karke trained counsellor se baat kar sakta hai.

q.en: Meera feels low and anxious but thinks, 'My problem is not big enough to call a helpline.' What is true?
q.hg: Meera low aur anxious feel karti hai par sochti hai, 'Meri problem itni badi nahi ki helpline call karun.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: She should wait until she has a diagnosed mental illness
options.hg: Use tab tak wait karna chahiye jab tak koi mental illness diagnose na ho

options.en: Helplines like 14416 are for everyday stress too, not only emergencies
options.hg: 14416 jaisi helplines roz ke stress ke liye bhi hain, sirf emergency ke liye nahi

options.en: Helplines only accept calls from adults above 25
options.hg: Helplines sirf 25 se upar ke adults ki call leti hain

options.en: Calling will automatically inform her school and parents
options.hg: Call karte hi school aur parents ko automatically pata chal jaayega

explain.en: You do not need a 'big enough' problem to ask for help. Tele-MANAS counsellors talk with people about exam stress, loneliness, family fights or worry. You can also call to ask how to help a friend.
explain.hg: Help maangne ke liye 'badi' problem hona zaroori nahi. Tele-MANAS ke counsellor exam stress, akelepan, ghar ke jhagdon ya tension ke baare mein baat karte hain. Kisi dost ki help kaise karein, ye poochne ke liye bhi call kar sakte ho.

q.en: Kabir, 16, has moved to a new city and eats lunch alone every day. He feels something is wrong with him. What is most accurate?
q.hg: Kabir, 16, naye shehar mein shift hua hai aur roz akele lunch karta hai. Use lagta hai uske andar kuch gadbad hai. Sabse sahi baat kya hai?

options.en: Loneliness is common and not a flaw; small regular steps to connect help
options.hg: Akelapan common hai aur koi kami nahi; connect karne ke chhote regular steps help karte hain

options.en: Lonely people are lonely because nobody could ever like them
options.hg: Akele log isliye akele hain kyunki unhe koi kabhi pasand nahi kar sakta

options.en: He should stay alone, because making friends after 15 is impossible
options.hg: Use akela hi rehna chahiye, kyunki 15 ke baad dost banana impossible hai

options.en: Loneliness only matters for old people, not for teenagers
options.hg: Akelapan sirf buzurgon ke liye matter karta hai, teenagers ke liye nahi

explain.en: Almost everyone feels lonely at times, especially after a move. Joining a club, sport or study group, or saying hello to one person a day, builds connection slowly. If loneliness turns into lasting sadness, talk to someone.
explain.hg: Lagbhag sabko kabhi na kabhi akelapan feel hota hai, khaaskar shift hone ke baad. Koi club, sport ya study group join karna, ya roz ek insaan ko hello bolna, dheere dheere connection banata hai. Akelapan lambi udaasi ban jaaye toh kisi se baat karo.

q.en: Which statement about seeing a counsellor or therapist is true?
q.hg: Counsellor ya therapist ke paas jaane ke baare mein kaunsi baat sach hai?

options.en: Only 'pagal' people go to counsellors, so it is shameful
options.hg: Sirf 'pagal' log counsellor ke paas jaate hain, isliye sharam ki baat hai

options.en: A counsellor will just tell you to pray and stop thinking
options.hg: Counsellor bas bolega ki pooja karo aur sochna band karo

options.en: It works only if you never feel sad again after one session
options.hg: Ye tabhi kaam karta hai jab ek session ke baad dobara kabhi udaasi na ho

options.en: It is a normal way to handle stress, like seeing a doctor for a fever
options.hg: Ye stress handle karne ka normal tareeka hai, jaise bukhaar mein doctor ke paas jaana

explain.en: Counselling is health care for the mind. People go for exam pressure, breakups, grief, family problems or anxiety. Progress usually takes several sessions, and asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.
explain.hg: Counselling mann ki health care hai. Log exam pressure, breakup, kisi ke jaane ka gham, ghar ki problem ya anxiety ke liye jaate hain. Farak aam taur pe kuch sessions mein dikhta hai, aur help maangna kamzori nahi, himmat hai.

q.en: Meena's counsellor thinks her depression might also need medicine. Which professional should she see for a prescription?
q.hg: Meena ke counsellor ko lagta hai ki uske depression mein medicine ki bhi zaroorat ho sakti hai. Prescription ke liye use kisse milna chahiye?

options.en: A clinical psychologist
options.hg: Clinical psychologist

options.en: A school counsellor
options.hg: School counsellor

options.en: A psychiatrist
options.hg: Psychiatrist

options.en: A life coach or wellness influencer
options.hg: Life coach ya wellness influencer

explain.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specialises in mental health and can prescribe medicines. Clinical psychologists and counsellors give talk therapy but do not prescribe. Influencers and life coaches are not health professionals.
explain.hg: Psychiatrist ek medical doctor hai jo mental health mein specialise karta hai aur medicine likh sakta hai. Clinical psychologist aur counsellor talk therapy dete hain par medicine nahi likhte. Influencer aur life coach health professional nahi hote.

q.en: Tanvi, 14, tells the school counsellor something private. When might the counsellor need to share it with others?
q.hg: Tanvi, 14, school counsellor ko kuch private baat batati hai. Counsellor ko kab ye baat dusron ko batani pad sakti hai?

options.en: Whenever the counsellor thinks the story is interesting
options.hg: Jab bhi counsellor ko kahani interesting lage

options.en: If Tanvi is at serious risk of harm or is being abused
options.hg: Agar Tanvi ko serious nuksaan ka khatra hai ya uske saath abuse ho raha hai

options.en: Never, a counsellor must keep every secret no matter what
options.hg: Kabhi nahi, counsellor ko har secret har haal mein rakhna hi hai

options.en: Only if Tanvi's marks are lower than her classmates'
options.hg: Sirf tab jab Tanvi ke marks classmates se kam hon

explain.en: Counsellors keep most things private, but they cannot promise total secrecy to someone under 18 if there is serious danger or abuse; then they must get help, and Indian law requires abuse to be reported. A good counsellor explains this up front.
explain.hg: Counsellor zyadatar baatein private rakhte hain, par 18 se kam umar ke kisi ko poori secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte agar serious khatra ya abuse ho; tab unhe help leni padti hai, aur Indian law mein abuse report karna zaroori hai. Achha counsellor ye pehle hi bata deta hai.

q.en: A friend shows you marks on her arm and says she has been hurting herself. She begs you not to tell anyone. What is the best response?
q.hg: Ek dost tumhe apni baanh pe nishaan dikhati hai aur kehti hai ki woh khud ko hurt kar rahi hai. Woh request karti hai ki kisi ko mat batana. Sabse achha response kya hai?

options.en: Listen calmly, and help her reach a trusted adult or call 14416 together
options.hg: Shaanti se suno, aur use trusted adult tak pahunchne mein ya saath mein 14416 call karne mein help karo

options.en: Promise to keep it secret forever so she keeps trusting you
options.hg: Hamesha secret rakhne ka promise karo taaki woh tum pe trust karti rahe

options.en: Tell her she is only doing it for attention and should stop
options.hg: Use bolo ki woh sirf attention ke liye kar rahi hai aur band kare

options.en: Post about it in the class group so others can help too
options.hg: Class group mein post kar do taaki baaki bhi help kar sakein

explain.en: Self-harm is usually a way of coping with deep pain, not attention-seeking. Stay calm and kind, do not promise secrecy, and help her reach a trusted adult, a counsellor or Tele-MANAS 14416. If she is in immediate danger, call 112.
explain.hg: Self-harm aksar gehre dard se deal karne ka tareeka hota hai, attention ke liye nahi. Shaant aur pyaar se raho, secret rakhne ka promise mat karo, aur use trusted adult, counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 tak pahunchne mein help karo. Turant khatra ho toh 112 call karo.

q.en: Your friend has been very low and says, 'Sometimes I wish I could just disappear.' Is it okay to ask directly if they are thinking about suicide?
q.hg: Tumhara dost bahut low hai aur kehta hai, 'Kabhi kabhi lagta hai bas gayab ho jaaun.' Kya seedha poochna theek hai ki kya woh suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai?

options.en: No, asking will put the idea into their head
options.hg: Nahi, poochne se ye idea unke dimaag mein aa jaayega

options.en: No, you should change the topic and make a joke instead
options.hg: Nahi, topic badal ke koi joke maar dena chahiye

options.en: Only a doctor is ever allowed to say the word suicide
options.hg: Suicide shabd sirf doctor hi bol sakta hai

options.en: Yes, asking directly and kindly opens the door to getting help
options.hg: Haan, seedha aur pyaar se poochna help tak pahunchne ka darwaza kholta hai

explain.en: Research shows that asking someone directly about suicidal thoughts does not plant the idea; it often brings relief. Listen without judging, stay with them, and connect them to Tele-MANAS 14416 or a trusted adult. If there is immediate danger, call 112.
explain.hg: Research batati hai ki kisi se seedha suicide ke khayalon ke baare mein poochne se idea nahi aata; aksar unhe halka mehsoos hota hai. Bina judge kiye suno, saath raho, aur unhe Tele-MANAS 14416 ya trusted adult se jodo. Turant khatra ho toh 112 call karo.

q.en: Depression or anxiety is best understood as:
q.hg: Depression ya anxiety ko sabse sahi kaise samjha jaaye?

options.en: Laziness that disappears if the person just tries harder
options.hg: Aalas jo insaan zyada koshish kare toh chala jaata hai

options.en: A punishment for something bad the person did in the past
options.hg: Pehle kiye kisi bure kaam ki saza

options.en: A health condition that can be treated, like asthma or diabetes
options.hg: Ek health condition jiska ilaaj ho sakta hai, jaise asthma ya diabetes

options.en: A problem that only rich city people can get
options.hg: Problem jo sirf ameer shehar ke logon ko hoti hai

explain.en: Depression and anxiety are real health conditions linked to biology, life events and stress. They are not laziness or a moral failing, and they affect people of every background. Therapy, support and sometimes medicine help.
explain.hg: Depression aur anxiety asli health conditions hain jo biology, life events aur stress se judi hoti hain. Ye aalas ya character ki kami nahi, aur har background ke logon ko hoti hain. Therapy, support aur kabhi medicine help karti hai.

q.en: You want to tell your parents you have been feeling very stressed. Which approach is most likely to work?
q.hg: Tum parents ko batana chahte ho ki tum bahut stressed feel kar rahe ho. Kaunsa tareeka sabse zyada kaam karega?

options.en: Bring it up in the middle of a family fight so they listen
options.hg: Ghar ke jhagde ke beech mein bolo taaki woh suno

options.en: Pick a calm time and start with 'I have been feeling … and need help'
options.hg: Shaant time chuno aur 'Main kuch time se … feel kar raha/rahi hoon, help chahiye' se shuru karo

options.en: Drop hints for months and hope they guess on their own
options.hg: Mahino tak ishaare do aur umeed rakho ki woh khud samajh jaayein

options.en: Wait until you are completely sure they will not be upset
options.hg: Tab tak ruko jab tak pakka na ho ki woh bilkul upset nahi honge

explain.en: A calm moment and a clear 'I feel' sentence make it easier for parents to listen. You can also write it in a letter or message, or ask another trusted adult, teacher or counsellor to be with you when you talk.
explain.hg: Shaant time aur saaf 'main feel karta/karti hoon' wala sentence parents ke liye sunna aasaan banata hai. Chaho toh letter ya message mein likh sakte ho, ya kisi aur trusted adult, teacher ya counsellor ko saath baithne bol sakte ho.

q.en: Sahil, 15, is teased daily about his weight in the class group. He has stopped wanting to go to school. What is true?
q.hg: Sahil, 15, ko class group mein roz uske weight pe chidhaya jaata hai. Ab uska school jaane ka mann nahi karta. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Body shaming is bullying and can seriously hurt mental health
options.hg: Body shaming bullying hai aur mental health ko seriously nuksaan pahuncha sakti hai

options.en: It is just friendly fun and he should learn to take a joke
options.hg: Ye bas dosti wala mazaak hai, use joke lena seekhna chahiye

options.en: Teasing will motivate him to lose weight, so it is helpful
options.hg: Chidhane se woh weight kam karne ke liye motivate hoga, toh ye achha hai

options.en: It only counts as bullying if someone hits him
options.hg: Ye bullying tabhi hai jab koi use maare

explain.en: Repeated teasing about someone's body is bullying, online or offline. It raises the risk of anxiety, low mood and unhealthy eating, and it does not 'motivate' anyone. Sahil should tell a trusted adult, and classmates can refuse to join in.
explain.hg: Kisi ki body pe baar baar mazaak udaana bullying hai, online ho ya offline. Isse anxiety, low mood aur unhealthy eating ka risk badhta hai, aur ye kisi ko 'motivate' nahi karta. Sahil ko trusted adult ko batana chahiye, aur classmates join karne se mana kar sakte hain.

q.en: Most photos of celebrities and influencers you see online are:
q.hg: Online jo celebrities aur influencers ki photos dikhti hain, woh zyadatar:

options.en: Exactly how those people look when they wake up
options.hg: Bilkul waise hi jaise woh log subah uth ke dikhte hain

options.en: Proof that a perfect body is easy if you try hard
options.hg: Proof ki thodi mehnat se perfect body aasaan hai

options.en: Checked by the government to make sure nothing is fake
