options.hg: Sarkar check karti hai taaki kuch bhi fake na ho

options.en: Posed, lit, filtered or edited, so they are not everyday reality
options.hg: Pose, lighting, filter ya editing wali hoti hain, roz ki asliyat nahi

explain.en: Professional photos use good angles, makeup, lighting, many takes and editing apps that smooth skin and reshape bodies. Comparing your everyday self with someone's best edited moment is not a fair comparison.
explain.hg: Professional photos mein achhe angles, makeup, lighting, kai takes aur editing apps hote hain jo skin smooth aur body reshape kar dete hain. Apne roz ke roop ko kisi ke best edited pal se compare karna fair comparison nahi hai.

q.en: Every time Pooja scrolls Instagram she feels worse about her looks. Which step is most likely to help?
q.hg: Jab bhi Pooja Instagram scroll karti hai, use apne looks ke baare mein bura lagta hai. Kaunsa step sabse zyada help karega?

options.en: Scroll even more so she gets used to the feeling
options.hg: Aur zyada scroll karo taaki feeling ki aadat pad jaaye

options.en: Buy every product those accounts are advertising
options.hg: Woh accounts jo bhi products dikhate hain sab khareed lo

options.en: Mute or unfollow accounts that make her feel bad and follow varied ones
options.hg: Jo accounts bura feel karaate hain unhe mute ya unfollow karo aur alag-alag tarah ke accounts follow karo

options.en: Post only heavily filtered photos of herself from now on
options.hg: Ab se sirf heavy filter wali apni photos post karo

explain.en: Feeds learn from what you watch and show you more of it. Muting accounts that trigger comparison and following people with different bodies, skills and interests changes what the algorithm shows, and often how you feel.
explain.hg: Feed seekhti hai ki tum kya dekhte ho aur wahi zyada dikhati hai. Comparison trigger karne wale accounts mute karke alag body, skills aur interests wale logon ko follow karne se algorithm badalta hai, aur aksar tumhari feeling bhi.

q.en: Why does a classmate's Instagram make their life look perfect?
q.hg: Ek classmate ka Instagram uski life ko perfect kyun dikhata hai?

options.en: Their life really is perfect, unlike yours
options.hg: Unki life sach mein perfect hai, tumhari jaisi nahi

options.en: People mostly post their best moments, not boring or hard days
options.hg: Log zyadatar apne best moments post karte hain, boring ya mushkil din nahi

options.en: Instagram only allows happy people to make accounts
options.hg: Instagram sirf khush logon ko account banane deta hai

options.en: They are lying, and everyone on social media is a fraud
options.hg: Woh jhooth bol rahe hain, social media pe har koi fraud hai

explain.en: Social media is a highlight reel: trips, results and selfies, rarely the fights, rejections or bad skin days. Remember you are comparing your behind-the-scenes with someone else's best scenes.
explain.hg: Social media highlight reel hai: trips, results aur selfies, jhagde, rejection ya bure skin days kam hi dikhte hain. Yaad rakho tum apne behind-the-scenes ko kisi ke best scenes se compare kar rahe ho.

q.en: Nisha uses a beauty filter in every selfie. Now her real face in the mirror looks 'wrong' to her. What is going on?
q.hg: Nisha har selfie mein beauty filter use karti hai. Ab mirror mein apna asli chehra use 'galat' lagta hai. Kya ho raha hai?

options.en: Filters change what she sees as normal, making her real face feel worse
options.hg: Filters ne uske liye 'normal' ka matlab badal diya, isliye asli chehra bura lagta hai

options.en: Her face has actually become less attractive than before
options.hg: Uska chehra sach mein pehle se kam achha ho gaya hai

options.en: Mirrors are less accurate than phone filters
options.hg: Mirror phone filter se kam accurate hota hai

options.en: It is a sign she needs cosmetic surgery as soon as possible
options.hg: Ye sign hai ki use jaldi se cosmetic surgery karwani chahiye

explain.en: Filters smooth skin, enlarge eyes and slim faces. Seeing that version again and again shifts your idea of normal, so your real face starts to feel flawed. Taking filter-free photos and breaks from selfies can reset this.
explain.hg: Filters skin smooth karte hain, aankhein badi aur chehra patla karte hain. Wahi version baar baar dekhne se 'normal' ka idea badal jaata hai, aur asli chehra galat lagne lagta hai. Bina filter photos aur selfies se break lene se ye reset ho sakta hai.

q.en: At a family wedding an aunt says loudly, 'Arre, you've become so fat!' What is a healthy way to respond?
q.hg: Family wedding mein ek aunty zor se bolti hain, 'Arre, tum kitne mote ho gaye!' Healthy response kya hai?

options.en: Stop eating for the rest of the wedding to prove her wrong
options.hg: Baaki shaadi mein khana band kar do taaki unhe galat prove karo

options.en: Agree that your body is a problem and apologise to her
options.hg: Maan lo ki tumhari body problem hai aur unse sorry bolo

options.en: Shout back an insult about her own weight
options.hg: Badle mein unke weight pe koi insult chilla do

options.en: Calmly change the subject; her comment is not a verdict on your worth
options.hg: Shaanti se topic badlo; unka comment tumhari value ka faisla nahi hai

explain.en: Comments about weight are very common at Indian family events and say more about habit than about you. You can deflect politely ('Let's talk about the food!') and tell someone you trust if it keeps bothering you. Skipping meals is not the answer.
explain.hg: Indian family functions mein weight pe comments bahut common hain aur ye tumhare baare mein kam, aadat ke baare mein zyada batate hain. Politely topic badal sakte ho ('Chalo khane ki baat karte hain!') aur pareshaan karta rahe toh kisi trusted insaan ko batao. Khana skip karna jawab nahi hai.

q.en: Which statement about healthy bodies is true?
q.hg: Healthy bodies ke baare mein kaunsi baat sach hai?

options.en: Only thin bodies can be healthy
options.hg: Sirf patli bodies hi healthy ho sakti hain

options.en: A body with visible abs is always the healthiest one
options.hg: Jis body mein abs dikhte hain wahi hamesha sabse healthy hai

options.en: Healthy bodies come in many shapes, sizes and skin colours
options.hg: Healthy bodies kai shapes, sizes aur skin colours mein aati hain

options.en: You can tell exactly how healthy someone is by looking
options.hg: Dekh ke pata chal jaata hai ki koi kitna healthy hai

explain.en: Genes, age, puberty and lifestyle all shape bodies differently. Health depends on things like activity, food, sleep and check-ups, not on matching one 'ideal' look. You cannot judge someone's health by their size alone.
explain.hg: Genes, umar, puberty aur lifestyle sab bodies ko alag shape dete hain. Health activity, khana, neend aur check-ups pe depend karti hai, kisi ek 'ideal' look jaisa dikhne pe nahi. Sirf size dekh ke kisi ki health judge nahi kar sakte.

q.en: Ads say a fairness cream will make you 'confident and successful'. What is the most accurate view?
q.hg: Ads kehte hain ki fairness cream tumhe 'confident aur successful' bana degi. Sabse sahi soch kya hai?

options.en: Darker skin is less attractive, so the cream is a smart buy
options.hg: Saanwali skin kam attractive hai, isliye cream khareedna smart hai

options.en: Skin colour has nothing to do with worth; the ad sells a bias
options.hg: Skin colour ka tumhari value se koi lena-dena nahi; ad ek bias bech raha hai

options.en: Fair skin is a sign of better health and higher intelligence
options.hg: Gori skin better health aur zyada intelligence ka sign hai

options.en: Success at jobs depends mainly on how fair your skin is
options.hg: Job mein success mainly is baat pe depend karti hai ki skin kitni gori hai

explain.en: Skin colour is set mostly by genes and sun, and every shade is normal and healthy. Linking fairness with confidence or success is colourism, a prejudice. Some unregulated creams can even contain harmful ingredients.
explain.hg: Skin colour zyadatar genes aur dhoop se tay hota hai, aur har shade normal aur healthy hai. Gorepan ko confidence ya success se jodna colourism hai, ek tarah ka bhed-bhaav. Kuch unregulated creams mein harmful ingredients bhi ho sakte hain.

q.en: Rohan, 15, sees gym reels promising 'six-pack abs in 30 days' and wants to buy 'mass gainer' supplements. What is wise?
q.hg: Rohan, 15, gym reels dekhta hai jo '30 din mein six-pack abs' ka promise karti hain, aur 'mass gainer' supplements lena chahta hai. Kya samajhdari hai?

options.en: Eat balanced meals, train sensibly and ask a doctor before any supplement
options.hg: Balanced khana khao, samajhdari se exercise karo, aur koi bhi supplement lene se pehle doctor se poocho

options.en: Buy the strongest supplement online, since reels are expert advice
options.hg: Online sabse strong supplement le lo, reels expert advice hi toh hain

options.en: Stop eating carbs completely so the abs show faster
options.hg: Carbs bilkul band kar do taaki abs jaldi dikhein

options.en: Train three hours daily, because rest days slow progress
options.hg: Roz teen ghante train karo, rest days se progress slow hoti hai

explain.en: Teen bodies are still growing, and muscle builds slowly with food, sleep and steady training. Some gym supplements sold online contain hidden steroids or other harmful ingredients. A doctor can tell you what, if anything, you need.
explain.hg: Teen bodies abhi grow ho rahi hoti hain, aur muscle khane, neend aur regular training se dheere bante hain. Online bikne wale kuch gym supplements mein chhupe steroids ya harmful cheezein hoti hain. Doctor bata sakta hai ki tumhe kuch chahiye bhi ya nahi.

q.en: Which of these is true about eating disorders such as anorexia or binge eating?
q.hg: Anorexia ya binge eating jaise eating disorders ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: They are a choice and stop as soon as the person decides to eat
options.hg: Ye ek choice hai aur insaan khane ka faisla kare toh turant ruk jaate hain

options.en: Only very thin girls from rich families can get them
options.hg: Sirf bahut patli ameer ghar ki ladkiyon ko hote hain

options.en: They are just a phase and never need professional help
options.hg: Ye bas ek phase hai aur kabhi professional help ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: They can affect any gender, size or background, and are treatable
options.hg: Ye kisi bhi gender, size ya background ke insaan ko ho sakte hain, aur inka ilaaj hai

explain.en: Eating disorders are serious mental health conditions that affect boys and men too, at any body size. Warning signs include fear of eating, secret eating, extreme exercise and constant body checking. Early help works best.
explain.hg: Eating disorders serious mental health conditions hain jo ladkon aur mardon ko bhi hote hain, kisi bhi body size pe. Warning signs: khane se darr, chhup ke khana, hadd se zyada exercise aur baar baar body check karna. Jaldi help sabse achha kaam karti hai.

q.en: Your cousin plans to skip dinner for a month to look slimmer at her engagement. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhari cousin engagement pe patli dikhne ke liye ek mahine tak dinner skip karne ka plan bana rahi hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Skipping meals is the safest and most lasting way to lose weight
options.hg: Meals skip karna weight kam karne ka sabse safe aur lasting tareeka hai

options.en: Starving speeds up the body, so you burn more fat
options.hg: Bhookhe rehne se body tez hoti hai, toh zyada fat jalta hai

options.en: Crash dieting can cause tiredness, mood swings and binge eating later
options.hg: Crash dieting se thakaan, mood swings aur baad mein binge eating ho sakti hai

options.en: It has no effect on mood or energy if done only for a month
options.hg: Sirf ek mahine ke liye karo toh mood ya energy pe koi asar nahi

explain.en: Severe restriction leaves the body short of energy, which brings fatigue, irritability, poor focus and often overeating later. Pressure to look a certain way at weddings is real; a doctor or dietitian can suggest safer, kinder changes.
explain.hg: Bahut kam khane se body mein energy ki kami hoti hai, jisse thakaan, chidchidapan, focus ki kami aur baad mein zyada khana hota hai. Shaadi pe ek khaas tarah dikhne ka pressure real hai; doctor ya dietitian safe aur behtar changes suggest kar sakte hain.

q.en: Ishaan, 18, is shorter than his friends and sees ads for 'height increase' capsules. What is true?
q.hg: Ishaan, 18, apne doston se chhota hai aur 'height badhao' capsules ke ads dekhta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: These capsules can add several inches at any age
options.hg: Ye capsules kisi bhi umar mein kai inch badha sakte hain

options.en: Height depends mostly on genes; pills cannot add height once growth ends
options.hg: Height zyadatar genes pe depend karti hai; growth ruk jaane ke baad goliyan height nahi badha saktin

options.en: Hanging from a bar daily will make him grow taller as an adult
options.hg: Roz bar se latakne se adult hone ke baad bhi height badhegi

options.en: Short height means he is less healthy than taller boys
options.hg: Kam height ka matlab hai woh lambe ladkon se kam healthy hai

explain.en: Most height is inherited, and growth stops when the growth plates in the bones close after puberty. No capsule can change that. If a teen seems to have stopped growing very early, a doctor can check, but adult height is not a measure of worth.
explain.hg: Height zyadatar genes se aati hai, aur puberty ke baad haddiyon ki growth plates band hone pe growth ruk jaati hai. Koi capsule isse nahi badal sakta. Agar teen ki growth bahut jaldi ruki lage toh doctor check kar sakta hai, par adult height kisi ki value ka naap nahi hai.

q.en: Sana, 14, notices one of her breasts is a bit bigger than the other. What is true?
q.hg: Sana, 14, notice karti hai ki uska ek breast dusre se thoda bada hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: This is very common and usually evens out or stays slightly different
options.hg: Ye bahut common hai aur aksar barabar ho jaata hai ya thoda sa farak rehta hai

options.en: It means something is wrong and she needs surgery soon
options.hg: Iska matlab kuch gadbad hai aur jaldi surgery chahiye

options.en: It happens only because she sleeps on one side
options.hg: Ye sirf ek side so ne ki wajah se hota hai

options.en: It means she will have problems feeding a baby later
options.hg: Iska matlab baad mein baby ko feed karne mein problem hogi

explain.en: Breasts often grow at different speeds during puberty, and many adults have one slightly larger breast. That is normal. See a doctor for a new lump, pain that does not go away, skin changes or fluid from the nipple.
explain.hg: Puberty mein breasts aksar alag speed se grow karte hain, aur bahut se adults mein ek breast thoda bada hota hai. Ye normal hai. Naya lump, na jaane wala dard, skin mein badlav ya nipple se fluid aaye toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: Many teens get pimples. Which statement is correct?
q.hg: Bahut se teens ko pimples hote hain. Kaunsi baat sahi hai?

options.en: Pimples mean you are not washing your face enough times
options.hg: Pimples ka matlab tum chehra kam baar dhote ho

options.en: Acne is a punishment for having sexual thoughts
options.hg: Acne sexual khayalon ki saza hai

options.en: Squeezing every pimple is the fastest way to clear skin
options.hg: Har pimple dabana skin saaf karne ka sabse tez tareeka hai

options.en: Acne is mainly caused by hormones and oil, not by being dirty
options.hg: Acne mainly hormones aur oil ki wajah se hota hai, gandagi se nahi

explain.en: Puberty hormones make skin glands produce more oil, which can block pores. Gentle washing helps, but scrubbing or squeezing can cause scars. If acne hurts or affects your confidence, a dermatologist can treat it.
explain.hg: Puberty ke hormones skin glands se zyada oil banwate hain, jo pores block kar sakta hai. Halke se dhona help karta hai, par ragadna ya dabana scars de sakta hai. Acne dard de ya confidence pe asar kare, toh dermatologist ilaaj kar sakte hain.

q.en: Neha, 13, is teased for the hair on her arms and upper lip. What is true?
q.hg: Neha, 13, ko uski baanhon aur upper lip ke baalon ke liye chidhaya jaata hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Girls with body hair have a hormone disease
options.hg: Body hair wali ladkiyon ko hormone ki bimaari hoti hai

options.en: She must start waxing now or the hair will keep spreading
options.hg: Use abhi se waxing shuru karni hogi warna baal phailte jaayenge

options.en: Body hair on girls is normal; removing it is a personal choice
options.hg: Ladkiyon ki body pe baal normal hain; hataana ya nahi, ye apni choice hai

options.en: Body hair on girls means she will look like a boy later
options.hg: Ladkiyon ke body hair ka matlab hai baad mein woh ladke jaisi dikhegi

explain.en: Everyone grows body hair in puberty, and the amount varies a lot by family and genes. Removing it or not is a personal choice. Sudden heavy hair growth along with irregular periods is worth checking with a doctor.
explain.hg: Puberty mein sabke body hair aate hain, aur kitne aayenge ye family aur genes pe bahut depend karta hai. Hataana ya nahi apni choice hai. Achanak bahut zyada baal aur saath mein irregular periods hon toh doctor se check karwana achha hai.

q.en: Faint lines appear on Aman's back and thighs after a growth spurt. What are they most likely to be?
q.hg: Growth spurt ke baad Aman ki peeth aur thighs pe halki lines aa gayi hain. Ye zyadatar kya hoti hain?

options.en: A skin infection that will spread to the whole body
options.hg: Skin infection jo poori body mein phail jaayega

options.en: Stretch marks, which are common in puberty and fade over time
options.hg: Stretch marks, jo puberty mein common hain aur time ke saath halke ho jaate hain

options.en: A sign he has been eating too much junk food
options.hg: Sign ki woh bahut zyada junk food kha raha hai

options.en: Marks that only appear on people who are overweight
options.hg: Marks jo sirf zyada weight walon ko aate hain

explain.en: When the body grows quickly, the skin stretches and can leave stretch marks, in boys and girls, thin or not. They are harmless and usually fade to lighter lines. Creams do not prevent them reliably.
explain.hg: Jab body tezi se grow karti hai, skin khinchti hai aur stretch marks aa sakte hain, ladkon aur ladkiyon dono mein, patle ho ya nahi. Ye harmless hain aur aam taur pe halke ho jaate hain. Creams inhe pakka nahi rok paati.

q.en: Which habit best builds steady self-esteem?
q.hg: Kaunsi aadat sabse achhe se steady self-esteem banati hai?

options.en: Noticing what you do well and talking to yourself like a good friend
options.hg: Jo achha karte ho use notice karna aur khud se ek achhe dost ki tarah baat karna

options.en: Counting likes on your posts and deleting ones that get few
options.hg: Posts ke likes ginna aur kam likes wali posts delete karna

options.en: Comparing your marks with the class topper every day
options.hg: Roz apne marks class topper se compare karna

options.en: Waiting for others to praise you before feeling okay
options.hg: Theek feel karne se pehle dusron ki taareef ka wait karna

explain.en: Self-esteem grows from inside: effort, skills, values and how you treat people. Likes and comparison go up and down and keep you dependent on others. Kind self-talk ('I made a mistake, I can fix it') builds steadier confidence.
explain.hg: Self-esteem andar se badhti hai: mehnat, skills, values aur tum logon se kaisa behave karte ho. Likes aur comparison upar neeche hote rehte hain aur tumhe dusron pe depend rakhte hain. Khud se pyaar bhari baat ('Galti hui, theek kar lunga/lungi') steady confidence banati hai.

q.en: Aditi posts a photo and gets only a few likes, while her friend gets hundreds. She wants to delete it. What is most accurate?
q.hg: Aditi ek photo post karti hai aur sirf kuch likes aate hain, jabki uski dost ko sainkdon aate hain. Woh photo delete karna chahti hai. Sabse sahi baat kya hai?

options.en: Few likes prove that people secretly dislike her
options.hg: Kam likes prove karte hain ki log use chupke se pasand nahi karte

options.en: She should keep posting until she beats her friend's count
options.hg: Jab tak dost ka count na beat ho tab tak post karti rahe

options.en: Likes are an accurate test of how attractive someone is
options.hg: Likes accurate test hain ki koi kitna attractive hai

options.en: Likes depend on timing and algorithms, not on her value as a person
options.hg: Likes timing aur algorithm pe depend karte hain, insaan ke roop mein uski value pe nahi

explain.en: Likes depend on when you post, how many followers you have and what the app chooses to push. They are not a measure of beauty or worth. Noticing how likes affect your mood is a good reason to take a break.
explain.hg: Likes is pe depend karte hain ki kab post kiya, kitne followers hain aur app kya aage push karta hai. Ye khoobsurti ya value ka naap nahi hain. Agar likes se mood upar-neeche hota hai, toh break lena achha idea hai.

q.en: A person spends hours each day worrying about a small flaw in their nose that others barely notice, and avoids going out. What might this be?
q.hg: Ek insaan roz ghanton apni naak ki ek chhoti si kami ke baare mein sochta hai jo dusron ko mushkil se dikhti hai, aur bahar jaana avoid karta hai. Ye kya ho sakta hai?

options.en: Normal vanity that everyone has and that needs no attention
options.hg: Normal vanity jo sabme hoti hai aur dhyaan dene ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: Proof that the nose really is deformed and needs surgery
options.hg: Proof ki naak sach mein kharab hai aur surgery chahiye

options.en: Body dysmorphic disorder, a treatable condition worth seeing a professional for
options.hg: Body dysmorphic disorder, ek treatable condition jiske liye professional se milna chahiye

options.en: A habit that goes away if friends keep teasing about it
options.hg: Aadat jo dost chidhate rahein toh chali jaati hai

explain.en: Body dysmorphic disorder involves being preoccupied with a perceived flaw for hours, checking mirrors and avoiding people. Cosmetic surgery usually does not relieve it, but therapy and sometimes medicine do. A psychiatrist or psychologist can help.
explain.hg: Body dysmorphic disorder mein insaan ghanton ek kami ke baare mein sochta hai, baar baar mirror check karta hai aur logon se bachta hai. Cosmetic surgery se aksar farak nahi padta, par therapy aur kabhi medicine help karti hai. Psychiatrist ya psychologist help kar sakte hain.

q.en: You want to compliment a friend in a way that boosts real self-esteem. Which is best?
q.hg: Tum dost ko aise compliment dena chahte ho jo asli self-esteem badhaye. Kaunsa best hai?

options.en: 'You look good now that you've lost weight'
options.hg: 'Weight kam karke ab achhe lag rahe ho'

options.en: 'You handled that tough situation so calmly'
options.hg: 'Tumne wo mushkil situation kitni shaanti se handle ki'

options.en: 'You're fair, so you'll easily get married'
options.hg: 'Tum gore ho, shaadi aasaani se ho jaayegi'

options.en: 'You're so much prettier than your sister'
options.hg: 'Tum apni behen se kitni zyada sundar ho'

explain.en: Praise for effort, kindness or skill tells people they are valued for who they are. Compliments tied to weight, skin colour or comparison can feed body worries, even when meant kindly.
explain.hg: Mehnat, achhai ya skill ki taareef logon ko batati hai ki unki value unki personality se hai. Weight, skin colour ya comparison se jude compliments body ki tension badha sakte hain, chahe achhe mann se kahe gaye hon.

q.en: During puberty, Varun's chest becomes a little swollen and tender. He is too embarrassed to go swimming. What is true?
q.hg: Puberty mein Varun ki chest thodi phool gayi hai aur dukhti hai. Woh sharam ki wajah se swimming nahi jaana chahta. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Temporary breast swelling is common in boys in puberty and often settles
options.hg: Puberty mein ladkon ki chest mein temporary sujan common hai aur aksar theek ho jaati hai

options.en: It means he is turning into a girl
options.hg: Iska matlab woh ladki ban raha hai

options.en: It is caused by eating too much milk and paneer
options.hg: Ye bahut zyada doodh aur paneer khane se hota hai

options.en: It always needs surgery before he turns 16
options.hg: Iske liye 16 se pehle surgery zaroori hai

explain.en: Many boys get some breast tissue growth in puberty because of normal hormone shifts, and it often settles within a year or two. A doctor can check if it is painful, very large or lasts. It does not change who he is.
explain.hg: Bahut se ladkon mein puberty ke normal hormone badlav ki wajah se thoda breast tissue badhta hai, aur aksar ek-do saal mein theek ho jaata hai. Dard ho, bahut bada ho ya lamba chale toh doctor check kar sakte hain. Isse woh kaun hai, ye nahi badalta.

q.en: Your crush says no when you ask them out. You feel crushed and think you'll never be good enough. What is the healthiest way to see it?
q.hg: Tum apne crush ko propose karte ho aur woh mana kar deta/deti hai. Tum toot jaate ho aur sochte ho ki tum kabhi achhe nahi ho paoge. Isko dekhne ka sabse healthy tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Keep asking until they say yes, because persistence shows love
options.hg: Haan bolne tak poochte raho, kyunki baar baar poochna pyaar dikhata hai

options.en: It proves nobody will ever like you, so stop trying
options.hg: Ye prove karta hai ki tumhe koi kabhi pasand nahi karega, koshish band karo

options.en: Post about how they hurt you so others know
options.hg: Unhone kaise hurt kiya, ye post kar do taaki sabko pata chale

options.en: Rejection hurts, but one 'no' says nothing about your whole worth
options.hg: Rejection dukhta hai, par ek 'na' tumhari poori value ke baare mein kuch nahi kehta

explain.en: Feeling sad after rejection is normal and usually fades with time, friends and things you enjoy. Their 'no' must be respected, and it is about their feelings, not your value. If sadness lasts weeks, talk to someone.
explain.hg: Rejection ke baad udaas lagna normal hai aur time, doston aur pasand ki cheezon ke saath kam hota hai. Unki 'na' ki respect karni hai, aur ye unki feelings ke baare mein hai, tumhari value ke baare mein nahi. Udaasi hafton tak rahe toh kisi se baat karo.

q.en: Relatives keep comparing Priya's marks with 'Sharma ji ki beti'. She feels she is never enough. What helps most?
q.hg: Rishtedaar baar baar Priya ke marks 'Sharma ji ki beti' se compare karte hain. Use lagta hai woh kabhi kaafi nahi hai. Sabse zyada kya help karta hai?

options.en: Studying all night, every night, until she scores higher than every single cousin
options.hg: Har raat, raat bhar padhna jab tak har ek cousin se zyada score na ho jaaye

options.en: Hiding her results from everyone for the rest of school
options.hg: Poore school life mein apne results sabse chhupana

options.en: Measuring progress against her own past effort and talking about the pressure
options.hg: Apni pichli mehnat se apni progress naapna aur pressure ke baare mein baat karna

options.en: Believing that worth depends only on rank in class
options.hg: Ye maan lena ki value sirf class rank pe depend karti hai

explain.en: Constant comparison can drain motivation and feed anxiety. Tracking your own improvement is fairer and more useful. Telling a parent how the comments feel, or asking a teacher or counsellor for support, can ease the pressure.
explain.hg: Baar baar comparison motivation khatam karta hai aur anxiety badhata hai. Apni khud ki improvement track karna zyada fair aur useful hai. Parent ko batana ki comments kaise lagte hain, ya teacher ya counsellor se support lena, pressure kam kar sakta hai.

q.en: Which belief is a sign of unhealthy perfectionism rather than healthy high standards?
q.hg: Kaunsi soch healthy high standards nahi, balki unhealthy perfectionism ka sign hai?

options.en: 'I want to do well and will learn from my mistakes'
options.hg: 'Main achha karna chahta/chahti hoon aur galtiyon se seekhunga/seekhungi'

options.en: 'If it isn't perfect, I have completely failed'
options.hg: 'Agar perfect nahi hua, toh main poori tarah fail ho gaya/gayi'

options.en: 'I worked hard, and a B grade is still progress'
options.hg: 'Maine mehnat ki, aur B grade bhi progress hai'

options.en: 'I can ask for help when a task is too hard'
options.hg: 'Kaam bahut mushkil ho toh main help maang sakta/sakti hoon'

explain.en: Healthy striving sets goals and accepts mistakes as part of learning. Perfectionism treats anything less than perfect as total failure, which fuels anxiety, procrastination and low mood. It can be eased with practice and support.
explain.hg: Healthy mehnat goals rakhti hai aur galtiyon ko seekhne ka hissa maanti hai. Perfectionism perfect se kam har cheez ko poori failure maanta hai, jisse anxiety, kaam taalna aur low mood badhta hai. Practice aur support se ise kam kiya ja sakta hai.

q.en: Which is a good way to look after your mental health day to day?
q.hg: Roz apni mental health ka khayal rakhne ka achha tareeka kaunsa hai?

options.en: Regular sleep, some movement, time outdoors and talking to people
options.hg: Regular neend, thoda exercise, bahar time bitana aur logon se baat karna

options.en: Staying in your room alone so nobody can upset you
options.hg: Akele kamre mein rehna taaki koi upset na kare

options.en: Using energy drinks to stay awake and get more done
options.hg: Energy drinks lekar jagte rehna aur zyada kaam karna

options.en: Never talking about feelings so they cannot grow
options.hg: Feelings ke baare mein kabhi baat na karna taaki woh badhein nahi

explain.en: Simple habits such as sleep, physical activity, daylight and connection protect mood and lower stress. Isolation and bottling up feelings usually make things harder over time.
explain.hg: Neend, physical activity, dhoop aur logon se judna jaise simple habits mood ko protect karte hain aur stress kam karte hain. Akele rehna aur feelings dabaana aksar time ke saath cheezein aur mushkil kar deta hai.

q.en: After a breakup, Dev starts drinking alcohol every evening 'to stop thinking'. What is true?
q.hg: Breakup ke baad Dev roz shaam ko 'sochna band karne' ke liye sharaab peene laga hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Alcohol is a safe medicine for heartbreak if taken daily
options.hg: Roz lo toh sharaab dil tootne ki safe dawai hai

options.en: Drinking helps you process feelings faster
options.hg: Peene se feelings jaldi process hoti hain

options.en: It only becomes a problem after many years of drinking
options.hg: Ye bahut saalon ke baad hi problem banti hai

options.en: Alcohol may numb feelings briefly but often worsens low mood and anxiety
options.hg: Sharaab thodi der feelings sunn kar sakti hai par aksar low mood aur anxiety badha deti hai

explain.en: Using alcohol or other substances to cope can feel like relief but tends to deepen sadness, disturb sleep and build dependence. Talking to friends, a counsellor or Tele-MANAS 14416 helps more. Under-18s should not be drinking at all.
explain.hg: Alcohol ya dusre nashe se cope karna relief jaisa lagta hai par aksar udaasi badhata hai, neend kharab karta hai aur aadat banata hai. Doston, counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 se baat karna zyada help karta hai. 18 se kam umar walon ko bilkul nahi peena chahiye.

q.en: 'Boys don't need therapy, they should handle things themselves.' What is the truth?
q.hg: 'Ladkon ko therapy ki zaroorat nahi, unhe khud sab handle karna chahiye.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: Men are biologically immune to depression and anxiety, so they never need help
options.hg: Mard biologically depression aur anxiety se immune hote hain, isliye unhe kabhi help nahi chahiye

options.en: Therapy makes boys weak and less masculine
options.hg: Therapy ladkon ko kamzor aur kam mardana banati hai

options.en: Boys and men feel stress and sadness too and benefit from asking for help
options.hg: Ladke aur mard bhi stress aur udaasi feel karte hain aur help maangne se fayda hota hai

options.en: Boys only need help if they cry in public
options.hg: Ladkon ko help tabhi chahiye jab woh sabke saamne roein

explain.en: Men often hide distress or show it as anger, irritability or drinking, which can delay help. Talking to someone is a strength. Counsellors, doctors and Tele-MANAS 14416 are there for boys and men as much as anyone.
explain.hg: Mard aksar takleef chhupate hain ya gussa, chidchidapan ya peene ke roop mein dikhate hain, jisse help mein der hoti hai. Kisi se baat karna himmat hai. Counsellor, doctor aur Tele-MANAS 14416 ladkon aur mardon ke liye bhi utne hi hain.

q.en: Someone has been prescribed medicine for depression and feels better after a month. What should they do?
q.hg: Kisi ko depression ki medicine di gayi hai aur ek mahine baad woh better feel kar raha hai. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Stop immediately, because feeling better means it is cured
options.hg: Turant band karo, kyunki better feel karna matlab theek ho gaye

options.en: Keep taking it and discuss any change or stopping with the doctor
options.hg: Lete raho aur koi bhi badlav ya band karne ki baat doctor se karo

options.en: Double the dose so recovery becomes even faster
options.hg: Dose double kar do taaki recovery aur tez ho

options.en: Share the tablets with a friend who also feels sad
options.hg: Goliyan ek dost ke saath share karo jo bhi udaas hai

explain.en: Feeling better often means the medicine is working, not that treatment is finished. Stopping suddenly can bring symptoms back or cause side effects, so changes should be planned with the doctor. Prescribed medicines are never shared.
explain.hg: Better feel karna aksar matlab hai medicine kaam kar rahi hai, ye nahi ki ilaaj khatam. Achanak band karne se symptoms wapas aa sakte hain ya side effects ho sakte hain, isliye koi bhi badlav doctor ke saath plan karo. Prescribed medicine kabhi share nahi karte.

q.en: Under India's Mental Healthcare Act, 2017, how is a person who attempts suicide meant to be treated?
q.hg: India ke Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ke hisaab se suicide attempt karne wale insaan ke saath kaisa vyavhaar hona chahiye?

options.en: Presumed to be under severe stress and given care, not punishment
options.hg: Maana jaata hai ki woh severe stress mein hai aur use saza nahi, care milni chahiye

options.en: Arrested and sent to jail for at least one year
options.hg: Arrest karke kam se kam ek saal jail bheja jaata hai

options.en: Fined, and their family must pay the hospital as a penalty
options.hg: Fine lagta hai aur family ko penalty ke roop mein hospital ko paisa dena padta hai

options.en: Reported to their school or office as a criminal
options.hg: Unke school ya office ko criminal ke roop mein report kiya jaata hai

explain.en: Section 115 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 presumes that a person who attempts suicide has severe stress, bars punishing them, and obliges the government to provide care. Anyone struggling can call Tele-MANAS 14416, or 112 in an emergency.
explain.hg: Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ka Section 115 maanta hai ki suicide attempt karne wala severe stress mein hai, use saza dene pe rok lagata hai, aur sarkar ko care dene ka zimma deta hai. Jo bhi mushkil mein ho, Tele-MANAS 14416 call kar sakta hai, emergency mein 112.

q.en: Which is a helpful thing to say to a friend who tells you they feel anxious all the time?
q.hg: Jo dost kehta hai ki use hamesha anxiety rehti hai, use kya kehna helpful hai?

options.en: 'Just relax, you're overthinking everything'
options.hg: 'Bas relax karo, tum har cheez overthink karte ho'

options.en: 'Everyone has stress, stop making a big deal'
options.hg: 'Stress toh sabko hota hai, itna bada issue mat banao'

options.en: 'Don't tell anyone, people will think you're weak'
options.hg: 'Kisi ko mat batana, log tumhe kamzor samjhenge'

options.en: 'Thanks for telling me. Want to talk, or shall we find help together?'
options.hg: 'Batane ke liye thanks. Baat karni hai, ya saath mein help dhoondhein?'

explain.en: Listening and offering support makes it easier for someone to seek help. 'Just relax' or 'stop overthinking' can feel dismissive. You do not need the perfect words; staying kind and pointing to a counsellor or Tele-MANAS 14416 is enough.
explain.hg: Sunna aur support offer karna kisi ke liye help maangna aasaan banata hai. 'Bas relax karo' ya 'overthink mat karo' ignore karne jaisa lagta hai. Perfect words zaroori nahi; pyaar se saath dena aur counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 ka raasta dikhana kaafi hai.

q.en: What does medical science say about masturbation?
q.hg: Medical science masturbation ke baare mein kya kehti hai?

options.en: It slowly damages the nerves and the brain
options.hg: Ye dheere dheere nerves aur brain ko damage karta hai

options.en: It uses up a fixed lifetime supply of energy
options.hg: Isse zindagi bhar ki fixed energy khatam hoti hai

options.en: It is common and not physically harmful
options.hg: Ye common hai aur body ke liye harmful nahi

options.en: It is only safe after marriage
options.hg: Ye sirf shaadi ke baad safe hai

explain.en: Masturbation is a common, private part of many people's lives and does not harm the body. It does not cause weakness, infertility, blindness or acne. Choosing not to do it is also completely normal.
explain.hg: Masturbation bahut logon ki life ka common aur private hissa hai aur body ko nuksaan nahi karta. Isse kamzori, infertility, andhapan ya acne nahi hota. Na karna bhi bilkul normal hai.

q.en: Kunal, 15, has never masturbated, and his friends joke that something is wrong with him. What is true?
q.hg: Kunal, 15, ne kabhi masturbate nahi kiya, aur uske dost mazaak udaate hain ki usme kuch gadbad hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It means his hormones have not started working
options.hg: Iska matlab uske hormones ne kaam karna shuru nahi kiya

options.en: Not masturbating is just as normal as masturbating
options.hg: Masturbate na karna bhi utna hi normal hai jitna karna

options.en: He will have problems with fertility when he grows up
options.hg: Bade hokar use fertility mein problem hogi

options.en: Every boy his age must do it at least once a day
options.hg: Uski umar ke har ladke ko din mein kam se kam ek baar karna hi chahiye

explain.en: People differ: some masturbate often, some rarely, some never, and all of these are normal. There is no 'correct' amount. Friends' teasing says nothing about Kunal's health.
explain.hg: Log alag hote hain: kuch aksar karte hain, kuch kabhi kabhi, kuch kabhi nahi, aur ye sab normal hai. Koi 'sahi' amount nahi hota. Doston ka mazaak Kunal ki health ke baare mein kuch nahi batata.

q.en: When might masturbation become something worth talking to a doctor or counsellor about?
q.hg: Masturbation kab aisi cheez ban sakti hai jiske baare mein doctor ya counsellor se baat karni chahiye?

options.en: When it causes distress or gets in the way of school, sleep or friends
options.hg: Jab isse pareshaani ho ya ye school, neend ya doston ke beech aaye

options.en: Whenever it happens more than once in a month
options.hg: Jab bhi ye mahine mein ek baar se zyada ho

options.en: Any time a person feels pleasure while doing it
options.hg: Jab bhi karte waqt kisi ko achha feel ho

options.en: As soon as a person starts puberty
options.hg: Jaise hi koi puberty shuru kare

explain.en: Masturbation is not harmful in itself. It is worth discussing only if it feels out of control, causes injury or strong distress, or crowds out daily life. A doctor or counsellor will talk about it without judging.
explain.hg: Masturbation apne aap mein harmful nahi. Baat karne layak tabhi hai jab ye control se bahar lage, chot lage ya bahut pareshaani ho, ya roz ki life pe asar pade. Doctor ya counsellor bina judge kiye baat karenge.

q.en: Aryan feels guilty and 'dirty' after masturbating, though nothing is physically wrong. Why might this happen?
q.hg: Aryan masturbate karne ke baad guilty aur 'ganda' feel karta hai, jabki body mein koi problem nahi. Aisa kyun ho sakta hai?

options.en: His body is warning him that real damage has been done
options.hg: Uski body warning de rahi hai ki asli nuksaan ho gaya hai

options.en: Guilt is a medical side effect of masturbation
options.hg: Guilt masturbation ka medical side effect hai

options.en: It proves masturbation is harmful for boys his age
options.hg: Ye prove karta hai ki uski umar ke ladkon ke liye masturbation harmful hai

options.en: He has absorbed myths and shame, which can be unlearned by talking
options.hg: Usne myths aur sharam seekh li hai, jo baat karke unlearn ho sakti hai

explain.en: Many young people grow up hearing that masturbation is shameful or dangerous, so guilt is common. The feeling comes from those messages, not from harm. Reliable information and talking to a doctor or counsellor can ease it.
explain.hg: Bahut se young log sunte hue bade hote hain ki masturbation sharam ki ya khatarnak baat hai, isliye guilt common hai. Ye feeling un messages se aati hai, nuksaan se nahi. Sahi jaankari aur doctor ya counsellor se baat karna isse halka karta hai.

q.en: Is it normal for girls and women to masturbate?
q.hg: Kya ladkiyon aur mahilaon ka masturbate karna normal hai?

options.en: No, only boys have the kind of feelings that lead to it
options.hg: Nahi, sirf ladkon mein aisi feelings hoti hain

options.en: Only if they are married and their husband agrees
options.hg: Sirf agar shaadi ho chuki ho aur pati maane

options.en: Yes, people of every gender may masturbate, and it is normal
options.hg: Haan, har gender ke log masturbate kar sakte hain, aur ye normal hai

options.en: No, for girls it causes problems with periods
options.hg: Nahi, ladkiyon mein isse periods ki problem hoti hai

explain.en: Sexual feelings are a normal part of growing up for all genders. Girls who masturbate are not 'bad' or unhealthy, and it does not affect periods or future fertility.
explain.hg: Sexual feelings har gender ke liye bade hone ka normal hissa hain. Jo ladkiyan masturbate karti hain woh 'buri' ya unhealthy nahi hain, aur isse periods ya future fertility pe koi asar nahi padta.

q.en: A viral reel claims that giving up masturbation for 90 days gives 'superpowers', glowing skin and huge confidence. What is the evidence-based view?
q.hg: Ek viral reel kehti hai ki 90 din masturbation chhodne se 'superpowers', glowing skin aur zabardast confidence milta hai. Evidence ke hisaab se sach kya hai?

options.en: Doctors recommend it for every teen to improve their grades
options.hg: Doctor har teen ko grades sudharne ke liye ye recommend karte hain

options.en: There is no good evidence for these claims; stopping is a choice, not a cure
options.hg: In claims ka koi achha evidence nahi; chhodna ek choice hai, ilaaj nahi

options.en: It works because semen goes back into the blood as energy
options.hg: Ye kaam karta hai kyunki semen khoon mein energy ban ke wapas jaata hai

options.en: Not stopping will slowly make the face lose its glow
options.hg: Na chhodne se chehre ki chamak dheere dheere chali jaati hai

explain.en: Some people choose to cut down and feel better, which is fine, but claims of superpowers or glowing skin are not backed by research. Masturbation is not harmful, so there is no medical need to stop. Be wary of reels selling guilt.
explain.hg: Kuch log kam karna chunte hain aur achha feel karte hain, jo theek hai, par superpowers ya glowing skin ke claims research se prove nahi hain. Masturbation harmful nahi, isliye medically chhodne ki zaroorat nahi. Guilt bechne wali reels se savdhaan raho.

q.en: What happens to sperm that are not ejaculated?
q.hg: Jo sperm bahar nahi nikalte, unka kya hota hai?

options.en: They break down and the body reabsorbs them, while new ones keep forming
options.hg: Woh toot jaate hain aur body unhe absorb kar leti hai, aur naye bante rehte hain

options.en: They build up and turn into extra muscle and strength
options.hg: Woh jama hokar extra muscle aur taakat ban jaate hain

options.en: They travel to the brain and improve memory
options.hg: Woh brain tak jaakar memory sudharte hain

options.en: They stay stored for life, so every single release is a permanent loss of strength
options.hg: Woh zindagi bhar store rehte hain, isliye har baar nikalna taakat ka permanent nuksaan hai

explain.en: The testes make sperm continuously from puberty onwards. Unused sperm are broken down and reabsorbed. 'Saving' semen does not add strength, and releasing it through sex, masturbation or wet dreams does not drain the body.
explain.hg: Puberty ke baad testes lagataar sperm banate hain. Jo use nahi hote woh toot ke absorb ho jaate hain. Semen 'bachaane' se taakat nahi badhti, aur sex, masturbation ya wet dreams se nikalna body ko kamzor nahi karta.

q.en: Which statement about masturbation and privacy is right?
q.hg: Masturbation aur privacy ke baare mein kaunsi baat sahi hai?

options.en: It is fine anywhere as long as no adult is watching
options.hg: Kahin bhi theek hai jab tak koi adult na dekh raha ho

options.en: It should be discussed with everyone in the class group
options.hg: Iske baare mein class group mein sabse discuss karna chahiye

options.en: Privacy does not matter because it is a normal activity
options.hg: Privacy matter nahi karti kyunki ye normal activity hai

options.en: It is a private activity, so it belongs in a private place
options.hg: Ye private activity hai, isliye private jagah pe hi theek hai

explain.en: Masturbation is normal and private, like using the toilet. Doing it in a private place respects you and others. Doing sexual things where others can see, or in front of children, is not okay and can be an offence.
explain.hg: Masturbation normal aur private hai, jaise toilet use karna. Private jagah pe karna tumhari aur dusron ki respect hai. Dusre dekh sakein wahan ya bachchon ke saamne sexual cheezein karna theek nahi aur offence ho sakta hai.

q.en: What is pornography, really?
q.hg: Pornography asal mein kya hai?

options.en: A reliable guide to how most couples have sex
options.hg: Ek reliable guide ki zyadatar couples kaise sex karte hain

options.en: A form of sex education approved by doctors
options.hg: Doctors ki approved sex education

options.en: Filmed entertainment with actors, scripts and editing, not real-life sex
options.hg: Actors, script aur editing wala filmed entertainment, asli zindagi ka sex nahi

options.en: Hidden-camera footage of ordinary people's lives
options.hg: Aam logon ki zindagi ki hidden camera footage

explain.en: Commercial porn is produced to excite viewers, using chosen performers, many takes, angles and editing. It leaves out talking, consent, protection and awkward moments, so it is a poor guide to real relationships.
explain.hg: Commercial porn dekhne walon ko excite karne ke liye banaya jaata hai, chune hue performers, kai takes, angles aur editing ke saath. Isme baat-cheet, consent, protection aur awkward moments nahi hote, isliye ye asli relationships ki achhi guide nahi.

q.en: In most porn, partners rarely ask each other anything. In real life, what is essential?
q.hg: Zyadatar porn mein partners ek dusre se kuch poochte hi nahi. Asli zindagi mein kya zaroori hai?

options.en: Guessing what the other person wants from their expression
options.hg: Doosre ke chehre se andaaza lagana ki woh kya chahte hain

options.en: Asking, checking in and stopping whenever someone wants to
options.hg: Poochna, beech mein check karna, aur jab bhi koi chahe ruk jaana

options.en: Continuing once things start, since stopping is awkward
options.hg: Ek baar shuru ho gaya toh chalte rehna, rukna awkward hai

options.en: Doing what you saw in videos because everyone likes it
options.hg: Videos mein jo dekha wahi karna kyunki sabko pasand hota hai

explain.en: Consent is clear, freely given and ongoing, and anyone can change their mind at any point. Porn often skips this because it is scripted. Real partners talk, check in and respect a 'no' or a hesitation.
explain.hg: Consent saaf, apni marzi se aur lagataar hona chahiye, aur koi bhi kabhi bhi mann badal sakta hai. Porn aksar ise skip karta hai kyunki woh scripted hai. Asli partners baat karte hain, check karte hain aur 'na' ya jhijhak ki respect karte hain.

q.en: Why do bodies in porn often look so different from most people's?
q.hg: Porn mein bodies aksar zyadatar logon se itni alag kyun dikhti hain?

options.en: Performers are selected for unusual features, and angles and surgery add to it
options.hg: Performers unusual features ke liye chune jaate hain, aur camera angles aur surgery bhi farak laate hain

options.en: They show the average body that most adults have
options.hg: Ye wahi average body dikhate hain jo zyadatar adults ki hoti hai

options.en: Bodies naturally change to look like that after a few years of having regular sex
options.hg: Kuch saal regular sex ke baad bodies naturally waisi ban jaati hain

options.en: Anyone can look like that by using special oils
options.hg: Koi bhi special oils lagaakar waisa dikh sakta hai

explain.en: Porn picks performers for features that are uncommon, then uses lighting, camera tricks, editing and sometimes cosmetic surgery. Real genitals, breasts and bodies vary hugely, and that variety is normal.
explain.hg: Porn aise performers chunta hai jinke features uncommon hote hain, phir lighting, camera tricks, editing aur kabhi cosmetic surgery use hoti hai. Asli genitals, breasts aur bodies bahut alag alag hoti hain, aur ye variety normal hai.

q.en: A scene in a porn video seems to go on for a very long time. What is the reality?
q.hg: Porn video ka ek scene bahut lamba chalta dikhta hai. Asliyat kya hai?

options.en: Real sex is supposed to last at least that long
options.hg: Asli sex ko kam se kam itna lamba chalna hi chahiye

options.en: Performers can do it because they take special herbal pills
options.hg: Performers special herbal goliyan lete hain isliye kar paate hain

options.en: Anything shorter means a man has a medical problem
options.hg: Isse kam ho toh mard ko medical problem hai

options.en: Scenes are shot in many takes over hours and edited together
options.hg: Scenes ghanton mein kai takes mein shoot hokar jode jaate hain

explain.en: Porn is filmed with breaks, retakes and editing, so what looks continuous is not. There is no 'correct' length for sex; what matters is that both partners are comfortable and communicating. Comparing with edited video fuels needless anxiety.
explain.hg: Porn break, retakes aur editing ke saath shoot hota hai, toh jo lagataar dikhta hai woh hota nahi. Sex ki koi 'sahi' length nahi hoti; zaroori ye hai ki dono comfortable hon aur baat karein. Edited video se compare karna bekaar anxiety badhata hai.

q.en: Condoms and contraception rarely appear in porn. What does that mean for real life?
q.hg: Porn mein condom aur contraception kam hi dikhte hain. Asli zindagi ke liye iska kya matlab hai?

options.en: Protection is not really needed if partners look healthy
options.hg: Partners healthy dikhein toh protection ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: Condoms spoil the mood, which is why nobody uses them
options.hg: Condom mood kharab karte hain, isliye koi use nahi karta

options.en: Real sex needs planning for pregnancy and STI protection
options.hg: Asli sex mein pregnancy aur STI protection ki planning zaroori hai

options.en: Porn performers are immune to STIs, so others are too
options.hg: Porn performers STI se immune hote hain, toh baaki bhi

explain.en: Leaving out condoms is a filming choice, not a sign they are unnecessary. In real life, condoms lower the risk of both pregnancy and STIs, and many STIs show no symptoms, so looking healthy proves nothing.
explain.hg: Condom na dikhana filming ki choice hai, ye sign nahi ki unki zaroorat nahi. Asli zindagi mein condom pregnancy aur STI dono ka risk kam karte hain, aur bahut se STI ke koi symptoms nahi hote, toh healthy dikhna kuch prove nahi karta.

q.en: Someone says, 'Anyone who watches porn is a porn addict.' What is the most accurate response?
q.hg: Koi kehta hai, 'Jo bhi porn dekhta hai woh porn addict hai.' Sabse sahi jawab kya hai?

options.en: Yes, even a single viewing permanently rewires the brain in the same way as hard drugs
options.hg: Haan, ek baar dekhne se bhi brain hard drugs ki tarah hamesha ke liye badal jaata hai

options.en: For most it isn't addiction; it's a problem when control is lost and life suffers
options.hg: Zyadatar ke liye ye addiction nahi; problem tab hai jab control chala jaaye aur life pe asar pade

options.en: No, porn can never cause any problems for anyone
options.hg: Nahi, porn kabhi kisi ke liye koi problem nahi bana sakta

options.en: Only women can become hooked, because they are more emotional
options.hg: Sirf mahilaon ko aadat lagti hai kyunki woh zyada emotional hoti hain

explain.en: Experts debate the word 'addiction'. What clearly matters is the pattern: repeated failed attempts to cut down, using it to escape distress, or harm to sleep, studies, work or relationships. That is worth talking to a doctor or counsellor about.
explain.hg: Experts 'addiction' shabd pe behas karte hain. Jo saaf matter karta hai woh pattern hai: kam karne ki baar baar fail koshish, pareshaani se bhaagne ke liye use karna, ya neend, padhai, kaam ya rishton pe nuksaan. Is baare mein doctor ya counsellor se baat karna achha hai.

q.en: Nikhil, 22, has no trouble getting an erection alone but does with a new partner, and is terrified something is wrong. What is a common cause?
q.hg: Nikhil, 22, ko akele erection mein koi problem nahi, par naye partner ke saath hoti hai, aur woh bahut dara hua hai ki kuch gadbad hai. Iska common kaaran kya hai?

options.en: Performance anxiety, which is common and treatable; a doctor can help
options.hg: Performance anxiety, jo common hai aur ilaaj ho sakta hai; doctor help kar sakte hain

options.en: Permanent nerve damage caused by past masturbation
options.hg: Pehle ke masturbation se hua permanent nerve damage

options.en: Proof that he is not attracted to anyone at all
options.hg: Proof ki woh kisi ki taraf bhi attracted nahi hai

options.en: A sign that only a quack's 'shakti' capsule can fix
options.hg: Sign ki sirf kisi neem-hakeem ka 'shakti' capsule hi theek karega

explain.en: Worry about 'performing' triggers the stress response, which works against arousal, so anxiety itself is a very common cause in young men. Talking with the partner and seeing a qualified doctor helps. Quack capsules can be unsafe.
explain.hg: 'Perform' karne ki tension stress response chalu karti hai, jo arousal ke khilaaf kaam karta hai, isliye young men mein anxiety khud bahut common kaaran hai. Partner se baat karna aur qualified doctor se milna help karta hai. Neem-hakeem ke capsules unsafe ho sakte hain.

q.en: A partner asks to try something they saw in a porn video, and you feel unsure. What is true?
q.hg: Partner kuch try karna chahta hai jo usne porn video mein dekha, aur tum unsure ho. Kya sach hai?

options.en: You must agree, because it is normal if it was in a video
options.hg: Tumhe maanna padega, video mein tha toh normal hai

options.en: Saying no means you do not really love your partner
options.hg: Na bolne ka matlab tum partner se sach mein pyaar nahi karte

options.en: It is fine to agree now and quietly regret it later
options.hg: Abhi haan bol do aur baad mein chupchaap pachhtao, theek hai

options.en: You can say no or 'not now', and a respectful partner accepts it
options.hg: Tum na ya 'abhi nahi' bol sakte ho, aur respectful partner ise maanega

explain.en: Seeing something in porn does not make it expected or safe. Consent means each person freely agrees to each thing, and unsure is not yes. Talking openly about likes and limits is part of a healthy relationship.
explain.hg: Porn mein kuch dekhne se woh expected ya safe nahi ho jaata. Consent ka matlab hai har insaan har cheez ke liye apni marzi se haan bole, aur unsure 'haan' nahi hai. Pasand aur limits ke baare mein khul ke baat karna healthy relationship ka hissa hai.

q.en: Some porn shows rough or aggressive acts as if the other person always enjoys them. What is the reality?
q.hg: Kuch porn mein rough ya aggressive cheezein aise dikhai jaati hain jaise doosra insaan hamesha enjoy karta hai. Asliyat kya hai?

options.en: Most people secretly want this, even if they say no
options.hg: Zyadatar log chupke se yahi chahte hain, chahe na bolein

options.en: If a partner does not protest loudly, they are enjoying it
options.hg: Partner zor se virodh na kare toh woh enjoy kar raha hai

options.en: Real people vary, and anything risky needs clear agreement and can stop anytime
options.hg: Asli log alag hote hain, aur koi bhi risky cheez saaf agreement chahti hai aur kabhi bhi ruk sakti hai

options.en: Aggression is a normal and healthy sign of passion in every loving relationship
options.hg: Har pyaar bhare rishte mein aggression passion ka normal aur healthy sign hai

explain.en: Porn often scripts aggression as welcome, which can blur the line between what is wanted and what is harm. In real life, nobody can be assumed to want something; acts that can hurt need explicit agreement, and silence or freezing is not consent.
explain.hg: Porn aksar aggression ko welcome dikhata hai, jisse chahat aur nuksaan ke beech ki line dhundhli ho sakti hai. Asli zindagi mein koi kuch chahta hai, ye assume nahi kar sakte; jo cheez hurt kar sakti hai uske liye saaf agreement chahiye, aur chup rehna ya freeze hona consent nahi.

q.en: How does porn commonly misrepresent women's pleasure?
q.hg: Porn aksar mahilaon ki pleasure ko galat kaise dikhata hai?

options.en: It shows exactly how most women experience sex
options.hg: Ye bilkul waise dikhata hai jaise zyadatar mahilaayein sex experience karti hain

options.en: It shows quick, loud, effortless reactions that are acted, not typical
options.hg: Ye jaldi, zor se, bina mehnat ke reactions dikhata hai jo acting hain, typical nahi

options.en: It proves women do not need to communicate what they like
options.hg: Ye prove karta hai ki mahilaon ko batane ki zaroorat nahi ki unhe kya pasand hai

options.en: It shows that pleasure depends mainly on a partner's size
options.hg: Ye dikhata hai ki pleasure mainly partner ke size pe depend karti hai

explain.en: Reactions in porn are performed for the camera. In real life, pleasure differs from person to person and depends a lot on comfort, trust and communication. Expecting porn-style reactions can create pressure for both partners.
explain.hg: Porn ke reactions camera ke liye perform kiye jaate hain. Asli zindagi mein pleasure har insaan mein alag hoti hai aur comfort, trust aur baat-cheet pe bahut depend karti hai. Porn jaise reactions expect karna dono partners pe pressure daal sakta hai.

q.en: While browsing a free porn site, a pop-up says, 'Police have locked your phone. Pay Rs 5,000 fine now.' What should you do?
q.hg: Free porn site browse karte hue pop-up aata hai, 'Police ne aapka phone lock kar diya hai. Abhi Rs 5,000 fine bharo.' Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Do not pay; it is a scam, close it and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in
options.hg: Pay mat karo; ye scam hai, band karo aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo

options.en: Pay quickly so the police do not come to your house
options.hg: Jaldi pay kar do taaki police ghar na aaye

options.en: Share your bank details with them to prove your identity
options.hg: Identity prove karne ke liye unhe bank details de do

options.en: Call the number on the pop-up to negotiate a lower fine
options.hg: Pop-up wale number pe call karke fine kam karwao

explain.en: Police never lock phones or collect fines through pop-ups. These are scams designed to frighten people into paying. Close the browser, do not share details, and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in. If you already paid, report quickly.
explain.hg: Police kabhi pop-up ke through phone lock nahi karti ya fine nahi leti. Ye scams hain jo darra ke paise nikalwaate hain. Browser band karo, details mat do, aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo. Agar pay kar diya hai, toh jaldi report karo.

q.en: A sexual video of a 16-year-old from your college is posted in a WhatsApp group. What is the right action?
q.hg: Tumhare college ke ek 16 saal ke student ka sexual video WhatsApp group mein post hota hai. Sahi action kya hai?

options.en: Download it as evidence and keep it safely on your phone
options.hg: Evidence ke liye download karke phone mein safe rakh lo

options.en: Forward it to the student so they know it is going around
options.hg: Student ko forward kar do taaki unhe pata chale ki ye phail raha hai

options.en: Ignore it, because it is not your fault and not your business
options.hg: Ignore karo, kyunki ye tumhari galti nahi aur tumhara matlab nahi

options.en: Don't forward or save it; report it to cybercrime.gov.in or 1930 with an adult
options.hg: Forward ya save mat karo; kisi adult ke saath cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report karo

explain.en: Any sexual image of someone under 18 is child sexual abuse material; creating, viewing, storing or sharing it is a serious offence. Do not download or forward it, even as evidence. Note the group details and report with a trusted adult.
explain.hg: 18 se kam umar ke kisi ki bhi sexual image child sexual abuse material hai; ise banana, dekhna, rakhna ya share karna serious offence hai. Evidence ke liye bhi download ya forward mat karo. Group ki details note karo aur trusted adult ke saath report karo.

q.en: Where is a young person most likely to find accurate information about sex and sexual health?
q.hg: Kisi young insaan ko sex aur sexual health ki sahi jaankari kahan milne ki sabse zyada sambhavna hai?

options.en: Porn videos, because they show it directly
options.hg: Porn videos, kyunki woh seedha dikhate hain

options.en: Wall ads for 'gupt rog' clinics near the railway station
options.hg: Railway station ke paas 'gupt rog' clinics ke deewar wale ads

options.en: A doctor, a trusted health website or a good sex-education resource
options.hg: Doctor, trusted health website ya achha sex-education resource

options.en: Whatever the oldest boy in the hostel says
options.hg: Hostel ka sabse bada ladka jo bhi bolta hai

explain.en: Porn, rumours and quack ads mix entertainment, fear and sales. Doctors, health services and evidence-based sex-education sources explain bodies, consent and protection accurately, and you can ask questions without being judged.
explain.hg: Porn, afwaahein aur neem-hakeem ke ads entertainment, darr aur bikri ka mix hain. Doctor, health services aur evidence-based sex-education sources body, consent aur protection sahi samjhaate hain, aur bina judge hue sawaal pooch sakte ho.

q.en: Akash, 17, compares himself with porn actors and worries his body is 'too small'. What is most accurate?
q.hg: Akash, 17, khud ko porn actors se compare karta hai aur tension mein hai ki uski body 'bahut chhoti' hai. Sabse sahi baat kya hai?

options.en: He should start enlargement pills before he turns 18
options.hg: Use 18 se pehle enlargement pills shuru kar deni chahiye

options.en: Porn actors are not typical, and most worried young men are in the normal range
options.hg: Porn actors typical nahi hote, aur zyadatar pareshaan young men normal range mein hote hain

options.en: Size decides whether he can become a father later
options.hg: Size tay karta hai ki woh baad mein baap ban payega ya nahi

options.en: Porn shows the average adult size, so his worry about being too small is fully correct
options.hg: Porn average adult size dikhata hai, isliye chhota hone ki uski tension bilkul sahi hai

explain.en: Many young men worry about size because they compare themselves with chosen performers and camera angles. Size varies a lot and is not linked to fertility. Pills and oils do not change it. A doctor can reassure anyone still worried.
explain.hg: Bahut se young men size ki tension lete hain kyunki woh chune hue performers aur camera angles se compare karte hain. Size bahut alag hota hai aur fertility se juda nahi. Pills aur oils isse nahi badalte. Fir bhi tension ho toh doctor reassure kar sakte hain.

q.en: Raj wants to cut down on watching porn. Which plan is most likely to help?
q.hg: Raj porn dekhna kam karna chahta hai. Kaunsa plan sabse zyada help karega?

options.en: Notice triggers like boredom or late nights, and plan other things for those times
options.hg: Triggers jaise boriyat ya der raat notice karo, aur us time ke liye doosri cheezein plan karo

options.en: Shame himself harshly every time he slips
options.hg: Har baar slip hone pe khud ko bahut bura bhala kaho

options.en: Promise himself to stop forever, starting tonight, and tell nobody so nobody judges him
options.hg: Khud se promise kare ki aaj raat se hamesha ke liye band, aur kisi ko na bataye taaki koi judge na kare

options.en: Watch more for a while so he gets bored of it
options.hg: Kuch time aur zyada dekho taaki bore ho jaao

explain.en: Practical steps work better than shame: spot triggers, keep the phone out of the bedroom, fill those times with sport, friends or hobbies, and use filters if helpful. If it feels out of control, a counsellor can help without judging.
explain.hg: Sharam se zyada practical steps kaam karte hain: triggers pehchano, phone bedroom se bahar rakho, us time ko sport, doston ya hobbies se bharo, aur chaho toh filters lagao. Control se bahar lage toh counsellor bina judge kiye help kar sakta hai.

q.en: Porn often shows bodies with all hair removed. What is true about pubic hair in real life?
q.hg: Porn mein aksar bodies se saare baal hataaye dikhte hain. Asli zindagi mein pubic hair ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: Pubic hair is dirty and must be removed for hygiene
options.hg: Pubic hair gande hote hain aur hygiene ke liye hataane hi chahiye

options.en: Hair removal is required before seeing a doctor
options.hg: Doctor ke paas jaane se pehle baal hataana zaroori hai

options.en: Partners will always reject someone who keeps body hair
options.hg: Body hair rakhne wale ko partner hamesha reject karenge

options.en: Keeping, trimming or removing it is a personal choice; hair is normal
options.hg: Rakhna, trim karna ya hataana apni choice hai; baal normal hain

explain.en: Pubic hair is a normal part of an adult body and has nothing to do with being clean. Washing with water is enough. Removing it is a personal choice, and shaving or waxing can cause cuts, ingrown hairs or irritation.
explain.hg: Pubic hair adult body ka normal hissa hain aur safai se iska koi lena-dena nahi. Paani se dhona kaafi hai. Hataana apni choice hai, aur shaving ya waxing se cut, andar ugne wale baal ya irritation ho sakti hai.

q.en: Why can watching a lot of porn shape what a person expects from sex, even if they know it is fake?
q.hg: Bahut zyada porn dekhne se, ye jaante hue bhi ki ye fake hai, sex se expectations kyun badal sakti hain?

options.en: Porn sends hidden signals through the screen that permanently change a person's hormones
options.hg: Porn screen ke through hidden signals bhejta hai jo hormones hamesha ke liye badal dete hain

options.en: The brain cannot tell a video from a memory at all
options.hg: Brain video aur yaad mein bilkul farak nahi kar sakta

options.en: Seeing the same scripts again and again can make them feel normal or expected
options.hg: Same scripts baar baar dekhne se woh normal ya expected lagne lagti hain

options.en: It only happens to people who watch porn on a big screen
options.hg: Ye sirf unke saath hota hai jo bade screen pe porn dekhte hain

explain.en: People learn from repeated stories, and porn repeats a narrow script about bodies, roles and what partners want. Even knowing it is staged, those scripts can quietly shape expectations. Talking with partners and trusted sources helps balance them.
explain.hg: Log baar baar dekhi kahaniyon se seekhte hain, aur porn bodies, roles aur partner ki chahat ke baare mein ek tang script repeat karta hai. Staged jaante hue bhi, ye scripts chupchaap expectations badal sakti hain. Partner aur trusted sources se baat karna balance laata hai.

q.en: 'A real man always wants sex and is always ready.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Asli mard hamesha sex chahta hai aur hamesha ready rehta hai.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: Every healthy man wants sex at all times of the day
options.hg: Har healthy mard din ke har time sex chahta hai

options.en: Desire varies with mood, stress, health and relationship, in men too
options.hg: Chahat mood, stress, health aur rishte ke saath badalti hai, mardon mein bhi

options.en: A man who says no is weak or has a disease
options.hg: Jo mard na bolta hai woh kamzor hai ya use bimaari hai

options.en: Only women can ever feel 'not in the mood'
options.hg: Sirf mahilaayein hi 'mood nahi hai' feel kar sakti hain

explain.en: Sexual desire naturally rises and falls for everyone. Tiredness, stress, worries and the relationship all affect it. Men can say no too, and the 'always ready' myth puts unfair pressure on boys and men.
explain.hg: Sexual chahat sabme naturally upar neeche hoti hai. Thakaan, stress, tension aur rishta sab asar daalte hain. Mard bhi na bol sakte hain, aur 'hamesha ready' wala myth ladkon aur mardon pe unfair pressure daalta hai.

q.en: What is 'performance anxiety' in a sexual context?
q.hg: Sexual context mein 'performance anxiety' kya hai?

options.en: Worry about doing 'well' that can itself make sex harder
options.hg: 'Achha' karne ki tension jo khud sex ko mushkil bana sakti hai

options.en: A sign that a person is not attracted to their partner
options.hg: Sign ki insaan apne partner ki taraf attracted nahi hai

options.en: A permanent condition that cannot be treated
options.hg: Permanent condition jiska ilaaj nahi ho sakta

options.en: Something that only happens to people over 60
options.hg: Kuch jo sirf 60 se upar walon ko hota hai

explain.en: Fear of disappointing a partner or of 'failing' can cause erection difficulties, trouble with arousal or finishing quickly. It is common, especially early in relationships, and talking, reassurance and sometimes counselling help.
explain.hg: Partner ko disappoint karne ya 'fail' hone ka darr erection mein mushkil, arousal mein problem ya jaldi finish hone ka kaaran ban sakta hai. Ye common hai, khaaskar relationship ki shuruaat mein, aur baat karna, reassurance aur kabhi counselling help karti hai.

q.en: Ravi, 24, worries he ejaculates 'too fast' and is about to buy a 'timing oil' from an ad. What is the better step?
q.hg: Ravi, 24, ko tension hai ki woh 'bahut jaldi' ejaculate karta hai aur ek ad se 'timing oil' khareedne wala hai. Behtar step kya hai?

options.en: Buy the oil, since ads for these products are checked by doctors
options.hg: Oil khareed lo, aise products ke ads doctors check karte hain

options.en: Avoid all relationships, because the problem is permanent
options.hg: Saare relationships avoid karo, kyunki problem permanent hai

options.en: Take several unknown capsules together for a stronger effect
options.hg: Kai unknown capsules ek saath lo taaki asar zyada ho

options.en: See a qualified doctor; early ejaculation is common and treatable
options.hg: Qualified doctor se milo; jaldi ejaculation common hai aur iska ilaaj hai

explain.en: Finishing sooner than one would like is one of the most common sexual concerns in men. Doctors can offer techniques, counselling and, if needed, proper medicine. Unlabelled oils and capsules sold through ads may not work and can be unsafe.
explain.hg: Chahne se pehle finish ho jaana mardon ki sabse common sexual concerns mein se ek hai. Doctor techniques, counselling aur zaroorat ho toh sahi medicine de sakte hain. Ads se bikne wale bina label ke oils aur capsules kaam na karein aur unsafe bhi ho sakte hain.

q.en: Friends tease Sneha, 16, for never having had a boyfriend. What is true?
q.hg: Dost Sneha, 16, ko chidhaate hain ki uska kabhi boyfriend nahi raha. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Something is wrong with her if she is single at 16
options.hg: 16 mein single ho toh usme kuch gadbad hai

options.en: Everyone her age is already in a relationship
options.hg: Uski umar ka har koi pehle se relationship mein hai

options.en: There is no deadline for relationships; she can go at her own pace
options.hg: Relationship ki koi deadline nahi; woh apni speed se chal sakti hai

options.en: She should date anyone who asks, just to fit in
options.hg: Fit in hone ke liye jo bhi pooche usse date kar le

explain.en: Many teenagers are not dating, and people start relationships at very different ages, or not at all. Feeling ready, safe and respected matters far more than keeping up with friends.
explain.hg: Bahut se teenagers date nahi kar rahe, aur log bahut alag umar mein relationship shuru karte hain, ya bilkul nahi karte. Ready, safe aur respected feel karna doston ke saath race lagane se kahin zyada zaroori hai.

q.en: A newly married couple feel anxious and not ready for sex on their wedding night, while relatives tease them. What is healthy?
q.hg: Ek naya shaadi-shuda couple suhaag raat pe anxious hai aur sex ke liye ready nahi, jabki rishtedaar chhed rahe hain. Healthy kya hai?

options.en: Have sex that night anyway, because it is expected
options.hg: Phir bhi usi raat sex karo, kyunki sab yahi expect karte hain

options.en: Take time, talk and wait until both genuinely want it
options.hg: Time lo, baat karo, aur tab tak ruko jab tak dono sach mein na chahein

options.en: Get a doctor's medicine so you can perform on time
options.hg: Doctor ki medicine le lo taaki time pe perform kar sako

options.en: One partner should decide for both, since they are married
options.hg: Ek partner dono ke liye decide kare, shaadi jo ho gayi hai

explain.en: Marriage is not consent; each act needs both partners' willing agreement. Nerves are normal, especially between people who are still getting to know each other. Going slowly and talking builds trust, and nobody else gets a timetable.
explain.hg: Shaadi consent nahi hai; har baar dono partners ki apni marzi chahiye. Ghabrahat normal hai, khaaskar jab log ek dusre ko abhi jaan rahe hon. Dheere chalna aur baat karna trust banata hai, aur kisi aur ka timetable nahi chalta.

q.en: A woman has little interest in sex for months and her husband calls her 'cold'. What is the most accurate view?
q.hg: Ek mahila ko mahino se sex mein kam interest hai aur uska pati use 'thandi' kehta hai. Sabse sahi soch kya hai?

options.en: Low desire has many causes, like stress, pain or relationship issues; a doctor can help
options.hg: Kam chahat ke kai kaaran hote hain, jaise stress, dard ya rishte ki problem; doctor help kar sakte hain

options.en: Women naturally lose all interest in sex after marriage and nothing can ever change that
options.hg: Shaadi ke baad mahilaayein naturally sex mein interest kho deti hain aur ye kabhi nahi badalta

options.en: It means she is secretly in love with someone else
options.hg: Iska matlab woh chupke se kisi aur se pyaar karti hai

options.en: It is her duty to have sex anyway, whatever she feels
options.hg: Jo bhi feel kare, sex karna uska farz hai

explain.en: Desire is affected by tiredness, stress, depression, hormones, medicines, pain and how the relationship feels. Labels like 'cold' add shame. Both partners talking openly, and a doctor or counsellor, can help find the cause. Nobody owes sex.
explain.hg: Chahat pe thakaan, stress, depression, hormones, medicines, dard aur rishte ka mahaul asar daalte hain. 'Thandi' jaise labels sharam badhaate hain. Dono ka khul ke baat karna, aur doctor ya counsellor, kaaran dhoondhne mein help kar sakte hain. Sex kisi ka farz nahi.

q.en: Which can lower sexual desire for a while in healthy young people?
q.hg: Kaunsi cheez healthy young logon mein kuch time ke liye sexual chahat kam kar sakti hai?

options.en: Drinking enough water every day
options.hg: Roz kaafi paani peena

options.en: Exercising a few times a week
options.hg: Hafte mein kuch baar exercise karna

options.en: Eating a balanced home-cooked diet
options.hg: Balanced ghar ka khana khaana

options.en: Stress, poor sleep or feeling low
options.hg: Stress, kam neend ya low feel karna

explain.en: Desire is closely tied to mental state. Exams, work pressure, poor sleep, low mood and some medicines can all dampen it for a time. That is normal, and it often returns when the cause eases.
explain.hg: Chahat mann ki halat se gehra judi hai. Exams, kaam ka pressure, kam neend, low mood aur kuch medicines kuch time ke liye ise kam kar sakti hain. Ye normal hai, aur aksar kaaran kam hone pe wapas aa jaati hai.

q.en: A woman feels pain every time she has sex and has been told to 'just get used to it'. What is right?
q.hg: Ek mahila ko har baar sex mein dard hota hai aur use kaha gaya hai 'aadat ho jaayegi'. Sahi kya hai?

options.en: Pain just proves she was a virgin, and it will stop on its own after a few months
options.hg: Dard bas prove karta hai ki woh virgin thi, aur kuch mahino mein apne aap ruk jaayega

options.en: Pain is normal for all women and needs no attention
options.hg: Dard sab mahilaon ke liye normal hai aur dhyaan ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: Pain during sex is not something to endure; a gynaecologist can find the cause
options.hg: Sex mein dard sehne ki cheez nahi; gynaecologist kaaran dhoondh sakti hain

options.en: She should drink alcohol beforehand to numb it
options.hg: Pehle sharaab pee le taaki dard mehsoos na ho

explain.en: Repeated pain can come from infection, dryness, anxiety, muscle tightness, endometriosis or other treatable causes. It deserves medical attention, and she can stop or say no at any time. Pushing through pain is not 'normal'.
explain.hg: Baar baar dard infection, dryness, anxiety, muscles ki jakdan, endometriosis ya doosre treatable kaaranon se ho sakta hai. Iske liye doctor se milna chahiye, aur woh kabhi bhi ruk ya na bol sakti hai. Dard sehte rehna 'normal' nahi hai.

q.en: Many people worry about their 'first time'. What matters most?
q.hg: Bahut log apne 'first time' ki tension lete hain. Sabse zyada kya matter karta hai?

options.en: Knowing all the moves from videos beforehand
options.hg: Pehle se videos se saare moves seekh lena

options.en: Both people being ready, agreeing and able to talk about it
options.hg: Dono ready hon, raazi hon aur iske baare mein baat kar sakein

options.en: Lasting a long time to impress the partner
options.hg: Partner ko impress karne ke liye lamba chalna

options.en: Doing it by a certain age so you are not left behind
options.hg: Ek fixed umar tak kar lena taaki peeche na raho

explain.en: No one is an expert the first time, and nervousness is normal. Readiness, mutual consent, protection and being able to talk honestly matter far more than technique. Sex with anyone under 18 is an offence in India under POCSO.
explain.hg: Pehli baar koi expert nahi hota, aur ghabrahat normal hai. Ready hona, dono ki consent, protection aur khul ke baat kar paana technique se kahin zyada zaroori hai. India mein 18 se kam umar ke kisi ke saath sex POCSO ke tahat offence hai.

q.en: Your partner makes fun of a part of your body during an intimate moment. What is true?
q.hg: Ek intimate pal mein tumhara partner tumhari body ke kisi hisse ka mazaak udaata hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: You deserve respect; it is okay to stop and say it hurt you
options.hg: Tum respect deserve karte ho; rukna aur ye kehna ki bura laga, theek hai

options.en: You should get surgery so it does not happen again
options.hg: Surgery karwa lo taaki dobara na ho

options.en: Partners are allowed to criticise each other's bodies
options.hg: Partners ko ek dusre ki body criticise karne ka haq hai

options.en: Feeling hurt means you are too sensitive for a relationship
options.hg: Bura lagna matlab tum relationship ke liye bahut sensitive ho
