explain.en: Mocking someone's body, especially when they are vulnerable, is disrespectful and can damage self-esteem. You can stop, say how it felt and decide what you want. Repeated put-downs are a warning sign of an unhealthy relationship.
explain.hg: Kisi ki body ka mazaak udaana, khaaskar jab woh vulnerable ho, disrespect hai aur self-esteem ko chot pahuncha sakta hai. Tum ruk sakte ho, bata sakte ho kaisa laga aur decide kar sakte ho kya chahte ho. Baar baar neecha dikhana unhealthy relationship ka warning sign hai.

q.en: If someone is in immediate danger of hurting themselves, which number should you call?
q.hg: Agar koi turant khud ko hurt karne ke khatre mein hai, toh kaunsa number call karna chahiye?

explain.en: 112 is India's emergency number for immediate danger. Stay with the person if it is safe. For ongoing support with stress, low mood or thoughts of self-harm, Tele-MANAS 14416 is free and available 24x7.
explain.hg: 112 India ka emergency number hai jab turant khatra ho. Safe ho toh us insaan ke saath raho. Stress, low mood ya self-harm ke khayalon mein lagataar support ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 free aur 24x7 hai.

q.en: Where can a teenager in India get free, confidential counselling and health advice at a government facility?
q.hg: India mein ek teenager ko sarkari jagah pe free, confidential counselling aur health advice kahan mil sakti hai?

options.en: A roadside clinic that advertises guaranteed 'gupt rog' cures on walls and buses
options.hg: Sadak kinare clinic jo deewaron aur buses pe pakke 'gupt rog' ilaaj ka ad karta hai

options.en: The nearest police station's reception desk
options.hg: Sabse paas wale police station ka reception desk

options.en: An Adolescent Friendly Health Centre at a government hospital or health centre
options.hg: Sarkari hospital ya health centre mein Adolescent Friendly Health Centre

options.en: A gym trainer who sells supplements
options.hg: Gym trainer jo supplements bechta hai

explain.en: Under the RKSK programme, Adolescent Friendly Health Centres at primary and community health centres, district hospitals and medical colleges offer counselling and clinical care for young people, designed so they can visit without hesitation.
explain.hg: RKSK programme ke tahat, primary aur community health centres, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein Adolescent Friendly Health Centres young logon ko counselling aur clinical care dete hain, aise design kiye gaye ki bina jhijhak jaa sakein.

q.en: You find an online 'therapist' on Instagram. How can you check they are actually qualified?
q.hg: Tumhe Instagram pe ek online 'therapist' milta hai. Kaise check karoge ki woh sach mein qualified hai?

options.en: Count their followers, since more followers always means more training and expertise
options.hg: Followers gino, kyunki zyada followers matlab hamesha zyada training aur expertise

options.en: Check for a psychiatry degree, or RCI registration for a clinical psychologist
options.hg: Psychiatry degree check karo, ya clinical psychologist ke liye RCI registration

options.en: Trust them if their reels have calm music and quotes
options.hg: Agar reels mein calm music aur quotes hain toh trust karo

options.en: Check whether they offer a money-back guarantee
options.hg: Dekho ki woh money-back guarantee dete hain ya nahi

explain.en: Anyone can call themselves a coach or 'therapist' online. A psychiatrist holds a medical degree with specialisation in psychiatry, and clinical psychologists in India register with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). Ask for credentials before sharing personal details.
explain.hg: Online koi bhi khud ko coach ya 'therapist' bol sakta hai. Psychiatrist ke paas psychiatry mein specialisation wali medical degree hoti hai, aur India mein clinical psychologists Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) mein register hote hain. Personal baatein share karne se pehle credentials poocho.

q.en: After a scary road accident, Aditya has nightmares and jumps at loud sounds for a couple of weeks. What is true?
q.hg: Ek darawne road accident ke baad Aditya ko do hafte se bure sapne aate hain aur tez awaaz pe woh chaunk jaata hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Such reactions are common at first; help is wise if they last over a month
options.hg: Shuru mein aise reactions common hain; mahine se zyada rahein toh help lena samajhdari hai

options.en: It means he is weak and should be told to forget it
options.hg: Iska matlab woh kamzor hai aur use bhool jaane ko kehna chahiye

options.en: Nightmares after a shock always mean a serious illness
options.hg: Shock ke baad bure sapne hamesha serious bimaari ka matlab hain

options.en: He should avoid talking about it with anyone ever
options.hg: Use iske baare mein kabhi kisi se baat nahi karni chahiye

explain.en: After a frightening event, the mind often replays it, with nightmares, jumpiness or poor sleep. These usually ease over weeks with rest and support. If they last more than a month or get worse, a doctor or counsellor can help.
explain.hg: Darawni ghatna ke baad mann aksar use replay karta hai, bure sapne, chaunkna ya kam neend ke saath. Ye aam taur pe aaram aur support se hafton mein kam ho jaate hain. Mahine se zyada rahein ya badhein toh doctor ya counsellor help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Writing down your thoughts and feelings in a diary or notes app can:
q.hg: Diary ya notes app mein apne thoughts aur feelings likhna:

options.en: Make your problems permanent by recording them
options.hg: Record karke problems ko permanent bana deta hai

options.en: Replace the need for sleep and food
options.hg: Neend aur khane ki zaroorat khatam kar deta hai

options.en: Only help people who want to become writers
options.hg: Sirf unki help karta hai jo writer banna chahte hain

options.en: Help you understand and calm your emotions
options.hg: Emotions ko samajhne aur shaant karne mein help kar sakta hai

explain.en: Putting feelings into words helps the brain process them and often makes them feel more manageable. It is a simple coping tool. If what you write shows feelings that keep getting heavier, share it with someone you trust.
explain.hg: Feelings ko shabdon mein daalna brain ko unhe process karne mein help karta hai aur aksar woh sambhalne layak lagti hain. Ye simple coping tool hai. Agar likhte hue feelings bhaari hoti ja rahi hain, toh kisi trusted insaan se share karo.

q.en: You notice that after an hour of scrolling you always feel worse. What is a sensible step?
q.hg: Tum notice karte ho ki ek ghante scroll karne ke baad hamesha bura feel hota hai. Samajhdaar step kya hai?

options.en: Scroll faster so you see more content in less time
options.hg: Tez scroll karo taaki kam time mein zyada content dikhe

options.en: Delete all your friends so nobody posts anything
options.hg: Saare dost delete kar do taaki koi kuch post na kare

options.en: Set app time limits and plan screen-free breaks
options.hg: App time limits lagao aur bina screen wale breaks plan karo

options.en: Keep going, because the feeling has nothing to do with the phone
options.hg: Chalte raho, kyunki feeling ka phone se koi lena-dena nahi

explain.en: Noticing how an app affects your mood is a useful skill. Built-in screen-time limits, keeping the phone away at night and replacing some scrolling with sport, music or friends can lift your mood.
explain.hg: Ye notice karna ki app tumhare mood pe kaisa asar daalta hai, useful skill hai. Built-in screen time limits, raat ko phone door rakhna aur kuch scrolling ki jagah sport, music ya dost, mood behtar kar sakte hain.

q.en: Your younger brother is so angry he wants to throw his phone. What is a healthy way to handle anger?
q.hg: Tumhara chhota bhai itne gusse mein hai ki phone phenkna chahta hai. Gussa handle karne ka healthy tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Break something so the anger leaves the body
options.hg: Kuch tod do taaki gussa body se nikal jaaye

options.en: Pause, breathe slowly or walk away, then talk when calmer
options.hg: Ruko, dheemi saans lo ya wahan se hat jao, phir shaant hokar baat karo

options.en: Keep it bottled up and never mention it again
options.hg: Andar daba ke rakho aur kabhi mention mat karo

options.en: Shout at whoever is nearest until he feels better
options.hg: Jo bhi paas ho uspe tab tak chillao jab tak achha na lage

explain.en: Anger is a normal emotion; what matters is what we do with it. Taking a pause, slow breathing, moving the body and talking later prevent hurting people or things. Breaking things or bottling it up tends to make anger worse.
explain.hg: Gussa normal emotion hai; matter ye karta hai ki hum uske saath kya karte hain. Rukna, dheemi saans, body ko move karna aur baad mein baat karna logon ya cheezon ko nuksaan se bachata hai. Todna ya andar dabaana gusse ko aur badhata hai.

q.en: Isha's grandmother died two months ago. Some days Isha is fine, other days she cries suddenly. What is true?
q.hg: Isha ki daadi do mahine pehle guzar gayi. Kuch din Isha theek rehti hai, kuch din achanak ro padti hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Grief often comes in waves, and this is a normal part of it
options.hg: Gham aksar lehron mein aata hai, aur ye uska normal hissa hai

options.en: She should be completely over it within a week
options.hg: Use ek hafte mein poori tarah theek ho jaana chahiye tha

options.en: Crying means she is not strong enough to cope
options.hg: Rona matlab woh cope karne layak strong nahi hai

options.en: Grief only matters if the person who died was a parent
options.hg: Gham tabhi matter karta hai jab jaane wala parent ho

explain.en: Grief does not follow a timetable; good days and hard days can mix for months. Talking about the person, keeping routines and leaning on family help. If grief stops someone functioning for a long time, a counsellor can help.
explain.hg: Gham ka koi timetable nahi hota; achhe aur mushkil din mahino tak mix ho sakte hain. Jaane wale ke baare mein baat karna, routine rakhna aur family ka saath help karta hai. Lambe time tak gham se roz ka kaam ruk jaaye toh counsellor help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Strangers leave cruel comments on Zoya's video. She feels it must be her fault. What is true?
q.hg: Anjaan log Zoya ke video pe bahut bure comments karte hain. Use lagta hai ye uski galti hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: She deserved it for posting in public
options.hg: Public mein post kiya toh woh isi layak thi

options.en: Replying angrily to each comment will make them stop
options.hg: Har comment ka gusse mein reply karne se woh ruk jaayenge

options.en: Cruel comments online cannot affect real feelings
options.hg: Online bure comments asli feelings pe asar nahi daal sakte

options.en: Trolling is not her fault; she can block, report and tell someone
options.hg: Trolling uski galti nahi; woh block, report aur kisi ko bata sakti hai

explain.en: Online abuse says more about the people posting it than about the target. Blocking, reporting, limiting comments and talking to friends or family help. Hurtful comments can really affect mood, so it is fine to step away. Serious threats can be reported on cybercrime.gov.in.
explain.hg: Online abuse target ke baare mein kam, post karne walon ke baare mein zyada batata hai. Block, report, comments limit karna aur dost ya family se baat karna help karta hai. Bure comments sach mein mood pe asar daalte hain, toh break lena theek hai. Serious dhamkiyan cybercrime.gov.in pe report ho sakti hain.

q.en: Yash loves classical dance, and classmates call him 'girly'. He starts feeling ashamed. What is true?
q.hg: Yash ko classical dance pasand hai, aur classmates use 'girly' bulaate hain. Use sharam aane lagi hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: He should quit dance and play cricket to be a real boy
options.hg: Use dance chhod ke cricket khelna chahiye taaki asli ladka bane

options.en: Boys who dance are always weaker than other boys
options.hg: Dance karne wale ladke hamesha baaki ladkon se kamzor hote hain

options.en: Interests have no gender, and teasing like this can hurt mental health
options.hg: Interests ka koi gender nahi hota, aur aisa mazaak mental health ko chot pahuncha sakta hai

options.en: Teasing is harmless and will make him tougher
options.hg: Mazaak harmless hai aur use tough banayega

explain.en: Dance, cooking, art or sport can be loved by anyone. Rigid ideas about what boys and girls 'should' like lead to bullying, shame and isolation. Yash can keep doing what he loves and get support from a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Dance, cooking, art ya sport kisi ko bhi pasand ho sakta hai. Ladke-ladkiyon ko kya 'pasand hona chahiye', is baare mein sakht soch bullying, sharam aur akelapan laati hai. Yash jo pasand hai karta rahe aur trusted adult se support le.

q.en: You are struggling and do not know who to talk to first. Which is a good option?
q.hg: Tum mushkil mein ho aur samajh nahi aa raha pehle kisse baat karo. Kaunsa achha option hai?

options.en: A stranger in an online chat room who promises to understand
options.hg: Online chat room ka anjaan insaan jo samajhne ka promise kare

options.en: A parent, teacher, counsellor or doctor you trust, or Tele-MANAS 14416
options.hg: Koi trusted parent, teacher, counsellor ya doctor, ya Tele-MANAS 14416

options.en: Nobody, because asking for help is a burden on others
options.hg: Koi nahi, kyunki help maangna dusron pe bojh hai

options.en: Only someone who has had the exact same problem
options.hg: Sirf woh jisko bilkul same problem hui ho

explain.en: Any trusted adult can be a first step, and they can help you find more support. If you cannot talk to anyone around you, Tele-MANAS 14416 is free and available all day and night. Asking for help is not a burden.
explain.hg: Koi bhi trusted adult pehla step ho sakta hai, aur woh aur support dhoondhne mein help kar sakte hain. Aas-paas kisi se baat na kar pao toh Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai aur din-raat available hai. Help maangna bojh nahi hai.

q.en: Which sign suggests online gaming may have become a problem for someone?
q.hg: Kaunsa sign batata hai ki kisi ke liye online gaming problem ban gayi hai?

options.en: Losing control over time spent, and skipping sleep, school or meals for it
options.hg: Time pe control kho dena, aur iske liye neend, school ya khana skip karna

options.en: Playing with friends for an hour on weekends
options.hg: Weekend pe doston ke saath ek ghanta khelna

options.en: Enjoying a game and talking about it at lunch
options.hg: Game enjoy karna aur lunch pe uski baat karna

options.en: Getting excited after winning a difficult level
options.hg: Mushkil level jeetne ke baad excited hona

explain.en: Enjoying games is normal. Warning signs are losing control, gaming taking priority over sleep, studies, food and people, and carrying on despite clear harm. Setting limits helps, and a counsellor can help if it feels out of control.
explain.hg: Games enjoy karna normal hai. Warning signs hain control kho dena, gaming ka neend, padhai, khane aur logon se zyada zaroori ho jaana, aur nuksaan ke bawajood chalte rehna. Limits rakhna help karta hai, aur control se bahar lage toh counsellor help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Ananya fails one unit test and thinks, 'I'll fail the boards, never get a job and ruin my life.' What is this thinking pattern called?
q.hg: Ananya ek unit test mein fail hoti hai aur sochti hai, 'Main boards mein fail houngi, kabhi job nahi milegi aur life barbaad ho jaayegi.' Is soch ke pattern ko kya kehte hain?

options.en: Realistic planning based on the evidence
options.hg: Evidence pe based realistic planning

options.en: Positive thinking that boosts motivation
options.hg: Positive thinking jo motivation badhata hai

options.en: Mindfulness of the present moment
options.hg: Abhi ke pal ki mindfulness

options.en: Catastrophising: jumping to the worst possible outcome
options.hg: Catastrophising: seedha sabse bure nateeje pe pahunch jaana

explain.en: Catastrophising turns one setback into a chain of disasters. Spotting it helps: ask 'What is the evidence? What is a more likely outcome? What would I tell a friend?' Counsellors teach these skills in cognitive behavioural therapy.
explain.hg: Catastrophising ek jhatke ko museebaton ki chain bana deta hai. Ise pehchanna help karta hai: poocho 'Evidence kya hai? Zyada likely nateeja kya hai? Dost ko kya bolti?' Counsellors ye skills cognitive behavioural therapy mein sikhaate hain.

q.en: Which breathing pattern is most likely to calm your body when you feel stressed?
q.hg: Stress mein body ko shaant karne ke liye kaunsa breathing pattern sabse zyada kaam karta hai?

options.en: Very fast, short breaths through the mouth
options.hg: Munh se bahut tez, chhoti chhoti saans

options.en: Holding your breath until you feel dizzy
options.hg: Chakkar aane tak saans rokna

options.en: Slow breaths with a longer breath out than in
options.hg: Dheemi saans jisme saans chhodna lene se lamba ho

options.en: Breathing only through the chest as hard as you can
options.hg: Sirf chest se jitna zor se ho sake saans lena

explain.en: Slow breathing, especially with a longer out-breath (for example in for four counts, out for six), signals the nervous system to relax. Fast shallow breathing does the opposite and can make anxiety feel worse.
explain.hg: Dheemi saans, khaaskar jab saans chhodna lamba ho (jaise chaar ginti mein andar, chhe mein bahar), nervous system ko relax ka signal deti hai. Tez aur chhoti saans ulta karti hai aur anxiety badha sakti hai.

q.en: How does regular physical activity affect mood?
q.hg: Regular physical activity mood pe kaisa asar daalti hai?

options.en: It only helps the body and has no effect on the mind
options.hg: Ye sirf body ki help karti hai, mann pe koi asar nahi

options.en: It can lift mood and reduce stress and anxiety
options.hg: Ye mood behtar aur stress aur anxiety kam kar sakti hai

options.en: It makes anxiety worse because the heart beats faster
options.hg: Isse anxiety badhti hai kyunki dil tez dhadakta hai

options.en: It helps only if done for three hours every day
options.hg: Ye tabhi help karti hai jab roz teen ghante karo

explain.en: Walking, dancing, sports or yoga release chemicals that improve mood and help sleep. Even short daily activity helps. It is one tool among many and does not replace professional help when someone needs it.
explain.hg: Walking, dance, sports ya yoga aise chemicals release karte hain jo mood aur neend behtar karte hain. Roz thodi si activity bhi help karti hai. Ye kai tools mein se ek hai aur zaroorat ho toh professional help ki jagah nahi leti.

q.en: Aarav, 16, thinks he might be gay and is anxious and lonely because he hides it. What is true?
q.hg: Aarav, 16, ko lagta hai ki woh gay ho sakta hai aur chhupaane ki wajah se anxious aur akela feel karta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Being gay is not an illness; stress comes from stigma, and support helps
options.hg: Gay hona bimaari nahi; stress stigma se aata hai, aur support help karta hai

options.en: His anxiety proves that being gay is a mental disorder
options.hg: Uski anxiety prove karti hai ki gay hona mental disorder hai

options.en: He should try a 'cure' so the anxiety goes away
options.hg: Use koi 'ilaaj' try karna chahiye taaki anxiety chali jaaye

options.en: He must come out to everyone immediately to feel better
options.hg: Better feel karne ke liye use turant sabko bata dena chahiye

explain.en: Being lesbian, gay, bisexual or trans is not an illness, and 'conversion therapy' is harmful. Hiding and fearing rejection can cause real stress. Aarav can choose when and to whom to come out, and talk to a supportive counsellor or Tele-MANAS 14416.
explain.hg: Lesbian, gay, bisexual ya trans hona bimaari nahi, aur 'conversion therapy' nuksaan karti hai. Chhupaana aur rejection ka darr asli stress de sakta hai. Aarav khud chun sakta hai kab aur kisko batana hai, aur supportive counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 se baat kar sakta hai.

q.en: Which of these could be a warning sign that a friend may be thinking about suicide?
q.hg: Inme se kaunsa sign ho sakta hai ki dost suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai?

options.en: Getting excited about an upcoming cricket match
options.hg: Aane wale cricket match ko lekar excited hona

options.en: Feeling nervous before a job interview
options.hg: Job interview se pehle nervous hona

options.en: Being annoyed about a long queue at the bank
options.hg: Bank ki lambi line se pareshaan hona

options.en: Talking about being a burden and giving away things they value
options.hg: Bojh hone ki baat karna aur apni pyaari cheezein de dena

explain.en: Warning signs include talking about being a burden or wanting to die, withdrawing, saying goodbye, giving away belongings and sudden mood changes. Take them seriously: ask, listen, stay with them and connect them to Tele-MANAS 14416, or 112 in an emergency.
explain.hg: Warning signs mein bojh hone ya marne ki baat, logon se door hona, alvida kehna, cheezein de dena aur achanak mood badalna shaamil hain. Inhe seriously lo: poocho, suno, saath raho aur Tele-MANAS 14416 se jodo, emergency mein 112.

q.en: Which sign suggests stress has turned into burnout?
q.hg: Kaunsa sign batata hai ki stress burnout ban gaya hai?

options.en: Feeling a little nervous on the morning of an exam
options.hg: Exam ki subah thoda nervous hona

options.en: Being tired after a long football match
options.hg: Lambe football match ke baad thakna

options.en: Feeling exhausted, detached and unable to care, even after rest
options.hg: Aaram ke baad bhi thaka hua, alag-thalag aur kisi cheez ki parwah na kar paana

options.en: Wanting a holiday after finishing a project
options.hg: Project khatam hone ke baad chhutti chahna

explain.en: Short-term stress can even help performance. Burnout is long-lasting exhaustion, cynicism and feeling unable to cope that rest alone does not fix. It needs real changes in workload, support and sometimes professional help.
explain.hg: Thode time ka stress performance mein help bhi kar sakta hai. Burnout lambi thakaan, sab se mann uth jaana aur cope na kar paane ki feeling hai jo sirf aaram se theek nahi hoti. Isme kaam ke bojh, support mein asli badlav aur kabhi professional help chahiye.

q.en: Can a doctor look at the hymen and tell whether someone has had sex?
q.hg: Kya doctor hymen dekh ke bata sakta hai ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi?

options.en: Yes, an unbroken hymen always proves virginity
options.hg: Haan, bina toota hymen hamesha virginity prove karta hai

options.en: No, the hymen varies naturally and cannot show that
options.hg: Nahi, hymen naturally alag alag hota hai aur ye nahi bata sakta

options.en: Yes, but only if the check is done after marriage
options.hg: Haan, par sirf shaadi ke baad check kiya jaaye toh

options.en: Only a trained midwife can tell it by touch
options.hg: Sirf trained daai chhoo ke bata sakti hai

explain.en: The hymen is a thin, stretchy tissue whose shape varies from person to person. It may or may not stretch, tear or bleed, and it can never prove whether someone has had sex. 'Virginity' is a social idea, not a medical finding.
explain.hg: Hymen ek patla, stretchy tissue hai jiski shape har insaan mein alag hoti hai. Ye stretch, tear ya bleed ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi, aur kabhi prove nahi kar sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya ya nahi. 'Virginity' ek social idea hai, medical finding nahi.

q.en: After a fall during gymnastics, Kavya, 14, notices a little spotting. A cousin says she has 'lost her virginity'. What is true?
q.hg: Gymnastics mein girne ke baad Kavya, 14, ko thodi spotting dikhti hai. Ek cousin kehti hai ki usne 'virginity kho di'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Virginity is not a physical thing that sport or a fall can take away
options.hg: Virginity koi physical cheez nahi jo sport ya girne se chali jaaye

options.en: Her virginity is gone and she should hide it from her family
options.hg: Uski virginity chali gayi aur use family se chhupaana chahiye

options.en: Girls who do gymnastics or cycling cannot marry later
options.hg: Gymnastics ya cycling karne wali ladkiyan baad mein shaadi nahi kar saktin

options.en: A doctor can now give her a certificate of lost virginity
options.hg: Ab doctor use virginity khone ka certificate de sakta hai

explain.en: Sports, cycling or a fall may stretch the hymen, or not, but that has nothing to do with virginity, which is about a person's experiences, not tissue. Spotting after an injury should be mentioned to a parent or doctor if it continues or hurts.
explain.hg: Sports, cycling ya girne se hymen stretch ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi, par iska virginity se koi lena-dena nahi, jo insaan ke experience ke baare mein hai, tissue ke nahi. Chot ke baad spotting jaari rahe ya dard ho toh parent ya doctor ko batao.

q.en: 'If a bride does not bleed on the first night, she was not a virgin.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Agar dulhan pehli raat bleed nahi karti, toh woh virgin nahi thi.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Every virgin bleeds heavily the first time without exception
options.hg: Har virgin ko pehli baar bina exception heavy bleeding hoti hai

options.en: No bleeding means the hymen was removed by surgery
options.hg: Bleeding nahi hui matlab hymen surgery se hataaya gaya tha

options.en: Bleeding only fails to happen if the bride is unhealthy
options.hg: Bleeding tabhi nahi hoti jab dulhan unhealthy ho

options.en: Many people do not bleed the first time; bleeding proves nothing
options.hg: Bahut logon ko pehli baar bleeding nahi hoti; bleeding kuch prove nahi karti

explain.en: Whether there is bleeding depends on how the hymen is shaped, how relaxed and comfortable a person is, and other factors. Many people do not bleed at all. The 'bedsheet test' has no scientific basis and causes real harm.
explain.hg: Bleeding hogi ya nahi, ye hymen ki shape, insaan kitna relaxed aur comfortable hai, aur doosri cheezon pe depend karta hai. Bahut logon ko bilkul bleeding nahi hoti. 'Bedsheet test' ka koi scientific base nahi aur ye asli nuksaan karta hai.

q.en: A family insists on a 'virginity test' for a bride before the wedding. What is the correct position?
q.hg: Ek family shaadi se pehle dulhan ka 'virginity test' karwane pe zor de rahi hai. Sahi position kya hai?

options.en: They are reliable if done by a qualified gynaecologist
options.hg: Qualified gynaecologist kare toh ye reliable hain

options.en: They are required by Indian law before any marriage
options.hg: Indian law mein har shaadi se pehle ye zaroori hain

options.en: Such tests are unscientific, condemned by WHO and a violation of dignity
options.hg: Aise tests unscientific hain, WHO ne inki ninda ki hai aur ye dignity ka ullanghan hain

options.en: They are harmless and only meant to reassure the groom
options.hg: Ye harmless hain aur sirf groom ko tasalli dene ke liye hain

explain.en: No exam can show whether someone has had sex. WHO has condemned 'virginity testing' as unscientific and a human rights violation, and the Supreme Court of India has prohibited the 'two-finger test'. A person can refuse, and doctors should not perform it.
explain.hg: Koi bhi exam nahi bata sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya ya nahi. WHO ne 'virginity testing' ko unscientific aur human rights violation kaha hai, aur Supreme Court of India ne 'two-finger test' pe rok lagayi hai. Insaan mana kar sakta hai, aur doctors ko ye nahi karna chahiye.

q.en: Mehak, 16, wants to try a menstrual cup. Her aunt says it will 'ruin' her for marriage. What is true?
q.hg: Mehak, 16, menstrual cup try karna chahti hai. Uski aunty kehti hain ki isse woh shaadi ke laayak nahi rahegi. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Cups permanently stretch the body and should be avoided
options.hg: Cups body ko hamesha ke liye stretch kar dete hain, inse bachna chahiye

options.en: Cups are safe for teens and have nothing to do with virginity
options.hg: Cups teens ke liye safe hain aur inka virginity se koi lena-dena nahi

options.en: Only women who have given birth can use cups
options.hg: Sirf jinhone baby ko janam diya hai woh cups use kar sakti hain

options.en: Using a cup counts as losing virginity in medical terms
options.hg: Medical terms mein cup use karna virginity khona maana jaata hai

explain.en: Menstrual cups and tampons can be used from the first period onwards when inserted correctly. The hymen is stretchy and usually has an opening, which is how period blood flows out. Virginity is not a medical state that a cup can change.
explain.hg: Menstrual cups aur tampons sahi tareeke se lagaaye jaayein toh pehle period se use ho sakte hain. Hymen stretchy hota hai aur usme aam taur pe opening hoti hai, jisse period blood bahar aata hai. Virginity koi medical state nahi jo cup badal de.

q.en: A clinic advertises 'virginity restoration' surgery. What is the most accurate view?
q.hg: Ek clinic 'virginity restoration' surgery ka ad karta hai. Sabse sahi soch kya hai?

options.en: It sells a myth; the hymen was never a seal that proves anything
options.hg: Ye ek myth bech raha hai; hymen kabhi koi seal tha hi nahi jo kuch prove kare

options.en: It is a medical necessity for every woman before marriage
options.hg: Ye shaadi se pehle har mahila ke liye medical zaroorat hai

options.en: It restores health that was lost through sex
options.hg: Ye sex se gayi hui health wapas laata hai

options.en: It is recommended by WHO for women who play sports
options.hg: WHO sports khelne wali mahilaon ke liye ise recommend karta hai

explain.en: These ads profit from fear of being judged. Since no hymen can prove virginity, there is nothing medical to 'restore'. The real problem is the pressure on women to prove 'purity', and that is where change is needed.
explain.hg: Ye ads judge hone ke darr se paisa kamaate hain. Jab hymen virginity prove hi nahi kar sakta, toh 'restore' karne ko kuch medical hai hi nahi. Asli problem mahilaon pe 'purity' prove karne ka pressure hai, aur badlav wahin chahiye.

q.en: 'You can tell a girl has had sex by the way she walks or sits.' Is that true?
q.hg: 'Ladki ke chalne ya baithne ke tareeke se pata chal jaata hai ki usne sex kiya hai.' Kya ye sach hai?

options.en: Yes, the hips widen after the first time
options.hg: Haan, pehli baar ke baad hips chaude ho jaate hain

options.en: Yes, but only experienced elders can notice it
options.hg: Haan, par sirf anubhavi bade-bujurg notice kar sakte hain

options.en: Only if she has had sex more than once
options.hg: Sirf agar usne ek se zyada baar sex kiya ho

options.en: No, sex does not change how anyone walks, sits or looks
options.hg: Nahi, sex se kisi ka chalna, baithna ya dikhna nahi badalta

explain.en: Hips widen during puberty because of hormones, not because of sex. There is no visible sign that someone has had sex. Such rumours are used to shame and control girls and have no basis in biology.
explain.hg: Puberty mein hips hormones ki wajah se chaude hote hain, sex ki wajah se nahi. Kisi ke sex karne ka koi dikhne wala sign nahi hota. Aisi afwaahein ladkiyon ko sharminda aur control karne ke liye use hoti hain aur biology mein inka koi base nahi.

q.en: What is the hymen, really?
q.hg: Hymen asal mein kya hai?

options.en: A solid seal that fully closes the vagina until marriage
options.hg: Ek solid seal jo shaadi tak vagina ko poori tarah band rakhta hai

options.en: A membrane that grows back every month with each period
options.hg: Ek jhilli jo har mahine period ke saath wapas ban jaati hai

options.en: A thin, flexible fold of tissue at the vaginal entrance, usually with a gap in it
options.hg: Vagina ke entrance pe patla, flexible tissue ka fold, jisme aam taur pe gap hota hai

options.en: A part of the uterus that breaks during the first period
options.hg: Uterus ka hissa jo pehle period mein toot jaata hai

explain.en: The hymen is a thin fold of tissue around the vaginal opening. It nearly always has an opening, which is how period blood flows out. Its shape and stretchiness vary naturally, and it can change over time from everyday activities.
explain.hg: Hymen vagina ke opening ke aas-paas patla tissue ka fold hai. Isme lagbhag hamesha opening hoti hai, jisse period blood bahar aata hai. Iski shape aur stretchiness naturally alag hoti hai, aur roz ki activities se time ke saath badal sakti hai.

q.en: Is there any medical test that can show whether a man is a virgin?
q.hg: Kya koi medical test hai jo bata sake ki ek mard virgin hai ya nahi?

options.en: Yes, a semen test shows whether he has had sex before
options.hg: Haan, semen test se pata chalta hai ki usne pehle sex kiya hai

options.en: No, and there is no reliable test for anyone of any gender
options.hg: Nahi, aur kisi bhi gender ke liye koi reliable test nahi hai

options.en: Yes, a blood test can measure his 'virginity hormone'
options.hg: Haan, blood test se uska 'virginity hormone' naap sakte hain

options.en: Yes, doctors can tell from the size of his testicles
options.hg: Haan, doctor testicles ke size se bata sakte hain

explain.en: No body part or lab test reveals sexual history, for men or women. The double standard that checks only women's 'purity' has no medical basis. Health checks focus on things that matter, such as STI testing when someone is at risk.
explain.hg: Koi body part ya lab test sexual history nahi batata, mardon ka ho ya mahilaon ka. Sirf mahilaon ki 'purity' check karne wale double standard ka koi medical base nahi. Health checks wahi dekhte hain jo zaroori hai, jaise risk ho toh STI testing.

q.en: Does penis size affect a man's ability to become a father?
q.hg: Kya penis ka size mard ke baap banne ki kshamata pe asar daalta hai?

options.en: No, fertility depends on sperm health, not penis size
options.hg: Nahi, fertility sperm ki health pe depend karti hai, penis size pe nahi

options.en: Yes, a bigger penis produces more and stronger sperm
options.hg: Haan, bada penis zyada aur strong sperm banata hai

options.en: Yes, men with a smaller penis are usually infertile
options.hg: Haan, chhote penis wale mard aksar infertile hote hain

options.en: Only if the penis is smaller than the average in porn
options.hg: Sirf agar penis porn ke average se chhota ho

explain.en: Sperm are made in the testes, and fertility depends on sperm count, movement and shape, plus a partner's health. Penis size, which varies widely, does not decide fertility. Concerns about fertility are checked with a simple semen test.
explain.hg: Sperm testes mein bante hain, aur fertility sperm ki ginti, movement aur shape, aur partner ki health pe depend karti hai. Penis size, jo bahut alag hota hai, fertility tay nahi karta. Fertility ki tension simple semen test se check hoti hai.

q.en: Do penis-enlargement pills, oils or pumps sold online work?
q.hg: Kya online bikne wali penis badhaane wali pills, oils ya pumps kaam karti hain?

options.en: Yes, herbal oils permanently add a few inches in weeks
options.hg: Haan, herbal oils kuch hafton mein hamesha ke liye kuch inch badha dete hain

options.en: Yes, if they are expensive and imported
options.hg: Haan, agar mehenge aur imported hon

options.en: Yes, but only for men under the age of 25
options.hg: Haan, par sirf 25 se kam umar ke mardon ke liye

options.en: No, they do not increase size and some can cause harm
options.hg: Nahi, ye size nahi badhaate aur kuch nuksaan bhi kar sakte hain

explain.en: No pill, oil or cream has been shown to increase penis size. Some products contain hidden drugs, and pumps or devices can injure tissue. Worries about size are very common and a doctor can offer reassurance.
explain.hg: Koi pill, oil ya cream penis size badhaane mein prove nahi hui. Kuch products mein chhupi dawaiyan hoti hain, aur pumps ya devices tissue ko chot pahuncha sakte hain. Size ki tension bahut common hai aur doctor reassure kar sakte hain.

q.en: 'You can guess a man's penis size from his shoe size, hands or nose.' What does the evidence say?
q.hg: 'Mard ke juton, haathon ya naak ke size se uske penis ka size andaaza lag jaata hai.' Evidence kya kehta hai?

options.en: Shoe size predicts it exactly in every man
options.hg: Juton ka size har mard mein bilkul sahi bata deta hai

options.en: Nose size is the most accurate medical measure
options.hg: Naak ka size sabse accurate medical naap hai

options.en: There is no reliable link; it is a joke dressed up as fact
options.hg: Koi reliable link nahi; ye fact ki tarah pesh kiya gaya mazaak hai

options.en: Hand size works only for men above six feet
options.hg: Haath ka size sirf chhe feet se lambe mardon pe kaam karta hai

explain.en: Studies have not found a reliable link between penis size and shoe size, hands, nose or height. Bodies vary in many independent ways. Such jokes mainly add to body worries.
explain.hg: Studies mein penis size aur jute, haath, naak ya height ke beech koi reliable link nahi mila. Bodies kai alag alag tareekon se vary karti hain. Aise mazaak zyadatar body ki tension badhaate hain.

q.en: Why might a young man believe his penis is smaller than it actually is?
q.hg: Ek young mard ko kyun lag sakta hai ki uska penis asal se chhota hai?

options.en: Masturbating often in the teenage years permanently shrinks it and stops its growth
options.hg: Teenage mein zyada masturbation se ye hamesha ke liye chhota ho jaata hai aur growth ruk jaati hai

options.en: Looking down from above makes it seem shorter, and cold or stress shrinks it briefly
options.hg: Upar se neeche dekhne pe chhota lagta hai, aur thand ya stress se thodi der chhota ho jaata hai

options.en: Wearing tight jeans stops it from growing after 18
options.hg: Tight jeans pehenne se 18 ke baad iski growth ruk jaati hai

options.en: Eating spicy food makes it shrink over the years
options.hg: Teekha khana saalon mein ise chhota kar deta hai

explain.en: Viewed from above, any body part looks shorter than it is from the side. Cold, swimming, anxiety and exercise temporarily reduce flaccid size, which is normal. Masturbation and clothing do not change size. Comparing with porn adds to the worry.
explain.hg: Upar se dekhne pe koi bhi body part side se dekhne ke muqable chhota lagta hai. Thand, swimming, anxiety aur exercise se flaccid size thodi der kam hota hai, jo normal hai. Masturbation aur kapde size nahi badalte. Porn se compare karna tension badhata hai.

q.en: Does breast size decide how much milk a mother can make for her baby?
q.hg: Kya breast ka size tay karta hai ki maa baby ke liye kitna doodh bana sakti hai?

options.en: No, milk is made by glands, and size is mostly fat tissue
options.hg: Nahi, doodh glands banate hain, aur size zyadatar fat tissue hota hai

options.en: Yes, small breasts cannot make enough milk
options.hg: Haan, chhote breasts kaafi doodh nahi bana sakte

options.en: Yes, only large breasts can feed twins
options.hg: Haan, sirf bade breasts judwa bachchon ko feed kar sakte hain

options.en: Yes, so women with small breasts must use formula
options.hg: Haan, isliye chhote breasts wali mahilaon ko formula hi dena padta hai

explain.en: Breast size mostly reflects fat, which varies with genes and body weight. Milk-making glands work in breasts of all sizes. Frequent feeding and good support matter far more than size for breastfeeding.
explain.hg: Breast size zyadatar fat hota hai, jo genes aur body weight ke saath badalta hai. Doodh banane wale glands har size ke breasts mein kaam karte hain. Breastfeeding ke liye size se kahin zyada baar baar feed karna aur achha support matter karta hai.

q.en: Can creams, massage oils or special exercises increase breast size?
q.hg: Kya creams, massage oils ya special exercises se breast size badh sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, daily massage with special oil adds a cup size
options.hg: Haan, special oil se roz massage karne se ek cup size badh jaata hai

options.en: Yes, creams with herbs make breasts grow in a month
options.hg: Haan, herbal creams se ek mahine mein breasts badh jaate hain

options.en: Yes, but only if started before the first period
options.hg: Haan, par sirf pehle period se pehle shuru karein toh

options.en: No, breast size is set mainly by genes, hormones and body weight
options.hg: Nahi, breast size mainly genes, hormones aur body weight se tay hota hai

explain.en: Breast tissue grows in puberty under the influence of hormones, and the final size is mostly inherited. Exercise can strengthen chest muscles but does not add breast tissue. Ads for creams and oils sell insecurity.
explain.hg: Breast tissue puberty mein hormones ki wajah se grow hota hai, aur final size zyadatar genes se aata hai. Exercise chest ke muscles strong kar sakti hai par breast tissue nahi badhati. Creams aur oils ke ads insecurity bechte hain.

q.en: 'Having sex often makes the vagina permanently loose.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Baar baar sex karne se vagina hamesha ke liye dheeli ho jaati hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Each act of sex stretches it a little more for good
options.hg: Har baar sex use thoda aur hamesha ke liye stretch kar deta hai

options.en: A 'tight' vagina is clear proof that a woman has never had any sexual partner
options.hg: 'Tight' vagina pakka proof hai ki mahila ka kabhi koi sexual partner nahi raha

options.en: The vagina is elastic and returns to its resting state; sex does not loosen it
options.hg: Vagina elastic hai aur wapas apni normal state mein aa jaati hai; sex se ye dheeli nahi hoti

options.en: Only special creams can restore its shape after marriage
options.hg: Shaadi ke baad sirf special creams hi iski shape wapas la sakti hain

explain.en: The vagina is a muscular, elastic canal that relaxes with arousal and returns to its usual state afterwards. How often someone has sex does not loosen it. Childbirth and ageing can affect pelvic muscles, and pelvic-floor exercises help. The 'tightness' myth is used to shame women.
explain.hg: Vagina ek muscular, elastic canal hai jo arousal mein relax hoti hai aur baad mein apni normal state mein aa jaati hai. Kitni baar sex hota hai, isse ye dheeli nahi hoti. Delivery aur umar pelvic muscles pe asar daal sakte hain, aur pelvic-floor exercises help karti hain. 'Tightness' ka myth mahilaon ko sharminda karne ke liye use hota hai.

q.en: A wall near the bus stand says: 'Gupt rog ka 100% guaranteed ilaaj. Secret desi dawa. Ek baar milein.' What should you think?
q.hg: Bus stand ke paas deewar pe likha hai: 'Gupt rog ka 100% guaranteed ilaaj. Secret desi dawa. Ek baar milein.' Tumhe kya sochna chahiye?

options.en: A 100% guarantee shows they are the best experts in town
options.hg: 100% guarantee dikhati hai ki woh shehar ke best experts hain

options.en: These are red flags; see a qualified doctor or government clinic instead
options.hg: Ye red flags hain; iski jagah qualified doctor ya sarkari clinic jao

options.en: Secret medicines are safer because they are natural
options.hg: Secret dawaiyan safe hoti hain kyunki natural hain

options.en: Wall ads are checked by the health department first
options.hg: Deewar ke ads pehle health department check karta hai

explain.en: Real doctors do not promise 100% cures or sell secret formulas. Quack clinics play on shame and fear about sexual health, charge a lot and can delay real treatment. Qualified doctors and government hospitals treat these concerns confidentially.
explain.hg: Asli doctor 100% ilaaj ka promise nahi karte ya secret formula nahi bechte. Neem-hakeem clinics sexual health ki sharam aur darr ka fayda uthaate hain, bahut paisa lete hain aur asli ilaaj mein der karwaate hain. Qualified doctors aur sarkari hospitals in baaton ka confidential ilaaj karte hain.

q.en: Which of these is the right place to get a possible sexually transmitted infection checked?
q.hg: Possible sexually transmitted infection check karwane ki sahi jagah kaunsi hai?

options.en: A skin-and-VD specialist, gynaecologist, urologist or government STI clinic
options.hg: Skin-and-VD specialist, gynaecologist, urologist ya sarkari STI clinic

options.en: A 'sex specialist' who advertises on walls and trains and promises a quick secret cure
options.hg: Deewaron aur trains mein ad dene wala 'sex specialist' jo jaldi secret ilaaj ka promise karta hai

options.en: A chemist who gives tablets without a prescription
options.hg: Chemist jo bina prescription goliyan de deta hai

options.en: A gym trainer who knows about men's health
options.hg: Gym trainer jise mardon ki health ka pata hai

explain.en: STIs are treated by doctors in dermatology-venereology, gynaecology or urology, and at government STI clinics (often called Suraksha Clinics). Testing is confidential. Self-medicating from a chemist can hide symptoms without curing the infection.
explain.hg: STI ka ilaaj dermatology-venereology, gynaecology ya urology ke doctors, aur sarkari STI clinics (jinhe aksar Suraksha Clinic kehte hain) karte hain. Testing confidential hoti hai. Chemist se khud dawa lene se symptoms chhup sakte hain bina infection theek hue.

q.en: Vikram, 35, has trouble keeping an erection and wants to buy 'shilajit shakti' capsules from a TV ad. What is the better step?
q.hg: Vikram, 35, ko erection banaye rakhne mein problem hai aur woh TV ad se 'shilajit shakti' capsules khareedna chahta hai. Behtar step kya hai?

options.en: Buy the capsules, as TV ads must be medically approved
options.hg: Capsules khareed lo, TV ads medically approved hi hote hain

options.en: Double the dose of any capsule for faster results
options.hg: Koi bhi capsule ka dose double karo taaki jaldi asar ho

options.en: Ignore it, because it is a normal part of being 35
options.hg: Ignore karo, kyunki 35 mein ye normal hai

options.en: See a doctor; erection problems can signal diabetes or heart issues
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhao; erection ki problem diabetes ya heart issue ka signal ho sakti hai

explain.en: Erection difficulties are common and treatable, and can be an early sign of diabetes, high blood pressure or heart disease, so a check-up matters. Doctors can prescribe proven treatment. Unregulated capsules can contain hidden drugs that are risky with heart medicines.
explain.hg: Erection ki problem common hai aur iska ilaaj hai, aur ye diabetes, high BP ya heart disease ka early sign ho sakti hai, isliye check-up zaroori hai. Doctor proven ilaaj de sakte hain. Bina regulation wale capsules mein chhupi dawaiyan ho sakti hain jo heart medicines ke saath risky hain.

q.en: A poster outside a clinic says 'Nightfall (swapandosh) is a disease that drains your strength. Get a 40-day course!' What is true?
q.hg: Clinic ke bahar poster hai 'Nightfall (swapandosh) ek bimaari hai jo taakat khatam karti hai. 40 din ka course lo!' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Nightfall is a serious disease that needs strong medicine
options.hg: Nightfall ek serious bimaari hai jisme strong dawa chahiye

options.en: Each wet dream takes away a fixed amount of strength
options.hg: Har wet dream ek fixed amount taakat le jaata hai

options.en: Wet dreams are a normal part of puberty and need no treatment
options.hg: Wet dreams puberty ka normal hissa hain aur ilaaj ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: Only weak boys get wet dreams, so the course will help
options.hg: Sirf kamzor ladkon ko wet dreams hote hain, isliye course help karega

explain.en: Wet dreams happen when the body releases semen during sleep. They are common from puberty onwards and do not cause weakness. Clinics that call them a disease are selling a cure for something that is not a problem.
explain.hg: Wet dreams tab hote hain jab neend mein body semen release karti hai. Puberty se ye common hain aur kamzori nahi laate. Jo clinics inhe bimaari kehte hain, woh aisi cheez ka ilaaj bech rahe hain jo problem hi nahi hai.

q.en: Sunil, 19, sees whitish urine sometimes and fears he is 'losing dhat' (semen). What is the most accurate response?
q.hg: Sunil, 19, ko kabhi kabhi safed sa urine dikhta hai aur use darr hai ki woh 'dhat' (semen) kho raha hai. Sabse sahi jawab kya hai?

options.en: He is losing vital strength and must stop all physical activity
options.hg: Woh zaroori taakat kho raha hai aur use saari physical activity band karni chahiye

options.en: Whitish urine usually has harmless causes; a simple urine test can check
options.hg: Safed sa urine aksar harmless kaaranon se hota hai; simple urine test check kar sakta hai

options.en: It proves masturbation has damaged his body permanently
options.hg: Ye prove karta hai ki masturbation ne body ko hamesha ke liye damage kar diya

options.en: Only a hakim's secret powder can stop the leakage
options.hg: Sirf hakim ka secret powder hi leakage rok sakta hai

explain.en: Cloudy urine is often due to minerals from food, concentrated urine or, less often, an infection that a doctor can test for. 'Dhat' anxiety, the fear of losing strength through semen, is a recognised worry and is treated by reassurance and talking with a doctor, not by quack powders.
explain.hg: Dhundhla urine aksar khane ke minerals, gaadhe urine ya kabhi kabhi infection ki wajah se hota hai jise doctor test kar sakte hain. 'Dhat' anxiety, yaani semen se taakat jaane ka darr, ek pehchani hui tension hai aur iska ilaaj doctor se baat aur reassurance hai, neem-hakeem ka powder nahi.

q.en: Why can unlabelled 'desi' powders and capsules for 'mardana kamzori' be risky?
q.hg: 'Mardana kamzori' ke liye bina label ke 'desi' powders aur capsules risky kyun ho sakte hain?

options.en: Their ingredients and doses are unknown and may include harmful substances
options.hg: Inke ingredients aur dose pata nahi hote aur inme harmful cheezein ho sakti hain

options.en: Natural products can never cause any side effects
options.hg: Natural products se kabhi koi side effect nahi hota

options.en: They are only risky if taken with milk
options.hg: Ye sirf doodh ke saath lene pe risky hain

options.en: They are tested more strictly than hospital medicines, because they are traditional
options.hg: Ye traditional hain, isliye inki testing hospital ki dawaiyon se zyada sakht hoti hai

explain.en: Products sold without proper labels or licences may contain undeclared drugs, steroids or contaminants, in unknown amounts. 'Natural' does not mean safe. A qualified doctor can find the real cause and prescribe tested treatment.
explain.hg: Bina sahi label ya licence ke bikne wale products mein chhupi dawaiyan, steroids ya milawat ho sakti hai, anjaan maatra mein. 'Natural' ka matlab safe nahi. Qualified doctor asli kaaran dhoondh ke tested ilaaj de sakte hain.

q.en: A 'clinic' tells a young man his condition is dangerous, he must pay in full today, and he should not tell his family or see another doctor. What does this suggest?
q.hg: Ek 'clinic' young mard ko kehta hai ki uski condition khatarnak hai, aaj hi poora paisa do, aur family ko mat batao ya doosre doctor ke paas mat jao. Isse kya pata chalta hai?

options.en: A careful doctor protecting his privacy
options.hg: Ek savdhaan doctor jo uski privacy bacha raha hai

options.en: Standard practice in government hospitals
options.hg: Sarkari hospitals ka standard tareeka

options.en: A sign that the treatment is especially effective
options.hg: Sign ki ilaaj khaas taur pe asardaar hai

options.en: Classic quack tactics: fear, pressure and secrecy
options.hg: Neem-hakeem ki purani chaal: darr, pressure aur secrecy

explain.en: Qualified doctors explain the diagnosis, welcome second opinions and do not demand secrecy or rush payment. Fear and urgency are sales tactics. Confidential care is available at government hospitals and with registered doctors.
explain.hg: Qualified doctor diagnosis samjhaate hain, second opinion ka swagat karte hain aur secrecy ya jaldi payment ki maang nahi karte. Darr aur jaldbaazi bechne ki chaal hai. Confidential ilaaj sarkari hospitals aur registered doctors ke paas milta hai.

q.en: 'Thin or watery semen means a man has lost his sexual power.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Patla ya paani jaisa semen matlab mard ki sexual power chali gayi.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Thick, creamy semen is a sure sign of a stronger, healthier and more manly body
options.hg: Gaadha, malaidaar semen zyada strong, healthy aur mardana body ka pakka sign hai

options.en: Watery semen means he can never become a father
options.hg: Paani jaisa semen matlab woh kabhi baap nahi ban sakta

options.en: Semen's thickness varies normally and says little about health or 'power'
options.hg: Semen ki gaadhapan normally badalta hai aur health ya 'power' ke baare mein kam batata hai

options.en: Semen becomes thin only because of masturbation
options.hg: Semen sirf masturbation ki wajah se patla hota hai

explain.en: Semen thickness changes with how recently someone ejaculated, hydration and other everyday factors. It is not a measure of strength or manhood. If a couple is worried about fertility, a semen analysis by a lab gives real answers.
explain.hg: Semen ka gaadhapan is baat se badalta hai ki pichhli baar kab ejaculation hua, paani kitna piya aur doosri roz ki cheezon se. Ye taakat ya mardangi ka naap nahi. Couple ko fertility ki tension ho toh lab ka semen analysis asli jawab deta hai.

q.en: In the hostel, Rahul, 13, wakes up with wet shorts and is scared he is ill. What is true?
q.hg: Hostel mein Rahul, 13, geele shorts ke saath uthta hai aur darr jaata hai ki woh beemar hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: He has an infection and needs antibiotics
options.hg: Use infection hai aur antibiotics chahiye

options.en: It is a wet dream, a normal and healthy part of puberty
options.hg: Ye wet dream hai, puberty ka normal aur healthy hissa

options.en: It means he will become weak and lose weight
options.hg: Iska matlab woh kamzor hoga aur weight kam hoga

options.en: It happens only to boys who think bad thoughts
options.hg: Ye sirf un ladkon ke saath hota hai jo gande khayal sochte hain

explain.en: During puberty the body starts making semen, and it is sometimes released during sleep. This is a wet dream. It is normal, harmless and not something to feel guilty about. Rinsing the shorts and changing is all that is needed.
explain.hg: Puberty mein body semen banana shuru karti hai, aur kabhi kabhi neend mein release ho jaata hai. Ise wet dream kehte hain. Ye normal hai, harmless hai aur guilty feel karne wali baat nahi. Shorts dhona aur badalna hi kaafi hai.

q.en: Aman, 14, has never had a wet dream though his friends talk about them. What is true?
q.hg: Aman, 14, ko kabhi wet dream nahi hua jabki uske dost iski baatein karte hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Some boys have them often, some rarely or never, and all are normal
options.hg: Kuch ladkon ko aksar hote hain, kuch ko kabhi kabhi ya kabhi nahi, aur sab normal hai

options.en: It means his body is not producing hormones
options.hg: Iska matlab uski body hormones nahi bana rahi

options.en: He will not be able to have children later
options.hg: Woh baad mein bachche nahi kar payega

options.en: He should take medicine to start them
options.hg: Use shuru karne ke liye dawa leni chahiye

explain.en: Wet dreams vary a lot between people. Their absence is not a sign of a problem. Puberty shows up in many ways, such as growth, voice changes and hair. If puberty signs have not started by about 14, a doctor can check.
explain.hg: Wet dreams logon mein bahut alag hote hain. Na hona kisi problem ka sign nahi. Puberty kai tareekon se dikhti hai, jaise height, awaaz ka badalna aur baal. Agar lagbhag 14 tak puberty ke sign shuru na hon toh doctor check kar sakte hain.

q.en: What is semen mostly made of?
q.hg: Semen zyadatar kis cheez se bana hota hai?

options.en: Concentrated blood that has been filtered many times
options.hg: Kai baar filter kiya hua gaadha khoon

options.en: Bone marrow that slowly drains from the spine
options.hg: Bone marrow jo reedh ki haddi se dheere dheere nikalta hai

options.en: Brain fluid, which is why losing it causes weakness
options.hg: Brain ka fluid, isliye isse kamzori aati hai

options.en: Fluid from glands like the prostate, with a small share of sperm
options.hg: Prostate jaise glands ka fluid, aur thoda sa hissa sperm

explain.en: Semen is mostly fluid from the seminal vesicles and prostate, which nourishes and carries sperm. Sperm make up only a small part. It is not made from blood or brain fluid, and releasing it does not drain the body.
explain.hg: Semen zyadatar seminal vesicles aur prostate ka fluid hai, jo sperm ko poshan deta aur le jaata hai. Sperm sirf chhota sa hissa hain. Ye khoon ya brain fluid se nahi bana, aur nikalne se body kamzor nahi hoti.

q.en: 'One drop of semen is made from forty drops of blood.' Is this true?
q.hg: 'Semen ki ek boond khoon ki chaalis boondon se banti hai.' Kya ye sach hai?

options.en: Yes, which is why semen loss causes weakness
options.hg: Haan, isliye semen nikalne se kamzori aati hai

options.en: Yes, but only in men under 25
options.hg: Haan, par sirf 25 se kam umar ke mardon mein

options.en: No, semen is made by glands and is not made from blood
options.hg: Nahi, semen glands banate hain aur ye khoon se nahi banta

options.en: Partly, it takes about ten drops of blood
options.hg: Kuch had tak, lagbhag das boond khoon lagta hai

explain.en: This old saying has no scientific basis. Glands make semen continuously using ordinary nutrients, just as the body makes saliva or tears. Ejaculation does not use up blood or strength.
explain.hg: Is purani kahawat ka koi scientific base nahi. Glands lagataar normal nutrients se semen banate hain, jaise body thook ya aansu banati hai. Ejaculation se khoon ya taakat khatam nahi hoti.

q.en: At a neighbour's house, an aunty tells Anjali, 12, not to touch the pickle jar because she is on her period. What is true?
q.hg: Padosi ke ghar ek aunty Anjali, 12, ko kehti hain ki periods mein achaar ka jar mat chhoona. Kya sach hai?

options.en: A girl on her period makes food rot by touching it
options.hg: Periods wali ladki ke chhoone se khana sadd jaata hai

options.en: Pickle spoils from moisture or dirty spoons, not from periods
options.hg: Achaar nami ya gande chammach se kharab hota hai, periods se nahi

options.en: Period hormones pass through the skin into the pickle
options.hg: Period hormones skin se achaar mein chale jaate hain

options.en: Only pickles spoil; other foods are safe to touch
options.hg: Sirf achaar kharab hota hai; baaki khana chhoona safe hai

explain.en: Pickle goes bad because of moisture, fungus or unclean spoons. A person's period has no effect on food. Washing hands before handling food is good hygiene for everyone, every day.
explain.hg: Achaar nami, fungus ya gande chammach se kharab hota hai. Kisi ke periods ka khane pe koi asar nahi hota. Khana chhoone se pehle haath dhona sabke liye, har din ki achhi hygiene hai.

q.en: Is there any health reason for a girl to stay out of the kitchen during her period?
q.hg: Kya periods mein ladki ke kitchen se door rehne ka koi health reason hai?

options.en: No, periods do not make food or utensils unsafe
options.hg: Nahi, periods se khana ya bartan unsafe nahi hote

options.en: Yes, her touch can make food poisonous
options.hg: Haan, uske chhoone se khana zehreela ho sakta hai

options.en: Yes, cooking during periods causes heavy bleeding
options.hg: Haan, periods mein khana banane se heavy bleeding hoti hai

options.en: Yes, the smell of food worsens period blood
options.hg: Haan, khane ki khushboo se period blood kharab hota hai

explain.en: Periods are a normal body process and do not affect food. Restrictions like staying out of the kitchen come from custom, not health. If someone feels tired or crampy, rest is fine, but by choice, not by rule.
explain.hg: Periods body ka normal process hai aur khane pe asar nahi daalte. Kitchen se door rehne jaisi rokein riwaaz se aati hain, health se nahi. Thakaan ya cramps ho toh aaram theek hai, par apni marzi se, rule se nahi.

q.en: 'Washing your hair during your period increases the bleeding or stops it.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Periods mein baal dhone se bleeding badh jaati hai ya ruk jaati hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Hair washing pushes period blood back into the body
options.hg: Baal dhone se period blood wapas body mein chala jaata hai

options.en: Cold water on the head stops periods for months
options.hg: Sar pe thanda paani periods ko mahino ke liye rok deta hai

options.en: You should not bathe at all until the period ends
options.hg: Period khatam hone tak bilkul nahi nahana chahiye

options.en: Bathing and washing hair are safe and help you feel fresh
options.hg: Nahana aur baal dhona safe hai aur fresh feel karaata hai

explain.en: Bathing does not change how much you bleed. A warm bath can even ease cramps. Keeping clean during periods helps prevent rashes and infections, so bathing and washing hair are encouraged.
explain.hg: Nahane se bleeding ki maatra nahi badalti. Garam paani se nahana cramps bhi kam kar sakta hai. Periods mein saaf rehna rash aur infection se bachata hai, isliye nahana aur baal dhona achha hai.

q.en: Grandma says that eating curd, ice cream or sour food during a period will make cramps worse. What does the evidence say?
q.hg: Daadi kehti hain ki periods mein dahi, ice cream ya khatta khane se cramps badhte hain. Evidence kya kehta hai?

options.en: Curd during periods causes infertility later
options.hg: Periods mein dahi khane se baad mein infertility hoti hai

options.en: Sour food stops the period from coming out
options.hg: Khatta khana period ko bahar aane se rok deta hai

options.en: There is no evidence these foods harm; a balanced diet is fine
options.hg: Is baat ka koi evidence nahi ki ye khane nuksaan karte hain; balanced diet theek hai

options.en: Cold foods freeze the blood inside the uterus
options.hg: Thanda khana uterus ke andar khoon jama deta hai

explain.en: No food 'freezes' or blocks period blood. Eating well, drinking water and staying active help with energy and cramps. If a particular food makes you feel unwell, you can skip it, but there is no rule against curd or sour food.
explain.hg: Koi bhi khana period blood ko 'jama' ya block nahi karta. Achha khana, paani aur active rehna energy aur cramps mein help karta hai. Koi khaas cheez se bura lage toh skip kar sakte ho, par dahi ya khatte ke khilaaf koi rule nahi.

q.en: 'If a girl on her period waters a plant, it will dry up.' Is this true?
q.hg: 'Periods wali ladki agar paudhe ko paani de, toh woh sookh jaayega.' Kya ye sach hai?

options.en: Yes, period hormones in sweat kill plants
options.hg: Haan, pasine ke period hormones paudhe maar dete hain

options.en: No, periods have no effect on plants
options.hg: Nahi, periods ka paudhon pe koi asar nahi

options.en: Yes, but only sacred plants like tulsi
options.hg: Haan, par sirf tulsi jaise pavitra paudhe

options.en: Yes, unless she washes her hands with salt
options.hg: Haan, jab tak woh namak se haath na dhoye

explain.en: Plants dry up from too little or too much water, heat or pests. A person's period cannot harm a plant. Myths like this make girls feel ashamed of a normal body process.
explain.hg: Paudhe kam ya zyada paani, garmi ya keedon se sookhte hain. Kisi ke periods paudhe ko nuksaan nahi pahuncha sakte. Aise myths ladkiyon ko ek normal body process ke liye sharminda karte hain.

q.en: Simran, 13, has her period on sports day. Her friend says running will harm her. What is true?
q.hg: Simran, 13, ko sports day pe periods hain. Uski dost kehti hai ki daudne se nuksaan hoga. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Exercise is safe during periods and may even ease cramps
options.hg: Periods mein exercise safe hai aur cramps bhi kam kar sakti hai

options.en: Running during a period damages the uterus
options.hg: Periods mein daudne se uterus damage hota hai

options.en: Sports during periods cause problems in having babies later
options.hg: Periods mein sports se baad mein bachche hone mein problem hoti hai

options.en: Girls must sit out every PE class during their period
options.hg: Periods mein ladkiyon ko har PE class mein baithna hi chahiye

explain.en: Moving the body increases blood flow and releases natural painkillers, which can ease cramps. Athletes compete during periods all the time. Rest if you feel unwell, but there is no medical reason to stop sport.
explain.hg: Body ko move karne se blood flow badhta hai aur natural painkillers release hote hain, jo cramps kam karte hain. Athletes periods mein bhi compete karte hain. Tabiyat theek na ho toh aaram karo, par sport rokne ka koi medical reason nahi.

q.en: Where does period blood come from?
q.hg: Period blood kahan se aata hai?

options.en: Dirty, impure blood that the body throws out every month to clean itself
options.hg: Ganda, apavitra khoon jo body har mahine khud ko saaf karne ke liye bahar nikalti hai

options.en: The stomach, after it digests heavy food
options.hg: Pet se, bhaari khana pachane ke baad

options.en: A wound that opens every month and then heals
options.hg: Ek zakhm se jo har mahine khulta aur bhar jaata hai

options.en: The lining of the uterus, which is shed each month if there is no pregnancy
options.hg: Uterus ki lining se, jo pregnancy na ho toh har mahine nikalti hai

explain.en: Each month the uterus builds a soft lining in case of pregnancy. If no pregnancy happens, the lining comes out as a period. It is ordinary blood and tissue, not 'dirty' or 'impure' blood.
explain.hg: Har mahine uterus pregnancy ke liye ek naram lining banata hai. Pregnancy na ho toh woh lining period ke roop mein bahar aati hai. Ye normal khoon aur tissue hai, 'ganda' ya 'apavitra' khoon nahi.

q.en: 'Boys should not learn about periods.' What is the better view?
q.hg: 'Ladkon ko periods ke baare mein nahi seekhna chahiye.' Behtar soch kya hai?

options.en: Periods are a secret only girls are allowed to know
options.hg: Periods ek secret hai jo sirf ladkiyon ko pata hona chahiye

options.en: Boys will get embarrassed and should be sent out of class
options.hg: Ladke sharmaenge, isliye unhe class se bahar bhej dena chahiye

options.en: Boys should learn too, so they can understand and support others
options.hg: Ladkon ko bhi seekhna chahiye, taaki woh samjhein aur support karein

options.en: Boys learning about periods will make them disrespectful
options.hg: Periods ke baare mein seekhne se ladke badtameez ho jaayenge

explain.en: When boys understand periods, teasing drops and they can support sisters, classmates, partners and, one day, daughters. Silence is what feeds myths and shame.
explain.hg: Jab ladke periods samajhte hain, chhedna kam hota hai aur woh behnon, classmates, partners aur aage chal ke betiyon ko support kar paate hain. Chuppi hi myths aur sharam ko badhati hai.

q.en: Tara, 15, faints from period pain every month. Her mother says, 'I had the same; it is normal, bear it.' What is true?
q.hg: Tara, 15, har mahine period ke dard se behosh ho jaati hai. Uski maa kehti hain, 'Mujhe bhi hota tha; normal hai, seh lo.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Severe period pain is normal for girls and will stop on its own after marriage
options.hg: Periods ka tez dard ladkiyon ke liye normal hai aur shaadi ke baad apne aap ruk jaayega

options.en: Pain that stops daily life needs a doctor; it may have a treatable cause
options.hg: Jo dard roz ki zindagi rok de uske liye doctor chahiye; uska treatable kaaran ho sakta hai

options.en: Fainting means her body is cleaning itself well
options.hg: Behosh hona matlab body achhe se saaf ho rahi hai

options.en: Painkillers during periods cause infertility
options.hg: Periods mein painkillers lene se infertility hoti hai

explain.en: Some cramping is common, but pain that causes fainting, vomiting or missed school is not something to just endure. Conditions like endometriosis can run in families and can be treated. A doctor can help even if mum 'had the same'.
explain.hg: Thode cramps common hain, par jo dard behoshi, ulti ya school chhootne tak le jaaye, use bas sehna nahi chahiye. Endometriosis jaisi conditions family mein chal sakti hain aur inka ilaaj hai. Maa ko 'bhi hota tha', fir bhi doctor help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Pihu, 12, got her first period four months ago and has not had another since. Her cousin says she will never be able to have babies. What is true?
q.hg: Pihu, 12, ko chaar mahine pehle pehla period aaya aur tab se dobara nahi aaya. Uski cousin kehti hai ki woh kabhi maa nahi ban paayegi. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Irregular periods are common in the first years and usually settle
options.hg: Pehle kuch saalon mein irregular periods common hain aur aksar settle ho jaate hain

options.en: It proves her uterus is not working properly
options.hg: Ye prove karta hai ki uska uterus sahi kaam nahi kar raha

options.en: Irregular periods at 12 always mean infertility later
options.hg: 12 mein irregular periods matlab baad mein pakki infertility

options.en: She needs hormone tablets immediately to fix it
options.hg: Use theek karne ke liye turant hormone tablets chahiye

explain.en: In the first couple of years after the first period, cycles are often irregular as hormones settle. This does not predict future fertility. Tell a parent or doctor if periods stop for three months or more after being regular, or if there are other worries.
explain.hg: Pehle period ke baad shuru ke ek-do saal cycles aksar irregular hote hain jab tak hormones settle hote hain. Isse future fertility ka pata nahi chalta. Regular hone ke baad teen mahine ya zyada periods ruk jaayein, ya koi aur tension ho, toh parent ya doctor ko batao.

q.en: From a health and science point of view, is a person on their period 'impure'?
q.hg: Health aur science ke hisaab se, kya periods wala insaan 'apavitra' hota hai?

options.en: Yes, the body releases toxins during a period
options.hg: Haan, period mein body zeher bahar nikalti hai

options.en: Yes, which is why doctors advise staying apart
options.hg: Haan, isliye doctor alag rehne ki salaah dete hain

options.en: Only on the first two days of the period
options.hg: Sirf period ke pehle do din

options.en: No, a period is a normal body process and makes no one unclean
options.hg: Nahi, period body ka normal process hai aur kisi ko ganda nahi banata

explain.en: Science sees no impurity in periods: menstrual blood is ordinary blood and uterine lining. Religious and social customs are a matter of belief, but they have no medical basis, and many families today choose not to follow restrictions.
explain.hg: Science periods mein koi apavitrata nahi dekhti: menstrual blood normal khoon aur uterus ki lining hai. Dharmik aur samajik riwaaz aastha ki baat hain, par unka koi medical base nahi, aur aaj bahut families rokein na maanna chunti hain.

q.en: In some homes, a girl on her period must sleep on a separate mat in a corner and eat alone. What is true?
q.hg: Kuch gharon mein periods wali ladki ko kone mein alag chatai pe sona aur akele khana padta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It protects the rest of the family from infection
options.hg: Isse baaki family infection se bachti hai

options.en: It helps the period finish faster
options.hg: Isse period jaldi khatam hota hai

options.en: There is no health reason, and isolation can make girls feel ashamed
options.hg: Iska koi health reason nahi, aur alag karna ladkiyon ko sharminda feel karaata hai

options.en: Doctors recommend it to prevent period pain
options.hg: Doctor period ke dard se bachne ke liye ise recommend karte hain

explain.en: Periods are not contagious and do not make anyone unclean. Isolating girls sends a message that their bodies are shameful and can affect their schooling and confidence. Comfort, rest if needed and normal family life are what help.
explain.hg: Periods chhoot ki bimaari nahi aur kisi ko ganda nahi banate. Ladkiyon ko alag karna ye message deta hai ki unki body sharam ki cheez hai, aur padhai aur confidence pe asar daalta hai. Aaram, zaroorat ho toh rest aur normal family life hi help karti hai.

q.en: 'PMS is just an excuse for drama.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'PMS bas drama ka bahana hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: PMS was invented to excuse bad behaviour
options.hg: PMS kharab behaviour ka bahana banane ke liye banaya gaya

options.en: PMS is real, linked to hormone changes, and a severe form needs treatment
options.hg: PMS real hai, hormone badlav se juda hai, aur iske severe form ka ilaaj chahiye

options.en: PMS only happens to women who are emotionally weak and cannot control their moods
options.hg: PMS sirf emotionally kamzor mahilaon ko hota hai jo apna mood control nahi kar paatin

options.en: PMS proves women cannot handle responsible jobs
options.hg: PMS prove karta hai ki mahilaayein zimmedaar kaam nahi sambhal saktin

explain.en: Premenstrual syndrome brings real symptoms such as bloating, tiredness, irritability and low mood in the days before a period. A severe form called PMDD can seriously affect life and is treatable. Mocking it makes people hide symptoms.
explain.hg: Premenstrual syndrome mein period se pehle ke dinon mein asli symptoms hote hain jaise bloating, thakaan, chidchidapan aur low mood. Iska severe form PMDD zindagi pe gehra asar daal sakta hai aur iska ilaaj hai. Mazaak udaane se log symptoms chhupaate hain.

q.en: Rekha uses cloth pads and dries them hidden under other clothes in a dark corner so no one sees. What is the safer way?
q.hg: Rekha cloth pads use karti hai aur unhe chhupa ke doosre kapdon ke neeche andhere kone mein sukhati hai taaki koi na dekhe. Safe tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Wash with soap and dry fully in sunlight before reuse
options.hg: Sabun se dho ke dhoop mein poori tarah sukhao, phir use karo

options.en: Dry them in the dark, since sunlight weakens cloth
options.hg: Andhere mein sukhao, dhoop se kapda kamzor hota hai

options.en: Use them while slightly damp to save time
options.hg: Time bachaane ke liye thode geele hi use kar lo

options.en: Rinse in plain water only, as soap causes infection
options.hg: Sirf saade paani se dho lo, sabun se infection hota hai

explain.en: Cloth pads are a safe choice when washed with soap and dried completely, ideally in the sun, which helps kill germs. Damp or hidden cloth can grow germs and cause infections. Shame about periods should not force unsafe drying.
explain.hg: Cloth pads safe choice hain jab sabun se dhoye jaayein aur poori tarah sukhaaye jaayein, behtar hai dhoop mein, jo germs maarti hai. Geela ya chhupa ke sukhaya kapda germs paal sakta hai aur infection kar sakta hai. Periods ki sharam ki wajah se unsafe tareeke se nahi sukhaana chahiye.

q.en: 'Boys cannot be sexually abused.' Is this true?
q.hg: 'Ladkon ke saath sexual abuse nahi ho sakta.' Kya ye sach hai?

options.en: Yes, boys are strong enough to always stop it
options.hg: Haan, ladke itne strong hote hain ki hamesha rok lete hain

options.en: Yes, so only girls need to learn about body safety and safe touch
options.hg: Haan, isliye sirf ladkiyon ko body safety aur safe touch seekhna chahiye

options.en: Only if the boy is younger than five
options.hg: Sirf agar ladka paanch saal se chhota ho

options.en: No, boys can be abused too, and they deserve help just as much
options.hg: Nahi, ladkon ke saath bhi abuse ho sakta hai, aur unhe bhi utni hi help ka haq hai

explain.en: Sexual abuse can happen to any child, of any gender. Boys often stay silent because of this myth and fear of not being believed. Indian law (POCSO) protects every child under 18, and Childline 1098 helps boys and girls.
explain.hg: Sexual abuse kisi bhi bachche ke saath ho sakta hai, kisi bhi gender ka. Is myth aur yakeen na kiye jaane ke darr se ladke aksar chup rehte hain. Indian law (POCSO) 18 se kam har bachche ko protect karta hai, aur Childline 1098 ladkon aur ladkiyon dono ki help karti hai.

q.en: In India's 2007 national Study on Child Abuse, who made up more of the children who reported sexual abuse?
q.hg: India ki 2007 ki national Study on Child Abuse mein, sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein kaun zyada the?

options.en: Girls, by a very wide margin
options.hg: Ladkiyan, bahut bade farak se

options.en: Only girls; no boys reported abuse
options.hg: Sirf ladkiyan; kisi ladke ne report nahi kiya

options.en: Boys, slightly more than girls
options.hg: Ladke, ladkiyon se thode zyada

options.en: The study did not include boys at all
options.hg: Study mein ladke shaamil hi nahi the

explain.en: In that 2007 study, boys made up 52.94% of the children who reported sexual abuse and girls 47.06%. It describes the children surveyed, not a national rate, but it clearly shows boys are abused too and need to be heard.
explain.hg: Us 2007 ki study mein, sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein 52.94% ladke the aur 47.06% ladkiyan. Ye survey kiye gaye bachchon ke baare mein hai, national rate nahi, par saaf dikhata hai ki ladkon ke saath bhi abuse hota hai aur unki baat sunni chahiye.

q.en: Who is most likely to sexually abuse a child?
q.hg: Bachche ka sexual abuse karne wala sabse zyada kaun hota hai?

options.en: A stranger hiding in a dark lane
options.hg: Andheri gali mein chhupa koi anjaan

options.en: Someone the child already knows and trusts
options.hg: Koi jise bachcha pehle se jaanta aur trust karta hai

options.en: Only people from other cities or countries
options.hg: Sirf doosre shehar ya desh ke log

options.en: Someone who looks scary and dirty
options.hg: Koi jo darawna aur ganda dikhe

explain.en: Most child sexual abuse is by someone known to the child: a relative, neighbour, family friend, tutor or older child. Teaching children that any unsafe touch must be told, even about family, protects them better than 'stranger danger' alone.
explain.hg: Zyadatar child sexual abuse koi jaana-pehchana karta hai: rishtedaar, padosi, family friend, tutor ya bada bachcha. Bachchon ko sikhana ki koi bhi unsafe touch batana hai, chahe family ka ho, sirf 'stranger danger' se zyada protect karta hai.

q.en: 'You can spot an abuser; they look creepy.' What is the truth?
q.hg: 'Abuser ko pehchana ja sakta hai; woh creepy dikhte hain.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: Abusers often seem kind and trusted, which helps them hide
options.hg: Abuser aksar achhe aur trusted lagte hain, jisse woh chhup paate hain

options.en: Abusers always behave strangely in front of others
options.hg: Abuser hamesha dusron ke saamne ajeeb behave karte hain

options.en: Respected people like teachers never abuse children
options.hg: Teacher jaise izzatdaar log kabhi bachchon ka abuse nahi karte

options.en: Abusers can be identified by their clothes
options.hg: Abusers ko unke kapdon se pehchana ja sakta hai

explain.en: People who abuse often build trust with the child and family first, through gifts, attention or special favours, which is called grooming. Watch behaviour, like insisting on time alone or asking for secrets, rather than looks.
explain.hg: Abuse karne wale aksar pehle bachche aur family ka trust jeette hain, gifts, attention ya khaas favours se, ise grooming kehte hain. Shakal ki jagah behaviour dekho, jaise akele time pe zor dena ya secret rakhne ko kehna.

q.en: 'Sexual abuse only happens in poor or uneducated families.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Sexual abuse sirf gareeb ya anpadh families mein hota hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Rich families are fully protected because of their wealth, security and big homes
options.hg: Ameer families apne paise, security aur bade gharon ki wajah se poori tarah protected hain

options.en: Educated parents' children are never targeted
options.hg: Padhe-likhe parents ke bachche kabhi target nahi hote

options.en: It only happens in villages, never in cities
options.hg: Ye sirf gaon mein hota hai, shehar mein kabhi nahi

options.en: It happens in families of every income, caste, religion and education
options.hg: Ye har income, jaati, dharm aur education wali families mein hota hai
