explain.en: Abuse crosses every social boundary. Wealthier families may hide it more because of 'reputation', so it is reported less, not that it happens less. Every child needs body-safety education and adults who listen.
explain.hg: Abuse har samajik deewar paar karta hai. Ameer families 'izzat' ke liye ise zyada chhupa sakti hain, toh report kam hota hai, ye nahi ki kam hota hai. Har bachche ko body-safety ki shiksha aur sunne wale adults chahiye.

q.en: 'She wore short clothes, so she was asking for it.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Usne chhote kapde pehne the, toh usne khud bulaaya.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Short or revealing clothes send a clear signal that a woman is agreeing to sex
options.hg: Chhote ya revealing kapde saaf signal dete hain ki mahila sex ke liye raazi hai

options.en: Modest clothes always prevent harassment
options.hg: Dhake kapde hamesha harassment rok lete hain

options.en: Clothes never cause assault; only the person who does it is responsible
options.hg: Kapde kabhi assault ka kaaran nahi; zimmedaar sirf karne wala hai

options.en: It is partly her fault and partly his
options.hg: Thodi uski galti hai aur thodi uski

explain.en: People in saris, burqas, school uniforms and jeans are all harassed and assaulted. Clothing is not consent. Blaming clothes shifts responsibility away from the person who chose to harm, and stops survivors from speaking up.
explain.hg: Saree, burqa, school uniform aur jeans, sab pehne logon ke saath harassment aur assault hota hai. Kapde consent nahi hain. Kapdon ko blame karna zimmedari nuksaan karne wale se hata deta hai, aur survivors ko bolne se rokta hai.

q.en: 'If she was drunk at the party, it is her own fault.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Agar woh party mein nashe mein thi, toh uski apni galti hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Drinking alcohol means agreeing to whatever happens
options.hg: Sharaab peena matlab jo bhi ho uske liye raazi hona

options.en: Someone too drunk to decide cannot consent; the person who assaults is to blame
options.hg: Jo nashe mein decide hi na kar sake woh consent nahi de sakta; galti assault karne wale ki hai

options.en: She should not report it, since she had been drinking and will not be believed anyway
options.hg: Use report nahi karna chahiye, kyunki usne pee rakhi thi aur waise bhi koi yakeen nahi karega

options.en: Assault only counts if both people were sober
options.hg: Assault tabhi maana jaata hai jab dono hosh mein hon

explain.en: Consent must be clear and freely given by someone able to decide. A person who is very drunk cannot give it. Drinking is never an invitation, and survivors who had been drinking still deserve to be believed and helped.
explain.hg: Consent saaf aur apni marzi se, aise insaan ki taraf se hona chahiye jo decide kar sake. Bahut nashe mein insaan consent nahi de sakta. Peena kabhi invitation nahi, aur jo survivor nashe mein the, unki baat bhi maani jaani chahiye aur help milni chahiye.

q.en: Why do many people 'freeze' and do not fight back or scream during an assault?
q.hg: Assault ke waqt bahut log 'freeze' kyun ho jaate hain aur lad ya chilla nahi paate?

options.en: Freezing is an automatic survival response, not a sign of consent
options.hg: Freeze hona ek automatic survival response hai, consent ka sign nahi

options.en: They secretly wanted it to happen
options.hg: Woh chupke se chahte the ki ye ho

options.en: They were not really scared
options.hg: Woh asal mein dare hue nahi the

options.en: Only weak people freeze; strong people always fight
options.hg: Sirf kamzor log freeze hote hain; strong log hamesha ladte hain

explain.en: Under extreme threat the brain may choose fight, flight or freeze, without a conscious decision. Many survivors freeze. Not resisting does not mean agreeing, and survivors should never be blamed for how their body reacted.
explain.hg: Bahut bade khatre mein brain bina soche ladna, bhaagna ya freeze chun sakta hai. Bahut survivors freeze ho jaate hain. Virodh na karna raazi hona nahi, aur survivors ko unki body ke reaction ke liye kabhi blame nahi karna chahiye.

q.en: 'If she waited months to report, she must be lying.' What does the Supreme Court's 2023 Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes say?
q.hg: 'Agar usne report karne mein mahine lagaaye, toh woh jhooth bol rahi hai.' Supreme Court ki 2023 Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes kya kehti hai?

options.en: Any delay of more than a week is clear proof that the complaint is a false case
options.hg: Ek hafte se zyada ki der saaf proof hai ki complaint jhootha case hai

options.en: Late complaints cannot be registered by police
options.hg: Der se ki gayi complaint police register nahi kar sakti

options.en: Courts must reject cases reported after one month
options.hg: Ek mahine baad report hue cases court ko reject karne hi hain

options.en: It rejects this as a stereotype; delay can come from fear, shame or trauma
options.hg: Ye ise stereotype maanti hai; der darr, sharam ya trauma ki wajah se ho sakti hai

explain.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook lists the idea that a woman who delays reporting is lying as a stereotype. Survivors often wait because of fear, shame, dependence on the abuser or trauma. Delay alone does not make a complaint false.
explain.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook is soch ko stereotype maanti hai ki der se report karne wali mahila jhooth bol rahi hai. Survivors aksar darr, sharam, abuser pe nirbharta ya trauma ki wajah se rukte hain. Sirf der se complaint jhoothi nahi ho jaati.

q.en: 'A real survivor would be crying all the time.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Asli survivor hamesha rota rehta.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Survivors who laugh or seem calm are faking it
options.hg: Jo survivors hanste ya shaant lagte hain woh natak kar rahe hain

options.en: Crying is legal proof that an assault happened
options.hg: Rona legal proof hai ki assault hua

options.en: There is no 'correct' way to react; calm survivors are not lying
options.hg: React karne ka koi 'sahi' tareeka nahi; shaant survivors jhooth nahi bol rahe

options.en: Courts only believe survivors who cry in front of the judge
options.hg: Court sirf unhi survivors ko maanta hai jo judge ke saamne roein

explain.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook calls the expectation that a 'real' survivor cries constantly a stereotype. People respond to trauma very differently: some cry, some seem numb, calm or even make jokes. Judging their behaviour causes more harm.
explain.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook is umeed ko stereotype kehti hai ki 'asli' survivor lagataar roti hai. Log trauma pe bahut alag react karte hain: kuch rote hain, kuch sunn, shaant lagte hain ya mazaak bhi karte hain. Unke behaviour ko judge karna aur nuksaan karta hai.

q.en: Some elders suggest that a rape survivor should marry the accused 'to save her honour'. What is the fact?
q.hg: Kuch bade suggest karte hain ki rape survivor accused se shaadi kar le 'izzat bachaane ke liye'. Fact kya hai?

options.en: Marriage cancels the crime and restores her honour
options.hg: Shaadi crime ko khatam karke izzat wapas laati hai

options.en: The Supreme Court says marriage is not a remedy for the violence of rape
options.hg: Supreme Court kehta hai ki shaadi rape ki hinsa ka ilaaj nahi hai

options.en: It is the law that the accused must marry the survivor
options.hg: Law hai ki accused ko survivor se shaadi karni hi hogi

options.en: Marriage is the best way to help the survivor heal
options.hg: Survivor ke theek hone ka sabse achha tareeka shaadi hai

explain.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook states that 'Marriage is not a remedy to the violence of rape.' The survivor's honour was never lost. What helps is safety, belief, medical care, legal support and counselling.
explain.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook kehti hai, 'Marriage is not a remedy to the violence of rape.' Survivor ki izzat kabhi gayi hi nahi thi. Help karti hai safety, yakeen, medical care, legal support aur counselling.

q.en: Boys outside the college whistle and pass comments at girls every day and call it 'just eve-teasing'. What is it really?
q.hg: College ke bahar ladke roz ladkiyon pe seeti bajaate aur comments karte hain aur ise 'bas eve-teasing' kehte hain. Ye asal mein kya hai?

options.en: Sexual harassment, which is an offence and causes real harm
options.hg: Sexual harassment, jo offence hai aur asli nuksaan karta hai

options.en: Harmless fun that girls should take as a compliment
options.hg: Harmless mazaak jise ladkiyon ko compliment samajhna chahiye

options.en: A normal way for boys to show they like someone
options.hg: Ladkon ka kisi ko pasand karne ka normal tareeka

options.en: Only a problem if someone is physically touched
options.hg: Problem tabhi hai jab kisi ko physically chhua jaaye

explain.en: 'Eve-teasing' is a soft word for street sexual harassment, including comments, gestures and following. It makes people change routes, miss classes or drop out. It is an offence under Indian law, and bystanders can help by not joining in and supporting the person targeted.
explain.hg: 'Eve-teasing' street sexual harassment ka naram naam hai, jisme comments, ishaare aur peecha karna shaamil hai. Isse log raasta badalte hain, classes chhodte hain ya padhai chhod dete hain. Indian law mein ye offence hai, aur aas-paas ke log join na karke aur target insaan ka saath dekar help kar sakte hain.

q.en: 'A boy who was sexually abused will grow up to be gay or to abuse others.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Jis ladke ke saath sexual abuse hua woh bada hoke gay banega ya dusron ka abuse karega.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Every abused boy becomes an abuser later
options.hg: Har abused ladka baad mein abuser banta hai

options.en: Abuse changes a boy's orientation permanently
options.hg: Abuse ladke ka orientation hamesha ke liye badal deta hai

options.en: Abused boys should be kept away from other children because they will harm them
options.hg: Abused ladkon ko baaki bachchon se door rakhna chahiye kyunki woh unhe nuksaan pahunchayenge

options.en: Abuse does not decide sexual orientation, and most survivors never abuse anyone
options.hg: Abuse sexual orientation tay nahi karta, aur zyadatar survivors kabhi kisi ka abuse nahi karte

explain.en: These myths add stigma and keep boys silent. Sexual orientation is not caused by abuse, and the great majority of survivors never harm others. What boys need is to be believed, supported and offered counselling.
explain.hg: Ye myths stigma badhaate hain aur ladkon ko chup rakhte hain. Sexual orientation abuse se nahi banta, aur zyadatar survivors kabhi kisi ko nuksaan nahi pahunchate. Ladkon ko chahiye yakeen, support aur counselling.

q.en: 'Women cannot sexually abuse anyone.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Mahilaayein kisi ka sexual abuse nahi kar saktin.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is physically impossible for a woman to abuse anyone
options.hg: Mahila ke liye kisi ka abuse karna physically impossible hai

options.en: Abuse by a woman is always harmless for a boy
options.hg: Mahila ka kiya abuse ladke ke liye hamesha harmless hai

options.en: Though less common, women can sexually abuse children or adults
options.hg: Kam common hai, par mahilaayein bhi bachchon ya adults ka sexual abuse kar sakti hain

options.en: A boy abused by a woman should feel lucky
options.hg: Mahila se abuse hua ladka khud ko lucky samjhe

explain.en: Most reported abusers are men, but women can also abuse, and survivors of abuse by women, especially boys, are often not believed or are told they were 'lucky'. Under POCSO, any person can be an offender against a child.
explain.hg: Zyadatar reported abusers mard hote hain, par mahilaayein bhi abuse kar sakti hain, aur mahilaon se abuse hue survivors, khaaskar ladkon, ki baat aksar nahi maani jaati ya kaha jaata hai ki 'lucky' the. POCSO mein koi bhi insaan bachche ke khilaaf offender ho sakta hai.

q.en: A parent says, 'Something happened to her, but she is too young; she will forget.' What is true?
q.hg: Ek parent kehte hain, 'Uske saath kuch hua, par woh bahut chhoti hai; bhool jaayegi.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Children under ten cannot remember anything that happens to them later
options.hg: Das saal se chhote bachchon ko baad mein kuch bhi yaad nahi rehta

options.en: Young children are affected too and need calm support and help
options.hg: Chhote bachchon pe bhi asar padta hai aur unhe shaant support aur help chahiye

options.en: Talking about it will only make the child worse
options.hg: Iske baare mein baat karne se bachcha aur bigad jaayega

options.en: It is best to act as if nothing happened
options.hg: Sabse achha hai aise behave karo jaise kuch hua hi nahi

explain.en: Abuse can affect a child's feelings, sleep and behaviour even if they cannot explain it. Believing the child, keeping them safe, getting medical care and counselling, and reporting (call 1098 or 112) all help. Silence protects the abuser, not the child.
explain.hg: Abuse bachche ki feelings, neend aur behaviour pe asar daal sakta hai, chahe woh samjha na paaye. Bachche pe yakeen, unki safety, medical care aur counselling, aur report karna (1098 ya 112 call karo) sab help karte hain. Chuppi abuser ko bachati hai, bachche ko nahi.

q.en: An uncle tells a child, 'Don't tell anyone, it's a family matter and our izzat is at stake.' What should the child know?
q.hg: Ek uncle bachche ko kehte hain, 'Kisi ko mat batana, ghar ki baat hai aur hamari izzat ka sawaal hai.' Bachche ko kya pata hona chahiye?

options.en: Unsafe secrets must be told to a trusted adult or Childline 1098
options.hg: Unsafe secrets kisi trusted adult ya Childline 1098 ko batane hi chahiye

options.en: Family honour matters more than the child's safety
options.hg: Family ki izzat bachche ki safety se zyada zaroori hai

options.en: Children should obey every adult in the family
options.hg: Bachchon ko family ke har adult ki baat maanni chahiye

options.en: Telling will get the child punished by police
options.hg: Batane se police bachche ko saza degi

explain.en: Abusers often use secrecy, shame and 'izzat' to keep children quiet. No secret about touching or anything that feels wrong should be kept. Telling is never wrong, and Childline 1098 is free and works day and night.
explain.hg: Abuser aksar secrecy, sharam aur 'izzat' se bachchon ko chup karate hain. Chhoone ya galat lagne wali kisi bhi cheez ka secret nahi rakhna chahiye. Batana kabhi galat nahi, aur Childline 1098 free hai aur din-raat kaam karti hai.

q.en: Arjun, 20, tells a friend he was sexually assaulted. The friend laughs: 'Men can't be assaulted.' What is true?
q.hg: Arjun, 20, ek dost ko batata hai ki uske saath sexual assault hua. Dost hansta hai: 'Mardon ke saath assault nahi hota.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: A man can always stop an assault if he really wants to, because men are stronger
options.hg: Mard chahe toh assault hamesha rok sakta hai, kyunki mard zyada strong hote hain

options.en: Assault on a man is only a joke, not a real harm
options.hg: Mard pe assault bas mazaak hai, asli nuksaan nahi

options.en: Men who are assaulted must have wanted it
options.hg: Jin mardon ke saath assault hua unhone chaha hoga

options.en: Men can be sexually assaulted, and it causes real trauma that needs support
options.hg: Mardon ke saath bhi sexual assault ho sakta hai, aur isse asli trauma hota hai jise support chahiye

explain.en: Sexual assault can happen to anyone, regardless of gender or strength. Male survivors often face disbelief and mockery, which deepens the harm. Believe them, listen, and help them reach a doctor, counsellor or Tele-MANAS 14416.
explain.hg: Sexual assault kisi ke saath bhi ho sakta hai, gender ya taakat se farak nahi padta. Male survivors ko aksar yakeen nahi milta aur mazaak udta hai, jo nuksaan badhata hai. Unki baat maano, suno, aur doctor, counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 tak pahunchne mein help karo.

q.en: 'Most women who report rape are lying for revenge or money.' What does the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook say about this belief?
q.hg: 'Rape report karne wali zyadatar mahilaayein badla ya paise ke liye jhooth bolti hain.' Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook is soch ke baare mein kya kehti hai?

options.en: It says most rape complaints are proven false
options.hg: Ye kehti hai ki zyadatar rape complaints jhoothi saabit hoti hain

options.en: It tells police to doubt every complaint first
options.hg: Ye police ko kehti hai ki pehle har complaint pe shaq karo

options.en: It lists it as a stereotype that courts must not rely on
options.hg: Ye ise stereotype maanti hai jis par courts ko bharosa nahi karna chahiye

options.en: It says only married women can be believed
options.hg: Ye kehti hai ki sirf shaadi-shuda mahilaon pe yakeen karo

explain.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes rejects the belief that women are very likely to make false rape allegations. Reporting is hard and costly for survivors. Each case is decided on evidence, not assumptions.
explain.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes is soch ko reject karti hai ki mahilaayein aksar jhoothe rape ilzaam lagati hain. Report karna survivors ke liye mushkil aur mehenga hai. Har case evidence pe tay hota hai, maanyataon pe nahi.

q.en: 'Real men don't cry.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Asli mard rote nahi.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Boys who cry are weak and will not succeed
options.hg: Rone wale ladke kamzor hote hain aur kaamyaab nahi honge

options.en: Crying is a healthy human way to release feelings, for everyone
options.hg: Rona feelings nikalne ka healthy insaani tareeka hai, sabke liye

options.en: Men's bodies do not make tears for sadness
options.hg: Mardon ki body udaasi ke aansu nahi banati

options.en: Crying is only allowed for girls and babies
options.hg: Rona sirf ladkiyon aur babies ke liye allowed hai

explain.en: Everyone feels sadness, fear and pain, and crying is one natural way of letting those feelings out. Telling boys not to cry teaches them to bottle things up, which can harm mental health later.
explain.hg: Sabko udaasi, darr aur dard feel hota hai, aur rona in feelings ko bahar nikalne ka natural tareeka hai. Ladkon ko na rone ko kehna unhe sab andar dabaana sikhata hai, jo baad mein mental health ko nuksaan kar sakta hai.

q.en: 'Men don't get depressed; they just get angry.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Mardon ko depression nahi hota; bas gussa aata hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Men do get depressed, and it can show up as anger or irritability
options.hg: Mardon ko depression hota hai, aur ye gusse ya chidchidepan ke roop mein dikh sakta hai

options.en: Depression is a women's illness only
options.hg: Depression sirf mahilaon ki bimaari hai

options.en: Anger in men is always just a personality trait
options.hg: Mardon ka gussa hamesha bas personality hai

options.en: Men who feel low only need to work harder
options.hg: Low feel karne wale mardon ko bas zyada kaam karna chahiye

explain.en: Depression affects men too, but they may show it as anger, irritability, risk-taking, overwork or drinking rather than sadness, so it is often missed. Recognising this helps men get treatment. Tele-MANAS 14416 is for everyone.
explain.hg: Depression mardon ko bhi hota hai, par woh ise udaasi ki jagah gussa, chidchidapan, risk lena, hadd se zyada kaam ya peene ke roop mein dikha sakte hain, isliye aksar pakda nahi jaata. Ye samajhna mardon ko ilaaj tak pahunchata hai. Tele-MANAS 14416 sabke liye hai.

q.en: Dev, 11, hurts his ankle at cricket. His uncle says, 'Mard ko dard nahi hota, keep playing.' What is true?
q.hg: Dev, 11, ko cricket mein ankle mein chot lagti hai. Uske uncle kehte hain, 'Mard ko dard nahi hota, khelte raho.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Real boys do not feel pain, so it cannot be serious
options.hg: Asli ladkon ko dard nahi hota, toh serious nahi ho sakta

options.en: Ignoring pain makes bones heal stronger
options.hg: Dard ignore karne se haddiyan aur strong judti hain

options.en: Only girls need rest after getting hurt
options.hg: Chot ke baad sirf ladkiyon ko aaram chahiye

options.en: Boys feel pain like anyone, and an injury should be checked
options.hg: Ladkon ko bhi sabki tarah dard hota hai, aur chot check karwani chahiye

explain.en: Pain is the body's warning signal, and it works the same in boys and girls. Ignoring an injury can make it worse. Rest and a check-up are sensible, and saying 'it hurts' is not weakness.
explain.hg: Dard body ka warning signal hai, aur ladkon aur ladkiyon mein same kaam karta hai. Chot ignore karne se woh badh sakti hai. Aaram aur check-up samajhdari hai, aur 'dard ho raha hai' bolna kamzori nahi.

q.en: 'Cooking and cleaning are not a boy's job.' What is the better view?
q.hg: 'Khana banana aur safai ladke ka kaam nahi.' Behtar soch kya hai?

options.en: Boys who cook become less manly
options.hg: Khana banane wale ladke kam mardana ho jaate hain

options.en: Only women have the natural ability to cook
options.hg: Sirf mahilaon mein khana banane ki natural kabiliyat hoti hai

options.en: Housework is a life skill for everyone, whatever their gender
options.hg: Ghar ka kaam har kisi ke liye life skill hai, gender koi bhi ho

options.en: Boys should help only when no woman is at home
options.hg: Ladke tabhi help karein jab ghar mein koi mahila na ho

explain.en: Cooking and cleaning are skills anyone can learn, and sharing them makes homes fairer. Many top chefs are men. Fixed ideas of 'men's work' and 'women's work' limit everyone.
explain.hg: Khana banana aur safai aise skills hain jo koi bhi seekh sakta hai, aur baantne se ghar zyada fair bante hain. Bahut se top chefs mard hain. 'Mardon ka kaam' aur 'auraton ka kaam' wali sakht soch sabko seemit karti hai.

q.en: Your friend says, 'He looks so fit and healthy, he can't have HIV.' What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara dost kehta hai, 'Woh itna fit aur healthy dikhta hai, use HIV ho hi nahi sakta.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: People with HIV always look thin and weak
options.hg: HIV wale log hamesha patle aur kamzor dikhte hain

options.en: You cannot tell HIV status by looking; only a test can
options.hg: Dekh ke HIV status pata nahi chalta; sirf test se pata chalta hai

options.en: HIV shows up as a rash on the face
options.hg: HIV chehre pe rash ki tarah dikhta hai

options.en: Gym-going people cannot get HIV
options.hg: Gym jaane walon ko HIV nahi ho sakta

explain.en: Many people with HIV feel and look completely well for years, and those on treatment can live long, healthy lives. The only way to know is testing. Looks are never a guide to anyone's STI status.
explain.hg: HIV wale bahut log saalon tak bilkul theek feel karte aur dikhte hain, aur treatment pe log lambi, healthy zindagi jee sakte hain. Pata karne ka ek hi tareeka hai testing. Shakal kabhi kisi ke STI status ka pata nahi deti.

q.en: Can HIV spread through sharing a toilet, a swimming pool or a plate of food?
q.hg: Kya toilet, swimming pool ya khane ki plate share karne se HIV phail sakta hai?

options.en: No, HIV does not spread through everyday contact like these
options.hg: Nahi, HIV aise roz ke contact se nahi phailta

options.en: Yes, toilets are a common way HIV spreads
options.hg: Haan, toilet HIV phailne ka common tareeka hai

options.en: Yes, the virus survives in pool water for days
options.hg: Haan, virus pool ke paani mein kai din zinda rehta hai

options.en: Yes, if the plate is not washed with hot water
options.hg: Haan, agar plate garam paani se na dhoyi jaaye

explain.en: HIV spreads through certain body fluids: unprotected sex, sharing needles, from parent to baby, and unscreened blood. It does not spread through toilets, pools, food, hugs or mosquitoes. Avoiding people with HIV is discrimination, not protection.
explain.hg: HIV kuch body fluids se phailta hai: bina protection sex, needles share karna, maa-baap se baby, aur bina jaanch ka khoon. Toilet, pool, khana, gale milna ya machchar se nahi phailta. HIV wale logon se door rehna bhed-bhaav hai, bachaav nahi.

q.en: 'HIV is a death sentence.' What is the fact today?
q.hg: 'HIV matlab maut ki saza.' Aaj ka fact kya hai?

options.en: Everyone with HIV dies within a year or two
options.hg: HIV wale sab ek-do saal mein mar jaate hain

options.en: Treatment exists, but only for very rich people who can travel abroad for it
options.hg: Ilaaj hai, par sirf bahut ameer logon ke liye jo iske liye videsh ja sakein

options.en: People with HIV cannot work, marry or have children
options.hg: HIV wale log kaam, shaadi ya bachche nahi kar sakte

options.en: With regular treatment, people with HIV can live long, healthy lives
options.hg: Regular treatment ke saath HIV wale log lambi, healthy zindagi jee sakte hain

explain.en: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) controls HIV. People who take it regularly can work, marry and have children, and someone with an undetectable viral load does not pass HIV on through sex (U=U). ART is provided free at government centres. NACO helpline: 1097.
explain.hg: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) HIV ko control karti hai. Jo log regular lete hain woh kaam, shaadi aur bachche kar sakte hain, aur undetectable viral load wala insaan sex se HIV nahi phailata (U=U). ART sarkari centres pe free milti hai. NACO helpline: 1097.

q.en: 'Only sex workers and people with many partners get STIs.' What is true?
q.hg: 'STI sirf sex workers aur bahut partners walon ko hote hain.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Married people can never get an STI
options.hg: Shaadi-shuda logon ko kabhi STI nahi ho sakta

options.en: STIs only happen to people who are 'dirty'
options.hg: STI sirf 'gande' logon ko hote hain

options.en: Anyone who is sexually active can get an STI, even with one partner
options.hg: Koi bhi jo sexually active hai use STI ho sakta hai, ek partner ke saath bhi

options.en: Having one partner gives full immunity to STIs
options.hg: Ek partner hone se STI se poori immunity milti hai

explain.en: STIs spread through sexual contact, not character. One partner can pass on an infection they did not know they had, since many STIs have no symptoms. Condoms and testing protect everyone, and stigma only stops people from getting checked.
explain.hg: STI sexual contact se phailte hain, character se nahi. Ek partner bhi aisa infection de sakta hai jiska use pata hi na ho, kyunki bahut STI ke symptoms nahi hote. Condom aur testing sabko protect karte hain, aur stigma bas logon ko check karwaane se rokta hai.

q.en: A chemist says taking a couple of antibiotic tablets after sex will 'prevent any infection'. What is true?
q.hg: Ek chemist kehta hai ki sex ke baad do antibiotic tablets lene se 'koi infection nahi hoga'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Yes, two tablets after sex protect against every STI, including HIV and herpes
options.hg: Haan, sex ke baad do tablets HIV aur herpes samet har STI se bachaati hain

options.en: No, this does not reliably prevent STIs and can cause drug resistance
options.hg: Nahi, isse STI pakka nahi rukte aur dawa ka asar khatam (resistance) ho sakta hai

options.en: Yes, as long as they are taken with milk
options.hg: Haan, bas doodh ke saath leni hain

options.en: Yes, which is why condoms are not needed
options.hg: Haan, isliye condom ki zaroorat nahi

explain.en: Random antibiotics do not stop viral STIs like HIV or herpes, may not treat bacterial ones properly, and help germs become resistant. Condoms lower risk, and after a possible exposure the right step is to see a doctor for testing and, if needed, PEP within 72 hours.
explain.hg: Koi bhi antibiotics HIV ya herpes jaise viral STI nahi rokte, bacterial ko bhi sahi se theek nahi karte, aur germs ko resistant banate hain. Condom risk kam karte hain, aur exposure ke baad sahi step doctor se testing hai, aur zaroorat ho toh 72 ghante ke andar PEP.

q.en: 'Coconut oil or Vaseline is fine to use with a latex condom.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Latex condom ke saath coconut oil ya Vaseline use karna theek hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Oil-based products weaken latex; use water- or silicone-based lubricant
options.hg: Oil wale products latex ko kamzor karte hain; water ya silicone based lubricant use karo

options.en: Any kitchen oil makes condoms stronger, smoother and much less likely to tear
options.hg: Koi bhi kitchen ka tel condom ko strong, smooth aur phatne se kaafi safe banata hai

options.en: Only mustard oil damages condoms; other oils are safe
options.hg: Sirf sarson ka tel condom kharab karta hai; baaki oils safe hain

options.en: Lubricants of any kind always make condoms fail
options.hg: Kisi bhi tarah ka lubricant condom ko hamesha fail kar deta hai

explain.en: Oils, petroleum jelly and many lotions can weaken latex and make a condom more likely to break. Water-based or silicone-based lubricants are safe with latex condoms and can reduce friction and tearing.
explain.hg: Oils, petroleum jelly aur bahut si lotions latex ko kamzor karke condom phatne ka chance badhati hain. Water based ya silicone based lubricants latex condom ke saath safe hain aur ragad aur phatna kam kar sakte hain.

q.en: 'You can catch an STI from a public toilet seat.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Public toilet seat se STI ho sakta hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is the most common way people get STIs
options.hg: Log aksar isi tareeke se STI lete hain

options.en: Yes, especially HIV, which can live for weeks on a dirty public toilet seat
options.hg: Haan, khaaskar HIV, jo gandi public toilet seat pe hafton zinda reh sakta hai

options.en: Yes, which is why STIs are not linked to sex
options.hg: Haan, isliye STI ka sex se koi lena-dena nahi

options.en: This is very unlikely, because STI germs do not survive or spread that way
options.hg: Ye bahut hi unlikely hai, kyunki STI ke germs is tarah zinda nahi rehte ya phailte nahi

explain.en: STIs spread mainly through sexual contact. Germs that cause them do not survive well on hard surfaces, and toilet seats are not a realistic route. Good toilet hygiene is still sensible, but blaming toilets can delay proper testing.
explain.hg: STI mainly sexual contact se phailte hain. Inke germs sakht surfaces pe achhe se zinda nahi rehte, aur toilet seat realistic raasta nahi hai. Toilet hygiene fir bhi achhi baat hai, par toilet ko blame karna sahi testing mein der karwa sakta hai.

q.en: 'Only gay men get HIV.' What is true?
q.hg: 'HIV sirf gay mardon ko hota hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: HIV cannot spread between a man and a woman
options.hg: HIV mard aur aurat ke beech nahi phail sakta

options.en: Married women are fully safe from HIV
options.hg: Shaadi-shuda mahilaayein HIV se poori tarah safe hain

options.en: Anyone can get HIV; risk depends on actions, not identity
options.hg: HIV kisi ko bhi ho sakta hai; risk actions pe depend karta hai, identity pe nahi

options.en: Straight people do not need HIV tests
options.hg: Straight logon ko HIV test ki zaroorat nahi

explain.en: HIV spreads through unprotected sex between any genders, shared needles, from parent to child and through unscreened blood. Linking it to one group fuels stigma and gives others a false sense of safety. Testing and condoms are for everyone.
explain.hg: HIV kisi bhi gender ke beech bina protection sex, needles share karne, maa-baap se bachche aur bina jaanch ke khoon se phailta hai. Ise ek group se jodna stigma badhata hai aur baaki logon ko jhoothi safety deta hai. Testing aur condom sabke liye hain.

q.en: Some parents worry the HPV vaccine will make girls 'start sex early'. What is the fact?
q.hg: Kuch parents ko darr hai ki HPV vaccine se ladkiyan 'jaldi sex shuru kar dengi'. Fact kya hai?

options.en: It works only for girls who are already sexually active, so giving it early is useless
options.hg: Ye sirf pehle se sexually active ladkiyon pe kaam karta hai, isliye jaldi dena bekaar hai

options.en: It is a vaccine against cancer-causing HPV, given early so it protects in time
options.hg: Ye cancer karne wale HPV ke khilaaf vaccine hai, jaldi diya jaata hai taaki time pe protect kare

options.en: It changes hormones and increases sexual desire
options.hg: Ye hormones badal ke sexual chahat badha deta hai

options.en: It is a type of contraceptive injection
options.hg: Ye ek tarah ka contraceptive injection hai

explain.en: HPV causes most cervical cancer. The vaccine works best before any exposure, which is why WHO's main target group is girls aged 9 to 14. It does not affect behaviour or fertility and is not contraception. Screening later in life is still needed.
explain.hg: Zyadatar cervical cancer HPV se hota hai. Vaccine exposure se pehle sabse achha kaam karta hai, isliye WHO ka main target 9 se 14 saal ki ladkiyan hain. Ye behaviour ya fertility pe asar nahi daalta aur contraception nahi hai. Baad mein screening fir bhi zaroori hai.

q.en: 'If the man pulls out before ejaculating, she can't get pregnant.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Agar mard ejaculate karne se pehle bahar nikaal le, toh pregnancy nahi hogi.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Withdrawal is unreliable; pregnancy can still happen
options.hg: Withdrawal reliable nahi; pregnancy fir bhi ho sakti hai

options.en: Withdrawal is as safe as the pill or an IUD
options.hg: Withdrawal pill ya IUD jitna safe hai

options.en: It works every time if the man is experienced
options.hg: Mard experienced ho toh har baar kaam karta hai

options.en: It also protects against STIs
options.hg: Ye STI se bhi bachata hai

explain.en: Pre-ejaculate can contain sperm, and pulling out in time is hard to do every time. In everyday use it fails far more often than the pill, an IUD or condoms, and it gives no STI protection. Condoms, pills or an IUD are far more reliable.
explain.hg: Pre-ejaculate mein sperm ho sakte hain, aur har baar time pe bahar nikaalna mushkil hai. Roz ke use mein ye pill, IUD ya condom se kahin zyada fail hota hai, aur isse STI se koi bachaav nahi. Condom, pills ya IUD kahin zyada reliable hain.

q.en: 'A girl cannot get pregnant the first time she has sex.' Is this true?
q.hg: 'Pehli baar sex karne pe ladki pregnant nahi ho sakti.' Kya ye sach hai?

options.en: Yes, the body needs practice before it can conceive
options.hg: Haan, body ko conceive karne se pehle practice chahiye

options.en: Yes, because the hymen blocks sperm the first time
options.hg: Haan, kyunki pehli baar hymen sperm ko rok leta hai

options.en: Only if it happens on her birthday
options.hg: Sirf agar uske birthday pe ho

options.en: No, pregnancy can happen the very first time
options.hg: Nahi, pehli baar mein bhi pregnancy ho sakti hai

explain.en: If sperm meets an egg, pregnancy can happen, whether it is the first time or the hundredth. There is no 'first-time protection'. Anyone who is sexually active and does not want a pregnancy needs contraception every time.
explain.hg: Agar sperm egg se mil jaaye toh pregnancy ho sakti hai, chahe pehli baar ho ya sauvi. 'First-time protection' jaisi koi cheez nahi. Jo bhi sexually active hai aur pregnancy nahi chahta, use har baar contraception chahiye.

q.en: 'Jumping, peeing or washing right after sex will stop a pregnancy.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Sex ke turant baad koodne, peshaab karne ya dhone se pregnancy ruk jaati hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Jumping ten times pushes all sperm out
options.hg: Das baar koodne se saare sperm bahar nikal jaate hain

options.en: Urinating flushes sperm from the vagina
options.hg: Peshaab vagina se sperm baha deta hai

options.en: They don't work; sperm reach the uterus within minutes
options.hg: Ye kaam nahi karte; sperm minuton mein uterus tak pahunch jaate hain

options.en: Washing with soap kills sperm inside the body
options.hg: Sabun se dhone se andar ke sperm mar jaate hain

explain.en: Sperm move quickly into the cervix and uterus. Urine comes out of a different opening, and washing or jumping cannot reach them. If contraception failed or was not used, emergency contraception works up to 5 days after sex, the sooner the better.
explain.hg: Sperm tezi se cervix aur uterus mein chale jaate hain. Peshaab alag raaste se nikalta hai, aur dhona ya koodna wahan tak nahi pahunchta. Contraception fail hua ya use nahi hua, toh emergency contraception sex ke 5 din tak kaam karta hai, jitna jaldi utna achha.

q.en: 'Pregnancy cannot happen if the couple has sex standing up or in certain positions.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Khade hokar ya kuch khaas positions mein sex karne se pregnancy nahi hoti.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Gravity pulls sperm out when standing
options.hg: Khade hone pe gravity sperm ko bahar kheench leti hai

options.en: Position makes no difference; pregnancy can happen in any position
options.hg: Position se koi farak nahi; kisi bhi position mein pregnancy ho sakti hai

options.en: Only one position can lead to pregnancy
options.hg: Sirf ek position se pregnancy ho sakti hai

options.en: Positions decide whether the baby is a boy or a girl
options.hg: Positions tay karti hain ki baby ladka hoga ya ladki

explain.en: Sperm swim and are not stopped by gravity. Any sex where semen or pre-ejaculate enters the vagina can lead to pregnancy. Reliable contraception, not position, prevents it.
explain.hg: Sperm tairte hain aur gravity unhe nahi rokti. Koi bhi sex jisme semen ya pre-ejaculate vagina mein jaaye, pregnancy la sakta hai. Position nahi, reliable contraception hi pregnancy rokta hai.

q.en: A friend says eating lots of raw papaya or pineapple will end an unwanted pregnancy. What is the fact?
q.hg: Ek dost kehta hai ki bahut saara kachcha papita ya ananas khane se anchahi pregnancy khatam ho jaayegi. Fact kya hai?

options.en: No food reliably ends a pregnancy; safe, legal abortion needs a doctor
options.hg: Koi bhi khana pregnancy ko pakka khatam nahi karta; safe, legal abortion ke liye doctor chahiye

options.en: Papaya works within a day if eaten on an empty stomach
options.hg: Khaali pet papita khao toh ek din mein kaam karta hai

options.en: Pineapple is a safe home method approved by doctors
options.hg: Ananas doctors se approved safe ghar ka tareeka hai

options.en: Mixing papaya with hot tea guarantees an abortion
options.hg: Papite ko garam chai ke saath lene se abortion pakka hai

explain.en: Food myths waste precious time and some home methods are dangerous. In India, abortion is legal under the MTP Act up to 20 weeks on one doctor's opinion, and in some cases up to 24 weeks, for married and unmarried women. See a registered doctor and never self-medicate.
explain.hg: Khane wale myths keemti time barbaad karte hain aur kuch ghar ke tareeke khatarnak hain. India mein MTP Act ke tahat abortion 20 hafte tak ek doctor ki raay pe legal hai, aur kuch cases mein 24 hafte tak, shaadi-shuda aur unmarried dono ke liye. Registered doctor se milo aur kabhi khud dawa mat lo.

q.en: Relatives tell a pregnant woman to eat certain foods so that she 'has a boy'. What is the fact?
q.hg: Rishtedaar ek pregnant mahila ko kuch khaas khane ko kehte hain taaki 'ladka ho'. Fact kya hai?

options.en: Eating sweets in the first month guarantees a boy
options.hg: Pehle mahine meetha khane se ladka pakka hai

options.en: Sour food during pregnancy produces a girl
options.hg: Pregnancy mein khatta khane se ladki hoti hai

options.en: The mother's diet decides the baby's sex until about the fifth month of pregnancy
options.hg: Pregnancy ke lagbhag paanchve mahine tak maa ki diet baby ka sex tay karti hai

options.en: The baby's sex is set by the sperm at conception; food cannot change it
options.hg: Baby ka sex conception ke waqt sperm se tay hota hai; khana ise nahi badal sakta

explain.en: Whether the sperm carries an X or a Y chromosome decides the baby's sex at the moment of conception. No diet, ritual or medicine changes it, and blaming the mother for having a daughter is wrong. Sex-determination tests are illegal in India.
explain.hg: Sperm X chromosome le ke aaya ya Y, isse conception ke pal hi baby ka sex tay ho jaata hai. Koi diet, riwaaz ya dawa ise nahi badalti, aur beti hone pe maa ko blame karna galat hai. India mein sex-determination tests illegal hain.

q.en: 'If the bump is pointed and low, it's a boy.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Agar pet nukila aur neeche hai, toh ladka hoga.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: A round bump always means a girl
options.hg: Gol pet hamesha ladki ka matlab hai

options.en: Doctors use the shape of the bump to tell the baby's sex during routine check-ups
options.hg: Doctor routine check-up mein pet ki shape se baby ka sex batate hain

options.en: Bump shape depends on muscles, body type and the baby's position, not sex
options.hg: Pet ki shape muscles, body type aur baby ki position pe depend karti hai, sex pe nahi

options.en: A high bump means twins of the same sex
options.hg: Upar wala pet matlab same sex ke judwa

explain.en: How a pregnancy 'carries' depends on the mother's muscle tone, height, earlier pregnancies and the baby's position. It does not predict sex. Such guessing games can add to harmful pressure for sons.
explain.hg: Pregnancy kaisi 'dikhti' hai ye maa ke muscles, height, pichhli pregnancies aur baby ki position pe depend karta hai. Isse sex ka pata nahi chalta. Aise andaaze bete ke liye harmful pressure badha sakte hain.

q.en: 'A Copper-T can travel through the body to the heart or brain.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Copper-T body mein ghoom ke dil ya dimaag tak pahunch sakta hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: It often moves into the blood and reaches the heart
options.hg: Ye aksar khoon mein jaakar dil tak pahunch jaata hai

options.en: It cannot travel there; rarely it can slip out of place, which a doctor can check
options.hg: Ye wahan nahi ja sakta; kabhi kabhi apni jagah se khisak sakta hai, jo doctor check kar sakte hain

options.en: It dissolves after a year or two and slowly spreads its copper all through the body
options.hg: Ye ek-do saal mein ghul jaata hai aur dheere dheere apna copper poori body mein phaila deta hai

options.en: It must be removed every month to stop it moving
options.hg: Ise hilne se rokne ke liye har mahine nikaalna padta hai

explain.en: A Copper-T sits in the uterus, a closed muscular organ, and cannot enter the blood. Rarely it slips down or out, so a follow-up check is advised. It is one of the most effective contraceptives and can work for years.
explain.hg: Copper-T uterus mein rehta hai, jo ek band muscular organ hai, aur khoon mein nahi ja sakta. Kabhi kabhi ye neeche ya bahar khisak sakta hai, isliye follow-up check ki salaah di jaati hai. Ye sabse effective contraceptives mein se ek hai aur saalon tak kaam kar sakta hai.

q.en: 'A vasectomy makes a man weak and ends his sex life.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Nasbandi (vasectomy) se mard kamzor ho jaata hai aur uski sex life khatam ho jaati hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: It blocks sperm only; strength, erections and desire stay the same
options.hg: Ye sirf sperm rokti hai; taakat, erection aur chahat waise hi rehti hai

options.en: It removes the testicles and lowers male hormones
options.hg: Isme testicles nikaal diye jaate hain aur male hormones kam ho jaate hain

options.en: It works from the very same day, so no other protection is needed afterwards
options.hg: Ye bilkul usi din se kaam karti hai, toh baad mein aur protection ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: Men cannot ejaculate at all after it
options.hg: Iske baad mard bilkul ejaculate nahi kar sakte

explain.en: A vasectomy is a minor procedure that blocks the tubes carrying sperm. Hormones, erections, desire and ejaculation continue, just without sperm. It is not effective immediately: another method is needed until a semen test confirms no sperm. It is simpler and safer than female sterilisation.
explain.hg: Vasectomy ek chhota procedure hai jo sperm le jaane wali nalis ko block karta hai. Hormones, erection, chahat aur ejaculation chalte rehte hain, bas sperm nahi hote. Ye turant kaam nahi karti: semen test se sperm na hone ki pushti tak doosra tareeka chahiye. Ye mahila nasbandi se zyada simple aur safe hai.

q.en: Can a girl get pregnant from a kiss, a hug or sharing a bench with a boy?
q.hg: Kya ladki kiss, gale milne ya ladke ke saath bench share karne se pregnant ho sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, a kiss can cause pregnancy if it lasts long
options.hg: Haan, lamba kiss pregnancy kar sakta hai

options.en: Yes, sitting close lets sperm travel through clothes
options.hg: Haan, paas baithne se sperm kapdon se guzar jaate hain

options.en: Yes, but only during the girl's period
options.hg: Haan, par sirf ladki ke periods ke dauraan

options.en: No, pregnancy needs sperm to reach an egg inside the body
options.hg: Nahi, pregnancy ke liye sperm ka body ke andar egg tak pahunchna zaroori hai

explain.en: Pregnancy happens when sperm meets an egg, which needs semen or pre-ejaculate to enter the vagina. Kissing, hugging and sitting together cannot cause it. Knowing how pregnancy really happens removes needless fear.
explain.hg: Pregnancy tab hoti hai jab sperm egg se milta hai, jiske liye semen ya pre-ejaculate ka vagina mein jaana zaroori hai. Kiss, gale milna ya saath baithna isse nahi kar sakte. Pregnancy asal mein kaise hoti hai ye jaanna bekaar ka darr door karta hai.

q.en: 'A woman can only get pregnant if she has an orgasm.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Mahila tabhi pregnant ho sakti hai jab use orgasm ho.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Without orgasm, the uterus stays closed to sperm
options.hg: Orgasm ke bina uterus sperm ke liye band rehta hai

options.en: Orgasm is needed to release the egg
options.hg: Egg release hone ke liye orgasm zaroori hai

options.en: Pregnancy can happen whether or not she has an orgasm
options.hg: Orgasm ho ya na ho, pregnancy ho sakti hai

options.en: Only women who enjoy sex can conceive
options.hg: Sirf sex enjoy karne wali mahilaayein conceive kar sakti hain

explain.en: Ovulation follows the hormonal cycle and has nothing to do with orgasm. If sperm reach an egg, pregnancy can happen regardless of pleasure. This myth has been used to deny that pregnancy can follow sexual assault, which is false.
explain.hg: Ovulation hormonal cycle se hota hai aur orgasm se iska koi lena-dena nahi. Agar sperm egg tak pahunch jaaye toh pleasure ho ya na ho, pregnancy ho sakti hai. Is myth se ye jhooth bhi failaaya gaya ki sexual assault se pregnancy nahi hoti.

q.en: A couple has not conceived after a year of trying, and only the wife is sent for tests. What is the better approach?
q.hg: Ek couple ek saal koshish ke baad bhi conceive nahi kar paaya, aur sirf patni ko tests ke liye bheja jaata hai. Behtar tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Only the wife, because infertility is a women's problem
options.hg: Sirf patni, kyunki infertility auraton ki problem hai

options.en: Both partners should be tested, since male factors are common
options.hg: Dono partners ka test hona chahiye, kyunki male factors bhi common hain

options.en: Only the husband if the wife's family insists
options.hg: Sirf pati, agar patni ki family zor de

options.en: Neither; they should keep trying for ten more years
options.hg: Kisi ka nahi; das saal aur koshish karte rehna chahiye

explain.en: Fertility problems can come from either partner or both, so doctors check both together. A man's semen test is simple and quick. Blaming women alone delays the right treatment and causes great unfairness.
explain.hg: Fertility problem kisi bhi partner ya dono se ho sakti hai, isliye doctor dono ko saath check karte hain. Mard ka semen test simple aur jaldi hota hai. Sirf mahila ko blame karna sahi ilaaj mein der karta hai aur bahut na-insaafi karta hai.

q.en: 'Masturbation makes hair grow on your palms or makes you go blind.' Is that true?
q.hg: 'Masturbation se hatheli pe baal ugte hain ya aankhein chali jaati hain.' Kya ye sach hai?

options.en: No, these are old scare stories with no truth in them
options.hg: Nahi, ye purani daraane wali kahaniyan hain jinme koi sach nahi

options.en: Yes, blindness happens after many years
options.hg: Haan, kai saalon baad andhapan ho jaata hai

options.en: Only the hair on the palms is true
options.hg: Sirf hatheli pe baal wali baat sach hai

options.en: Yes, but glasses can correct the damage
options.hg: Haan, par chashma damage theek kar sakta hai

explain.en: These myths were invented to frighten young people. Masturbation does not affect eyesight, hair, skin or growth. It is common and not harmful, and choosing not to do it is also fine.
explain.hg: Ye myths young logon ko daraane ke liye banaye gaye the. Masturbation aankhon, baalon, skin ya growth pe asar nahi daalta. Ye common hai aur harmful nahi, aur na karna bhi theek hai.

q.en: Varun's gym trainer says masturbation will 'ruin his gains' and drain his muscles. What is true?
q.hg: Varun ka gym trainer kehta hai ki masturbation uske 'gains barbaad' kar dega aur muscles kamzor kar dega. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Each time drains protein that muscles need
options.hg: Har baar woh protein nikal jaata hai jo muscles ko chahiye

options.en: It lowers testosterone permanently
options.hg: Ye testosterone ko hamesha ke liye kam kar deta hai

options.en: Athletes must avoid it for months before a match
options.hg: Athletes ko match se mahino pehle isse bachna chahiye

options.en: There is no evidence it harms muscle growth or strength
options.hg: Is baat ka koi evidence nahi ki ye muscle growth ya taakat ko nuksaan karta hai

explain.en: Muscle growth depends on training, food, sleep and genes. Ejaculation uses a tiny amount of nutrients and does not lower testosterone in a lasting way. The 'drain' idea is a version of the old semen-loss myth.
explain.hg: Muscle growth training, khane, neend aur genes pe depend karti hai. Ejaculation mein bahut kam nutrients lagte hain aur ye testosterone ko lambe time ke liye kam nahi karta. 'Drain' wala idea purane semen-loss myth ka hi roop hai.

q.en: An uncle tells Sameer, 16, 'Save your energy for marriage, or you won't be able to have children.' What is the fact?
q.hg: Ek uncle Sameer, 16, ko kehte hain, 'Apni energy shaadi ke liye bachao, warna bachche nahi honge.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Every ejaculation reduces the sperm left for later
options.hg: Har ejaculation baad ke liye bache sperm kam kar deta hai

options.en: Men are born with a fixed number of sperm
options.hg: Mard ek fixed number ke sperm ke saath paida hote hain

options.en: Masturbation does not affect future fertility or sexual ability
options.hg: Masturbation future fertility ya sexual ability pe asar nahi daalta

options.en: Boys who masturbate need a course of treatment before they get married
options.hg: Masturbate karne wale ladkon ko shaadi se pehle ilaaj ka course chahiye

explain.en: Unlike eggs, sperm are made fresh every day from puberty onwards, so there is no stock to 'use up'. Masturbation in the teens does not cause infertility or impotence later. Worry and guilt, not masturbation, are what quacks profit from.
explain.hg: Eggs ke ulat, sperm puberty ke baad roz naye bante hain, toh 'khatam' hone wala koi stock nahi. Teens mein masturbation se baad mein infertility ya impotence nahi hoti. Neem-hakeem masturbation se nahi, tension aur guilt se paisa kamaate hain.

q.en: 'Masturbation causes dark circles and a thin, weak body.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Masturbation se dark circles aur patli, kamzor body ho jaati hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Yes, it drains blood from the face
options.hg: Haan, ye chehre se khoon kheench leta hai

options.en: No, these come from sleep, genes, diet or illness, not masturbation
options.hg: Nahi, ye neend, genes, khane ya bimaari se hote hain, masturbation se nahi

options.en: Yes, every boy who does it becomes thin
options.hg: Haan, jo bhi ladka karta hai woh patla ho jaata hai

options.en: Only if done more than once a week
options.hg: Sirf agar hafte mein ek baar se zyada kiya jaaye

explain.en: Dark circles are usually from genes, poor sleep, allergies or screen time, and body shape depends on genes, food and activity. Linking them to masturbation is a myth that causes needless guilt.
explain.hg: Dark circles aksar genes, kam neend, allergy ya screen time se hote hain, aur body ki shape genes, khane aur activity pe depend karti hai. Inhe masturbation se jodna myth hai jo bekaar ka guilt deta hai.

q.en: 'Teaching sex education in school makes young people have sex earlier.' What does the evidence say?
q.hg: 'School mein sex education padhane se young log jaldi sex karne lagte hain.' Evidence kya kehta hai?

options.en: It does not increase sexual activity; good programmes improve safety
options.hg: Isse sexual activity nahi badhti; achhe programmes safety badhaate hain

options.en: It doubles the number of teenage pregnancies
options.hg: Isse teenage pregnancies double ho jaati hain

options.en: It is banned by the WHO for under-18s
options.hg: WHO ne 18 se kam umar ke liye ise ban kiya hai

options.en: It only works if it teaches nothing about the body and just tells students to wait
options.hg: Ye tabhi kaam karti hai jab body ke baare mein kuch na sikhaaye aur bas wait karne ko kahe

explain.en: The UN's International Technical Guidance on Sexuality Education (2018) states that sexuality education does not increase sexual activity, risk-taking or STI/HIV rates. Good programmes are linked to later first sex, more condom and contraceptive use and less risk-taking.
explain.hg: UN ki International Technical Guidance on Sexuality Education (2018) kehti hai ki sexuality education se sexual activity, risk lena ya STI/HIV rates nahi badhte. Achhe programmes der se pehla sex, zyada condom aur contraceptive use aur kam risk se jude hain.

q.en: A family says their gay son should get married or see a doctor for a 'cure'. What is the fact in India?
q.hg: Ek family kehti hai ki unke gay bete ki shaadi kara do ya 'ilaaj' ke liye doctor ko dikhao. India mein fact kya hai?

options.en: Marriage to the right partner reliably changes a person's sexual orientation over time
options.hg: Sahi partner se shaadi time ke saath insaan ka sexual orientation reliably badal deti hai

options.en: Doctors in India are required to treat homosexuality
options.hg: India mein doctors ko homosexuality ka ilaaj karna zaroori hai

options.en: Hormone injections can turn a gay man straight
options.hg: Hormone injections gay mard ko straight bana sakte hain

options.en: Being gay is not an illness, and the NMC calls 'conversion therapy' misconduct
options.hg: Gay hona bimaari nahi, aur NMC 'conversion therapy' ko misconduct kehta hai

explain.en: Sexual orientation is not a disease and cannot be 'cured'. In August 2022 the National Medical Commission declared that conversion therapy on LGBTQIA+ persons is professional misconduct. Forcing marriage harms both spouses. Acceptance and support protect mental health.
explain.hg: Sexual orientation bimaari nahi aur iska 'ilaaj' nahi hota. August 2022 mein National Medical Commission ne kaha ki LGBTQIA+ logon pe conversion therapy professional misconduct hai. Zabardasti shaadi dono partners ko nuksaan pahunchati hai. Apnapan aur support mental health bachate hain.

q.en: Ads for 'likoria' (white discharge) medicines say any discharge drains a woman's strength. What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Likoria' (safed paani) ki dawaiyon ke ads kehte hain ki koi bhi discharge mahila ki taakat khatam karta hai. Fact kya hai?

options.en: All vaginal discharge is a disease that slowly weakens the body and must be treated
options.hg: Har vaginal discharge bimaari hai jo dheere dheere body kamzor karti hai aur iska ilaaj zaroori hai

options.en: Discharge means a girl has been sexually active
options.hg: Discharge matlab ladki sexually active rahi hai

options.en: Clear or white discharge is normal; smell, itching or colour change needs a doctor
options.hg: Saaf ya safed discharge normal hai; badbu, khujli ya rang badle toh doctor chahiye

options.en: Discharge drains calcium from the bones
options.hg: Discharge haddiyon se calcium nikaal deta hai

explain.en: Normal discharge keeps the vagina clean and healthy and changes through the cycle. It does not cause weakness. A strong smell, itching, burning, a green or grey colour or a cottage-cheese texture can mean an infection, which a doctor can treat easily.
explain.hg: Normal discharge vagina ko saaf aur healthy rakhta hai aur cycle ke saath badalta hai. Isse kamzori nahi aati. Tez badbu, khujli, jalan, hara ya grey rang ya dahi jaisa texture infection ho sakta hai, jiska doctor aasaani se ilaaj kar sakte hain.

q.en: 'Men cannot get breast cancer.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Mardon ko breast cancer nahi ho sakta.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Men have no breast tissue at all
options.hg: Mardon mein bilkul breast tissue nahi hota

options.en: Men can get it, though it is rare; a chest lump should be checked
options.hg: Mardon ko ho sakta hai, halanki rare hai; chest mein lump ho toh check karwao

options.en: Only men who are overweight can get it
options.hg: Sirf zyada weight wale mardon ko ho sakta hai

options.en: It only affects men who have taken hormones
options.hg: Ye sirf hormones lene wale mardon ko hota hai

explain.en: Everyone has some breast tissue, so men can develop breast cancer, though it is much less common than in women. Because of the myth, men often notice a lump late. Any new lump, nipple change or discharge should be shown to a doctor.
explain.hg: Sabme kuch breast tissue hota hai, isliye mardon ko bhi breast cancer ho sakta hai, halanki mahilaon se bahut kam common hai. Is myth ki wajah se mard aksar lump der se notice karte hain. Koi naya lump, nipple mein badlav ya discharge ho toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: Rohit, 12, notices one testicle hangs lower than the other and worries. What is true?
q.hg: Rohit, 12, notice karta hai ki ek testicle doosre se neeche latakta hai aur tension mein hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: This is normal; it is common for one to hang lower
options.hg: Ye normal hai; ek ka neeche latakna common hai

options.en: It means one testicle is not working
options.hg: Iska matlab ek testicle kaam nahi kar raha

options.en: He will need an operation before puberty ends
options.hg: Puberty khatam hone se pehle operation chahiye

options.en: It is caused by sitting cross-legged too much
options.hg: Ye zyada paalthi maar ke baithne se hota hai

explain.en: It is very common for one testicle to hang a little lower or be slightly bigger. What needs urgent care is sudden, severe pain or swelling in a testicle, which is an emergency. A new lump should also be shown to a doctor.
explain.hg: Ek testicle ka thoda neeche latakna ya thoda bada hona bahut common hai. Urgent care tab chahiye jab testicle mein achanak bahut dard ya sujan ho, ye emergency hai. Naya lump ho toh bhi doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: 'A late period always means a girl is pregnant.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Period late ho toh ladki pakka pregnant hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: A period is never late for any reason other than pregnancy, whatever the girl's age
options.hg: Umar koi bhi ho, pregnancy ke alawa kisi wajah se period kabhi late nahi hota

options.en: A late period means the uterus is blocked
options.hg: Late period matlab uterus block hai

options.en: Periods are always exactly 28 days apart
options.hg: Periods hamesha bilkul 28 din ke gap pe aate hain

options.en: Stress, illness, weight change and exams can also delay a period
options.hg: Stress, bimaari, weight badalna aur exams bhi period late kar sakte hain

explain.en: Cycles vary, and stress, travel, illness, sudden weight change or intense exercise can delay a period. Someone who has had sex and has a late period should take a pregnancy test. Periods that stop for three months or more need a doctor.
explain.hg: Cycles alag hote hain, aur stress, travel, bimaari, achanak weight badalna ya bahut exercise period late kar sakte hain. Jisne sex kiya hai aur period late hai, use pregnancy test karna chahiye. Teen mahine ya zyada periods ruk jaayein toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: 'Pimples will go away after marriage.' Is that true?
q.hg: 'Shaadi ke baad pimples chale jaayenge.' Kya ye sach hai?

options.en: Yes, marriage balances the hormones that cause acne
options.hg: Haan, shaadi acne wale hormones ko balance kar deti hai

options.en: Yes, but only for girls
options.hg: Haan, par sirf ladkiyon ke liye

options.en: No, acne depends on hormones, skin and genes, not marriage
options.hg: Nahi, acne hormones, skin aur genes pe depend karta hai, shaadi pe nahi

options.en: Yes, because married people eat less oily food
options.hg: Haan, kyunki shaadi-shuda log kam oily khaate hain

explain.en: Acne is common in puberty and often improves with age, which is why the myth started. Marriage has nothing to do with it. If pimples are painful or leave marks, a dermatologist can treat them now.
explain.hg: Acne puberty mein common hai aur aksar umar ke saath kam hota hai, isliye ye myth shuru hua. Shaadi ka isse koi lena-dena nahi. Pimples dard dein ya nishaan chhodein toh dermatologist abhi ilaaj kar sakte hain.

q.en: 'Teaching children the correct names for private parts is shameless.' What is the better view?
q.hg: 'Bachchon ko private parts ke sahi naam sikhana besharmi hai.' Behtar soch kya hai?

options.en: Children should only learn cute nicknames for private parts until they are married
options.hg: Bachchon ko shaadi tak private parts ke sirf cute nicknames seekhne chahiye

options.en: Correct names help children stay safe and tell an adult if something is wrong
options.hg: Sahi naam bachchon ko safe rehne aur kuch galat ho toh adult ko batane mein help karte hain

options.en: Knowing the names makes children curious about sex
options.hg: Naam jaanne se bachche sex ke baare mein curious ho jaate hain

options.en: Only doctors need to know these words
options.hg: Sirf doctors ko ye shabd jaanne chahiye

explain.en: Words like penis, vulva and vagina are just body-part names, like elbow or knee. Children who know them can describe problems or unsafe touch clearly, and are taken more seriously when they ask for help.
explain.hg: Penis, vulva aur vagina jaise shabd bas body parts ke naam hain, jaise kohni ya ghutna. Jo bachche ye jaante hain woh problem ya unsafe touch saaf bata paate hain, aur help maangne pe unki baat zyada seriously li jaati hai.

q.en: 'Drinking milk with saffron in pregnancy makes the baby fair.' What is the fact?
q.hg: 'Pregnancy mein kesar wala doodh peene se baby gora hota hai.' Fact kya hai?

options.en: Skin colour comes from genes; no food changes it
options.hg: Skin colour genes se aata hai; koi khana ise nahi badalta

options.en: Saffron lightens the baby's skin by two shades
options.hg: Kesar baby ki skin do shade halki kar deta hai

options.en: Milk makes the baby fair, but saffron makes it dark
options.hg: Doodh baby ko gora banata hai, par kesar saanwla

options.en: Coconut water works better than saffron
options.hg: Nariyal paani kesar se zyada kaam karta hai

explain.en: A baby's skin colour is inherited from both parents. Good nutrition in pregnancy matters for health, not for colour. The wish for a 'fair' baby reflects colourism, and every skin shade is healthy.
explain.hg: Baby ka skin colour dono parents ke genes se aata hai. Pregnancy mein achha khana health ke liye zaroori hai, rang ke liye nahi. 'Gore' baby ki chahat colourism dikhati hai, aur har skin shade healthy hai.

q.en: A teenager suddenly stops sleeping, talks to no one and seems terrified. Relatives say it is 'nazar' or black magic and plan to visit a baba. What is wise?
q.hg: Ek teenager achanak sona band kar deta hai, kisi se baat nahi karta aur bahut dara hua lagta hai. Rishtedaar kehte hain 'nazar' ya kaala jaadu hai aur baba ke paas jaane ka plan hai. Samajhdari kya hai?

options.en: Wait and see for a few months, as such things always settle on their own
options.hg: Kuch mahine ruko aur dekho, aisi cheezein hamesha apne aap theek ho jaati hain

options.en: Lock them in a room until the spirit leaves
options.hg: Unhe kamre mein band kar do jab tak saaya na jaaye

options.en: Scold them until they start behaving normally
options.hg: Unhe tab tak daanto jab tak normal behave na karein

options.en: Take them to a doctor; sudden changes can be treatable health problems
options.hg: Doctor ke paas le jao; achanak badlav treatable health problem ho sakte hain

explain.en: Sudden changes in sleep, mood or behaviour can come from mental or physical illness, which doctors can treat. Faith can comfort a family, but it should not delay medical care. Tele-MANAS 14416 can guide families on where to go.
explain.hg: Neend, mood ya behaviour mein achanak badlav mental ya physical bimaari se ho sakta hai, jiska doctor ilaaj kar sakte hain. Aastha family ko sahara de sakti hai, par medical care mein der nahi honi chahiye. Tele-MANAS 14416 families ko bata sakta hai kahan jaana hai.

q.en: 'People who talk about wanting to die are just seeking attention.' What is true?
q.hg: 'Jo log marne ki baat karte hain woh bas attention chahte hain.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Ignoring them is best, so they stop the drama
options.hg: Ignore karna best hai taaki drama band ho

options.en: People who talk about it never actually act on it
options.hg: Jo log iski baat karte hain woh kabhi kuch karte nahi

options.en: Such talk should always be taken seriously and met with support
options.hg: Aisi baat ko hamesha seriously lena aur support dena chahiye

options.en: Only a family member is allowed to respond
options.hg: Sirf family member hi jawab de sakta hai

explain.en: Talking about death or not wanting to live is often a sign of real pain and a call for help. Listen without judging, ask directly how they are, stay with them and connect them to Tele-MANAS 14416, or call 112 if there is immediate danger.
explain.hg: Maut ya na jeene ki baat aksar asli dard aur help ki pukaar hoti hai. Bina judge kiye suno, seedha poocho ki woh kaise hain, saath raho aur Tele-MANAS 14416 se jodo, ya turant khatra ho toh 112 call karo.

q.en: What is a period?
q.hg: Period kya hota hai?

options.en: Blood and tissue leaving the uterus, about monthly
options.hg: Uterus se blood aur tissue ka bahar aana, lagbhag har mahine

options.en: Bleeding from a wound inside the tummy
options.hg: Pet ke andar kisi zakhm se blood aana

options.en: An illness that girls catch from others
options.hg: Ek beemari jo girls ek-doosre se pakadti hain

options.en: Something that happens only to sick women
options.hg: Kuch jo sirf beemar auraton ko hota hai

explain.en: Each month or so, the lining of the uterus thickens. If there is no pregnancy, it breaks down and flows out through the vagina. That flow is a period. It is not a wound and not an illness.
explain.hg: Lagbhag har mahine uterus ki andar ki parat moti hoti hai. Pregnancy na ho toh woh toot ke vagina se bahar aati hai. Yahi period hai. Yeh na zakhm hai, na beemari.

q.en: Is a period a sign that someone is ill or hurt?
q.hg: Kya period is baat ka sign hai ki koi beemar hai ya use chot lagi hai?

options.en: Yes, it means something inside is broken
options.hg: Haan, iska matlab andar kuch toot gaya hai

options.en: Yes, it is a kind of fever
options.hg: Haan, yeh ek tarah ka bukhaar hai

options.en: Yes, it is caused by eating bad food
options.hg: Haan, yeh kharaab khaane se hota hai

options.en: No, it shows the body is growing up healthily
options.hg: Nahi, yeh dikhata hai ki body theek se bade ho rahi hai

explain.en: Periods are a normal, healthy part of growing up for most girls. They show that the body is working as it should, not that anything is wrong.
explain.hg: Periods zyada-tar girls ke liye bade hone ka normal, healthy hissa hain. Yeh dikhate hain ki body sahi kaam kar rahi hai, koi gadbad nahi.

q.en: Your mother says she has her period and feels tired today. What is a kind thing to do?
q.hg: Mummy kehti hain ki unka period chal raha hai aur aaj thakaan hai. Kya karna achha rahega?

options.en: Tell her she must not touch anything
options.hg: Bolo ki woh kuch bhi na chhuyen

options.en: Stay away from her until it is over
options.hg: Period khatam hone tak unse door raho

options.en: Offer help, like bringing water or a hot bag
options.hg: Help offer karo, jaise paani ya garam bottle laana

options.en: Laugh and tell your friends about it
options.hg: Haso aur doston ko bata do

explain.en: Periods can bring tiredness and cramps. Small kindnesses, like bringing water or a hot water bottle, help. A period does not make anyone dirty, so there is no need to avoid her.
explain.hg: Periods mein thakaan aur dard ho sakta hai. Chhoti si help, jaise paani ya hot water bottle laana, kaam aati hai. Period se koi ganda nahi hota, isliye unse door rehne ki zaroorat nahi.

q.en: Who gets periods?
q.hg: Periods kisko aate hain?

options.en: Only grown-up women above 30
options.hg: Sirf 30 se upar ki auraton ko

options.en: Most girls and women, starting around puberty
options.hg: Zyada-tar girls aur women ko, puberty ke aas-paas se

options.en: Every person, including all boys
options.hg: Har insaan ko, sab boys ko bhi

options.en: Only women who are married
options.hg: Sirf shaadishuda auraton ko

explain.en: Most girls get their first period during puberty, often between 10 and 15, and periods continue for many years. Marriage has nothing to do with it. Boys do not have periods but can learn about them.
explain.hg: Zyada-tar girls ko pehla period puberty mein aata hai, aksar 10 se 15 ke beech, aur periods kai saal chalte hain. Shaadi se iska koi lena-dena nahi. Boys ko periods nahi aate, par woh inke baare mein seekh sakte hain.

q.en: Can a girl on her period go to school and play games?
q.hg: Kya period mein girl school ja sakti hai aur khel sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, she can do everything as usual
options.hg: Haan, woh sab kuch normal kar sakti hai

options.en: No, she must stay at home
options.hg: Nahi, use ghar pe rehna chahiye

options.en: She can go but must not run
options.hg: Ja sakti hai par bhaag nahi sakti

options.en: Only if nobody finds out
options.hg: Sirf agar kisi ko pata na chale

explain.en: A period is no reason to miss school, sport, dance or play. Moving around can even ease cramps. With a pad and a spare in the bag, she can carry on as usual.
explain.hg: Period ki wajah se school, sports, dance ya khel chhodne ki zaroorat nahi. Chalne-phirne se dard bhi kam ho sakta hai. Pad aur bag mein ek extra ho, toh sab normal chal sakta hai.

q.en: What is a sanitary pad used for?
q.hg: Sanitary pad kis kaam aata hai?

options.en: To cover a cut on the knee
options.hg: Ghutne ki chot dhakne ke liye

options.en: To keep underwear warm
options.hg: Underwear garam rakhne ke liye

options.en: To wipe the face clean
options.hg: Chehra saaf karne ke liye

options.en: To soak up period blood
options.hg: Period ka blood sokhne ke liye

explain.en: A pad sticks inside the underwear and soaks up period blood. Seeing pads at home or in a shop is normal, and children can ask what they are for.
explain.hg: Pad underwear ke andar chipakta hai aur period ka blood sokh leta hai. Ghar pe ya dukaan mein pads dikhna normal hai, aur bachche pooch sakte hain ki yeh kis kaam aata hai.

q.en: Is it okay for boys to learn about periods?
q.hg: Kya boys ka periods ke baare mein seekhna theek hai?

options.en: Only after they get married
options.hg: Sirf shaadi ke baad

options.en: Only if they want to be doctors
options.hg: Sirf agar doctor banna ho

options.en: Yes, so they understand and can be kind
options.hg: Haan, taaki woh samjhen aur madad kar sakein

options.en: No, it is a secret only for girls
options.hg: Nahi, yeh sirf girls ka secret hai

explain.en: Periods affect mothers, sisters, friends and classmates. Boys who understand them can help, stop teasing and make periods easier for everyone at home and school.
explain.hg: Periods mummy, behen, dost aur classmates sabki zindagi ka hissa hain. Jo boys inhe samajhte hain, woh help kar sakte hain, chidhana rok sakte hain aur ghar aur school mein sabke liye periods aasaan bana sakte hain.

q.en: About how often does a period usually come?
q.hg: Period aam taur pe kitne time mein aata hai?

options.en: Once every week
options.hg: Har hafte ek baar

options.en: Roughly once a month, though gaps vary
options.hg: Lagbhag mahine mein ek baar, gap alag ho sakta hai

options.en: Once a year, on the birthday
options.hg: Saal mein ek baar, birthday pe

options.en: Every day for a few hours
options.hg: Roz kuch ghante ke liye

explain.en: Periods come roughly once a month, but the gap varies. In the first years after the first period it can be anywhere from 21 to 45 days, and a month may even be skipped.
explain.hg: Periods lagbhag mahine mein ek baar aate hain, par gap alag hota hai. Pehle period ke baad shuru ke saalon mein yeh 21 se 45 din tak kuch bhi ho sakta hai, aur kabhi ek mahina skip bhi ho jaata hai.

q.en: Which change often shows up a few months before a girl's first period?
q.hg: Girl ke pehle period se kuch mahine pehle aksar kya badlaav dikhta hai?

options.en: White or clear discharge in her underwear
options.hg: Underwear mein safed ya saaf discharge

options.en: Her voice becoming much deeper
options.hg: Awaaz ka bahut bhaari ho jaana

options.en: Her hair starting to fall out
options.hg: Baal jhadna shuru ho jaana

options.en: Her nails turning yellow
options.hg: Naakhun peele pad jaana

explain.en: Many girls notice a clear or white discharge for months before the first period. It is the vagina cleaning itself and a sign that the first period is on its way.
explain.hg: Kai girls ko pehle period se mahinon pehle saaf ya safed discharge dikhta hai. Yeh vagina khud ko saaf kar rahi hoti hai aur sign hai ki pehla period aane wala hai.

q.en: The first period usually comes about how long after breasts start to develop?
q.hg: Breasts badhna shuru hone ke lagbhag kitne time baad pehla period aata hai?

options.en: About two weeks
options.hg: Lagbhag do hafte

options.en: About ten years
options.hg: Lagbhag das saal

options.en: On the very same day
options.hg: Bilkul usi din

options.en: About two years
options.hg: Lagbhag do saal

explain.en: The first period usually arrives around two years after breast buds appear. That is a good time to keep a pad in the school bag and to talk to a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Pehla period aam taur pe breast buds aane ke lagbhag do saal baad aata hai. Tab se school bag mein pad rakhna aur kisi trusted bade se baat karna achha rehta hai.

q.en: Your period starts during class and you have no pad. What can you do?
q.hg: Class ke beech period shuru ho jaata hai aur tumhare paas pad nahi hai. Kya kar sakti ho?

options.en: Leave school without telling anyone
options.hg: Kisi ko bataye bina school se chali jao

options.en: Use paper and ignore it all day
options.hg: Kaagaz laga lo aur din bhar ignore karo

options.en: Ask a teacher, friend or the school office
options.hg: Teacher, dost ya school office se maango

options.en: Sit silently until school ends
options.hg: School khatam hone tak chup-chaap baithi raho

explain.en: Teachers and school offices are used to this and often keep pads. Asking is normal; everyone who has periods has been surprised by one at some point.
explain.hg: Teachers aur school office ke liye yeh aam baat hai, aur aksar unke paas pads hote hain. Maangna normal hai; jinhe periods aate hain, sabke saath kabhi na kabhi aisa hua hai.

q.en: What is useful to keep in a small period kit in your school bag?
q.hg: School bag ke chhote period kit mein kya rakhna useful hai?

options.en: A spare pair of school shoes
options.hg: School shoes ka extra joda

options.en: Two pads, spare underwear and a paper bag
options.hg: Do pads, extra underwear aur ek paper bag

options.en: Perfume and talcum powder
options.hg: Perfume aur talcum powder

options.en: Painkillers and nothing else
options.hg: Sirf painkillers, aur kuch nahi

explain.en: Two pads, spare underwear and a paper bag for disposal cover most surprises. Perfume and powder are not needed and can irritate the skin.
explain.hg: Do pads, extra underwear aur disposal ke liye paper bag zyada-tar surprises sambhaal lete hain. Perfume aur powder ki zaroorat nahi, aur yeh skin ko irritate kar sakte hain.

q.en: How often should a pad usually be changed?
q.hg: Pad aam taur pe kitni der mein badalna chahiye?

options.en: About every 4 to 6 hours
options.hg: Lagbhag har 4 se 6 ghante mein

options.en: Only when it is completely full
options.hg: Sirf jab poora bhar jaaye

options.en: Once a day, before bed
options.hg: Din mein ek baar, sone se pehle

options.en: Every 30 minutes
options.hg: Har 30 minute mein

explain.en: Change a pad about every 4 to 6 hours, or sooner if it feels wet or heavy, even on light days. A longer pad can be used overnight.
explain.hg: Pad lagbhag har 4 se 6 ghante mein badlo, ya geela ya bhaari lage toh pehle, halke dinon mein bhi. Raat ke liye lamba pad use kar sakte ho.

q.en: How should a used disposable pad be thrown away?
q.hg: Use kiya hua disposable pad kaise phenkna chahiye?

options.en: Flush it down the toilet
options.hg: Toilet mein flush kar do

options.en: Throw it out of the window
options.hg: Khidki se bahar phenk do

options.en: Leave it in a corner of the washroom
options.hg: Washroom ke kone mein chhod do

options.en: Wrap it in paper and put it in a dustbin
options.hg: Kaagaz mein lapet ke dustbin mein daalo

explain.en: Wrap the used pad in its wrapper or paper and put it in a dustbin. Never flush it, because pads block toilets and drains.
explain.hg: Use kiya pad uske wrapper ya kaagaz mein lapeto aur dustbin mein daalo. Kabhi flush mat karo, kyunki pads toilet aur naali band kar dete hain.

q.en: In the school washroom there is no dustbin for used pads. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: School washroom mein used pads ke liye dustbin nahi hai. Sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Leave it behind the toilet
options.hg: Toilet ke peeche chhod do

options.en: Stop changing pads at school
options.hg: School mein pad badalna hi band kar do

options.en: Wrap it, carry it to a bin, and tell a teacher
options.hg: Lapet ke bin tak le jao, aur teacher ko batao

options.en: Flush it, since there is no other option
options.hg: Flush kar do, aur koi option nahi hai

explain.en: Wrapping the pad and carrying it in a paper bag to the nearest bin keeps things clean. Telling a teacher helps the school fix the problem; schools are expected to provide safe disposal.
explain.hg: Pad lapet ke paper bag mein sabse paas ke bin tak le jaana safai rakhta hai. Teacher ko batane se school problem theek kar sakta hai; schools se safe disposal ki ummeed ki jaati hai.

q.en: Is it safe to bathe and wash your hair during a period?
q.hg: Kya period mein nahana aur baal dhona safe hai?

options.en: Only after the third day
options.hg: Sirf teesre din ke baad

options.en: Yes, and warm water can ease cramps
options.hg: Haan, aur garam paani se dard kam ho sakta hai

options.en: No, it stops the flow and is harmful
options.hg: Nahi, isse flow ruk jaata hai aur nuksaan hota hai

options.en: No, washing hair causes a cold
options.hg: Nahi, baal dhone se sardi lag jaati hai

explain.en: Bathing daily, including washing hair, is healthy during a period. It keeps you fresh and warm water can relax cramping muscles. It does not stop or increase the flow.
explain.hg: Period mein roz nahana, baal dhona bhi, healthy hai. Isse freshness rehti hai aur garam paani dard wali muscles ko relax karta hai. Isse flow na rukta hai na badhta hai.

q.en: Your aunt says you must not touch the pickle jar during your period because the pickle will spoil. What is true?
q.hg: Aunty kehti hain ki period mein achaar ka martbaan mat chhoona, achaar kharaab ho jaayega. Kya sach hai?

options.en: A period cannot spoil food in any way
options.hg: Period kisi bhi tarah khaana kharaab nahi kar sakta

options.en: Pickles do rot if touched on those days
