options.hg: Un dinon chhoone se achaar sach mein sadta hai

options.en: Only sour foods are affected
options.hg: Sirf khatti cheezon pe asar hota hai

options.en: It is true only on the first day
options.hg: Yeh sirf pehle din sach hai

explain.en: Menstrual blood is ordinary blood and tissue, and a person on their period is not impure. Food spoils from germs or moisture, not from being touched by someone having a period.
explain.hg: Period ka blood aam blood aur tissue hai, aur period wali insaan apavitra nahi hoti. Khaana germs ya nami se kharaab hota hai, kisi ke period mein chhoone se nahi.

q.en: What colour can healthy period blood be?
q.hg: Healthy period blood kis rang ka ho sakta hai?

options.en: Only bright red, nothing else
options.hg: Sirf chamkeela laal, aur kuch nahi

options.en: Brown always means an infection
options.hg: Bhoora matlab hamesha infection

options.en: Dark red means a serious disease
options.hg: Gehra laal matlab gambhir beemari

options.en: Bright red, dark red or brown
options.hg: Chamkeela laal, gehra laal ya bhoora

explain.en: Period blood can be bright red, dark red or brown. Brown spotting at the start or end is just older blood that took longer to leave the body.
explain.hg: Period ka blood chamkeela laal, gehra laal ya bhoora ho sakta hai. Shuru ya aakhir mein bhoore dhabbe bas purana blood hai jo bahar aane mein zyada time leta hai.

q.en: In total, how much blood is usually lost during one period?
q.hg: Ek period mein kul milaake aam taur pe kitna blood jaata hai?

options.en: About two full glasses
options.hg: Lagbhag do bhare glass

options.en: Half the blood in the body
options.hg: Body ka aadha blood

options.en: Only a few tablespoons
options.hg: Bas kuch chammach

options.en: About one litre
options.hg: Lagbhag ek litre

explain.en: The total is usually only a few tablespoons, even though it can look like more on a pad. Soaking a pad every one to two hours is heavier than normal and worth a doctor's check.
explain.hg: Kul milaake aksar bas kuch chammach blood jaata hai, chahe pad pe zyada dikhe. Agar har ek-do ghante mein pad bhar jaaye, toh yeh normal se zyada hai aur doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

q.en: Kavya, 12, got her first period three months ago and has not had another since. What is most likely?
q.hg: Kavya, 12, ka pehla period teen mahine pehle aaya tha aur tab se doosra nahi aaya. Sabse zyada kya sambhav hai?

options.en: Her first period was not a real one
options.hg: Uska pehla period asli nahi tha

options.en: Cycles are often irregular in the first years
options.hg: Shuru ke saalon mein cycles aksar irregular hoti hain

options.en: Her periods have stopped for ever
options.hg: Uske periods hamesha ke liye band ho gaye

options.en: She has a serious illness
options.hg: Use koi gambhir beemari hai

explain.en: Hormone signals take time to settle, so gaps of 21 to 45 days, and even a skipped month, are common early on. She can note dates and talk to a trusted adult or doctor if long gaps keep happening.
explain.hg: Hormones ke signal settle hone mein time lagta hai, isliye shuru mein 21 se 45 din ka gap, ya ek mahina skip hona, common hai. Woh dates note kar sakti hai, aur lambe gap baar-baar hon toh trusted bade ya doctor se baat kare.

q.en: A friend says scented pads and perfumed washes keep you cleaner during periods. What is true?
q.hg: Ek dost kehti hai ki khushbu wale pads aur perfumed wash periods mein zyada saaf rakhte hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Changing on time keeps you clean, not perfume
options.hg: Time pe badalna saaf rakhta hai, khushbu nahi

options.en: Scented pads kill all germs
options.hg: Khushbu wale pads saare germs maar dete hain

options.en: Perfumed washes should be used inside
options.hg: Perfumed wash andar use karna chahiye

options.en: Pricier pads are always more hygienic
options.hg: Mehenge pads hamesha zyada hygienic hote hain

explain.en: Hygiene comes from clean hands and changing products on time, not price or perfume. Fragrances can cause itching and rashes, and only the outside, the vulva, needs gentle washing with water.
explain.hg: Safai saaf haathon aur time pe product badalne se hoti hai, price ya khushbu se nahi. Fragrance se khujli aur rash ho sakte hain, aur sirf bahar ka hissa, vulva, paani se halke se dhona kaafi hai.

q.en: Your sister asks you to pick up a pack of pads from the chemist. What do you do?
q.hg: Tumhari behen kehti hai chemist se pads ka packet le aao. Tum kya karoge?

options.en: Refuse because it is embarrassing
options.hg: Mana kar do kyunki sharam aati hai

options.en: Tell her to go and get them herself
options.hg: Bolo khud jaake le aaye

options.en: Buy them but tell your friends
options.hg: Le aao par doston ko bata do

options.en: Buy them like any other item, no fuss
options.hg: Kisi aur cheez ki tarah le aao, bina drama

explain.en: Pads are an everyday health product, like toothpaste. Brothers, fathers and friends buying them without fuss helps make periods a normal topic at home.
explain.hg: Pads toothpaste ki tarah roz ki health ki cheez hain. Bhai, papa aur dost bina drama ke laayen, toh ghar mein periods normal topic ban jaata hai.

q.en: In class, a boy notices a period stain on a classmate's skirt and others start laughing. What is the right thing to do?
q.hg: Class mein ek boy ek classmate ki skirt pe period ka daag dekhta hai aur baaki hasne lagte hain. Sahi kya hai?

options.en: Take a photo to show the group
options.hg: Group ko dikhane ke liye photo le

options.en: Announce it loudly so she knows
options.hg: Zor se bol de taaki use pata chale

options.en: Quietly tell her and ask others to stop
options.hg: Chupke se use batao aur baakiyon ko rokne ko kaho

options.en: Laugh along so he fits in
options.hg: Saath mein has de taaki group mein rahe

explain.en: Leaks happen to almost everyone who has periods. Telling her quietly, offering a sweater to tie around her waist and stopping the laughter is simple kindness. Photos would be cruel and wrong.
explain.hg: Jinhe periods aate hain, unme se lagbhag sabke saath kabhi leak hota hai. Chupke se batana, kamar pe baandhne ke liye sweater dena aur hasi rokna simple kindness hai. Photo lena cruel aur galat hoga.

q.en: A period stain on clothes comes out best with which water?
q.hg: Kapdon pe period ka daag kis paani se sabse achha nikalta hai?

options.en: No water, just a dry cloth
options.hg: Paani nahi, bas sookha kapda

options.en: Cold water
options.hg: Thanda paani

options.en: Very hot water
options.hg: Bahut garam paani

options.en: Boiling salty water
options.hg: Ubalta namak wala paani

explain.en: Rinse blood stains in cold water as soon as you can. Hot water can set the stain into the fabric and make it harder to remove.
explain.hg: Blood ka daag jitna jaldi ho sake thande paani mein dho do. Garam paani daag ko kapde mein pakka kar deta hai aur nikalna mushkil ho jaata hai.

q.en: What does gentle movement, like walking or stretching, do for many people's period cramps?
q.hg: Halki movement, jaise walk ya stretching, kai logon ke period cramps pe kya asar karti hai?

options.en: It often eases them
options.hg: Aksar dard kam karti hai

options.en: It always makes them worse
options.hg: Hamesha dard badhati hai

options.en: It stops the period early
options.hg: Period jaldi rok deti hai

options.en: It causes heavy bleeding
options.hg: Zyada bleeding karwati hai

explain.en: Gentle movement increases blood flow and often eases cramps, although resting is fine too when you need it. Sport and exercise are safe during a period.
explain.hg: Halki movement se blood flow badhta hai aur aksar cramps kam hote hain, par zaroorat ho toh aaraam karna bhi theek hai. Period mein sports aur exercise safe hain.

q.en: What is a simple thing that helps period cramps?
q.hg: Period cramps mein kya simple cheez help karti hai?

options.en: Drinking no water at all that day
options.hg: Us din bilkul paani na peena

options.en: Skipping meals until it passes
options.hg: Theek hone tak khaana chhodna

options.en: Tying a tight belt around the waist
options.hg: Kamar pe tight belt baandhna

options.en: A hot water bottle on the lower belly
options.hg: Pet ke neeche hot water bottle

explain.en: Heat relaxes the uterus muscle, so a hot water bottle or warm bath helps. Drinking water, eating regular meals and gentle movement help too.
explain.hg: Garmi uterus ki muscle ko relax karti hai, isliye hot water bottle ya garam paani se nahana help karta hai. Paani peena, time pe khaana aur halki movement bhi help karte hain.

q.en: Ananya, 11, gets her first period while her mother is away, and only her father is home. What is the best thing for him to do?
q.hg: Ananya, 11, ka pehla period tab aata hai jab mummy bahar hain aur ghar pe sirf papa hain. Papa ke liye sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Keep her home from school for a week
options.hg: Hafte bhar school se ghar pe rakhen

options.en: Say that fathers cannot discuss such things
options.hg: Bolen ki papa aisi baatein nahi kar sakte

options.en: Stay calm, get pads, help or call someone she trusts
options.hg: Shaant rahen, pads laayen, help karen ya trusted insaan ko bulayen

options.en: Tell her to wait until her mother is back
options.hg: Bolen ki mummy ke aane tak wait kare

explain.en: A calm father can buy pads, explain how they stick to underwear, or call a woman relative or teacher she trusts. What matters is that she does not feel scared, ashamed or alone.
explain.hg: Shaant papa pads la sakte hain, bata sakte hain ki underwear pe kaise lagta hai, ya kisi trusted mahila rishtedaar ya teacher ko bula sakte hain. Zaroori yeh hai ki woh dari, sharminda ya akeli mehsoos na kare.

q.en: A relative says that once a girl gets her period she has 'become a woman' and is ready for marriage. What is true?
q.hg: Ek rishtedaar kehte hain ki period aate hi girl 'aurat ban gayi' aur shaadi ke liye tayyar hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: She no longer needs to go to school
options.hg: Ab use school jaane ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: She is still a child whose body keeps growing
options.hg: Woh abhi bhi bachchi hai jiski body badh rahi hai

options.en: Her body has finished all its growing
options.hg: Uski body ka badhna poora ho gaya

options.en: She can now legally be married
options.hg: Ab uski legally shaadi ho sakti hai

explain.en: A first period only means the reproductive system has started to mature. Her body, brain and emotions keep growing for years, and in India the legal age of marriage for women is 18.
explain.hg: Pehle period ka matlab bas itna hai ki reproductive system mature hona shuru hua hai. Uski body, dimaag aur emotions saalon tak badhte rahenge, aur India mein auraton ki shaadi ki legal umar 18 hai.

q.en: Are reusable cloth pads safe to use?
q.hg: Kya reusable cloth pads use karna safe hai?

options.en: Yes, if washed with soap and sun-dried fully
options.hg: Haan, agar sabun se dhoye aur dhoop mein poore sukhaye jaayen

options.en: No, cloth always causes infections
options.hg: Nahi, kapde se hamesha infection hota hai

options.en: Yes, and they never need washing
options.hg: Haan, aur inhe dhone ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: Only if dried in a dark cupboard
options.hg: Sirf agar andhere almirah mein sukhaye jaayen

explain.en: Cloth pads are a fine choice when washed with soap and water and dried completely, ideally in sunlight, before the next use. Damp or hidden cloth is what causes problems.
explain.hg: Cloth pads achha option hain agar sabun-paani se dhoye jaayen aur agle use se pehle poore sukhaye jaayen, behtar ho dhoop mein. Problem geele ya chhupa ke sukhaye kapde se hoti hai.

q.en: Your aunt dries her cloth pads hidden under other clothes so that nobody sees them. What is the problem?
q.hg: Aunty apne cloth pads doosre kapdon ke neeche chhupa ke sukhati hain taaki koi dekhe na. Isme problem kya hai?

options.en: Sunlight makes cloth pads unsafe
options.hg: Dhoop se cloth pads unsafe ho jaate hain

options.en: Other clothes will catch the period
options.hg: Doosre kapdon ko 'period lag jaayega'

options.en: There is no problem with it at all
options.hg: Isme koi problem nahi hai

options.en: They may stay damp and grow germs
options.hg: Woh geele reh sakte hain aur germs badh sakte hain

explain.en: Pads dried in hiding often stay damp, and germs grow in damp cloth, which can cause itching and infections. Drying them fully in the sun is safer, and there is nothing shameful in that.
explain.hg: Chhupa ke sukhaye pads aksar geele reh jaate hain, aur geele kapde mein germs badhte hain, jisse khujli aur infection ho sakta hai. Dhoop mein poora sukhana safe hai, aur isme sharam ki koi baat nahi.

q.en: Where can low-cost sanitary pads be found in many parts of India?
q.hg: India ke kai hisson mein sasti sanitary pads kahan mil sakti hain?

options.en: Only on foreign websites
options.hg: Sirf videshi websites pe

options.en: Only with a doctor's prescription
options.hg: Sirf doctor ke prescription se

options.en: Jan Aushadhi stores and ASHA workers
options.hg: Jan Aushadhi stores aur ASHA workers ke paas

options.en: Only in big shopping malls
options.hg: Sirf bade shopping malls mein

explain.en: Low-cost pads are sold at Jan Aushadhi stores and supplied through ASHA workers in many areas. Pads never need a prescription.
explain.hg: Kai jagah Jan Aushadhi stores pe sasti pads milti hain aur ASHA workers ke zariye bhi milti hain. Pads ke liye kabhi prescription nahi chahiye.

q.en: Why should you wash your hands before and after changing a pad?
q.hg: Pad badalne se pehle aur baad mein haath kyun dhone chahiye?

options.en: It is only needed on the first day
options.hg: Yeh sirf pehle din zaroori hai

options.en: To keep germs away from you and others
options.hg: Taaki germs tumse aur doosron se door rahen

options.en: Because period blood is poisonous
options.hg: Kyunki period ka blood zehreela hota hai

options.en: Because the pad will not stick otherwise
options.hg: Warna pad chipkega nahi

explain.en: Clean hands keep germs away from the sensitive genital area and stop germs spreading afterwards. Period blood is not poisonous; this is ordinary hygiene, like before eating.
explain.hg: Saaf haath germs ko naazuk genital area se door rakhte hain aur baad mein germs failne se rokte hain. Period ka blood zehreela nahi hai; yeh khaane se pehle haath dhone jaisi normal safai hai.

q.en: Is a slight smell during a period normal?
q.hg: Kya period ke dauraan halki smell normal hai?

options.en: Yes, and changing pads on time keeps it mild
options.hg: Haan, aur time pe pad badalne se halki rehti hai

options.en: No, any smell means an infection
options.hg: Nahi, koi bhi smell matlab infection

options.en: Yes, and everyone nearby can notice it
options.hg: Haan, aur aas-paas sabko pata chal jaata hai

options.en: No, only unwashed girls have a smell
options.hg: Nahi, smell sirf na nahaane wali girls ko hoti hai

explain.en: A slight smell is normal and others usually cannot notice it. Changing on time and daily bathing keep it mild. A strong, fishy or unusual smell with itching is worth checking.
explain.hg: Halki smell normal hai aur doosron ko aam taur pe pata nahi chalti. Time pe badalna aur roz nahana ise halka rakhta hai. Tez, machhli jaisi ya ajeeb smell ke saath khujli ho toh check karwao.

q.en: What works best for a heavy flow at night?
q.hg: Raat mein heavy flow ke liye kya sabse achha kaam karta hai?

options.en: Two pads stuck one on top of the other
options.hg: Do pads ek ke upar ek chipka ke

options.en: Old newspaper under the sheet
options.hg: Chaadar ke neeche purana akhbaar

options.en: Not sleeping until the flow eases
options.hg: Flow kam hone tak na sona

options.en: A longer or overnight pad
options.hg: Lamba ya overnight pad

explain.en: Longer, overnight pads are made to cover more area while lying down. Stacking pads does not absorb better and can be uncomfortable.
explain.hg: Lambe overnight pads letne ki position mein zyada area cover karne ke liye bane hain. Ek ke upar ek pad lagane se zyada sokh nahi hota aur uncomfortable ho sakta hai.

q.en: Your younger sister, 12, has just got her first period and is scared something is wrong. What helps most?
q.hg: Tumhari chhoti behen, 12, ka pehla period abhi aaya hai aur woh darti hai ki kuch gadbad hai. Sabse zyada kya help karega?

options.en: Laugh and tell her she is overreacting
options.hg: Haso aur bolo ki woh overreact kar rahi hai

options.en: Tell her she cannot play outside any more
options.hg: Bolo ki ab woh bahar nahi khel sakti

options.en: Calmly tell her it is normal and help her get pads
options.hg: Shaanti se batao ki yeh normal hai aur pads dilao

options.en: Tell her to keep it a secret from everyone
options.hg: Bolo ki sabse secret rakhe

explain.en: Hearing that periods are normal from someone calm makes a huge difference. Helping her find pads and a trusted adult to talk to is the kindest response, whether you are a brother or a sister.
explain.hg: Kisi shaant insaan se sunna ki periods normal hain, bahut farak laata hai. Pads dhoondhne mein aur kisi trusted bade se baat karwane mein help karna sabse achha hai, chahe tum bhai ho ya behen.

q.en: A girl feels more tired, cranky and hungry a few days before her period. What is most likely?
q.hg: Ek girl ko period se kuch din pehle zyada thakaan, chidchidapan aur bhookh lagti hai. Sabse zyada kya sambhav hai?

options.en: She is not eating enough sweets
options.hg: Woh kaafi meetha nahi kha rahi

options.en: Normal hormone changes before a period
options.hg: Period se pehle hormones ke normal badlaav

options.en: She is pretending to avoid work
options.hg: Woh kaam se bachne ka naatak kar rahi hai

options.en: She has a stomach infection
options.hg: Use pet ka infection hai

explain.en: Hormones shift after ovulation, and many people notice tiredness, cravings, bloating or mood changes before a period. This is called PMS, and it eases a few days after bleeding starts.
explain.hg: Ovulation ke baad hormones badalte hain, aur kai logon ko period se pehle thakaan, cravings, pet phoolna ya mood change hota hai. Ise PMS kehte hain, aur bleeding shuru hone ke kuch din baad yeh kam ho jaata hai.

q.en: Can you eat curd, lemon or other sour foods during a period?
q.hg: Kya period mein dahi, nimbu ya khatti cheezen kha sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, no food needs to be avoided
options.hg: Haan, koi khaana avoid karne ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: No, sour foods increase bleeding
options.hg: Nahi, khatti cheezen bleeding badhati hain

options.en: No, curd stops the period
options.hg: Nahi, dahi period rok deta hai

options.en: Only after the period is over
options.hg: Sirf period khatam hone ke baad

explain.en: There is no medical reason to avoid curd, lemon, pickle or any other food during a period. A balanced diet with iron-rich foods and enough water is what helps.
explain.hg: Period mein dahi, nimbu, achaar ya koi bhi khaana avoid karne ki koi medical wajah nahi hai. Iron wala balanced khaana aur kaafi paani hi help karta hai.

q.en: Period blood leaves the body through which opening?
q.hg: Period ka blood body ke kis opening se bahar aata hai?

options.en: The urethra, with urine
options.hg: Urethra, susu ke saath

options.en: The anus
options.hg: Anus

options.en: The navel
options.hg: Navel (naabhi)

options.en: The vagina
options.hg: Vagina

explain.en: Period blood flows from the uterus out through the vagina. Urine leaves through the urethra, a separate small opening just in front, so you can pee normally during a period.
explain.hg: Period ka blood uterus se vagina ke raaste bahar aata hai. Susu urethra se nikalti hai, jo aage ek alag chhota opening hai, isliye period mein bhi normal susu kar sakte ho.

q.en: When counting a menstrual cycle, which day is 'Day 1'?
q.hg: Menstrual cycle ginte waqt 'Day 1' kaunsa din hota hai?

options.en: The day of ovulation
options.hg: Ovulation ka din

options.en: The 1st of every month
options.hg: Har mahine ki 1 tareekh

options.en: The first day of bleeding
options.hg: Bleeding ka pehla din

options.en: The last day of bleeding
options.hg: Bleeding ka aakhri din

explain.en: A cycle runs from the first day of bleeding to the day before the next period starts. Noting each Day 1 shows your cycle length over a few months.
explain.hg: Cycle bleeding ke pehle din se agle period ke ek din pehle tak chalti hai. Har Day 1 note karne se kuch mahinon mein apni cycle ki length pata chalti hai.

q.en: What is a typical cycle length for adults?
q.hg: Adults mein cycle ki typical length kitni hoti hai?

options.en: Between 50 and 60 days
options.hg: 50 se 60 din ke beech

options.en: Anywhere from 21 to 35 days
options.hg: 21 se 35 din ke beech kuch bhi

options.en: Exactly 28 days for everyone
options.hg: Sabki bilkul 28 din

options.en: Between 10 and 14 days
options.hg: 10 se 14 din ke beech

explain.en: Twenty-eight days is only a textbook average. Healthy adult cycles range from 21 to 35 days, and in the first years after the first period, 21 to 45 days is common.
explain.hg: 28 din bas textbook ka average hai. Healthy adult cycles 21 se 35 din ki hoti hain, aur pehle period ke baad shuru ke saalon mein 21 se 45 din common hai.

q.en: What does the hormone FSH do at the start of a cycle?
q.hg: Cycle ki shuruaat mein FSH hormone kya karta hai?

options.en: Tells the ovaries to ripen egg follicles
options.hg: Ovaries ko egg follicles pakane ka signal deta hai

options.en: Makes the uterus lining break down
options.hg: Uterus ki lining tod deta hai

options.en: Causes the cramps on the first day
options.hg: Pehle din ke cramps paida karta hai

options.en: Starts the making of breast milk
options.hg: Breast milk banana shuru karta hai

explain.en: The pituitary gland releases FSH, follicle-stimulating hormone, which tells the ovaries to ripen a few egg-containing follicles. These follicles make oestrogen, which rebuilds the uterus lining.
explain.hg: Pituitary gland FSH (follicle-stimulating hormone) chhodti hai, jo ovaries ko kuch egg wale follicles pakane ko kehta hai. Yeh follicles oestrogen banate hain, jo uterus ki lining dobara banata hai.

q.en: After ovulation, which hormone keeps the uterus lining thick and ready?
q.hg: Ovulation ke baad kaunsa hormone uterus ki lining ko mota aur tayyar rakhta hai?

options.en: Testosterone
options.hg: Testosterone

options.en: Insulin
options.hg: Insulin

options.en: Adrenaline
options.hg: Adrenaline

options.en: Progesterone
options.hg: Progesterone

explain.en: After ovulation, the empty follicle becomes the corpus luteum and makes progesterone, which keeps the lining stable. If there is no pregnancy, progesterone falls and the lining sheds as a period.
explain.hg: Ovulation ke baad khaali follicle corpus luteum ban jaata hai aur progesterone banata hai, jo lining ko stable rakhta hai. Pregnancy na ho toh progesterone girta hai aur lining period ban ke nikalti hai.

q.en: When cycles vary in length from month to month, which part of the cycle usually changes the most?
q.hg: Jab cycle ki length har mahine badalti hai, toh cycle ka kaunsa hissa aksar sabse zyada badalta hai?

options.en: The days of bleeding only
options.hg: Sirf bleeding ke din

options.en: No part ever changes
options.hg: Koi hissa kabhi nahi badalta

options.en: The part before ovulation
options.hg: Ovulation se pehle wala hissa

options.en: The part after ovulation
options.hg: Ovulation ke baad wala hissa

explain.en: The phase after ovulation is fairly steady at about two weeks. Most variation comes from the phase before ovulation, which is why ovulation day shifts and cannot be predicted by a calendar.
explain.hg: Ovulation ke baad wala phase kaafi steady rehta hai, lagbhag do hafte. Zyada-tar badlaav ovulation se pehle wale phase mein hota hai, isliye ovulation ka din khisakta hai aur calendar se pakka nahi bataya ja sakta.

q.en: Clear, slippery, stretchy discharge, a bit like raw egg white, often appears when?
q.hg: Saaf, chikna, khinchne wala discharge, kachche ande ki safedi jaisa, aksar kab dikhta hai?

options.en: Only on the first day of bleeding
options.hg: Sirf bleeding ke pehle din

options.en: Around ovulation
options.hg: Ovulation ke aas-paas

options.en: Only during an illness
options.hg: Sirf beemari ke time

options.en: Only after the age of 30
options.hg: Sirf 30 ki umar ke baad

explain.en: Discharge changes through the cycle. Around ovulation it often becomes clear, slippery and stretchy; after ovulation it becomes thicker and creamier. These changes are normal.
explain.hg: Discharge cycle ke saath badalta hai. Ovulation ke aas-paas yeh aksar saaf, chikna aur khinchne wala hota hai; ovulation ke baad gaadha aur creamy ho jaata hai. Yeh badlaav normal hain.

q.en: Can a period-tracking app tell you exactly which days pregnancy is impossible?
q.hg: Kya period-tracking app bata sakta hai ki kaunse din pregnancy bilkul nahi ho sakti?

options.en: No, apps only estimate and ovulation shifts
options.hg: Nahi, apps bas andaza lagate hain aur ovulation khisakta hai

options.en: Yes, if you enter dates for three months
options.hg: Haan, agar teen mahine ki dates daalo

options.en: Yes, the green days are always safe
options.hg: Haan, hare din hamesha safe hote hain

options.en: Yes, but only for teenagers
options.hg: Haan, par sirf teenagers ke liye

explain.en: Apps estimate from past dates, but ovulation moves from cycle to cycle and sperm can survive for several days. Tracking is useful for health, but 'safe days' are not reliable contraception.
explain.hg: Apps purani dates se andaza lagate hain, par ovulation har cycle mein khisakta hai aur sperm kai din zinda reh sakte hain. Tracking health ke liye useful hai, par 'safe days' bharosemand contraception nahi hain.

q.en: What is the main benefit of tracking your periods?
q.hg: Periods track karne ka sabse bada faayda kya hai?

options.en: Finding days when pregnancy cannot happen
options.hg: Woh din dhoondhna jab pregnancy nahi ho sakti

options.en: Making your cycle exactly regular
options.hg: Cycle ko bilkul regular bana dena

options.en: Meeting a rule set by the school
options.hg: School ka koi rule poora karna

options.en: Knowing your pattern and telling a doctor
options.hg: Apna pattern jaanna aur doctor ko batana

explain.en: Noting the first day, how long bleeding lasts, pain and mood shows your pattern, helps you carry pads on time and gives a doctor real information if something changes.
explain.hg: Pehla din, bleeding kitne din chali, dard aur mood note karne se tumhara pattern dikhta hai, time pe pad saath rakhne mein help hoti hai, aur kuch badle toh doctor ko sahi jaankari milti hai.

q.en: What is PMS?
q.hg: PMS kya hai?

options.en: A sure sign that someone is pregnant
options.hg: Pregnancy ka pakka sign

options.en: An infection caused by using pads
options.hg: Pads use karne se hone wala infection

options.en: Body and mood changes in the days before a period
options.hg: Period se pehle ke dinon mein body aur mood ke badlaav

options.en: Bleeding that happens between two periods
options.hg: Do periods ke beech hone wali bleeding

explain.en: Premenstrual syndrome is a set of changes, such as bloating, tender breasts, pimples, cravings, irritability or low mood, in the one to two weeks before a period. It eases once bleeding starts.
explain.hg: Premenstrual syndrome kuch badlaavon ka group hai, jaise pet phoolna, breasts mein dard, pimples, cravings, chidchidapan ya udaasi, jo period se ek-do hafte pehle hote hain. Bleeding shuru hone pe yeh kam ho jaate hain.

q.en: In a group project, a classmate says, 'Ignore her opinion, she's probably PMSing.' What is true?
q.hg: Group project mein ek classmate kehta hai, 'Iski baat ignore karo, shayad PMS chal raha hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: PMS is made up and does not exist
options.hg: PMS banawati hai, hota hi nahi

options.en: PMS is real but never a reason to dismiss her
options.hg: PMS sach hai, par uski baat taalne ki wajah nahi

options.en: He is right; PMS makes people irrational
options.hg: Woh sahi hai; PMS se log irrational ho jaate hain

options.en: Girls' opinions count less every month
options.hg: Har mahine girls ki raay kam maayne rakhti hai

explain.en: PMS can bring real physical and mood changes, but it does not make anyone irrational. Using it to brush off what someone says is disrespectful; her ideas deserve to be heard on their merits.
explain.hg: PMS se sach mein body aur mood mein badlaav ho sakte hain, par isse koi irrational nahi hota. Iska bahaana banake kisi ki baat taalna disrespect hai; uske ideas ko unki quality pe suna jaana chahiye.

q.en: How is PMDD different from ordinary PMS?
q.hg: PMDD aam PMS se kaise alag hai?

options.en: It is severe, with mood symptoms that disrupt life
options.hg: Yeh gambhir hai, mood symptoms zindagi bigaad dete hain

options.en: It is simply another name for cramps
options.hg: Yeh bas cramps ka doosra naam hai

options.en: It only happens after menopause
options.hg: Yeh sirf menopause ke baad hota hai

options.en: It is not a real health condition
options.hg: Yeh asli health condition nahi hai

explain.en: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder brings intense sadness, hopelessness, anger or anxiety before a period, enough to disrupt studies, work or relationships. It is a recognised condition with treatments. Tele-MANAS (14416) can help.
explain.hg: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder mein period se pehle itni gehri udaasi, niraasha, gussa ya anxiety hoti hai ki padhai, kaam ya rishte bigad jaate hain. Yeh maani hui condition hai jiska ilaaj hai. Tele-MANAS (14416) help kar sakta hai.

q.en: Anti-inflammatory pain medicines for period cramps tend to work best when taken how?
q.hg: Period cramps ke liye anti-inflammatory pain medicines kab lene pe sabse achha kaam karti hain?

options.en: Only after two full days of pain
options.hg: Sirf do din dard sehne ke baad

options.en: Every day of the month, non-stop
options.hg: Mahine ke har din, bina ruke

options.en: In double doses for a faster effect
options.hg: Jaldi asar ke liye double dose mein

options.en: As pain begins, as a doctor or label advises
options.hg: Dard shuru hote hi, doctor ya label ke hisaab se

explain.en: These medicines lower prostaglandins, the chemicals behind cramps, so they work best early. Ask a doctor or pharmacist which one suits you, follow the label, and never double the dose.
explain.hg: Yeh dawaiyan prostaglandins kam karti hain, jo cramps ki wajah hain, isliye jaldi lene pe achha kaam karti hain. Doctor ya pharmacist se poochho kaunsi suit karegi, label follow karo, aur kabhi double dose mat lo.

q.en: What causes period cramps?
q.hg: Period cramps kyun hote hain?

options.en: Eating cold food during the period
options.hg: Period mein thanda khaana khaana

options.en: The ovaries tearing every month
options.hg: Har mahine ovaries ka phatna

options.en: The uterus muscle squeezing to shed its lining
options.hg: Lining nikaalne ke liye uterus ki muscle ka sikudna

options.en: Blood collecting in the stomach
options.hg: Pet mein blood jama hona

explain.en: The uterus is a muscle. Chemicals called prostaglandins make it squeeze to push out the lining, which causes cramps in the lower belly, back or thighs, usually strongest in the first day or two.
explain.hg: Uterus ek muscle hai. Prostaglandins naam ke chemicals use sikodte hain taaki lining bahar nikle, isse pet ke neeche, kamar ya thighs mein cramps hote hain, aksar pehle ek-do din sabse zyada.

q.en: Ishita's cramps make her vomit and miss school every month, and painkillers barely help. What should she do?
q.hg: Ishita ke cramps se har mahine ulti hoti hai aur school chhoot jaata hai, aur painkillers bhi kam kaam karte hain. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Wait until marriage for the pain to stop
options.hg: Shaadi tak wait kare, dard ruk jaayega

options.en: See a doctor; this level of pain needs a check
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhaye; itna dard check hona chahiye

options.en: Accept it, since all periods are like this
options.hg: Maan le, sab periods aise hi hote hain

options.en: Take more painkillers than the label says
options.hg: Label se zyada painkillers le

explain.en: Pain that stops normal activity, causes vomiting or fainting, or is not eased by usual measures is not 'just periods'. A doctor can look for causes such as endometriosis and treat the pain.
explain.hg: Jo dard normal kaam rok de, ulti ya behoshi laaye, ya aam upaayon se kam na ho, woh 'bas periods' nahi hai. Doctor endometriosis jaisi wajah dhoondh ke dard ka ilaaj kar sakte hain.

q.en: Which of these is a reason to see a doctor about periods?
q.hg: Inme se kis wajah se periods ke liye doctor ko dikhana chahiye?

options.en: Soaking a pad every 1 to 2 hours
options.hg: Har 1 se 2 ghante mein pad bhar jaana

options.en: Brown spotting on the last day
options.hg: Aakhri din bhoore dhabbe

options.en: Mild cramps on the first day
options.hg: Pehle din halke cramps

options.en: A cycle that lasts 30 days
options.hg: 30 din ki cycle

explain.en: Soaking through a pad or tampon every one to two hours is heavier than normal. Brown spotting, mild first-day cramps and a 30-day cycle are all usual.
explain.hg: Har ek-do ghante mein pad ya tampon bhar jaana normal se zyada heavy hai. Bhoore dhabbe, pehle din halke cramps aur 30 din ki cycle sab normal hain.

q.en: Tanya's period has now lasted nine days. What is sensible?
q.hg: Tanya ka period ab nau din se chal raha hai. Samajhdaari kya hai?

options.en: Ignore it; longer periods are healthier
options.hg: Ignore kare; lambe periods zyada healthy hain

options.en: Stop eating until it ends
options.hg: Khatam hone tak khaana band kare

options.en: Use two pads and say nothing
options.hg: Do pads lagaye aur kuch na bole

options.en: See a doctor, as over 7 days needs a check
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhaye, 7 din se zyada check hona chahiye

explain.en: Bleeding usually lasts 2 to 7 days. Bleeding for more than 7 days, or bleeding between periods, is worth a check-up so a doctor can find the cause.
explain.hg: Bleeding aam taur pe 2 se 7 din chalti hai. 7 din se zyada bleeding, ya do periods ke beech bleeding ho, toh check-up karwana chahiye taaki doctor wajah dhoondh sake.

q.en: During a very heavy period, Pooja feels faint and her heart is racing. What should happen?
q.hg: Bahut heavy period ke time Pooja ko chakkar aa raha hai aur dil tez dhadak raha hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Drink tea and carry on with work
options.hg: Chai piye aur kaam karti rahe

options.en: Book a check-up for next month
options.hg: Agle mahine ka check-up book kare

options.en: Go to a hospital now or call 112
options.hg: Abhi hospital jaaye ya 112 call kare

options.en: Lie down and wait for the next period
options.hg: Let jaaye aur agle period ka wait kare

explain.en: Heavy bleeding with fainting or a racing heartbeat can mean serious blood loss. That is an emergency: go to a hospital straight away or call 112.
explain.hg: Heavy bleeding ke saath chakkar ya tez dhadkan ka matlab zyada blood loss ho sakta hai. Yeh emergency hai: seedha hospital jao ya 112 call karo.

q.en: Very heavy periods over many months can lead to which problem?
q.hg: Kai mahinon tak bahut heavy periods se kaunsi problem ho sakti hai?

options.en: Bad breath
options.hg: Muh se badboo

options.en: Anaemia, or low iron
options.hg: Anaemia, yaani iron ki kami

options.en: Weaker eyesight
options.hg: Kamzor nazar

options.en: Early grey hair
options.hg: Jaldi safed baal

explain.en: Losing a lot of blood month after month can drain iron and cause anaemia, with tiredness, breathlessness, dizziness and pale skin. A doctor can test for it and treat both the anaemia and its cause.
explain.hg: Har mahine bahut blood jaane se iron kam ho jaata hai aur anaemia ho sakta hai, jisme thakaan, saans phoolna, chakkar aur peeli skin hoti hai. Doctor test karke anaemia aur uski wajah dono ka ilaaj kar sakte hain.

q.en: Which of these foods are good sources of iron?
q.hg: Inme se kaunse khaane iron ke achhe source hain?

options.en: Green leafy vegetables, dals, chana and eggs
options.hg: Hari patte wali sabziyan, dal, chana aur ande

options.en: Chips, biscuits and namkeen
options.hg: Chips, biscuits aur namkeen

options.en: Tea, coffee and cold drinks
options.hg: Chai, coffee aur cold drinks

options.en: Sugar, jalebi and sweets
options.hg: Cheeni, jalebi aur mithai

explain.en: Iron-rich foods such as green leafy vegetables, dals, chana and eggs help the body replace what is lost in periods. Packaged snacks and sweets add little iron.
explain.hg: Hari patte wali sabziyan, dal, chana aur ande jaise iron wale khaane periods mein gaya iron wapas laane mein help karte hain. Packet wale snacks aur mithai mein iron bahut kam hota hai.

q.en: What is PCOS?
q.hg: PCOS kya hai?

options.en: An infection caught from public toilets
options.hg: Public toilet se lagne wala infection

options.en: A type of cancer of the uterus
options.hg: Uterus ka ek tarah ka cancer

options.en: A normal stage every girl goes through
options.hg: Ek normal stage jisse har girl guzarti hai

options.en: A hormone condition with irregular ovulation
options.hg: Ek hormone condition jisme ovulation irregular hota hai

explain.en: Polycystic ovary syndrome is one of the most common hormonal conditions in people who menstruate. The ovaries make more androgens than usual and ovulation becomes irregular. It is manageable with support.
explain.hg: Polycystic ovary syndrome periods wale logon mein sabse common hormonal conditions mein se ek hai. Ovaries normal se zyada androgens banati hain aur ovulation irregular ho jaata hai. Sahi support se yeh manage hota hai.

q.en: Which group of signs can point to PCOS?
q.hg: Kaunse signs ka group PCOS ki taraf ishaara kar sakta hai?

options.en: Short height and flat feet
options.hg: Chhoti height aur flat feet

options.en: Frequent sneezing and itchy eyes
options.hg: Baar-baar chheenk aur aankhon mein khujli

options.en: Missed periods, extra facial hair, stubborn acne
options.hg: Periods miss hona, extra facial hair, na jaane wale acne

options.en: Fever, cough and a runny nose
options.hg: Bukhaar, khaansi aur behti naak

explain.en: PCOS can cause infrequent or missed periods, extra hair on the face, chest or tummy, stubborn acne, thinning scalp hair and for some, weight gain. A doctor diagnoses it with history, blood tests and sometimes an ultrasound.
explain.hg: PCOS mein periods kam ya miss ho sakte hain, chehre, chest ya pet pe extra baal, na jaane wale acne, sir ke baal patle hona, aur kuch logon mein weight badhna. Doctor history, blood test aur kabhi ultrasound se diagnose karte hain.

q.en: Your slim friend says she cannot have PCOS because only overweight people get it. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhari patli dost kehti hai ki use PCOS nahi ho sakta kyunki yeh sirf overweight logon ko hota hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: PCOS only affects women over 40
options.hg: PCOS sirf 40 se upar ki auraton ko hota hai

options.en: Thin people can have PCOS too
options.hg: Patle logon ko bhi PCOS ho sakta hai

options.en: Only overweight people get PCOS
options.hg: Sirf overweight logon ko PCOS hota hai

options.en: PCOS goes away if you lose weight
options.hg: Weight kam karne se PCOS chala jaata hai

explain.en: PCOS affects people of every body size. Weight changes can ease some symptoms for some people, but there is no cure; it is managed with lifestyle support and medicines.
explain.hg: PCOS har body size ke logon ko hota hai. Kuch logon mein weight badalne se kuch symptoms kam ho sakte hain, par iska koi cure nahi; lifestyle support aur dawaiyon se manage hota hai.

q.en: Does having PCOS or irregular periods mean someone can never have children?
q.hg: Kya PCOS ya irregular periods ka matlab hai ki kabhi bachche nahi ho sakte?

options.en: No; it may take longer, but many conceive
options.hg: Nahi; time lag sakta hai, par kai log conceive karte hain

options.en: Yes, it always means infertility
options.hg: Haan, iska matlab hamesha infertility hai

options.en: Yes, unless they marry before 20
options.hg: Haan, jab tak 20 se pehle shaadi na ho

options.en: Only if they stop all exercise
options.hg: Sirf agar saari exercise band kar den

explain.en: PCOS can make ovulation less frequent, so conceiving may take longer, but many people with PCOS do become pregnant, some with medical help. Irregular cycles alone say little about future fertility.
explain.hg: PCOS se ovulation kam hota hai, isliye conceive karne mein time lag sakta hai, par PCOS wale kai log pregnant hote hain, kuch medical help se. Sirf irregular cycles se future fertility ke baare mein zyada pata nahi chalta.

q.en: What is endometriosis?
q.hg: Endometriosis kya hai?

options.en: An infection caused by unwashed pads
options.hg: Bina dhoye pads se hone wala infection

options.en: The normal mild cramps of a period
options.hg: Period ke normal halke cramps

options.en: A period that comes twice a month
options.hg: Mahine mein do baar aane wala period

options.en: Tissue like the uterus lining growing outside it
options.hg: Uterus lining jaisa tissue uske bahar badhna

explain.en: In endometriosis, tissue similar to the uterus lining grows outside the uterus and causes inflammation. Severe period pain, long-lasting pelvic pain and pain while passing stool or urine during periods are typical signs.
explain.hg: Endometriosis mein uterus ki lining jaisa tissue uterus ke bahar badhta hai aur sujan karta hai. Periods mein bahut tez dard, lambe time tak pelvic dard aur periods mein potty ya susu karte waqt dard iske typical signs hain.

q.en: Your friend misses exams every month because of severe period pain, and her family says 'all girls suffer'. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhari dost har mahine period ke tez dard se exams chhod deti hai, aur family kehti hai 'sab girls ko hota hai'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Pain this bad means she is weak
options.hg: Itna dard matlab woh kamzor hai

options.en: It will surely stop after childbirth
options.hg: Bachcha hone ke baad pakka ruk jaayega

options.en: Severe pain should be checked by a doctor
options.hg: Itna tez dard doctor ko dikhana chahiye

options.en: Her family is right; she must bear it
options.hg: Family sahi hai; use sehna padega

explain.en: Pain that stops someone studying or working is not normal. Conditions such as endometriosis are often dismissed as ordinary cramps for years, yet treatments can control them.
explain.hg: Jo dard padhai ya kaam rok de, woh normal nahi hai. Endometriosis jaisi conditions ko aksar saalon tak normal cramps maan ke taal diya jaata hai, jabki ilaaj se inhe control kiya ja sakta hai.

q.en: Which of these can make periods irregular after the first few years?
q.hg: Shuru ke kuch saalon ke baad periods kis wajah se irregular ho sakte hain?

options.en: Washing hair during a period
options.hg: Period mein baal dhona

options.en: Stress, big weight changes or thyroid problems
options.hg: Stress, weight mein bada badlaav ya thyroid

options.en: Eating ice cream in winter
options.hg: Sardi mein ice cream khaana

options.en: Wearing jeans too often
options.hg: Zyada jeans pehenna

explain.en: Common causes include stress, sudden weight loss or gain, very intense exercise, thyroid problems and PCOS. Pregnancy is also possible after any genital contact. A pattern over several months is worth a check-up.
explain.hg: Common wajahen hain stress, achanak weight kam ya zyada hona, bahut zyada exercise, thyroid problems aur PCOS. Kisi bhi genital contact ke baad pregnancy bhi ho sakti hai. Kai mahinon tak aisa pattern rahe toh check-up karwao.

q.en: Shreya, 16, wants to see a doctor about painful periods but feels shy. Which is true?
q.hg: Shreya, 16, painful periods ke liye doctor ko dikhana chahti hai par sharmati hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: She can ask for a female doctor and a companion
options.hg: Woh female doctor aur saath mein kisi ko maang sakti hai

options.en: Only married women can see a gynaecologist
options.hg: Sirf shaadishuda auratein gynaecologist ke paas ja sakti hain

options.en: She needs a police letter to be examined
options.hg: Check-up ke liye police letter chahiye

options.en: Doctors only help with period pain after 18
options.hg: Doctors 18 ke baad hi period pain mein help karte hain

explain.en: Anyone can see a gynaecologist, a general doctor or an Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic. She can ask for a female doctor and for someone she trusts to be present, and carry notes on dates, pads used and pain.
explain.hg: Koi bhi gynaecologist, general doctor ya Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic ja sakta hai. Woh female doctor maang sakti hai aur kisi trusted insaan ko saath rakh sakti hai, aur dates, pads aur dard ke notes le ja sakti hai.

q.en: Can a tampon get lost inside the body?
q.hg: Kya tampon body ke andar kho sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, it can travel up to the stomach
options.hg: Haan, yeh pet tak ja sakta hai

options.en: Yes, if you sit down for too long
options.hg: Haan, agar zyada der baitho

options.en: Yes, it can slip into the bladder
options.hg: Haan, yeh bladder mein ja sakta hai

options.en: No, the cervix opening is far too small
options.hg: Nahi, cervix ka opening bahut chhota hai

explain.en: The vagina ends at the cervix, whose opening is far too small for a tampon to pass. If you cannot find the string, a doctor can remove it easily, so do not delay out of embarrassment.
explain.hg: Vagina cervix pe khatam hoti hai, jiska opening tampon ke guzarne ke liye bahut chhota hai. Agar string na mile toh doctor aasaani se nikaal dete hain, isliye sharam mein der mat karo.

q.en: What is a menstrual cup usually made of?
q.hg: Menstrual cup aam taur pe kis cheez ka bana hota hai?

options.en: Cotton wrapped around a stick
options.hg: Stick pe lipti rui

options.en: Thin steel or aluminium
options.hg: Patla steel ya aluminium

options.en: Flexible medical-grade silicone
options.hg: Lachila medical-grade silicone

options.en: Hard plastic like a bottle
options.hg: Bottle jaisa sakht plastic

explain.en: A menstrual cup is a flexible cup, usually made of medical-grade silicone, that collects blood instead of absorbing it. With care, one cup can be reused for years.
explain.hg: Menstrual cup ek lachila cup hai, aksar medical-grade silicone ka, jo blood sokhta nahi balki jama karta hai. Dhyan se use karo toh ek cup saalon chal sakta hai.

q.en: Does using a tampon or a menstrual cup affect virginity?
q.hg: Kya tampon ya menstrual cup use karne se virginity pe asar padta hai?

options.en: Yes, so they are banned for unmarried girls
options.hg: Haan, isliye kunwari girls ke liye mana hai

options.en: No; the hymen cannot show anyone's sexual history
options.hg: Nahi; hymen kisi ki sexual history nahi bata sakta

options.en: Yes, the first use ends virginity
options.hg: Haan, pehli baar use karte hi virginity khatam

options.en: Yes, but only cups, not tampons
options.hg: Haan, par sirf cups se, tampons se nahi

explain.en: Virginity is not a medical condition. The hymen varies naturally and cannot show whether someone has had sex. Unmarried girls can use tampons or cups safely.
explain.hg: Virginity koi medical condition nahi hai. Hymen sabme alag hota hai aur nahi bata sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi. Unmarried girls bhi tampons ya cups safely use kar sakti hain.

q.en: Neha is moving into a hostel with shared washrooms and no tap inside the toilet. Which product may be easiest for her there?
q.hg: Neha ek hostel mein ja rahi hai jahan shared washrooms hain aur toilet ke andar nal nahi hai. Wahan uske liye kaunsa product sabse aasaan ho sakta hai?

options.en: Disposable pads, as cups need water and privacy
options.hg: Disposable pads, kyunki cup ko paani aur privacy chahiye

options.en: A cup, since it never needs rinsing
options.hg: Cup, kyunki use kabhi dhona nahi padta

options.en: Cloth pads dried under her mattress
options.hg: Gadde ke neeche sukhaye cloth pads

options.en: No product, since periods stop in hostels
options.hg: Kuch nahi, hostel mein periods ruk jaate hain

explain.en: Cups are emptied, rinsed with clean water and reinserted, which is hard without a private washroom with water. Disposable pads may be simpler there; the best product is the one that fits your situation.
explain.hg: Cup ko khaali karke saaf paani se dhona aur wapas lagana hota hai, jo bina paani wale private washroom ke mushkil hai. Wahan disposable pads aasaan ho sakte hain; sabse achha product wahi hai jo tumhari situation mein fit ho.

q.en: Which is true about reusable cloth pads and period underwear?
q.hg: Reusable cloth pads aur period underwear ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: They can be worn for three days unwashed
options.hg: Bina dhoye teen din pehen sakte hain

options.en: They work only for very light flow
options.hg: Yeh sirf bahut halke flow mein kaam karte hain

options.en: They are banned in Indian schools
options.hg: Indian schools mein yeh banned hain

options.en: They cost less over time but need washing
options.hg: Lambe time mein saste hain par dhone padte hain

explain.en: Reusable products save money and waste over time, but they need soap, water and full drying, ideally in sunlight. Like pads, they should be changed regularly through the day.
explain.hg: Reusable products lambe time mein paisa aur kachra bachate hain, par inhe sabun, paani aur poori tarah sukhana, behtar ho dhoop mein, zaroori hai. Pads ki tarah inhe bhi din mein time pe badalna chahiye.

q.en: Is menstrual blood 'dirty' or 'impure' compared with other blood?
q.hg: Kya period ka blood doosre blood se 'ganda' ya 'apavitra' hota hai?

options.en: Yes, it can make others ill by touch
options.hg: Haan, chhoone se doosre beemar ho sakte hain

options.en: Yes, which is why it smells strongly
options.hg: Haan, isliye isse tez smell aati hai

options.en: No, it is ordinary blood and tissue
options.hg: Nahi, yeh aam blood aur tissue hai

options.en: Yes, it carries the body's toxins
options.hg: Haan, isme body ke zehreele padarth hote hain

explain.en: Menstrual blood is ordinary blood mixed with the tissue of the uterus lining. It is not toxic and does not make a person or anything they touch impure. Restrictions based on this idea have no medical basis.
explain.hg: Period ka blood aam blood hai jisme uterus lining ka tissue mila hota hai. Yeh zehreela nahi hai aur insaan ya unki chhui cheez ko apavitra nahi banata. Is soch pe bani pabandiyon ka koi medical aadhaar nahi.

q.en: Your friend is at a college fest and has bad period cramps. How can you best help?
q.hg: Tumhari dost college fest mein hai aur use period ke tez cramps hain. Tum sabse achhe se kaise help kar sakte ho?

options.en: Leave her alone; it is not your business
options.hg: Akele chhod do; tumhara kaam nahi

options.en: Ask what she needs, like water or a quiet seat
options.hg: Poochho use kya chahiye, jaise paani ya shaant jagah

options.en: Tell her to stop overreacting and enjoy
options.hg: Bolo overreact band kare aur enjoy kare

options.en: Make jokes so she forgets the pain
options.hg: Mazaak karo taaki dard bhool jaaye

explain.en: Cramps are real. Asking what helps, such as water, a seat, a hot water bottle or a pad, shows support without fuss. This applies whether you are a girl or a boy.
explain.hg: Cramps sach mein hote hain. Poochhna ki kya help karega, jaise paani, baithne ki jagah, hot water bottle ya pad, bina drama ke support dikhata hai. Yeh girls aur boys dono pe laagu hota hai.

q.en: At a family dinner, an uncle jokes loudly that a cousin is 'in a mood because of her days'. What is a good response?
q.hg: Family dinner pe ek uncle zor se mazaak karte hain ki cousin ka 'mood uske dinon ki wajah se kharaab hai'. Achha jawaab kya hoga?

options.en: Calmly say periods are not a joke and move on
options.hg: Shaanti se kaho periods mazaak nahi hain aur baat badlo

options.en: Laugh loudly to keep the peace
options.hg: Maahaul theek rakhne ke liye zor se haso

options.en: Ask the cousin if it is true in front of all
options.hg: Sabke saamne cousin se poochho kya yeh sach hai

options.en: Add another joke about periods
options.hg: Periods pe ek aur mazaak jodo

explain.en: Public jokes about someone's period are embarrassing and dismissive. A calm word and a change of topic protects the cousin without starting a fight; boys and men speaking up makes a big difference.
explain.hg: Sabke saamne kisi ke period pe mazaak sharminda karta hai aur uski baat ko halka karta hai. Shaant shabdon mein bol ke topic badalna cousin ko bachata hai bina jhagde ke; boys aur mard bolen toh bada farak padta hai.

q.en: What can happen if a pad is worn for too long?
q.hg: Pad bahut der tak pehne rehne se kya ho sakta hai?

options.en: The bleeding stops early
options.hg: Bleeding jaldi ruk jaati hai

options.en: Infertility in later life
options.hg: Aage chalke infertility

options.en: Nothing at all happens
options.hg: Kuch bhi nahi hota

options.en: Rashes, smell and skin irritation
options.hg: Rash, smell aur skin irritation

explain.en: A pad left on too long stays damp against the skin, which can cause rashes, itching, smell and irritation. Changing about every 4 to 6 hours prevents this.
explain.hg: Bahut der tak laga pad skin pe geela rehta hai, jisse rash, khujli, smell aur irritation ho sakta hai. Lagbhag har 4 se 6 ghante mein badalne se yeh nahi hota.

q.en: About how long does a released egg survive if it is not fertilised?
q.hg: Agar egg fertilise na ho toh nikalne ke baad lagbhag kitni der zinda rehta hai?

options.en: About a month
options.hg: Lagbhag ek mahina

options.en: Until the next period ends
options.hg: Agla period khatam hone tak

options.en: About a day
options.hg: Lagbhag ek din

options.en: About a week
options.hg: Lagbhag ek hafta

explain.en: An egg survives roughly 12 to 24 hours after ovulation. Sperm can survive several days, though, so the fertile window is several days long, not just one day.
explain.hg: Ovulation ke baad egg lagbhag 12 se 24 ghante zinda rehta hai. Par sperm kai din zinda reh sakte hain, isliye fertile window kai din ki hoti hai, sirf ek din ki nahi.

q.en: When does ovulation usually happen?
q.hg: Ovulation aam taur pe kab hota hai?

options.en: Right after a period ends, always
options.hg: Period khatam hote hi, hamesha

options.en: About two weeks before the next period
options.hg: Agle period se lagbhag do hafte pehle

options.en: On day 14 of every cycle, without fail
options.hg: Har cycle ke 14ve din, hamesha

options.en: On the first day of bleeding
options.hg: Bleeding ke pehle din

explain.en: Ovulation usually happens roughly two weeks before the next period, not on a fixed date. It shifts with stress, illness, travel and age, especially in teenagers.
explain.hg: Ovulation aksar agle period se lagbhag do hafte pehle hota hai, kisi fixed date pe nahi. Yeh stress, beemari, travel aur umar ke saath khisakta hai, khaas kar teenagers mein.

q.en: Who can have periods?
q.hg: Periods kisko aa sakte hain?

options.en: Most women, and some trans men and non-binary people
options.hg: Zyada-tar women, aur kuch trans men aur non-binary log

options.en: Only women who are over 18
options.hg: Sirf 18 se upar ki women

options.en: Only women who have had children
options.hg: Sirf woh women jinke bachche hain

options.en: Everyone with long hair
options.hg: Har woh insaan jiske lambe baal hain

explain.en: Periods come from having a uterus and ovaries that cycle. Most women have periods, and some transgender men and non-binary people do too. They deserve the same products, privacy and respect.
explain.hg: Periods uterus aur cycle karne wali ovaries ki wajah se aate hain. Zyada-tar women ko periods aate hain, aur kuch transgender men aur non-binary logon ko bhi. Unhe bhi wahi products, privacy aur respect milni chahiye.

q.en: Small clots appear on the heaviest day of Riya's period. What is true?
q.hg: Riya ke period ke sabse heavy din chhote clots dikhte hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Any clot means a miscarriage
options.hg: Koi bhi clot matlab miscarriage

options.en: Clots mean the blood is impure
options.hg: Clots matlab blood apavitra hai

options.en: Clots always need surgery
options.hg: Clots mein hamesha surgery chahiye

options.en: Small clots are usually normal on heavy days
options.hg: Heavy dinon mein chhote clots aksar normal hain

explain.en: Small clots on heavy days are common. Repeatedly passing large clots, along with very heavy bleeding, is a reason to see a doctor.
explain.hg: Heavy dinon mein chhote clots common hain. Baar-baar bade clots aayen, saath mein bahut heavy bleeding ho, toh doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

q.en: Bleeding between periods is best handled how?
q.hg: Do periods ke beech bleeding ho toh kya karna sabse sahi hai?

options.en: Stop bathing until it stops
options.hg: Rukne tak nahana band karo

options.en: Drink only cold water
options.hg: Sirf thanda paani piyo

options.en: Get it checked by a doctor
options.hg: Doctor se check karwao

options.en: Ignore it; it is a bonus period
options.hg: Ignore karo; yeh bonus period hai

explain.en: Bleeding between periods is on the list of signs to get checked, along with very heavy flow, bleeding over 7 days and periods stopping for three months or more.
explain.hg: Do periods ke beech bleeding un signs mein hai jinhe check karwana chahiye, saath mein bahut heavy flow, 7 din se zyada bleeding aur teen mahine ya zyada periods band rehna.

q.en: In January 2026, India's Supreme Court said menstrual health is part of which right?
q.hg: January 2026 mein India ke Supreme Court ne kaha ki menstrual health kis right ka hissa hai?

options.en: The right to form unions
options.hg: Union banane ka right

options.en: The right to life under Article 21
options.hg: Article 21 ke tahat right to life

options.en: The right to vote
options.hg: Vote dene ka right

options.en: The right to property
options.hg: Property ka right

explain.en: On 30 January 2026, in Dr Jaya Thakur v. Government of India, the Supreme Court held that menstrual health is part of the right to life under Article 21 and directed schools to provide working toilets with water, free sanitary napkins and safe disposal.
explain.hg: 30 January 2026 ko Dr Jaya Thakur v. Government of India case mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki menstrual health Article 21 ke right to life ka hissa hai, aur schools ko paani wale chalu toilets, free sanitary napkins aur safe disposal dene ka order diya.

q.en: A boy in class asks why girls carry pads in their bags and calls it 'gross'. What is the best reply?
q.hg: Class ka ek boy poochhta hai ki girls bag mein pads kyun rakhti hain aur ise 'gross' bolta hai. Sabse achha jawaab kya hai?

options.en: Periods are normal health; pads are like plasters
options.hg: Periods normal health hai; pads plaster jaisi cheez hain

options.en: He is right; they should hide them better
options.hg: Woh sahi hai; unhe aur achhe se chhupana chahiye

options.en: Pads should only be kept at home
options.hg: Pads sirf ghar pe rakhne chahiye

options.en: Girls carry them only to show off
options.hg: Girls inhe sirf dikhaane ke liye rakhti hain

explain.en: Periods are a normal part of health, and carrying pads is as sensible as carrying a plaster or water bottle. Teasing makes people hide what they need, which helps no one.
explain.hg: Periods health ka normal hissa hain, aur pads rakhna plaster ya paani ki bottle rakhne jitna samajhdaari wala kaam hai. Chidhane se log zaroori cheez chhupane lagte hain, jisse kisi ka bhala nahi hota.

q.en: Can you go swimming during a period?
q.hg: Kya period mein swimming kar sakte hain?

options.en: No, water makes bleeding heavier
options.hg: Nahi, paani se bleeding badh jaati hai

options.en: Only with a normal pad on
options.hg: Sirf normal pad laga ke

options.en: No, it is unsafe for the uterus
options.hg: Nahi, yeh uterus ke liye unsafe hai

options.en: Yes, with a tampon or cup
options.hg: Haan, tampon ya cup ke saath

explain.en: Swimming is safe during a period. Pads soak up water, so swimmers usually use a tampon or cup, which work inside the body and are not affected by water.
explain.hg: Period mein swimming safe hai. Pads paani sokh lete hain, isliye swimmers aksar tampon ya cup use karte hain, jo body ke andar kaam karte hain aur paani se affect nahi hote.

q.en: How often should a tampon be changed?
q.hg: Tampon kitni der mein badalna chahiye?

options.en: Only when it falls out
options.hg: Sirf jab gir jaaye

options.en: Once at the end of the period
options.hg: Period ke aakhir mein ek baar

options.en: Every 4 to 8 hours
options.hg: Har 4 se 8 ghante mein

options.en: Once every 24 hours
options.hg: Har 24 ghante mein ek baar

explain.en: Change a tampon every 4 to 8 hours and never leave one in longer. Leaving it too long raises the risk of toxic shock syndrome, a rare but serious infection.
explain.hg: Tampon har 4 se 8 ghante mein badlo aur kabhi isse zyada der mat rakho. Zyada der rakhne se toxic shock syndrome ka risk badhta hai, jo rare par gambhir infection hai.

q.en: Which tampon absorbency should you choose?
q.hg: Kaunsi absorbency wala tampon chunna chahiye?

options.en: Any, as long as it is scented
options.hg: Koi bhi, bas khushbu wala ho

options.en: The lowest that manages your flow
options.hg: Sabse kam jo tumhara flow sambhaal le

options.en: Always the highest, to be safe
options.hg: Hamesha sabse zyada, safe rehne ke liye

options.en: Whichever is the cheapest
options.hg: Jo sabse sasta ho

explain.en: Use the lowest absorbency that handles your flow. Dryness or pain when removing a tampon usually means it is more absorbent than you need, and lower absorbency also lowers TSS risk.
explain.hg: Sabse kam absorbency use karo jo flow sambhaal le. Nikalte waqt sookhapan ya dard ka matlab aksar hai ki zaroorat se zyada absorbent hai, aur kam absorbency se TSS ka risk bhi kam hota hai.

q.en: Which habit lowers the risk of toxic shock syndrome?
q.hg: Kaunsi aadat toxic shock syndrome ka risk kam karti hai?

options.en: Changing tampons every 4 to 8 hours
options.hg: Har 4 se 8 ghante mein tampon badalna

options.en: Wearing one tampon all night and day
options.hg: Ek tampon din-raat pehne rehna

options.en: Using two tampons together
options.hg: Do tampons ek saath use karna

options.en: Choosing scented tampons
options.hg: Khushbu wale tampons chunna

explain.en: TSS is rare but serious and is linked to products left in too long. Change tampons on time, use the lowest absorbency, wash hands and follow cup instructions. Fever, rash, vomiting or dizziness means remove it and get urgent care.
explain.hg: TSS rare par gambhir hai aur zyada der andar rakhe products se juda hai. Time pe tampon badlo, kam absorbency use karo, haath dho aur cup ke instructions follow karo. Bukhaar, rash, ulti ya chakkar ho toh nikaal ke turant doctor ke paas jao.

q.en: How should a menstrual cup be cleaned between periods?
q.hg: Do periods ke beech menstrual cup kaise saaf karna chahiye?

options.en: Wash it with scented soap only
options.hg: Sirf khushbu wale sabun se dho

options.en: Wipe it with a dry tissue
options.hg: Sookhe tissue se pochh do

options.en: Soak it overnight in bleach
options.hg: Raat bhar bleach mein bhigo do

options.en: Sterilise it in boiling water
options.hg: Ubalte paani mein sterilise karo

explain.en: During a period the cup is emptied and rinsed with clean water, as the maker's instructions say. Between periods it is sterilised in boiling water. Bleach and scented soaps can damage the silicone and irritate skin.
explain.hg: Period ke dauraan cup ko khaali karke saaf paani se dhote hain, maker ke instructions ke hisaab se. Do periods ke beech ise ubalte paani mein sterilise karte hain. Bleach aur khushbu wale sabun silicone ko kharaab aur skin ko irritate kar sakte hain.

q.en: Trying a menstrual cup for the first time, Aisha finds it hard. What is true?
q.hg: Pehli baar menstrual cup try karte hue Aisha ko mushkil lagti hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It means her body is not normal
options.hg: Iska matlab uski body normal nahi hai

options.en: She should use force to push it in
options.hg: Use zor laga ke andar daalna chahiye

options.en: It often takes two or three cycles to learn
options.hg: Aksar seekhne mein do-teen cycles lagti hain

options.en: It means cups can never work for her
options.hg: Iska matlab cup uske liye kabhi kaam nahi karega

explain.en: Learning to fold, place and remove a cup comfortably often takes two or three cycles, and cups come in different sizes. Relaxing helps; forcing does not. Pads remain a fine choice.
explain.hg: Cup ko fold karna, lagana aur aaraam se nikaalna seekhne mein aksar do-teen cycles lagti hain, aur cups alag sizes mein aate hain. Relax rehna help karta hai, zor lagana nahi. Pads bhi achha option hain.

q.en: Someone who has a copper or hormonal IUD wants to start using a menstrual cup. What is best?
q.hg: Jiske paas copper ya hormonal IUD hai, woh menstrual cup use karna chahti hai. Sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Use the cup without ever breaking the seal
options.hg: Cup ki seal kabhi tode bina nikaale

options.en: Ask a doctor first, as careless removal can pull the IUD
options.hg: Pehle doctor se poochhe, galat tareeke se nikaalne pe IUD khinch sakta hai

options.en: Cups and IUDs can never be used together
options.hg: Cup aur IUD kabhi saath use nahi ho sakte

options.en: Remove the IUD before every period
options.hg: Har period se pehle IUD nikaal de

explain.en: Removing a cup carelessly can pull on the IUD strings. A doctor can advise on safe use, such as breaking the seal before removal and checking the strings.
explain.hg: Cup galat tareeke se nikaalne pe IUD ki strings khinch sakti hain. Doctor safe use ke baare mein bata sakte hain, jaise nikaalne se pehle seal todna aur strings check karna.

q.en: Can someone get pregnant if they have sex during their period?
q.hg: Kya period ke dauraan sex karne se pregnancy ho sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, it is possible
options.hg: Haan, ho sakti hai

options.en: No, never during bleeding
options.hg: Nahi, bleeding mein kabhi nahi

options.en: Only on the first day
options.hg: Sirf pehle din

options.en: Only if periods are regular
options.hg: Sirf agar periods regular hon

explain.en: Pregnancy during a period is less likely but possible, especially with short cycles, because sperm can survive for several days and ovulation can come early. Periods are not a form of contraception.
explain.hg: Period mein pregnancy kam sambhav hai par ho sakti hai, khaas kar chhoti cycles mein, kyunki sperm kai din zinda reh sakte hain aur ovulation jaldi ho sakta hai. Periods contraception nahi hain.

q.en: A 17-year-old's period is two weeks late after genital contact with her partner. What is the sensible step?
q.hg: Partner ke saath genital contact ke baad ek 17 saal ki ladki ka period do hafte late hai. Samajhdaari ka kadam kya hai?

options.en: Wait three more months before acting
options.hg: Kuch karne se pehle teen mahine aur wait kare

options.en: Take herbal pills to bring the period
options.hg: Period laane ke liye herbal goliyan le

options.en: Assume stress and do nothing
options.hg: Maan le stress hai aur kuch na kare

options.en: Take a pregnancy test and see a doctor
options.hg: Pregnancy test kare aur doctor ko dikhaye

explain.en: After any genital contact, a late period can mean pregnancy, so test and see a doctor rather than wait. Never self-medicate to 'bring on' a period. A trusted adult, 1098 or 181 can help someone under 18.
explain.hg: Kisi bhi genital contact ke baad late period ka matlab pregnancy ho sakta hai, isliye wait karne ki jagah test karo aur doctor ko dikhao. Period 'laane' ke liye khud dawai kabhi mat lo. 18 se kam umar mein trusted bade, 1098 ya 181 help kar sakte hain.

q.en: A relative says period pain always disappears after marriage or childbirth, so there is no point treating it. What is true?
q.hg: Ek rishtedaar kehti hain ki period ka dard shaadi ya bachche ke baad hamesha chala jaata hai, isliye ilaaj ka faayda nahi. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Childbirth always ends endometriosis
options.hg: Bachche ke baad endometriosis hamesha khatam

options.en: Treating pain early harms fertility
options.hg: Jaldi ilaaj se fertility kharaab hoti hai

options.en: Pain can and should be treated now
options.hg: Dard ka ilaaj abhi ho sakta hai aur hona chahiye

options.en: Marriage always cures period pain
options.hg: Shaadi se period ka dard hamesha theek hota hai

explain.en: Cramps ease with age or after childbirth for some people, not all, and conditions like endometriosis do not vanish that way. Pain can be assessed and treated now; years of suffering have no benefit.
explain.hg: Kuch logon ke cramps umar ya delivery ke baad kam hote hain, sabke nahi, aur endometriosis jaisi conditions aise nahi jaati. Dard ka check aur ilaaj abhi ho sakta hai; saalon tak sehne ka koi faayda nahi.

q.en: A bride wants to delay her period for her wedding using tablets a friend recommended. What is best?
q.hg: Ek dulhan shaadi ke liye dost ki batayi goliyon se period delay karna chahti hai. Sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Skip meals so the period comes late
options.hg: Khaana chhode taaki period late aaye

options.en: Consult a doctor first, who can advise safely
options.hg: Pehle doctor se mile, jo safely salah denge

options.en: Take the friend's tablets in double dose
options.hg: Dost ki goliyan double dose mein le

options.en: Buy any hormone pill from a chemist
options.hg: Chemist se koi bhi hormone goli le le

explain.en: Periods can sometimes be delayed with hormone tablets, but only a doctor can check whether they are safe for you, which one to take and when. Do not take someone else's medicine or self-medicate.
explain.hg: Kabhi-kabhi hormone goliyon se period delay ho sakta hai, par sirf doctor check kar sakte hain ki yeh tumhare liye safe hai ya nahi, kaunsi aur kab leni hai. Kisi aur ki dawai ya khud se dawai mat lo.

q.en: What is menopause?
q.hg: Menopause kya hai?

options.en: When periods stop for good, in midlife
options.hg: Jab periods hamesha ke liye ruk jaate hain, umar ke beech mein

options.en: A pause in periods during exams
options.hg: Exams ke time periods mein break

options.en: The very first period of a girl
options.hg: Girl ka sabse pehla period

options.en: A disease that stops bleeding
options.hg: Ek beemari jo bleeding rok deti hai

explain.en: Menopause is the natural point in midlife when periods stop permanently because the ovaries slow down. Symptoms such as hot flushes or sleep changes are common and doctors can help with them.
explain.hg: Menopause umar ke beech mein woh natural point hai jab ovaries dheemi ho jaati hain aur periods hamesha ke liye band ho jaate hain. Hot flushes ya neend mein badlaav common hain aur doctor inme help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Your colleague often looks pale and breathless, and mentions very heavy periods. What could you gently suggest?
q.hg: Tumhari colleague aksar peeli aur hafti hui lagti hai, aur bahut heavy periods ka zikr karti hai. Tum pyaar se kya suggest kar sakte ho?

options.en: More tea to boost her energy
options.hg: Energy ke liye zyada chai

options.en: Skipping lunch to lose weight
options.hg: Weight kam karne ke liye lunch skip

options.en: Ignoring it, as heavy periods are normal
options.hg: Ignore karna, heavy periods normal hain

options.en: A doctor's check, including for anaemia
options.hg: Doctor se check, anaemia ka bhi

explain.en: Paleness, tiredness and breathlessness with heavy periods can be signs of anaemia. A doctor can test iron levels and treat both the anaemia and the heavy bleeding.
explain.hg: Heavy periods ke saath peelapan, thakaan aur saans phoolna anaemia ke sign ho sakte hain. Doctor iron level test karke anaemia aur heavy bleeding dono ka ilaaj kar sakte hain.

q.en: A father wonders whether to talk to his 10-year-old daughter about periods or leave it to her mother. What is best?
q.hg: Ek papa soch rahe hain ki 10 saal ki beti se periods ki baat karen ya mummy pe chhod den. Sabse achha kya hai?

options.en: Wait until her first period comes
options.hg: Pehla period aane tak wait karen

options.en: Leave it to the school to explain
options.hg: School ko samjhaane den

options.en: Both parents can talk about it openly
options.hg: Dono parents khul ke baat kar sakte hain

options.en: Fathers should never mention periods
options.hg: Papa ko periods ka naam bhi nahi lena chahiye

explain.en: Girls who hear about periods before the first one cope better. When fathers talk calmly, buy pads and treat periods as normal, daughters learn they can ask either parent for help.
explain.hg: Jo girls pehle period se pehle iske baare mein sunti hain, woh behtar sambhaal paati hain. Jab papa shaanti se baat karte hain, pads laate hain aur periods ko normal maante hain, beti seekhti hai ki woh dono parents se help maang sakti hai.

q.en: A woman at work has bad cramps on the first day of her period. Which response from her manager is most helpful?
q.hg: Office mein ek mahila ko period ke pehle din tez cramps hain. Manager ka kaunsa jawaab sabse helpful hai?

options.en: Ask her to prove her pain with a test
options.hg: Dard saabit karne ke liye test maangna

options.en: Offer flexibility, like a break or working from home
options.hg: Flexibility dena, jaise break ya work from home

options.en: Tell her to hide it from the team
options.hg: Use team se chhupane ko kehna

options.en: Joke that women cannot handle work
options.hg: Mazaak karna ki auratein kaam nahi sambhaal sakti

explain.en: Period pain is real and usually passes in a day or two. Simple flexibility, such as a short break or working from home, helps people stay productive without shame. Severe, regular pain deserves a doctor's check.
explain.hg: Period ka dard sach hai aur aksar ek-do din mein chala jaata hai. Thodi flexibility, jaise chhota break ya work from home, logon ko bina sharam ke productive rehne deti hai. Har baar tez dard ho toh doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

q.en: Your friend says she has bled lightly for two days, mid-cycle, every month for three months. What should she do?
q.hg: Tumhari dost kehti hai ki teen mahine se har mahine cycle ke beech do din halki bleeding hoti hai. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Mention it to a doctor for a check-up
options.hg: Check-up ke liye doctor ko bataye

options.en: Ignore it, as it is always harmless
options.hg: Ignore kare, yeh hamesha harmless hai

options.en: Treat it as a second full period
options.hg: Ise doosra poora period maan le

options.en: Stop all exercise and spicy food
options.hg: Saari exercise aur masaledaar khaana band kare

explain.en: Light spotting around ovulation happens for some people, but repeated bleeding between periods should be checked by a doctor to rule out causes such as hormone problems, infections or growths.
explain.hg: Kuch logon ko ovulation ke aas-paas halki spotting hoti hai, par baar-baar periods ke beech bleeding ho toh doctor ko dikhana chahiye, taaki hormone problems, infection ya growth jaisi wajahen check ho sakein.

q.en: Which is a safe way to dispose of a used menstrual cup's contents?
q.hg: Menstrual cup mein jama blood ko safely kaise khaali karna chahiye?

options.en: Throw the cup away after each use
options.hg: Har use ke baad cup phenk do

options.en: Pour it into the kitchen sink
options.hg: Kitchen sink mein daal do

options.en: Store it until the period ends
options.hg: Period khatam hone tak jama rakho

options.en: Empty it into the toilet and rinse the cup
options.hg: Toilet mein khaali karo aur cup dho lo

explain.en: Unlike pads, a cup's contents are simply emptied into the toilet and flushed, and the cup is rinsed with clean water before reinserting. The cup itself is reused for years.
explain.hg: Pads ke ulat, cup ka blood bas toilet mein khaali karke flush kar dete hain, aur dobara lagane se pehle cup ko saaf paani se dhote hain. Cup khud saalon tak dobara use hota hai.

q.en: Does a person need complete bed rest during their period?
q.hg: Kya period mein poora bed rest zaroori hai?

options.en: Yes, for at least the first three days
options.hg: Haan, kam se kam pehle teen din

options.en: Yes, or the period will become irregular
options.hg: Haan, warna period irregular ho jaayega

options.en: No, most people can carry on as usual
options.hg: Nahi, zyada-tar log normal kaam kar sakte hain

options.en: Yes, moving around makes bleeding dangerous
options.hg: Haan, chalne-phirne se bleeding khatarnaak ho jaati hai

explain.en: A period is not an illness, so school, work, sport and housework can carry on. Resting when tired or crampy is fine, but pain that regularly forces someone to bed is worth a doctor's check.
explain.hg: Period beemari nahi hai, isliye school, kaam, sports aur ghar ka kaam chal sakta hai. Thakaan ya cramps mein aaraam karna theek hai, par agar dard har baar bistar pe le aaye toh doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

q.en: After her period ends, a friend uses a douche to 'clean out' her vagina. What is true?
q.hg: Period khatam hone ke baad ek dost vagina ko 'andar se saaf' karne ke liye douche use karti hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It is advised by doctors every month
options.hg: Doctors har mahine iski salah dete hain

options.en: It is not needed and can upset the natural balance
options.hg: Zaroorat nahi, aur isse natural balance bigad sakta hai

options.en: It is needed to remove leftover period blood
options.hg: Bacha hua period blood nikaalne ke liye zaroori hai

options.en: It prevents all infections
options.hg: Isse saare infection rukte hain

explain.en: The vagina cleans itself with helpful bacteria and a slightly acidic fluid. Douching washes these away and can raise the chance of irritation and infection. Gently washing the vulva outside is enough.
explain.hg: Vagina helpful bacteria aur halke acidic fluid se khud saaf hoti hai. Douching inhe dho deta hai aur irritation aur infection ka chance badha sakta hai. Bahar vulva ko halke se dhona kaafi hai.

q.en: You are 11 and have a crush on someone in your class. What is true?
q.hg: Tum 11 saal ke ho aur class mein kisi par crush hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's wrong to have feelings at your age
options.hg: Is umar mein feelings hona galat hai

options.en: You must tell the person right away
options.hg: Us insaan ko turant batana padega

options.en: It's normal; you don't have to do anything about it
options.hg: Normal hai; iske baare mein kuch karna zaroori nahi

options.en: It means you have to start dating them
options.hg: Iska matlab tumhe unhe date karna shuru karna hai

explain.en: Crushes are a normal part of growing up, and they often come and go. Feelings are okay. You can enjoy them quietly, talk to someone you trust, or just let them pass.
explain.hg: Crush hona bade hone ka normal hissa hai, aur aksar aate-jaate rehte hain. Feelings theek hain. Tum unhe chupchaap enjoy kar sakte ho, kisi trusted insaan se baat kar sakte ho, ya bas guzar jaane do.

q.en: Which of these describes a good friend?
q.hg: In mein se achhe dost ki pehchaan kaunsi hai?

options.en: Respects you even when you disagree
options.hg: Disagree karne par bhi tumhari respect karta hai

options.en: Makes you prove loyalty with dares
options.hg: Dares se tumhari loyalty test karta hai

options.en: Decides who else you can be friends with
options.hg: Decide karta hai tum aur kisse dosti karoge

options.en: Only talks to you when they need help
options.hg: Sirf tab baat karta hai jab use help chahiye

explain.en: Good friends can disagree, say sorry and still respect each other. Friendship that comes with tests, control or one-way favours is not healthy.
