explain.hg: Achhe dost disagree kar sakte hain, sorry bol sakte hain aur phir bhi ek doosre ki respect karte hain. Jis dosti mein tests, control ya ek-tarfa favours hon, woh healthy nahi hai.

q.en: Your best friend makes a new friend and you feel left out. What is a healthy way to handle it?
q.hg: Tumhare best friend ne naya dost banaya aur tumhe left out lag raha hai. Healthy tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Stop talking to your friend to teach them a lesson
options.hg: Sabak sikhane ke liye dost se baat band kar do

options.en: Spread a rumour about the new friend
options.hg: Naye dost ke baare mein afwaah phailao

options.en: Tell your friend to choose between you two
options.hg: Dost ko bolo ki hum dono mein se ek ko chuno

options.en: Tell them how you feel and try hanging out together
options.hg: Unhe apni feeling batao aur saath mein hang out try karo

explain.en: Feeling a bit jealous is normal. People can have more than one friend. Saying 'I've been missing you' and including the new friend works better than punishing anyone.
explain.hg: Thodi jealousy normal hai. Logon ke ek se zyada dost ho sakte hain. 'Main tumhe miss kar raha tha' bolna aur naye dost ko bhi shamil karna kisi ko saza dene se behtar kaam karta hai.

q.en: A friend says, 'If you're really my friend, you won't talk to Aisha any more.' What is this?
q.hg: Ek dost bolta hai, 'Agar tum sach mein mere dost ho toh Aisha se baat nahi karoge.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Loyalty, which every good friendship needs
options.hg: Loyalty, jo har achhi dosti mein chahiye

options.en: Controlling; real friends don't choose for you
options.hg: Control karna; asli dost tumhare liye nahi chunte

options.en: Normal, because friends share enemies
options.hg: Normal, kyunki dost dushman bhi share karte hain

options.en: Fair, if Aisha was once rude to them
options.hg: Fair, agar Aisha kabhi unse rude thi

explain.en: A friend can tell you they had a problem with someone, but they shouldn't make your friendship depend on cutting others off. You can be kind to both.
explain.hg: Dost bata sakta hai ki use kisi se problem hai, par dosti ko is shart par nahi rakhna chahiye ki tum doosron se baat band karo. Tum dono ke saath achhe reh sakte ho.

q.en: Your group wants to prank call a classmate at night and tease her. You don't want to. What can you do?
q.hg: Tumhara group raat ko ek classmate ko prank call karke chidhana chahta hai. Tum nahi chahte. Kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Join in, so the group doesn't tease you next
options.hg: Shamil ho jao, taaki group agli baar tumhe na chidhaye

options.en: Say 'I'm not doing this' and suggest something else
options.hg: 'Main yeh nahi karunga' bolo aur kuch aur suggest karo

options.en: Make the call but stay silent on the phone
options.hg: Call kar lo par phone par chup raho

options.en: Go along, then apologise to her secretly
options.hg: Saath do, phir chupke se usse sorry bol do

explain.en: Peer pressure feels strong, but saying no once often gives others permission to say no too. Hurting someone to fit in is never a fair price.
explain.hg: Peer pressure strong lagta hai, par ek baar na bolne se aksar doosron ko bhi na bolne ki himmat milti hai. Group mein fit hone ke liye kisi ko hurt karna kabhi sahi keemat nahi hai.

q.en: You want to tell your parents something awkward, like being teased at school. What is a good way to start?
q.hg: Tum mummy-papa ko kuch awkward baat batana chahte ho, jaise school mein chidhaya jana. Shuru kaise karo?

options.en: Wait until they are angry about something else
options.hg: Jab woh kisi aur baat par gusse mein hon tab bolo

options.en: Drop it into a family WhatsApp group
options.hg: Family WhatsApp group mein daal do

options.en: Wait for them to guess what is wrong
options.hg: Wait karo ki woh khud guess kar lein

options.en: Pick a calm time and say, 'Can I talk to you?'
options.hg: Shaant time chuno aur bolo, 'Kya main aapse baat kar sakta/sakti hoon?'

explain.en: Choosing a calm moment, like a walk or a car ride, makes hard talks easier. You can even start with 'This is awkward, but…'. If a parent isn't the right person, try another trusted adult.
explain.hg: Shaant moment, jaise walk ya car ride, mushkil baat ko aasaan banata hai. Tum 'Thoda awkward hai, par…' se bhi shuru kar sakte ho. Agar parent sahi insaan nahi, toh koi aur trusted bada try karo.

q.en: You told a parent something important and they reacted badly. What can you do next?
q.hg: Tumne parent ko kuch zaroori bataya aur unhone bura react kiya. Ab kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Try again later, or talk to another trusted adult
options.hg: Baad mein phir try karo, ya kisi aur trusted bade se baat karo

options.en: Never share anything with any adult again
options.hg: Kisi bhi bade se kabhi kuch share mat karna

options.en: Decide that the problem must not matter
options.hg: Maan lo ki problem matter hi nahi karti

options.en: Handle everything alone from now on
options.hg: Ab se sab kuch akele handle karo

explain.en: Parents sometimes react with shock or worry before they calm down. A second try often goes better. If it still doesn't, a teacher, relative, counsellor or 1098 can help.
explain.hg: Parents kabhi-kabhi shaant hone se pehle shock ya fikr mein react karte hain. Doosri koshish aksar behtar jati hai. Phir bhi na ho, toh teacher, rishtedaar, counsellor ya 1098 help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Someone writes 'Rohan loves Priya' on the class board and everyone laughs. Priya looks upset. What is kind?
q.hg: Kisi ne class board par 'Rohan loves Priya' likh diya aur sab has rahe hain. Priya upset lag rahi hai. Kind kya hai?

options.en: Add a heart to make it funnier
options.hg: Mazaak badhane ke liye ek heart bana do

options.en: Laugh along so the moment passes
options.hg: Saath mein has do taaki baat nikal jaye

options.en: Rub it off and tell people to stop
options.hg: Use mita do aur logon ko rukne ko bolo

options.en: Take a photo for the class group
options.hg: Class group ke liye photo kheench lo

explain.en: Teasing about crushes can be really embarrassing, whether or not it's true. Stopping it and not spreading it shows respect for both Rohan and Priya.
explain.hg: Crush ko lekar chidhana bahut sharminda kar sakta hai, sach ho ya na ho. Ise rokna aur aage na phailana Rohan aur Priya dono ki respect hai.

q.en: You get a note saying 'I like you' from a classmate. You don't feel the same. What is a kind response?
q.hg: Ek classmate se tumhe 'I like you' wala note milta hai. Tumhe waisa feel nahi hota. Kind response kya hai?

options.en: Show the note around so everyone knows
options.hg: Note sabko dikha do taaki sabko pata chale

options.en: Ignore them completely from now on
options.hg: Ab se unhe poori tarah ignore karo

options.en: 'Thanks, but I only see you as a friend.'
options.hg: 'Thanks, par main tumhe bas dost maanta/maanti hoon.'

options.en: Say yes so that they don't feel bad
options.hg: Haan bol do taaki unhe bura na lage

explain.en: Telling someone you like them takes courage. A short, honest and private reply respects their feelings and yours. Showing the note around turns a kind act into humiliation.
explain.hg: Kisi ko apni feeling batana himmat ka kaam hai. Chhota, honest aur private jawab dono ki feelings ki respect hai. Note sabko dikhana ek achhi baat ko sharmindagi mein badal deta hai.

q.en: Is it okay to feel jealous sometimes?
q.hg: Kya kabhi-kabhi jealous feel karna theek hai?

options.en: Yes; what matters is what you do with the feeling
options.hg: Haan; matter yeh karta hai ki feeling ke saath tum kya karte ho

options.en: No, jealous people are bad people
options.hg: Nahi, jealous log bure log hote hain

options.en: Yes, and it means you can control others
options.hg: Haan, aur iska matlab tum doosron ko control kar sakte ho

options.en: No, you should hide all such feelings
options.hg: Nahi, aisi saari feelings chhupa leni chahiye

explain.en: Jealousy is a normal human feeling. Talking about it, or noticing what it says about your needs, is healthy. Using it to control or hurt someone is not.
explain.hg: Jealousy ek normal insaani feeling hai. Uske baare mein baat karna, ya samajhna ki woh tumhari zaroorat ke baare mein kya batati hai, healthy hai. Use kisi ko control ya hurt karne ke liye use karna nahi.

q.en: Your class makes a new WhatsApp group and leaves one classmate out on purpose. What is true?
q.hg: Class ek naya WhatsApp group banati hai aur jaan-boojh kar ek classmate ko bahar rakhti hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's fine, groups can have any members
options.hg: Theek hai, group mein koi bhi ho sakta hai

options.en: It's only a problem if they find out
options.hg: Problem tabhi hai jab use pata chale

options.en: It is their fault for not fitting in
options.hg: Fit na hone mein uski hi galti hai

options.en: Leaving someone out on purpose can be bullying
options.hg: Jaan-boojh kar kisi ko bahar rakhna bullying ho sakta hai

explain.en: Not every group has to include everyone, but deliberately excluding one person to hurt them is a form of bullying. Adding them, or speaking up, can change their whole school year.
explain.hg: Har group mein sabko hona zaroori nahi, par kisi ek ko hurt karne ke liye jaan-boojh kar bahar rakhna bullying hai. Unhe add karna, ya awaaz uthana, unka poora school saal badal sakta hai.

q.en: What makes an apology a good one?
q.hg: Achhi apology kaisi hoti hai?

options.en: Saying sorry, but explaining it was their fault
options.hg: Sorry bolna, par samjhana ki galti unki thi

options.en: Naming what you did and trying not to repeat it
options.hg: Jo kiya use maanna aur dobara na karne ki koshish

options.en: Buying a gift so you don't have to talk
options.hg: Gift de dena taaki baat na karni pade

options.en: Saying 'sorry if you felt hurt' and moving on
options.hg: 'Sorry agar tumhe bura laga' bol kar aage badh jana

explain.en: A real apology says 'I'm sorry I did X', without a 'but', and then shows change. 'Sorry if you felt hurt' puts the problem on the other person's feelings, not on what was done.
explain.hg: Asli apology kehti hai 'Sorry, maine X kiya', bina 'par' ke, aur phir badlav dikhati hai. 'Sorry agar tumhe bura laga' problem ko saamne wale ki feelings par daal deta hai, kiye hue kaam par nahi.

q.en: An online gaming friend you've never met asks you to keep your friendship a secret from your parents. What is true?
q.hg: Ek online gaming dost jisse tum kabhi nahi mile, kehta hai ki dosti mummy-papa se secret rakho. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's normal, since parents don't get gaming
options.hg: Normal hai, parents gaming nahi samajhte

options.en: Asking for secrecy is a red flag; tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Secret rakhne ko kehna red flag hai; trusted bade ko batao

options.en: It's fine if they are your age, as they say
options.hg: Theek hai agar woh tumhari umar ke hain, jaisa woh kehte hain

options.en: It shows they are a really close friend
options.hg: Isse pata chalta hai ki woh bahut close dost hain

explain.en: Safe friends don't need you to hide them. People who want to harm children often ask for secrecy and pretend to be younger. Telling a parent or trusted adult keeps you safe.
explain.hg: Safe dosto ko chhupane ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Bachchon ko harm karna chahne wale aksar secrecy maangte hain aur khud ko chhota batate hain. Parent ya trusted bade ko batane se tum safe rehte ho.

q.en: Your friend seems sad but says, 'I'm fine.' What can you do?
q.hg: Tumhara dost udaas lag raha hai par kehta hai, 'Main theek hoon.' Kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Force them to tell you what is wrong
options.hg: Zabardasti poochho ki kya hua hai

options.en: Tell the whole class that they are sad
options.hg: Poori class ko batao ki woh udaas hai

options.en: Ignore it, since they said they're fine
options.hg: Ignore karo, unhone kaha toh theek hain

options.en: Gently say you're there if they want to talk
options.hg: Pyaar se bolo ki baat karni ho toh tum ho

explain.en: People don't always open up right away. Letting them know you care, and checking in again later, helps them feel safe to talk when they are ready.
explain.hg: Log hamesha turant nahi khulte. Unhe batana ki tumhe parwah hai, aur baad mein phir poochhna, unhe ready hone par baat karne ke liye safe feel karata hai.

q.en: Can a boy and a girl be just good friends?
q.hg: Kya ek ladka aur ladki bas achhe dost ho sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, friendship works across all genders
options.hg: Haan, dosti har gender ke beech ho sakti hai

options.en: No, one of them always secretly likes the other
options.hg: Nahi, ek hamesha chupke se doosre ko pasand karta hai

options.en: Only until they turn thirteen
options.hg: Sirf terah saal ke hone tak

options.en: Only if their families are close
options.hg: Sirf tab jab families close hon

explain.en: Friendships between people of any gender are normal and valuable. Teasing them as 'couples' can make people avoid healthy friendships.
explain.hg: Kisi bhi gender ke logon ke beech dosti normal aur keemti hai. Unhe 'couple' bol kar chidhana logon ko healthy dosti se door kar sakta hai.

q.en: Your parents keep comparing you with your cousin who scores higher. How can you talk to them about it?
q.hg: Mummy-papa tumhe baar-baar zyada marks lane wale cousin se compare karte hain. Unse is baare mein kaise baat karo?

options.en: Shout back so they finally understand
options.hg: Zor se jawab do taaki woh aakhir samjhein

options.en: Stop talking to your cousin altogether
options.hg: Cousin se baat karna bilkul band kar do

options.en: Calmly say how it makes you feel and what helps
options.hg: Shaanti se batao tumhe kaisa lagta hai aur kya help karta hai

options.en: Say nothing and hope they stop one day
options.hg: Kuch mat bolo aur ummeed karo ek din ruk jayenge

explain.en: Parents often compare because they worry, not to hurt. An 'I' sentence like 'When you compare me, I feel I'm not good enough' helps them understand. Your cousin isn't the problem.
explain.hg: Parents aksar fikr ki wajah se compare karte hain, hurt karne ke liye nahi. 'Jab aap compare karte ho, mujhe lagta hai main kaafi nahi hoon' jaisa 'I' sentence unhe samjhata hai. Cousin problem nahi hai.

q.en: You have a crush on a teacher. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhe ek teacher par crush hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It means the teacher likes you back
options.hg: Iska matlab teacher bhi tumhe pasand karte hain

options.en: You should give the teacher a love letter
options.hg: Teacher ko love letter dena chahiye

options.en: Common feeling; a teacher must never act on it
options.hg: Common feeling hai; teacher ko kabhi aage nahi badhna chahiye

options.en: It is shameful and you must punish yourself
options.hg: Yeh sharam ki baat hai, khud ko saza do

explain.en: Crushes on teachers or older people are common and pass with time. Adults must keep clear boundaries with students. If an adult ever responds romantically, tell a trusted adult or call 1098.
explain.hg: Teachers ya bade logon par crush common hai aur time ke saath chala jata hai. Badon ko students ke saath clear boundaries rakhni chahiye. Agar koi bada kabhi romantic jawab de, toh trusted bade ko batao ya 1098 call karo.

q.en: You disagree with your friend about which film is better. What does a healthy disagreement look like?
q.hg: Tum aur tumhara dost kaunsi film behtar hai is par disagree karte ho. Healthy disagreement kaisa dikhta hai?

options.en: Sharing views and respecting that they differ
options.hg: Apni raay batana aur maanna ki raay alag ho sakti hai

options.en: Not talking for a week until they agree
options.hg: Ek hafte tak baat na karna jab tak woh maan na jayein

options.en: Making fun of their taste in front of others
options.hg: Sabke saamne unki pasand ka mazaak udana

options.en: Pretending to agree to avoid any argument
options.hg: Behas se bachne ke liye maan lene ka natak karna

explain.en: Friends don't have to agree on everything. Saying what you think, listening, and letting the difference be is a skill that helps in every relationship.
explain.hg: Doston ko har baat par agree karna zaroori nahi. Apni baat kehna, sunna, aur farak ko rehne dena ek skill hai jo har rishte mein kaam aati hai.

q.en: In a new school or hostel, you don't know anyone. What is a good way to start making friends?
q.hg: Naye school ya hostel mein tum kisi ko nahi jaante. Dost banane ki shuruaat kaise karo?

options.en: Wait for others to come and talk to you first
options.hg: Wait karo ki log pehle tumse baat karein

options.en: Copy whatever the popular group is doing
options.hg: Popular group jo kar raha hai wahi copy karo

options.en: Pretend to be someone you are not
options.hg: Aisa insaan hone ka natak karo jo tum nahi ho

options.en: Join an activity and ask people simple questions
options.hg: Koi activity join karo aur logon se simple sawaal poochho

explain.en: Shared activities, like sports, music or a club, make it easier to talk. Small questions ('Which coaching do you go to?') open doors. Real friendships grow when you are yourself.
explain.hg: Saath ki activities, jaise sports, music ya club, baat karna aasaan banati hain. Chhote sawaal ('Kaunsi coaching jaate ho?') raaste kholte hain. Asli dosti tab banti hai jab tum khud jaise ho.

q.en: Your friend told you about her crush, and you shared it with others. She is hurt. What should you do?
q.hg: Dost ne tumhe apne crush ke baare mein bataya, aur tumne doosron ko bata diya. Woh hurt hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Tell her it's really not a big deal
options.hg: Bolo ki yeh sach mein koi badi baat nahi

options.en: Say sorry and keep her secrets from now on
options.hg: Sorry bolo aur ab se uski baatein apne tak rakho

options.en: Blame the person you told for spreading it
options.hg: Jisko bataya use phailane ka blame do

options.en: Avoid her until she forgets about it
options.hg: Usse bacho jab tak woh bhool na jaye

explain.en: Trust is easy to break and slow to rebuild. Owning the mistake and showing you can keep private things private is how friendships recover.
explain.hg: Trust todna aasaan hai aur dobara banana dheere hota hai. Galti maanna aur dikhana ki tum private baatein private rakh sakte ho, isi se dosti theek hoti hai.

q.en: A friend only messages you when they need homework answers, and ignores you otherwise. What is the healthiest step?
q.hg: Ek dost tumhe sirf homework answers chahiye hon tab message karta hai, baaki time ignore karta hai. Sabse healthy step kya hai?

options.en: Keep helping, so they will start to like you more
options.hg: Help karte raho, taaki woh tumhe zyada pasand karne lagein

options.en: Notice the pattern and set a limit on what you give
options.hg: Pattern samjho aur jitna dete ho uski limit set karo

options.en: Give them wrong answers to get revenge
options.hg: Badla lene ke liye galat answers do

options.en: Pay them back by ignoring them in class
options.hg: Class mein unhe ignore karke hisaab barabar karo

explain.en: Healthy friendships go both ways. You can still be friendly, but it's okay to say 'Let's study together instead' or simply give less to someone who only takes.
explain.hg: Healthy dosti dono taraf se chalti hai. Tum friendly reh sakte ho, par 'Chalo saath mein padhte hain' bolna, ya sirf lene wale ko kam dena, bilkul theek hai.

q.en: Which is the clearest sign that a friendship has become unhealthy?
q.hg: Kaunsa sign sabse clearly batata hai ki dosti unhealthy ho gayi hai?

options.en: You sometimes disagree about small things
options.hg: Kabhi-kabhi chhoti baaton par disagree karte ho

options.en: They have other friends besides you
options.hg: Unke tumhare alawa aur bhi dost hain

options.en: You two don't talk every single day
options.hg: Tum dono roz baat nahi karte

options.en: You often feel scared or small around them
options.hg: Unke saath tum aksar dare hue ya chhote feel karte ho

explain.en: All friendships have ups and downs. But if you keep feeling afraid, put down or guilty, that's a sign to step back and talk to someone you trust.
explain.hg: Har dosti mein utaar-chadhav aate hain. Par agar tum baar-baar darr, neecha ya guilty feel karte ho, toh yeh peeche hatne aur kisi trusted insaan se baat karne ka sign hai.

q.en: Your friends mock a boy for crying after his grandfather died. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhare dost ek ladke ka mazaak udate hain kyunki woh apne Dada ke jaane ke baad roya. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Crying is a human reaction, for boys too
options.hg: Rona insaani reaction hai, ladkon ke liye bhi

options.en: Boys should learn to hide their feelings
options.hg: Ladkon ko feelings chhupana seekhna chahiye

options.en: Mocking him will help him toughen up
options.hg: Mazaak udane se woh strong banega

options.en: He should only cry at home, not at school
options.hg: Use sirf ghar par rona chahiye, school mein nahi

explain.en: Grief is painful for everyone. 'Boys don't cry' pushes boys to bottle things up, which can hurt their mental health. Kindness here is simple: sit with him, don't mock.
explain.hg: Dukh sabke liye dard bhara hota hai. 'Ladke rote nahi' wali soch ladkon ko sab andar dabane par majboor karti hai, jo mental health ko hurt kar sakta hai. Yahan kindness simple hai: uske saath baitho, mazaak mat udao.

q.en: At the farewell party, friends push you to try a drink: 'Just one, don't be boring.' What is true?
q.hg: Farewell party mein dost tumhe drink try karne ke liye push karte hain: 'Bas ek, boring mat ban.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: Saying no will make you lose all your friends
options.hg: Na bologe toh saare dost chale jayenge

options.en: One drink is needed to fit in at parties
options.hg: Party mein fit hone ke liye ek drink zaroori hai

options.en: You can say no without a lecture; real friends accept it
options.hg: Bina lecture ke na bol sakte ho; asli dost maan lete hain

options.en: You must give a medical reason to refuse
options.hg: Mana karne ke liye medical reason dena padega

explain.en: A simple 'No thanks, I'm good' is enough, and you can hold a soft drink if it helps. Friends who keep pushing after a no are showing pressure, not friendship.
explain.hg: Simple 'No thanks, main theek hoon' kaafi hai, aur chaho toh haath mein soft drink rakh lo. Jo dost na ke baad bhi push karte rahein, woh pressure dikha rahe hain, dosti nahi.

q.en: Everyone in your class seems to be 'committed'. You're not interested in dating. What is true?
q.hg: Class mein sab 'committed' lagte hain. Tumhe dating mein interest nahi. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Something must be wrong with you
options.hg: Tum mein zaroor kuch gadbad hai

options.en: You should date someone just to fit in
options.hg: Fit hone ke liye kisi ko bhi date kar lo

options.en: That's completely fine; there's no deadline
options.hg: Bilkul theek hai; koi deadline nahi hai

options.en: You will be alone for the rest of your life
options.hg: Tum poori zindagi akele rahoge

explain.en: People are ready for relationships at different times, and some people feel little or no romantic or sexual attraction at all, which is also normal. Your timeline is yours.
explain.hg: Log alag-alag time par relationships ke liye ready hote hain, aur kuch logon ko bahut kam ya bilkul romantic ya sexual attraction nahi hota, yeh bhi normal hai. Tumhari timeline tumhari hai.

q.en: A friend tells you they have a crush on someone of the same gender. What is the best response?
q.hg: Ek dost batata hai ki use same gender ke kisi insaan par crush hai. Sabse achha response kya hai?

options.en: Listen, and keep it private unless asked
options.hg: Suno, aur jab tak na kahein, baat private rakho

options.en: Tell them it's just a phase and will pass
options.hg: Bolo ki yeh bas phase hai, nikal jayega

options.en: Tell others so they can 'help'
options.hg: Doosron ko batao taaki woh 'help' kar sakein

options.en: Avoid them in case people talk
options.hg: Unse door raho, kahin log baatein na karein

explain.en: Sharing this takes trust. Being lesbian, gay or bisexual is a natural variation, not a phase to fix. Telling others without permission (outing) can put someone at real risk.
explain.hg: Yeh share karna trust ki baat hai. Lesbian, gay ya bisexual hona natural variation hai, theek karne wala phase nahi. Bina permission doosron ko batana (outing) kisi ko asli khatre mein daal sakta hai.

q.en: Which is a sign of a healthy relationship?
q.hg: Healthy relationship ki pehchaan kaunsi hai?

options.en: One partner makes all the important decisions
options.hg: Ek partner saare zaroori faisle leta hai

options.en: You must reply to every message within minutes
options.hg: Har message ka jawab minutes mein dena zaroori hai

options.en: Partners share every password with each other
options.hg: Partners ek doosre ko har password dete hain

options.en: Both can say no and see friends without fear
options.hg: Dono bina darr ke na bol sakte hain aur doston se mil sakte hain

explain.en: Healthy relationships have respect, trust and room for each person's own life. Fear, rules and constant checking are signs of control, not closeness.
explain.hg: Healthy relationship mein respect, trust aur har insaan ki apni life ke liye jagah hoti hai. Darr, rules aur lagataar checking control ke sign hain, closeness ke nahi.

q.en: Your partner checks your phone every day 'because they love you'. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara partner roz tumhara phone check karta hai 'kyunki woh tumse pyaar karta hai'. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Love; caring partners keep an eye on you
options.hg: Pyaar; care karne wale partner nazar rakhte hain

options.en: Control; trust doesn't need daily checks
options.hg: Control; trust ko roz checking ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: Normal, as long as you have nothing to hide
options.hg: Normal, jab tak tumhare paas chhupane ko kuch nahi

options.en: Fair, if you checked their phone once
options.hg: Fair, agar tumne ek baar unka phone check kiya tha

explain.en: Love and control can look alike at first. Checking someone's phone regularly is about control and insecurity. A partner who is worried can talk about it instead.
explain.hg: Shuru mein pyaar aur control ek jaise lag sakte hain. Kisi ka phone regularly check karna control aur insecurity ki baat hai. Partner ko fikr hai toh woh baat kar sakta hai.

q.en: Your partner asks for your Instagram password to 'prove you trust them'. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner 'trust prove karne ke liye' tumhara Instagram password maangta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Refusing shows that you are hiding something
options.hg: Mana karne ka matlab tum kuch chhupa rahe ho

options.en: You can say no; privacy is normal in a relationship
options.hg: Tum mana kar sakte ho; relationship mein privacy normal hai

options.en: Every serious couple shares all passwords
options.hg: Har serious couple saare passwords share karta hai

options.en: You have to agree if they share theirs first
options.hg: Agar unhone pehle diya toh tumhe bhi dena padega

explain.en: Trust is shown through honesty and behaviour, not passwords. Sharing logins also makes it easy for someone to control or misuse your account, especially after a breakup.
explain.hg: Trust honesty aur behaviour se dikhta hai, passwords se nahi. Login share karne se kisi ke liye tumhara account control ya misuse karna aasaan ho jata hai, khaaskar breakup ke baad.

q.en: You feel jealous when your partner laughs a lot with a classmate. What is a healthy way to handle it?
q.hg: Partner ko ek classmate ke saath bahut haste dekh kar tumhe jealousy hoti hai. Healthy tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Tell them to stop talking to that classmate
options.hg: Unhe bolo us classmate se baat band karo

options.en: Check their chats to see if anything is going on
options.hg: Unki chats check karo kahin kuch chal toh nahi raha

options.en: Flirt with someone else to make them jealous
options.hg: Unhe jealous karne ke liye kisi aur se flirt karo

options.en: Notice it and talk calmly, without making rules
options.hg: Feeling ko samjho aur shaanti se baat karo, bina rules banaye

explain.en: Jealousy is a feeling, not a fact. Saying 'I felt a bit insecure today' opens a conversation. Rules, spying or revenge damage trust.
explain.hg: Jealousy ek feeling hai, fact nahi. 'Aaj mujhe thoda insecure laga' bolna baat-cheet shuru karta hai. Rules, jasoosi ya badla trust ko kharab karte hain.

q.en: Your partner gets angry whenever you go out with friends and says, 'Them or me.' What is this?
q.hg: Jab bhi tum doston ke saath bahar jate ho, partner gussa hota hai aur kehta hai, 'Woh ya main.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Isolation, a common sign of a controlling partner
options.hg: Isolation, controlling partner ka common sign

options.en: Proof of how much they love you
options.hg: Saboot ki woh tumse kitna pyaar karte hain

options.en: Normal; couples should spend all their time together
options.hg: Normal; couples ko saara time saath bitana chahiye

options.en: A fair request if your friends are fun
options.hg: Fair request agar tumhare dost mazedaar hain

explain.en: Cutting someone off from friends and family makes them easier to control and harder to help. A loving partner wants you to have people who care about you.
explain.hg: Kisi ko doston aur family se kaat dena use control karna aasaan aur help karna mushkil bana deta hai. Pyaar karne wala partner chahta hai ki tumhare paas parwah karne wale log hon.

q.en: In the first two weeks, someone you met on Instagram calls you their soulmate, sends gifts and wants all your time. What should you notice?
q.hg: Pehle do hafton mein Instagram par mila koi tumhe soulmate bolta hai, gifts bhejta hai aur tumhara saara time chahta hai. Kya notice karna chahiye?

options.en: This is what true love at first sight is
options.hg: Yahi pehli nazar ka sachcha pyaar hai

options.en: Gifts prove that they are serious about you
options.hg: Gifts saabit karte hain ki woh serious hain

options.en: Too much, too fast can be a red flag
options.hg: Bahut zyada, bahut jaldi ek red flag ho sakta hai

options.en: You should match their pace to keep them
options.hg: Unhe rakhne ke liye unki speed se chalo

explain.en: Intense attention very early, sometimes called 'love bombing', can be used to build dependence before control begins. Healthy closeness grows at a pace that lets you keep your own life.
explain.hg: Bahut jaldi bahut zyada attention, jise kabhi 'love bombing' kehte hain, control shuru hone se pehle dependence banane ke liye use ho sakta hai. Healthy closeness aisi speed se badhti hai jisme tumhari apni life bani rahe.

q.en: Your partner insists you share your live location with them all day. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner zid karta hai ki tum poore din apni live location share karo. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's for your safety, so you have to agree
options.hg: Tumhari safety ke liye hai, haan bolna padega

options.en: It's normal for every modern couple
options.hg: Har modern couple ke liye normal hai

options.en: Constant tracking is control; you can say no
options.hg: Lagataar tracking control hai; tum na bol sakte ho

options.en: It's fine if they promise not to look often
options.hg: Theek hai agar woh promise karein ki zyada nahi dekhenge

explain.en: Sharing location for a specific trip can be a choice you make. Being required to be trackable all the time is about monitoring you, and you are allowed to refuse.
explain.hg: Kisi ek trip ke liye location share karna tumhari choice ho sakti hai. Har waqt track hone ki shart tumhe monitor karne ki baat hai, aur tum mana kar sakte ho.

q.en: Your partner says, 'If you leave me, I'll hurt myself.' What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner kehta hai, 'Agar tum mujhe chhodoge toh main khud ko hurt kar lunga.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's pressure; get them help, but you aren't to blame
options.hg: Yeh pressure hai; unhe help dilao, par tum zimmedaar nahi

options.en: You must stay, or anything that happens is on you
options.hg: Tumhe rukna padega, warna jo bhi hoga tumhari galti

options.en: They are joking, so you can ignore it fully
options.hg: Woh mazaak kar rahe hain, poori tarah ignore karo

options.en: It proves they love you more than anyone
options.hg: Isse saabit hota hai woh tumhe sabse zyada pyaar karte hain

explain.en: Take any mention of self-harm seriously: tell a trusted adult, and share Tele-MANAS 14416, or call 112 if there is immediate danger. But using it to stop you leaving is emotional pressure, and their choices are not your fault.
explain.hg: Self-harm ki koi bhi baat serious lo: trusted bade ko batao, aur Tele-MANAS 14416 share karo, ya turant khatra ho toh 112 call karo. Par ise tumhe rokne ke liye use karna emotional pressure hai, aur unke faisle tumhari galti nahi.

q.en: Your partner tells you what to wear and sulks if you wear something they don't like. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara partner batata hai kya pehnna hai aur unki pasand ka na pehno toh naraaz ho jata hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Caring about how you look in public
options.hg: Public mein tum kaise dikhte ho iski parwah

options.en: Protection from other people's eyes
options.hg: Doosron ki nazar se protection

options.en: Just a normal part of being in love
options.hg: Bas pyaar mein hone ka normal hissa

options.en: Control over your choices, a warning sign
options.hg: Tumhare faislon par control, ek warning sign

explain.en: Partners can share opinions, but deciding for you, and punishing you with sulking, is control. Your clothes, like your body, are your choice.
explain.hg: Partners apni raay de sakte hain, par tumhare liye decide karna, aur naraazgi se saza dena, control hai. Tumhare kapde, tumhari body ki tarah, tumhari choice hain.

q.en: What does a fair argument between partners look like?
q.hg: Partners ke beech fair behas kaisi dikhti hai?

options.en: Bringing up every old mistake to win the point
options.hg: Point jeetne ke liye har purani galti nikalna

options.en: Talking about the issue, without insults or threats
options.hg: Issue par baat karna, bina gaali ya dhamki ke

options.en: Shouting until the other person gives up
options.hg: Tab tak chillana jab tak doosra haar na maan le

options.en: Ending it by threatening to break up
options.hg: Breakup ki dhamki dekar khatam karna

explain.en: Disagreements are normal. Fair fights stay on the topic, allow breaks to cool down, and avoid name-calling or threats. How you argue matters more than whether you argue.
explain.hg: Disagreement normal hai. Fair behas topic par rehti hai, thanda hone ke liye break leti hai, aur gaali ya dhamki se bachti hai. Behas hoti hai ya nahi se zyada matter karta hai ki kaise hoti hai.

q.en: Your partner yells and breaks things, then apologises with gifts, and the cycle repeats. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner chillata hai aur cheezein todta hai, phir gifts ke saath sorry bolta hai, aur yeh cycle chalta rehta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: The gifts show that they have truly changed
options.hg: Gifts dikhate hain ki woh sach mein badal gaye

options.en: Apologies don't fix it if the behaviour keeps returning
options.hg: Behaviour baar-baar laut aaye toh sorry se theek nahi hota

options.en: It's normal, since every couple fights
options.hg: Normal hai, har couple ladta hai

options.en: It will stop once you stop upsetting them
options.hg: Tum unhe pareshaan karna band karoge toh ruk jayega

explain.en: A cycle of anger, apology and calm is a common pattern in abusive relationships. You are not causing it. Talk to someone you trust; 181 (women) and 112 (emergency) can help.
explain.hg: Gussa, sorry aur shaanti ka cycle abusive relationships ka common pattern hai. Iski wajah tum nahi ho. Kisi trusted insaan se baat karo; 181 (women) aur 112 (emergency) help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Is it okay for a partner to slap you 'just once' in anger if they apologise?
q.hg: Kya partner ka gusse mein 'bas ek baar' thappad maarna theek hai agar woh sorry bol de?

options.en: Yes, if it really was only once
options.hg: Haan, agar sach mein sirf ek baar hua

options.en: Yes, if you had made them very angry
options.hg: Haan, agar tumne unhe bahut gussa dilaya tha

options.en: Yes, as long as nobody else saw it
options.hg: Haan, jab tak kisi aur ne nahi dekha

options.en: No, physical violence is never okay
options.hg: Nahi, physical violence kabhi theek nahi

explain.en: No reason makes hitting a partner acceptable, and it is not your fault. Violence often gets worse over time. Telling someone you trust, or calling 181 or 112, is a strong step.
explain.hg: Partner ko maarne ki koi wajah theek nahi, aur galti tumhari nahi. Violence aksar time ke saath badhti hai. Kisi trusted insaan ko batana, ya 181 ya 112 call karna, ek strong step hai.

q.en: Your partner often says, 'You're nothing without me' or calls you stupid in private. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara partner aksar kehta hai, 'Tum mere bina kuch nahi ho' ya akele mein tumhe bewakoof bolta hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Emotional abuse, even without any hitting
options.hg: Emotional abuse, bina maare bhi

options.en: Honest feedback that helps you improve
options.hg: Honest feedback jo tumhe behtar banata hai

options.en: Teasing that all couples do sometimes
options.hg: Chhed-chhaad jo saare couples kabhi-kabhi karte hain

options.en: Fine, as long as it's not in public
options.hg: Theek hai, jab tak public mein nahi

explain.en: Repeated put-downs wear down self-esteem and make it harder to leave. Abuse is not only physical. Talking to a friend, counsellor or Tele-MANAS 14416 can help you see it clearly.
explain.hg: Baar-baar neecha dikhana self-esteem ko kamzor karta hai aur chhodna mushkil banata hai. Abuse sirf physical nahi hota. Dost, counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 se baat karna cheezon ko saaf dekhne mein help karta hai.

q.en: In films, the hero follows the heroine everywhere after she says no, and it's shown as romantic. What is true?
q.hg: Films mein hero, heroine ke na bolne ke baad bhi har jagah uska peechha karta hai, aur ise romantic dikhaya jata hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Not giving up is how true love wins
options.hg: Haar na maanna hi sachche pyaar ki jeet hai

options.en: It is romantic if the hero is handsome
options.hg: Hero handsome ho toh romantic hai

options.en: Following someone after a no is stalking
options.hg: Na ke baad peechha karna stalking hai

options.en: A no in the start always becomes a yes
options.hg: Shuru ka na hamesha haan ban jata hai

explain.en: Repeatedly following or contacting someone who has said no is stalking, and it is a crime under the BNS. Real respect means taking a no seriously the first time.
explain.hg: Na bolne wale ka baar-baar peechha karna ya contact karna stalking hai, aur BNS ke tahat crime hai. Asli respect ka matlab hai pehli baar mein na ko serious lena.

q.en: People say, 'Possessive means he really cares.' What is true?
q.hg: Log kehte hain, 'Possessive hai matlab sach mein care karta hai.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: A little possessiveness proves true love
options.hg: Thoda possessive hona sachcha pyaar saabit karta hai

options.en: Only girls should be possessive
options.hg: Sirf ladkiyon ko possessive hona chahiye

options.en: Possessiveness is about control, not care
options.hg: Possessiveness control ki baat hai, care ki nahi

options.en: It's a problem only after marriage
options.hg: Problem sirf shaadi ke baad hai

explain.en: Care sounds like 'Text me when you reach home if you like.' Possessiveness sounds like 'You can't go without me.' One supports your freedom; the other limits it.
explain.hg: Care aisa lagta hai: 'Ghar pahunch kar text kar dena, agar theek lage.' Possessiveness aisa: 'Tum mere bina nahi jaoge.' Ek tumhari azadi ko support karta hai, doosra use rokta hai.

q.en: Your elder brother checks your sister's phone and tells her which friends she can have, 'for her protection'. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara bada bhai behen ka phone check karta hai aur batata hai kaun se dost rakh sakti hai, 'uski protection ke liye'. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Caring means trust and talking, not policing her
options.hg: Care ka matlab trust aur baat-cheet hai, nigrani nahi

options.en: Brothers have the right to control sisters
options.hg: Bhaiyon ko behenon ko control karne ka haq hai

options.en: It's protection, so she should be grateful
options.hg: Yeh protection hai, use shukriya karna chahiye

options.en: It's fine as long as parents allow it
options.hg: Theek hai jab tak parents allow karein

explain.en: Siblings can worry and offer help. Controlling someone's phone and friendships, whatever the gender, takes away their freedom and makes them less likely to ask for help when they need it.
explain.hg: Bhai-behen fikr kar sakte hain aur help offer kar sakte hain. Kisi ke phone aur dosti ko control karna, gender kuch bhi ho, unki azadi chheenta hai aur zaroorat par help maangne ke chance kam karta hai.

q.en: A girl hits her boyfriend when she is angry, and his friends laugh it off. What is true?
q.hg: Ek ladki gusse mein apne boyfriend ko maarti hai, aur uske dost has kar taal dete hain. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's not serious if a girl does it
options.hg: Ladki kare toh serious nahi hai

options.en: He must have deserved it somehow
options.hg: Usne zaroor kuch kiya hoga

options.en: Real men just take it quietly
options.hg: Asli mard chupchaap seh lete hain

options.en: Abuse is abuse, whatever the gender
options.hg: Abuse abuse hai, gender kuch bhi ho

explain.en: Boys and men can face violence in relationships too, and shame often keeps them silent. He deserves to be taken seriously and supported, just like anyone else.
explain.hg: Ladkon aur mardon ke saath bhi relationships mein violence hoti hai, aur sharam aksar unhe chup rakhti hai. Unhe bhi kisi aur ki tarah serious liya jana aur support milna chahiye.

q.en: Your partner says, 'If you loved me, you would do this for me.' What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara partner kehta hai, 'Agar tum mujhse pyaar karte, toh mere liye yeh karte.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A fair test of how much you love them
options.hg: Tumhare pyaar ka fair test

options.en: A guilt trip, using love as pressure
options.hg: Guilt trip, pyaar ko pressure ki tarah use karna

options.en: A sweet way of asking for something
options.hg: Kuch maangne ka pyaara tareeka

options.en: Proof that you don't love them enough
options.hg: Saboot ki tum unse kaafi pyaar nahi karte

explain.en: Love doesn't have to be proved by doing things you don't want to do. A partner who loves you will accept your no, even if they feel disappointed.
explain.hg: Pyaar ko aisi cheezein karke saabit nahi karna padta jo tum nahi chahte. Jo partner tumse pyaar karta hai woh tumhara na maan lega, chahe use disappointment ho.

q.en: Your partner keeps asking for intimate photos and says, 'If you trust me, you'll send them.' You are 16. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner baar-baar intimate photos maangta hai aur kehta hai, 'Trust karte ho toh bhejoge.' Tum 16 saal ke ho. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Sending one is fine if you trust them
options.hg: Trust hai toh ek bhejna theek hai

options.en: It's pressure, and such images of minors are illegal
options.hg: Yeh pressure hai, aur minors ki aisi images illegal hain

options.en: It's legal if you both are under 18
options.hg: Legal hai agar dono 18 se kam ho

options.en: It's fine if your face is not in the photo
options.hg: Theek hai agar photo mein chehra nahi

explain.en: Sexual images of anyone under 18 are treated as child sexual abuse material, which is illegal to make, share or keep. You can say no. If you feel pressured or threatened, tell a trusted adult or call 1098.
explain.hg: 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ki sexual images child sexual abuse material maani jati hain, jinhe banana, share karna ya rakhna illegal hai. Tum na bol sakte ho. Pressure ya dhamki mile toh trusted bade ko batao ya 1098 call karo.

q.en: Your friend's boyfriend decides who she can talk to. She says it's fine. What can you do as her friend?
q.hg: Tumhari dost ka boyfriend decide karta hai woh kisse baat karegi. Woh kehti hai sab theek hai. Dost ke roop mein kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Tell her she's stupid for staying with him
options.hg: Bolo ki usse rehna bewakoofi hai

options.en: Cut her off until she breaks up with him
options.hg: Jab tak breakup na kare tab tak usse baat band

options.en: Confront the boyfriend in front of everyone
options.hg: Sabke saamne boyfriend se ladai karo

options.en: Stay close and gently share what you've noticed
options.hg: Uske paas raho aur pyaar se batao tumne kya notice kiya

explain.en: People in controlling relationships often get cut off from friends. Staying in touch, without judging, means she has someone to turn to when she is ready.
explain.hg: Controlling relationships mein log aksar doston se kat jate hain. Bina judge kiye contact mein rehne ka matlab hai jab woh ready hogi, uske paas koi hoga.

q.en: Your partner insists you drop out of coaching classes because they 'worry about the boys there'. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara partner zid karta hai ki coaching chhod do kyunki use 'wahan ke ladkon ki fikr hai'. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Control that limits your future
options.hg: Control jo tumhara future rokta hai

options.en: Normal worry from a caring partner
options.hg: Care karne wale partner ki normal fikr

options.en: A small sacrifice worth making for love
options.hg: Pyaar ke liye chhoti si qurbani

options.en: Fair, if they also skip something for you
options.hg: Fair, agar woh bhi tumhare liye kuch chhodein

explain.en: Stopping a partner from studying, working or meeting people is a serious red flag. A partner's insecurity is theirs to work on; it should not shrink your life.
explain.hg: Partner ko padhne, kaam karne ya logon se milne se rokna serious red flag hai. Partner ki insecurity unhe khud theek karni hai; isse tumhari life chhoti nahi honi chahiye.

q.en: How is trust built in a relationship?
q.hg: Relationship mein trust kaise banta hai?

options.en: By checking each other's phones regularly
options.hg: Ek doosre ka phone regularly check karne se

options.en: By spending every free minute together
options.hg: Har free minute saath bitane se

options.en: By keeping promises and being honest over time
options.hg: Time ke saath vaade nibhane aur honest rehne se

options.en: By never telling each other about problems
options.hg: Ek doosre ko kabhi problems na batane se

explain.en: Trust grows when words and actions match again and again. Surveillance and secrecy both damage it.
explain.hg: Trust tab badhta hai jab words aur actions baar-baar match karte hain. Nigrani aur secrecy dono ise kharab karte hain.

q.en: Your partner wants to talk about something that upset them. What is good listening?
q.hg: Tumhara partner kisi baat par baat karna chahta hai jisse woh upset hua. Achhi listening kya hai?

options.en: Interrupt to explain your side quickly
options.hg: Beech mein tok kar apni side jaldi samjhao

options.en: Scroll your phone so it feels less tense
options.hg: Phone scroll karo taaki tension kam lage

options.en: Listen fully, then say back what you heard
options.hg: Poori baat suno, phir batao tumne kya samjha

options.en: Change the topic to something happier
options.hg: Topic badal kar kuch khushi wali baat karo

explain.en: Repeating what you heard ('So you felt ignored when…') shows you understood before you reply. Most people calm down when they feel heard.
explain.hg: Jo suna use dohrana ('Matlab tumhe ignore feel hua jab…') dikhata hai ki jawab dene se pehle tumne samjha. Zyadatar log sune jaane par shaant ho jate hain.

q.en: Your partner makes hurtful jokes about you in front of friends and says, 'Chill, it's just a joke.' What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner doston ke saamne tumhare baare mein hurtful jokes karta hai aur kehta hai, 'Chill, bas mazaak hai.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: Your hurt is real, and you can ask them to stop
options.hg: Tumhara hurt asli hai, aur tum rukne ko keh sakte ho

options.en: You are too sensitive and should laugh along
options.hg: Tum zyada sensitive ho, saath mein haso

options.en: Jokes can never be hurtful between couples
options.hg: Couples ke beech jokes kabhi hurt nahi karte

options.en: You should embarrass them back next time
options.hg: Agli baar tum bhi unhe sharminda karo

explain.en: 'Just a joke' can be used to put someone down while avoiding blame. A caring partner stops when they learn a joke hurts you.
explain.hg: 'Bas mazaak hai' kisi ko neecha dikhakar blame se bachne ke liye use ho sakta hai. Care karne wala partner jaan-ne par ruk jata hai ki mazaak tumhe hurt karta hai.

q.en: After an argument, your partner gives you the silent treatment for days as punishment. What can you do?
q.hg: Behas ke baad partner saza ke taur par kai din tak tumse baat nahi karta. Tum kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Beg and apologise for everything, right or wrong
options.hg: Har baat ke liye minnat aur sorry karo, sahi ho ya galat

options.en: Give the silent treatment back for longer
options.hg: Unse bhi zyada din tak baat band karo

options.en: Post about it publicly to get them to respond
options.hg: Jawab paane ke liye public mein post karo

options.en: Say you'd like to talk when they're ready, then wait
options.hg: Bolo ki jab woh ready hon tab baat karna chahoge, phir wait karo

explain.en: Needing time to cool off is fine; using silence to punish is not. You can offer to talk and set a limit for yourself if this keeps happening.
explain.hg: Thanda hone ke liye time chahiye, yeh theek hai; chuppi ko saza ki tarah use karna nahi. Tum baat karne ki offer kar sakte ho, aur baar-baar ho toh apne liye limit set kar sakte ho.

q.en: You keep changing your clothes, friends and hobbies to please your partner. What does this suggest?
q.hg: Tum partner ko khush karne ke liye apne kapde, dost aur hobbies badalte ja rahe ho. Isse kya pata chalta hai?

options.en: This is what commitment always looks like
options.hg: Commitment hamesha aisa hi dikhta hai

options.en: You may be losing yourself in the relationship
options.hg: Shayad tum rishte mein khud ko kho rahe ho

options.en: You are finally becoming a better person
options.hg: Tum aakhir mein behtar insaan ban rahe ho

options.en: Your partner simply has better taste
options.hg: Tumhare partner ki pasand bas behtar hai

explain.en: Growing together is good, but a relationship shouldn't need you to give up who you are. Check in with friends you trust; they often notice changes first.
explain.hg: Saath mein badhna achha hai, par relationship ko tumse yeh nahi chahiye ki tum apni pehchaan chhod do. Trusted doston se baat karo; aksar unhe badlav pehle dikhta hai.

q.en: You compare your relationship with couples on Instagram and feel yours isn't good enough. What is true?
q.hg: Tum apne relationship ko Instagram couples se compare karte ho aur lagta hai tumhara kaafi achha nahi. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Those couples never really fight
options.hg: Woh couples kabhi sach mein nahi ladte

options.en: Social media shows only the highlights
options.hg: Social media sirf highlights dikhata hai

options.en: Expensive gifts prove a better relationship
options.hg: Mehenge gifts behtar relationship saabit karte hain

options.en: You should post more to make it real
options.hg: Ise real banane ke liye zyada post karo

explain.en: Posts are chosen and edited. What matters is how you feel together: respected, safe and happy, not how it looks online.
explain.hg: Posts chun kar aur edit karke daale jate hain. Matter yeh karta hai ki saath mein tum kaisa feel karte ho: respected, safe aur khush, yeh nahi ki online kaisa dikhta hai.

q.en: Is it okay to end a friendship that keeps making you feel bad?
q.hg: Kya aisi dosti khatam karna theek hai jo baar-baar tumhe bura feel karati hai?

options.en: No, old friends must be kept at any cost
options.hg: Nahi, purane dost har keemat par rakhne chahiye

options.en: Only if your parents agree to it first
options.hg: Sirf tab jab parents pehle is par maan jayein

options.en: Only if the friend apologises first
options.hg: Sirf tab jab dost pehle sorry bole

options.en: Yes, you can step back from a hurtful friendship
options.hg: Haan, hurt karne wali dosti se peeche hat sakte ho

explain.en: You can try talking first, but you don't owe anyone a friendship that leaves you feeling small or unsafe. Stepping back kindly and calmly is a form of self-respect.
explain.hg: Pehle baat karke dekh sakte ho, par aisi dosti nibhana zaroori nahi jo tumhe chhota ya unsafe feel karaye. Pyaar aur shaanti se peeche hatna self-respect hai.

q.en: Someone you turned down keeps sending friends to 'convince' you. What is true?
q.hg: Jise tumne mana kiya, woh tumhe 'manane' ke liye doston ko bhejta rehta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's pressure; you can repeat your no
options.hg: Yeh pressure hai; tum apna na dohra sakte ho

options.en: It shows how serious and sweet they are
options.hg: Isse pata chalta hai woh kitne serious aur sweet hain

options.en: You should say yes to stop the drama
options.hg: Drama rokne ke liye haan bol do

options.en: Their friends' opinions should change your mind
options.hg: Unke doston ki raay se tumhara mann badalna chahiye

explain.en: A no doesn't need a committee to review it. Sending others to push you ignores your answer. You can block, tell a teacher or parent, and keep messages as proof if it continues.
explain.hg: Na ko review karne ke liye committee nahi chahiye. Doosron ko push karne bhejna tumhare jawab ko ignore karta hai. Tum block kar sakte ho, teacher ya parent ko bata sakte ho, aur aage bhi chale toh messages saboot ke liye rakho.

q.en: Why might someone find it hard to leave a partner who hurts them?
q.hg: Koi apne hurt karne wale partner ko chhodna mushkil kyun pa sakta hai?

options.en: Because they secretly enjoy being treated badly
options.hg: Kyunki unhe chupke se bura bartaav achha lagta hai

options.en: Because leaving is always easy and safe
options.hg: Kyunki chhodna hamesha aasaan aur safe hai

options.en: Fear, love, money or family pressure can all hold them
options.hg: Darr, pyaar, paise ya family pressure, sab unhe rok sakte hain

options.en: Because they don't care enough about themselves
options.hg: Kyunki unhe apni parwah hi nahi

explain.en: Leaving can be complicated and even dangerous. Asking 'Why don't you just leave?' blames the person being hurt. Support without judgement helps more.
explain.hg: Chhodna complicated aur khatarnak bhi ho sakta hai. 'Chhod kyun nahi dete?' poochhna hurt hone wale ko blame karta hai. Bina judge kiye support zyada help karta hai.

q.en: Why might someone feel deeply attached to a partner who keeps hurting them?
q.hg: Koi baar-baar hurt karne wale partner se gehra lagaav kyun mehsoos kar sakta hai?

options.en: Because the hurt shows how passionate the love is
options.hg: Kyunki hurt dikhata hai pyaar kitna gehra hai

options.en: Because it means the relationship is meant to be
options.hg: Kyunki iska matlab yeh rishta kismat mein hai

options.en: Cycles of hurt and affection can create a strong bond
options.hg: Hurt aur pyaar ke cycles strong bond bana sakte hain

options.en: Because they must be weak-minded people
options.hg: Kyunki woh zaroor kamzor dimaag ke log hain

explain.en: When kindness and cruelty alternate, the good moments feel extra powerful and keep hope alive. This is a known pattern and not a personal weakness. A counsellor can help untangle it.
explain.hg: Jab kindness aur cruelty baari-baari aati hai, toh achhe moments bahut powerful lagte hain aur umeed zinda rakhte hain. Yeh ek jaana-maana pattern hai, kamzori nahi. Counsellor ise suljhane mein help kar sakta hai.

q.en: Your friend is in a hurtful relationship but isn't ready to leave. What is the most helpful thing?
q.hg: Tumhari dost ek hurtful relationship mein hai par abhi chhodne ke liye ready nahi. Sabse helpful kya hai?

options.en: Keep supporting her and share where help is available
options.hg: Uska saath dete raho aur batao help kahan milti hai

options.en: Give her an ultimatum: him or your friendship
options.hg: Ultimatum do: woh ya tumhari dosti

options.en: Tell everyone so that people pressure her
options.hg: Sabko batao taaki log us par pressure daalein

options.en: Stop listening until she decides to leave
options.hg: Jab tak woh chhodne ka faisla na kare tab tak sunna band

explain.en: Ultimatums can isolate her further. Staying in her corner, believing her and sharing options like 181, 112 or a counsellor means she has a way out when she's ready. If she is in immediate danger, call 112.
explain.hg: Ultimatum use aur akela kar sakta hai. Uske saath rehna, uski baat maanna aur 181, 112 ya counsellor jaise options batana matlab ready hone par uske paas raasta hoga. Turant khatra ho toh 112 call karo.

q.en: Your queer friend's partner threatens to tell their family about their sexuality if they break up. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhare queer dost ka partner dhamki deta hai ki breakup kiya toh uski sexuality ke baare mein family ko bata dega. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A normal fight that every couple goes through
options.hg: Normal jhagda jo har couple mein hota hai

options.en: Fair, since the family will find out one day
options.hg: Fair, family ko ek din pata chal hi jayega

options.en: Honesty, because secrets are bad for families
options.hg: Honesty, kyunki secrets family ke liye bure hain

options.en: Abuse; threatening to out someone is a form of control
options.hg: Abuse; kisi ko out karne ki dhamki control ka roop hai

explain.en: Coming out is a personal decision about when and to whom. Using it as a threat is emotional abuse and blackmail. Help your friend find safe, queer-friendly support.
explain.hg: Coming out ek personal faisla hai ki kab aur kisko batana hai. Ise dhamki ki tarah use karna emotional abuse aur blackmail hai. Dost ko safe, queer-friendly support dhoondhne mein help karo.

q.en: Are the signs of a healthy relationship different for same-sex couples?
q.hg: Kya same-sex couples ke liye healthy relationship ke signs alag hote hain?

options.en: Yes, same-sex couples have no real rules
options.hg: Haan, same-sex couples ke koi asli rules nahi hote

options.en: No, respect and trust matter for everyone
options.hg: Nahi, respect aur trust sabke liye matter karte hain

options.en: Yes, jealousy is healthier in same-sex couples
options.hg: Haan, same-sex couples mein jealousy zyada healthy hai

options.en: Yes, one partner must always lead
options.hg: Haan, ek partner ko hamesha lead karna chahiye

explain.en: Healthy and unhealthy patterns are the same in every kind of relationship. Queer couples deserve the same respect, and the same help if things go wrong.
explain.hg: Healthy aur unhealthy patterns har tarah ke rishte mein same hote hain. Queer couples ko bhi utni hi respect, aur kuch galat ho toh utni hi help milni chahiye.

q.en: A 15-year-old's new 'boyfriend' is 23 and asks her to keep it secret from her family. What is true?
q.hg: Ek 15 saal ki ladki ka naya 'boyfriend' 23 saal ka hai aur kehta hai family se secret rakho. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Age doesn't matter if they truly love each other
options.hg: Sachcha pyaar ho toh umar matter nahi karti

options.en: It's a serious red flag; she should tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Yeh serious red flag hai; use trusted bade ko batana chahiye

options.en: It's fine if he treats her well and buys gifts
options.hg: Theek hai agar woh achha bartaav kare aur gifts de

options.en: Secrecy is normal in every new relationship
options.hg: Har naye rishte mein secrecy normal hai

explain.en: An adult seeking a relationship with a child, and asking for secrecy, is a classic grooming pattern. Any sexual activity with her would be an offence under POCSO. A trusted adult or 1098 can help.
explain.hg: Ek adult ka bachche ke saath rishta chahna aur secrecy maangna grooming ka classic pattern hai. Uske saath koi bhi sexual activity POCSO ke tahat offence hogi. Trusted bada ya 1098 help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Someone you have chatted with online for months always has excuses not to video call. What should you consider?
q.hg: Jisse tum mahino se online chat kar rahe ho, woh video call na karne ke hamesha bahane banata hai. Kya sochna chahiye?

options.en: They are probably just very shy
options.hg: Woh shayad bas bahut sharmile hain

options.en: Real love doesn't need to see a face
options.hg: Sachche pyaar ko chehra dekhne ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: You should send photos to build trust
options.hg: Trust banane ke liye tum photos bhejo

options.en: They may not be who they say they are
options.hg: Ho sakta hai woh woh na hon jo bolte hain

explain.en: Fake profiles often avoid video calls. Be careful with personal details and photos, never meet alone, and tell someone you trust. Report fraud or threats at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.
explain.hg: Fake profiles aksar video call se bachte hain. Personal details aur photos ke saath dhyaan rakho, kabhi akele mat milo, aur kisi trusted insaan ko batao. Fraud ya dhamki ho toh cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo.

q.en: You want to end a relationship. What is a respectful way to do it?
q.hg: Tum ek relationship khatam karna chahte ho. Respectful tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Be honest and clear, in a way that feels safe for you
options.hg: Honest aur clear raho, aise jo tumhare liye safe ho

options.en: Start ignoring them until they get the hint
options.hg: Unhe ignore karna shuru karo jab tak woh samajh na jayein

options.en: Tell their friends first so the news spreads
options.hg: Pehle unke doston ko batao taaki khabar phail jaye

options.en: Change your status online and say nothing
options.hg: Online status badal do aur kuch mat bolo

explain.en: A short, honest conversation ('I don't want to continue, and here's why if you want to know') is kinder than slow ignoring. If you fear their reaction, do it by message or with someone nearby.
explain.hg: Chhoti, honest baat ('Main aage nahi badhna chahta, chaho toh wajah bata doon') dheere-dheere ignore karne se zyada kind hai. Agar unke reaction se darr lagta hai toh message se ya kisi ko paas rakh kar karo.

q.en: After a breakup, your ex keeps messaging you from new numbers after you've blocked them. What is true?
q.hg: Breakup ke baad tumhara ex block karne ke baad bhi naye numbers se message karta rehta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's romantic; they just can't let go
options.hg: Romantic hai; woh bas bhool nahi pa rahe

options.en: You must reply once so they will stop
options.hg: Ek baar reply karna padega taaki woh ruk jayein

options.en: It's harassment; keep proof and get help
options.hg: Yeh harassment hai; saboot rakho aur help lo

options.en: It's your fault for ending things badly
options.hg: Galti tumhari hai ki tumne theek se khatam nahi kiya

explain.en: Repeated contact after a clear no can be stalking under the BNS. Save screenshots, tell a trusted adult and report at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930. Call 112 if you feel unsafe.
explain.hg: Clear na ke baad baar-baar contact BNS ke tahat stalking ho sakta hai. Screenshots save karo, trusted bade ko batao aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo. Unsafe lage toh 112 call karo.

q.en: Feeling sad, angry or empty for weeks after a breakup is…
q.hg: Breakup ke baad hafton tak udaas, gussa ya khaali feel karna…

options.en: a sign that you should get back together
options.hg: sign hai ki tumhe wapas saath aana chahiye

options.en: weakness that you should hide from everyone
options.hg: kamzori hai jo sabse chhupani chahiye

options.en: normal; talking to people helps it ease
options.hg: normal hai; logon se baat karne se halka hota hai

options.en: proof that you will never love again
options.hg: saboot hai ki tum phir kabhi pyaar nahi karoge

explain.en: Breakups really hurt and grief takes time. Sleep, friends and routine help. If the sadness doesn't lift or you think of harming yourself, reach out to Tele-MANAS 14416 or a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Breakup sach mein hurt karta hai aur dukh ko time lagta hai. Neend, dost aur routine help karte hain. Agar udaasi na jaye ya khud ko harm karne ke khayal aayein, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 ya trusted bade se baat karo.

q.en: After your breakup, a friend suggests posting screenshots of your ex's private chats 'to expose them'. What should you do?
q.hg: Breakup ke baad ek dost suggest karta hai ki ex ki private chats ke screenshots post karo 'unhe expose karne ke liye'. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Don't; it hurts them and may break the law
options.hg: Mat karo; isse unhe hurt hota hai aur law toot sakta hai

options.en: Post them, since they hurt you first
options.hg: Post karo, unhone pehle tumhe hurt kiya

options.en: Post them only in a private group
options.hg: Sirf private group mein post karo

options.en: Post them, but hide their name first
options.hg: Post karo, par pehle unka naam chhupa do

explain.en: Sharing someone's private messages or images to shame them is a violation of their privacy and can be an offence. Anger after a breakup is valid; talk it out with friends instead.
explain.hg: Kisi ko sharminda karne ke liye uske private messages ya images share karna privacy ka violation hai aur offence ho sakta hai. Breakup ke baad gussa jayaz hai; doston se baat karke nikalo.

q.en: You've chatted with someone for a month and want to stop. What is the kinder choice?
q.hg: Tum ek mahine se kisi se chat kar rahe ho aur ab rukna chahte ho. Zyada kind choice kya hai?

options.en: Disappear completely without a word
options.hg: Bina kuch bole poori tarah gayab ho jao

options.en: Reply slower and slower until they stop
options.hg: Dheere-dheere reply karo jab tak woh ruk na jayein

options.en: Ask a friend to tell them for you
options.hg: Kisi dost se bolo ki tumhari taraf se bata de

options.en: A short honest message, unless you feel unsafe
options.hg: Chhota honest message, jab tak tum unsafe na feel karo

explain.en: Ghosting leaves people confused. 'I've enjoyed chatting, but I'm not feeling a connection' takes a minute. If someone is pushy or scary, blocking without explaining is completely fine.
explain.hg: Ghosting logon ko confuse chhod deta hai. 'Chat achhi lagi, par mujhe connection feel nahi ho raha' ek minute leta hai. Agar koi pushy ya darawna ho, toh bina samjhaye block karna bilkul theek hai.

q.en: Can you stay friends with an ex?
q.hg: Kya ex ke saath dost reh sakte ho?

options.en: No, exes always end up as enemies
options.hg: Nahi, ex hamesha dushman ban jate hain

options.en: Some can, some need distance; both are okay
options.hg: Kuch reh paate hain, kuch ko doori chahiye; dono theek hai

options.en: Yes, you are required to stay friends
options.hg: Haan, dost rehna zaroori hai

options.en: Only if you plan to get back together
options.hg: Sirf tab jab wapas saath aane ka plan ho

explain.en: There's no rule. If both people feel comfortable and respected, friendship can work. If seeing them keeps reopening the hurt, taking space is healthy.
explain.hg: Koi rule nahi hai. Agar dono comfortable aur respected feel karein toh dosti chal sakti hai. Agar unhe dekh kar baar-baar dard taaza ho, toh space lena healthy hai.

q.en: Your friend just went through a breakup. How can you support them?
q.hg: Tumhare dost ka abhi breakup hua hai. Tum kaise support kar sakte ho?

options.en: Tell them to get over it in a day
options.hg: Bolo ki ek din mein bhool jao

options.en: Listen, spend time with them and check in later
options.hg: Suno, unke saath time bitao aur baad mein haal poochho

options.en: Push them to start dating someone new now
options.hg: Unhe abhi kisi naye ko date karne ke liye push karo

options.en: Keep showing them their ex's new photos
options.hg: Unhe ex ki nayi photos dikhate raho

explain.en: Breakups are a kind of loss. Being around, listening without judging, and inviting them out gently helps more than advice. Notice if they seem very low for a long time.
explain.hg: Breakup ek tarah ka loss hai. Saath rehna, bina judge kiye sunna, aur pyaar se bahar bulana advice se zyada help karta hai. Agar woh lambe time tak bahut low lagein toh dhyaan do.

q.en: After a breakup, your ex spreads rumours about you in the college group. What is the best first step?
q.hg: Breakup ke baad tumhara ex college group mein tumhare baare mein afwaahein phailata hai. Sabse achha pehla step kya hai?

options.en: Spread even worse rumours about them
options.hg: Unke baare mein usse bhi buri afwaahein phailao

options.en: Leave college to avoid everyone there
options.hg: Wahan sabse bachne ke liye college chhod do

options.en: Argue with everyone in the group chat
options.hg: Group chat mein sabse behas karo

options.en: Save evidence and talk to someone who can act
options.hg: Saboot save karo aur action le sakne wale se baat karo

explain.en: Screenshots help if you report it to a teacher, the college grievance cell or, for threats or sexual content, cybercrime.gov.in or 1930. Getting back at them usually makes things worse.
explain.hg: Screenshots help karte hain agar tum teacher, college grievance cell, ya dhamki ya sexual content ho toh cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo. Badla lene se aksar baat aur bigadti hai.

q.en: You keep checking your ex's profile through a fake account after they blocked you. What is true?
q.hg: Ex ne tumhe block kar diya, phir bhi tum fake account se unki profile check karte rehte ho. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It crosses their boundary and can become stalking
options.hg: Yeh unki boundary todta hai aur stalking ban sakta hai

options.en: It's harmless as long as you don't message
options.hg: Jab tak message nahi karte tab tak harmless hai

options.en: It just shows how much you still care
options.hg: Bas dikhata hai tumhe abhi bhi kitni parwah hai

options.en: Everyone does it, so it's acceptable
options.hg: Sab karte hain, isliye theek hai

explain.en: Blocking is a clear message. Repeatedly monitoring someone online against their wishes can count as stalking under the BNS, and it also keeps your own pain fresh. Talking to someone can help you move on.
explain.hg: Block karna clear message hai. Kisi ki marzi ke khilaf baar-baar online nigrani BNS ke tahat stalking maani ja sakti hai, aur yeh tumhara apna dard bhi taaza rakhta hai. Kisi se baat karna aage badhne mein help kar sakta hai.

q.en: You are 17 and want to tell your parents you are in a relationship. What helps the conversation?
q.hg: Tum 17 saal ke ho aur mummy-papa ko batana chahte ho ki tum relationship mein ho. Baat-cheet mein kya help karta hai?

options.en: Telling them during a big family fight
options.hg: Bade family jhagde ke beech batana

options.en: Lying about it until you turn 25
options.hg: 25 ke hone tak jhooth bolte rehna

options.en: Being honest and listening to their worries too
options.hg: Honest rehna aur unki fikr bhi sunna

options.en: Getting a cousin to tell them for you
options.hg: Cousin se apni taraf se batwana

explain.en: Parents often worry about safety and studies. Sharing what matters to you, listening to them and agreeing on some ground rules builds trust, even if the first talk is awkward.
explain.hg: Parents aksar safety aur padhai ki fikr karte hain. Apni baat batana, unki sunna aur kuch ground rules par agree karna trust banata hai, chahe pehli baat awkward ho.

q.en: Your parent read your diary without asking. How can you talk about it?
q.hg: Mummy ya papa ne bina poochhe tumhari diary padh li. Is baare mein kaise baat karo?

options.en: Stop speaking to them for a week
options.hg: Ek hafte tak unse baat band

options.en: Read their phone to make it even
options.hg: Hisaab barabar karne ke liye unka phone padho

options.en: Calmly say how it felt and suggest ground rules
options.hg: Shaanti se batao kaisa laga aur ground rules suggest karo

options.en: Pretend that it never even happened
options.hg: Aise dikhao jaise kuch hua hi nahi

explain.en: Parents of young people do have a duty to keep them safe, and privacy matters too. Saying 'I felt hurt when you read it; can you ask me if you're worried?' opens a fair conversation.
explain.hg: Bachchon ko safe rakhna parents ki zimmedaari hai, aur privacy bhi matter karti hai. 'Aapne padha toh mujhe bura laga; fikr ho toh mujhse poochh lena?' bolna ek fair baat-cheet shuru karta hai.

q.en: If you ever meet someone you only know online, what is the safest plan?
q.hg: Agar kabhi kisi aise insaan se milo jise sirf online jaante ho, toh sabse safe plan kya hai?

options.en: Meet in public and tell someone where you are
options.hg: Public jagah milo aur kisi ko batao tum kahan ho

options.en: Meet at their home so it feels relaxed
options.hg: Unke ghar milo taaki relaxed lage

options.en: Go alone and keep the meeting a secret
options.hg: Akele jao aur milne ki baat secret rakho

options.en: Let them pick you up from your home
options.hg: Unhe apne ghar se pick karne do

explain.en: People online may not be who they say. A public place, your own transport and someone who knows where you are keep you in control. If you are under 18, involve a parent or trusted adult.
explain.hg: Online log woh nahi bhi ho sakte jo bolte hain. Public jagah, apni transport aur koi jo jaane tum kahan ho, tumhe control mein rakhta hai. 18 se kam ho toh parent ya trusted bade ko shamil karo.

q.en: Your dating-app match refuses to video call, shares a sad story and asks to borrow money. What is this likely to be?
q.hg: Tumhara dating-app match video call se mana karta hai, dukh bhari kahani sunata hai aur paise udhaar maangta hai. Yeh kya ho sakta hai?

options.en: A genuine person in a tough spot
options.hg: Mushkil mein ek sachcha insaan

options.en: A test of how much you care
options.hg: Tumhari parwah ka test

options.en: A normal step in online dating
options.hg: Online dating ka normal step

options.en: A romance scam; stop and report it
options.hg: Romance scam; ruko aur report karo

explain.en: Avoiding video, moving fast emotionally and asking for money are classic scam signs. Don't send money or personal photos. Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, especially if money is already gone.
explain.hg: Video se bachna, emotionally jaldi aage badhna aur paise maangna classic scam signs hain. Paise ya personal photos mat bhejo. cybercrime.gov.in par report karo ya 1930 call karo, khaaskar agar paise ja chuke hain.

q.en: On a first date, your date orders for you, mocks your clothes and insists on dropping you home after you said no. What should you notice?
q.hg: Pehli date par tumhari date tumhare liye order karti hai, kapdon ka mazaak udati hai aur na bolne ke baad bhi ghar chhodne ki zid karti hai. Kya notice karna chahiye?

options.en: They are confident and like to take charge
options.hg: Woh confident hain aur charge lena pasand karte hain

options.en: Ignoring small no's early on is a red flag
options.hg: Shuru mein chhote na ko ignore karna red flag hai

options.en: This is how a gentleman shows interest
options.hg: Gentleman aise hi interest dikhata hai

options.en: Nerves make everyone act like this
options.hg: Ghabrahat mein sab aisa karte hain

explain.en: How someone treats small boundaries often shows how they will treat big ones. You can end the date, get home on your own, and trust that feeling.
explain.hg: Koi chhoti boundaries ke saath kaisa bartaav karta hai, aksar wahi dikhata hai ki badi boundaries ke saath kaisa karega. Tum date khatam kar sakte ho, khud ghar ja sakte ho, aur us feeling par bharosa karo.

q.en: Your spouse takes your entire salary and gives you a small allowance, and gets angry if you ask about money. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara spouse tumhari poori salary le leta hai, thoda sa kharcha deta hai, aur paison ke baare mein poochho toh gussa hota hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Smart budgeting by the family's money manager
options.hg: Ghar ke money manager ki smart budgeting

options.en: Economic abuse, a form of domestic violence
options.hg: Economic abuse, domestic violence ka ek roop

options.en: A normal arrangement in most marriages
options.hg: Zyadatar shaadiyon mein normal arrangement

options.en: Fine, as long as there is no hitting
options.hg: Theek hai, jab tak maar-peet nahi

explain.en: Controlling someone's money to make them dependent is economic abuse. The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 recognises it, along with physical, sexual and emotional abuse. 181 can guide you.
explain.hg: Kisi ke paison ko control karke use dependent banana economic abuse hai. Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ise physical, sexual aur emotional abuse ke saath maanta hai. 181 guide kar sakta hai.

q.en: After the wedding, the in-laws demand more dowry and taunt the bride daily. What is true?
q.hg: Shaadi ke baad sasural wale aur dahej maangte hain aur roz bahu ko taane dete hain. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is tradition, so she should adjust
options.hg: Yeh parampara hai, use adjust karna chahiye

options.en: It's legal if it is called a 'gift'
options.hg: Agar 'gift' bola jaye toh legal hai

options.en: Only physical harm can be reported
options.hg: Sirf physical harm report ho sakta hai

options.en: Demanding dowry is a crime; she can get help
options.hg: Dahej maangna crime hai; woh help le sakti hai

explain.en: Giving, taking or demanding dowry is an offence under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, and harassment for dowry is a serious crime. She can call 181 or 112, or approach the police or a Protection Officer.
explain.hg: Dahej dena, lena ya maangna Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 ke tahat offence hai, aur dahej ke liye harassment serious crime hai. Woh 181 ya 112 call kar sakti hai, ya police ya Protection Officer ke paas ja sakti hai.

q.en: Two adults from different religions want to marry, but their families object. What does Indian law say?
q.hg: Alag dharm ke do adults shaadi karna chahte hain, par families virodh karti hain. Indian law kya kehta hai?

options.en: Adults have the right to choose whom they marry
options.hg: Adults ko apna jeevansaathi chunne ka haq hai

options.en: They need both families' written permission
options.hg: Unhe dono families ki likhit permission chahiye

options.en: Interfaith marriage is not allowed in India
options.hg: India mein interfaith shaadi allowed nahi hai

options.en: Only the elder's community can approve it
options.hg: Sirf buzurgon ki community ise approve kar sakti hai

explain.en: The Supreme Court has held that adults have the right to choose their partner, and the Special Marriage Act, 1954 allows marriage across religions. If anyone threatens them, they can seek police protection or call 112.
explain.hg: Supreme Court ne kaha hai ki adults ko apna partner chunne ka haq hai, aur Special Marriage Act, 1954 alag dharm ke logon ki shaadi allow karta hai. Koi dhamki de toh woh police protection le sakte hain ya 112 call kar sakte hain.

q.en: You are meeting a prospective partner for an arranged marriage. What is fair to talk about?
q.hg: Tum arranged marriage ke liye ek prospective partner se mil rahe ho. Kis baare mein baat karna fair hai?

options.en: Nothing personal; families will decide
options.hg: Kuch personal nahi; families decide karengi

options.en: Only their salary and family property
options.hg: Sirf unki salary aur family property

options.en: Values, work, money, children and expectations
options.hg: Values, kaam, paise, bachche aur expectations

options.en: Only small talk, to avoid seeming rude
options.hg: Sirf idhar-udhar ki baat, taaki rude na lago

explain.en: Arranged or not, a good marriage starts with knowing each other. Honest talk about careers, household work, money, children and personal boundaries helps both people decide freely.
