explain.hg: Arranged ho ya nahi, achhi shaadi ek doosre ko jaanne se shuru hoti hai. Career, ghar ka kaam, paise, bachche aur personal boundaries par honest baat dono ko apni marzi se decide karne mein help karti hai.

q.en: After the roka, you realise you don't want to marry this person. Can you still say no?
q.hg: Roka ke baad tumhe samajh aata hai ki tum is insaan se shaadi nahi karna chahte. Kya ab bhi mana kar sakte ho?

options.en: No, after the roka it is all final
options.hg: Nahi, roka ke baad sab kuch final hai

options.en: Only if the other family agrees first
options.hg: Sirf tab jab doosri family pehle maan jaye

options.en: Yes; marriage needs both people's free consent
options.hg: Haan; shaadi ke liye dono ka free consent chahiye

options.en: Only if you return all the gifts
options.hg: Sirf tab jab saare gifts wapas karo

explain.en: A ceremony or family promise does not take away your choice. Saying no is hard socially, but marrying without wanting to is harder. A counsellor or trusted relative can help you have the talk.
explain.hg: Koi rasm ya family ka vaada tumhari choice nahi chheenta. Na bolna samaj mein mushkil hai, par bina chahe shaadi karna usse bhi mushkil hai. Counsellor ya trusted rishtedaar baat karne mein help kar sakte hain.

q.en: Your parents are planning your marriage while you are 16. What is true?
q.hg: Tum 16 saal ke ho aur mummy-papa tumhari shaadi plan kar rahe hain. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It's child marriage, which is illegal
options.hg: Yeh child marriage hai, jo illegal hai

options.en: It's legal if both families agree
options.hg: Dono families maan jayein toh legal hai

options.en: It's legal if the wedding is small
options.hg: Chhoti shaadi ho toh legal hai

options.en: It's legal once you finish school
options.hg: School khatam hone ke baad legal hai

explain.en: The legal age of marriage in India is 18 for women and 21 for men. Child marriage is an offence under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006. Childline 1098, 112, a teacher or a Child Marriage Prohibition Officer can step in.
explain.hg: India mein shaadi ki legal umar ladkiyon ke liye 18 aur ladkon ke liye 21 hai. Child marriage Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 ke tahat offence hai. Childline 1098, 112, teacher ya Child Marriage Prohibition Officer beech mein aa sakte hain.

q.en: Your partner hides your contraceptive pills or pressures you to get pregnant before you're ready. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara partner tumhari contraceptive pills chhupa deta hai ya ready hone se pehle pregnant hone ka pressure daalta hai. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A normal disagreement about family plans
options.hg: Family planning par normal disagreement

options.en: A romantic sign that they want a future
options.hg: Romantic sign ki woh future chahte hain

options.en: Their right as your husband or partner
options.hg: Pati ya partner hone ke naate unka haq

options.en: Reproductive coercion, a form of abuse
options.hg: Reproductive coercion, abuse ka ek roop

explain.en: Decisions about pregnancy and contraception belong to the person whose body is involved. Sabotaging them is abuse. A doctor can help with methods your partner can't interfere with, and 181 offers support.
explain.hg: Pregnancy aur contraception ke faisle us insaan ke hain jiski body hai. Unme gadbad karna abuse hai. Doctor aise methods mein help kar sakta hai jinme partner dakhal na de sake, aur 181 support deta hai.

q.en: Soon after the wedding, relatives pressure a couple to 'give good news' quickly. What is true?
q.hg: Shaadi ke kuch hi time baad rishtedaar couple par jaldi 'good news' dene ka pressure daalte hain. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Elders decide when a couple should have a baby
options.hg: Bade decide karte hain couple ka bachcha kab ho

options.en: The couple decides if and when to have children
options.hg: Bachche kab aur hon ya nahi, yeh couple decide karega

options.en: A baby in the first year is a duty
options.hg: Pehle saal mein bachcha farz hai

options.en: Delaying children means the marriage is weak
options.hg: Bachche mein der ka matlab shaadi kamzor hai

explain.en: Having a child is a huge decision about health, money and readiness. It belongs to the couple, and most of all to the person who would be pregnant. Polite boundaries with family are okay.
explain.hg: Bachcha hona health, paise aur readiness ka bahut bada faisla hai. Yeh couple ka hai, aur sabse zyada us insaan ka jo pregnant hoga. Family ke saath polite boundaries rakhna theek hai.

q.en: In a relationship, one partner wants sex more often than the other. What is true?
q.hg: Ek relationship mein ek partner doosre se zyada baar sex chahta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: The partner who wants less must give in
options.hg: Kam chahne wale partner ko maan jana chahiye

options.en: It's common; talk openly, and no one is obliged
options.hg: Common hai; khul ke baat karo, kisi par koi farz nahi

options.en: It means the relationship is failing
options.hg: Iska matlab relationship fail ho raha hai

options.en: It means one partner is cheating
options.hg: Iska matlab ek partner cheat kar raha hai

explain.en: Desire naturally differs between people and changes with stress, health and time. Couples can talk about needs, try compromises that both like, and see a doctor or counsellor if it worries them. A no is always respected.
explain.hg: Desire logon mein naturally alag hoti hai aur stress, health aur time ke saath badalti hai. Couples zaroorat par baat kar sakte hain, aise compromise try kar sakte hain jo dono ko pasand hon, aur fikr ho toh doctor ya counsellor se mil sakte hain. Na ki hamesha respect hoti hai.

q.en: A married couple both work full-time. How should household chores be shared?
q.hg: Shaadi-shuda couple dono full-time kaam karte hain. Ghar ka kaam kaise baantna chahiye?

options.en: The wife does it all, as that's her role
options.hg: Saara kaam patni kare, yahi uska role hai

options.en: Whoever earns less does it all
options.hg: Jo kam kamata hai woh saara kare

options.en: Nobody needs to discuss it at all
options.hg: Is par baat karne ki koi zaroorat nahi

options.en: Fairly, by talking and agreeing together
options.hg: Fair tarah se, baat karke aur milkar tay karke

explain.en: Unequal housework is a common source of resentment. Equal partners split the load fairly, whatever their gender or salary, and revisit the plan when life changes.
explain.hg: Ghar ke kaam ka ghair-barabar bantwara naraazgi ki common wajah hai. Barabar ke partners gender ya salary dekhe bina kaam fair tarah baant-te hain, aur zindagi badle toh plan dobara dekhte hain.

q.en: Sana turned down her senior's request for a date. Since then, he gives her the worst shifts and criticises her in meetings. What is true?
q.hg: Sana ne apne senior ki date request mana ki. Tab se woh use sabse kharab shifts deta hai aur meetings mein uski burai karta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It can be sexual harassment; she can go to the IC
options.hg: Yeh sexual harassment ho sakta hai; woh IC ke paas ja sakti hai

options.en: It's office politics; she should work harder
options.hg: Yeh office politics hai; use bas zyada mehnat karni chahiye

options.en: It's fair, since she hurt his feelings
options.hg: Fair hai, usne senior ki feelings hurt ki

options.en: Nothing can be done because he is senior
options.hg: Kuch nahi ho sakta kyunki woh senior hai

explain.en: Under the POSH Act, 2013, threatening a woman's job or treating her worse at work because she rejected a sexual advance can be sexual harassment. She can keep a record of dates and incidents and complain to the Internal Committee.
explain.hg: POSH Act, 2013 ke tahat, sexual advance mana karne ki wajah se kisi aurat ki job ko dhamki dena ya kaam par uske saath bura bartaav karna sexual harassment ho sakta hai. Woh dates aur incidents ka record rakh kar Internal Committee mein complaint kar sakti hai.

q.en: Your long-distance partner demands a video call every time you go out, to 'see who you're with'. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhara long-distance partner jab bhi tum bahar jao, video call ki maang karta hai 'dekhne ke liye tum kiske saath ho'. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A healthy way to stay close over distance
options.hg: Doori mein close rehne ka healthy tareeka

options.en: Normal, since distance makes people worry
options.hg: Normal, doori se log fikr karte hain

options.en: Monitoring, which is a form of control
options.hg: Monitoring, jo control ka ek roop hai

options.en: Fair, as long as the calls are short
options.hg: Fair, jab tak calls chhoti hon

explain.en: Distance can bring insecurity, and talking about it is healthy. Demanding proof of where and with whom you are is checking up on you, not connecting with you.
explain.hg: Doori insecurity la sakti hai, aur us par baat karna healthy hai. Tum kahan aur kiske saath ho iska saboot maangna tumhari nigrani hai, tumse judna nahi.

q.en: Your partner says, 'If you really loved me, you'd go further with me.' You're not ready. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara partner kehta hai, 'Sach mein pyaar karte toh mere saath aage badhte.' Tum ready nahi ho. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Going further is how love is proved
options.hg: Aage badhna hi pyaar saabit karna hai

options.en: You should agree so they don't leave
options.hg: Haan bol do taaki woh chhod ke na jayein

options.en: Love doesn't need proof; waiting is a valid choice
options.hg: Pyaar ko saboot nahi chahiye; wait karna valid choice hai

options.en: Not being ready means you don't love them
options.hg: Ready na hona matlab tum pyaar nahi karte

explain.en: Feeling ready is personal, and delaying is always a valid choice. For anyone under 18, sexual activity is also an offence under POCSO. A partner who cares will wait without pressure.
explain.hg: Ready feel karna personal hai, aur wait karna hamesha valid choice hai. 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke liye sexual activity POCSO ke tahat offence bhi hai. Jo partner care karta hai woh bina pressure wait karega.

q.en: In a hostel, your roommate keeps using your things without asking. What is a good first step?
q.hg: Hostel mein tumhara roommate bina poochhe tumhari cheezein use karta rehta hai. Achha pehla step kya hai?

options.en: Talk calmly and agree on simple room rules
options.hg: Shaanti se baat karo aur simple room rules tay karo

options.en: Hide all your things and say nothing
options.hg: Saari cheezein chhupa do aur kuch mat bolo

options.en: Complain to everyone except the roommate
options.hg: Roommate ke alawa sabse complain karo

options.en: Use their things to teach them a lesson
options.hg: Sabak sikhane ke liye unki cheezein use karo

explain.en: Most roommate problems shrink with one direct, friendly talk: 'Can you ask before using my stuff?' Clear agreements early prevent bigger fights later.
explain.hg: Roommate ki zyadatar problems ek seedhi, friendly baat se kam ho jati hain: 'Meri cheezein use karne se pehle poochh lena?' Jaldi clear agreement baad ke bade jhagdon ko rokta hai.

q.en: Your friends keep saying you 'need' a girlfriend or boyfriend by the end of school. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhare dost baar-baar kehte hain ki school khatam hone tak tumhe girlfriend ya boyfriend 'chahiye hi'. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Being single at 17 means something is wrong
options.hg: 17 mein single hona matlab kuch gadbad hai

options.en: You should date anyone, just to be safe
options.hg: Bas safe rehne ke liye kisi ko bhi date kar lo

options.en: Real friends set dating goals for you
options.hg: Asli dost tumhare liye dating goals set karte hain

options.en: There is no deadline; date when you truly want to
options.hg: Koi deadline nahi; jab sach mein chaho tab date karo

explain.en: Dating to meet a deadline or impress friends rarely makes anyone happy. Being single is a full, valid way to live at any age.
explain.hg: Deadline ya doston ko impress karne ke liye date karna shayad hi kisi ko khush karta hai. Kisi bhi umar mein single rehna ek poora, valid tareeka hai.

q.en: Your partner keeps saying, 'You're overreacting, that never happened,' about things you clearly remember. Over time you start doubting yourself. What helps most?
q.hg: Tumhara partner un baaton ke baare mein jo tumhe saaf yaad hain, kehta rehta hai, 'Tum overreact kar rahe ho, aisa hua hi nahi.' Dheere-dheere tum khud par shak karne lagte ho. Sabse zyada kya help karta hai?

options.en: Accept their version to avoid more fights
options.hg: Aur jhagde se bachne ke liye unki baat maan lo

options.en: Write things down and talk to someone you trust
options.hg: Baatein likh lo aur kisi trusted insaan se baat karo

options.en: Record them secretly and post it online
options.hg: Chupke se record karke online daal do

options.en: Ask them to decide what really happened
options.hg: Unhi se poochho ki asal mein kya hua

explain.en: Repeatedly denying someone's reality is called gaslighting. Keeping notes and checking with a trusted friend or counsellor helps you trust your own memory again.
explain.hg: Baar-baar kisi ki reality ko jhuthlana gaslighting kehlata hai. Notes rakhna aur trusted dost ya counsellor se baat karna tumhe apni yaaddasht par phir se bharosa karne mein help karta hai.

q.en: Which of these is an early warning sign that is easy to miss?
q.hg: In mein se kaunsa early warning sign hai jo aasaani se miss ho jata hai?

options.en: Asking you how your exams went
options.hg: Tumse poochhna ki exams kaise gaye

options.en: Guilt-tripping you over family time
options.hg: Family ke saath time par guilt-trip karna

options.en: Wanting to meet your friends
options.hg: Tumhare doston se milna chahna

options.en: Saying sorry after a mistake
options.hg: Galti ke baad sorry bolna

explain.en: Control often starts small, with guilt about time spent elsewhere, and grows into isolation. Noticing it early makes it easier to talk about it or step away.
explain.hg: Control aksar chhote se shuru hota hai, kahin aur time bitane par guilt se, aur isolation tak badh jata hai. Jaldi notice karne se baat karna ya peeche hatna aasaan hota hai.

q.en: A friend says her boyfriend checks her phone, but 'only because he was cheated on before'. What is true?
q.hg: Ek dost kehti hai ki uska boyfriend uska phone check karta hai, par 'sirf isliye kyunki pehle uske saath cheating hui thi'. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Then it's fine, because he has a good reason
options.hg: Phir theek hai, uske paas achhi wajah hai

options.en: She should prove herself until he trusts her
options.hg: Use tab tak khud ko saabit karna chahiye jab tak woh trust na kare

options.en: She should hand over her phone every day
options.hg: Use roz apna phone de dena chahiye

options.en: Past hurt explains insecurity but doesn't excuse control
options.hg: Purana dard insecurity samjhata hai, par control ko sahi nahi banata

explain.en: Everyone carries past hurts, and they are his to work through, perhaps with a counsellor. It is not her job to accept surveillance to heal him.
explain.hg: Sabke paas purane zakhm hote hain, aur unhe theek karna uska kaam hai, shayad counsellor ke saath. Use theek karne ke liye nigrani sehna uski zimmedaari nahi.

q.en: Your partner wants you to stop talking to your best friend, who is of the gender they're attracted to. What is a healthy response?
q.hg: Tumhara partner chahta hai ki tum apne best friend se baat band karo, jo us gender ka hai jisse partner attracted hota hai. Healthy response kya hai?

options.en: Hear their worry, but keep your friendship
options.hg: Unki fikr suno, par apni dosti rakho

options.en: Drop the friend to keep your partner happy
options.hg: Partner ko khush rakhne ke liye dost chhod do

options.en: Hide the friendship from your partner
options.hg: Partner se dosti chhupa lo

options.en: Threaten to break up straight away
options.hg: Turant breakup ki dhamki do

explain.en: You can reassure a partner and talk about what would help them feel secure. But being asked to give up close friends is a step towards isolation, and you don't have to accept it.
explain.hg: Tum partner ko tasalli de sakte ho aur baat kar sakte ho ki unhe secure feel karne mein kya help karega. Par close doston ko chhodne ko kehna isolation ki taraf kadam hai, aur ise maanna zaroori nahi.

q.en: What does respect in a relationship look like?
q.hg: Relationship mein respect kaisi dikhti hai?

options.en: Always agreeing so there is never a fight
options.hg: Hamesha agree karna taaki kabhi jhagda na ho

options.en: One partner obeying the other
options.hg: Ek partner ka doosre ki baat maanna

options.en: Valuing each other's feelings and limits
options.hg: Ek doosre ki feelings aur limits ki kadar

options.en: Never saying what you really need
options.hg: Kabhi apni asli zaroorat na batana

explain.en: Respect means both people matter equally. You can disagree, say what you need, and still treat each other with care.
explain.hg: Respect ka matlab dono barabar matter karte hain. Tum disagree kar sakte ho, apni zaroorat bata sakte ho, aur phir bhi ek doosre ka khayal rakh sakte ho.

q.en: A friend tells you, 'My partner gets angry if I don't reply within five minutes.' What is this?
q.hg: Ek dost batata hai, 'Paanch minute mein reply na karun toh partner gussa ho jata hai.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A sign of how much they miss each other
options.hg: Sign ki woh ek doosre ko kitna miss karte hain

options.en: Normal for couples who are really close
options.hg: Bahut close couples ke liye normal

options.en: A controlling rule, not a sign of love
options.hg: Control wala rule, pyaar ka sign nahi

options.en: Fair, since replying fast shows respect
options.hg: Fair, jaldi reply respect dikhata hai

explain.en: Everyone has classes, work and family. Getting angry about reply times is a way to keep tabs on someone. A healthy partner trusts you'll reply when you can.
explain.hg: Sabki classes, kaam aur family hoti hai. Reply time par gussa hona kisi par nazar rakhne ka tareeka hai. Healthy partner bharosa karta hai ki tum jab ho sake reply karoge.

q.en: You and your partner disagree about whether to post couple photos online. What is the fair approach?
q.hg: Tum aur tumhara partner couple photos online post karne par disagree karte ho. Fair approach kya hai?

options.en: Post only what both of you are comfortable with
options.hg: Sirf wahi post karo jisse dono comfortable hon

options.en: Whoever took the photo decides
options.hg: Jisne photo kheenchi woh decide kare

options.en: Post it; refusing means hiding the relationship
options.hg: Post karo; mana karna matlab rishta chhupana

options.en: Never discuss it and just post
options.hg: Kabhi baat mat karo, bas post karo

explain.en: People have many reasons to keep things private, like family, safety or work. Consent applies to photos too, and agreeing together prevents hurt later, including after a breakup.
explain.hg: Logon ke paas cheezein private rakhne ki kai wajahein hoti hain, jaise family, safety ya kaam. Photos par bhi consent laagu hota hai, aur saath milkar tay karna baad ke hurt ko rokta hai, breakup ke baad bhi.

q.en: Which is the strongest sign that a relationship has become abusive, not just going through a rough patch?
q.hg: Kaunsa sign sabse strongly batata hai ki relationship abusive ho gaya hai, sirf bura daur nahi chal raha?

options.en: The couple argues loudly every now and then
options.hg: Couple kabhi-kabhi zor se behas karta hai

options.en: They have less time together during exams
options.hg: Exams mein unke paas saath ka time kam hai

options.en: They disagree about where to go on dates
options.hg: Date par kahan jaana hai is par disagree karte hain

options.en: One person is afraid of how the other will react
options.hg: Ek insaan doosre ke reaction se darta hai

explain.en: Every couple has hard phases. The key difference is fear: walking on eggshells, changing what you say or do to avoid the other person's anger. That points to control, not ordinary conflict.
explain.hg: Har couple ke mushkil daur aate hain. Asli farak darr ka hai: phoonk-phoonk kar chalna, doosre ke gusse se bachne ke liye apni baat ya kaam badalna. Yeh control dikhata hai, normal jhagda nahi.

q.en: What is 'coercive control' in a relationship?
q.hg: Relationship mein 'coercive control' kya hota hai?

options.en: One serious fight that ends in a breakup
options.hg: Ek bada jhagda jo breakup par khatam ho

options.en: A pattern of monitoring, isolating and threatening
options.hg: Nigrani, isolation aur dhamkiyon ka ek pattern

options.en: A partner giving advice about your career
options.hg: Partner ka career ke baare mein salah dena

options.en: Couples agreeing on a shared monthly budget
options.hg: Couple ka milkar monthly budget tay karna

explain.en: Coercive control is a pattern, not a single event: checking phones, limiting money and friends, constant rules and threats, which slowly take away someone's freedom. It can happen with no physical violence at all.
explain.hg: Coercive control ek pattern hai, ek ghatna nahi: phone check karna, paise aur doston par rok, lagataar rules aur dhamkiyan, jo dheere-dheere kisi ki azadi chheen leti hain. Yeh bina kisi physical violence ke bhi ho sakta hai.

q.en: Which parts of your body are called private parts?
q.hg: Body ke kaunse parts 'private parts' kehlaate hain?

options.en: The parts covered by your underwear or swimsuit
options.hg: Jo parts underwear ya swimsuit se dhake rehte hain

options.en: Any part that has a cut or a wound
options.hg: Koi bhi part jahan chot ya ghaav ho

options.en: Your hands, your feet and your face
options.hg: Tumhare haath, tumhare pair aur chehra

options.en: Only the parts you feel shy about
options.hg: Sirf woh parts jinke baare mein sharam aaye

explain.en: Private parts are the parts your underwear or swimsuit covers. Nobody should touch them, look at them or take pictures of them except to keep you clean or healthy.
explain.hg: Private parts woh hain jo underwear ya swimsuit se dhake rehte hain. Inhe koi touch na kare, na dekhe, na photo le, sirf saaf-safai ya health ke liye zaroori ho toh alag baat hai.

q.en: Nani gives you a warm hug and you like it. What kind of touch is this?
q.hg: Nani tumhe pyaar se hug karti hain aur tumhe achha lagta hai. Yeh kaisa touch hai?

options.en: A secret touch
options.hg: Secret touch

options.en: An unsafe touch
options.hg: Unsafe touch

options.en: A touch you must hide
options.hg: Aisa touch jo chhupana pade

options.en: A safe touch
options.hg: Safe touch

explain.en: A safe touch feels good, is not secret and you are happy to tell anyone about it. If you ever do not want a hug, even from someone you love, you can say no.
explain.hg: Safe touch achha lagta hai, usme koi secret nahi hota aur tum kisi ko bhi bata sakte ho. Kabhi hug nahi chahiye, chahe apna koi ho, toh tum mana kar sakte ho.

q.en: Someone touches your private parts and says it is 'just a game'. What is true?
q.hg: Koi tumhare private parts ko touch karta hai aur kehta hai 'bas ek game hai'. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is an unsafe touch, and you should tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Yeh unsafe touch hai, kisi trusted bade ko batao

options.en: You should keep quiet so nobody gets upset
options.hg: Chup rehna chahiye taaki koi naraz na ho

options.en: It is fine if the person is someone you know
options.hg: Theek hai agar woh jaan-pehchaan ka hai

options.en: It is fine because the person called it a game
options.hg: Theek hai, kyunki usne ise game bola

explain.en: Calling it a game does not make it okay. Say no if you can, get away, and tell a grown-up you trust. It is never your fault, even if the person is someone you know.
explain.hg: Game bolne se woh theek nahi ho jaata. Ho sake toh NO bolo, wahan se hato, aur kisi trusted bade ko batao. Yeh kabhi tumhari galti nahi hoti, chahe woh jaan-pehchaan wala ho.

q.en: When can a doctor check your private parts?
q.hg: Doctor tumhare private parts kab check kar sakta hai?

options.en: Whenever the doctor wants, with no one else there
options.hg: Jab doctor chahe, bina kisi ke saath

options.en: Never, not even when you are unwell
options.hg: Kabhi nahi, beemar hone par bhi nahi

options.en: For your health, with a parent or carer there
options.hg: Health ke liye, jab mummy-papa ya carer saath ho

options.en: Only if you promise to keep it a secret
options.hg: Sirf tab jab tum secret rakhne ka promise karo

explain.en: A doctor may need to check your private parts when you are unwell, but a parent or carer you trust should be there and it should be explained to you. A real check-up is never a secret.
explain.hg: Beemar hone par doctor ko private parts check karne pad sakte hain, lekin koi trusted bada saath hona chahiye aur tumhe samjhaya jaana chahiye. Asli check-up kabhi secret nahi hota.

q.en: What is the difference between a surprise and a secret?
q.hg: Surprise aur secret mein kya fark hai?

options.en: A surprise is only for birthdays; a secret is for every day
options.hg: Surprise sirf birthday ke liye; secret roz ke liye

options.en: There is no real difference between the two of them
options.hg: Dono mein asal mein koi fark nahi hai

options.en: A surprise is fun and gets told soon; a secret may be kept forever
options.hg: Surprise mazedaar hai aur jaldi khulta hai; secret hamesha chhupa reh sakta hai

options.en: A surprise is told to everyone; a secret is told to one person
options.hg: Surprise sabko bataya jaata hai; secret ek ko

explain.en: A surprise, like a gift for Papa, makes people happy and is told soon. A secret that makes you feel worried, scared or confused should be told to a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Surprise, jaise Papa ke liye gift, sabko khush karta hai aur jaldi bata diya jaata hai. Jo secret tumhe pareshan, darr ya confuse kare, use kisi trusted bade ko batana chahiye.

q.en: An uncle says, 'This is our special game. Don't tell Mummy.' What should you do?
q.hg: Ek uncle kehte hain, 'Yeh hamara special game hai. Mummy ko mat batana.' Tum kya karoge?

options.en: Tell Mummy or another trusted adult
options.hg: Mummy ya kisi aur trusted bade ko bata doge

options.en: Keep the secret if he gives you a gift
options.hg: Gift mile toh secret rakhoge

options.en: Wait until you are older to tell anyone
options.hg: Bade hone tak kisi ko nahi bataoge

options.en: Keep the secret because he is family
options.hg: Secret rakhoge kyunki woh family hain

explain.en: Safe grown-ups do not ask children to hide games or touches from their parents. Telling is the right thing to do, and you will not be in trouble for it.
explain.hg: Safe bade kabhi bachchon se games ya touch parents se chhupane ko nahi kehte. Batana bilkul sahi hai, aur iske liye tumhe daant nahi padegi.

q.en: Who is a trusted adult?
q.hg: Trusted adult kaun hota hai?

options.en: A grown-up who asks you to keep secrets
options.hg: Aisa bada jo tumse secret rakhne ko kahe

options.en: Any grown-up who is older than your parents
options.hg: Koi bhi jo tumhare parents se bada ho

options.en: Any grown-up who gives you sweets or toys
options.hg: Koi bhi bada jo tumhe mithai ya toys de

options.en: A grown-up who listens to you and helps keep you safe
options.hg: Aisa bada jo tumhari sunta hai aur tumhe safe rakhta hai

explain.en: A trusted adult listens, believes you and helps when you feel unsafe. It could be a parent, a grandparent, a teacher or a school counsellor. It is good to have more than one.
explain.hg: Trusted adult woh hai jo tumhari sune, tum par yakeen kare aur unsafe lagne par madad kare. Mummy-papa, dadi-nani, teacher ya school counsellor ho sakte hain. Ek se zyada hon toh aur achha.

q.en: You tell a grown-up about an unsafe touch, but they do not believe you. What should you do next?
q.hg: Tumne ek bade ko unsafe touch ke baare mein bataya, par unhone yakeen nahi kiya. Ab kya karoge?

options.en: Try to forget it and never talk about it again
options.hg: Bhoolne ki koshish karo aur kabhi baat mat karo

options.en: Say sorry to them for making the whole thing up
options.hg: Unse sorry bolo ki tumne poori baat banayi

options.en: Stop telling, because one adult did not believe you
options.hg: Batana band kar do, kyunki ek ne yakeen nahi kiya

options.en: Keep telling other trusted adults until someone helps
options.hg: Doosre trusted badon ko batate raho jab tak koi madad na kare

explain.en: Sometimes a grown-up does not understand the first time. That is not your fault. Tell another trusted adult, a teacher, or call 1098, and keep telling until someone helps.
explain.hg: Kabhi-kabhi bade pehli baar mein samajh nahi paate. Isme tumhari galti nahi. Kisi aur trusted bade ko, teacher ko batao ya 1098 par call karo, aur tab tak batate raho jab tak koi madad na kare.

q.en: If someone gives you an unsafe touch, whose fault is it?
q.hg: Agar koi tumhe unsafe touch kare, toh galti kiski hai?

options.en: Always the person who did it
options.hg: Hamesha usi ki jisne kiya

options.en: Nobody's, so there is no need to tell
options.hg: Kisi ki nahi, toh batane ki zaroorat nahi

options.en: The child's, for not running away
options.hg: Bachche ki, kyunki woh bhaaga nahi

options.en: The child's, for being friendly
options.hg: Bachche ki, kyunki woh friendly tha

explain.en: It is never the child's fault, whatever the child did or did not do. The grown-up or older person is responsible. Telling a trusted adult is always the right thing.
explain.hg: Yeh kabhi bachche ki galti nahi hoti, chahe bachche ne kuch bhi kiya ho ya na kiya ho. Zimmedaar woh bada ya older person hai. Trusted bade ko batana hamesha sahi hai.

q.en: Which of these secrets should you tell a grown-up you trust straight away?
q.hg: In mein se kaunsa secret kisi trusted bade ko turant batana chahiye?

options.en: Someone touched you and said not to tell
options.hg: Kisi ne tumhe touch kiya aur kaha kisi ko mat batana

options.en: Where you hid Papa's surprise card
options.hg: Papa ka surprise card kahan chhupaya hai

options.en: The name of your friend's favourite cartoon
options.hg: Dost ka favourite cartoon kaunsa hai

options.en: The gift you bought for Didi's birthday
options.hg: Didi ke birthday ke liye liya hua gift

explain.en: A secret about touching, or one that makes you feel scared or confused, must be told. Happy surprises like gifts and cards can wait, because everyone will know soon anyway.
explain.hg: Touch wala secret, ya jo secret tumhe darr ya confusion de, woh zaroor batana chahiye. Gift aur card jaise happy surprises wait kar sakte hain, kyunki sabko jaldi pata chal hi jaayega.

q.en: Meera felt so scared that she could not say 'no' when someone touched her in an unsafe way. What is true?
q.hg: Meera itni darr gayi ki unsafe touch ke waqt 'no' nahi bol paayi. Sach kya hai?

options.en: She should be scolded for not shouting
options.hg: Chillane ke liye use daant padni chahiye

options.en: It is still not okay, and she can still tell
options.hg: Phir bhi woh galat tha, aur woh ab bhi bata sakti hai

options.en: Because she did not say no, it was okay
options.hg: Usne no nahi bola, toh sab theek tha

options.en: She has lost the chance to tell anyone
options.hg: Ab uske paas batane ka mauka nahi raha

explain.en: Many children freeze when they are scared; bodies do that. Not saying no does not make an unsafe touch okay. Meera can tell a trusted adult now, and she is not to blame.
explain.hg: Darr mein kai bachche freeze ho jaate hain, body aisa karti hai. No na bolne se unsafe touch theek nahi ho jaata. Meera abhi bhi trusted bade ko bata sakti hai, aur uski koi galti nahi.

q.en: Something unsafe happened to Aman months ago and he never told anyone. Is it too late to tell?
q.hg: Aman ke saath mahino pehle kuch unsafe hua aur usne kisi ko nahi bataya. Kya ab batane mein der ho gayi?

options.en: Yes, he will be in trouble for waiting
options.hg: Haan, itna wait karne ke liye use daant padegi

options.en: No, it is never too late to tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Nahi, trusted bade ko batane mein kabhi der nahi hoti

options.en: Only if the same thing happens again
options.hg: Sirf tab jab wahi cheez dobara ho

options.en: Yes, after a few days nobody can help
options.hg: Haan, kuch din baad koi madad nahi kar sakta

explain.en: It is never too late to tell. Many children wait because they feel scared or confused, and that is okay. A trusted adult or 1098 can still help Aman feel safe.
explain.hg: Batane mein kabhi der nahi hoti. Bahut bachche darr ya confusion ki wajah se wait karte hain, aur yeh normal hai. Trusted bada ya 1098 ab bhi Aman ki madad kar sakte hain.

q.en: A neighbour keeps giving Riya chocolates and says, 'Don't tell your parents I give you these.' What is the best thing for Riya to do?
q.hg: Ek padosi Riya ko baar-baar chocolate deta hai aur kehta hai, 'Parents ko mat batana.' Riya ke liye sabse sahi kya hai?

options.en: Say thank you and hide the wrappers
options.hg: Thank you bolna aur wrappers chhupa dena

options.en: Keep eating them quietly, it is only chocolate
options.hg: Chupchaap khaate rehna, bas chocolate hi toh hai

options.en: Share them with friends so it is fair
options.hg: Doston ke saath share karna taaki fair rahe

options.en: Tell her parents about the gifts and the secret
options.hg: Parents ko gifts aur secret dono ke baare mein batana

explain.en: Gifts that come with 'don't tell' are a warning sign. A kind grown-up has no reason to hide gifts from parents. Riya is not in trouble for telling; she is being smart.
explain.hg: 'Mat batana' wale gifts ek warning sign hain. Achhe bade ko parents se gifts chhupane ki koi zaroorat nahi. Batane par Riya ko daant nahi padegi, woh samajhdaari dikha rahi hai.

q.en: While playing an online game, a stranger asks which school you go to. What should you do?
q.hg: Online game khelte hue ek stranger poochta hai ki tum kis school mein ho. Kya karoge?

options.en: Not tell, and let a grown-up know
options.hg: Nahi bataoge, aur kisi bade ko bataoge

options.en: Tell, but only the school's name
options.hg: Bata doge, bas school ka naam

options.en: Tell, if they seem friendly
options.hg: Bata doge, agar woh friendly lage

options.en: Tell, if they say they are a child too
options.hg: Bata doge, agar woh bole woh bhi bachcha hai

explain.en: Your school, address and phone number are private, because they show where to find you. Anyone online can pretend to be a child. Tell a grown-up you trust if someone keeps asking.
explain.hg: School, address aur phone number private hain, kyunki inse pata chalta hai tum kahan milte ho. Online koi bhi bachcha banne ka natak kar sakta hai. Koi baar-baar pooche toh trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: A friend from an online game says, 'Let's video call, but don't tell your parents.' What does this most likely mean?
q.hg: Online game ka ek dost kehta hai, 'Video call karte hain, par parents ko mat batana.' Iska kya matlab ho sakta hai?

options.en: It is fine if the call is short
options.hg: Call chhoti ho toh theek hai

options.en: It is normal for online friends
options.hg: Online doston ke liye yeh normal hai

options.en: It is a warning sign; tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Yeh warning sign hai; trusted bade ko batao

options.en: They are shy and want to stay private
options.hg: Woh sharmeela hai, private rehna chahta hai

explain.en: Asking a child to hide a call from parents is a common trick used by people who want to harm children. You are not in trouble; tell a parent or teacher, and stop chatting with them.
explain.hg: Bachche se parents se call chhupane ko kehna, nuksaan pahunchane walon ki common trick hai. Tum trouble mein nahi ho; parent ya teacher ko batao aur unse baat band karo.

q.en: Someone in a game offers you free coins if you send a photo of yourself. What is the safest choice?
q.hg: Game mein koi kehta hai ki apni photo bhejo toh free coins milenge. Sabse safe kya hai?

options.en: Send it, since coins are hard to earn
options.hg: Bhej do, coins kamana mushkil hai

options.en: Say no, block them and tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Mana karo, block karo aur trusted bade ko batao

options.en: Send a photo with your face hidden
options.hg: Chehra chhupa ke photo bhej do

options.en: Ask a friend to send their photo instead
options.hg: Kisi dost se uski photo bhejne ko kaho

explain.en: People who want to harm children often offer gifts or game rewards to get photos. Do not send any photo. Block, report and tell a grown-up; you have done nothing wrong.
explain.hg: Bachchon ko nuksaan pahunchane wale aksar gifts ya game rewards dekar photo maangte hain. Koi photo mat bhejo. Block, report karo aur kisi bade ko batao; tumne kuch galat nahi kiya.

q.en: Who is most likely to give a child an unsafe touch?
q.hg: Bachche ko unsafe touch dene wala zyada tar kaun hota hai?

options.en: Only strangers on the street
options.hg: Sirf sadak ke ajnabi

options.en: Only people from another town
options.hg: Sirf doosre shehar ke log

options.en: Only people who look scary
options.hg: Sirf darawne dikhne wale log

options.en: Often someone the child already knows
options.hg: Aksar koi jise bachcha pehle se jaanta hai

explain.en: Most people who abuse children are someone the child knows, like a relative, neighbour or tutor. So the rule is about the touch, not the person: if it feels unsafe, tell.
explain.hg: Bachchon ke saath galat karne wale zyada tar jaan-pehchaan ke hote hain, jaise rishtedaar, padosi ya tutor. Isliye rule touch ka hai, insaan ka nahi: unsafe lage toh batao.

q.en: Why is it helpful to know the real names of private parts, like penis and vulva?
q.hg: Private parts ke asli naam, jaise penis aur vulva, jaanna kyun helpful hai?

options.en: To tell an adult clearly if something is wrong
options.hg: Taaki kuch galat ho toh bade ko saaf bata sako

options.en: Because the shy, cute names are rude
options.hg: Kyunki sharam wale cute naam rude hain

options.en: It does not help in any way at all
options.hg: Isse kisi tarah ka fayda nahi

options.en: So you can tease other children with them
options.hg: Taaki inse doosre bachchon ko chidha sako

explain.en: Real names are just body words, like elbow or knee. Knowing them helps you explain clearly to a parent, teacher or doctor if something happens or hurts.
explain.hg: Asli naam bas body ke words hain, jaise kohni ya ghutna. Inhe jaanne se tum mummy-papa, teacher ya doctor ko saaf samjha sakte ho agar kuch ho ya dard ho.

q.en: At a family function, an aunty you barely know wants a kiss, but you don't want to. What can you do?
q.hg: Family function mein ek aunty jinhe tum theek se nahi jaante, kiss maangti hain, par tumhe nahi chahiye. Kya kar sakte ho?

options.en: Let her, because saying no is rude
options.hg: Karne do, kyunki mana karna rude hai

options.en: Start crying so that she stops asking you
options.hg: Rone lag jao taaki woh poochna band kare

options.en: Politely say no and offer a wave or namaste
options.hg: Politely mana karo aur wave ya namaste kar do

options.en: Run away and hide for the whole function
options.hg: Bhaag kar poore function mein chhup jao

explain.en: Your body belongs to you, even with relatives. A wave, high five or namaste is a kind way to say hello. A good grown-up will respect your choice.
explain.hg: Tumhari body tumhari hai, rishtedaaron ke saath bhi. Wave, high five ya namaste bhi pyaar se hello kehne ka tareeka hai. Achha bada tumhari choice ki respect karega.

q.en: You get a sudden 'uh-oh' feeling in your tummy when a grown-up asks you to come alone to their room. What should you do?
q.hg: Ek bada tumhe akele apne kamre mein bulata hai aur pet mein ajeeb 'uh-oh' feeling aati hai. Kya karoge?

options.en: Ignore it, grown-ups are always right
options.hg: Ignore karo, bade hamesha sahi hote hain

options.en: Listen to the feeling, stay with others, and tell
options.hg: Feeling ki suno, sabke saath raho, aur batao

options.en: Go with them, but don't tell anyone
options.hg: Unke saath chale jao, par kisi ko mat batana

options.en: Go only if they promise a treat
options.hg: Tabhi jao jab woh treat ka promise kare

explain.en: That uneasy feeling is your body's warning. You can say no, stay where other people are, and tell a trusted adult what happened. You will not be in trouble for being careful.
explain.hg: Woh ajeeb feeling tumhari body ki warning hai. Tum mana kar sakte ho, sabke beech reh sakte ho, aur trusted bade ko bata sakte ho. Saavdhaan rehne par daant nahi padegi.

q.en: Your friend whispers that someone touches her in a bad way, and she makes you promise not to tell. What should you do?
q.hg: Tumhari dost chupke se batati hai ki koi use galat tareeke se touch karta hai, aur promise leti hai ki kisi ko mat batana. Kya karoge?

options.en: Go and shout at the person yourself
options.hg: Khud jaa kar us insaan par chillaoge

options.en: Tell the whole class so everyone knows
options.hg: Poori class ko bata doge taaki sabko pata ho

options.en: Keep the promise, because friends never break one
options.hg: Promise nibhaoge, dost promise nahi todte

options.en: Tell a trusted adult, even though you promised
options.hg: Promise ke bawajood kisi trusted bade ko bataoge

explain.en: Some promises should be broken when someone is being hurt. Telling a trusted adult is how you help your friend stay safe. You are being a good friend, not a bad one.
explain.hg: Jab koi hurt ho raha ho, tab kuch promise todne hi chahiye. Trusted bade ko batana hi dost ko safe rakhne ka tareeka hai. Tum achhe dost ho, bure nahi.

q.en: Can a child call the Child Helpline 1098 alone, without asking their parents first?
q.hg: Kya koi bachcha bina parents se pooche akele Child Helpline 1098 par call kar sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, it is free and open day and night
options.hg: Haan, yeh free hai aur din-raat khula hai

options.en: Only if they call from a school phone
options.hg: Sirf tab jab school ke phone se call karein

options.en: No, only parents are allowed to call
options.hg: Nahi, sirf parents call kar sakte hain

options.en: Only after the police allow it
options.hg: Sirf police ki permission ke baad

explain.en: Any child can call 1098 for free, any time, about anything that makes them feel unsafe. Adults can also call it if they are worried about a child.
explain.hg: Koi bhi bachcha kabhi bhi 1098 par free call kar sakta hai, kisi bhi baat par jisse woh unsafe feel kare. Bade bhi call kar sakte hain agar unhe kisi bachche ki fikar ho.

q.en: A big boy in your building shows you pictures of people with no clothes on his phone. What should you do?
q.hg: Building ka ek bada ladka apne phone par bina kapdon wale logon ki photos dikhata hai. Kya karoge?

options.en: Walk away and tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Wahan se hat jao aur trusted bade ko batao

options.en: Ask him to send the pictures to you
options.hg: Usse photos tumhe bhejne ko kaho

options.en: Keep watching so he doesn't laugh at you
options.hg: Dekhte raho taaki woh tum par hase nahi

options.en: Keep it a secret between you two
options.hg: Isko tum dono ka secret rakho

explain.en: No one should show children pictures of private parts or people without clothes. It is not your fault you saw them. Leave and tell a trusted adult; you will not be in trouble.
explain.hg: Kisi ko bhi bachchon ko private parts ya bina kapdon wali photos nahi dikhani chahiye. Tumne dekh liya, isme tumhari galti nahi. Wahan se hato aur trusted bade ko batao; daant nahi padegi.

q.en: A grown-up asks you to touch their private parts. What is true?
q.hg: Koi bada tumse apne private parts touch karne ko kehta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: That is never okay; say no, get away and tell
options.hg: Yeh kabhi theek nahi; mana karo, hato aur batao

options.en: It is okay if they ask you nicely first
options.hg: Pehle pyaar se poochein toh theek hai

options.en: It is okay if they give you a gift
options.hg: Gift de toh theek hai

options.en: It is okay if the person is family
options.hg: Woh insaan family ka ho toh theek hai

explain.en: The body safety rule works both ways: no one should touch your private parts, and no one should ask you to touch theirs. Tell a trusted adult, and remember it is never your fault.
explain.hg: Body safety rule dono taraf hai: koi tumhare private parts na chhuye, aur koi tumse apne private parts na chhuwaye. Trusted bade ko batao, aur yaad rakho, yeh kabhi tumhari galti nahi.

q.en: Someone wants to take a photo of you without your clothes on. What should you do?
q.hg: Koi tumhari bina kapdon ki photo lena chahta hai. Kya karoge?

options.en: Say no, get away and tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Mana karo, wahan se hato aur trusted bade ko batao

options.en: Allow it if they promise to delete it
options.hg: Delete karne ka promise kare toh allow karo

options.en: Allow it but keep your face hidden
options.hg: Allow karo par chehra chhupa lo

options.en: Allow it if they are a family friend
options.hg: Family friend ho toh allow karo

explain.en: No one should take pictures of a child's private parts. If someone tries, it is not okay, and it is not your fault. Get away and tell a grown-up you trust as soon as you can.
explain.hg: Kisi ko bhi bachche ke private parts ki photo nahi leni chahiye. Agar koi koshish kare toh yeh galat hai, aur tumhari galti nahi. Wahan se hato aur jaldi se trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: The person who touched you says, 'If you tell, your parents will be angry with you.' What is true?
q.hg: Jisne tumhe touch kiya, woh kehta hai, 'Batayega toh mummy-papa tujh par gussa honge.' Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is true, so it's better to stay quiet
options.hg: Sach hai, toh chup rehna behtar hai

options.en: It is true only if you are a boy
options.hg: Sach hai, sirf agar tum ladke ho

options.en: It is a trick to stop you telling; tell anyway
options.hg: Yeh tumhe chup karane ki trick hai; phir bhi batao

options.en: It means you did something wrong
options.hg: Iska matlab tumne kuch galat kiya

explain.en: People who do unsafe things often scare children so they keep quiet. You did nothing wrong. A trusted adult wants to know and will help keep you safe.
explain.hg: Galat kaam karne wale aksar bachchon ko daraate hain taaki woh chup rahein. Tumne kuch galat nahi kiya. Trusted bada jaanna chahega aur tumhe safe rakhne mein madad karega.

q.en: Someone says they will hurt your pet if you tell anyone what they did. What is the bravest and safest thing to do?
q.hg: Koi kehta hai ki agar tumne kisi ko bataya toh woh tumhare pet ko nuksaan pahunchayega. Sabse bahaadur aur safe kya hai?

options.en: Give your pet away so you can tell
options.hg: Pet kisi aur ko de do, phir batao

options.en: Never tell anyone, to keep your pet safe
options.hg: Kisi ko kabhi mat batao, taaki pet safe rahe

options.en: Tell a trusted adult, who can protect you and your pet
options.hg: Trusted bade ko batao, woh tumhe aur pet ko bacha sakte hain

options.en: Try to handle the person on your own
options.hg: Akele us insaan se nipatne ki koshish karo

explain.en: Threats are how some people try to keep children silent. Grown-ups like parents, teachers, police and 1098 can protect you and the people and pets you love. Telling is the bravest choice.
explain.hg: Kuch log dhamki dekar bachchon ko chup karate hain. Parents, teachers, police aur 1098 tumhe aur tumhare apnon aur pets ko bacha sakte hain. Batana hi sabse bahaadur kadam hai.

q.en: Is telling a teacher that someone is being hurt the same as 'tattling'?
q.hg: Kya teacher ko batana ki kisi ko hurt kiya ja raha hai, 'chugli' karna hai?

options.en: Yes, and you should mind your own business
options.hg: Haan, apne kaam se kaam rakho

options.en: Yes, so only tell if you are asked
options.hg: Haan, toh sirf poochne par batao

options.en: Yes, unless the person is your best friend
options.hg: Haan, jab tak woh best friend na ho

options.en: No, telling to keep someone safe is the right thing
options.hg: Nahi, kisi ko safe rakhne ke liye batana sahi hai

explain.en: Tattling is trying to get someone in trouble for something small. Telling is getting help when someone is hurt or unsafe. Telling is always okay.
explain.hg: Chugli matlab chhoti baat par kisi ko phansana. Batana matlab jab koi hurt ya unsafe ho toh madad lena. Batana hamesha theek hai.

q.en: After school, a man you don't know says, 'Your mummy sent me to pick you up.' What should you do?
q.hg: School ke baad ek anjaan aadmi kehta hai, 'Tumhari mummy ne mujhe lene bheja hai.' Kya karoge?

options.en: Go if your friend comes with you
options.hg: Dost saath aaye toh chale jaoge

options.en: Go if he shows you a photo of her
options.hg: Chale jaoge agar woh mummy ki photo dikhaye

options.en: Go, because he knows your mummy's name
options.hg: Chale jaoge, kyunki use mummy ka naam pata hai

options.en: Not go, and tell a teacher or the guard
options.hg: Nahi jaoge, aur teacher ya guard ko bataoge

explain.en: Never go with someone your family has not told you about. Many families use a secret code word for this. Stay inside the school and tell a teacher or guard straight away.
explain.hg: Jiske baare mein family ne pehle nahi bataya, uske saath kabhi mat jao. Kai families iske liye ek secret code word rakhti hain. School ke andar raho aur turant teacher ya guard ko batao.

q.en: Can boys be abused or touched in unsafe ways too?
q.hg: Kya ladkon ke saath bhi abuse ya unsafe touch ho sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, and boys deserve help too
options.hg: Haan, aur ladkon ko bhi madad milni chahiye

options.en: Only if the boy is very young
options.hg: Sirf jab ladka bahut chhota ho

options.en: Only if the boy is small or weak
options.hg: Sirf agar ladka chhota ya kamzor ho

options.en: No, this only ever happens to girls
options.hg: Nahi, yeh sirf ladkiyon ke saath hota hai

explain.en: Abuse can happen to any child: boys, girls and transgender children. Boys sometimes stay quiet because of shame or 'be a man' talk. Boys who tell are brave and should be believed.
explain.hg: Abuse kisi bhi bachche ke saath ho sakta hai: ladke, ladkiyan, transgender bachche. Ladke kabhi 'mard ban' wali baaton ki wajah se chup rehte hain. Jo ladka batata hai woh bahaadur hai, uska yakeen karna chahiye.

q.en: An older student on the school van keeps touching you in a way you don't like. What should you do?
q.hg: School van mein ek senior baar-baar tumhe aise touch karta hai jo tumhe pasand nahi. Kya karoge?

options.en: Tell your parents or class teacher
options.hg: Parents ya class teacher ko batao

options.en: Keep quiet so he doesn't get angry
options.hg: Chup raho taaki woh gussa na ho

options.en: Put up with it, he is only a student
options.hg: Seh lo, woh toh bas student hai

options.en: Stop going to school
options.hg: School jaana band kar do

explain.en: The body safety rules apply to everyone, including older children. Tell a parent or teacher so they can change seats, talk to the school and keep you safe.
explain.hg: Body safety rules sab par lagte hain, bade bachchon par bhi. Parents ya teacher ko batao, taaki woh seat badlein, school se baat karein aur tumhe safe rakhein.

q.en: Your tuition teacher says, 'Let's keep our extra lesson a secret. Your parents don't need to know.' What is the best response?
q.hg: Tuition teacher kehte hain, 'Hamari extra class secret rakhte hain. Parents ko jaanne ki zaroorat nahi.' Sabse sahi kya hai?

options.en: Keep the secret, because teachers know best
options.hg: Secret rakho, teachers sab jaante hain

options.en: Tell your parents about the 'secret lesson'
options.hg: Parents ko is 'secret class' ke baare mein batao

options.en: Go to the lesson but stay silent about it
options.hg: Class jao par uske baare mein chup raho

options.en: Ask your friends to keep it secret too
options.hg: Doston ko bhi secret rakhne ko kaho

explain.en: A safe teacher has no reason to hide lessons from parents. Secrecy plus time alone is a warning sign. Telling your parents keeps you safe, and you will not be in trouble.
explain.hg: Safe teacher ko parents se class chhupane ki koi wajah nahi. Secret aur akele mein time, dono saath ho toh warning sign hai. Parents ko batana tumhe safe rakhta hai, daant nahi padegi.

q.en: Your older cousin keeps walking into the bathroom while you are inside, and laughs when you complain. What is true?
q.hg: Tumhara bada cousin baar-baar bathroom mein aa jaata hai jab tum andar ho, aur shikayat karne par hasta hai. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It is just a joke between cousins
options.hg: Yeh cousins ke beech bas mazaak hai

options.en: You have a right to privacy; tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Tumhe privacy ka haq hai; trusted bade ko batao

options.en: You should stop bathing at home for a while
options.hg: Kuch din ghar par nahaana band kar do

options.en: Privacy does not apply inside the family
options.hg: Family mein privacy nahi hoti

explain.en: Everyone, including children, deserves privacy while bathing and changing. Doing it again after you complained is not a joke. Tell a parent or another trusted adult.
explain.hg: Har kisi ko, bachchon ko bhi, nahaate aur kapde badalte waqt privacy ka haq hai. Mana karne ke baad bhi karna mazaak nahi. Parents ya kisi aur trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: A grown-up asks you to keep a secret about touching. What should you know?
q.hg: Ek bada tumse touch ke baare mein secret rakhne ko kehta hai. Tumhe kya pata hona chahiye?

options.en: You must keep all secrets grown-ups ask for
options.hg: Badon ka har secret rakhna zaroori hai

options.en: Safe adults never ask children to hide touches
options.hg: Safe bade kabhi bachchon se touch chhupane ko nahi kehte

options.en: Secrets about touch are fine with relatives
options.hg: Rishtedaaron ke saath touch wale secret theek hain

options.en: Some touches are meant to stay secret
options.hg: Kuch touch secret rakhne ke liye hote hain

explain.en: There should be no secrets about touching. If anyone asks you to hide a touch, that itself is a warning sign. Tell a trusted adult straight away.
explain.hg: Touch ke baare mein koi secret nahi hona chahiye. Agar koi touch chhupane ko kahe, toh wahi ek warning sign hai. Turant trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: Tanya loves her uncle, but he touches her in ways that feel wrong. She worries telling will get him in trouble. What is true?
q.hg: Tanya apne chacha se pyaar karti hai, par woh use aise touch karte hain jo galat lagta hai. Use darr hai ki batane se chacha musibat mein padenge. Sach kya hai?

options.en: Telling would make her a bad, ungrateful niece
options.hg: Batane se woh buri, ehsaan-faramosh bhatiji ban jayegi

options.en: She should stay quiet because she loves him
options.hg: Use chup rehna chahiye kyunki woh unse pyaar karti hai

options.en: Her safety matters more; protecting him is not her job
options.hg: Uski safety zyada zaroori hai; chacha ko bachana uska kaam nahi

options.en: She should wait until he says sorry to her
options.hg: Use wait karna chahiye jab tak chacha usse sorry na bolein

explain.en: It is normal to love someone and still feel scared or confused by what they do. The grown-up is responsible for his actions, not Tanya. Telling a trusted adult or 1098 is the right step.
explain.hg: Kisi se pyaar karna aur saath mein unki harkaton se darrna ya confuse hona normal hai. Apni harkaton ke zimmedaar chacha hain, Tanya nahi. Trusted bade ya 1098 ko batana sahi kadam hai.

q.en: A classmate dares you to show your private parts 'just for fun'. What should you do?
q.hg: Ek classmate dare deta hai ki 'bas mazaak ke liye' apne private parts dikhao. Kya karoge?

options.en: Say no, leave, and tell an adult if it goes on
options.hg: Mana karo, hat jao, aur na ruke toh bade ko batao

options.en: Do it if everyone else in the group does
options.hg: Group mein sab kar rahe hon toh kar do

options.en: Dare them to do it first, then decide
options.hg: Pehle unhe dare do, phir dekhna

options.en: Do it quickly so they stop asking
options.hg: Jaldi se kar do taaki woh poochna band karein

explain.en: Private parts stay private, even in a game or a dare. Saying no is not rude. If someone keeps pushing, a teacher or parent should know.
explain.hg: Private parts private hi rehte hain, game ya dare mein bhi. Mana karna rude nahi hai. Agar koi baar-baar force kare, toh teacher ya parents ko pata hona chahiye.

q.en: After an unsafe touch, Kabir feels dirty and ashamed. What is true for Kabir?
q.hg: Ek unsafe touch ke baad Kabir ko ganda aur sharminda feel hota hai. Kabir ke liye sach kya hai?

options.en: Those feelings will mean he can never be happy
options.hg: In feelings ki wajah se woh kabhi khush nahi ho paayega

options.en: Feeling ashamed means it was partly his fault
options.hg: Sharam aana matlab thodi galti uski thi

options.en: He should hide his feelings from everyone
options.hg: Use apni feelings sabse chhupani chahiye

options.en: He did nothing wrong, and talking can help him feel better
options.hg: Usne kuch galat nahi kiya, aur baat karne se behtar lagega

explain.en: Many children feel shame after abuse, but the shame belongs to the person who did it. Talking to a trusted adult, a counsellor or 1098 can help Kabir feel safe and okay again.
explain.hg: Abuse ke baad bahut bachchon ko sharam aati hai, par woh sharam galat karne wale ki hai. Trusted bade, counsellor ya 1098 se baat karke Kabir phir se safe aur theek feel kar sakta hai.

q.en: A grown-up you know asks you to sit on their lap and you don't want to. What can you say?
q.hg: Ek jaan-pehchaan wale bade tumhe god mein baithne ko kehte hain aur tumhara mann nahi hai. Kya bol sakte ho?

options.en: 'Okay', even though you feel bad
options.hg: 'Okay', bhale hi bura lage

options.en: Nothing, children must always obey
options.hg: Kuch nahi, bachchon ko hamesha maanna chahiye

options.en: 'Only if you give me a toy'
options.hg: 'Sirf tab jab toy doge'

options.en: 'No thank you, I'll sit here.'
options.hg: 'Nahi, thank you, main yahan baithunga/baithungi.'

explain.en: You are allowed to say no to touch you do not want, even from grown-ups you know. Saying it politely and firmly is enough. If they don't listen, tell a trusted adult.
explain.hg: Jo touch tumhe nahi chahiye, use tum mana kar sakte ho, jaan-pehchaan ke badon ko bhi. Politely aur pakke se bolna kaafi hai. Na maanein toh trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: Is it okay to say 'no' to a grown-up who wants to touch you in a way you don't like?
q.hg: Kya kisi bade ko 'no' bolna theek hai jo tumhe aise touch karna chahe jo tumhe pasand nahi?

options.en: No, children must never say no to adults
options.hg: Nahi, bachche badon ko kabhi no nahi bolte

options.en: Only to strangers, never to people you know
options.hg: Sirf anjaan logon ko, jaan-pehchaan walon ko nahi

options.en: Only if a parent is standing next to you
options.hg: Sirf tab jab parents paas khade hon

options.en: Yes, you can always say no to unwanted touch
options.hg: Haan, unwanted touch ko hamesha no bol sakte ho

explain.en: Being respectful does not mean letting anyone touch you. You can say no to anyone, and then tell a trusted adult. Your body belongs to you.
explain.hg: Respect karne ka matlab yeh nahi ki koi bhi tumhe touch kare. Tum kisi ko bhi no bol sakte ho, aur phir trusted bade ko batao. Tumhari body tumhari hai.

q.en: You are lost in a crowded mall. Who is the safest person to ask for help?
q.hg: Tum ek bheed wale mall mein kho gaye ho. Madad ke liye sabse safe kaun hai?

options.en: Nobody; walk around until you find them
options.hg: Kisi se nahi; ghoomte raho jab tak mil na jaayein

options.en: A person who says they know your parents
options.hg: Jo kahe ki woh tumhare parents ko jaanta hai

options.en: Anyone who offers to take you outside
options.hg: Koi bhi jo bahar le jaane ki baat kare

options.en: A shop counter staff member or security guard
options.hg: Dukaan ke counter wala staff ya security guard

explain.en: Stay inside, go to a shop counter, information desk or guard in uniform, and tell them your parent's name and phone number. Do not leave the place with anyone.
explain.hg: Andar hi raho, kisi shop counter, information desk ya uniform wale guard ke paas jao, aur parents ka naam aur phone number batao. Kisi ke saath bahar mat jao.

q.en: Under the POCSO Act, who counts as a 'child'?
q.hg: POCSO Act ke hisaab se 'child' kaun hai?

options.en: Only girls under 16
options.hg: Sirf 16 se kam umar ki ladkiyan

options.en: Anyone under 18
options.hg: 18 saal se kam umar ka koi bhi

options.en: Anyone under 14
options.hg: 14 saal se kam umar ka koi bhi

options.en: Anyone still in school
options.hg: Koi bhi jo abhi school mein hai

explain.en: POCSO, India's child sexual abuse law, protects every person under 18. It does not matter whether they are a boy, girl or transgender child, or whether they are still in school.
explain.hg: POCSO, India ka child sexual abuse kanoon, 18 saal se kam har insaan ko protect karta hai. Ladka ho, ladki ho ya transgender bachcha, school mein ho ya nahi, farak nahi padta.

q.en: A 14-year-old boy is groped by an older man at his gym. Which law specifically protects him?
q.hg: Gym mein ek bade aadmi ne 14 saal ke ladke ko galat tareeke se chhua. Kaunsa kanoon khaas taur par use protect karta hai?

options.en: The POCSO Act, which covers every child under 18
options.hg: POCSO Act, jo 18 se kam har bachche ko cover karta hai

options.en: Only a law that applies after age 18
options.hg: Sirf woh kanoon jo 18 ke baad lagta hai

options.en: None, because the law protects only girls
options.hg: Koi nahi, kyunki kanoon sirf ladkiyon ko bachata hai

options.en: Only the gym's own membership rules
options.hg: Sirf gym ke apne membership rules

explain.en: POCSO is gender-neutral: it protects all children, whatever their gender, and applies to anyone who abuses them. Boys who are abused have the same right to help and justice; he or a trusted adult can report it.
explain.hg: POCSO gender-neutral hai: har bachche ko protect karta hai, gender kuch bhi ho, aur har abuser par lagta hai. Abuse hue ladkon ko bhi madad aur insaaf ka utna hi haq hai; woh ya koi trusted bada report kar sakta hai.

q.en: Which of these can be an offence under the POCSO Act, even with no touching at all?
q.hg: In mein se kya POCSO ke under offence ho sakta hai, bina kisi touch ke bhi?

options.en: Teaching a child correct body-part names
options.hg: Bachche ko body parts ke sahi naam sikhana

options.en: Hugging a child who asked for a hug
options.hg: Hug maangne wale bachche ko hug karna

options.en: A doctor examining a child with a parent present
options.hg: Parent ke saamne doctor ka bachche ko check karna

options.en: Showing a child sexual pictures or videos
options.hg: Bachche ko sexual photos ya videos dikhana

explain.en: POCSO covers more than touch. Sexual harassment, such as showing sexual material to a child, making sexual remarks or following a child, is also an offence, as is using a child for sexual images.
explain.hg: POCSO sirf touch tak nahi hai. Sexual harassment, jaise bachche ko sexual material dikhana, sexual comments karna ya peecha karna, bhi offence hai, aur bachche ki sexual images banana bhi.

q.en: A 23-year-old tells a 15-year-old, 'It's fine, because you agreed.' What does Indian law say?
q.hg: Ek 23 saal ka insaan 15 saal ki ladki/ladke se kehta hai, 'Sab theek hai, tumne haan bola tha.' Indian law kya kehta hai?

options.en: It is legal if they are in a relationship
options.hg: Relationship mein hon toh legal hai

options.en: It is an offence with anyone under 18, agreed or not
options.hg: 18 se kam umar ke saath yeh offence hai, haan bola ho ya nahi

options.en: It is legal if both families agree to it
options.hg: Dono families maan jaayein toh legal hai

options.en: It is legal if the teen said yes to it
options.hg: Teen ne haan bola toh legal hai

explain.en: Under POCSO, a person under 18 cannot legally consent to sexual activity, so 'they agreed' is no defence. The teen is never to blame; the adult is responsible.
explain.hg: POCSO ke under 18 se kam umar ka insaan legally sexual activity ke liye consent nahi de sakta, toh 'usne haan bola' koi bahaana nahi. Teen ki koi galti nahi; zimmedaar adult hai.

q.en: Grooming usually happens in steps. Which order is most typical?
q.hg: Grooming aksar steps mein hoti hai. Sabse typical order kaunsa hai?

options.en: Crossing boundaries first, then building trust
options.hg: Pehle boundaries todna, phir trust banana

options.en: Abuse first, then gifts to keep the child quiet
options.hg: Pehle abuse, phir bachche ko chup rakhne ke liye gifts

options.en: Attention and gifts, then secrets, time alone and crossing lines
options.hg: Attention aur gifts, phir secrets, akele mein time aur boundaries todna

options.en: Threats first, then gifts, then close friendship
options.hg: Pehle dhamki, phir gifts, phir gehri dosti

explain.en: Groomers usually start by being extra kind: special attention, gifts and listening. Then come secrets and time alone, and small boundary-crossings that grow. Spotting the early steps lets adults step in.
explain.hg: Groomer aksar pehle bahut achhe bante hain: special attention, gifts, dhyaan se sunna. Phir secrets, akele mein time, aur chhoti-chhoti boundaries todna jo badhta jaata hai. Shuru ke steps pehchaan lo toh bade beech mein aa sakte hain.

q.en: Your 25-year-old neighbour messages you, 'You're so mature for your age. Don't tell anyone we chat.' What is this most likely?
q.hg: 25 saal ka padosi message karta hai, 'Tum apni umar se zyada mature ho. Kisi ko mat batana hum baat karte hain.' Yeh kya ho sakta hai?

options.en: A grooming sign; tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Grooming ka sign; trusted bade ko batao

options.en: A normal friendship between neighbours
options.hg: Padosiyon ki normal dosti

options.en: A compliment and nothing more
options.hg: Bas ek compliment, aur kuch nahi

options.en: A sign he wants to help with studies
options.hg: Sign ki woh padhai mein madad karna chahta hai

explain.en: Flattery like 'mature for your age' plus a request for secrecy is a classic grooming pattern. You have done nothing wrong. Keep the messages and tell a parent, teacher or 1098.
explain.hg: 'Umar se zyada mature' jaisi taareef aur saath mein secret rakhne ko kehna, grooming ka classic pattern hai. Tumne kuch galat nahi kiya. Messages sambhal ke rakho aur parent, teacher ya 1098 ko batao.

q.en: A friend tells you her coach has been touching her, and begs you not to tell. What is the most helpful response?
q.hg: Ek dost batati hai ki uska coach use touch karta raha hai, aur request karti hai ki kisi ko mat batana. Sabse helpful response kya hai?

options.en: Believe her, say it's not her fault, help her tell an adult
options.hg: Yakeen karo, bolo uski galti nahi, bade ko batane mein madad karo

options.en: Name and shame the coach on social media
options.hg: Social media par coach ka naam lekar sharminda karo

options.en: Ask her why she didn't stop it much earlier
options.hg: Usse poocho ki usne bahut pehle kyun nahi roka

options.en: Keep the secret so she keeps trusting you
options.hg: Secret rakho taaki woh tum par trust karti rahe

explain.en: First, believe her and tell her it is not her fault. Then help her talk to a trusted adult or call 1098 together. Her safety matters more than the promise; posting online can harm her and the case.
explain.hg: Pehle uska yakeen karo aur bolo ki uski galti nahi. Phir trusted bade se baat karne ya saath mein 1098 call karne mein madad karo. Promise se zyada uski safety zaroori hai; online post karne se use aur case dono ko nuksaan ho sakta hai.

q.en: Apart from parents, who can a teenager turn to about abuse?
q.hg: Parents ke alawa, abuse ke baare mein teenager kisse baat kar sakta hai?

options.en: Only the person who caused the harm
options.hg: Sirf us insaan se jisne nuksaan kiya

options.en: No one; teens must handle it alone
options.hg: Kisi se nahi; teens ko akele sambhalna padta hai

options.en: A school counsellor, a teacher they trust, or 1098
options.hg: School counsellor, trusted teacher, ya 1098

options.en: Only the police, and nobody else at all
options.hg: Sirf police, aur koi bhi nahi

explain.en: If home does not feel safe to talk, there are other trusted adults: a counsellor, teacher, relative or doctor. The Child Helpline 1098 is free and open day and night.
explain.hg: Agar ghar par baat karna safe na lage, toh aur trusted bade hain: counsellor, teacher, rishtedaar ya doctor. Child Helpline 1098 free hai aur din-raat khuli hai.

q.en: You are 15 and tell your school counsellor about sexual abuse. Can they promise to keep it completely secret?
q.hg: Tum 15 saal ke ho aur school counsellor ko sexual abuse ke baare mein batate ho. Kya woh poora secret rakhne ka promise kar sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, counsellors must never tell anyone
options.hg: Haan, counsellor kabhi kisi ko nahi bata sakte

options.en: Yes, as long as you don't tell anyone else
options.hg: Haan, jab tak tum kisi aur ko na batao

options.en: No, they have to tell your whole class too
options.hg: Nahi, unhe poori class ko bhi batana padega

options.en: No; the law requires a report, but they should protect you
options.hg: Nahi; kanoon report maangta hai, par woh tumhe protect karenge

explain.en: Under POCSO, anyone who knows about child sexual abuse must report it to the police or Special Juvenile Police Unit. A good counsellor will be honest about this and explain each step; your identity is protected.
explain.hg: POCSO ke under jo bhi child sexual abuse ke baare mein jaanta hai, use police ya Special Juvenile Police Unit ko report karna hota hai. Achha counsellor yeh honestly batayega aur har step samjhayega; tumhari pehchaan protected rehti hai.

q.en: On the school bus, you see a senior repeatedly touching younger students who look scared. What should you do?
q.hg: School bus mein tum dekhte ho ki ek senior baar-baar chhote bachchon ko touch karta hai aur woh darre hue lagte hain. Kya karoge?

options.en: Film it secretly and post it in the class group
options.hg: Chupke se video banao aur class group mein daal do

options.en: Tell the bus attendant or a teacher, and stay near the juniors
options.hg: Bus attendant ya teacher ko batao, aur juniors ke paas raho

options.en: Wait to see if the juniors complain first
options.hg: Wait karo ki juniors khud shikayat karein

options.en: Ignore it, because it's none of your business
options.hg: Ignore karo, kyunki tumhara koi lena-dena nahi

explain.en: You can help without getting into a fight. Report what you saw to an adult in charge, and offer the younger students a seat near you. Posting videos can shame the children who were targeted.
explain.hg: Ladai kiye bina bhi madad ho sakti hai. Jo dekha woh kisi zimmedaar bade ko batao, aur chhote bachchon ko apne paas baithne do. Video post karne se jin bachchon ke saath hua unki hi beizzati ho sakti hai.

q.en: A boy in your class says a coach did something sexual to him. Some classmates laugh. What is the best thing to say?
q.hg: Class ka ek ladka batata hai ki coach ne uske saath kuch sexual kiya. Kuch classmates haste hain. Sabse achha kya bologe?

options.en: 'It's not your fault. Let's tell a teacher.'
options.hg: 'Tumhari galti nahi. Chalo teacher ko batate hain.'

options.en: 'Just forget about it and move on, yaar.'
options.hg: 'Bhool jao yaar, aage badho.'

options.en: 'Why didn't you just fight back or run?'
options.hg: 'Tumne ladai kyun nahi ki, ya bhaage kyun nahi?'

options.en: 'Boys can't be abused, stop making it up.'
options.hg: 'Ladkon ke saath aisa nahi hota, kahani mat banao.'

explain.en: Boys can be sexually abused, and laughing makes it harder for them to speak up. Believing him, saying it is not his fault and helping him reach a trusted adult or 1098 is what helps.
explain.hg: Ladkon ke saath bhi sexual abuse hota hai, aur hasne se unke liye bolna aur mushkil ho jaata hai. Yakeen karna, kehna ki galti uski nahi, aur trusted bade ya 1098 tak pahunchne mein madad karna hi sahi hai.

q.en: At tuition, a classmate keeps 'accidentally' brushing against you, though you have moved away twice. What is the best step?
q.hg: Tuition mein ek classmate baar-baar 'galti se' tumse takraata hai, jabki tum do baar door hat chuke ho. Sabse sahi step kya hai?

options.en: Blame yourself for choosing to sit near him
options.hg: Uske paas baithne ke liye khud ko blame karo

options.en: Tell him clearly to stop, and tell the tutor or a parent
options.hg: Saaf bolo ki band kare, aur tutor ya parents ko batao

options.en: Assume it is just an accident every single time
options.hg: Har baar ise bas accident maan lo

options.en: Stop going to tuition without telling anyone
options.hg: Kisi ko bataye bina tuition jaana chhod do

explain.en: When something keeps happening after you have moved away, it is not an accident. You can say 'Stop' firmly and tell an adult who can change the seating. It is not your fault.
explain.hg: Door hatne ke baad bhi baar-baar ho, toh yeh accident nahi. Tum pakke se 'Stop' bol sakte ho aur kisi bade ko bata sakte ho jo seating badal sake. Tumhari galti nahi.

q.en: Someone was abused and their body reacted in ways that confused them. What is true?
q.hg: Kisi ke saath abuse hua aur unki body ne aise react kiya jisse woh confuse ho gaye. Sach kya hai?

options.en: It never means they wanted it or were to blame
options.hg: Iska kabhi matlab nahi ki unhe chahiye tha ya galti unki thi

options.en: It means that, deep down, they agreed to it
options.hg: Iska matlab andar se unhone haan bola tha

options.en: It means they should never tell anyone about it
options.hg: Iska matlab unhe kabhi kisi ko nahi batana chahiye

options.en: It means the abuse was not really abuse
options.hg: Iska matlab abuse asal mein abuse nahi tha

explain.en: Bodies can react automatically to touch, and that has nothing to do with wanting it. Abusers sometimes use this to make children feel guilty. The responsibility is always the abuser's.
explain.hg: Body touch par apne aap react kar sakti hai, iska chahne se koi lena-dena nahi. Abusers kabhi-kabhi isi se bachchon ko guilty feel karaate hain. Zimmedaari hamesha abuser ki hai.

q.en: Priya, 15, says her family has fixed her marriage for next month. Who can she call for help?
q.hg: 15 saal ki Priya kehti hai ki ghar walon ne agle mahine uski shaadi tay kar di hai. Woh madad ke liye kise call kar sakti hai?

options.en: 14416, only after the wedding
options.hg: 14416, sirf shaadi ke baad

options.en: No one, families decide marriages
options.hg: Kisi ko nahi, shaadi family tay karti hai

options.en: 1098, the Child Helpline
options.hg: 1098, Child Helpline

options.en: 1097, the HIV helpline
options.hg: 1097, HIV helpline

explain.en: Child marriage is illegal in India: girls must be 18 and boys 21. 1098 can work with local child-protection officers and police to stop the marriage. Priya is not doing anything wrong by asking for help.
explain.hg: India mein child marriage illegal hai: ladki ki umar 18 aur ladke ki 21 honi chahiye. 1098 local child-protection officers aur police ke saath milkar shaadi rok sakti hai. Madad maangkar Priya kuch galat nahi kar rahi.

q.en: A stranger on social media offers your 16-year-old friend a well-paid job in another city, with travel paid, if she leaves quietly. What is the main worry?
q.hg: Social media par ek anjaan insaan tumhari 16 saal ki dost ko doosre shehar mein achhi salary wali job offer karta hai, travel ka kharcha bhi, bas chupchaap aana hai. Sabse badi chinta kya hai?

options.en: It is a lucky chance she should not miss
options.hg: Yeh lucky chance hai, chhodna nahi chahiye

options.en: It's fine if the stranger seems polite
options.hg: Anjaan polite lage toh theek hai

options.en: The only worry is the salary amount
options.hg: Bas salary kitni hai, yahi chinta hai

options.en: It could be trafficking; tell an adult or call 1098
options.hg: Yeh trafficking ho sakti hai; bade ko batao ya 1098 call karo

explain.en: Too-good offers that ask a teenager to travel secretly are a common trafficking pattern. Real jobs do not need secrecy from family. Tell a trusted adult or call 1098 or 112.
explain.hg: Bahut achhe offers jisme teen ko chupke se travel karne ko kaha jaaye, trafficking ka common pattern hai. Asli job mein family se kuch chhupaane ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Trusted bade ko batao ya 1098 ya 112 call karo.

q.en: Your class teacher starts sending you late-night personal messages and asks you to delete them. What is the best step?
q.hg: Tumhare class teacher raat ko der se personal messages bhejne lagte hain aur delete karne ko kehte hain. Sabse sahi step kya hai?

options.en: Delete them as asked to avoid trouble
options.hg: Kehne ke hisaab se delete kar do taaki problem na ho

options.en: Keep the messages and show a parent or the principal
options.hg: Messages rakh lo aur parents ya principal ko dikhao

options.en: Reply politely so marks are not affected
options.hg: Politely reply karo taaki marks par asar na pade

options.en: Confront the teacher alone after class
options.hg: Class ke baad akele teacher se ladai karo

explain.en: A teacher asking a student to hide or delete private messages is crossing a clear boundary. Saving the messages and telling a parent, the principal or 1098 protects you. You are not to blame.
explain.hg: Teacher ka student se private messages chhupane ya delete karne ko kehna saaf boundary todna hai. Messages save karke parents, principal ya 1098 ko batana tumhe protect karta hai. Tumhari galti nahi.

q.en: Is a teenager ever to blame for being sexually abused because of what they wore or where they went?
q.hg: Kya kabhi koi teenager apne kapdon ya kahin jaane ki wajah se sexual abuse ke liye zimmedaar hota hai?

options.en: Yes, if their clothes were short
options.hg: Haan, agar kapde chhote the

options.en: Never; only the abuser is to blame
options.hg: Kabhi nahi; zimmedaar sirf abuser hai

options.en: Yes, if they went out at night
options.hg: Haan, agar woh raat ko bahar gaye

options.en: Yes, if they had chatted with the person
options.hg: Haan, agar unhone us insaan se baat ki thi

explain.en: Clothes, time of day or friendliness never cause abuse; abusers choose to abuse. Blaming the survivor keeps others silent. Support and belief help them heal.
explain.hg: Kapde, waqt ya friendly hona kabhi abuse ki wajah nahi; abuser khud chunta hai. Survivor ko blame karne se doosre bhi chup ho jaate hain. Saath aur yakeen se hi healing hoti hai.

q.en: Why do many children not tell anyone when they are being abused?
q.hg: Bahut bachche abuse hone par kisi ko kyun nahi batate?

options.en: Because children always forget such things
options.hg: Kyunki bachche aisi baatein hamesha bhool jaate hain

options.en: They fear threats, blame or not being believed
options.hg: Unhe dhamki, blame ya yakeen na kiye jaane ka darr hota hai

options.en: Because the abuse did not really bother them
options.hg: Kyunki abuse se unhe farak nahi pada

options.en: Because they want to protect their friends
options.hg: Kyunki woh apne doston ko bachana chahte hain

explain.en: Children often stay silent because the abuser threatened them, because they feel ashamed or confused, or because they fear adults will blame or doubt them. Calm, believing adults make telling easier.
explain.hg: Bachche aksar isliye chup rehte hain kyunki abuser ne dhamki di, woh sharminda ya confuse hain, ya darr hai ki bade blame karenge ya yakeen nahi karenge. Shaant aur yakeen karne wale bade batana aasaan banate hain.

q.en: Your younger brother says his tuition sir 'tickles him in a way he doesn't like' and makes him promise not to tell. What should you do?
q.hg: Chhota bhai batata hai ki tuition sir use 'aise gudgudi karte hain jo use pasand nahi' aur promise lete hain ki kisi ko na bataye. Kya karoge?

options.en: Tell him to stop exaggerating things
