options.hg: Usse bolo baat ko badha-chadha kar mat bolo

options.en: Keep his promise so he keeps trusting you
options.hg: Uska promise rakho taaki woh tum par trust karta rahe

options.en: Laugh it off, since tickling is harmless
options.hg: Has ke taal do, gudgudi toh harmless hai

options.en: Thank him, and tell a parent or trusted adult today
options.hg: Thank you bolo, aur aaj hi parents ya trusted bade ko batao

explain.en: Touch a child does not like, combined with a secret, is a warning sign. Thank him for telling, say he did the right thing, and bring in a parent or 1098. Do not ask him lots of detailed questions yourself.
explain.hg: Jo touch bachche ko pasand nahi, aur saath mein secret, yeh warning sign hai. Batane ke liye thank you bolo, kaho usne sahi kiya, aur parents ya 1098 ko shaamil karo. Khud usse bahut detail mein sawaal mat poocho.

q.en: Your 12-year-old sister's 'gamer friend' sends her gift cards and asks her to keep their chats private. What is the best move?
q.hg: Tumhari 12 saal ki behen ka 'gamer friend' use gift cards bhejta hai aur kehta hai chats private rakho. Sabse sahi kya hai?

options.en: Shout at her and delete the game
options.hg: Uspar chillao aur game delete kar do

options.en: Message the friend and threaten him
options.hg: Us friend ko message karke dhamki do

options.en: Ignore it; gamers send gifts all the time
options.hg: Ignore karo; gamers gifts bhejte rehte hain

options.en: Calmly talk to her and tell your parents
options.hg: Shaanti se usse baat karo aur parents ko batao

explain.en: Gifts plus secrecy from an online adult are classic grooming signs. Stay calm so she doesn't feel blamed, tell your parents, keep the chats, and report the account if needed.
explain.hg: Online adult se gifts aur secrecy, dono grooming ke classic signs hain. Shaant raho taaki use blame na lage, parents ko batao, chats sambhal ke rakho, aur zaroorat ho toh account report karo.

q.en: In POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases registered in India in 2024, who was the offender in most cases?
q.hg: India mein 2024 mein darj POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases mein zyada tar offender kaun tha?

options.en: A complete stranger
options.hg: Koi bilkul anjaan

options.en: Someone the child knew
options.hg: Koi jise bachcha jaanta tha

options.en: A person from another state
options.hg: Doosre state ka koi insaan

options.en: Someone the child met that same day
options.hg: Koi jisse bachcha usi din mila

explain.en: NCRB data show that in 96.6% of POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases registered in 2024, the offender was someone the child knew. 'Stranger danger' alone does not protect children.
explain.hg: NCRB data ke mutabik 2024 mein darj POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases mein se 96.6% mein offender koi jaan-pehchaan wala tha. Sirf 'stranger danger' sikhane se bachche safe nahi hote.

q.en: Which of these is a common grooming red flag in an adult's behaviour?
q.hg: Kisi adult ke behaviour mein kaunsa common grooming red flag hai?

options.en: Helping a child with homework in the living room
options.hg: Living room mein bachche ka homework karwana

options.en: Greeting all the children in a group equally
options.hg: Group mein sab bachchon se ek jaisa milna

options.en: Giving one child special attention, gifts and time alone
options.hg: Ek bachche ko special attention, gifts aur akele mein time dena

options.en: Telling parents about a child's progress
options.hg: Parents ko bachche ki progress batana

explain.en: Child-protection groups list singling out one child, gifts, touching or hugging, acting as the child's special listener and seeking time alone as grooming red flags. Watch the pattern, not one act.
explain.hg: Child-protection organisations grooming ke red flags batate hain: ek bachche ko alag se chunna, gifts, touch ya hug, bachche ka 'special' sunne wala banna, akele mein time dhundhna. Ek harkat nahi, pattern dekho.

q.en: A family friend keeps offering to babysit only your youngest child, free, and gets annoyed when plans change. Why might this matter?
q.hg: Ek family friend baar-baar sirf aapke sabse chhote bachche ko free mein sambhalne ki offer karta hai, aur plan badalne par naraz hota hai. Yeh kyun maayne rakhta hai?

options.en: Babysitting offers like this are always a crime
options.hg: Aise babysitting offers hamesha crime hote hain

options.en: Offering to help the family can be how groomers gain access
options.hg: Family ki madad ke bahaane groomer bachche tak pahunch banate hain

options.en: It matters only if the child complains about it
options.hg: Sirf tab maayne rakhta hai jab bachcha shikayat kare

options.en: It only shows the friend is simply very generous
options.hg: Isse bas pata chalta hai ki woh bahut dildaar hain

explain.en: Groomers often win the trust of parents too, by being helpful, so they can be alone with a child. One offer proves nothing, but insistence on one child and on time alone deserves attention.
explain.hg: Groomer aksar parents ka bhi trust jeet-te hain, madad karke, taaki bachche ke saath akele reh sakein. Ek offer se kuch saabit nahi hota, par ek hi bachche aur akele time par zid dhyaan dene wali baat hai.

q.en: Which signs of child sexual abuse are more common: physical injuries, or changes in emotions and behaviour?
q.hg: Child sexual abuse ke kaunse signs zyada common hain: physical chot, ya emotions aur behaviour mein badlaav?

options.en: Physical injuries that anyone can see
options.hg: Physical chot jo sabko dikhe

options.en: There are never any signs
options.hg: Koi sign hota hi nahi

options.en: Changes in emotions and behaviour
options.hg: Emotions aur behaviour mein badlaav

options.en: Both are equally rare
options.hg: Dono hi bahut rare hain

explain.en: Emotional and behavioural signs are more common: sleep problems, nightmares, fear of a person, bedwetting again, mood or school changes. They can have other causes, so respond with calm questions, not panic.
explain.hg: Emotional aur behavioural signs zyada common hain: neend ki dikkat, bure sapne, kisi insaan se darr, phir se bistar geela karna, mood ya school mein badlaav. Inki aur wajah bhi ho sakti hai, isliye shaanti se baat karo, ghabrao mat.

q.en: Your 7-year-old suddenly refuses to go to a relative's house and cries when you insist. What is the best response?
q.hg: Aapka 7 saal ka bachcha achaanak ek rishtedaar ke ghar jaane se mana karta hai aur zor dene par rota hai. Sabse sahi response kya hai?

options.en: Punish the child for being rude to elders
options.hg: Badon se rude hone ke liye bachche ko saza do

options.en: Insist, so the relative is not insulted
options.hg: Zid karo, taaki rishtedaar ko bura na lage

options.en: Don't force it; calmly ask open questions and listen
options.hg: Zabardasti mat karo; shaanti se khule sawaal poocho aur suno

options.en: Ignore it, since all children have moods
options.hg: Ignore karo, sab bachchon ke mood hote hain

explain.en: Fear of a particular person can be a warning sign. Take it seriously, don't force contact, and ask gently, 'Did something happen there that you didn't like?' Listen without reacting with anger.
explain.hg: Kisi khaas insaan se darr warning sign ho sakta hai. Ise seriously lo, milne par zor mat do, aur pyaar se poocho, 'Wahan kuch hua jo tumhe achha nahi laga?' Gussa dikhaye bina suno.

q.en: A child tells you someone touched them in an unsafe way. What should you say first?
q.hg: Ek bachcha aapko batata hai ki kisi ne use unsafe tareeke se touch kiya. Pehle kya kehna chahiye?

options.en: 'Why didn't you tell me about this earlier?'
options.hg: 'Yeh pehle kyun nahi bataya?'

options.en: 'Don't tell anyone else in the family about this.'
options.hg: 'Family mein kisi aur ko yeh mat batana.'

options.en: 'I believe you. It's not your fault. I'm glad you told me.'
options.hg: 'Mujhe tum par yakeen hai. Tumhari galti nahi. Achha kiya jo bataya.'

options.en: 'Are you sure? He's such a nice, decent man.'
options.hg: 'Pakka? Woh toh itne achhe, shareef insaan hain.'

explain.en: The first response shapes whether a child keeps talking. Believe them, say clearly it is not their fault, and thank them. Doubt or blame can make them take it back or never tell again.
explain.hg: Pehla response decide karta hai ki bachcha aage bolega ya nahi. Yakeen karo, saaf kaho ki galti uski nahi, aur thank you bolo. Shak ya blame se bachcha baat palat sakta hai ya phir kabhi nahi batayega.

q.en: After a child discloses abuse, why should a parent avoid questioning them again and again for details?
q.hg: Bachche ke abuse batane ke baad, parents ko baar-baar detail mein sawaal kyun nahi poochne chahiye?

options.en: Repeated or leading questions can upset the child and harm the case
options.hg: Baar-baar ya leading sawaal bachche ko pareshan karte hain aur case bigaad sakte hain

options.en: Because the details never really matter in such cases
options.hg: Kyunki aise cases mein details maayne nahi rakhti

options.en: Because only doctors are allowed to talk to children
options.hg: Kyunki sirf doctors bachchon se baat kar sakte hain

options.en: Because young children never remember anything correctly
options.hg: Kyunki chhote bachchon ko kuch theek se yaad nahi rehta

explain.en: Listen calmly and note the child's own words, with date and time. Detailed questioning is for trained police and child-protection staff; repeated or leading questions can upset the child and weaken their account.
explain.hg: Shaanti se suno aur bachche ke apne shabd, date aur time ke saath, likh lo. Detail mein poochhtaachh trained police aur child-protection staff ka kaam hai; baar-baar ya leading sawaal bachche ko pareshan karte hain aur uski baat kamzor kar sakte hain.

q.en: A 10-year-old says, 'I'll tell you something, but promise you won't tell anyone.' What is the best reply?
q.hg: 10 saal ka bachcha kehta hai, 'Ek baat bataun, par promise karo kisi ko nahi bataoge.' Sabse sahi jawab kya hai?

options.en: 'Tell me first, and then I'll decide whether to tell.'
options.hg: 'Pehle batao, phir main tay karunga kisi ko bataun ya nahi.'

options.en: 'Then it's better that you don't tell me at all.'
options.hg: 'Toh behtar hai mujhe bhi mat batao.'

options.en: 'I can't promise, but I'll only tell people who can keep you safe.'
options.hg: 'Promise nahi kar sakta, par sirf unhe bataunga jo tumhe safe rakh sakein.'

options.en: 'I promise, I'll never tell a soul, whatever it is.'
options.hg: 'Promise, jo bhi ho, kisi ko kabhi nahi bataunga.'

explain.en: Never promise total secrecy, because you may need to report to keep the child safe, and a broken promise destroys trust. Be honest and kind about who you will tell and why.
explain.hg: Kabhi poore secret ka promise mat karo, kyunki bachche ki safety ke liye report karna pad sakta hai, aur toota promise trust tod deta hai. Honestly aur pyaar se batao ki kise bataoge aur kyun.

q.en: Your child names a relative as the abuser. Why is it unwise to confront that relative yourself before reporting?
q.hg: Aapka bachcha ek rishtedaar ko abuser bataata hai. Report karne se pehle khud us rishtedaar se ladna kyun samajhdaari nahi?

options.en: Because the relative has a right to know first
options.hg: Kyunki rishtedaar ko pehle jaanne ka haq hai

options.en: It can endanger the child and allow pressure or deleted evidence
options.hg: Bachcha khatre mein aa sakta hai, dabaav ya saboot mitaane ka mauka mil sakta hai

options.en: Because the child may have imagined the whole thing
options.hg: Kyunki shaayad bachche ne sab kuch kalpana kiya ho

options.en: Because confronting is illegal in all cases
options.hg: Kyunki saamna karna har haal mein illegal hai

explain.en: Confronting an alleged abuser first can lead to threats against the child, pressure on the family or deleted messages. Keep the child safe and away from the person, and report to the police, the SJPU or 1098.
explain.hg: Pehle aaropi se ladne par bachche ko dhamki, family par dabaav ya messages delete ho sakte hain. Bachche ko safe aur us insaan se door rakho, aur police, SJPU ya 1098 ko report karo.

q.en: Under the POCSO Act, who must report child sexual abuse they know about?
q.hg: POCSO Act ke under child sexual abuse ki jaankari hone par kise report karna zaroori hai?

options.en: Only doctors and police officers
options.hg: Sirf doctors aur police officers

options.en: Only the child, once they turn 18
options.hg: Sirf bachcha, 18 saal hone ke baad

options.en: Anyone who knows or suspects it
options.hg: Har koi jo jaanta ho ya jise shak ho

options.en: Only the child's parents
options.hg: Sirf bachche ke parents

explain.en: POCSO's mandatory reporting duty applies to everyone, including parents, relatives, teachers, doctors and neighbours. A report goes to the Special Juvenile Police Unit or the local police.
explain.hg: POCSO ki mandatory reporting duty sab par lagti hai: parents, rishtedaar, teachers, doctors, padosi. Report Special Juvenile Police Unit ya local police ko jaati hai.

q.en: Under the POCSO Act, what is the maximum punishment for a person who fails to report a known child sexual offence?
q.hg: POCSO Act ke under jaankari hote hue child sexual offence report na karne par maximum saza kya hai?

options.en: A warning letter from the school
options.hg: School se warning letter

options.en: Life imprisonment
options.hg: Umar qaid

options.en: Up to six months in jail, a fine, or both
options.hg: Chhe mahine tak jail, fine, ya dono

options.en: No punishment; reporting is optional
options.hg: Koi saza nahi; report karna optional hai

explain.en: Under Sections 19 and 21 of POCSO, failing to report is punishable with up to six months in jail, a fine or both. Heads of institutions who fail to report offences by their staff face up to one year and a fine.
explain.hg: POCSO ke Sections 19 aur 21 ke under report na karne par chhe mahine tak jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain. Jo institution heads apne staff ke offence report nahi karte, unhe ek saal tak jail aur fine ho sakta hai.

q.en: A school principal learns that a staff member abused a student and decides to 'handle it internally'. What does POCSO say?
q.hg: Principal ko pata chalta hai ki ek staff member ne student ke saath abuse kiya, aur woh 'andar hi nipta' dene ka faisla karte hain. POCSO kya kehta hai?

options.en: Only the student's parents can report it
options.hg: Sirf student ke parents report kar sakte hain

options.en: Suspending the staff member is enough action
options.hg: Staff member ko suspend karna kaafi action hai

options.en: Heads must report; failing can mean up to a year in jail
options.hg: Heads ko report karna hai; na karne par ek saal tak jail ho sakti hai

options.en: Schools may settle it privately with the family
options.hg: School family ke saath private mein settle kar sakta hai

explain.en: POCSO punishes heads of companies or institutions who fail to report offences by people under them, with up to one year in jail and a fine. Internal action does not replace a police report.
explain.hg: POCSO un company ya institution heads ko saza deta hai jo apne neeche kaam karne walon ke offence report nahi karte: ek saal tak jail aur fine. Internal action police report ki jagah nahi le sakta.

q.en: You suspect a neighbour's child is being sexually abused. Where can you report it?
q.hg: Aapko shak hai ki padosi ke bachche ke saath sexual abuse ho raha hai. Kahan report kar sakte hain?

options.en: Only the residents' association
options.hg: Sirf society ki committee ko

options.en: Nowhere, unless the parents agree
options.hg: Kahin nahi, jab tak parents raazi na hon

options.en: Police or SJPU, or 1098; 112 in an emergency
options.hg: Police ya SJPU, ya 1098; emergency mein 112

options.en: Only the child's school principal
options.hg: Sirf bachche ke school principal ko

explain.en: You can report to the local police or Special Juvenile Police Unit, or call Childline 1098, which works with child-protection services. If the child is in immediate danger, call 112.
explain.hg: Aap local police ya Special Juvenile Police Unit ko report kar sakte hain, ya Childline 1098 call kar sakte hain, jo child-protection services ke saath kaam karti hai. Bachcha turant khatre mein ho toh 112 call karo.

q.en: Do you need proof before reporting suspected child sexual abuse under POCSO?
q.hg: Kya POCSO ke under shak hone par report karne se pehle saboot chahiye?

options.en: No; suspicion is enough, and police do the investigating
options.hg: Nahi; shak kaafi hai, jaanch police karti hai

options.en: Yes, you need a doctor's certificate first
options.hg: Haan, pehle doctor ka certificate chahiye

options.en: Yes, you need the child's written statement
options.hg: Haan, bachche ka likha hua bayaan chahiye

options.en: Yes, you need photos or a video as proof
options.hg: Haan, saboot ke liye photos ya video chahiye

explain.en: The duty covers anyone who knows or suspects that an offence has happened or is likely to happen. Collecting proof is the police's job. Never try to gather evidence by questioning or examining the child yourself.
explain.hg: Yeh duty har us insaan par hai jo jaanta hai ya jise shak hai ki offence hua hai ya hone wala hai. Saboot jutana police ka kaam hai. Khud bachche se poochhtaachh ya check karke saboot mat jutao.

q.en: Elders say a child's abuse should be 'settled within the family' to protect the family's izzat. What is correct?
q.hg: Bade kehte hain ki bachche ke abuse ka maamla 'ghar mein hi suljha lo' taaki izzat bachi rahe. Sahi kya hai?

options.en: Only a panchayat or the elders can decide such cases
options.hg: Aise case sirf panchayat ya bade-buzurg tay kar sakte hain

options.en: Family settlement is legal if the abuser apologises
options.hg: Abuser maafi maange toh ghar mein settle karna legal hai

options.en: Reporting is only needed if there is injury
options.hg: Report sirf chot lagne par zaroori hai

options.en: It must be reported; a family settlement can't replace that
options.hg: Report karna zaroori hai; ghar ka faisla uski jagah nahi le sakta

explain.en: POCSO requires anyone who knows of child sexual abuse to report it. Keeping it 'in the family' often leaves the child near the abuser. The shame belongs to the abuser, never to the child.
explain.hg: POCSO kehta hai ki child sexual abuse ki jaankari wale har insaan ko report karna hai. 'Ghar mein' rakhne se bachcha aksar abuser ke paas hi reh jaata hai. Sharam abuser ki hai, bachche ki kabhi nahi.

q.en: Under POCSO, can a newspaper or news channel publish the name or school of a child who was sexually abused?
q.hg: POCSO ke under kya akhbaar ya news channel sexually abused bachche ka naam ya school chhaap sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, they can print the name but not the photo
options.hg: Haan, naam chhaap sakte hain par photo nahi

options.en: Yes, if the family gives them a quote
options.hg: Haan, agar family unhe quote de

options.en: Yes, once the trial in court is over
options.hg: Haan, court mein trial khatam hone ke baad

options.en: No, anything that could identify the child is barred
options.hg: Nahi, bachche ki pehchaan bataane wali koi bhi baat mana hai

explain.en: Section 23 of POCSO bars media from disclosing a child victim's identity, including name, address, school, family details or photos. Sharing such details on social media also harms the child.
explain.hg: POCSO ka Section 23 media ko bachche ki pehchaan, jaise naam, address, school, family details ya photo, bataane se rokta hai. Social media par aisi details share karna bhi bachche ko nuksaan pahunchata hai.

q.en: What does the POCSO Act say about timelines in a Special Court?
q.hg: POCSO Act Special Court ki timelines ke baare mein kya kehta hai?

options.en: The trial can start only after five years have passed
options.hg: Trial paanch saal guzarne ke baad hi shuru ho sakta hai

options.en: Evidence within 30 days; trial within a year, where possible
options.hg: 30 din mein gawahi; jahan tak ho sake ek saal mein trial

options.en: Evidence within a week; trial within a month
options.hg: Ek hafte mein gawahi; ek mahine mein trial

options.en: No timeline; cases take as long as needed
options.hg: Koi timeline nahi; jitna time lage

explain.en: Section 35 asks a Special Court to record the child's evidence within 30 days of taking cognisance and to finish the trial, as far as possible, within one year. In practice many cases take much longer.
explain.hg: Section 35 ke hisaab se Special Court ko cognisance ke 30 din mein bachche ki gawahi record karni hai aur jahan tak ho sake ek saal mein trial poora karna hai. Asal mein kai cases isse kaafi zyada time lete hain.

q.en: Why do child-safety experts advise teaching young children the correct names for private parts?
q.hg: Child-safety experts chhote bachchon ko private parts ke sahi naam sikhane ki salah kyun dete hain?

options.en: It is only useful for doctors and nurses, not kids
options.hg: Yeh sirf doctors aur nurses ke kaam ka hai, bachchon ke nahi

options.en: Children can report clearly and learn their body isn't shameful
options.hg: Bachche saaf bata paate hain aur seekhte hain ki body sharam ki cheez nahi

options.en: It makes children curious about sex too early
options.hg: Isse bachche jaldi sex ke baare mein curious ho jaate hain

options.en: It replaces the need for adults to supervise them
options.hg: Isse badon ki nigraani ki zaroorat khatam ho jaati hai

explain.en: Children who know words like penis and vulva can describe what happened clearly to parents, teachers or doctors. Using these words calmly also teaches that their body is not a source of shame.
explain.hg: Jo bachche penis aur vulva jaise words jaante hain, woh parents, teachers ya doctors ko saaf bata sakte hain ki kya hua. Shaanti se yeh words use karna yeh bhi sikhata hai ki body sharam ki cheez nahi.

q.en: Which family rule best protects children from abuse?
q.hg: Kaunsa family rule bachchon ko abuse se sabse achhe se bachata hai?

options.en: 'Always obey every elder without question.'
options.hg: 'Har bade ki baat bina sawaal ke maano.'

options.en: 'Only strangers can hurt you.'
options.hg: 'Sirf anjaan log hi nuksaan pahuncha sakte hain.'

options.en: 'In our family, we never keep secrets about touching.'
options.hg: 'Hamari family mein touch ke baare mein koi secret nahi.'

options.en: 'Never talk about bodies at home.'
options.hg: 'Ghar mein body ke baare mein baat nahi karte.'

explain.en: A clear 'no secrets about touching' rule gives children permission to tell, and makes it harder for abusers, who rely on secrecy. Blind obedience and silence about bodies do the opposite.
explain.hg: Saaf rule, 'touch ke baare mein koi secret nahi', bachchon ko batane ki permission deta hai aur secrecy par chalne wale abusers ke liye mushkil banata hai. Andhi aagyakaarita aur body par chuppi ulta asar karti hai.

q.en: Why should parents avoid forcing children to hug or kiss relatives they don't want to?
q.hg: Parents ko bachchon ko un rishtedaaron ko hug ya kiss karne par majboor kyun nahi karna chahiye jinke liye unka mann nahi?

options.en: It does not really matter either way for children
options.hg: Bachchon ke liye isse koi khaas farak nahi padta

options.en: Because hugs from relatives are always unsafe
options.hg: Kyunki rishtedaaron ke hug hamesha unsafe hote hain

options.en: It teaches that their 'no' doesn't count, which abusers exploit
options.hg: Isse bachche seekhte hain ki unka 'no' maayne nahi rakhta, jiska abuser fayda uthate hain

options.en: Because most relatives are secretly abusers
options.hg: Kyunki zyada tar rishtedaar chupe hue abuser hote hain

explain.en: Letting children choose a wave or namaste instead teaches that their body and their 'no' matter. That lesson makes it easier for them to refuse and to tell if someone crosses a line.
explain.hg: Bachchon ko hug ki jagah wave ya namaste chunne dena sikhata hai ki unki body aur unka 'no' maayne rakhte hain. Isse unke liye mana karna aur koi line cross kare toh batana aasaan hota hai.

q.en: A teacher notices a Class 4 student has become withdrawn and seems scared of one staff member. What is the right step?
q.hg: Ek teacher dekhti hai ki Class 4 ka ek student chup-chup rehne laga hai aur ek staff member se darta hai. Sahi step kya hai?

options.en: Wait until the child makes a formal complaint
options.hg: Bachche ki formal shikayat ka intezaar karo

options.en: Quietly warn the staff member in private first
options.hg: Pehle chupke se staff member ko private mein warning do

options.en: Note what you saw, check in gently, and follow reporting rules
options.hg: Jo dekha likh lo, pyaar se baat karo, aur reporting rules follow karo

options.en: Ask the class to keep a close eye on the student
options.hg: Class se kaho ki student par kadi nazar rakhe

explain.en: Write down what you observed, talk gently with the child, and tell the school's child-protection lead. If abuse is known or suspected, POCSO requires a report to the police or SJPU. Don't alert the staff member.
explain.hg: Jo dekha woh likho, bachche se pyaar se baat karo, aur school ke child-protection incharge ko batao. Abuse ki jaankari ya shak ho toh POCSO ke hisaab se police ya SJPU ko report zaroori hai. Staff member ko alert mat karo.

q.en: Which school practice best reduces the risk of abuse?
q.hg: Kaunsi school practice abuse ka risk sabse zyada kam karti hai?

options.en: Keeping complaints secret from parents
options.hg: Shikayatein parents se chhupana

options.en: Banning children from talking to counsellors
options.hg: Bachchon ko counsellors se baat karne se rokna

options.en: Letting trusted staff take children anywhere alone
options.hg: Trusted staff ko bachchon ko kahin bhi akele le jaane dena

options.en: One-to-one sessions in visible spaces, with doors open
options.hg: One-to-one sessions dikhne wali jagah par, darwaza khula rakh kar

explain.en: Visible, interruptible one-to-one time, clear codes of conduct and easy ways for children to report reduce opportunities for abuse while still allowing mentoring and counselling.
explain.hg: Dikhne wala aur beech mein aaya ja sake aisa one-to-one time, saaf code of conduct, aur bachchon ke liye report karne ke aasaan raaste abuse ke mauke kam karte hain, aur mentoring aur counselling bhi chalti rehti hai.

q.en: Your 8-year-old tells you an older child at school made them do 'private things'. What is true?
q.hg: Aapka 8 saal ka bachcha batata hai ki school ke ek bade bachche ne usse 'private cheezein' karwayi. Sach kya hai?

options.en: The children should sort it out themselves
options.hg: Bachche khud suljha lein

options.en: Only adults can abuse, so it can't be serious
options.hg: Sirf adults abuse kar sakte hain, toh serious nahi

options.en: It is just children playing and should be ignored
options.hg: Yeh bas bachchon ka khel hai, ignore karo

options.en: Abuse by older children happens and needs the same calm response
options.hg: Bade bachchon dwara abuse hota hai aur iska bhi wahi shaant response chahiye

explain.en: Harmful sexual behaviour by other children is real. Believe your child, keep them safe, inform the school and report as needed. The older child also needs professional help; your child is never to blame.
explain.hg: Doosre bachchon ka harmful sexual behaviour bhi hota hai. Apne bachche ka yakeen karo, use safe rakho, school ko batao aur zaroorat ho toh report karo. Bade bachche ko bhi professional help chahiye; aapke bachche ki galti kabhi nahi.

q.en: In the government's 2007 Study on Child Abuse, which group made up the larger share of children who reported sexual abuse?
q.hg: Sarkar ki 2007 ki Study on Child Abuse mein, sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein kis group ka hissa bada tha?

options.en: Boys
options.hg: Ladke

options.en: Only children in hostels
options.hg: Sirf hostel ke bachche

options.en: Girls
options.hg: Ladkiyan

options.en: Only children under five
options.hg: Sirf paanch saal se chhote bachche

explain.en: In the Ministry of Women and Child Development's 2007 study, boys made up 52.94% of the children who reported sexual abuse, against 47.06% girls. Boys need body-safety lessons and support just as much.
explain.hg: Ministry of Women and Child Development ki 2007 ki study mein sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein 52.94% ladke the aur 47.06% ladkiyan. Ladkon ko bhi body-safety lessons aur support utna hi chahiye.

q.en: A child tells you about abuse, then a week later says, 'I made it up.' What should an adult understand?
q.hg: Ek bachcha abuse ke baare mein batata hai, phir ek hafte baad kehta hai, 'Maine jhooth bola tha.' Bade ko kya samajhna chahiye?

options.en: The report must now be withdrawn at once
options.hg: Report turant wapas le leni chahiye

options.en: Taking it back is common and doesn't mean it didn't happen
options.hg: Baat palatna common hai, iska matlab yeh nahi ki kuch hua nahi

options.en: It proves the child was lying from the start
options.hg: Isse saabit hota hai ki bachcha shuru se jhooth bol raha tha

options.en: The child should now be punished for lying
options.hg: Ab jhooth ke liye bachche ko saza deni chahiye

explain.en: Children often retract after family pressure, threats or fear of what happens next. Stay supportive, keep the child safe and let professionals assess it. Punishing the child teaches them never to tell again.
explain.hg: Bachche aksar family ke dabaav, dhamki ya aage kya hoga uske darr se baat palat dete hain. Saath do, bachche ko safe rakho aur professionals ko dekhne do. Saza dene se bachcha seekhta hai ki kabhi na bataye.

q.en: Besides reporting, what does a child usually need after disclosing sexual abuse?
q.hg: Sexual abuse batane ke baad report ke alawa bachche ko aksar kya chahiye hota hai?

options.en: To be kept home from school for good
options.hg: Hamesha ke liye school se ghar par rakhna

options.en: To never mention it again in the family
options.hg: Family mein kabhi zikr na karna

options.en: Medical care, counselling and steady support at home
options.hg: Medical care, counselling aur ghar mein lagataar support

options.en: To meet the accused and forgive them
options.hg: Aaropi se milkar use maaf karna

explain.en: A medical check, counselling and calm, believing adults help a child recover. Keeping normal routines like school, where safe, also helps. Silence and isolation make healing harder.
explain.hg: Medical check, counselling aur shaant, yakeen karne wale bade bachche ko theek hone mein madad karte hain. Safe ho toh school jaisa normal routine bhi madad karta hai. Chuppi aur akelapan healing ko mushkil banate hain.

q.en: The person a child names is a respected teacher or religious leader. What should you do?
q.hg: Bachcha jis insaan ka naam leta hai woh ek izzatdaar teacher ya dharmik guru hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Take it as seriously as any report and report it
options.hg: Kisi bhi report ki tarah seriously lo aur report karo

options.en: Assume the child has misunderstood something
options.hg: Maan lo bachche ne kuch galat samjha hai

options.en: Ask the person to explain before acting
options.hg: Kuch karne se pehle us insaan se safai maango

options.en: Keep quiet to avoid a scandal in the community
options.hg: Samaaj mein scandal se bachne ke liye chup raho

explain.en: Abusers often hold trusted roles, and status is exactly what helps them avoid suspicion. The reporting duty is the same whoever is named. The child's safety comes before anyone's reputation.
explain.hg: Abusers aksar trusted roles mein hote hain, aur unki izzat hi unhe shak se bachati hai. Naam kisi ka bhi ho, report karne ki duty wahi hai. Bachche ki safety kisi ki bhi reputation se pehle hai.

q.en: A child has no visible injuries. Does that mean sexual abuse could not have happened?
q.hg: Bachche ko koi chot nahi dikhti. Kya iska matlab sexual abuse nahi hua ho sakta?

options.en: Yes, abuse always leaves marks
options.hg: Haan, abuse hamesha nishaan chhodta hai

options.en: No, abuse often leaves no visible injury
options.hg: Nahi, abuse aksar koi dikhne wali chot nahi chhodta

options.en: Only a family elder can tell for sure
options.hg: Sirf ghar ka bada pakka bata sakta hai

options.en: Yes, unless the child cried for days
options.hg: Haan, jab tak bachcha kai din roya na ho

explain.en: Much abuse leaves no physical marks, and emotional and behavioural signs are more common. A child's words are reason enough to act. A doctor should examine the child, not family members.
explain.hg: Bahut sa abuse koi physical nishaan nahi chhodta, aur emotional aur behavioural signs zyada common hain. Bachche ki baat hi kadam uthane ke liye kaafi hai. Check-up doctor kare, family wale nahi.

q.en: Who can make a complaint under the POCSO Act?
q.hg: POCSO Act ke under complaint kaun kar sakta hai?

options.en: Only the school the child attends
options.hg: Sirf bachche ka school

options.en: The child or anyone who knows about the abuse
options.hg: Bachcha khud ya koi bhi jo abuse ke baare mein jaanta ho

options.en: Only the child's father or grandfather
options.hg: Sirf bachche ke papa ya dada

options.en: Only a lawyer hired by the family
options.hg: Sirf family ka rakha hua vakeel

explain.en: Anyone can report: the child, a parent, a relative, a teacher, a neighbour or a doctor. Reporting to the police, the SJPU or 1098 starts the process of protecting the child.
explain.hg: Koi bhi report kar sakta hai: bachcha, parent, rishtedaar, teacher, padosi ya doctor. Police, SJPU ya 1098 ko report karne se bachche ko bachane ka process shuru hota hai.

q.en: What do children with disabilities need when it comes to body safety?
q.hg: Disability wale bachchon ko body safety ke baare mein kya chahiye?

options.en: Body-safety lessons only after they turn 18
options.hg: Body-safety lessons sirf 18 ke baad

options.en: Only to be kept away from everyone else
options.hg: Bas sabse door rakhna

options.en: The same lessons, adapted to how they communicate
options.hg: Wahi lessons, unke communication ke tareeke ke hisaab se

options.en: Nothing, because abusers don't target them
options.hg: Kuch nahi, kyunki abusers unhe target nahi karte

explain.en: Children with disabilities have the same right to safety and can be easier for abusers to target or silence. Use pictures, signs or simple words they understand, and make sure they know who to tell.
explain.hg: Disability wale bachchon ko bhi safety ka utna hi haq hai, aur abusers unhe aasaani se target ya chup kara sakte hain. Pictures, signs ya simple words use karo jo woh samjhein, aur pakka karo ki unhe pata ho kise batana hai.

q.en: In September 2024, what term did the Supreme Court tell courts to use instead of 'child pornography'?
q.hg: September 2024 mein Supreme Court ne courts ko 'child pornography' ki jagah kaunsa term use karne ko kaha?

options.en: Juvenile obscene and indecent material
options.hg: Juvenile obscene aur indecent material

options.en: Explicit adult content involving minors
options.hg: Minors wala explicit adult content

options.en: Underage sexually explicit media content
options.hg: Underage sexually explicit media content

options.en: Child sexual exploitation and abuse material
options.hg: Child sexual exploitation and abuse material

explain.en: The court said 'pornography' wrongly suggests consent; every such image records the abuse of a child. It directed courts to use 'child sexual exploitation and abuse material' and urged Parliament to amend POCSO.
explain.hg: Court ne kaha ki 'pornography' shabd galat tareeke se consent jaisa lagta hai; har aisi image ek bachche ke abuse ka record hai. Court ne 'child sexual exploitation and abuse material' use karne ko kaha aur Parliament se POCSO amend karne ko kaha.

q.en: Under POCSO, should a child have to face the accused while giving evidence in court?
q.hg: POCSO ke under kya court mein gawahi dete waqt bachche ko aaropi ka saamna karna padta hai?

options.en: No, the child should not be exposed to the accused
options.hg: Nahi, bachche ko aaropi ke saamne nahi laana chahiye

options.en: Only if the child is over 12 years old
options.hg: Sirf agar bachcha 12 saal se bada ho

options.en: Yes, face-to-face is required by law
options.hg: Haan, kanoon ke hisaab se aamne-saamne zaroori hai

options.en: Only if the judge hearing it is a woman
options.hg: Sirf agar case sunne wali judge aurat ho

explain.en: POCSO's procedures are meant to be child-friendly. Courts must make sure the child is not exposed to the accused while testifying, for example using a screen or video link, while the accused can still hear the evidence.
explain.hg: POCSO ke procedures child-friendly hone chahiye. Court ko dhyaan rakhna hai ki gawahi ke waqt bachcha aaropi ke saamne na aaye, jaise screen ya video link se, jabki aaropi gawahi sun sake.

q.en: Is Childline 1098 free, and when does it work?
q.hg: Kya Childline 1098 free hai, aur kab kaam karti hai?

options.en: Free, but only on weekdays
options.hg: Free, par sirf weekdays par

options.en: Paid, and only in office hours
options.hg: Paid, aur sirf office time mein

options.en: Free, but only from landlines
options.hg: Free, par sirf landline se

options.en: Free, 24 hours a day, every day
options.hg: Free, din ke 24 ghante, roz

explain.en: 1098 is India's free 24x7 child helpline, linked with the 112 emergency system. Children, parents, teachers and neighbours can all call it about a child who needs care or protection.
explain.hg: 1098 India ki free 24x7 child helpline hai, jo 112 emergency system se judi hai. Bachche, parents, teachers, padosi, sab kisi bachche ki care ya protection ke liye call kar sakte hain.

q.en: Can a child's clothes, friendliness or 'behaviour' ever cause sexual abuse?
q.hg: Kya bachche ke kapde, friendly hona ya 'behaviour' kabhi sexual abuse ki wajah ban sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, if the child accepted gifts
options.hg: Haan, agar bachche ne gifts liye

options.en: Yes, if the child dresses in a certain way
options.hg: Haan, agar bachcha ek khaas tarah ke kapde pehne

options.en: Yes, if the child is very affectionate
options.hg: Haan, agar bachcha bahut pyaar jataata hai

options.en: No, the abuser alone is responsible
options.hg: Nahi, zimmedaar sirf abuser hai

explain.en: Children are never responsible for abuse. Groomers deliberately use a child's affection and trust. Blaming the child adds harm and teaches other children to stay silent.
explain.hg: Abuse ke liye bachche kabhi zimmedaar nahi. Groomer jaan-boojh kar bachche ke pyaar aur trust ka fayda uthate hain. Bachche ko blame karne se nuksaan badhta hai aur doosre bachche chup rehna seekhte hain.

q.en: Your teenage cousin says an older relative has been abusing him, but he fears no one will believe a boy. What helps most?
q.hg: Tumhara teenage cousin batata hai ki ek bada rishtedaar uske saath abuse karta raha hai, par use darr hai ki ladke par koi yakeen nahi karega. Sabse zyada kya madad karega?

options.en: Tell him to toughen up and ignore it
options.hg: Usse bolo mazboot bane aur ignore kare

options.en: Tell the relative so he can explain himself
options.hg: Rishtedaar ko batao taaki woh apni safai de

options.en: Believe him and help him reach a trusted adult or 1098
options.hg: Yakeen karo aur trusted bade ya 1098 tak pahunchne mein madad karo

options.en: Ask him to prove it before you do anything
options.hg: Kuch karne se pehle usse saboot maango

explain.en: Boys are often disbelieved or told to 'be a man', which keeps them silent. Your belief can be the turning point. Help him tell a trusted adult or call 1098, and remind him it is not his fault.
explain.hg: Ladkon par aksar yakeen nahi kiya jaata ya 'mard ban' bola jaata hai, jisse woh chup reh jaate hain. Tumhara yakeen turning point ban sakta hai. Trusted bade ya 1098 tak pahunchne mein madad karo, aur yaad dilao ki galti uski nahi.

q.en: A relative keeps telling your child, 'This is our little secret,' after playing alone with them. What should a parent do?
q.hg: Ek rishtedaar aapke bachche ke saath akele khelne ke baad baar-baar kehta hai, 'Yeh hamara chhota sa secret hai.' Parents ko kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Ask the relative to keep playtime shorter
options.hg: Rishtedaar se kaho khelne ka time kam kare

options.en: Scold the child for keeping secrets from you
options.hg: Aapse secret rakhne ke liye bachche ko daanto

options.en: Assume it's just harmless family fun and games
options.hg: Maan lo yeh family ka harmless mazaak hai

options.en: Stop alone time and gently ask the child about the 'secret'
options.hg: Akele ka time band karo aur pyaar se bachche se 'secret' ke baare mein poocho

explain.en: Secrecy with a child, especially after time alone, is a red flag. Calmly limit unsupervised time and ask open questions. If anything worrying comes up, report to the police, SJPU or 1098.
explain.hg: Bachche ke saath secret, khaas kar akele time ke baad, red flag hai. Shaanti se akele ka time band karo aur khule sawaal poocho. Kuch chinta ki baat aaye toh police, SJPU ya 1098 ko report karo.

q.en: A teacher starts a body-safety lesson and a student suddenly says something about abuse in front of the class. What is the best response?
q.hg: Body-safety lesson ke beech ek student achaanak poori class ke saamne abuse ke baare mein kuch bol deta hai. Sabse achha response kya hai?

options.en: Ignore it and move to the next topic
options.hg: Ignore karke agle topic par chalo

options.en: Calmly thank them and talk privately soon after
options.hg: Shaanti se thank you bolo aur jaldi akele mein baat karo

options.en: Ask for full details in front of everyone
options.hg: Sabke saamne poori detail poocho

options.en: Tell the student not to make things up
options.hg: Student ko bolo kahani mat banao

explain.en: Acknowledge them kindly so they don't feel dismissed, protect their privacy by moving the conversation somewhere private, then follow the school's child-protection and POCSO reporting steps.
explain.hg: Pyaar se acknowledge karo taaki use ignore hua na lage, privacy ke liye baat akele mein karo, phir school ke child-protection aur POCSO reporting steps follow karo.

q.en: Which is a sign that a child may be upset by something that happened online?
q.hg: Kaunsa sign batata hai ki bachcha online hui kisi baat se pareshan ho sakta hai?

options.en: Using the phone to finish school homework
options.hg: School ka homework karne ke liye phone use karna

options.en: Becoming secretive and upset after using the phone
options.hg: Phone use karne ke baad chupa-chupa aur pareshan rehna

options.en: Playing games with cousins on weekends
options.hg: Weekends par cousins ke saath games khelna

options.en: Asking for a new phone cover for a birthday
options.hg: Birthday par naya phone cover maangna

explain.en: UNICEF lists signs such as distress after being online, unusual secrecy or avoiding devices, trouble sleeping, stomach aches and fear of going to school. Ask gently and keep calm, so the child feels safe to talk.
explain.hg: UNICEF ke bataaye signs hain: online hone ke baad pareshaani, ajeeb secrecy ya devices se bachna, neend ki dikkat, pet dard, aur school jaane se darr. Pyaar se poocho aur shaant raho, taaki bachcha baat karne mein safe feel kare.

q.en: What does POCSO say about recording a child's statement to the police?
q.hg: POCSO police ko bachche ka bayaan record karne ke baare mein kya kehta hai?

options.en: Only a male officer in uniform may record it
options.hg: Sirf uniform wala male officer record kar sakta hai

options.en: Where the child is comfortable, ideally by a woman officer
options.hg: Jahan bachcha comfortable ho, jahan tak ho sake mahila officer dwara

options.en: The child must come to the police station at night
options.hg: Bachche ko raat ko thane aana hoga

options.en: The accused must be present while it is recorded
options.hg: Record karte waqt aaropi ka maujood hona zaroori hai

explain.en: POCSO asks police to record the statement at the child's home or a place of their choice, as far as possible by a woman officer not in uniform, with a trusted adult present. The aim is to avoid frightening the child.
explain.hg: POCSO kehta hai ki police bachche ka bayaan uske ghar ya uski pasand ki jagah par le, jahan tak ho sake mahila officer bina uniform ke, aur trusted bada saath ho. Maksad hai bachche ko darr na lage.

q.en: Your child tells you about abuse and you feel furious. What is the most helpful thing to do in that moment?
q.hg: Aapka bachcha abuse ke baare mein batata hai aur aapko bahut gussa aata hai. Us waqt sabse helpful kya hai?

options.en: Stay calm in front of the child and focus on their safety
options.hg: Bachche ke saamne shaant raho aur uski safety par dhyaan do

options.en: Rush out at once to find and confront the abuser
options.hg: Turant bhaag kar abuser ko dhundho aur usse lado

options.en: Cry and ask the child how this could happen
options.hg: Ro kar bachche se poocho yeh kaise hua

options.en: Show your anger so the child knows it's serious
options.hg: Gussa dikhao taaki bachche ko pata chale ki serious hai

explain.en: Children watch your reaction. Visible rage or panic can make them think they caused trouble, and they may stop talking. Stay calm, reassure them, then report and get support for yourself too.
explain.hg: Bachche aapka reaction dekhte hain. Gussa ya ghabrahat dekh kar unhe lag sakta hai ki unki wajah se musibat aayi, aur woh bolna band kar sakte hain. Shaant raho, bharosa do, phir report karo aur apne liye bhi support lo.

q.en: What is an STI?
q.hg: STI kya hota hai?

options.en: A punishment for breaking social rules
options.hg: Samaj ke niyam todne ki saza

options.en: An infection spread mainly through sexual contact
options.hg: Infection jo mainly sexual contact se phailta hai

options.en: A disease that only sex workers can get
options.hg: Bimaari jo sirf sex workers ko hoti hai

options.en: An illness that is caused by masturbating too much
options.hg: Zyada masturbation karne se hone wali bimaari

explain.en: STI means sexually transmitted infection. Germs such as bacteria, viruses or parasites pass from one person to another, mostly during sexual contact. Anyone can get one, and most are treatable or manageable.
explain.hg: STI ka matlab sexually transmitted infection. Bacteria, virus ya parasite jaise germs ek insaan se doosre mein, zyaadatar sexual contact ke dauraan, jaate hain. Yeh kisi ko bhi ho sakta hai, aur zyaadatar ka ilaaj ya management possible hai.

q.en: Which of these can NOT pass HIV from one person to another?
q.hg: Inme se kis cheez se HIV ek insaan se doosre mein NAHI jaata?

options.en: Sharing a tiffin or a water bottle
options.hg: Tiffin ya paani ki bottle share karna

options.en: From mother to baby without treatment
options.hg: Bina treatment ke maa se baby ko

options.en: Receiving unscreened blood
options.hg: Bina test kiya hua blood chadhna

options.en: Sharing needles or syringes
options.hg: Needle ya syringe share karna

explain.en: HIV spreads through blood, semen, vaginal fluids and breast milk. It does not spread through food, water, utensils, hugging, toilets or casual contact, so sharing lunch is completely safe.
explain.hg: HIV blood, semen, vaginal fluids aur breast milk se phailta hai. Khana, paani, bartan, hug, toilet ya aam contact se nahi phailta, isliye lunch share karna bilkul safe hai.

q.en: Can mosquitoes spread HIV?
q.hg: Kya machhar HIV phaila sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, but only during the monsoon season
options.hg: Haan, par sirf baarish ke mausam mein

options.en: Yes, the same way they spread malaria
options.hg: Haan, jaise malaria phailate hain

options.en: Only if one mosquito bites two people very quickly
options.hg: Sirf agar ek machhar jaldi jaldi do logon ko kaate

options.en: No, HIV can't survive or spread in mosquitoes
options.hg: Nahi, HIV machhar mein na jeeta hai na phailta hai

explain.en: Mosquitoes do not inject blood from one person into another, and HIV cannot multiply inside them. Malaria and dengue spread through mosquitoes; HIV does not.
explain.hg: Machhar ek insaan ka khoon doosre mein inject nahi karte, aur HIV unke andar badh nahi sakta. Malaria aur dengue machhar se phailte hain; HIV nahi.

q.en: Can a person look and feel completely healthy and still have an STI?
q.hg: Kya koi bilkul healthy dikh aur mehsoos kar sakta hai aur phir bhi use STI ho?

options.en: Yes, many STIs cause no symptoms
options.hg: Haan, kai STIs ke koi symptoms nahi hote

options.en: Only if they have had it for many years
options.hg: Sirf agar kai saalon se ho

options.en: No, STIs always show clear signs
options.hg: Nahi, STIs ke hamesha saaf sign hote hain

options.en: Only older people can carry STIs silently
options.hg: Sirf bade log chupchaap STI le kar ghoomte hain

explain.en: Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, HIV, hepatitis B and HPV can all go unnoticed for a long time. Only testing tells for sure, which is why routine checks matter for sexually active people.
explain.hg: Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, HIV, hepatitis B aur HPV lambe time tak bina pata chale reh sakte hain. Pakka sirf test se pata chalta hai, isliye sexually active logon ke liye regular check-up zaroori hai.

q.en: Your cousin is scared to ask anyone about HIV. What is true about the NACO helpline 1097?
q.hg: Tumhara cousin HIV ke baare mein kisi se poochne se darta hai. NACO helpline 1097 ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: It is a paid line, open only on weekdays
options.hg: Yeh paid line hai, sirf weekdays par

options.en: It only takes calls from doctors
options.hg: Yeh sirf doctors ke call leta hai

options.en: Free, confidential and open round the clock
options.hg: Free, confidential aur chaubees ghante khula

options.en: You must give your Aadhaar number first
options.hg: Pehle Aadhaar number dena padta hai

explain.en: India's national AIDS helpline 1097 is toll-free and offers confidential counselling round the clock in 16 languages (2025). Callers can ask about HIV, testing, PEP and where to get help.
explain.hg: India ki national AIDS helpline 1097 toll-free hai aur 16 bhashaon mein chaubees ghante confidential counselling deti hai (2025). HIV, testing, PEP aur madad kahan mile, sab pooch sakte ho.

q.en: A classmate's parent has HIV, and some students now avoid sitting with him. What is right?
q.hg: Ek classmate ke parent ko HIV hai, aur kuch students ab uske saath baithna avoid karte hain. Sahi kya hai?

options.en: Keep away until he gets an HIV test
options.hg: Jab tak woh HIV test na karaye door raho

options.en: Ask the school to move him to a different section or class
options.hg: School se kaho use doosre section ya class mein bheje

options.en: Avoid sharing pens and books with him
options.hg: Uske saath pen aur books share mat karo

options.en: Include him; HIV doesn't spread by sitting together
options.hg: Use shaamil karo; saath baithne se HIV nahi phailta

explain.en: HIV does not spread through touch, shared objects or sitting together. India's HIV Act, 2017 also bars discrimination against people with HIV and those who live with them, including in schools.
explain.hg: HIV chhoone, cheezein share karne ya saath baithne se nahi phailta. India ka HIV Act, 2017 HIV wale logon aur unke saath rehne walon ke saath discrimination ko bhi mana karta hai, schools mein bhi.

q.en: Under India's national campaign launched in 2026, which group is offered the free HPV vaccine?
q.hg: 2026 mein shuru hue India ke national campaign mein free HPV vaccine kis group ko di jaati hai?

options.en: Newborn babies, right at birth
options.hg: Newborn babies, paida hote hi

options.en: Only women who are pregnant
options.hg: Sirf pregnant women

options.en: All adults over the age of 40
options.hg: 40 saal se zyada umar ke sabhi adults

options.en: Girls aged 14, at government facilities
options.hg: 14 saal ki ladkiyon ko, government facilities par

explain.en: India launched a nationwide free HPV vaccination campaign on 28 February 2026, offering a single dose to girls aged 14 at government health facilities. It protects against the virus types behind most cervical cancers.
explain.hg: India ne 28 February 2026 ko nationwide free HPV vaccination campaign shuru kiya, jisme 14 saal ki ladkiyon ko government health facilities par ek dose di jaati hai. Yeh cervical cancer ke zyaadatar cases wale virus types se bachati hai.

q.en: What does the HPV vaccine mainly protect against?
q.hg: HPV vaccine mainly kis cheez se bachati hai?

options.en: Pregnancy, for several years at a time
options.hg: Kai saal tak pregnancy se

options.en: The HPV types behind most cervical cancers
options.hg: HPV ke woh types jo zyaadatar cervical cancer karte hain

options.en: HIV and hepatitis C infections
options.hg: HIV aur hepatitis C infections

options.en: All sexually transmitted infections
options.hg: Saare sexually transmitted infections

explain.en: HPV (human papillomavirus) types 16 and 18 cause more than 80% of cervical cancer cases in India (PIB, 2026). The vaccine protects against these types; it does not prevent other STIs or pregnancy.
explain.hg: India mein cervical cancer ke 80% se zyada cases HPV (human papillomavirus) types 16 aur 18 se hote hain (PIB, 2026). Vaccine in types se bachati hai; doosre STIs ya pregnancy ko nahi rokti.

q.en: A message in the family WhatsApp group says the HPV vaccine makes girls infertile. What is true?
q.hg: Family WhatsApp group mein message hai ki HPV vaccine se ladkiyan infertile ho jaati hain. Kya sach hai?

options.en: True, if given before periods start
options.hg: Sahi, agar periods se pehle di jaaye

options.en: True, but only for girls under 14
options.hg: Sahi, par sirf 14 se kam umar ki ladkiyon ke liye

options.en: True: that is exactly why it is only given as one dose
options.hg: Sahi: isi wajah se sirf ek dose di jaati hai

options.en: False: there is no evidence it affects fertility
options.hg: Galat: iska fertility par asar ka koi saboot nahi

explain.en: HPV vaccines have been used in many countries for years and studied closely; they do not cause infertility. By preventing cervical cancer, they actually protect women's health and fertility.
explain.hg: HPV vaccines kai deshon mein saalon se use ho rahi hain aur dhyan se study hui hain; inse infertility nahi hoti. Cervical cancer rok kar yeh women ki health aur fertility ko bachati hain.

q.en: What is required for a girl to get the free HPV vaccine under India's 2026 programme?
q.hg: India ke 2026 programme mein ladki ko free HPV vaccine lene ke liye kya zaroori hai?

options.en: Proof that she has started her periods
options.hg: Periods shuru hone ka proof

options.en: A parent's consent; it is voluntary
options.hg: Parent ki consent; yeh voluntary hai

options.en: A paid registration at a private hospital
options.hg: Private hospital mein paid registration

options.en: A doctor's certificate of good health
options.hg: Achhi health ka doctor certificate

explain.en: The HPV vaccine is offered free only at government facilities, from Ayushman Arogya Mandir primary health centres to medical colleges. Vaccination is voluntary and parental consent is mandatory.
explain.hg: HPV vaccine sirf government facilities par free milti hai, Ayushman Arogya Mandir primary health centres se lekar medical colleges tak. Vaccination voluntary hai aur parent ki consent zaroori hai.

q.en: Many Indian babies get a vaccine at birth against an infection that can also spread through sex. Which one?
q.hg: Kai Indian babies ko janm par ek aise infection ki vaccine milti hai jo sex se bhi phail sakta hai. Kaunsa?

options.en: HIV infection
options.hg: HIV infection

options.en: Hepatitis B
options.hg: Hepatitis B

options.en: Gonorrhoea
options.hg: Gonorrhoea

options.en: Syphilis
options.hg: Syphilis

explain.en: Hepatitis B spreads through blood, sex and from mother to baby, and it damages the liver. A birth dose and later doses in India's routine immunisation protect children for life. There is no vaccine for HIV, syphilis or gonorrhoea.
explain.hg: Hepatitis B blood, sex aur maa se baby ko phailta hai, aur liver ko nuksaan pahunchata hai. India ke routine immunisation mein janm ki dose aur baad ki doses bachchon ko zindagi bhar bachati hain. HIV, syphilis ya gonorrhoea ki koi vaccine nahi hai.

q.en: Is it shameful to see a doctor about a problem with your genitals?
q.hg: Kya genitals ki kisi problem ke liye doctor ke paas jaana sharam ki baat hai?

options.en: Yes, it's better to wait for it to go away
options.hg: Haan, apne aap theek hone ka wait karna behtar

options.en: No, doctors treat such problems every day
options.hg: Nahi, doctor aisi problems roz treat karte hain

options.en: Only if a family member comes along
options.hg: Sirf agar family member saath aaye

options.en: Yes, only a quack should be asked privately
options.hg: Haan, chupke se sirf jhola-chhaap se poochho

explain.en: Genitals are part of the body like any other, and doctors see itching, pain, discharge and sores all the time. Early care is easier care. Quacks often sell useless or harmful 'cures'.
explain.hg: Genitals bhi baaki body ki tarah hain, aur doctor khujli, dard, discharge aur sores roz dekhte hain. Jaldi ilaaj aasaan ilaaj hai. Jhola-chhaap aksar bekaar ya nuksaandayak 'ilaaj' bechte hain.

q.en: Can you get HIV from using a public toilet or swimming pool?
q.hg: Kya public toilet ya swimming pool use karne se HIV ho sakta hai?

options.en: No, HIV does not spread that way
options.hg: Nahi, HIV aise nahi phailta

options.en: Yes, in pools without chlorine
options.hg: Haan, bina chlorine wale pool mein

options.en: Yes, if the seat is wet
options.hg: Haan, agar seat geeli ho

options.en: Only if you have a small cut on your leg
options.hg: Sirf agar pair par chhota sa cut ho

explain.en: HIV dies quickly outside the body and is not passed through toilet seats, water, sweat or saliva. It spreads through specific body fluids such as blood, semen, vaginal fluids and breast milk.
explain.hg: HIV body ke bahar jaldi mar jaata hai aur toilet seat, paani, paseena ya thook se nahi phailta. Yeh khaas body fluids jaise blood, semen, vaginal fluids aur breast milk se phailta hai.

q.en: What is the difference between HIV and AIDS?
q.hg: HIV aur AIDS mein kya fark hai?

options.en: AIDS is the virus, while HIV is the disease it causes
options.hg: AIDS virus hai, aur HIV uski wajah se hone wali bimaari

options.en: HIV affects men, AIDS affects women
options.hg: HIV aadmiyon ko, AIDS auraton ko hota hai

options.en: They are two names for the same thing
options.hg: Dono ek hi cheez ke do naam hain

options.en: HIV is the virus; AIDS is a late stage if untreated
options.hg: HIV virus hai; AIDS bina ilaaj ki aakhri stage hai

explain.en: HIV is the virus that weakens the immune system. AIDS is the advanced stage that can develop if HIV is not treated. With daily treatment (ART), most people with HIV never develop AIDS.
explain.hg: HIV woh virus hai jo immune system ko kamzor karta hai. AIDS woh advanced stage hai jo HIV ka ilaaj na hone par aa sakti hai. Roz ke treatment (ART) se HIV wale zyaadatar log kabhi AIDS tak nahi pahunchte.

q.en: Which body fluids can carry enough HIV to pass it on?
q.hg: Kin body fluids mein itna HIV ho sakta hai ki woh phail jaaye?

options.en: Blood, semen, vaginal fluids, breast milk
options.hg: Blood, semen, vaginal fluids, breast milk

options.en: Urine, saliva and sweat only
options.hg: Sirf urine, thook aur paseena

options.en: Saliva, sweat, tears and nasal mucus
options.hg: Thook, paseena, aansu aur naak ka balgam

options.en: Sweat and the air someone breathes out
options.hg: Paseena aur saans se nikli hawa

explain.en: HIV passes through blood, semen (and pre-ejaculate), vaginal fluids, rectal fluids and breast milk. Saliva, sweat and tears do not transmit it, which is why kissing and hugging are safe.
explain.hg: HIV blood, semen (aur pre-ejaculate), vaginal fluids, rectal fluids aur breast milk se phailta hai. Thook, paseena aur aansu se nahi, isliye kiss aur hug safe hain.

q.en: Can STIs spread through oral sex?
q.hg: Kya oral sex se STIs phail sakte hain?

options.en: No, saliva kills all the STI germs there
options.hg: Nahi, thook wahan ke saare STI germs maar deta hai

options.en: Yes, including gonorrhoea, herpes and syphilis
options.hg: Haan, gonorrhoea, herpes aur syphilis samet

options.en: Only if both partners have symptoms
options.hg: Sirf agar dono partners ko symptoms hon

options.en: No, STIs can spread only through vaginal intercourse
options.hg: Nahi, STIs sirf vaginal intercourse se phailte hain

explain.en: Several STIs, including gonorrhoea, herpes, syphilis and HPV, can pass through oral contact with the genitals. Condoms lower this risk too. The risk of HIV this way is much lower but not zero.
explain.hg: Gonorrhoea, herpes, syphilis aur HPV samet kai STIs genitals ke saath oral contact se phail sakte hain. Condom isme bhi risk kam karta hai. Is tarah HIV ka risk bahut kam hai, par zero nahi.

q.en: Can herpes or HPV spread even when a condom is used?
q.hg: Kya condom use karne par bhi herpes ya HPV phail sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, from skin the condom doesn't cover
options.hg: Haan, us skin se jo condom cover nahi karta

options.en: Only if the partner has visible sores
options.hg: Sirf agar partner ko dikhne wale sores hon

options.en: Only if the condom is past its expiry
options.hg: Sirf agar condom expire ho chuka ho

options.en: No, condoms block every infection completely
options.hg: Nahi, condom har infection ko poori tarah rokta hai

explain.en: Herpes and HPV spread by skin-to-skin contact, including from areas a condom does not cover, sometimes even without visible sores. Condoms greatly reduce the risk but do not remove it, and the HPV vaccine adds protection.
explain.hg: Herpes aur HPV skin-to-skin contact se phailte hain, un hisson se bhi jo condom cover nahi karta, kabhi bina dikhne wale sores ke bhi. Condom risk bahut kam karta hai par khatam nahi, aur HPV vaccine extra protection deti hai.

q.en: Does washing the genitals after sex prevent STIs?
q.hg: Kya sex ke baad genitals dhone se STIs se bachaav hota hai?

options.en: Yes, warm water kills the germs
options.hg: Haan, garam paani germs maar deta hai

options.en: No, washing cannot stop an STI
options.hg: Nahi, dhone se STI nahi rukta

options.en: Yes, if done within ten minutes
options.hg: Haan, agar das minute ke andar karo

options.en: Yes, if you use antiseptic liquid
options.hg: Haan, agar antiseptic liquid use karo

explain.en: STI germs enter through the delicate skin and lining of the genitals during contact. Washing afterwards does not remove that risk, and harsh antiseptics can irritate the skin. Condoms and testing are what help.
explain.hg: STI ke germs contact ke dauraan genitals ki naazuk skin aur lining se andar jaate hain. Baad mein dhone se woh risk khatam nahi hota, aur tez antiseptic se skin mein irritation ho sakta hai. Condom aur testing hi madad karte hain.

q.en: At a mela, a roadside tattoo artist is reusing the same needle on everyone. What is the risk?
q.hg: Mele mein ek roadside tattoo wala sab par ek hi needle use kar raha hai. Risk kya hai?

options.en: Only a minor skin rash for a day
options.hg: Bas ek din ka halka skin rash

options.en: No risk if the ink is black
options.hg: Agar ink kaali ho toh koi risk nahi

options.en: Only a risk for people over 40
options.hg: Sirf 40 se upar walon ke liye risk

options.en: HIV and hepatitis B and C can spread
options.hg: HIV aur hepatitis B aur C phail sakte hain

explain.en: Needles that pierce skin carry tiny amounts of blood, which can pass HIV and hepatitis B and C. Only use a licensed studio that opens a new sterile needle in front of you.
explain.hg: Skin mein jaane wali needle mein thoda sa khoon reh jaata hai, jisse HIV aur hepatitis B aur C phail sakte hain. Sirf licensed studio jao jo tumhare saamne naya sterile needle khole.

q.en: Your hostel roommate has hepatitis B. Which of these is a real risk to avoid?
q.hg: Tumhare hostel roommate ko hepatitis B hai. Inme se kaunsa asli risk hai jisse bachna chahiye?

options.en: Shaking hands or hugging
options.hg: Haath milana ya hug karna

options.en: Sharing a razor or toothbrush
options.hg: Razor ya toothbrush share karna

options.en: Eating from the same plate
options.hg: Ek hi plate se khaana

options.en: Using the same bathroom
options.hg: Ek hi bathroom use karna

explain.en: Hepatitis B spreads through blood and sexual fluids, so razors and toothbrushes, which can carry tiny amounts of blood, should not be shared. Food, toilets and touch are safe. If you aren't vaccinated, ask a doctor about the vaccine.
explain.hg: Hepatitis B blood aur sexual fluids se phailta hai, isliye razor aur toothbrush, jin par thoda khoon ho sakta hai, share nahi karne chahiye. Khaana, toilet aur chhoona safe hai. Agar vaccine nahi lagi toh doctor se poochho.

q.en: Why does having an untreated STI raise the risk of getting HIV?
q.hg: Bina ilaaj ka STI hone se HIV ka risk kyun badhta hai?

options.en: Sores and inflammation make it easier for HIV to enter
options.hg: Sores aur sujan se HIV ka andar jaana aasaan hota hai

options.en: STI germs turn into HIV over time
options.hg: STI germs time ke saath HIV ban jaate hain

options.en: The medicines for STIs weaken the immune system for years
options.hg: STI ki dawaiyan saalon tak immune system kamzor karti hain

options.en: It doesn't; the two are unrelated
options.hg: Aisa nahi hai; dono ka koi rishta nahi

explain.en: Sores, broken skin and inflammation from STIs like syphilis, herpes or gonorrhoea give HIV an easier way in. Treating STIs quickly is part of HIV prevention, and a person can have more than one STI at a time.
explain.hg: Syphilis, herpes ya gonorrhoea jaise STIs ke sores, kati-phati skin aur sujan HIV ko andar jaane ka aasaan raasta dete hain. STI ka jaldi ilaaj HIV se bachaav ka hissa hai, aur ek insaan ko ek saath ek se zyada STI ho sakte hain.

q.en: Can someone get an STI the very first time they have sex?
q.hg: Kya pehli hi baar sex karne par STI ho sakta hai?

options.en: Only if the person is over the age of 25
options.hg: Sirf agar umar 25 saal se zyada ho

options.en: Yes, once is enough if a partner has an infection
options.hg: Haan, partner ko infection ho toh ek baar kaafi hai

options.en: No, STIs only come after someone has had many partners
options.hg: Nahi, STIs tabhi hote hain jab kisi ke bahut partners rahe hon

options.en: No, the body is immune the first time
options.hg: Nahi, pehli baar body immune hoti hai

explain.en: There is no 'first time' protection. If a partner has an STI, even without symptoms, it can pass on the first time. Using a condom from the start lowers the risk.
explain.hg: 'Pehli baar' wala koi protection nahi hota. Agar partner ko STI hai, bina symptoms ke bhi, toh pehli baar mein bhi phail sakta hai. Shuru se condom use karna risk kam karta hai.

q.en: 'Only people with many partners get STIs.' What is true?
q.hg: 'STIs sirf unhe hote hain jinke bahut partners hon.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: True, unless the partner is from a city
options.hg: Sahi, jab tak partner shehar ka na ho

options.en: True: one partner means zero risk
options.hg: Sahi: ek partner matlab zero risk

options.en: One partner with an infection is enough
options.hg: Infection wala ek partner bhi kaafi hai

options.en: True, married people never get STIs
options.hg: Sahi, shaadishuda logon ko kabhi STI nahi hota

explain.en: What matters is whether a partner has an infection, not how many partners someone has had. Many people get STIs from a single regular partner, including a spouse, often because neither knew.
explain.hg: Matter yeh karta hai ki partner ko infection hai ya nahi, na ki kitne partners rahe. Bahut log ek hi regular partner, pati ya patni samet, se STI paate hain, aksar kyunki dono mein se kisi ko pata nahi tha.

q.en: Among people newly diagnosed with HIV in India in 2024-25, which route did most report?
q.hg: 2024-25 mein India mein naye HIV diagnosed logon mein se zyaadatar ne kaunsa route bataya?

options.en: Sharing food and utensils
options.hg: Khaana aur bartan share karna

options.en: Mosquito bites
options.hg: Machhar ka kaatna

options.en: Blood transfusions
options.hg: Blood transfusion

options.en: Heterosexual sex
options.hg: Heterosexual sex

explain.en: NACO data for 2024-25 show nearly 74% of newly diagnosed people reported heterosexual sex, 11.5% shared needles or syringes, 5.4% homosexual or bisexual sex and 3.5% mother-to-child transmission. HIV is not 'one group's disease'.
explain.hg: NACO ke 2024-25 data mein naye diagnosed logon mein lagbhag 74% ne heterosexual sex bataya, 11.5% ne shared needle ya syringe, 5.4% ne homosexual ya bisexual sex aur 3.5% ne maa se bachche ko. HIV kisi 'ek group ki bimaari' nahi hai.

q.en: In some north-eastern states and Punjab, which route was most commonly reported among people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25?
q.hg: Kuch north-eastern states aur Punjab mein 2024-25 mein naye HIV diagnosed logon mein sabse common route kaunsa tha?

options.en: Sharing needles and syringes
options.hg: Needle aur syringe share karna

options.en: Blood transfusion in hospitals
options.hg: Hospital mein blood transfusion

options.en: Kissing and casual contact
options.hg: Kiss aur aam contact

options.en: Mother-to-child transmission
options.hg: Maa se bachche ko

explain.en: In 2024-25, shared needles and syringes were the most commonly reported route in Arunachal Pradesh (72%), Tripura (67%), Assam (60%) and Punjab (56%), against 11.5% nationally. Never share needles; harm-reduction services can help.
explain.hg: 2024-25 mein Arunachal Pradesh (72%), Tripura (67%), Assam (60%) aur Punjab (56%) mein shared needle aur syringe sabse common route tha, jabki national level par 11.5%. Kabhi needle share mat karo; harm-reduction services madad kar sakti hain.

q.en: Which STIs can pass from a pregnant woman to her baby?
q.hg: Kaunse STIs pregnant woman se uske baby tak ja sakte hain?

options.en: Only infections the father has
options.hg: Sirf woh infections jo pita ko hain

options.en: Only the common cold
options.hg: Sirf normal sardi-zukaam

options.en: None; the placenta blocks all infections
options.hg: Koi nahi; placenta saare infections rok deta hai

options.en: HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B
options.hg: HIV, syphilis aur hepatitis B

explain.en: HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B can pass to a baby during pregnancy, birth or breastfeeding. Testing in antenatal check-ups and timely treatment or vaccination greatly lower the risk.
explain.hg: HIV, syphilis aur hepatitis B pregnancy, delivery ya breastfeeding ke dauraan baby tak ja sakte hain. Antenatal check-up mein test aur time par treatment ya vaccination se risk bahut kam ho jaata hai.

q.en: Which infection can spread through kissing?
q.hg: Kaunsa infection kiss karne se phail sakta hai?

options.en: Hepatitis B
options.hg: Hepatitis B

options.en: Trichomoniasis
options.hg: Trichomoniasis

options.en: Oral herpes
options.hg: Oral herpes

options.en: HIV
options.hg: HIV

explain.en: The herpes virus that causes cold sores spreads through kissing and skin contact, especially when a sore is present. HIV, hepatitis B and trichomoniasis are not spread by kissing.
explain.hg: Honthon ke chhaale karne wala herpes virus kiss aur skin contact se phailta hai, khaaskar jab chhaala ho. HIV, hepatitis B aur trichomoniasis kiss se nahi phailte.

q.en: What is the most common 'symptom' of many STIs?
q.hg: Kai STIs ka sabse common 'symptom' kya hai?

options.en: A skin rash on the face
options.hg: Chehre par rash

options.en: Sudden weight gain
options.hg: Achanak weight badhna

options.en: A high fever
options.hg: Tez bukhaar

options.en: No symptoms at all
options.hg: Koi symptom hi nahi

explain.en: Many people with chlamydia, gonorrhoea, HIV or HPV feel nothing for a long time. That is why testing, not waiting for symptoms, is the only way to know.
explain.hg: Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, HIV ya HPV wale bahut logon ko lambe time tak kuch mehsoos nahi hota. Isliye symptoms ka wait nahi, test hi pata karne ka ek tareeka hai.

q.en: Which of these is a good reason to get checked at an STI clinic?
q.hg: Inme se kaunsi cheez STI clinic mein check karane ki achhi wajah hai?

options.en: A painless genital sore, even if it heals
options.hg: Genitals par bina dard ka sore, chahe theek ho jaaye

options.en: Clear discharge that changes through the cycle
options.hg: Saaf discharge jo cycle ke saath badalta hai

options.en: Having a wet dream during sleep
options.hg: Neend mein wet dream hona

options.en: Waking up with a morning erection
options.hg: Subah erection ke saath uthna

explain.en: A painless sore can be early syphilis, which heals on its own while the infection continues. Morning erections, wet dreams and clear discharge that changes with the cycle are normal body events.
explain.hg: Bina dard ka sore shuruaati syphilis ho sakta hai, jo apne aap theek ho jaata hai par infection chalta rehta hai. Subah ka erection, wet dream aur cycle ke saath badalne wala saaf discharge normal hain.

q.en: A sore from syphilis disappears by itself after a few weeks. What does that mean?
q.hg: Syphilis ka sore kuch hafton mein apne aap gayab ho jaata hai. Iska matlab kya hai?

options.en: The body has cured the infection
options.hg: Body ne infection theek kar diya

options.en: It means the sore was never syphilis to begin with
options.hg: Matlab woh sore syphilis tha hi nahi

options.en: The person is now immune for life
options.hg: Ab woh insaan zindagi bhar immune hai

options.en: The infection is still there and needs treatment
options.hg: Infection abhi bhi hai aur ilaaj chahiye

explain.en: Syphilis moves through stages. The first sore heals, but without treatment the infection can return later and harm the heart, brain and other organs. It is easily cured with antibiotics from a doctor.
explain.hg: Syphilis stages mein badhta hai. Pehla sore theek ho jaata hai, par bina ilaaj ke infection baad mein lautkar dil, dimaag aur doosre organs ko nuksaan pahuncha sakta hai. Doctor ki antibiotics se yeh aasaani se theek hota hai.

q.en: Where can people get free STI check-ups and treatment at government hospitals?
q.hg: Government hospitals mein free STI check-up aur ilaaj kahan milta hai?

options.en: Suraksha Clinics
options.hg: Suraksha Clinics

options.en: The birth registration counter
options.hg: Janm registration counter

options.en: The blood bank
options.hg: Blood bank

options.en: The cybercrime cell
options.hg: Cybercrime cell

explain.en: NACO runs 1,127 designated STI/RTI clinics, branded Suraksha Clinics, at district hospitals and medical colleges (2025). They offer free, confidential testing, treatment and counselling.
explain.hg: NACO 1,127 designated STI/RTI clinics chalata hai, jinhe Suraksha Clinics kehte hain, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein (2025). Yahan free, confidential testing, ilaaj aur counselling milti hai.

q.en: Where can someone get a free, confidential HIV test in India?
q.hg: India mein free, confidential HIV test kahan ho sakta hai?

options.en: Only at the AIIMS in Delhi
options.hg: Sirf Delhi ke AIIMS mein

options.en: At an ICTC in a government hospital
options.hg: Government hospital ke ICTC mein

options.en: At a police station
options.hg: Police station mein

options.en: Only at private labs, with a referral
options.hg: Sirf private labs mein, referral ke saath

explain.en: Integrated Counselling and Testing Centres (ICTCs) in government hospitals and many health centres offer free HIV tests with counselling before and after. Results are confidential.
explain.hg: Government hospitals aur kai health centres ke Integrated Counselling and Testing Centres (ICTC) mein free HIV test hota hai, test se pehle aur baad counselling ke saath. Result confidential rehta hai.

q.en: Aarav took an HIV test the day after a risky exposure. It was negative. What is true?
q.hg: Aarav ne risky exposure ke agle din HIV test karaya. Negative aaya. Kya sach hai?

options.en: He is definitely HIV-negative from now on
options.hg: Ab se woh pakka HIV-negative hai

options.en: Too early to be sure; ask about PEP and retesting
options.hg: Itni jaldi pakka nahi; PEP aur dobara test ka poochho

options.en: Tests can never pick up HIV that comes from sex at all
options.hg: Sex se hua HIV test mein kabhi pakda hi nahi jaata

options.en: A negative test means he is immune
options.hg: Negative test matlab woh immune hai

explain.en: Tests cannot detect a very recent infection; this gap is called the window period. A counsellor will advise when to retest. Within 72 hours, PEP can still prevent HIV, so he should seek care urgently.
explain.hg: Test bahut naye infection ko detect nahi kar sakta; is gap ko window period kehte hain. Counsellor batayenge kab dobara test karna hai. 72 ghante ke andar PEP ab bhi HIV rok sakti hai, toh use turant care leni chahiye.

q.en: Can an employer or a college force someone to take an HIV test?
q.hg: Kya employer ya college kisi ko HIV test ke liye majboor kar sakta hai?

options.en: No; testing needs informed consent
options.hg: Nahi; test ke liye informed consent chahiye

options.en: Yes, but only for women applicants
options.hg: Haan, par sirf women applicants ke liye

options.en: Yes, if they pay for the test
options.hg: Haan, agar woh test ka paisa dein

options.en: Yes, for any job or admission
options.hg: Haan, kisi bhi job ya admission ke liye

explain.en: India's HIV Act, 2017 forbids HIV testing without informed consent (Section 5) and bars making an HIV test a condition for jobs, healthcare or education (Section 3).
explain.hg: India ka HIV Act, 2017 bina informed consent ke HIV test ko mana karta hai (Section 5) aur HIV test ko job, healthcare ya education ki shart banane par rok lagata hai (Section 3).

q.en: A free HIV testing camp comes to your college. Friends joke that anyone who goes 'must have done something'. What is true?
q.hg: College mein free HIV testing camp aaya hai. Dost mazaak udaate hain ki jo jaayega 'usne kuch kiya hoga'. Kya sach hai?

options.en: It's a routine health check; results stay private
options.hg: Yeh routine health check hai; result private rehta hai

options.en: Going to the camp is proof that someone is already infected
options.hg: Camp jaana hi saboot hai ki kisi ko infection hai

options.en: Results are read out to the whole class
options.hg: Results poori class ko padhkar sunaaye jaate hain

options.en: Only people with symptoms should get tested
options.hg: Sirf symptoms walon ko test karana chahiye

explain.en: Knowing your status is a normal, responsible step, like checking blood pressure. Camps offer free counselling and confidential results. Mocking people for testing only keeps others away from care.
explain.hg: Apna status jaanna normal, responsible step hai, jaise BP check karna. Camps mein free counselling aur confidential result milta hai. Test karne walon ka mazaak udaane se doosre log care se door rehte hain.

q.en: Who should consider regular STI testing?
q.hg: Regular STI testing kise karwani chahiye?

options.en: Anyone who is sexually active
options.hg: Jo bhi sexually active hai

options.en: Only people who have clear symptoms
options.hg: Sirf jinhe saaf symptoms hon

options.en: Only people who are not married yet
options.hg: Sirf woh log jinki shaadi nahi hui

options.en: Only sex workers and their clients
options.hg: Sirf sex workers aur unke clients

explain.en: Because many STIs have no symptoms, testing is sensible for anyone sexually active, particularly with a new partner or more than one partner. A clinic can advise how often.
