explain.hg: Kyunki kai STIs ke symptoms nahi hote, jo bhi sexually active hai uske liye testing samajhdaari hai, khaaskar naye ya ek se zyada partner ke saath. Clinic bata sakta hai kitni baar.

q.en: Before their wedding, an engaged couple's families demand an HIV test from the bride only. What is fair and true?
q.hg: Shaadi se pehle ek engaged couple ki families sirf dulhan se HIV test maangti hain. Kya fair aur sach hai?

options.en: Testing is voluntary; both can choose to test together
options.hg: Test voluntary hai; dono saath mein test kara sakte hain

options.en: The result must be shared with both families before the wedding
options.hg: Shaadi se pehle result dono families ko batana zaroori hai

options.en: The groom's test is not needed by law
options.hg: Law ke hisaab se dulhe ka test zaroori nahi

options.en: Only women can pass HIV to a spouse
options.hg: Sirf women hi spouse ko HIV de sakti hain

explain.en: HIV can be passed by anyone, and the HIV Act requires informed consent for testing and protects confidentiality. A couple can choose to test together and share results with each other, not with relatives.
explain.hg: HIV koi bhi de sakta hai, aur HIV Act test ke liye informed consent maangta hai aur confidentiality bachata hai. Couple saath mein test karke result ek doosre se share kar sakta hai, rishtedaaron se nahi.

q.en: After being treated for chlamydia, why should a person's partner be treated too?
q.hg: Chlamydia ka ilaaj hone ke baad, partner ka ilaaj bhi kyun hona chahiye?

options.en: It is a legal punishment for the partner
options.hg: Yeh partner ke liye legal saza hai

options.en: Treatment only works if both take it on the same day
options.hg: Ilaaj tabhi kaam karta hai jab dono ek hi din lein

options.en: Otherwise the infection can pass back and forth
options.hg: Warna infection aage-peeche hota rahega

options.en: The partner's treatment protects against HIV
options.hg: Partner ka ilaaj HIV se bachata hai

explain.en: If only one partner is treated, the untreated partner can reinfect them, a 'ping-pong' effect. Clinics can help with partner notification, and both should avoid sex until treatment is complete.
explain.hg: Agar sirf ek ka ilaaj ho, toh bina ilaaj wala partner phir se infection de sakta hai, ek 'ping-pong' effect. Clinic partner ko batane mein madad kar sakte hain, aur dono ko ilaaj poora hone tak sex se bachna chahiye.

q.en: The doctor prescribed a full course of antibiotics for gonorrhoea. Symptoms vanished in two days. What should the person do?
q.hg: Doctor ne gonorrhoea ke liye antibiotics ka poora course diya. Do din mein symptoms chale gaye. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Finish the whole course as prescribed
options.hg: Poora course waise hi khatam karo jaise likha hai

options.en: Save the leftover pills for next time
options.hg: Bachi goliyan agli baar ke liye rakh lo

options.en: Stop, since the symptoms are gone
options.hg: Band kar do, symptoms toh chale gaye

options.en: Give the rest to a friend with symptoms
options.hg: Baaki goliyan symptoms wale dost ko de do

explain.en: Feeling better does not mean the infection is gone. Stopping early can leave germs behind and help them become resistant, and gonorrhoea is already becoming harder to treat. Finish the course and get re-checked if advised.
explain.hg: Behtar mehsoos karna matlab infection khatam nahi. Jaldi band karne se germs bache reh sakte hain aur resistant ban sakte hain, aur gonorrhoea pehle se hi mushkil se treat hone laga hai. Course poora karo aur advise ho toh dobara check karao.

q.en: Sameer has burning when he pees and some discharge. He plans to buy antibiotics from the chemist himself. What's better?
q.hg: Sameer ko peshaab mein jalan aur thoda discharge hai. Woh khud chemist se antibiotics khareedne wala hai. Behtar kya hai?

options.en: Take whatever antibiotic the chemist suggests for it
options.hg: Chemist jo bhi antibiotic bataye woh le lo

options.en: Drink lots of water and ignore it
options.hg: Bahut paani piyo aur ignore karo

options.en: Use a friend's leftover medicine
options.hg: Dost ki bachi hui dawa le lo

options.en: See a doctor or Suraksha Clinic for testing first
options.hg: Pehle doctor ya Suraksha Clinic mein test karao

explain.en: Burning and discharge can come from several different infections, each needing the right medicine. Guessing can leave an STI untreated and fuel antibiotic resistance. A clinic can test, treat and advise on partners.
explain.hg: Jalan aur discharge kai alag infections se ho sakte hain, aur har ek ko sahi dawa chahiye. Andaze se dawa lene se STI bina ilaaj reh sakta hai aur antibiotic resistance badhta hai. Clinic test, ilaaj aur partner ke baare mein advise kar sakta hai.

q.en: While being treated for an STI, when is it safe to have sex again?
q.hg: STI ka ilaaj chalte hue, dobara sex kab safe hai?

options.en: After treatment ends and the doctor confirms
options.hg: Ilaaj khatam hone aur doctor ke confirm karne ke baad

options.en: As soon as the first pill is taken
options.hg: Pehli goli lete hi

options.en: Once the itching and burning stop
options.hg: Jaise hi khujli aur jalan band ho

options.en: Right away, if a condom is not used
options.hg: Turant, agar condom use na ho

explain.en: Having sex before treatment is complete can pass the infection on or bring it back. Wait until both partners have finished treatment and the doctor confirms it, and use condoms after that.
explain.hg: Ilaaj poora hone se pehle sex karne se infection aage ja sakta hai ya wapas aa sakta hai. Jab tak dono partners ka ilaaj poora na ho aur doctor confirm na kare, wait karo, aur uske baad condom use karo.

q.en: A wall poster from a 'gupt rog' clinic promises a guaranteed cure for all sex problems in 7 days with herbal powders. What is true?
q.hg: Ek 'gupt rog' clinic ka poster 7 din mein herbal powder se saari sex problems ka guaranteed ilaaj ka vaada karta hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Such ads are illegal and the claims are misleading
options.hg: Aise ads illegal hain aur daave gumraah karne wale hain

options.en: Guaranteed cures are proof that the doctors are good
options.hg: Guaranteed ilaaj is baat ka saboot hai ki doctor achhe hain

options.en: These clinics are government approved
options.hg: Ye clinics government approved hain

options.en: Herbal powders cure all STIs safely
options.hg: Herbal powder saare STIs safely theek karte hain

explain.en: India's Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 bans ads claiming to cure venereal diseases and sexual problems. Real STI care is free and confidential at Suraksha Clinics and government hospitals.
explain.hg: India ka Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 venereal diseases aur sexual problems ke ilaaj ka daava karne wale ads par rok lagata hai. Asli STI care Suraksha Clinics aur government hospitals mein free aur confidential hai.

q.en: Under the 1954 Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, what can happen to someone convicted for the first time of advertising a 'cure' for venereal disease?
q.hg: 1954 ke Drugs and Magic Remedies Act ke tahat, venereal disease ke 'ilaaj' ka ad dene par pehli baar doshi paaye gaye insaan ko kya ho sakta hai?

options.en: A mandatory life sentence in prison
options.hg: Zaroori umar qaid ki saza

options.en: Up to six months in jail, a fine, or both
options.hg: Chhe mahine tak jail, fine, ya dono

options.en: Nothing, because such ads are legal
options.hg: Kuch nahi, kyunki aise ads legal hain

options.en: Only a verbal warning from the police
options.hg: Police se sirf zubaani warning

explain.en: The Act makes such ads a crime: up to six months, a fine or both for a first conviction, and up to one year for a repeat. In March 2025 the Supreme Court ordered states to enforce the law and set up complaint mechanisms.
explain.hg: Yeh Act aise ads ko crime banata hai: pehli baar chhe mahine tak, fine ya dono, aur dobara hone par ek saal tak. March 2025 mein Supreme Court ne states ko law lagu karne aur complaint system banane ka order diya.

q.en: A roadside 'sexologist' claims he can cure HIV in 21 days. What is true?
q.hg: Ek roadside 'sexologist' daava karta hai ki woh 21 din mein HIV theek kar dega. Kya sach hai?

options.en: HIV goes away if you stop eating meat
options.hg: Meat chhodne se HIV chala jaata hai

options.en: A cure exists but only in private clinics
options.hg: Cure hai par sirf private clinics mein

options.en: No cure exists, but free ART controls HIV
options.hg: Koi cure nahi hai, par free ART HIV ko control karta hai

options.en: Some herbal mixes can cure HIV
options.hg: Kuch herbal mixture HIV theek kar dete hain

explain.en: There is no cure for HIV yet, but antiretroviral therapy (ART), free at government ART centres, keeps the virus under control so people live long, healthy lives. Fake cures waste money and delay real treatment.
explain.hg: HIV ka abhi tak koi cure nahi hai, par antiretroviral therapy (ART), jo government ART centres par free hai, virus ko control mein rakhti hai taaki log lambi, healthy zindagi jee sakein. Nakli ilaaj paisa barbaad karte hain aur asli ilaaj mein der karte hain.

q.en: Which of these STIs can be cured with the right antibiotics?
q.hg: Inme se kaunsa STI sahi antibiotics se poori tarah theek ho sakta hai?

options.en: HPV infection
options.hg: HPV infection

options.en: Herpes
options.hg: Herpes

options.en: Syphilis
options.hg: Syphilis

options.en: HIV infection
options.hg: HIV infection

explain.en: Bacterial STIs such as syphilis, chlamydia and gonorrhoea, and the parasite trichomoniasis, are curable. Viral ones like HIV, herpes, hepatitis B and HPV can be managed or prevented but not simply cured with antibiotics.
explain.hg: Bacterial STIs jaise syphilis, chlamydia aur gonorrhoea, aur parasite wala trichomoniasis, theek ho sakte hain. Viral STIs jaise HIV, herpes, hepatitis B aur HPV manage ya prevent ho sakte hain, antibiotics se seedha theek nahi hote.

q.en: Which pair of STIs can be prevented with vaccines?
q.hg: Kaunse do STIs vaccine se roke ja sakte hain?

options.en: HPV and hepatitis B
options.hg: HPV aur hepatitis B

options.en: HIV and herpes
options.hg: HIV aur herpes

options.en: Syphilis and gonorrhoea
options.hg: Syphilis aur gonorrhoea

options.en: Chlamydia and trichomoniasis
options.hg: Chlamydia aur trichomoniasis

explain.en: Safe, effective vaccines exist for HPV and hepatitis B. There are no vaccines yet for HIV, herpes, syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia or trichomoniasis, so condoms and testing remain important.
explain.hg: HPV aur hepatitis B ke liye safe, effective vaccines hain. HIV, herpes, syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia ya trichomoniasis ki abhi koi vaccine nahi, isliye condom aur testing zaroori hain.

q.en: Neel has just been told he has genital herpes. He thinks he can never have a relationship again. What is true?
q.hg: Neel ko abhi pata chala ki use genital herpes hai. Use lagta hai ab woh kabhi relationship nahi kar payega. Kya sach hai?

options.en: He must hide it, since telling a partner is pointless
options.hg: Use chhupana chahiye, partner ko batane ka koi fayda nahi

options.en: Herpes always gets worse until it is fatal
options.hg: Herpes hamesha badhkar jaanleva ho jaata hai

options.en: A strong antibiotic course will cure it
options.hg: Strong antibiotic course se theek ho jaayega

options.en: Herpes is manageable; relationships are possible
options.hg: Herpes manageable hai; relationships possible hain

explain.en: Herpes has no cure, but antiviral medicines reduce outbreaks and the chance of passing it on. With honest talk, condoms and medical advice, people with herpes have loving, healthy relationships.
explain.hg: Herpes ka cure nahi hai, par antiviral dawaiyan outbreaks aur aage phailne ka chance kam karti hain. Imaandaar baat, condom aur medical advice se herpes wale log pyaar bhare, healthy relationships rakhte hain.

q.en: What usually happens to most HPV infections?
q.hg: Zyaadatar HPV infections ka aam taur par kya hota hai?

options.en: They always turn into cancer
options.hg: Woh hamesha cancer ban jaate hain

options.en: They cause symptoms within a week
options.hg: Ek hafte mein symptoms aa jaate hain

options.en: They need surgery to remove
options.hg: Unhe nikalne ke liye surgery chahiye

options.en: The body clears them by itself
options.hg: Body khud unhe saaf kar deti hai

explain.en: HPV is very common and most infections clear without causing problems. A few high-risk types can persist and slowly cause cell changes that may lead to cancer, which is why vaccination and screening matter.
explain.hg: HPV bahut common hai aur zyaadatar infections bina problem ke saaf ho jaate hain. Kuch high-risk types reh sakte hain aur dheere dheere cells mein badlaav laakar cancer tak le ja sakte hain, isliye vaccination aur screening zaroori hai.

q.en: 'HPV is only a women's problem.' What is true?
q.hg: 'HPV sirf women ki problem hai.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Men get HPV only from blood transfusions
options.hg: Aadmiyon ko HPV sirf blood transfusion se hota hai

options.en: True: men cannot carry or pass on HPV
options.hg: Sahi: aadmi HPV na le sakte hain na de sakte hain

options.en: Men can get HPV, warts and some HPV cancers
options.hg: Aadmiyon ko bhi HPV, warts aur kuch HPV cancers hote hain

options.en: True: HPV only affects the cervix
options.hg: Sahi: HPV sirf cervix ko affect karta hai

explain.en: HPV infects people of all genders. In men it can cause genital warts and cancers of the throat, anus and penis, and men can pass it on. Cervical cancer is simply the best-known HPV cancer.
explain.hg: HPV har gender ko infect karta hai. Aadmiyon mein yeh genital warts aur gale, anus aur penis ke cancer kar sakta hai, aur aadmi ise aage bhi de sakte hain. Cervical cancer bas sabse jaana-pehchaana HPV cancer hai.

q.en: A vaccinated woman asks if she still needs cervical cancer screening. What is the answer?
q.hg: Ek vaccinated woman poochti hai ki kya use ab bhi cervical cancer screening chahiye. Jawaab kya hai?

options.en: Only if she ever notices visible symptoms
options.hg: Sirf agar use kabhi dikhne wale symptoms hon

options.en: No, vaccination replaces screening completely for life
options.hg: Nahi, vaccine zindagi bhar ke liye screening ki jagah le leti hai

options.en: No, screening is only for unvaccinated women
options.hg: Nahi, screening sirf unvaccinated women ke liye hai

options.en: Yes, the vaccine doesn't cover every risky type
options.hg: Haan, vaccine har risky type ko cover nahi karti

explain.en: Vaccination plus screening together greatly lower cervical cancer risk. Screening tests such as VIA, Pap or HPV tests find early changes that can be treated before cancer develops.
explain.hg: Vaccine aur screening dono saath mein cervical cancer ka risk bahut kam karte hain. VIA, Pap ya HPV test jaise screening tests shuruaati badlaav pakad lete hain jinka cancer banne se pehle ilaaj ho sakta hai.

q.en: Why is the HPV vaccine given ideally before a person becomes sexually active?
q.hg: HPV vaccine ideally sexually active hone se pehle kyun di jaati hai?

options.en: Older people's bodies reject vaccines
options.hg: Badon ki body vaccines reject kar deti hai

options.en: It also works as contraception later
options.hg: Yeh baad mein contraception ka kaam bhi karti hai

options.en: It works best before any exposure to the virus
options.hg: Virus se contact hone se pehle sabse achha kaam karti hai

options.en: It changes behaviour so that teenagers avoid having sex
options.hg: Yeh behaviour badalti hai taaki teenagers sex se bachein

explain.en: A vaccine prevents infection; it does not clear an existing one. Giving it before possible exposure gives the strongest protection, which is why WHO's main target group is girls aged 9-14.
explain.hg: Vaccine infection rokti hai; pehle se maujood infection saaf nahi karti. Contact se pehle dene par sabse strong protection milta hai, isliye WHO ka main target group 9-14 saal ki ladkiyan hai.

q.en: Which organ does hepatitis B mainly damage?
q.hg: Hepatitis B mainly kis organ ko nuksaan pahunchata hai?

options.en: The kidneys
options.hg: Kidneys

options.en: The liver
options.hg: Liver (jigar)

options.en: The lungs
options.hg: Lungs (phephde)

options.en: The eyes
options.hg: Aankhein

explain.en: Hepatitis B infects the liver. Long-term infection can lead to liver damage and liver cancer. It spreads through blood, sex and from mother to baby, and a vaccine prevents it.
explain.hg: Hepatitis B liver ko infect karta hai. Lamba infection liver damage aur liver cancer tak le ja sakta hai. Yeh blood, sex aur maa se baby ko phailta hai, aur vaccine isse bachati hai.

q.en: An adult was never vaccinated against hepatitis B as a child. Can they still get the vaccine?
q.hg: Ek adult ko bachpan mein hepatitis B ki vaccine nahi lagi. Kya ab bhi lag sakti hai?

options.en: No, adults are naturally immune
options.hg: Nahi, adults naturally immune hote hain

options.en: No, it only works in newborns
options.hg: Nahi, yeh sirf newborns mein kaam karti hai

options.en: Yes, adults can be vaccinated too
options.hg: Haan, adults ko bhi vaccine lag sakti hai

options.en: Only if they already have hepatitis B
options.hg: Sirf agar unhe pehle se hepatitis B ho

explain.en: Unvaccinated adults, especially health workers and people at higher risk, can get the hepatitis B vaccine. A doctor may suggest a blood test first. It gives long-lasting protection.
explain.hg: Bina vaccine wale adults, khaaskar health workers aur zyada risk wale log, hepatitis B vaccine lagwa sakte hain. Doctor pehle blood test suggest kar sakte hain. Isse lamba protection milta hai.

q.en: Untreated chlamydia or gonorrhoea in women can lead to which serious problem?
q.hg: Women mein bina ilaaj ka chlamydia ya gonorrhoea kis gambhir problem tak le ja sakta hai?

options.en: Pelvic infection and infertility
options.hg: Pelvic infection aur infertility

options.en: Short-sightedness in both eyes
options.hg: Dono aankhon mein nazar kamzor hona

options.en: Type 2 diabetes in later life
options.hg: Aage chalkar type 2 diabetes

options.en: Hair loss and early greying
options.hg: Baal jhadna aur jaldi safed hona

explain.en: These infections can spread silently to the uterus and tubes, causing pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), long-term pain, ectopic pregnancy and infertility. Early testing and simple antibiotics prevent this.
explain.hg: Ye infections chupchaap uterus aur tubes tak phail sakte hain, jisse pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), lamba dard, ectopic pregnancy aur infertility ho sakti hai. Jaldi test aur simple antibiotics isse bachate hain.

q.en: Do men with an STI always notice symptoms?
q.hg: Kya STI wale aadmiyon ko hamesha symptoms pata chalte hain?

options.en: Men cannot get STIs at all
options.hg: Aadmiyon ko STI hota hi nahi

options.en: Yes, men always get pain or discharge
options.hg: Haan, aadmiyon ko hamesha dard ya discharge hota hai

options.en: Yes, only women have silent STIs
options.hg: Haan, sirf women ko silent STI hote hain

options.en: No, men can have silent STIs too
options.hg: Nahi, aadmiyon ko bhi silent STI ho sakte hain

explain.en: Chlamydia, HPV, HIV and even gonorrhoea can be silent in men. A man who feels fine can still pass on an infection, so testing is just as important for men.
explain.hg: Chlamydia, HPV, HIV aur kabhi gonorrhoea bhi aadmiyon mein silent ho sakte hain. Jo aadmi theek mehsoos karta hai woh bhi infection aage de sakta hai, isliye aadmiyon ke liye bhi testing utni hi zaroori hai.

q.en: Which change in vaginal discharge is a reason to see a doctor?
q.hg: Vaginal discharge mein kaunsa badlaav doctor ko dikhane ki wajah hai?

options.en: Slightly more discharge around ovulation
options.hg: Ovulation ke aas-paas thoda zyada discharge

options.en: Discharge that is stretchy mid-cycle
options.hg: Cycle ke beech mein khinchne wala discharge

options.en: Clear or white discharge that varies in the cycle
options.hg: Saaf ya safed discharge jo cycle ke saath badle

options.en: A strong smell, unusual colour or itching
options.hg: Tez badbu, alag rang ya khujli

explain.en: Discharge that changes through the cycle is normal and keeps the vagina healthy. A fishy or strong smell, green, yellow or grey colour, itching or pain can mean an infection, some of them STIs, and needs a check.
explain.hg: Cycle ke saath badalne wala discharge normal hai aur vagina ko healthy rakhta hai. Machhli jaisi ya tez badbu, hara, peela ya grey rang, khujli ya dard infection ka sign ho sakta hai, kuch STI bhi, aur check karana chahiye.

q.en: An aunty says white discharge (safed paani) drains a woman's strength. What is true?
q.hg: Ek aunty kehti hain ki safed paani (white discharge) aurat ki taakat kha jaata hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: True, it must be stopped with tonics
options.hg: Sahi, ise tonic se rokna padta hai

options.en: True, it slowly weakens the bones
options.hg: Sahi, yeh dheere dheere haddiyan kamzor karta hai

options.en: True, it is always a sign of an STI
options.hg: Sahi, yeh hamesha STI ka sign hai

options.en: Normal discharge doesn't cause weakness
options.hg: Normal discharge se kamzori nahi hoti

explain.en: Normal discharge is the vagina's way of cleaning itself and does not cause weakness. Tiredness has other causes, such as anaemia, worth checking. Discharge with itching, smell or pain should be seen by a doctor.
explain.hg: Normal discharge vagina ka khud ko saaf rakhne ka tareeka hai aur isse kamzori nahi hoti. Thakaan ki aur wajahein ho sakti hain, jaise anaemia, jinhe check karana chahiye. Khujli, badbu ya dard ke saath discharge ho toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: Burning while peeing can be a urinary tract infection (UTI) or an STI. What is the best way to know?
q.hg: Peshaab mein jalan UTI ya STI dono ho sakti hai. Pata karne ka sabse achha tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Wait a month to see if it spreads
options.hg: Ek mahina wait karo dekho phailta hai ya nahi

options.en: Guess from how bad the pain is
options.hg: Dard kitna hai usse andaza lagao

options.en: See a doctor for a check and the right tests
options.hg: Doctor se check aur sahi tests karwao

options.en: Assume it's a UTI and drink juice
options.hg: UTI maan lo aur juice piyo

explain.en: Symptoms of UTIs and some STIs overlap, and they need different treatment. A urine test or swab tells which it is, so the right medicine is given and partners can be treated if needed.
explain.hg: UTI aur kuch STIs ke symptoms milte-julte hain, aur dono ka ilaaj alag hai. Urine test ya swab se pata chalta hai kaunsa hai, taaki sahi dawa mile aur zaroorat ho toh partner ka bhi ilaaj ho.

q.en: Small painless bumps appear on Vikram's genitals. A friend suggests a wart-removing cream from the chemist. What is best?
q.hg: Vikram ke genitals par chhote bina dard ke daane aaye hain. Dost chemist ki wart hatane wali cream suggest karta hai. Kya best hai?

options.en: Scrape them off at home with a blade
options.hg: Ghar par blade se khurach do

options.en: Get them checked; they may be HPV warts
options.hg: Check karao; yeh HPV warts ho sakte hain

options.en: Ignore them; bumps there are always harmless
options.hg: Ignore karo; wahan ke daane hamesha harmless hote hain

options.en: Use the cream; all bumps are warts
options.hg: Cream lagao; saare daane warts hote hain

explain.en: Genital bumps can be normal skin features, warts caused by HPV, or other conditions. Over-the-counter wart creams are not meant for genital skin. A doctor can diagnose and treat safely.
explain.hg: Genitals par daane normal skin features, HPV se bane warts, ya kuch aur ho sakte hain. Chemist ki wart creams genital skin ke liye nahi bani. Doctor sahi diagnosis aur safe ilaaj kar sakte hain.

q.en: Why are pregnant women tested for syphilis during antenatal check-ups?
q.hg: Antenatal check-up mein pregnant women ka syphilis test kyun kiya jaata hai?

options.en: It shows whether the baby is a boy or girl
options.hg: Isse pata chalta hai baby ladka hai ya ladki

options.en: It can harm the baby, and treatment prevents that
options.hg: Yeh baby ko nuksaan karta hai, aur ilaaj isse bachata hai

options.en: It decides whether a C-section is needed
options.hg: Isse tay hota hai ki C-section chahiye ya nahi

options.en: It is needed to register the birth
options.hg: Janm register karne ke liye zaroori hai

explain.en: Syphilis can pass to the baby and cause miscarriage, stillbirth or congenital syphilis. A simple test and treatment during pregnancy protect the baby. In 2024-25, only 77% of pregnant women in India were tested for syphilis.
explain.hg: Syphilis baby tak jaakar miscarriage, stillbirth ya congenital syphilis kar sakta hai. Pregnancy mein simple test aur ilaaj baby ko bachata hai. 2024-25 mein India mein sirf 77% pregnant women ka syphilis test hua.

q.en: Is trichomoniasis curable?
q.hg: Kya trichomoniasis theek ho sakta hai?

options.en: No, it stays in the body for life
options.hg: Nahi, yeh zindagi bhar body mein rehta hai

options.en: Yes, with medicine for both partners
options.hg: Haan, dono partners ki dawa se

options.en: Only if caught within a day
options.hg: Sirf agar ek din ke andar pakda jaaye

options.en: Only with a small surgery
options.hg: Sirf chhoti si surgery se

explain.en: Trichomoniasis is caused by a tiny parasite and is cured with the right prescribed medicine. Partners should be treated at the same time, and it can come back if one is left out.
explain.hg: Trichomoniasis ek chhote parasite se hota hai aur sahi prescribed dawa se theek ho jaata hai. Partners ka ilaaj ek saath hona chahiye, warna ek chhoot jaaye toh yeh wapas aa sakta hai.

q.en: Is there a cure for HIV today?
q.hg: Kya aaj HIV ka koi cure hai?

options.en: Yes, certain herbs cure it completely if taken for months
options.hg: Haan, kuch jadi-bootiyan mahino tak lene se poori tarah theek karti hain

options.en: No, but treatment allows a long, healthy life
options.hg: Nahi, par treatment se lambi, healthy zindagi milti hai

options.en: Yes, a one-week injection cures it
options.hg: Haan, ek hafte ka injection theek kar deta hai

options.en: No, and treatment doesn't help at all
options.hg: Nahi, aur treatment se bhi koi fayda nahi

explain.en: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) does not cure HIV, but taken daily it keeps the virus under control. People with HIV on treatment can study, work, marry and have children.
explain.hg: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) HIV ko cure nahi karti, par roz lene par virus ko control mein rakhti hai. Treatment par HIV wale log padh sakte hain, kaam kar sakte hain, shaadi kar sakte hain aur bachche paida kar sakte hain.

q.en: Where can people living with HIV in India get antiretroviral therapy (ART) free of cost?
q.hg: India mein HIV ke saath jee rahe log antiretroviral therapy (ART) free mein kahan le sakte hain?

options.en: Only at private hospitals
options.hg: Sirf private hospitals mein

options.en: At any general store
options.hg: Kisi bhi general store par

options.en: Only abroad
options.hg: Sirf videsh mein

options.en: At government ART centres
options.hg: Government ART centres par

explain.en: NACO runs government ART centres across India; in March 2025, 17.54 lakh people were on ART at 800 government centres. Treatment, tests and counselling there are free.
explain.hg: NACO poore India mein government ART centres chalata hai; March 2025 mein 800 government centres par 17.54 lakh log ART par the. Wahan treatment, tests aur counselling free hain.

q.en: What does 'U=U' mean?
q.hg: 'U=U' ka matlab kya hai?

options.en: Unprotected = Unacceptable
options.hg: Unprotected = Unacceptable

options.en: Undetectable = Untransmittable
options.hg: Undetectable = Untransmittable

options.en: Unmarried = Uninfected
options.hg: Unmarried = Uninfected

options.en: Untested = Unknown status
options.hg: Untested = Unknown status

explain.en: U=U means a person with HIV whose treatment keeps the virus at an undetectable level does not pass HIV on through sex. It shows how powerful treatment is, and it fights stigma.
explain.hg: U=U ka matlab hai ki jis HIV wale insaan ka treatment virus ko undetectable level par rakhta hai, woh sex se HIV aage nahi deta. Yeh dikhata hai treatment kitna powerful hai, aur stigma se ladta hai.

q.en: Why must ART be taken every day, for life?
q.hg: ART roz, zindagi bhar kyun leni padti hai?

options.en: Missing doses makes no difference at all
options.hg: Dose miss karne se koi fark nahi padta

options.en: Stopping lets HIV rebound and become resistant
options.hg: Band karne se HIV phir badhta hai aur resistant ho jaata hai

options.en: It cures HIV only after ten years
options.hg: Yeh das saal baad hi HIV cure karti hai

options.en: It is needed only in the winter months
options.hg: Yeh sirf sardi ke mahino mein chahiye

explain.en: ART keeps HIV suppressed but does not remove it from the body. If doses are skipped, the virus can rebound and become resistant to the medicines. Daily treatment keeps the person healthy and the virus untransmittable.
explain.hg: ART HIV ko dabaakar rakhti hai par body se nikaalti nahi. Dose chhootne par virus phir badh sakta hai aur dawaiyon ke against resistant ho sakta hai. Roz ka treatment insaan ko healthy aur virus ko untransmittable rakhta hai.

q.en: What is HIV PEP?
q.hg: HIV PEP kya hai?

options.en: Medicine started soon after possible exposure
options.hg: Possible exposure ke jaldi baad shuru hone wali dawa

options.en: A daily pill for people already living with HIV
options.hg: HIV wale logon ki daily pill

options.en: A test that shows HIV the same day as exposure
options.hg: Test jo exposure ke din hi HIV dikha de

options.en: A vaccine that gives lifelong protection
options.hg: Vaccine jo zindagi bhar protection de

explain.en: Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) is a course of HIV medicines started as soon as possible, and within 72 hours, after a possible exposure, and taken for 28 days. It needs a doctor's assessment.
explain.hg: Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) HIV dawaiyon ka course hai jo possible exposure ke baad jaldi se jaldi, 72 ghante ke andar, shuru hota hai aur 28 din liya jaata hai. Iske liye doctor ka assessment zaroori hai.

q.en: Within how long after a possible HIV exposure must PEP be started?
q.hg: Possible HIV exposure ke kitne time ke andar PEP shuru honi chahiye?

options.en: Any time before symptoms appear
options.hg: Symptoms aane se pehle kabhi bhi

options.en: Within two weeks of exposure
options.hg: Exposure ke do hafte ke andar

options.en: Only after a positive HIV test
options.hg: Sirf HIV test positive aane ke baad

options.en: As soon as possible, within 72 hours
options.hg: Jaldi se jaldi, 72 ghante ke andar

explain.en: PEP works best the sooner it starts, and it is not recommended after 72 hours. That's why a possible exposure is an emergency: go to a hospital emergency department or ART centre right away.
explain.hg: PEP jitni jaldi shuru ho utna behtar, aur 72 ghante ke baad recommend nahi ki jaati. Isliye possible exposure emergency hai: turant hospital emergency ya ART centre jao.

q.en: It's Saturday night. A condom broke with a partner whose HIV status is unknown, and the ICTC is closed till Monday. What should you do?
q.hg: Shanivaar raat hai. Jis partner ka HIV status pata nahi uske saath condom phat gaya, aur ICTC Monday tak band hai. Kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Do nothing unless symptoms appear
options.hg: Jab tak symptoms na aayein kuch mat karo

options.en: Take a test tomorrow and decide then
options.hg: Kal test karo aur phir decide karo

options.en: Wait until Monday; there's plenty of time
options.hg: Monday tak ruko; bahut time hai

options.en: Go to hospital emergency now and ask for PEP
options.hg: Abhi hospital emergency jao aur PEP ke liye poochho

explain.en: PEP has a 72-hour window, and earlier is better, so don't wait for the weekend to end. Hospital emergency departments can assess you and start PEP. NACO's helpline 1097 can also guide you.
explain.hg: PEP ki window 72 ghante hai, aur jaldi behtar hai, toh weekend khatam hone ka wait mat karo. Hospital ki emergency assess karke PEP shuru kar sakti hai. NACO helpline 1097 bhi guide kar sakti hai.

q.en: A nursing student pricks her finger with a used needle on the ward. What is the first step after washing the area?
q.hg: Ek nursing student ward mein use ki hui needle se ungli chubha leti hai. Jagah dhone ke baad pehla step kya hai?

options.en: Keep quiet to avoid getting into trouble
options.hg: Mushkil se bachne ke liye chup raho

options.en: Squeeze and suck the wound hard
options.hg: Zakhm ko zor se dabao aur chooso

options.en: Wait a month and then get tested
options.hg: Ek mahina ruko phir test karao

options.en: Report it at once so PEP can be assessed
options.hg: Turant report karo taaki PEP ka assessment ho

explain.en: After washing with soap and water, needle-stick injuries should be reported immediately. A doctor assesses the risk and starts PEP if needed, within 72 hours and ideally within hours. Hospitals have protocols for this.
explain.hg: Sabun aur paani se dhone ke baad needle-stick injury turant report karni chahiye. Doctor risk assess karke zaroorat ho toh PEP shuru karte hain, 72 ghante ke andar aur ideally kuch ghanton mein. Hospitals mein iske protocols hote hain.

q.en: What is HIV PrEP?
q.hg: HIV PrEP kya hai?

options.en: A home test kit for checking HIV
options.hg: HIV check karne ki home test kit

options.en: A one-time vaccine that blocks HIV
options.hg: Ek baar ki vaccine jo HIV rokti hai

options.en: Medicine HIV-negative people use to prevent HIV
options.hg: Dawa jo HIV-negative log HIV se bachne ke liye lete hain

options.en: Medicine taken after an HIV-positive result
options.hg: HIV-positive result ke baad li jaane wali dawa

explain.en: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) is used by HIV-negative people at ongoing risk to prevent infection, today mostly as a daily pill. It is prescribed by a clinician, who checks HIV status and kidney health and does regular follow-ups.
explain.hg: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) woh HIV-negative log use karte hain jinhe lagataar risk hai, infection se bachne ke liye, aaj zyaadatar daily pill ki tarah. Ise clinician prescribe karte hain, jo HIV status aur kidney health check karke regular follow-up karte hain.

q.en: What is the key difference between PEP and PrEP?
q.hg: PEP aur PrEP mein main fark kya hai?

options.en: PEP cures HIV; PrEP only manages it
options.hg: PEP HIV cure karti hai; PrEP sirf manage karti hai

options.en: PEP is only for women; PrEP is only for men
options.hg: PEP sirf women ke liye; PrEP sirf men ke liye

options.en: PEP is after exposure; PrEP is ongoing, before it
options.hg: PEP exposure ke baad; PrEP lagataar, usse pehle

options.en: PEP is a vaccine; PrEP is a blood test
options.hg: PEP vaccine hai; PrEP blood test hai

explain.en: PEP is an emergency 28-day course started within 72 hours after a possible exposure. PrEP is taken regularly by HIV-negative people with ongoing risk, under a clinician's care. Neither cures HIV.
explain.hg: PEP emergency wala 28 din ka course hai jo possible exposure ke 72 ghante ke andar shuru hota hai. PrEP HIV-negative log lagataar risk hone par clinician ki dekhrekh mein regularly lete hain. Dono mein se koi HIV cure nahi karta.

q.en: Does PrEP protect against other STIs or pregnancy?
q.hg: Kya PrEP doosre STIs ya pregnancy se bachati hai?

options.en: Yes, it also works as contraception
options.hg: Haan, yeh contraception ka kaam bhi karti hai

options.en: Yes, it blocks all STIs
options.hg: Haan, yeh saare STIs rokti hai

options.en: Yes, it protects against both
options.hg: Haan, dono se bachati hai

options.en: No, it only prevents HIV
options.hg: Nahi, yeh sirf HIV rokti hai

explain.en: PrEP is specific to HIV. It does not prevent syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia, herpes or pregnancy, so condoms, regular STI testing and a contraceptive method still matter.
explain.hg: PrEP sirf HIV ke liye hai. Yeh syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia, herpes ya pregnancy nahi rokti, isliye condom, regular STI testing aur contraceptive method ab bhi zaroori hain.

q.en: A woman living with HIV wants to have a baby. What is true?
q.hg: HIV ke saath jee rahi ek woman baby chahti hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: She must stop all medicines during pregnancy
options.hg: Use pregnancy mein saari dawaiyan band karni hongi

options.en: The baby will definitely be born with HIV
options.hg: Baby pakka HIV ke saath paida hoga

options.en: Women with HIV are not allowed to have children by law
options.hg: Law ke hisaab se HIV wali women bachche nahi kar sakti

options.en: With treatment, her baby can very likely be HIV-free
options.hg: Treatment ke saath, bahut sambhav hai baby HIV-free ho

explain.en: With ART during pregnancy, safe delivery and care for the baby, the risk of passing HIV on becomes very low. Doctors at ART centres guide couples through planning a pregnancy safely.
explain.hg: Pregnancy mein ART, safe delivery aur baby ki care se HIV aage jaane ka risk bahut kam ho jaata hai. ART centres ke doctors couples ko safely pregnancy plan karne mein guide karte hain.

q.en: In a married couple, the husband has HIV and has had an undetectable viral load on ART for a long time. What is true about passing HIV to his wife through sex?
q.hg: Ek married couple mein pati ko HIV hai aur ART par lambe time se uska viral load undetectable hai. Sex se patni ko HIV jaane ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.en: She is protected only if she takes ART too
options.hg: Woh tabhi safe hai jab woh bhi ART le

options.en: He does not pass HIV on through sex
options.hg: Woh sex se HIV aage nahi deta

options.en: They must separate to stay safe
options.hg: Safe rehne ke liye unhe alag hona padega

options.en: The risk is the same as without treatment
options.hg: Risk bina treatment jitna hi hai

explain.en: This is U=U: a person whose HIV stays undetectable on treatment does not transmit HIV sexually. Regular viral-load tests confirm it. Condoms still help with other STIs and pregnancy planning.
explain.hg: Yahi U=U hai: jiska HIV treatment par undetectable rehta hai, woh sex se HIV aage nahi deta. Regular viral-load test isse confirm karte hain. Doosre STIs aur pregnancy planning ke liye condom ab bhi kaam aata hai.

q.en: Can a company fire someone because they are living with HIV?
q.hg: Kya koi company kisi ko HIV hone ki wajah se naukri se nikaal sakti hai?

options.en: Yes, if the job involves handling food
options.hg: Haan, agar kaam khaane se juda ho

options.en: Yes, if co-workers feel uncomfortable
options.hg: Haan, agar co-workers ko uncomfortable lage

options.en: Yes, in private companies only
options.hg: Haan, sirf private companies mein

options.en: No, the HIV Act, 2017 bars this
options.hg: Nahi, HIV Act, 2017 isse rokta hai

explain.en: Section 3 of the HIV Act, 2017 bars discrimination against people with HIV in employment, healthcare, education, housing and more. Complaints can go to a Complaints Officer or the state HIV Ombudsman.
explain.hg: HIV Act, 2017 ka Section 3 HIV wale logon ke saath employment, healthcare, education, housing aur kai jagah discrimination ko mana karta hai. Shikayat Complaints Officer ya state HIV Ombudsman ke paas ja sakti hai.

q.en: Under India's HIV Act, 2017, can someone be forced to reveal their HIV status?
q.hg: India ke HIV Act, 2017 ke tahat, kya kisi ko apna HIV status batane ke liye majboor kiya ja sakta hai?

options.en: Yes, to any neighbour who asks
options.hg: Haan, koi bhi padosi poochhe toh

options.en: Yes, whenever an employer asks
options.hg: Haan, jab bhi employer poochhe

options.en: No, except by a court order
options.hg: Nahi, sirf court order ke alawa

options.en: Yes, on every government form
options.hg: Haan, har government form par

explain.en: Section 8 of the Act says no one can be compelled to disclose their HIV status except by a court order, and courts can let people use a pseudonym in HIV-related cases (Section 34).
explain.hg: Act ka Section 8 kehta hai ki kisi ko court order ke alawa apna HIV status batane ke liye majboor nahi kiya ja sakta, aur courts HIV cases mein logon ko pseudonym use karne de sakti hain (Section 34).

q.en: A Facebook page posts hateful messages against people living with HIV. What does India's HIV Act say about this?
q.hg: Ek Facebook page HIV wale logon ke khilaaf nafrat bhare messages post karta hai. India ka HIV Act iske baare mein kya kehta hai?

options.en: Only a warning can be given
options.hg: Sirf warning di ja sakti hai

options.en: The Act says nothing about it
options.hg: Act iske baare mein kuch nahi kehta

options.en: It is a punishable offence
options.hg: Yeh sazaa layak apraadh hai

options.en: It's allowed as free speech
options.hg: Free speech ke naam par allowed hai

explain.en: Under Sections 4 and 37 of the HIV Act, 2017, publishing or advocating hatred against people living with HIV can be punished with three months to two years in prison, a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh, or both.
explain.hg: HIV Act, 2017 ke Sections 4 aur 37 ke tahat, HIV wale logon ke khilaaf nafrat publish karne ya phailane par teen mahine se do saal tak jail, 1 lakh rupaye tak fine, ya dono ho sakte hain.

q.en: About how many people were estimated to be living with HIV in India in 2024?
q.hg: 2024 mein India mein lagbhag kitne log HIV ke saath jee rahe the (estimate)?

options.en: About 25 thousand
options.hg: Lagbhag 25 hazaar

options.en: About 25.61 lakh
options.hg: Lagbhag 25.61 lakh

options.en: About 2.5 crore
options.hg: Lagbhag 2.5 crore

options.en: About 25 crore
options.hg: Lagbhag 25 crore

explain.en: NACO estimated 25.61 lakh (2.56 million) people living with HIV in India in 2024, the second-largest number in the world after South Africa, even though adult prevalence was a low 0.20%.
explain.hg: NACO ke estimate ke mutabik 2024 mein India mein 25.61 lakh (2.56 million) log HIV ke saath jee rahe the, South Africa ke baad duniya mein doosra sabse bada number, jabki adult prevalence sirf 0.20% thi.

q.en: In 2024, HIV prevalence in India was 2.84% among hijra/transgender people, against 0.20% among all adults. What is the most useful takeaway?
q.hg: 2024 mein India mein hijra/transgender logon mein HIV prevalence 2.84% thi, jabki sab adults mein 0.20%. Sabse useful seekh kya hai?

options.en: Transgender people should be avoided
options.hg: Transgender logon se door rehna chahiye

options.en: Other people need not worry about HIV or testing at all
options.hg: Baaki logon ko HIV ya testing ki bilkul fikar nahi karni

options.en: Stigma-free services must reach high-risk groups
options.hg: Zyada risk wale groups tak bina stigma ki services pahunchein

options.en: HIV is caused by being transgender itself
options.hg: Transgender hona hi HIV ka kaaran hai

explain.en: Higher prevalence reflects barriers like stigma, exclusion and difficulty getting care, not identity itself. NACO's key-population programmes and respectful, confidential services help. HIV can affect anyone.
explain.hg: Zyada prevalence stigma, exclusion aur care tak pahunchne ki mushkil jaisi rukaawaton ko dikhata hai, identity ko nahi. NACO ke key-population programmes aur respectful, confidential services madad karti hain. HIV kisi ko bhi ho sakta hai.

q.en: A couple uses condoms 'most of the time'. Why does that still leave real STI risk?
q.hg: Ek couple 'zyaadatar time' condom use karta hai. Isme ab bhi asli STI risk kyun hai?

options.en: Condoms only work if used every single day
options.hg: Condom tabhi kaam karte hain jab roz use ho

options.en: One unprotected time can pass an infection
options.hg: Ek baar bina protection bhi infection de sakta hai

options.en: Condoms lose power if used too often
options.hg: Bahut use karne se condom ki taakat kam hoti hai

options.en: Infections build up only after many times
options.hg: Infection kai baar ke baad hi jama hota hai

explain.en: Condoms protect only during the times they are used, correctly, from start to finish. Infections can pass in a single exposure, so consistent use is what makes condoms so effective.
explain.hg: Condom sirf tab protect karte hain jab sahi tarah, shuru se end tak use hon. Infection ek baar mein bhi ja sakta hai, isliye har baar use karna hi condom ko itna effective banata hai.

q.en: Does 'pulling out' protect against STIs?
q.hg: Kya 'pull out' karna STIs se bachata hai?

options.en: Yes, if done early enough each time
options.hg: Haan, agar har baar kaafi jaldi kiya jaaye

options.en: Yes, but only against HIV and hepatitis
options.hg: Haan, par sirf HIV aur hepatitis se

options.en: Yes, it blocks all infections completely
options.hg: Haan, yeh saare infections poori tarah rokta hai

options.en: No, STIs spread through fluids and skin anyway
options.hg: Nahi, STIs fluids aur skin se waise bhi phailte hain

explain.en: Withdrawal does nothing to stop skin-to-skin contact or pre-ejaculate and vaginal fluids, which can carry infections. Only condoms lower STI risk among contraceptive methods.
explain.hg: Withdrawal skin-to-skin contact ya pre-ejaculate aur vaginal fluids ko nahi rokta, jinme infection ho sakta hai. Contraceptive methods mein sirf condom hi STI risk kam karta hai.

q.en: A couple in an exclusive relationship want to stop using condoms. What is the safest way to decide?
q.hg: Ek exclusive relationship wala couple condom band karna chahta hai. Decide karne ka sabse safe tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Both test for STIs, then agree on contraception
options.hg: Dono STI test karayein, phir contraception par sahmat hon

options.en: Stop as soon as one of them gets a blood test done
options.hg: Kisi ek ka blood test hote hi band kar dein

options.en: Stop if neither has any symptoms
options.hg: Agar kisi ko symptoms na hon toh band kar dein

options.en: Stop once they've been together a month
options.hg: Ek mahina saath rehne ke baad band kar dein

explain.en: Symptoms are not reliable, so both partners getting tested, repeating a test after any window period if advised, is the safe way. They also need another plan to prevent pregnancy if they don't want one.
explain.hg: Symptoms par bharosa nahi kar sakte, isliye dono partners ka test, aur advise ho toh window period ke baad dobara test, safe tareeka hai. Pregnancy nahi chahiye toh uske liye bhi koi aur plan chahiye.

q.en: Tanvi has just been diagnosed with chlamydia. How can she tell her partner?
q.hg: Tanvi ko abhi chlamydia diagnose hua hai. Woh apne partner ko kaise bataye?

options.en: Only after she has finished her treatment
options.hg: Sirf apna ilaaj poora hone ke baad

options.en: She shouldn't tell, it will only cause a fight
options.hg: Nahi batana chahiye, bas jhagda hoga

options.en: Calmly and honestly, so he can get tested
options.hg: Shaanti aur imaandaari se, taaki woh test karaye

options.en: By blaming him in front of friends
options.hg: Doston ke saamne use blame karke

explain.en: Telling a partner soon lets them get tested and treated and stops reinfection. It need not be about blame, since many STIs are silent for a long time. Clinic staff can help with what to say.
explain.hg: Partner ko jaldi batane se woh test aur ilaaj kara sakta hai aur infection wapas nahi aata. Yeh blame ki baat nahi, kyunki kai STIs lambe time tak silent rehte hain. Clinic staff kya bolna hai usme madad kar sakte hain.

q.en: A friend is diagnosed with an STI and says she feels 'dirty'. What is the most helpful thing to say?
q.hg: Ek dost ko STI diagnose hua hai aur woh kehti hai ki use 'gandi' feel ho rahi hai. Sabse helpful kya kehna hai?

options.en: This only happens to people with bad character
options.hg: Yeh sirf bure character walon ke saath hota hai

options.en: It's a common condition and can be treated
options.hg: Yeh common condition hai aur iska ilaaj hai

options.en: She should be more careful about who she is
options.hg: Use apne character ka dhyan rakhna chahiye

options.en: Don't tell anyone, it's very shameful
options.hg: Kisi ko mat batana, bahut sharam ki baat hai

explain.en: STIs are infections, not a judgement on anyone's character. Most are treatable and all can be managed. Support and no shaming make it easier for people to get care and tell partners.
explain.hg: STIs infection hain, kisi ke character par faisla nahi. Zyaadatar ka ilaaj hai aur sab manage ho sakte hain. Support aur bina sharminda kiye baat karne se log aasaani se care lete hain aur partners ko batate hain.

q.en: Someone on a class WhatsApp group claims a classmate 'has AIDS' and asks others to forward it. What should you do?
q.hg: Class WhatsApp group par koi kehta hai ek classmate ko 'AIDS hai' aur sabse forward karne ko kehta hai. Tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Don't forward it, and speak up against the rumour
options.hg: Forward mat karo, aur rumour ke khilaaf bolo

options.en: Forward it so everyone can stay safe
options.hg: Forward karo taaki sab safe rahein

options.en: Stop talking to the classmate for now, just in case
options.hg: Just in case abhi ke liye classmate se baat band kar do

options.en: Ask the classmate for proof in the group
options.hg: Group mein classmate se proof maango

explain.en: HIV status is private health information, and HIV does not spread through everyday contact. Spreading such rumours causes real harm and can amount to hate or harassment. Report it to a teacher or the group admin.
explain.hg: HIV status private health information hai, aur HIV roz ke contact se nahi phailta. Aise rumours phailane se asli nuksaan hota hai aur yeh nafrat ya harassment ban sakta hai. Teacher ya group admin ko report karo.

q.en: What happens to your personal details when you get tested at a Suraksha Clinic or ICTC?
q.hg: Suraksha Clinic ya ICTC mein test karane par tumhari personal details ka kya hota hai?

options.en: They are shared with your employer
options.hg: Employer ke saath share hoti hain

options.en: They are kept confidential
options.hg: Woh confidential rakhi jaati hain

options.en: They are sent to your family
options.hg: Family ko bhej di jaati hain

options.en: They are posted on a public list
options.hg: Public list par daali jaati hain

explain.en: Government testing and treatment centres keep results confidential, and the HIV Act, 2017 protects the privacy of people tested for HIV. You can ask the counsellor how your information is stored.
explain.hg: Government testing aur treatment centres results confidential rakhte hain, aur HIV Act, 2017 HIV test karane walon ki privacy bachata hai. Counsellor se pooch sakte ho tumhari information kaise rakhi jaati hai.

q.en: Lower belly pain with fever and unusual discharge in a woman can be a sign of what?
q.hg: Woman mein bukhaar aur alag discharge ke saath pet ke neeche dard kis cheez ka sign ho sakta hai?

options.en: Indigestion from spicy food
options.hg: Teekha khaane se apach

options.en: Normal period cramps only
options.hg: Sirf normal period cramps

options.en: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID)
options.hg: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID)

options.en: Lack of sleep and stress
options.hg: Neend ki kami aur stress

explain.en: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) is an infection of the uterus, tubes or ovaries, often from untreated STIs. Prompt antibiotics from a doctor protect future fertility, so don't wait it out.
explain.hg: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) uterus, tubes ya ovaries ka infection hai, aksar bina ilaaj ke STIs se. Doctor ki jaldi di gayi antibiotics aage ki fertility bachati hain, toh wait mat karo.

q.en: A married man has itching and sores but is too embarrassed to tell his wife. What is the right step?
q.hg: Ek shaadishuda aadmi ko khujli aur sores hain par woh patni ko batane mein sharmata hai. Sahi step kya hai?

options.en: Get checked, and tell his wife so she can too
options.hg: Check karaye, aur patni ko bataye taaki woh bhi karaye

options.en: Go to a gupt rog quack for secrecy
options.hg: Secrecy ke liye gupt rog wale jhola-chhaap ke paas jaaye

options.en: Treat himself quietly with ointments
options.hg: Chupchaap khud ointment se ilaaj kare

options.en: Wait a few weeks to see if it goes away
options.hg: Kuch hafte wait kare, dekhe apne aap jaata hai ya nahi

explain.en: Sores and itching can have many causes, including STIs that also affect a spouse. A doctor or Suraksha Clinic gives confidential diagnosis and treatment for both partners; avoiding sex until then protects her.
explain.hg: Sores aur khujli ki kai wajahein ho sakti hain, STIs bhi jo patni ko bhi affect karte hain. Doctor ya Suraksha Clinic dono partners ko confidential diagnosis aur ilaaj dete hain; tab tak sex se bachna patni ko protect karta hai.

q.en: Can someone have more than one STI at the same time?
q.hg: Kya kisi ko ek saath ek se zyada STI ho sakte hain?

options.en: Only in people who are over the age of 40
options.hg: Sirf 40 saal se zyada umar walon mein

options.en: No, the body can only allow one infection at a time
options.hg: Nahi, body ek baar mein ek hi infection allow karti hai

options.en: No, one STI makes you immune to others
options.hg: Nahi, ek STI hone se doosron se immunity milti hai

options.en: Yes, which is why clinics often test for several
options.hg: Haan, isliye clinics aksar kai tests karte hain

explain.en: Infections such as chlamydia and gonorrhoea often occur together, and having one STI can raise the risk of HIV. Clinics usually test for several infections, including HIV and syphilis, at one visit.
explain.hg: Chlamydia aur gonorrhoea jaise infections aksar saath hote hain, aur ek STI hone se HIV ka risk badh sakta hai. Clinics aam taur par ek visit mein kai infections, HIV aur syphilis samet, test karte hain.

q.en: Does getting an STI once make you immune to it in future?
q.hg: Kya ek baar STI hone se future mein us STI se immunity mil jaati hai?

options.en: No, you can get many STIs again
options.hg: Nahi, kai STIs dobara ho sakte hain

options.en: Yes, for at least ten years
options.hg: Haan, kam se kam das saal tak

options.en: Yes, the body is protected for life
options.hg: Haan, body zindagi bhar protected hai

options.en: Yes, if treated with strong medicine
options.hg: Haan, agar strong dawa se ilaaj hua ho

explain.en: Curing chlamydia, gonorrhoea or syphilis does not give immunity, so reinfection is common if a partner is untreated or condoms are not used. That's why partner treatment and retesting matter.
explain.hg: Chlamydia, gonorrhoea ya syphilis theek hone se immunity nahi milti, isliye partner ka ilaaj na ho ya condom use na ho toh dobara infection common hai. Isliye partner ka ilaaj aur dobara test zaroori hai.

q.en: Is it safe to hug, share meals and play sports with someone living with HIV?
q.hg: Kya HIV ke saath jee rahe kisi insaan ko hug karna, saath khaana aur khelna safe hai?

options.en: No, sweat during sports can spread it
options.hg: Nahi, khel mein paseene se phail sakta hai

options.en: Only after they finish their medicines
options.hg: Sirf unki dawaiyan khatam hone ke baad

options.en: Only if they wear gloves and a mask
options.hg: Sirf agar woh gloves aur mask pehnein

options.en: Yes, these activities do not pass on HIV
options.hg: Haan, in cheezon se HIV nahi phailta

explain.en: HIV is not spread by hugging, sharing food, sweat, toilets or playing sports. Treating people with HIV normally is both safe and the law: the HIV Act, 2017 forbids isolating or segregating them.
explain.hg: HIV hug, khaana share karne, paseene, toilet ya khel se nahi phailta. HIV wale logon ke saath normal bartaav safe bhi hai aur law bhi: HIV Act, 2017 unhe alag ya isolate karne ko mana karta hai.

q.en: In 2024-25, spouses, partners and children of people with HIV tested through NACO's index testing had 4.1% positivity, about ten times the 0.40% among all at-risk people tested. What does this show?
q.hg: 2024-25 mein NACO ki index testing mein HIV wale logon ke spouse, partner aur bachchon mein positivity 4.1% thi, sabhi at-risk tested logon ke 0.40% se lagbhag das guna. Isse kya pata chalta hai?

options.en: Partner testing finds many people who didn't know
options.hg: Partner testing un logon ko dhoondhti hai jinhe pata nahi tha

options.en: Testing partners is not useful
options.hg: Partners ki testing ka koi fayda nahi

options.en: Children always get HIV from their parents
options.hg: Bachchon ko hamesha parents se HIV hota hai

options.en: HIV spreads mainly through casual everyday contact at home
options.hg: HIV zyaadatar ghar ke roz ke aam contact se phailta hai

explain.en: Offering tests to partners and children of people with HIV, with consent, finds undiagnosed infections far more often than general testing. Early diagnosis means early treatment and fewer new infections.
explain.hg: HIV wale logon ke partners aur bachchon ko consent ke saath test offer karne se general testing ke muqable kahin zyada undiagnosed infections milte hain. Jaldi diagnosis matlab jaldi treatment aur kam naye infections.

q.en: Can HIV be passed on through breastfeeding?
q.hg: Kya breastfeeding se HIV aage ja sakta hai?

options.en: No, breast milk can never carry HIV
options.hg: Nahi, breast milk mein kabhi HIV nahi hota

options.en: No, only formula milk can carry it
options.hg: Nahi, sirf formula milk mein ho sakta hai

options.en: Yes, so mothers with HIV need medical advice
options.hg: Haan, isliye HIV wali maaon ko medical advice chahiye

options.en: Only if the baby is over a year old
options.hg: Sirf agar baby ek saal se bada ho

explain.en: Breast milk is one of the fluids that can carry HIV. With the mother on effective treatment and following her doctor's advice on feeding, the risk is greatly reduced.
explain.hg: Breast milk un fluids mein se hai jinme HIV ho sakta hai. Maa effective treatment par ho aur feeding par doctor ki salah maane, toh risk bahut kam ho jaata hai.

q.en: Rahul's friend says that a strong person's immunity will fight off any STI without treatment. What is true?
q.hg: Rahul ka dost kehta hai ki strong insaan ki immunity bina ilaaj ke koi bhi STI hara degi. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Fitness can't cure STIs; testing and treatment can
options.hg: Fitness STI theek nahi karti; test aur ilaaj karte hain

options.en: True, if you take enough vitamin tablets
options.hg: Sahi, agar kaafi vitamin ki goliyan lo

options.en: True, people who go to the gym rarely need STI treatment
options.hg: Sahi, gym jaane walon ko STI ilaaj ki zaroorat kam padti hai

options.en: True, a healthy diet cures syphilis
options.hg: Sahi, healthy diet se syphilis theek hota hai

explain.en: Fitness does not cure syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia or HIV. Untreated, they can cause lasting damage and spread to partners. Testing and the right medicines are what work.
explain.hg: Fitness se syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia ya HIV theek nahi hote. Bina ilaaj ke yeh lamba nuksaan kar sakte hain aur partners tak phail sakte hain. Test aur sahi dawa hi kaam karti hai.

q.en: Can people who inject drugs lower their risk of HIV and hepatitis?
q.hg: Kya injection se drugs lene wale log HIV aur hepatitis ka risk kam kar sakte hain?

options.en: Yes, by sharing only with friends
options.hg: Haan, sirf doston ke saath share karke

options.en: No, nothing at all can lower the risk
options.hg: Nahi, kuch bhi risk kam nahi kar sakta

options.en: Yes, by never sharing needles or syringes
options.hg: Haan, kabhi needle ya syringe share na karke

options.en: Yes, by rinsing needles with water
options.hg: Haan, needle ko paani se dhokar

explain.en: Sharing needles or syringes passes blood directly, spreading HIV and hepatitis B and C. Using a new sterile needle every time and government harm-reduction and treatment services greatly lower the risk.
explain.hg: Needle ya syringe share karne se khoon seedha jaata hai, jisse HIV aur hepatitis B aur C phailte hain. Har baar naya sterile needle aur government ki harm-reduction aur treatment services se risk bahut kam hota hai.

q.en: A blood test shows Ankit has syphilis. He feels fine. Should he still get treated?
q.hg: Blood test mein Ankit ko syphilis nikla. Woh theek mehsoos karta hai. Kya phir bhi ilaaj karana chahiye?

options.en: No, feeling fine means it has gone
options.hg: Nahi, theek feel karna matlab chala gaya

options.en: Only if the sore appears again later
options.hg: Sirf agar baad mein sore dobara aaye

options.en: Yes, it can harm organs later without symptoms
options.hg: Haan, bina symptoms ke bhi baad mein organs ko nuksaan karta hai

options.en: Only if his partner also starts to feel unwell later
options.hg: Sirf agar baad mein partner bhi bimaar feel kare

explain.en: Syphilis can stay hidden for years and later damage the heart, brain, nerves and eyes. It is easy to cure with antibiotics, and partners should be tested and treated too.
explain.hg: Syphilis saalon tak chhupa reh sakta hai aur baad mein dil, dimaag, nerves aur aankhon ko nuksaan kar sakta hai. Antibiotics se yeh aasaani se theek hota hai, aur partners ka bhi test aur ilaaj hona chahiye.

q.en: Why is guessing your STI risk from a partner's looks, job or 'good family' a mistake?
q.hg: Partner ke looks, naukri ya 'achhe ghar' se apna STI risk andaza lagana galti kyun hai?

options.en: Educated people are immune to STIs
options.hg: Padhe-likhe log STI se immune hote hain

options.en: STIs only affect people in some jobs
options.hg: STI sirf kuch naukriyon walon ko hota hai

options.en: Infections don't show; only tests can tell
options.hg: Infection dikhta nahi; sirf test bata sakta hai

options.en: Families can tell if someone is infected
options.hg: Family bata sakti hai kisi ko infection hai ya nahi

explain.en: STIs affect people of every background, and many cause no symptoms. Judging by looks or status gives false comfort. Honest talk, testing and condoms are what actually lower risk.
explain.hg: STIs har background ke logon ko hote hain, aur kai ke koi symptoms nahi hote. Looks ya status se judge karna jhootha sukoon deta hai. Imaandaar baat, test aur condom hi asli risk kam karte hain.

q.en: What should someone expect at a first visit to a Suraksha Clinic?
q.hg: Suraksha Clinic ki pehli visit par kya expect karna chahiye?

options.en: A large fee before anyone talks to you
options.hg: Baat karne se pehle badi fees

options.en: Private questions, tests and free treatment
options.hg: Private sawaal, tests aur free ilaaj

options.en: A police officer recording a statement
options.hg: Police officer ka statement likhna

options.en: Being asked to bring parents and spouse
options.hg: Parents aur spouse ko saath laane ko kaha jaana

explain.en: Staff ask about symptoms and sexual history in private, may examine you, take samples and offer treatment and counselling free of cost. Being honest helps them choose the right tests.
explain.hg: Staff private mein symptoms aur sexual history poochte hain, zaroorat ho toh examine karte hain, samples lete hain aur free mein ilaaj aur counselling dete hain. Imaandaari se bataane par woh sahi tests chun paate hain.

q.en: A friend got a blood transfusion at a licensed hospital and now fears HIV. What is true?
q.hg: Ek dost ko licensed hospital mein blood chadha aur ab use HIV ka darr hai. Kya sach hai?

options.en: Every transfusion carries a high HIV risk
options.hg: Har transfusion mein HIV ka bada risk hai

options.en: Donated blood is screened, so risk is very low
options.hg: Donate kiya blood screen hota hai, risk bahut kam hai

options.en: Transfused blood is never tested at all
options.hg: Chadhaya gaya blood kabhi test hi nahi hota

options.en: Only blood from women carries HIV
options.hg: Sirf women ka blood HIV le jaata hai

explain.en: Licensed blood banks test donated blood for HIV, hepatitis B and C, syphilis and malaria, which makes transfusion very safe. Anyone worried can still talk to a doctor or call 1097.
explain.hg: Licensed blood banks donate kiye blood ko HIV, hepatitis B aur C, syphilis aur malaria ke liye test karte hain, jisse transfusion bahut safe hota hai. Fikar ho toh doctor se baat karo ya 1097 call karo.

q.en: Is it safe to donate blood at a licensed blood bank?
q.hg: Kya licensed blood bank mein blood donate karna safe hai?

options.en: Only for people who are over 50
options.hg: Sirf 50 saal se upar walon ke liye

options.en: Only if you bring your own needle
options.hg: Sirf agar apna needle laao

options.en: No, donors can catch HIV from the blood bank machine
options.hg: Nahi, donors ko blood bank ki machine se HIV ho sakta hai

options.en: Yes, each donor gets a new sterile needle
options.hg: Haan, har donor ko naya sterile needle milta hai

explain.en: Donating blood cannot give you HIV, because licensed blood banks use sterile, single-use equipment for every donor. The myth stops many people from donating.
explain.hg: Blood donate karne se HIV nahi ho sakta, kyunki licensed blood banks har donor ke liye sterile, ek baar wala equipment use karte hain. Yeh myth bahut logon ko donate karne se rokta hai.

q.en: Which person is the best one to ask for reliable information about STIs?
q.hg: STIs ke baare mein reliable information ke liye sabse achha kisse poochna hai?

options.en: An older friend who 'knows everything'
options.hg: Bada dost jo 'sab jaanta hai'

options.en: A doctor, counsellor or the 1097 helpline
options.hg: Doctor, counsellor ya 1097 helpline

options.en: A 'gupt rog' ad in the newspaper
options.hg: Akhbaar ka 'gupt rog' ad

options.en: Random comments on social media
options.hg: Social media ke random comments

explain.en: Doctors, trained counsellors, Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics and the NACO helpline 1097 give accurate, confidential information. Friends, ads and comments often repeat myths.
explain.hg: Doctor, trained counsellor, Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics aur NACO helpline 1097 sahi, confidential information dete hain. Dost, ads aur comments aksar myths dohraate hain.

q.en: After a sexual assault, why should a survivor reach a hospital as soon as possible, even before deciding about a police complaint?
q.hg: Sexual assault ke baad survivor ko police complaint ka faisla karne se pehle bhi jaldi se jaldi hospital kyun jaana chahiye?

options.en: Treatment depends on proving the assault
options.hg: Ilaaj assault prove karne par depend karta hai

options.en: Hospitals will only treat survivors within the first 6 hours
options.hg: Hospital survivors ka ilaaj sirf pehle 6 ghante mein karte hain

options.en: HIV PEP must start within 72 hours, and treatment is free
options.hg: HIV PEP 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi hai, aur ilaaj free hai

options.en: Survivors must pay unless police come along
options.hg: Police saath na aaye toh survivor ko paisa dena padta hai

explain.en: PEP to prevent HIV must start within 72 hours, emergency contraception works best early, and STI care can begin too. Hospitals must treat survivors free of cost; reporting can be decided separately.
explain.hg: HIV rokne wali PEP 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye, emergency contraception jaldi lene par behtar kaam karti hai, aur STI care bhi shuru ho sakti hai. Hospitals ko survivors ka free ilaaj karna hota hai; report karne ka faisla alag se ho sakta hai.

q.en: Which statement about condoms and STIs is accurate?
q.hg: Condom aur STIs ke baare mein kaunsi baat sahi hai?

options.en: They work against STIs only if used with oil
options.hg: Tel ke saath use karne par hi STIs se bachaate hain

options.en: They greatly cut risk but don't remove it
options.hg: Yeh risk bahut kam karte hain par khatam nahi

options.en: They block every STI completely
options.hg: Yeh har STI ko poori tarah rokte hain

options.en: They protect only against pregnancy
options.hg: Yeh sirf pregnancy se bachaate hain

explain.en: Used correctly every time, condoms are highly effective against HIV, gonorrhoea and chlamydia, and lower the risk of herpes, HPV and syphilis, which can spread from uncovered skin.
explain.hg: Har baar sahi use karne par condom HIV, gonorrhoea aur chlamydia ke against bahut effective hain, aur herpes, HPV aur syphilis ka risk kam karte hain, jo bina cover wali skin se phail sakte hain.

q.en: Priya notices a cluster of small painful blisters on her genitals. What is the best step?
q.hg: Priya ko genitals par chhote dard wale chhaalon ka jhund dikhta hai. Sabse achha step kya hai?

options.en: Burst the blisters to let them heal faster
options.hg: Chhaale phod do taaki jaldi theek hon

options.en: Ignore it; blisters there are always from heat
options.hg: Ignore karo; wahan chhaale hamesha garmi se hote hain

options.en: Apply toothpaste to dry them
options.hg: Sukhane ke liye toothpaste lagao

options.en: See a doctor soon; it may be herpes
options.hg: Jaldi doctor ko dikhao; yeh herpes ho sakta hai

explain.en: Painful genital blisters are a common sign of herpes. A doctor can confirm it and give antiviral medicine, which works best if started early. Avoid sexual contact until they heal and get advice.
explain.hg: Genitals par dard wale chhaale herpes ka common sign hain. Doctor confirm karke antiviral dawa de sakte hain, jo jaldi shuru karne par behtar kaam karti hai. Theek hone tak sexual contact se bacho aur salah lo.

q.en: A friend says, 'I used a condom, so I can skip my STI check-up forever.' What is true?
q.hg: Ek dost kehta hai, 'Maine condom use kiya, toh STI check-up kabhi nahi chahiye.' Kya sach hai?

options.en: Regular checks still make sense if sexually active
options.hg: Sexually active ho toh regular check ab bhi samajhdaari hai

options.en: Condoms make check-ups completely unnecessary
options.hg: Condom se check-up ki bilkul zaroorat nahi

options.en: Check-ups themselves can spread infections
options.hg: Check-up se hi infection phail sakta hai

options.en: Check-ups are only meant for people who skip condoms
options.hg: Check-up sirf bina condom walon ke liye hote hain

explain.en: Condoms lower risk a lot, but they can break or slip, and some infections spread through skin not covered. Periodic testing catches silent infections early, when they are easiest to treat.
explain.hg: Condom risk kaafi kam karte hain, par phat ya khisak sakte hain, aur kuch infections bina cover wali skin se phailte hain. Samay samay par test silent infections ko jaldi pakad leta hai, jab ilaaj sabse aasaan hota hai.

q.en: Under India's HIV Act, can a hospital refuse to treat or operate on a patient because they have HIV?
q.hg: India ke HIV Act ke tahat, kya hospital kisi patient ka ilaaj ya operation HIV ki wajah se mana kar sakta hai?

options.en: No, that is discrimination under the Act
options.hg: Nahi, yeh Act ke tahat discrimination hai

options.en: Yes, unless the patient pays extra
options.hg: Haan, jab tak patient extra paisa na de

options.en: Yes, if the surgery is not urgent
options.hg: Haan, agar surgery urgent na ho

options.en: Yes, private hospitals can choose
options.hg: Haan, private hospitals chun sakte hain

explain.en: Section 3 of the HIV Act, 2017 bars discrimination in healthcare. Standard infection-control precautions protect staff during any procedure, so HIV status is no reason to refuse care.
explain.hg: HIV Act, 2017 ka Section 3 healthcare mein discrimination ko mana karta hai. Standard infection-control precautions kisi bhi procedure mein staff ko protect karte hain, toh HIV status ilaaj mana karne ki wajah nahi hai.

q.en: In 2024-25, people who walked into HIV testing on their own made up only 14% of tests in India but had the highest positivity. What does that suggest?
q.hg: 2024-25 mein India mein khud se HIV test karane aaye log sirf 14% tests the par unki positivity sabse zyada thi. Isse kya pata chalta hai?

options.en: Only walk-in clients can ever get HIV
options.hg: Sirf walk-in clients ko hi HIV ho sakta hai

options.en: Walk-in testing should be stopped completely
options.hg: Walk-in testing poori tarah band honi chahiye

options.en: Self-referred testing finds many infections
options.hg: Khud se aakar test karane wale bahut infections pakadte hain

options.en: Testing itself makes people HIV-positive
options.hg: Test karane se hi log HIV-positive ho jaate hain

explain.en: India ran 4.13 crore HIV tests among at-risk clients in 2024-25, with 0.40% positive, while walk-ins had 1.1% positivity. Making testing easy, free and stigma-free helps people who suspect a risk come forward.
explain.hg: India ne 2024-25 mein at-risk clients ke 4.13 crore HIV tests kiye, jinme 0.40% positive the, jabki walk-ins mein positivity 1.1% thi. Testing ko aasaan, free aur bina stigma ka banane se jinhe risk lagta hai woh aage aate hain.
